Mammaaksa_AO: Aarri garaa seene, arrii dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Anger/grief that enters the belly (inside) is gray hair
Meaning_AO: Aarii, dhiphina yookaan gadda garaatti ukkaamsanii ta'uun qaama fi sammuu namaa miidhee dafee nama dulloomsa
Meaning_EN: Bottling up anger, stress, or sorrow inside damages one's physical and mental health, leading to premature aging
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko aarii yookaan dhiphina garaatti baatee of miidhu gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when advising someone who is harboring resentment, stress, or silent grief to let it go because it causes harm to oneself
Keywords_AO: aara; garaa; arrii; dhiphina; dulloomuu
Keywords_EN: anger; grief; gray hair; stress; premature aging

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni aaru, hin gabbatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who gets angry does not grow fat/thrive
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo hunda dallanu fi dhiphatu nagaa waan hin arganneef qaamaanis ta'ee jireenyaan hin dagaagu
Meaning_EN: A person consumed by chronic anger and stress lacks peace of mind, which prevents them from thriving physically, emotionally, or materially
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dallansuu baay'isuun miidhamaa jiru tokkoof nagaa fi obsi akka barbaachisu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone prone to constant anger that resentment and fury undermine health, peace, and prosperity
Keywords_AO: nama; aaru; gabbachuu; aarii; dhiphina
Keywords_EN: person; anger; thrive; weight gain; stress; health

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni aaru, dafeeti dullooma
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who gets angry ages quickly
Meaning_AO: Dhiphinni fi aariin walirraa hin cinne sammuu fi qaama namaa dadhabsiisuun nama moofeessee umurii malee nama dulloomsa
Meaning_EN: Persistent anger and emotional turmoil wear down the body and mind, accelerating the physical and mental aging process
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama yeroo hunda dallanuu fi dhiphatuuf tasgabbii fi obsi fayyaaf akka barbaachisu gorsan itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind an irritable or easily frustrated person that harboring constant anger takes a heavy toll on health and hastens old age
Keywords_AO: nama; aaru; dafee; dulloomuu; aarii; tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: person; anger; quickly; aging; stress; composure

Mammaaksa_AO: Ibiddi garaa, foon hin waadu
Translation_Literal_EN: The fire inside the belly does not roast meat
Meaning_AO: Aarii fi gaddi garaatti ukkaamsan nama keessaa gubee ofii nama miidha malee bu'aa tokkollee hin qabu, rakkoos hin furu
Meaning_EN: Silent anger and suppressed resentment burn a person from within without accomplishing anything productive or solving the underlying problem
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko aariidhaan garaa keessaa gubatu aariin isaa bu'aa akka hin qabne fi ofuma miidhuu malee homaa akka hin fayyanne gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone holding deep inner resentment that their unexpressed fury only harms themselves and yields no positive outcome
Keywords_AO: ibidda; garaa; foon; waaduu; aarii; of-miidhaa
Keywords_EN: fire; belly; meat; roast; resentment; self-destruction

Mammaaksa_AO: Aarri garaa, foon hin waadu
Translation_Literal_EN: The smoke (or anger) of the belly does not roast meat
Meaning_AO: Aariin garaa keessatti boba'ee aaru ofuma nama keessaa miidhuu malee faayidaa qabatamaa hin qabu, bu'aa tokkollee hin fidu
Meaning_EN: Fuming silently and holding inner rage only suffocates and damages the person experiencing it, without producing any tangible result or remedy
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko aariidhaan dhiphatee of keessatti gubatu, aariin sun homaa akka isa hin fayyanne gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone who is brooding or smoldering with anger that silent fury is futile and only harms oneself
Keywords_AO: aara; garaa; foon; waaduu; aarii; bu'aa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: smoke; anger; belly; meat; roast; brooding; futility

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama hin dhaalletti, hin aarani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not get angry at someone who does not inherit from them
Meaning_AO: Nama hariiroo dhiigaa, dhaala yookaan itti-gaafatamummaa waliin hin qabneetti aaruun bu'aa hin qabu; namni alagaarratti aarii ofii hin gubu
Meaning_EN: It is pointless to waste emotional energy or anger on someone with whom you have no kinship, stake, or mutual responsibility
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko amala yookaan balleessaa nama itti dhiheenya hin qabneetti aaree dhiphatu, aariin isaa gatii akka hin qabne gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone not to fret or get aggravated over a stranger or someone outside their circle of responsibility
Keywords_AO: nama; dhaaluu; aaruu; alagaa; hariiroo; daangaa
Keywords_EN: person; inherit; anger; stranger; kinship; emotional boundaries

Mammaaksa_AO: Hunda yaamnaan, hundi hafe
Translation_Literal_EN: When everyone was invited, everyone stayed behind
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokkorratti hunda akka walii-galaatti yoo waamaniifi nama adda baasanii itti-gaafatamummaa hin kennineef, namuu itti-dhimmamuu dhabee hundi hafa
Meaning_EN: When a call or responsibility is directed at everyone without specific accountability, no one feels personally obligated, resulting in total absence or inaction
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo waamichi yookaan hojiin tokko hundaaf dhihaatee sababa itti-gaafatamummaa dhuunfaa dhabameef namni tokkollee dhimma hin qabaanne akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the pitfall of general, unfocused invitations or tasks where lack of personal responsibility leads to collective failure
Keywords_AO: hunda; yaamuu; hafuu; itti-gaafatamummaa; afeerraa
Keywords_EN: everyone; invite; absence; accountability; responsibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Takka loluun dhiirummaa dha, keeysa ooluun gadhummaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Fighting once is bravery, but dwelling continuously in it is pettiness/disgrace
Meaning_AO: Yeroo dhimmi barbaadetti morkatanii ofirraa ittisuun gootummaa ta'us, jibba fi lola dheeressanii yeroo hunda keessa jiraachuun gadhummaa fi salphina
Meaning_EN: Standing up for oneself in conflict when necessary demonstrates courage, but holding grudges and perpetually prolonging hostility is petty and dishonorable
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni wal lolan araaramuu didanii lola fi jibba dheeressan, nagaa fi jaarsummaatti akka deebi'an gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in conflict mediation to persuade disputants to lay down arms and reconcile, reminding them that perpetual animosity is disgraceful
Keywords_AO: loluu; dhiirummaa; keessa ooluu; gadhummaa; araara; nagaa
Keywords_EN: fighting; courage; holding grudges; pettiness; reconciliation; peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Aarri ijoollee namaa, hidhii jala nama guba
Translation_Literal_EN: The anger caused by someone else's children burns one under the lip
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen nama alagaa yoo balleessaa raawwatte akka ijoollee ofiitti ifachuu fi adabuun waan hin danda'amneef, aarii fi dallansuu hidhii qabatanii garaatti ukkaamsanii dhiphachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The frustration caused by another person's children must be swallowed in silence because one lacks the social freedom to discipline or rebuke them as one's own, causing internal distress
Theme_EN: Restraint in Discipline and Suppressed Anger
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen nama biraa aarii fi miidhaa geessistee garuu sodaa maatii isaaniitiif yookaan safeeffannaaf jecha ifachuu dhabanii aarii garaatti dhiisan ibsuuf fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone is troubled or provoked by other people's children but is forced to suppress their annoyance and bite their tongue out of social courtesy or respect for the parents
Keywords_AO: aara; ijoollee namaa; hidhii; gubaa; aarii ukkaamsuu; safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: anger; someone else's children; lip; burn; suppressed frustration; social restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakkakkaan qara sodaate, jinfutti bu'a
Translation_Literal_EN: Lightning, fearing the sharp point, strikes the blunt end
Meaning_AO: Humna cimaa yookaan nama jabaa dura dhaabbachuu sodaatanii, humnuma ofii nama dadhabaa fi ofirraa hin qabnetti agarsiisuu yookaan irratti roorrisuu
Meaning_EN: Avoiding a strong or formidable opponent out of cowardice only to vent aggression on or oppress the weak and defenseless
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko isa humna qabu sodaatee, aarii yookaan gootummaa sobaa nama dadhabaa fi harka-qalleessarra baasu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize or ridicule someone who cowers before the strong and powerful but bullies and vents their frustration on the weak
Keywords_AO: bakkakkaa; qara; jinfuu; sodaachuu; dabeessa; roorroo
Keywords_EN: lightning; sharp point; blunt end; cowardice; bullying; displacement

Mammaaksa_AO: Onneellee dhaban, sonbaatu nama duta
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if one lacks a heart, the lungs bark at a person
Meaning_AO: Gootummaa fi murannoo dhugaa osoo hin qabaatin, waca fi dhaadannoo sobaatiin akka nama jabaatti of agarsiisuuf yaaluu
Meaning_EN: Putting on an aggressive, loud, or boastful front to intimidate others despite lacking genuine courage, conviction, or inner strength; empty bravado
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dabeessi yookaan humna hin qabne tokko afaaniin dutaa fi dheekkataa akka waan onnee qabuutti of dhiheessu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule or dismiss someone who blusters and makes aggressive empty threats to mask their lack of real courage
Keywords_AO: onnee; sonba; dutuu; dhaadannoo sobaa; dabeessummaa
Keywords_EN: heart; lung; bark; bravado; cowardice; bluffing

Mammaaksa_AO: Aarri, arrii dha nama baasisa
Translation_Literal_EN: Anger causes a person to sprout gray hair
Meaning_AO: Aarii, gaddaa fi dhiphina walirraa hin cinne keessa jiraachuun qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidhee dafee nama dulloomsa
Meaning_EN: Chronic anger, grief, and emotional distress take a severe toll on the mind and body, bringing about premature aging and gray hair
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko aariidhaan of dhiphisee yaaddoo baay'isu, aariin fayyaa fi dargaggummaa namaa akka balleessu gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone consumed by perpetual anger or worry, reminding them that negative emotions physically hasten aging and destroy vitality
Keywords_AO: aara; arrii; baasisuu; dulloomuu; dhiphina; fayyaa
Keywords_EN: anger; gray hair; sprouting; aging; stress; emotional toll

Mammaaksa_AO: "Tole je'ee sii laannaan, na keeysa laallattaa" jette, intalti
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Because I said okay and gave it to you, are you now looking inside me?' said the maiden
Meaning_AO: Gaarummaa, tola yookaan eeyyama namaaf godhan akka laaftuutti fudhatanii daangaa darbuu fi fedhii daangaa hin qabneen nama dhiphisuu
Meaning_EN: Taking unfair advantage of someone's kindness, tolerance, or concession by overstepping personal boundaries; giving an inch and taking a mile
Theme_EN: Abuse of Kindness and Boundary Violation
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko tola oolmaa yookaan arjummaa isaaf godhame tuffatee daangaa darbee dabalataan nama rakkisu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who exploits another person's goodwill, leniency, or hospitality to intrude or make excessive, disrespectful demands
Keywords_AO: tole; kennuu; keessa laallachuu; intala; daangaa darbuu; arjummaa
Keywords_EN: consent; generosity; boundary overstepping; greed; entitlement; taking advantage

Mammaaksa_AO: "Niitiin ani biraa harree salu, ormi haroo arbi dhiite godha" je'e, kan niitiirratti nama qabe
Translation_Literal_EN: 'The wife beside whom I would rather mate with a donkey, outsiders turn into a pond trampled by an elephant,' said the man who caught another with his wife
Meaning_AO: Wanta abbaan ofii tuffatee gate yookaan faayidaa hin qabne jedhee dhiise, namoonni biraa akka waan gati-jabeessa ta'eetti irratti daddafanii wal saamuuf figuu qishnaan agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Satirizes people who aggressively covet, scramble over, or inflate the value of something that its owner disregards, neglects, or finds entirely worthless
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni wanta abbaan tuffatee dhiise yookaan dhimma hin baafne tokko akka wanta guddaatti fudhatanii irratti wal saamanitti qishnaaf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically when outsiders covet, quarrel over, or make a chaotic fuss over something the rightful owner deems negligible or undesirable
Keywords_AO: niitii; harree; haroo; arba; tuffii; qishnaa; orma
Keywords_EN: wife; donkey; pond; elephant; infidelity; disdain; irony; covetousness

Mammaaksa_AO: Buli buli jedhanii, kophaa nama bulchani
Translation_Literal_EN: They say 'Spend the night, spend the night,' yet they make one spend the night alone
Meaning_AO: Afaaniin afeeranii fi simannaa mi'aawaa fakkeessanii, dhuma irratti garuu nama gatuu fi kophummaatti nama dhiisuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Extending polite invitations or warm promises only to abandon the person without real hospitality, care, or support when they actually stay; hollow courtesy
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsaa fi waamicha nama biraatiin amanee hafee booda garuu gargaarsa dhabee kophummaan dhiphatu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone is persuaded by polite insistence or friendly entreaties to stay or commit, only to be completely neglected and left isolated
Keywords_AO: buluu; kophaa; fakkeessummaa; keessummaa; waadaa sobaa
Keywords_EN: stay overnight; alone; hollow hospitality; neglect; superficiality

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaaniif maraatee, danfa dhuga
Translation_Literal_EN: Desperate for water, one drinks boiling water
Meaning_AO: Fedhii yookaan dhiphina hamaadhaan muddamee osoo hin tasgabbaayin furmaata barbaaduun, wanta nama gubu fi miidhaa guddaa fidu keessa of buusuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Driven by reckless desperation or extreme thirst, a person rushes into a dangerous remedy that scalds and ruins them rather than satisfying their need
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dharraa yookaan rakkoo isa qabee jiruuf jedhee jarjaree karaa badii fi miidhaa fidu filatu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone against letting sheer desperation or impatience blind them into adopting a ruinous quick-fix that causes more harm than good
Keywords_AO: bishaan; maraachuu; danfa; dhuguu; jarjara; obsa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: water; desperation; boiling water; drinking; rashness; impatience

Mammaaksa_AO: "Maaliif kofalta?" jennaan, "Ilkeetu na adii dha, rifeensaatu na gurraacha" jette
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked 'Why are you laughing?', she replied, 'My teeth are white, and my hair is black'
Meaning_AO: Bakka hin malleetti kofluu fi sababa bu'aa hin qabneen bareedina ofii mul'isuuf jecha of jajuu, koora fi qaanfii dhabuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Laughing inappropriately or putting on frivolous displays merely to show off superficial physical vanity; offering silly, self-absorbed excuses for unbecoming behavior
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko bakka hin malleetti koflee yookaan sababa gahaa malee bareedina qaamaa fi uffataatiin of jajee namatti of mul'isuu barbaadu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock or critique someone behaving frivolously and drawing attention to themselves merely to show off superficial attractiveness
Keywords_AO: kofaluu; ilkee; adii; rifeensa; gurraacha; of jajuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: laughing; teeth; white; hair; black; vanity; superficiality

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan du'e awwaalle, kan jiru afaan wallaalle
Translation_Literal_EN: We buried the one who died; [yet] we failed to understand the words/language of the one who lives
Meaning_AO: Wanta darbe fi du'a sirnaan geggeessuun salphaa ta'us, fedhii, yaada fi amala nama jiru hubachuunii fi quubsuun baay'ee ulfaataa akka ta'e ibsa
Meaning_EN: While burying the dead and resolving past tragedies is straightforward, understanding, managing, and satisfying the unpredictable behavior and complaints of the living is endlessly perplexing
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko amala, komii fi fedhii nama jiru hubachuu dadhabee yookaan quubsuu dadhabee abdii kutatu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to voice frustration or bewilderment when dealing with difficult, fickle, or impossible-to-please people whose intentions cannot be understood
Keywords_AO: du'uu; awwaaluu; jiraachuu; afaan; wallaaluu; amala namaa
Keywords_EN: death; burial; living; language; misunderstanding; human nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi abbaan abaare, gufuu teeysu dheeysa
Translation_Literal_EN: The son cursed by his father flees from a sitting tree stump
Meaning_AO: Namni abaarsa maatii baatee fi qalbii qulqulluu hin qabne nagaa fi jagnummaa dhabee, wanta homaa isa hin goone iyyuu naasuu fi sodaadhaan dheessa
Meaning_EN: A child bearing a parental curse lacks inner peace and fortitude; burdened by guilt, paranoia, and misfortune, they live in perpetual terror, jumping at shadows and harmless obstacles
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ulfina maatiitiif qabaniifi miidhaa abaarsi maatii nama irraan gahu akeekkachiisan, yookaan nama balleessaadhaan yaaddoo fi sodaa keessa gale ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against parental disobedience by emphasizing that a parent's curse breeds perpetual fear and misfortune, or to depict someone terrified by harmless things out of guilt
Keywords_AO: ilma; abbaa; abaaruu; gufuu; dheessuu; abaarsa; sodaa; safuu
Keywords_EN: son; father; curse; tree stump; flee; paranoia; guilt; parental curse

Mammaaksa_AO: Abaarsa qabaatan, gaangee abaaramte fe'atan
Translation_Literal_EN: If one carries a curse, one saddles a cursed mule
Meaning_AO: Namni carraa hamaa yookaan abaarsa qabu wantuma akkasaatti carraa hin qabnee fi firii hin baafne waliin walitti dhufuun rakkoo ofii dachaa godhata
Meaning_EN: A person plagued by misfortune or ill fate often compounds their misery by pairing with something equally barren, ill-omened, or unproductive; misfortune attracts misfortune
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni rakkoo fi carraa dhabuu keessa jiru tokko filannoo dogoggoraatiin rakkoo biraa kan duraan jiru caalu ofitti fidu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an already unfortunate or cursed situation is aggravated by adopting another equally flawed or unproductive partner, tool, or decision
Keywords_AO: abaarsa; gaangee; fe'achuu; abaaramuu; carraa hamaa; rakkoo
Keywords_EN: curse; mule; saddling; misfortune; bad luck; barrenness

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'a abaarsa qabu, kalloon isaa dibbe taati
Translation_Literal_EN: The cow that carries a curse, its hide becomes a drum
Meaning_AO: Namni carraa hin qabne yookaan abaaramte jireenya keessatti qofa osoo hin taane, erga dhumateeyyuu dhiphinni fi tumiinsi walirraa hin cinne hordofee miidhamuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: An ill-fated or cursed person cannot escape suffering; their misfortunes follow them relentlessly, like the hide of an unlucky cow turned into a drum only to be perpetually beaten
Theme_AO: Carraa Dhabuu fi Dhiphina Walirraa Hin Cinne
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko carraa dhabee yookaan abaarsi itti heeddummatee rakkoo fi dhiphinni walitti aansee irraa hin cinne dhiphatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe someone who seems perpetually plagued by misfortune and hardship, where troubles relentlessly pursue them without relief
Keywords_AO: sa'a; abaarsa; kalloo; dibbee; rukuttamuu; carraa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: cow; curse; hide; drum; beating; perpetual misfortune

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhadhaa ibidda bu'e, rabbi si haa godhu
Translation_Literal_EN: May God make you like butter that fell into the fire
Meaning_AO: Abaarsa cimaa ta'ee, namni sun akkuma dhadhaa ibidda keessatti baqe dhabamuutti dafee akka lafarraa dhabamu, dhumatu fi faana dhabu hawwuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: A severe traditional curse wishing that someone swiftly perishes, melts into complete ruin, and vanishes without a trace, just like butter dropped into a fire
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko miidhaa yookaan yakka hamaa uumee abaarsi hadhaawaan badiisa fi manca'iinsa isaa hawwu irratti darbatamutti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when casting a fierce, severe curse against an egregious wrongdoer or bitter enemy, wishing for their immediate obliteration and eradication
Keywords_AO: dhadhaa; ibidda; rabbi; abaarsa; baduu; manca'iinsa
Keywords_EN: butter; fire; God; curse; obliteration; destruction

Mammaaksa_AO: Cilee bishaan buute, rabbi si haa godhu
Translation_Literal_EN: May God make you like charcoal that fell into water
Meaning_AO: Abaarsa cimaa dha; humni, ifti fi lubbuun nama sunii akkuma cilee bishaan keessa buutee tasa dhaamteetti akka dhaamu, akka baduufi deebi'ee hin kaanetti akka dhabamu hawwuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: A severe traditional curse wishing that a person's vitality, power, and life be permanently snuffed out and rendered utterly dead and powerless, like burning charcoal extinguished in water
Theme_EN: Severe Curses and Extinction of Vitality
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo miidhaa guddaan nama irra gahee abaarsa hadhaawaadhaan humni fi jiruu nama sanaa akka guutummaatti dhaamu hawwanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when casting a harsh traditional curse against a severe offender or sworn enemy, wishing that their life, influence, and energy be completely extinguished
Keywords_AO: cilee; bishaan; rabbi; abaarsa; dhaamuu; baduu
Keywords_EN: charcoal; water; God; curse; extinguish; powerlessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi abboomii abbaa dide, abaarsa hin didu
Translation_Literal_EN: A son who defies his father's counsel cannot defy (escape) the curse
Meaning_AO: Namni gorsa fi ajaja maatii ofii tuffatee dide, badiisaa fi abaarsa maatiirraa dhufu jalaa miliquu hin danda'u; badii fi kufaatiitu isa mudata
Meaning_EN: A child who rebels against parental guidance and authority cannot evade the inevitable misfortune, ruin, and curse that follows filial disobedience
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen abboommii maatii tuffattee sirna hawaasaa cabsitutti badiisa dhufuuf jiru akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution rebellious or disrespectful youth that defying parental wisdom invariably brings about severe curses and downfall
Keywords_AO: ilma; abboommii; abbaa; diduu; abaarsa; safuu
Keywords_EN: son; obedience; father; defiance; curse; filial piety

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbi, buqqee caphxeen si haa waraabsisu
Translation_Literal_EN: May God make you draw water with a cracked calabash
Meaning_AO: Abaarsa cimaa dha; hojiin, carraaqqiin fi jiruun nama sanaa akkuma bishaan buqqee cabe keessaa yaa'ee baduutti akka dhangala'ee bu'aa malee hafu hawwuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: A severe traditional curse wishing that a person's labor, wealth, and endeavors leak away fruitlessly into complete futility, like water drawn with a broken gourd
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko daba hamaa raawwatee dadhabbiin fi qabeenyi isaa hundi firii malee akka dhangala'u abaaranitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a harsh curse wishing that all of an adversary's hard work, earnings, and projects leak away in perpetual loss and frustration
Keywords_AO: rabbi; buqqee; caphuu; waraabuu; abaarsa; kasaaraa
Keywords_EN: God; calabash; cracked; draw water; curse; futility; fruitlessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbi ilillii dikee irraan biqilte si haa godhu
Translation_Literal_EN: May God make you a flower sprouted upon a dung heap
Meaning_AO: Abaarsa cimaa dha; akkuma ililliin dikee/kosii irratti biqilte sababa xuriidhaan marfamteef namni fuudhee hin faayyanne fi hin safeeffanne, atis hawaasa keessatti gatami, tuffatami, kabaja dhabi jechuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: A severe traditional curse wishing that one becomes like a flower rooted in filth—untouchable, shunned, and degraded so that no one values, plucks, or welcomes them into honorable society
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko balleessaa hamaa raawwatee namuu akka itti hin dhihaanne, akka salphatu fi hawaasaan tuffatamu abaaranitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to cast a bitter curse on an offender wishing complete social estrangement and revulsion upon them, rendering them untouchable and despised
Keywords_AO: rabbi; ilillii; dikee; biqiluu; abaarsa; tuffatamuu; salphina
Keywords_EN: God; flower; dung heap; sprout; curse; ostracism; contempt

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi abaarsa haadhaa qabu, "Rooba keessaan dhukkee kaasa" je'eeti, fiiga

Keywords_AO: ilma; abaarsa haadhaa; rooba; dhukkee; fiiguu; maraatummaa
Keywords_EN: son; mother's curse; rain; dust; running; folly; delusion

Mammaaksa_AO: "Ani kaniin ureen cuqqaalaa inni kan ure haa cuqqaaluu" jette, jaartiin midhaan dhiiftee lootii gurraa bitatte
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I will plug the hole I pierced; let him who pierced the other hole plug his own,' said the woman who skipped buying grain and bought earrings instead

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko osoo beelli fi rakkoon mana guutee jiruu qabeenya isaatti fayyadamee wantoota faayidaa hin qabne bitu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who neglects life's vital necessities or household welfare to waste money on frivolous vanity and showy adornments
Keywords_AO: uruu; cuqqaaluu; jaartii; midhaan; lootii gurraa; dursa dhabuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: pierce; plug; grain; earrings; misplaced priorities; vanity; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbi biraan shiira
Translation_Literal_EN: With God (in the presence of God) is fertile land
Meaning_AO: Rabbi bira gabbina, barakaa fi badhaadhina qofatu jira; namni Rabbitti hirkatee fi abdii godhate gonkumaa hin honga'u, eebba fi quufa argata
Meaning_EN: With God there is abundant provision, fertility, and prosperity; whoever places their faith and reliance in God flourishes and never suffers true spiritual or material barrenness

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm profound faith in divine providence, reminding people that steadfast reliance on God brings enduring fruitfulness, abundance, and relief from hardship

Keywords_EN: God; fertile land; abundance; blessing; providence; prosperity

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamilee fi dhuufuun, garaa namaatii hin dhumani
Translation_Literal_EN: Ambition and gas never run out from a person's belly
Meaning_AO: Hamma lubbuun jirtutti fedhiin, hawwiin fi yaadi namaa yeroo hunda haaromaa jiraata malee gonkumaa keessaa hin dhumu
Meaning_EN: As long as human beings live, ambition, desires, and inner urges continually renew themselves and never truly deplete
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko umuriin yoo deemeyyuu hawwii fi kajeellaa adda addaa qabaachuu isaa qishnaan yookaan dhugaa uumamaatiin ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously or philosophically to observe that human desires, hopes, and inner cravings remain restless and never expire throughout life
Keywords_AO: hamilee; dhuufuu; garaa; dhumuu; hawwii; fedhii
Keywords_EN: ambition; gas; belly; endless desires; human nature; vitality

Mammaaksa_AO: Qaamaatu dullooma malee, onneen hin dulloomtu
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the body that grows old, but the heart never ages
Meaning_AO: Namni umuriin yoo dabalateyyuu fi humnaan yoo laafe, fedhiin, jaalallii fi kaka'umsi keessa isaa yeroo hunda dargaggeessa ta'ee hafa
Meaning_EN: While the physical body inevitably ages and frails with time, the spirit, passion, emotional capacity, and heart remain forever youthful
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni maanguddoon fedhii fi yaada jabina qabu agarsiisan, yookaan umuriin onnee akka hin daangessine jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage elders or note that advancing age merely affects the outward body, whereas inner desire and will endure undiminished
Keywords_AO: qaama; dulloomuu; onnee; umurii; hawwii; qalbii
Keywords_EN: body; aging; heart; youthfulness; ageless spirit; desire

Mammaaksa_AO: Tan kutte gundo, tan hafte guddo
Translation_Literal_EN: What you have cut is a small basket, what remains is immense
Meaning_AO: Wanti hojjetamee yookaan dhumate muraasa yoo ta'u, wanti fuulduratti nama eeggatu yookaan hojjetamuu qabu baay'ee bal'aa ta'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: What has been completed or harvested is only a tiny portion compared to the vast tasks, journey, or responsibilities that still lie ahead
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko wanta xiqqoo hojjeteen boonee dagatu, daandiin fi hojiin fuuldura isa eeggatu bal'aa akka ta'e akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against premature complacency, reminding someone that their initial accomplishment is modest compared to the extensive journey ahead

Keywords_EN: cut; small basket; remain; vast; future; complacency

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabessi bakka takka nyaatetti sagal agaba
Translation_Literal_EN: The hyena, having eaten once in a place, starves nine times [waiting there]
Meaning_AO: Carraa yookaan bu'aa yeroo tokko argatanirratti qofa hirkachuun yeroo hedduu harka qullaa nama hambisa; iddoo tokkotti cichuun kasaaraa fida
Meaning_EN: Depending persistently on a one-time windfall or opportunity leads to repeated starvation and disappointment; one must actively seek new paths

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko bakka kanaan dura carraa tokko argatetti deddeebi'ee harka duwwaa hafu gorsanii gara hojii biraatti qajeelchuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone against loitering around a past source of luck, reminding them that perpetual expectation in the same spot yields only hunger

Keywords_EN: hyena; one place; eat; nine times; starvation; past luck

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama jiruutu waa hunda arga
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the living person who sees everything
Meaning_AO: Namni lubbuun dacheerra jiraatu wantoota dinqisiisaa, rakkisaa, gaarii fi hunda ijaan arguuf carraa qaba; jiraachuun barumsa hedduu nama gonfachiisa
Meaning_EN: So long as a person remains alive, they will witness the unexpected, miraculous, tragic, and astonishing wonders of human existence

Meaning_AO: Wanta dhuunfaatti bu'aa hin qabne yookaan jijjiirama hin fidne dharra'uu; wanti tokko ta'us dhiisus ofii hin fayyadne beekaa hawwuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Yearning for an outcome or change that brings no personal benefit or difference, or echoing general hopes despite remaining unaffected by them
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko wanta bu'aa isaaf hin fiduun orma wajjin faarfatu yookaan jijjiirama dhimma isaa hin tuqne arguuf jarjaru ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama

Translation_Literal_EN: The hyena howled in broad daylight out of joy over a dead donkey
Meaning_AO: Gammachuu daangaa darbe yookaan faayidaa tasa argameen of to'achuu dadhabanii adabaa fi eeggannoo dhabuun of saaxiluu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Losing all composure, decorum, and caution due to reckless excitement over an unexpected gain, thereby foolishly exposing oneself to danger
Theme_EN: Excessive Joy and Loss of Composure
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko bu'aa tasa argatetti garmalee gammadee saffisaan of saaxilu fi naamusa dhabu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaaffiin nama hin fayyiftu, qalbii nama wayyeessiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Inquiring after someone does not cure the disease, but it comforts the heart
Meaning_AO: Nama dhukkubsate yookaan dhiphate gaafachuun dhukkuba balleessuu baatus, sammuu fi qalbii isaa jajjabeeffatee nagaa fi abdii akka argatu godha
Meaning_EN: Inquiring after or visiting the sick does not medically cure their physical condition, but it uplifts their spirits and provides deep emotional comfort
Theme_EN: Visiting the Sick and Moral Support
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dhukkubsate yookaan rakkoo keessa jiru dubbisuun fi wal-bira dhaabbachuun bu'aa qalbii akka qabu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage compassion and solidarity, emphasizing that checking on the suffering soothes the human spirit even if it cannot remove physical pain

Translation_Literal_EN: 'One never knows the ways of God; call me Mother of Waaqoo,' said the childless old woman

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko wanta ta'uuf carraa hin qabne hawwaa, akka nama wanta sana qabuutti kabaja fi faayidaa barbaadu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone living in self-delusion, demanding unearned respect and status grounded in wishful thinking rather than reality

Meaning_EN: Placing hope in one's advancing age and maturity for future wisdom, dignity, and elderhood; relying on accumulated traits for standing in later years
Theme_EN: Elderhood and Reliance on the Future

Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously when someone with meager resources or slow progress undertakes an immense endeavor, arguing that sincere intent matters above all else

Keywords_EN: frog; Hajj; pilgrimage; intention; capacity; ambition; humor

Mammaaksa_AO: Laagaa baname Rabbumaatu cufa
Translation_Literal_EN: A palate (mouth) that has opened, only God closes (satisfies)
Meaning_AO: Lubbuu fi afaan uumame hundumaaf kan nyaachisuu fi sooru Waaqayyo qofa; uumamaan namni jireenyaaf waan isa barbaachisu akka hin dhabne abdii Rabbii irratti qabaachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Every mouth that God brings into the world, He faithfully sustains and provides for; affirms complete trust in divine providence for sustenance and survival

Keywords_EN: palate; mouth; God; close; sustenance; providence; trust

Mammaaksa_AO: Margi xoolage, mandiisuu jecha dheebuu hin bahu

Meaning_AO: Namni rakkoo hamaa fi dhiphina keessa jiru haasaa mi'aawaa fi waadaa afaaniitiin furmaata hin argatu; gargaarsa fi gocha qabatamaa barbaada malee waci faayidaa hin qabu
Meaning_EN: Mere promises, loud declarations, or sympathetic talk cannot relieve deep distress or poverty; practical action and tangible help are required, just as parched grass needs real rain rather than distant thunder
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiphate tokko gargaarsa qabatamaa dhabee waadaa afaanii fi jecha qofaan gowwoomfamuu barbaadamu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize offering empty words or hollow promises to someone facing severe hardship, emphasizing that relief comes only through real action

Keywords_EN: grass; wither; thunder; thirst; tangible action; empty promises

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma qalannee hin nyaannetti beeluma
Translation_Literal_EN: Until we slaughter and eat, it is still hunger
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko qabatamaan harka nama hin seeninitti fi faayidaarra hin oolinitti abdii qofa qabaachuun bu'aa hin kennu; hanga dhimmi xumuramuutti of eeggachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Until a resource or promised gain is actually realized, in hand, and utilized, one remains in lack; having potential assets does not satisfy present need until actual execution
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko osoo bu'aan qabatamaan hin argamin abdii qofaan boonee dagatu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against premature complacency, reminding someone that possessing potential wealth is not the same as actually possessing and consuming the benefit

Keywords_EN: slaughter; eat; hunger; tangible realization; fruition; caution

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishingaa fi ilmi dhiiraa, torba kufaniiti torba ka'ani

Meaning_EN: Just as hardy sorghum bends or falls before strong winds only to rise back up, a resolute person endures repeated downfalls but persistently rises again; resilience and grit
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni kufaatii fi qormaanni jireenyaa mudatee gaddutti abdii itti horanii akka deebi'ee ka'u jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage someone who has suffered multiple setbacks or failures, urging them to exhibit grit and rise repeatedly after every fall
Keywords_AO: bishingaa; ilma dhiiraa; kufuu; ka'uu; torba; cichoomina
Keywords_EN: sorghum; resilient man; fall; rise; perseverance; grit

Meaning_EN: Severe fright, dread, and distress are ultimately followed by profound joy and relief once the danger passes; trial gives birth to peace
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko sodaa fi dhiphina hamaan qabamee jiruuf rakkoon kun darbee gammachuun akka dhufu abdachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to console someone overwhelmed by panic or anxiety during a crisis, assuring them that lasting relief and joy will follow
Keywords_AO: rifaasuu; booda; gammachuu; tasgabbii; abdii; obsa
Keywords_EN: fear; terror; joy; relief; peace; endurance

Mammaaksa_AO: Joollee Rabbiitu guddisa
Translation_Literal_EN: It is God who raises children

Meaning_EN: Raising children safely into adulthood relies upon divine providence, grace, and protection rather than mere human wealth or effort alone
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo maatiin harka-qalleeyyiin guddina daa'immaniitiif dhiphachaa jiranitti abdii fi jajjabina itti horuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort struggling parents, reassuring them that God sustains, protects, and nurtures growing children through hardships
Keywords_AO: joollee; rabbi; guddisuu; daa'ima; eegumsa; maatii
Keywords_EN: children; God; nurture; raise; protection; providence

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka kufanitti waa hin hafani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not stay in the exact position in which one fell
Meaning_AO: Namni yoo kufe yookaan rakkoon qabame akkuma sanatti hafee hin dhumatu; yeroon jijjiiramaa waan ta'eef deebi'anii ka'uun hin oolamu
Meaning_EN: No one remains permanently stuck in the defeat or misfortune in which they stumbled; time and human resilience ensure recovery and rebirth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko kasaaraa yookaan gadda keessa galee abdii kutatu, haalli kun jijjiiramee akka ka'u jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to restore hope to someone undergoing deep despair or loss, reminding them that adversity is transient and they will rise again

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbi, darbee nama hin darbu
Translation_Literal_EN: God, even having passed, does not pass over a person
Meaning_AO: Waaqayyo yeroof akka nama dhiiseetti yoo mul'ateyyuu, gonkumaa nama hin dagatu; haqaa fi murtiin isaa yeroo sirriitti hundaan akka qaqqabu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Though divine justice or aid may seem to delay for a season, God never forgets or bypasses anyone; divine balance and judgment reach all in due time
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni miidhame tokko haqni dhabamee rakkatu jajjabeessuuf, akkasumas roorristoota akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort the wronged that God has not abandoned them, while simultaneously cautioning wrongdoers that divine justice will inevitably overtake them
Keywords_AO: rabbi; darbuu; nama; haqa; eegumsa; murtii
Keywords_EN: God; pass over; justice; retribution; omniscience; patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan waaqiin bulu, agabuu hin bulu
Translation_Literal_EN: He who spends the night with God does not spend the night starving
Meaning_AO: Namni Waaqayyoon amanee fi isa irratti hirkate gonkumaa beelaan hin rakkatu; eebbi fi rizqiin uumaa biraa waan hin dhabamneef abdii hin kutatu
Meaning_EN: Whoever relies on and places their faith in God will never starve or be abandoned; divine providence unfailingly sustains the faithful
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko beela, dhabuu yookaan yaaddoo jireenyaatiin dhiphatu Waaqayyo akka nama hin ganne jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort someone struggling with poverty or anxiety about the future, reminding them that God never forsakes those who trust in Him
Keywords_AO: waaqa; buluu; agabuu; amantii; rizqii; eebba
Keywords_EN: God; spend night; starving; faith; sustenance; providence

Mammaaksa_AO: Tasalaq nafsee, abdadhu lubbuu
Translation_Literal_EN: Hang in there, oh soul; hold onto hope, oh life!
Meaning_AO: Rakkina, gidiraa fi dhiphina jireenyaa keessatti obsaan of jajjabeessaa, abdii osoo hin kutatin gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Urging one's soul to persevere patiently through trials and hold fast to hope; a self-comforting expression of resilience in hard times
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhiphina fi qormaata cimaa keessatti abdii kutachuu jala gahee of jajjabeessu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage oneself or others when enduring deep hardship, urging perseverance and steadfast hope until relief arrives
Keywords_AO: tasalaq; nafsee; abdachuu; lubbuu; obsa; dhiphina
Keywords_EN: persevere; soul; hope; life; endurance; resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Qanqalloo maranii, Rabbi hin mararani
Translation_Literal_EN: One rolls up a leather bag, but one does not roll up (confine) God
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyaa fi meeshaa ofii maranii dhoksuun yookaan qusachuun ni danda'ama, garuu murtii, eegumsaa fi beekumsa Waaqayyoo daangessuun yookaan jalaa miliquun gonkumaa hin danda'amu
Meaning_EN: One can fold up, pack away, or conceal a leather bag, but God's omniscience, justice, and sovereign power cannot be contained, escaped, or manipulated

Mammaaksa_AO: Tan kutte qallo, tan hafte bal'oo dha

Translation_Literal_EN: A dying person dies having destroyed something

Meaning_EN: A dying, ruined, or falling person rarely goes down alone; in their desperation and collapse, they wreck something or drag others down with them

Meaning_EN: Although there were countless things intended or planned to be spoken, what actually transpired and was uttered carries far more weight and consequence

Meaning_AO: Wanta ofii argachuu dadhaban yookaan galma gahuu hin dandeenye tokko tuffatanii fi gatii akka hin qabneetti dubbachuun qaanii ofii dhoksuuf yaaluu
