Meaning_EN: The wise perceive and anticipate events across distant oceans, while fools remain blind to what happens right under their feet; vision versus myopia
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dandeettii dur-arguu nama beekaa fi of-dagachuu nama wallaalaa wal bira qabanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast the expansive, strategic foresight of the wise with the oblivious, short-sighted blindness of the ignorant
Keywords_AO: beekaa; bahara; wallaalaa; jala; dur-arguu; ilaalcha
Keywords_EN: wise; ocean; ignorant; underneath; foresight; myopia

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaan kan dubbatu beeka, wallaalaan kan beeku dubbata
Translation_Literal_EN: A wise person knows what he speaks; a fool speaks all he knows
Meaning_AO: Namni beekaan osoo hin dubbatin dura yaada isaa madaalee beekumsaan dubbata; gowwaan garuu wantuma sammuu isaatti dhufe calalee osoo hin qoratin dubbata
Meaning_EN: A wise person carefully measures, filters, and understands what they say before speaking; a fool blurts out everything in their head without filter or discretion
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko afaan isaa eeggachuu dhabee waan arge hunda dubbatu gorsanii akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise discretion, reminding that wise people thoughtfully filter their words while fools embarrass themselves by blurting out everything
Keywords_AO: beekaa; dubbachuu; wallaalaa; beekuu; calallii; afaan
Keywords_EN: wise; speaking; ignorant; blurting out; discretion; filter

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaa hidhi dubbisani
Translation_Literal_EN: One speaks to the wise with subtle lip movements
Meaning_AO: Nama beekaaf dubbii dheeressanii fi wacanii itti himuun hin barbaachisu; haasaa gabaabaa fi mallattoo afaaniitiin ergaa dabarsuun gahaadha
Meaning_EN: One communicates with a wise person through subtle lip movements; an intelligent mind requires no loud shouting or long explanations to grasp the core truth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama hubataa ta'e tokkoof dubbii xiqqoon yaada bu'uuraa dabarsuu danda'an ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that perceptive individuals grasp concepts instantly from understated hints without needing exhausting lectures
Keywords_AO: beekaa; hidhii; dubbisuu; mallattoo; hubannoo; gorsa
Keywords_EN: wise; lip; addressing; subtle cues; comprehension; brevity

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaa bira dhawan malee isa hin dhawani
Translation_Literal_EN: One strikes near the wise, but does not strike him directly
Meaning_AO: Nama qalbii qabu ifatti rukutanii yookaan arrabsanii qaaneessuu mannaa, fakkeenyaan fi mallattoodhaan bira darbanii itti himuun safeeffannaadha
Meaning_EN: One strikes near a wise person rather than striking them directly; correct a wise person through tactful parables and hints rather than blunt humiliation
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama kabajamaa fi beekaa tokko dogoggora isaa yeroo qajeelchan safeeffannaa fi malaan itti himuun barbaachisu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when correcting a respected or intelligent person, advising that tactful allegories and subtle hints preserve dignity while delivering the truth
Keywords_AO: beekaa; bira; dha'uu; safeeffannaa; qajeelcha; amala
Keywords_EN: wise; near; striking; tact; discreet correction; dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaa dubbiin takka
Translation_Literal_EN: For the wise, a word is spoken once
Meaning_AO: Nama beekaa fi qalbii qabuuf dhimma tokko al tokko qofa itti himuun gahaadha; irra deddeebi'anii itti himuu hin barbaadu
Meaning_EN: For a wise person, a single word suffices; an intelligent mind absorbs the lesson immediately and never requires tiresome repetition
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsa yeroo tokko qofa kennameefiin qajeelee hojiirra oolchu faarsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise someone who grasps instructions or advice instantly on the first hearing without demanding repeated reminders
Keywords_AO: beekaa; dubbii; takka; hubannoo; saffisa; qalbii
Keywords_EN: wise; word; once; swift understanding; brevity; intellect

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin beekaan malti, duuti nama hin beekneen malti
Translation_Literal_EN: Counsel is fitting with the wise; death is bearable when it is someone you do not know
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin fi jaarsummaan nama beekaa wajjin yoo ta'e qajeela; akkuma sana gaddi du'aa kan nama hin jeeqne yoo namni du'e sun nama hin beekne (alagaa) ta'eedha
Meaning_EN: Deliberation and counsel are fitting only with the wise, just as the pain of death is easy to bear only when it touches a stranger; loss feels weightless until it strikes someone you personally know and love
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimma murteessaaf nama beekaa barbaadan, yookaan duuti alagaa namaaf quuqama akka hin qabne madaalanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that serious matters require wise counselors, or to reflect on human detachment, noting that the death of a stranger passes without leaving grief
Keywords_AO: dubbii; beekaa; maluu; du'a; nama hin beekne; alagaa; gadda
Keywords_EN: counsel; wise person; fitting; death; stranger; unknown person; detached grief

Mammaaksa_AO: "Qaroomni maali" jennaan, "qarumaa wajji jiraachuu dha" je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked 'What is wisdom/civilization?', he replied, 'It is living together with wisdom'
Meaning_AO: Qaroominni dhugaan beekumsa qofa osoo hin taane, ogummaa, dammaqinaa fi nagaan hawaasa waliin walsimanii jiraachuu danda'uudha
Meaning_EN: True wisdom or civilization is not mere academic knowledge; it is the art of living harmoniously, astutely, and adaptably with others in society
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiika qaroominaa fi ogummaa dhugaa ibsuuf barbaadamee, hawaasummaa wajjin walqabsiisanii dubbatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to define true enlightenment and wisdom as the practical capacity to coexist intelligently, peacefully, and constructively in society
Keywords_AO: qaroomina; qaruma; jiraachuu; ogummaa; dammaqina
Keywords_EN: civilization; wisdom; coexistence; living together; enlightenment

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin nama beeku dhibdi
Translation_Literal_EN: Speech/discourse puzzles even the knowledgeable person
Meaning_AO: Haasaa fi falmiin ulfaataan yookaan iccitii jireenyaa nama beekaa iyyuu yaaddessuu fi madaallii dhowwuu danda'a; dubbiin salphaa miti
Meaning_EN: Complex discourse, disputes, and human affairs are so intricate that they perplex and challenge even the wisest individuals; truth is multifaceted
Theme_EN: Complexity of Speech and Human Affairs
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbii fi falmiin tokko baay'ee walxaxaa ta'ee nama beekaatuu furuun itti ulfaatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a complex issue, dispute, or deep conversation challenges even seasoned thinkers and mediators
Keywords_AO: dubbii; nama beekaa; dhibuu; walxaxaa; qalbii
Keywords_EN: speech; discourse; wise person; perplexing; complexity; deliberation

Mammaaksa_AO: Shanyiitu diroo raasa
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the breed/lineage that shakes the saddle girth
Meaning_AO: Dandeettiin, gootummaan yookaan amalli namni tokko agarsiisu hundee sanyii fi hidda dhiigaa isaa irraa madda; sanyiin gaariin gochaan of mul'isa
Meaning_EN: Inherent lineage and breeding reveal themselves in vigor, character, and strength; good stock naturally shakes the saddle and displays its innate power
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dandeettii fi gootummaa sanyii irraa dhaale mul'isu faarsanii ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise an individual whose exceptional courage, nobility, or skill is seen as the natural outworking of noble bloodlines and heritage
Keywords_AO: shanyii; sanyii; diroo; raasuu; hidda; dandeettii
Keywords_EN: lineage; breed; ancestry; saddle; heredity; inherent strength

Mammaaksa_AO: Shanyii diroo raaftuutu jira, tan raaftu baaftu
Translation_Literal_EN: There is a breed that shakes the girth, and there is one that shakes it and throws it off
Meaning_AO: Namoonni yookaan sanyiiwwan sadarkaa garaagaraa qabu; jabaan jiru, isa caalaa jabaatee wanta hundumaa jijjiiruutu jira; dandeettiin wal caala
Meaning_EN: Among formidable breeds, there are varying tiers: some merely shake foundations, while others shake and shatter them entirely; excellence has degrees
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni dandeettiidhaan wal caalan, isa caalaas kan biraa jabaan jiraachuu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that power, bravery, or ability exist in degrees, showing that extraordinary people surpass even the strong
Keywords_AO: shanyii; diroo; raasuu; baasuu; wal-caalmaa; jabina
Keywords_EN: breed; lineage; shaking; dislodging; degrees of strength; excellence

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaa beekuuf lolli tapha
Translation_Literal_EN: To one who masters it, war is like a game
Meaning_AO: Hojiin yookaan dhimmi ulfaataa ta'e nama ogummaa, beekumsaa fi qophii gahaa qabuuf salphaa fi akka taphaatti kan lakkaa'amu ta'a
Meaning_EN: For someone who truly understands the art, strategy, and dynamics of a challenge, even grave conflict is handled with effortless skill and calm
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dandeettii ol-aanaa qabu rakkoo cimaa akka salphaatti furu faarsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise a master strategist or professional who navigates grave challenges with calm poise and ease because of thorough mastery
Keywords_AO: abbaa; beekuu; lola; tapha; ogummaa; dandeettii
Keywords_EN: master; knowing; war; game; skill; strategy; mastery

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni guddaan, yoo ibiddatti darban, gubbaa irra kuta
Translation_Literal_EN: A great person, if thrown into the fire, skims across its surface
Meaning_AO: Namni kabajamaa fi qalbii qabu rakkinaa fi qorumsa guddaa keessa yoo galeeyyuu, salphina jalaa nagaan baha; ulfinni isaa balaa hundumaa injifata
Meaning_EN: A person of true moral stature, dignity, and wisdom navigates through fiery trials and perils unscathed; their integrity transcends disaster
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni kabajamaa fi jabaan tokko qorumsa cimaa keessatti amala fi kabaja isaa eeggatee nagaan bahu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise a person of high character who endures extreme adversity and hostility with poise, emerging untarnished by the flames
Keywords_AO: nama guddaa; ibidda; darbuu; kutuu; kabaja; dandamannaa
Keywords_EN: great person; fire; thrown; skimming over; dignity; resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan galeetu gala, waan gale jaarsaatu fala
Translation_Literal_EN: That which came home comes home; what has settled in, an elder resolves
Meaning_AO: Dhimmi yookaan rakkoon tasgabbaa'ee qe'eetti deebi'e jaarsummaa fi ogummaa maanguddoon nagaan furmaata argata; araarri jaarsaan tola
Meaning_EN: Once a conflict cools down and disputants return home, wise elders can step in and skillfully resolve the issue; wisdom settles disputes once passions subside
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aariin tasgabbaa'ee dubbiin jaarsolii biyyaatiin akka furamu gara araaraatti deebi'anitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used during customary mediation, noting that when disputing parties retire from the heat of passion, elders are the ones equipped to untangle the dispute
Keywords_AO: galuu; jaarsa; faluu; araara; nagaa; dubbii
Keywords_EN: coming home; elder; resolve; mediation; peace; dispute resolution

Mammaaksa_AO: Qaalluun, waan ofii beeku namaa hima
Translation_Literal_EN: The diviner tells people only what he himself knows
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiinuu hanguma beekumsaa, muuxannoo fi hubannoo qabu qofa namaaf gumaacha; nama irraa kan eegamu dandeettii isaa qofa
Meaning_EN: Even a diviner or counselor can only impart what lies within their own knowledge and experience; one cannot expect insights beyond human limits
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsa yookaan deeggarsa kennu dandeettii isaa qofaan daangeffamuu isaa hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to set realistic expectations regarding advice or leadership, acknowledging that everyone counsels from their own limited perspective
Keywords_AO: qaalluu; beekuu; himuu; daangaa; beekumsa; gorsa
Keywords_EN: Qaalluu; diviner; knowing; telling; boundaries; personal knowledge

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo garaan duugda duuba jiraatee, hallayyatti nama gata
Translation_Literal_EN: If the belly were behind one's back, it would throw a person off a cliff
Meaning_AO: Garaan fuuldura ta'ee osoo arganuu bololaan nama dhiphisa; osoo duuba ta'ee immoo balaa fi hallayyaa hin taanetti nama oofa; bolola to'achuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Even with the stomach in front where one can see it, its appetites cause trouble; had it been behind, its unchecked greed would lead one off a cliff
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko fedhii garaatiin qabamee wanta sirrii hin taane hojjechuuf ka'u bolola akka to'atu gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically to warn against being ruled by physical greed and insatiable desires, emphasizing the danger of unchecked appetite
Keywords_AO: garaa; dugda; hallayyaa; gatuu; bolola; of-to'annoo
Keywords_EN: belly; back; cliff; throw; greed; appetite; self-control

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii jaarsaa, ganama didaniiti galgala itti deebi'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: The counsel of an elder, they reject it in the morning, only to return to it by evening
Meaning_AO: Gorsi fi dubbiin maanguddoon dubbatan yeroof didamuu danda'us, dhugaa fi bu'a-qabeessa waan ta'eef booda irra mirkanaa'ee fudhatama argata
Meaning_EN: The wise advice of an elder might be rashly dismissed in the morning, but by evening, bitter experience and reality force people to accept its truth
Theme_EN: The Enduring Truth of Elder Counsel
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dargaggoonni gorsa maanguddoo tuffatanii booda rakkina keessa seenanii gara gorsaatti deebi'anitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when youthful impatience rejects traditional guidance, only to realize later through costly trial that the elder's foresight was correct
Keywords_AO: dubbii jaarsaa; ganama; diduu; galgala; deebi'uu; gorsa
Keywords_EN: elder counsel; morning; rejecting; evening; returning; wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaan si haa argatu, wallaalaan lixee si haa dhabu
Translation_Literal_EN: May the wise person find you, and may the ignorant lose you in the deep
Meaning_AO: Eebba gaarii dha; jireenya keessatti nama ogummaa fi gaarummaa qabuun akka wal bartu, nama gowwaa fi balaa fidu jalaa ammoo akka milqitu hawwuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: A traditional blessing wishing that one is discovered and valued by wise benefactors, while remaining completely hidden and safe from destructive fools
Theme_EN: Blessing of Wise Allies and Deliverance from Fools
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama tokkoof eebba jaalalaa fi carraa gaarii kennanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken as an auspicious blessing for someone embarking on a new path, praying they attract wise companions while escaping the clutches of foolish people
Keywords_AO: beekaa; argachuu; wallaalaa; lixuu; dhabuu; eebba
Keywords_EN: wise person; finding; ignorant; losing; blessing; protection

Mammaaksa_AO: Mataatu luqqa'a malee, arrabni hin luqqa'u
Translation_Literal_EN: The head may peel, but the tongue never peels
Meaning_AO: Namni umuriin yoo dulloomee mataan isaa rifeensa dhabellee, arrabni fi haasaan isaa dandeettii dubbachuu hin dhabu; arrabni yeroo hundumaa dammaqaadha
Meaning_EN: Though age and time may cause hair to fall from the head, the tongue retains its power, sharpness, and capacity to speak; speech outlives physical youth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo maanguddoonni umuriin deemanis haasaa fi dubbii cimina qabu dubbatan, yookaan arrabni dafee akka hin dulloomne ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that while the body and hair decline with age, a person's talkativeness, wit, or sharp tongue never truly dulls or wearies
Keywords_AO: mataa; luqqa'uu; arraba; dulloomuu; dubbii
Keywords_EN: head; balding; tongue; aging; speech; sharp tongue

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan manguddoon hin beekne, ijoolleen hin beektu
Translation_Literal_EN: What the elder does not know, the child does not know
Meaning_AO: Muuxannoo, seenaa fi ogummaa maanguddoon jireenya dheeraa keessatti hin arganne ijoolleen beekuu hin dandeessu; beekumsi maanguddootaa bu'uura
Meaning_EN: If a seasoned elder with a lifetime of experience does not comprehend or know a thing, an inexperienced child cannot possibly know it
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen dhimma walxaxaa irratti maanguddoota caalaa akka waan beekaniitti of dhiheessan qajeelchuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humble young people who prematurely presume to know more than seasoned elders, asserting the irreplaceable value of life experience
Keywords_AO: maanguddoo; beekuu; ijoollee; muuxannoo; seenaa; ogummaa
Keywords_EN: elder; knowing; child; experience; life wisdom; authority

Mammaaksa_AO: Waa barreessuun waa barachuu dha; wal dhaga'uun humna horachuu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Writing is learning; listening to one another is building strength
Meaning_AO: Qubee fi barruudhaan beekumsa qabachuun barumsa gabbisa; hawaasni yeroo wal dhaga'ee fi waliigalu ammoo tokkummaa fi humna cimaa gonfata
Meaning_EN: Recording knowledge through writing deepens learning, while mutual listening and understanding build collective power and community resilience
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo faayidaa barreeffamaa fi barnootaa, akkasumas humna tokkummaa fi wal-dhagahuu hawaasaaf barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to promote education, literacy, and social cohesion, teaching that recording knowledge fosters wisdom while mutual respect builds collective strength
Keywords_AO: barreessuu; barachuu; wal-dhagahuu; humna; tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: writing; learning; listening; strength; education; solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: "Ofii keetiti beeki, ofii wallaaltu sitti himan beeki, sana dadhabdu naaf hin guddatin" jedhe, abbaan ilmaan
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Know by yourself; if you cannot, know when instructed; if you fail at that, do not grow up for me,' said the father to his son
Meaning_AO: Namni ofumaan dammaqee baruu qaba, yoo sana dadhabe gorsa namaa dhaggeeffatee hubachuu qaba; kan ofiin hin beekne fi kan gorsa hin dhageenye bu'aa hin qabu
Meaning_EN: A person must either have the insight to understand on their own or the humility to learn when told; one who possesses neither is worthless to society
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan ilma isaa amala fi dandeettii gorsa fudhachuu akka qabaatu jabeessanii gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used by parents or mentors to deliver stern discipline, demanding that a youth either think independently or listen obediently to wise counsel
Keywords_AO: ofii beekuu; wallaaluu; himuu; guddachuu; abbaa; ilma; gorsa
Keywords_EN: self-awareness; ignorance; instruction; growing up; father; son; teachability

Mammaaksa_AO: Amni abba qaba, duulli abba qaba
Translation_Literal_EN: The long march has a leader; the military campaign has a commander
Meaning_AO: Hojiin, adeemsi fi duulli kamiinuu qajeelfama, hoggansa fi itti-gaafatamummaa nama dura bu'uun geggeeffamuu qaba; hoggana malee milkaa'inni hin jiru
Meaning_EN: Every journey and military campaign requires an authorized leader and clear chain of command; orderly leadership and accountability are essential for success
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojii waloomaa fi sochiitti hoggansi fi itti gaafatamummaan bu'uura ta'uu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the necessity of clear leadership, structure, and chain of command during collective tasks or community initiatives
Keywords_AO: amna; abbaa; duula; hoggansa; itti-gaafatamummaa; qajeelfama
Keywords_EN: journey; leader; military campaign; command; leadership; accountability

Mammaaksa_AO: Intala daakuu beektu, daakuu hin hatani
Translation_Literal_EN: From a maiden who knows how to grind flour, one cannot steal flour
Meaning_AO: Nama dhimma tokko sirriitti beeku, ogeessa fi dammaqaa ta'e gowwoomsuun yookaan waan isaa jalaa saamuun hin danda'amu; ogummaan of eeggachiisa
Meaning_EN: One cannot steal flour from a girl who knows the exact yield of grinding grain; a knowledgeable and skilled expert cannot be cheated or defrauded in their own craft
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko nama ogummaa fi dandeettii dhimma sanaa guutuu qabu gowwoomsuuf yaalee hin milkaa'in hafetti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone tries to trick, shortchange, or defraud an expert who knows the exact details and cannot be fooled
Keywords_AO: intala; daakuu; beekuu; hatuu; ogummaa; dammaqina
Keywords_EN: maiden; flour; knowing; stealing; expertise; vigilance

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka gowwaatti du'uu mannaa, harka beekaatti du'uu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than dying at the hands of a fool, it is better to die at the hands of a wise person
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan yookaan murtiin nama beekaa fi seera qabu irraa dhufu sababa fi seera qabaata; gowwaan garuu sababa malee salphinaa fi badiisa hamaa fida
Meaning_EN: Falling or suffering at the hands of an intelligent adversary carries reason and rules, whereas suffering under a fool brings senseless and humiliating ruin
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo filannoo qormaata nama beekaa wajjin qabaachuu fi gowwaatti hirkachuu gidduutti madaallii godhanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when choosing between facing a competent, rational challenger versus being subjected to the erratic, chaotic mercy of an ignorant fool
Keywords_AO: harka; gowwaa; du'uu; beekaa; wayyuu; safuu
Keywords_EN: hands; fool; dying; wise person; dignity; rational adversary

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan dabaqata, qarri farajata
Translation_Literal_EN: The fool blunders blindly; the clever person acts with calculated circumspection
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan osoo hin yaadin tarkaanfatee rakkoo fi wal-xaxaa keessa of buusa; namni qaxaleen ammoo haala madaalee, fala barbaadee nagaan baha
Meaning_EN: A fool blunders recklessly into trouble and complicates matters, whereas an astute, discerning person observes, calculates, and finds an elegant way forward
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo jarjaraa fi gowwummaa nama tokkoo fi tasgabbii nama beekaa wal bira qabanii madaalanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast the hasty, clumsy actions of a fool with the careful, calculated, and effective methods of a sharp thinker
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; dabaqachuu; qara; farajachuu; ogummaa; madaallii
Keywords_EN: fool; blundering; clever; circumspection; wisdom; calculation

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan wajji taphachuu mannaa, beekaa wajji wal loluu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than playing with a fool, it is better to fight with a wise person
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan nagaa fi tapha keessattiyyuu balaa fi salphina fiduu danda'a; beekaan garuu yoo waldhabden jiraateyyuu daangaa fi safuu beeka
Meaning_EN: Even in jest and play, a fool can inflict lethal harm and unpredictable disgrace; a wise person, even in dispute, observes boundaries, rationality, and ethics
Theme_EN: Peril of Friendly Fools vs. Restraint of Wise Foes
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota gowwaa wajjin hariiroo qabaachuun balaa qabaachuu isaa fi beekaa wajjin falmuun caalu akeekkachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against keeping close company with reckless fools, preferring an honorable dispute with a wise adversary over casual association with an idiot
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; taphachuu; beekaa; loluu; daangaa; safuu
Keywords_EN: fool; playing; wise person; fighting; boundaries; ethics

Mammaaksa_AO: Qarri dachii dha, gowwaan bilillee dha
Translation_Literal_EN: The wise person is the earth; the fool is a narrow glass vial
Meaning_AO: Namni qaran akkuma dachee bal'aa, obsaa fi tasgabbaa'aadha; gowwaan garuu akkuma bilillee laafaa, dhiphoo, wacaa fi dafee kan cabuudha
Meaning_EN: A wise person is like the earth—broad, grounded, enduring, and carrying all; a fool is like a fragile glass vial—narrow, shallow, and quick to shatter
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo obsa bal'aa nama qaraatiifi qalbii dhiphummaa nama gowwaa wal bira qabanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast the profound patience and solid depth of a wise person with the brittle, shallow, and fragile temperament of a fool
Keywords_AO: qara; dachii; gowwaa; bilillee; obsa; bal'ina qalbii
Keywords_EN: clever; earth; fool; glass vial; patience; broad-mindedness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dheedhiin baalaa, hamtuun beela
Translation_Literal_EN: Raw food is mere leaves; the truly terrible thing is famine
Meaning_AO: Nyaanni qophii gaarii hin qabne yookaan dheedhii ta'e rakkisaa ta'us, wanti hunda caalaa nama miidhu beelaa fi dhabuudha; wanta argatanitti quufuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Poorly prepared or raw food is merely leaves, but the truly lethal enemy is absolute starvation; any available food is far better than dying of hunger
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo yeroo rakkoo keessatti wanta argame nyaatanii beela ofirraa ittisuun barbaachisaa ta'uu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage eating whatever basic food is available during hardship, reminding people that unrefined sustenance is far better than starving
Keywords_AO: dheedhii; baala; hamtuu; beela; soorata; quufa
Keywords_EN: raw food; leaves; terrible; famine; sustenance; survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Beelaan du'uu mannaa eelaan du'uu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than dying of hunger, it is better to die of deep sorrow
Meaning_AO: Salphina beelaatiin du'uu mannaa, kaayyoo, jaalala, gaddaa fi gootummaa qalbii keessaa qabaatanii du'uutu ulfina qaba; kabajaan du'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Dying of deep sorrow, passion, or noble tribulation is far more honorable than perishing miserably of starvation; choosing dignified demise over shameful deprivation
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo kabaja ofii eeggachuun wanta hunda caalaa murteessaa ta'uu fi salphina beelaa didanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert human dignity over base material misery, expressing that dying for love, grief, or a noble cause is preferable to dying of helpless starvation
Keywords_AO: beela; du'uu; eela; kabaja; jaalala; salphina
Keywords_EN: hunger; dying; deep grief; dignity; honor; starvation

Mammaaksa_AO: Beelaa fi billawni diina
Translation_Literal_EN: Hunger and a knife are deadly enemies
Meaning_AO: Beelli akkuma billawaa nama muruutti suuta suutaan lubbuu namaa galaafata; lamaanuu miidhaa fi badiisa dafee lubbuu balleessu fidu
Meaning_EN: Hunger and a knife are both lethal cutthroats; just like a sharp blade, starvation slashes through life, showing no mercy and destroying the human body
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo beelli hangam nama miidhuu fi akkuma meeshaa waraanaatti lubbuu galaafachuu danda'u ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the agonizing, destructive ruthlessness of hunger, equating starvation directly with a drawn blade that kills
Keywords_AO: beela; billawa; diina; lubbuu; miidhaa; galaafachuu
Keywords_EN: hunger; knife; enemy; life; destruction; deadly famine

Mammaaksa_AO: Beelti billawa caalaa marrimaan nama cirti
Translation_Literal_EN: Hunger cuts through one's entrails more severely than a knife
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan fi dhukkubbiin beelli qaamaa fi garaa keessatti fidu goraadee nama waraanu caalaa hadhaawaa fi laalessaadha; dhiphina beelaa agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Starvation tears through human entrails with greater agony than a physical knife; the inner pangs of famine inflict deeper, more torturous pain than an external blade
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo beelli hamaa ta'ee fi miidhaan garaa keessatti qaqqabu laalessaa ta'uu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express the unbearable, tearing physical and psychological torment of severe hunger and famine
Keywords_AO: beela; billawa; mar'umaan; ciruu; dhukkubbii; laalecha
Keywords_EN: hunger; knife; entrails; cutting; agony; famine pangs

Mammaaksa_AO: Agabuun qoosaa hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Fasting/going without food is no joke
Meaning_AO: Beelli fi dhabuun dhimma laayyootti kolfamu yookaan qoosaatti fudhatamu miti; dhiphina cimaa lubbuu galaafatu waan ta'eef xiyyeeffannaa barbaada
Meaning_EN: Hunger and starvation are no laughing matter or joke; going without food is a grave, life-threatening ordeal that demands serious attention
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko beelaa fi dhabamuu namaa akka qoosaatti ilaalu, beelli dhugaa ulfaataa ta'uu hubachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand someone treating hunger or food scarcity lightly, reminding them that starvation is an agonizing, deadly reality
Keywords_AO: agabuu; qoosaa; beela; lubbuu; jireenya; ulfaatina
Keywords_EN: starvation; hunger; joke; gravity; survival; food scarcity

Mammaaksa_AO: Wanni calalaqaa hundi, ziqeeyaa fi meetaa miti
Translation_Literal_EN: All that glitters is not gold or silver
Meaning_AO: Wanti alaan bareedee fi calaqqisee mul'atu hundi gati-jabeessa yookaan qulqulluu ta'uu dhabuu danda'a; bifa alaa qofaan madaaluun gowwummaadha
Meaning_EN: Not everything that glitters is precious gold or silver; outward shine and dazzling appearances often mask cheap, worthless substance
Theme_EN: All That Glitters and Deceptive Appearances
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko faaya, qabeenya yookaan nama alaan ifu tokkotti gowwoomee qulqullina keessaa dagatu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against judging by flashy outward appearances, reminding that superficial glamour rarely equates to genuine value
Keywords_AO: calalaquu; ziqeeyaa; meetaa; bifa alaa; gowwoomuu; dhugaa
Keywords_EN: glittering; gold; silver; appearance; deceptive; value

Mammaaksa_AO: Saree dabbassaa, kan duutu hin seehani
Translation_Literal_EN: A shaggy dog, people do not think it will die
Meaning_AO: Namni bifa, uffannaa yookaan haala alaa furdaa fakkaatu qabu keessi isaa beelaa fi dhukkubaan kan dhumate ta'uu danda'a; bifa alaan quufa sehuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: Because a shaggy dog has thick hair hiding its emaciated ribs, people assume it is well-fed and thriving; outward volume disguises lethal weakness
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko alaan nagaa fi quufaa fakkaatee garuu keessoo isaatti miidhamaa fi dhiphachaa jiru ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone appears robust or well-off purely due to outward trappings, while secretly on the verge of physical or financial collapse
Keywords_AO: saree; dabbassaa; du'uu; sehuu; bifa alaa; dhokataa
Keywords_EN: dog; shaggy; fur; dying; appearance vs reality; hidden starvation

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama gabaabaa, joolleen abbaa hin seetu
Translation_Literal_EN: A short person, children do not realize he is a father
Meaning_AO: Namni dheerina qaamaa yookaan humna mul'atu hin qabne hawaasa keessatti kabajaa fi sadarkaa isaaf malu dhabuu danda'a; dhaabbata qaamaatiin nama madaaluu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: Children mistake a short man for one of themselves and fail to recognize him as a father; people shallowly judge authority by physical stature
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko sababa dheerina qaamaa dhabeef namoota biraatiin akka nama salphaatti tuffatamu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight how people, especially the naive, unfairly discount someone's age, maturity, or authority simply because of short physical stature
Keywords_AO: nama gabaabaa; joollee; abbaa; sehuu; kabaja; dhaabbata qaamaa
Keywords_EN: short person; children; father; stature; authority; superficial bias

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni gabaabaan, osoo kabajaa hin arganne du'a
Translation_Literal_EN: A short person dies before ever receiving his due respect
Meaning_AO: Hawaasni yeroo baay'ee ulfinaa fi kabaja kan kennu dhaabbata qaamaa isa dheeraa fi jabaa mul'atuuf waan ta'eef, namni gabaabaan tuffatamaa jiraachuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: Society often shallowly equates dignity with towering height, causing a short individual to live and die without ever receiving the reverence they merit
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dandeettii fi gaarummaan nama tokkoo sababa dhaabbata qaama isaatiin tuffatamee kabaja dhabu balaaleffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament the unfair social bias that denies short individuals the dignity and prestige granted easily to taller figures
Keywords_AO: nama gabaabaa; kabaja; dhabuu; du'uu; tuffii; madaallii qaamaa
Keywords_EN: short person; respect; dying; prejudice; stature; denied honor

Mammaaksa_AO: "Numa qaqallii kanaatu, haadha tumaaleyyiiti" jette, re'eettiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'It is this very slender self of mine that is the mother of sturdy kids,' said the goat
Meaning_AO: Namni qaamaan qalloo yookaan salphaa fakkaatee mul'atu bu'aa guddaa fi firii ciccimaa horachuu akka danda'u; bifa qaamaa laafaa irraa bu'aa guddaatu madda
Meaning_EN: 'Slender as I appear, I am the mother of sturdy, fat young stock,' said the goat; a frail or modest exterior often produces magnificent, powerful achievements
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qaamaan laafaa yookaan harka-qalleessa fakkaatu tokko bu'aa guddaa fi ijoollee ciccimoo gumaache of jajuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone of slight build or unassuming background proudly proves that they can produce extraordinary, robust results and offspring
Keywords_AO: qaqalloo; haadha; tumaaleyyii; re'ee; firii; bu'aa guddaa
Keywords_EN: slender; mother; sturdy kids; goat; fruitfulness; unassuming strength

Mammaaksa_AO: Qallinaa hin caphani, furdinaa hin tarani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not break from thinness, nor survive indefinitely from thickness
Meaning_AO: Qallinni qaamaa sababa du'aa yookaan cabsaa hin ta'u; furdinni fi jabinnillee jireenya dheeraaf wabii hin ta'u; jireenyi fi duuti harka Waaqayyoo jirti
Meaning_EN: Slenderness does not cause one to snap, nor does girth guarantee survival; endurance, vitality, and destiny are determined by inner resilience and divine will
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko qaamni isaa qallachuu isaatiif yaadda'u, yookaan furdina qaamaatti boonuu dhiisuu akka qaban hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure a slender or frail-looking person that bulk does not dictate durability, and that survival depends on inner constitution and fate
Keywords_AO: qallina; caphuu; furdina; taruu; lubbuu; madaallii
Keywords_EN: thinness; breaking; thickness; surviving; resilience; destiny

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama kofla guddatu, aara/dallansuu isaa hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who grew up smiling, people do not recognize when he is truly angry
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo hunda amala gaarii, koflaa fi fuula ifaa qabu yoo dallane iyyuu namoonni aarii isaa akka salphaatti hubachuu hin danda'an; amalli durii aarii dhoksa
Meaning_EN: One who is habitually smiling and cheerful cannot easily communicate their anger; people fail to take their fury seriously because of their customary laughter
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amala garraamii fi koflaa qabu dallanee garuu namoonni aarii isaa akka qoosaatti fudhatan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how a gentle, ever-smiling person struggles to be taken seriously when furious, as people assume their anger is just good humor
Keywords_AO: kofla; guddachuu; aara; dallansuu; beekuu; amala
Keywords_EN: laughter; habitual smiling; anger; unrecognized fury; temperament

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama ilkee kalaadaa, aara/mufii isaa hin beekan
Translation_Literal_EN: A person with protruding teeth, one cannot tell when he is offended or angry
Meaning_AO: Akkuma namni ilkaan isaa uumamaan bakkee jiru yeroo aaru iyyuu kofla fakkaatu, namni bifa alaa amala tokko qabu miira isaa isa dhugaa beekuun ulfaataadha
Meaning_EN: Because a person with naturally protruding teeth always appears to be baring their teeth in a grin, others cannot tell when they are genuinely offended or brooding
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko miirri isaa inni dhugaan bifa qaamaa yookaan amala duriitiin dhokatee nama dhibu qishnaadhaan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously when someone's natural facial expression or physical quirks completely obscure whether they are smiling or seething with anger
Keywords_AO: ilkee; kalaadaa; aara; mufii; beekuu; miira; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: teeth; protruding; anger; offense; masking emotion; humor

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan ergame erga himaa, kan ergarame bifaatu hima
Translation_Literal_EN: The emissary speaks the message; the mistreated person, his face speaks for him
Meaning_AO: Ergamaan ergaa afaaniin yoo dabarse, namni rakkinaa fi roorroon irra gahe garuu dhiphina isaa bifa, qaamaa fi haala isaatiin ifatti mul'isa
Meaning_EN: A designated messenger communicates with spoken words, but one who has suffered mistreatment needs no speech—their haggard appearance tells the whole story
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni roorroon yookaan gidiraan irra gahe tokko osoo hin dubbatin dhiphinni isaa bifa isaarratti mul'atu hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an individual's worn, exhausted, or battered appearance testifies immediately to the abuse or extreme toil they have endured
Keywords_AO: ergamuu; ergaa; ergaramuu; bifa; himuu; miidhaa; gidiraa
Keywords_EN: messenger; errand; mistreated; appearance; suffering; visible trauma

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama huccuu carqaa, dubri qaadhimaa hin seetu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person in ragged clothes, a maiden does not think of him as a suitor
Meaning_AO: Namni uffata moofaa fi carqaa uffate intala biratti akka dhiira fuudhaaf qophaa'eetti hin ilaalamu; bifa alaa fi hiyyummaan hawwannaa jaalalaa dhabsiisa
Meaning_EN: A maiden will not consider a man dressed in tattered rags as a potential suitor; outward poverty and shabby dress diminish one's romantic and social standing
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qabeenyi fi uffanni gaariin hariiroo fi jaalala keessatti dhiibbaa qabaachuu isaa ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when noting how prospective partners often judge a suitor's worthiness by outward presentation, attire, and apparent wealth
Keywords_AO: nama; huccuu; carqaa; dubra; qaadhimaa; uffannaa; hiyyummaa
Keywords_EN: person; clothes; rags; maiden; suitor; attire; romance

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni huccuun carqii, namatti hin tolu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person whose clothes are rags does not appeal to people
Meaning_AO: Namni hiyyeessa uffata gahaa hin qabne hawaasa biratti tuffatama, kabaja hin argatu; ormi nama qabeenyaa fi uffata gaarii qabu qofa jaalata
Meaning_EN: A person dressed in rags is disdained and unappealing to others; society is superficial and withholds respect and warmth from the visibly destitute
Theme_EN: Social Disdain for the Poorly Dressed
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hawaasni nama harka-qalleessa uffata qulqulluu hin qabne tuffachuu isaa balaaleffatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique social superficiality, lamenting that people judge human dignity and pleasantness by clothing rather than character
Keywords_AO: huccuu; carqii; nama; toluu; tuffii; hiyyummaa
Keywords_EN: clothes; rags; person; pleasantness; superficiality; poverty

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan dhoysu, irreetu hima
Translation_Literal_EN: Though the person conceals it, the biceps reveal it
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko dandeettii, humna yookaan dadhabina ofii afaaniin dhoksuuf yoo yaaleyyuu, qaamni fi gochi isaa dhugaa jiru ifatti baasa
Meaning_EN: Even if an individual attempts to conceal their true strength, capability, or exhaustion verbally, their physical build and actions reveal the truth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko humna qabu yookaan dadhabina isaa dhoksuuf yaalu garuu qaamni isaa saaxilu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone tries to disguise their physical capability or inner condition, noting that natural bodily traits unmistakably betray the reality
Keywords_AO: abbaa; dhoksuu; irree; himuu; humna; saaxilamuu
Keywords_EN: owner; concealing; biceps; forearm; telling; physical truth

Mammaaksa_AO: Biddeena hamaa, danfa baredaan nyaatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Bad bread is eaten with delicious hot sauce
Meaning_AO: Haala yookaan wanta rakkisaa ta'e tokko obsaan dabarsuuf, wantoota gaarii fi jaalala naannoo jirutti fayyadamuun dhiphina sana laaffifatu
Meaning_EN: Coarse or poorly prepared bread is made palatable by pairing it with delicious stew; difficult circumstances are softened by complementary blessings
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoo jiru wantoota gaarii birootiin wal-madaalchisanii obsaan jireenya itti fufanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise making the best of a poor situation by complementing it with pleasant elements to ease the burden
Keywords_AO: biddeena hamaa; danfa; bareeda; nyaachuu; madaallii; furmaata
Keywords_EN: bad bread; hot stew; delicious; eating; coping; softening hardship

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaacha guddinaa, harreen lakkuu hin dhaltu
Translation_Literal_EN: For all the size of its belly, a donkey does not give birth to twins
Meaning_AO: Qaamaan guddaa yookaan bololaan bal'aa ta'uun bu'aa dachaa argamsiisa jechuu miti; guddinni alaa firii fi dandeettii wajjin wal hin simatu
Meaning_EN: Despite having a massive belly, a donkey never bears twins; outward bulk or large capacity does not automatically translate into double productivity
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhaabbata guddaa qabaatee garuu bu'aa xiqqoo gumaachu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock or critique someone whose large physical presence or boastful appetite yields modest, singular results
Keywords_AO: garaacha; guddina; harree; lakkuu; dhaluu; firii
Keywords_EN: belly; size; donkey; twins; birthing; productivity; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Mukni daraareef, firii hin dhalu
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because a tree flowers, it does not mean it will bear fruit
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko jalqabarratti hawwataa fi abdachiisaa mul'ateef dhuma irratti bu'aa qabatamaa fida jechuu miti; abdii fi firiin adda adda
Meaning_EN: Just because a tree blossoms profusely does not guarantee it will produce ripe fruit; promising starts do not always culminate in tangible achievements
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko abdii fi jalqaba qofatti gammadee osoo bu'aan hin dhufin of dagatu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against assuming that early blossoms and optimistic starts will automatically guarantee final success
Keywords_AO: muka; daraaruu; firii; dhaluu; abdii; bu'aa
Keywords_EN: tree; flowering; fruit; bearing; promise; realization

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo heddumminaa, aarri hurree hin taane
Translation_Literal_EN: If it were a matter of quantity, smoke would have become mist
Meaning_AO: Baay'inni yookaan heddumminni qofti wanta tokko gara qulqullinaa fi gatii dhugaatti hin jijjiiru; qulqullinaatu baay'ina caala
Meaning_EN: If sheer volume were enough, dense smoke would turn into life-giving morning mist; quantity without genuine substance cannot produce true value
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni baay'ina qofa irratti boonanii qulqullinaa fi bu'aa dhugaa dhaban ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke those who prioritize sheer numbers or volume over authentic quality, depth, and character
Keywords_AO: heddummina; aara; hurree; qulqullina; baay'ina; gatii
Keywords_EN: quantity; smoke; mist; quality; substance; value

Mammaaksa_AO: Dheerinni, gobeensaafuu humaa hin goone
Translation_Literal_EN: Height did nothing of value even for the giant bamboo
Meaning_AO: Dheerina qaamaa qabaachuun qofti faayidaa yookaan gootummaa hin argamsiisu; wanti bu'uuraa dandeettii fi jabinadha malee dheerina miti
Meaning_EN: Sheer height did not make the bamboo strong; physical tallness or towering presence is completely useless without inner substance and strength
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dheeraan tokko dandeettii fi humna dhabee akka nama laafaatti mul'atu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone that towering height or grand stature is meaningless if hollow and devoid of courage or practical utility
Keywords_AO: dheerinna; gobeensa; humna; faayidaa dhabuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: height; bamboo; cane; strength; hollow stature; substance

Mammaaksa_AO: Dunfuraa fi huccuun nama bareechani malee humna namaaf hin tahu
Translation_Literal_EN: Ornaments and fine clothes beautify a person, but they do not become strength
Meaning_AO: Faayanii fi uffanni gaariin bifa alaa qofa miidhagsa malee, jagnummaa, humnaa fi dandeettii dhugaa namaaf hin kennu; humnoon keessaa madda
Meaning_EN: Fine jewelry and elegant clothes adorn the exterior, but they impart neither physical strength nor inner fortitude; true might is internal
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko uffannaa fi faayaan of jaju garuu hojii fi humna dhabu gorsanii akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone that outward decoration and flashy clothing cannot substitute for actual capability, work ethic, or courage
Keywords_AO: dunfura; huccuu; bareechuu; humna; faaya alaa; jabina
Keywords_EN: ornaments; clothes; beautify; strength; jewelry; inner fortitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni uffatee qabu, kabaja qaba
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who dresses decently and possesses wealth has respect
Meaning_AO: Namni qulqullinaan uffatee of qabu hawaasa keessatti kabaja, ulfinaa fi fudhatama argata; of eeguun kabaja fida
Meaning_EN: One who is properly clothed, well-groomed, and possesses dignity commands social respect and reverence; outward propriety fosters esteem
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qulqullina uffannaa fi of eeggannoon kabaja dhuunfaatiif murteessaa ta'uu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise proper grooming and neat dress, emphasizing that respectful attire invites dignity and positive regard from the community
Keywords_AO: nama; uffachuu; qabaachuu; kabaja; qulqullina; safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: person; dressing; possessing; respect; dignity; grooming

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo diiminaa, hiddiinuu ala bulte
Translation_Literal_EN: If it were merely about redness, even the wild bitter berry would not spend the night outside
Meaning_AO: Bifti diimaan yookaan bareedinni alaa qofti gatii hin qabu; wanti sun faayidaa fi mi'aa qabaachuu baannaan ormi bira darba
Meaning_EN: If bright red color alone were worthy, the wild bitter-apple berry would not be left neglected in the bush; surface beauty is worthless without character
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni bifa alaa qofatti gowwoomee amala fi faayidaa dhugaa dagatu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to debunk infatuation with mere physical complexion or color, noting that beauty without good character is left abandoned
Keywords_AO: diimina; hiddi; ala buluu; bareedina; bifa; faayidaa
Keywords_EN: redness; bitter apple; berry; outdoors; superficial beauty; utility

Mammaaksa_AO: Soorti duraa ija
Translation_Literal_EN: The first nourishment is for the eye
Meaning_AO: Nyaanni yookaan wanti dhihaatu osoo afaaniin hin nyaatamin dura ijaan ilaalamee miidhaginaan nama hawwachuu qaba; dhiheessi gaariin fedhii bana
Meaning_EN: The eye eats first before the mouth; visual presentation, cleanliness, and aesthetics stimulate the appetite and welcome the soul
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nyaata qulqullinaan fi bifa hawwataadhaan dhiheessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that presentation and cleanliness matter immensely, as people evaluate and desire food visually before tasting it
Keywords_AO: soorta; dura; ija; nyaata; miidhagina; dhiheessa
Keywords_EN: nourishment; feeding; eye; food; presentation; appetite

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi huqqate, abbaa hin fakkaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: An emaciated son does not look like his father
Meaning_AO: Namni hiyyummaan, beelli fi dhiphinni isa dadhabse ulfinaa fi kabaja sanyii isaa calaqqisiisuu hin danda'u; gadadoon fakkii namaa jijjiira
Meaning_EN: An emaciated and starved son loses the noble resemblance of his prosperous father; deep deprivation disfigures a person and obscures their heritage
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo beellii fi gadadoon haala fi bifa namaa jijjiiree kabaja sanyii duraanii dhabsiisu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament how severe poverty and hardship wither a person physically, masking the noble bearing and resemblance of their lineage
Keywords_AO: ilma; huqqachuu; abbaa; fakkaachuu; hiyyummaa; bifa
Keywords_EN: son; emaciated; father; resemblance; poverty; physical decline

Mammaaksa_AO: Tiitichi Kanniisa fakkaateef, damma hin dalagu
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because a fly resembles a bee, it does not produce honey
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii fi amala nama gaarii akkeesse qofaan bu'aa guddaa nama sanaa fiduu hin danda'u; fakkeessitoonni firii dhugaa hin qaban
Meaning_EN: Even if a fly looks like a honeybee, it cannot produce honey; mere mimicry or superficial imitation of a skilled worker yields no productive results
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dandeettii hin qabne tokko ogeessa fakkaatee of mul'isuuf yaalee garuu bu'aa dhabu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dubra alaa fuudhe, nama daarota guutuun dikee mataa irratti ba'ate
Translation_Literal_EN: He who marries an Ala maiden is like one who carried a dustpan of ashes/dung upon his head
Meaning_AO: Aadaa fookloorii keessatti dubra gosa Alaa fuudhuun hojii loonii, dhoqqee fi qormaata baay'ee ofitti fe'uu yookaan aarii guddaa qabaachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: Folk satire comparing marrying an Ala maiden to carrying a heavy basket of ashes or dung upon one's head; teasingly depicting the marriage as bringing endless chores
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qoccolloo aadaa keessatti dubra Alaa fuudhuun ba'aa fi dhoqqee baay'ee fida jedhanii qoosanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in humorous clan banter in Hararghe to tease those marrying into the Ala clan about inheriting endless cattle-pen labor or household headaches
Keywords_AO: dubra alaa; fuudhuu; daarota; dikee; ba'achuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: Ala maiden; marriage; dustpan; dung; ashes; domestic chore; clan satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dubra ituu fuudhe, nama siree siree irratti jaare
Translation_Literal_EN: He who marries an Ituu maiden is like one who built a bed upon a bed
Meaning_AO: Dubartoonni gosa Ituu aadaa keessatti qananii, boqonnaa, fi kunuunsa guddaadhaan beekamu; ishee fuudhuun jireenya qananii fi boqonnaa dachaa namaaf argamsiisa
Meaning_EN: Marrying a maiden of the Ituu clan is like building a bed upon a bed, bringing double comfort and pampering; Ituu women are praised for gracious domestic care
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubartoota gosa Ituu qananii, kunuunsa fi boqonnaa bultii keessatti dhiirsaaf kennaniif faarsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in Hararghe cultural contexts to praise the homemaking, pampering, and luxurious domestic comfort attributed to marrying an Ituu woman
Keywords_AO: dubra ituu; fuudhuu; siree; jaaruu; qananii; boqonnaa
Keywords_EN: Ituu maiden; marriage; bed; building; luxury; comfort

Mammaaksa_AO: Saani aannan dhabnaan loonii miti, haati manaa fi abbaan manaa walii galtee dhabnaan gaarii miti
Translation_Literal_EN: A cow lacking milk is not truly livestock; a wife and husband lacking agreement are not good
Meaning_AO: Akkuma sa'i aannan hin kennine gatii dhabu, bultii keessattis wanti bu'uuraa waliigaltee fi nagaadha; waliigaltee malee bultiin milkaa'ina hin qabu
Meaning_EN: Just as a cow yielding no milk fails its primary purpose as livestock, a marriage lacking mutual agreement, peace, and harmony is devoid of goodness
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan manaa fi haati manaa waliigaluun bultii isaaniitiif faayidaa guddaa akka qabu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when counseling married couples that the true essence and sweetness of married life depend strictly on mutual agreement and harmony
Keywords_AO: sa'a; aannan; loon; haadha manaa; abbaa manaa; waliigaltee
Keywords_EN: cow; milk; livestock; wife; husband; mutual agreement

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni niitii hamtuu qabu, yeroo malee dullooma
Translation_Literal_EN: A man who has an ill-natured wife ages prematurely
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa amala badaa, aarii fi qoccolloo baay'iftu abbaa manaa isheef yaaddoo fi dhiphina taatee umuriin osoo hin gahin dafee akka dulloomu taasisti
Meaning_EN: A man burdened with a quarrelsome, toxic wife ages before his time; constant domestic strife and anxiety rapidly drain a husband's youth and health
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiphinni bultii keessaa qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidhee dafee nama dulloomsu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the severe physical and psychological toll an acrimonious spouse inflicts upon a person's vitality and longevity
Keywords_AO: niitii hamtuu; qabaachuu; yeroo malee; dulloomuu; dhiphina; bultii
Keywords_EN: bad wife; having; prematurely; aging; domestic stress; marriage

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni niitii hamtuu qabu, mana keessaa hiyyooma
Translation_Literal_EN: A man who has an ill-natured wife becomes impoverished from inside his house
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa qusannaa hin beekne, qisaasituu fi amala badaa qabdu qabeenya abbaan manaa alaa fidu barbadeessitee mana keessaa hiyyummaa uumti
Meaning_EN: A man with an irresponsible, wasteful wife is reduced to poverty right inside his own home; domestic wastefulness bleeds hard-earned wealth dry
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haati manaa amala qisaasamaa qabdu qabeenya maatii dhabamsiistee hiyyummaatti nama geessu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that an unsupportive, reckless spouse will dissolve all external earnings and plunge the household into chronic destitution
Keywords_AO: niitii hamtuu; mana keessaa; hiyyooma; qisaasama; qabeenya
Keywords_EN: bad wife; inside home; impoverished; wastefulness; wealth

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni niitii gaarii qabu, mana keessaa dulloma
Translation_Literal_EN: A man who has a good wife grows old peacefully inside his house
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa amala gaarii, nagaa fi qusannaa qabdu abbaa manaatiif boqonnaa taati; abbaan manaa alatti dhiphachuu dhiisee manuma isaa keessatti nagaan dullooma
Meaning_EN: A man blessed with a virtuous, loving, and supportive wife enjoys lasting domestic peace; he grows old contentedly within his own household without distress
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haati manaa gaariin nagaa fi tasgabbii bultii eegdee jireenya abbaa manaa bareechitu faarsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate the blessing of a good wife, noting that domestic harmony allows a husband to live out his years in tranquility and dignity at home
Keywords_AO: niitii gaarii; mana keessaa; dulloomuu; nagaa; boqonnaa; tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: good wife; inside home; aging peacefully; peace; comfort; contentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin hamtuun kufa
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad wife brings ruin
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa amala badaa fi safeeffannaa hin qabne bultii, kabaja, qabeenya fi jireenya abbaa manaa guutummaatti barbadeessitee gara kufaatiitti oofti
Meaning_EN: A wicked, irresponsible, or ill-natured wife brings ruin; she destabilizes and collapses the entire foundation, wealth, and reputation of the household
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo filannoo bultii keessatti amala gaariitti xiyyeeffachuu akka qaban, niitiin hamtuun badii maatii akka taate akeekkachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a stark warning when selecting a spouse, stressing that an unprincipled or toxic wife inevitably brings total domestic collapse and ruin
Keywords_AO: niitii hamtuu; kufa; kufaatii; bultii; manca'iinsa; badiisa
Keywords_EN: bad wife; ruin; downfall; marriage; collapse; destruction

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin dhiirsa hin qabne, mana utubaa hin qabne
Translation_Literal_EN: A woman without a husband is like a house without a central pillar
Meaning_AO: Dubartiin abbaa manaa hin qabne eegumsa, kabaja fi gargaarsa bu'uuraa dhabdi; akkuma manni utubaa hin qabne dafee jiguuf saaxilamu, isheenis qorumsaaf saaxilamtuudha
Meaning_EN: A woman without a husband is like a house lacking a central support pillar; she is deprived of foundational protection, social defense, and security
Theme_EN: The Husband as Household Pillar and Protector
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aadaa keessatti dhiirri akka utubaa maatiitti eegumsa fi kabaja bultiif kennu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in traditional social discourse to explain the protective role of marriage and the structural vulnerability faced by single women without support
Keywords_AO: niitii; dhiirsa; mana; utubaa; eegumsa; bultii
Keywords_EN: woman; husband; house; central pillar; protection; marriage

Mammaaksa_AO: "Maaliif lallabda" jennaan, "niitii natti hammaatteetu na lallabsiisa" je'e, korbeeysi
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked 'Why do you bleat so loud?', 'A wife who turned harsh makes me shout,' said the he-goat
Meaning_AO: Dhiirri manatti nagaa fi jaalala dhabee haadha manaatiin dararamu alatti aariin waca, namatti dheekkama, miira tasgabbii dhaba
Meaning_EN: When asked why he bleats loudly, the he-goat blamed his harsh mate; domestic misery and constant harassment at home cause a man to act irritable and noisy outside
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiiraa tokko sababa dhiphina manaatiin alatti aaree wacu qishnaadhaan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously to explain why a man is behaving cross, loud, or distressed in public, tracing his agitation back to domestic misery and nagging
Keywords_AO: lallabuu; niitii; hammaachuu; korbeessa; re'ee; qishnaa; dhiphina
Keywords_EN: shouting; bleating; harsh wife; he-goat; domestic strife; humor

Mammaaksa_AO: Ooyruu qa'ee fi niitii ganamaa booddee itti galan
Translation_Literal_EN: To the homestead farm and the wife of one's youth, one ultimately returns in the end
Meaning_AO: Namni bakka fagoo yoo deemeyyuu gara lafa qe'eetti akkuma deebi'u, jaalallii fi kabajni haadha manaa ishee ganama waliin bultii eegalaniis yoomiyyuu hin badu
Meaning_EN: One ultimately returns to the plot of land beside the homestead and to the first wife of one's youth; one's primary home plot and first love remain the ultimate refuge
Theme_EN: Primacy of First Love and Returning Home
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haadha manaa duraanii kabajuu fi hundee ofiitti deebi'uun qajeelloo ta'uu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind men to honor and appreciate their first wives and ancestral plots, emphasizing that one always returns home to what anchored them from the start
Keywords_AO: ooyruu; qa'ee; niitii ganamaa; booddee; galuu; jaalala
Keywords_EN: farm; homestead; wife of youth; returning; roots; first love

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana galgalaaf ijaarratu, niitii bultiif fuudhu
Translation_Literal_EN: One builds a house for the evening; one marries a wife for a lifetime
Meaning_AO: Manni boqonnaa fi nagaa galgalaa kan itti argataniidha; haati manaas wanta yerootiif osoo hin taane jireenya zalaalamii fi bultii itti fufiinsa qabuuf kan fuudhamtuudha
Meaning_EN: A house is built to provide restful shelter when night falls, and a wife is taken for an enduring, lifelong partnership; marriage demands long-term vision
Theme_EN: Lifelong Purpose and Seriousness of Marriage
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dargaggoota fuudhaaf qophaa'aniif bultiin dhimma yeroo gabaabaa osoo hin taane jireenya bara baraa ta'uu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when counseling youths against treating marriage as a temporary thrill, urging them to choose a spouse with the seriousness of building a permanent shelter
Keywords_AO: mana; galgala; ijaarrachuu; niitii; bultii; fuudhuu; karoora
Keywords_EN: house; evening; building; wife; lifetime; marriage; foresight

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitii duute faarsuun, tan jirtu jallisuu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Praising a deceased wife distorts and alienates the living one
Meaning_AO: Haadha manaa duraanii tan duute yeroo hunda faarsuun haadha manaa amma jirtu mufachiisa, garaa ishee gubee bultii ammaa mancaasa
Meaning_EN: Constantly praising a late wife alienates and embitters the living one, breeding resentment and destabilizing the current marriage through unfair comparison
Theme_EN: Unfair Comparisons and Alienating the Living Spouse
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan manaa tokko haadha manaa duraanii faarsuun ishee amma jirtu mufachiisu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise a widower or remarried man against praising his late wife in front of his new spouse, warning that it poisons the current relationship
Keywords_AO: niitii duute; faarsuu; tan jirtu; jallisuu; bultii; mufannaa
Keywords_EN: deceased wife; praising; living wife; alienating; comparison; resentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan niitii mooha, beekaa ammoo niitiitu moha
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool defeats his wife; as for the wise man, his wife persuades him
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan humnaan haadha manaa isaa caccabsee bituu yaala; namni beekaan garuu jaalala fi mariidhaan haadha manaa isaatiif dursa kennee waliigaltee uuma
Meaning_EN: A fool tries to overpower his wife through brute force, whereas a wise man willingly yields to his wife's counsel and affection to maintain domestic harmony
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiirri tokko manatti humnaan abbaa irree ta'uu dhiisee jaalala fi mariidhaan bultii geggeessuu qaba jedhanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique domestic authoritarianism, reminding men that true marital wisdom lies in mutual accommodation and listening, not domineering control
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; niitii; mo'uu; beekaa; bultii; jaalala; tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: fool; wife; conquering; wise man; persuasion; domestic harmony; wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitii fi irfiin tan ifii gadiiti
Translation_Literal_EN: A wife and a plow-handle are best when shorter than oneself
Meaning_AO: Akkuma irfiin qonnaa dheerina namaatiin ol ta'e qotuu nama dhibu, meeshaan hojiis ta'ee bultiin kan nama wajjin walsimuu fi madaalawaa ta'e jireenya salphisee nagaa fida
Meaning_EN: Just as a plow-handle taller than the farmer makes tilling awkward and unmanageable, practical tools and life partners are best when well-matched and manageable in scale, making life smoother and more cooperative
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo meeshaan hojii fi filannoon gaa'elaa dandeettii fi haala namaatiin walsimuu akka qabu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that practical everyday tools and compatible, well-matched spouses make daily labor and domestic life far smoother and more harmonious
Keywords_AO: niitii; irfii; ifii gadi; qonna; walsimannaa; madaallii; bultii
Keywords_EN: wife; plow-handle; shorter than oneself; compatibility; manageable; practical life; harmony

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin gowwaan mana ifii diiyde, beeytuun mana ifii jaarte
Translation_Literal_EN: A foolish wife destroys her own home; a wise woman builds her own house
Meaning_AO: Dubartiin qalbii hin qabne wacaa fi amala badaadhaan bultii ofii diigdi; dubartiin beektuun garuu obsa, jaalala fi qusannaadhaan maatii ishee cimsitee ijaarti
Meaning_EN: A foolish woman dismantles her own home through strife and bad temper; an astute and wise woman establishes and nurtures her household through prudence
Theme_EN: The Builder vs. The Destroyer of the Home
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gahee dubartiin bultii ijaaruu yookaan diiguu keessatti qabdu gorsanii barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise women on the enormous influence their wisdom and temperament have on either establishing household prosperity or tearing down their family
Keywords_AO: niitii gowwaa; diiguu; beektuu; jaaruu; mana; bultii
Keywords_EN: foolish wife; tearing down; wise woman; building; home; domestic wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Sodaataa du'a dheeysuu fi du'a Goota dheeysituutu walitti dhufa
Translation_Literal_EN: The coward fleeing death and the death that flees from the hero meet together
Meaning_AO: Namni dabeessi du'a baqachuuf jedhee osoo fiiguu du'uma sanatti kufa; gootni garuu du'a hin sodaatu, duutu isa dheessa; sodaan du'a jalaa nama hin oolchu
Meaning_EN: The coward fleeing death runs straight into it, while death evades the hero who confronts it fearlessly; cowardice accelerates doom, whereas courage wards it off
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dabeessi sodaa isaatiin salphinaa fi du'atti kufu, gootni ammoo ija-jabinnaan kabajamu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire bravery in the face of danger, reminding people that running away out of cowardice never saves one from mortality
Keywords_AO: sodaataa; du'a; dheessuu; goota; gootummaa; carraa
Keywords_EN: coward; death; fleeing; hero; courage; fate; inevitability

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa fuudha baranaa, yaa gursummaa bar hegeree
Translation_Literal_EN: Oh wedding of this year, alas the divorce of next year!
Meaning_AO: Fuudhaa fi heeruma jarjaraan, fedhii yeroo fi qorannoo malee raawwatamee dafee gara diigumsaatti jijjiiramu ceepha'a; bultiin qoosaa akka hin taane akeekkachiisa
Meaning_EN: Alas, the lavish wedding of this year will become next year's bitter divorce; laments hasty, impulsive marriages that collapse almost immediately
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni osoo wal hin barin dafanii walfuudhanii yeroo gabaabaa keessatti wal hiikan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize impulsive, showy weddings that lack solid foundation, predicting that hasty vows will disintegrate into quick divorce
Keywords_AO: fuudha; baranaa; gursummaa; bar hegeree; wal hiikuu; jarjara
Keywords_EN: wedding; this year; divorce; next year; hasty marriage; fragility

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan intalaan "dhiirsaafiin si kenna" jennaan "na kennuu na kennitaa, ammoo kan yeroo na arrabsu if arrabsuuf na kenni" jette
Translation_Literal_EN: When the father said 'I will marry you to a husband', she replied, 'Give me to one who, if he insults me, insults himself'
Meaning_AO: Intalli yeroo heerumtu nama kabaja qabu kan yoo ishee arrabse kabaja ofiis miidhu akka kennaniif gaafachuu; kabaja ofii eeggachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The maiden asked to be given to someone whose honor is so intertwined with hers that insulting her degrades himself; seeking a partner of mutual honor and respect
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo intalli dhiirsa kabajamaa fi ulfina ishee akka kan ofiitti ilaalu filachuu akka qabdu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that a maiden should only marry where mutual dignity exists, ensuring that disrespect toward her rebounds on the spouse himself
Keywords_AO: abbaa; intala; dhiirsa; kennuu; arrabsuu; kabaja ofii
Keywords_EN: father; daughter; husband; marriage; insult; mutual dignity; honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Bultiin raroo harreeti
Translation_Literal_EN: Marriage is like the packsaddle of a donkey
Meaning_AO: Bultiin akkuma raroo harree yeroo hunda jallachuu fi garagaluu danda'a; yeroo hunda obsaan qajeelchuu, wal-danda'uu fi kunuunsuu barbaada
Meaning_EN: Marriage is like a donkey's packsaddle; it constantly tilts and loosens unless spouses continually adjust, balance, and maintain it with patience
Theme_EN: Constant Maintenance and Fragility of Marriage
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bultii keessatti rakkoon uumamee obsaa fi mariidhaan yeroo hunda sirreessuu akka qaban gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel struggling couples, reminding them that marriage naturally shifts and encounters friction, requiring persistent readjustment
Keywords_AO: bultii; raroo; harree; jallachuu; qajeelchuu; obsa
Keywords_EN: marriage; packsaddle; donkey; balance; maintenance; patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni duuydaa fi niitiin ol ka'a
Translation_Literal_EN: A person rises through the backbone (kin) and a wife
Meaning_AO: Guddinni, milkaa'innii fi kabajni dhiira tokkoo deeggarsa firaa fi haadha manaa gaarii qabaachuu irratti hirkata; isaan lamaan utubaa jireenyaati
Meaning_EN: A man rises, prospers, and attains social prominence through two great pillars: a supportive clan backbone and a virtuous, faithful wife
Theme_EN: Pillars of Success: Kinship and Wife
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gahee haadha manaa fi firaa milkaa'ina dhiiraa keessatti qaban faarsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to honor the indispensable contributions of a faithful wife and loyal clan members in elevating a man to social respect and prosperity
Keywords_AO: nama; dugda; niitii; ol ka'uu; guddina; utubaa
Keywords_EN: person; backbone; kin; wife; rising; success; support

Mammaaksa_AO: "Yoo anaa fi ati wal taane, rakkoon hin jiru, hiraanni bilchoodha" jette, niitiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'If you and I are united, there is no trouble; hardship is easily digested,' said the wife
Meaning_AO: Abbaan manaa fi haati manaa yoo jaalala fi tokkummaa qabaatan, hiyyummaan fi dhiphinni alaa dhufe hunduu salphaatti danda'ama; tokkummaan bultii hunda mo'ata
Meaning_EN: 'If you and I stand in unified agreement, no hardship can defeat us; even bitter adversity is easily endured,' said the wife; spousal solidarity conquers all trials
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyummaa fi qorumsa keessatti abbaan manaa fi haati manaa jaalalaan wal cimsanii rakkoo mo'atan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire couples facing poverty or hardship, affirming that deep spousal solidarity and mutual love make any trial bearable and surmountable
Keywords_AO: wal ta'uu; rakkoo; hiraana; bilchoo; niitii; tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: unity; harmony; hardship; overcome; wife; marital solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Himaan numa himaa; dhagayaatu hin jirre
Translation_Literal_EN: The advisor speaks; it is a listener that is missing
Meaning_AO: Namni gorsaa fi dhugaa dubbatu hin dhabamu, garuu kan gorsa sana qalbiin dhaga'ee hojiirra oolchutu dhabame; gorsa tuffachuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: There is never a shortage of sound advice and warnings; what is truly lacking is an obedient ear willing to listen and act upon the counsel
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni akeekkachiisa fi gorsa kennamuuf cufatanii balaa keessa of buusanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when people ignore clear warnings and counsel only to suffer predictable consequences, pointing out that listeners are rare
Keywords_AO: himaa; himuu; dhagayaa; dhabamuu; gorsa; qalbii
Keywords_EN: teller; speaking; listener; absence; counsel; heedless

Mammaaksa_AO: Qalameen shanyii gadhee, reeffa fira ofiitti kolfiti
Translation_Literal_EN: A monkey of bad breed laughs at the corpse of its own kin
Meaning_AO: Namni amala badaa fi safeeffannaa hin qabne gadda fi rakkina fira isaatti gammada, itti kolfas; safuu dhabuu fi hammeenya firaa balaaleffata
Meaning_EN: An ill-bred monkey laughs at the corpse of its own kin; condemns callous, shameless individuals who mock or rejoice in the misfortunes of their family
Theme_AO: Safuu Dhabuu fi Gadda Firaatti Kolfuu
Theme_EN: Lack of Empathy and Mocking Kin's Tragedy
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gadda firaa fi rakkina maatiitti koflee qaanii dhabu balaaleffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone so devoid of familial love and decency that they mock or celebrate when disaster strikes their own kin
Keywords_AO: qamalee; shanyii gadhee; reeffa; fira; kolfuu; safuu
Keywords_EN: monkey; bad breed; corpse; kin; laughing; callousness

Mammaaksa_AO: Ani hin hanbifannee, ati hin qalbifanne
Translation_Literal_EN: I held nothing back, but you failed to take heed
Meaning_AO: Namni gorsu dhimma sana osoo hin dhoksin ifatti himee ture, garuu inni gorfamu qalbii kennuu dhabee kufaatiif of saaxile; itti gaafatamummaa ofii agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: I did not withhold any warning or truth, but you failed to pay attention; said to clear one's conscience when someone ignores advice and suffers ruin
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsa duraan kennameef diddee booda rakkina keessa galte itti dubbatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reminding someone that they were thoroughly warned before making a ruinous mistake and have only their own stubbornness to blame
Keywords_AO: hanbisuu; qalbifachuu; gorsa; akeekkachiisa; dhugaa
Keywords_EN: withholding; heeding; advice; warning; accountability

Mammaaksa_AO: Wadalli harree, haadha hin xooru
Translation_Literal_EN: A male donkey does not spare its own mother
Meaning_AO: Namni safuu, naamusa fi dhaloota hin beekne maatii ofiitiif illee kabaja hin qabu; amala bineensummaa fi daangaa safuu cabsuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: A male donkey has no filial boundary or respect for its own mother; satirizes uncouth, shameless people who violate sacred family taboos
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko maatii isaatiif kabaja fi safeeffannaa dhabee daangaa safuu cabsu balaaleffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn an utterly shameless person who mistreats, dishonors, or exploits their own parents and immediate family without remorse
Keywords_AO: wadala; harree; haadha; xooruu; safuu; kabaja dhabuu
Keywords_EN: male donkey; mother; sparing; incest; taboo; shamelessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Yeroo inni kaan dhugaa dubbatu, inni kaan dinnicha kadhata
Translation_Literal_EN: While one speaks the solemn truth, the other begs for potatoes
Meaning_AO: Yeroo dhimma jireenyaa isa murteessaa fi ulfaataa irratti mari'atan, namni qalbii hin qabne wanta laafaa fi fedhii qaamaa kaasee dubbii jallisuu ceepha'a
