Meaning_AO: Osoo rakkoo fi ba'aa duraanii furuu dadhabanii dhiphatanii, rakkoon isa caalaa ulfaataa fi dachaa ta'e dabalataan dhufee nama liqimsuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Already overwhelmed managing my father, my grandfather arrives dragging his father along; being crushed by ever-multiplying, heavier burdens
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qorumsi jiru osoo hin dhumatin rakkoon gurguddoon dabalataa dhufee nama humna dhabsiisu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a person already staggering under a difficult problem is suddenly hit by a succession of far more massive, insurmountable crises
Keywords_AO: abbaa; dadhabuu; akaakayyuu; ba'aa; dhiphina; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: father; exhaustion; grandfather; heavy burden; overwhelm

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka si jaalatanii yoo deemte, bakka si jibban dhayxa
Translation_Literal_EN: If you leave where you are loved, you will arrive where you are hated
Meaning_AO: Bakka kabaja, jaalala fi nagaa qabdu tuffattee gara ormaatti baqachuun salphinaa fi jibbaaf nama saaxila; iddoo kabajaa ofii eeggachuu gorsa
Meaning_EN: If you abandon the place where you are loved and cherished, you will end up among strangers where you are hated; treasure your sanctuary
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko qe'ee fi fira isa jaalatu tuffatee bakka ormaa fi salphinatti deemuuf ka'u akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone against abandoning loving relatives and respectful surroundings to wander among strangers who hold them in contempt
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu; deemuu; jibbuu; dhaquu; kabaja; fira
Keywords_EN: loved; leaving; hated; arriving; home sanctuary; respect

Mammaaksa_AO: Kofalteetuu hin bareennee, boochu bareeddii?
Translation_Literal_EN: She was not attractive even smiling; will she become beautiful while weeping?
Meaning_AO: Namni uumamaaniifi amalaan yeroo nagaa fudhatama hin qabne, aarii fi komii keessatti ammoo daran nama nuffisiisa malee hin miidhagu
Meaning_EN: She was unattractive even when smiling; will she look appealing weeping? If someone lacks charm at their best, sulking only makes them repulsive
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni duraanuu amala hin tolle qabu aaree fi booyee nama saalfachiisu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to deride someone with an already unappealing demeanor who thinks sulking, weeping, or throwing tantrums will make others cater to them
Keywords_AO: kofaluu; bareeduu; booyuu; amala badaa; qishnaa; komii
Keywords_EN: smiling; attractive; weeping; sulking; chronic bitterness

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkinni koo rakkinaa, haati too ammaas ulfa
Translation_Literal_EN: My troubles are already trouble enough, and my mother is pregnant once again
Meaning_AO: Osoo hiyyummaa fi ba'aan duraanii furmaata hin argatin, itti-gaafatamummaan fi rakkoon biraa dabalamee jireenya rakkisaa gochuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: My troubles are already heavy enough, and yet my mother is pregnant once again; lamenting mounting liabilities when one cannot survive present woes
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hiyyeessa ta'e tokko osoo rakkoo duraaniirraa hin bayyanatin ba'aan biraa itti fe'amu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to voice dark humor or rueful exasperation when new dependants, expenses, or burdens are heaped upon someone already in severe poverty
Keywords_AO: rakkina; haadha; ulfa; hiyyummaa; ba'aa; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: trouble; mother; pregnant; poverty; compounded liability

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan kuferratti, kan caphe dhufe
Translation_Literal_EN: On top of the one who fell, the broken one arrived
Meaning_AO: Namni yookaan dhimmi duraanuu kufee rakkachaa jiru irratti, dhimmi isa caalaa miidhamaa ta'e biraa itti dabalamee ba'aa ulfeessuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: On top of the fallen person arrives the one with broken limbs; accumulating miseries where the crippled are burdened with caring for the shattered
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon tokko osoo hin furamin dhibeen isa caalu itti dabalamee haala rakkisaa uumu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe a heartbreaking accumulation of misfortunes where an already afflicted person or family is hit by an even more crippled liability
Keywords_AO: kufuu; cabuu; dhufuu; rakkina; balaa; gadda
Keywords_EN: falling; broken; arriving; compounded misfortune; misery

Mammaaksa_AO: Duruu hin goomtuu, boosattii bokkeenyi dhaane
Translation_Literal_EN: She was not tidy to begin with, and now the rain has drenched the slovenly woman
Meaning_AO: Namni duraanuu dhibaa'aa fi qulqullina hin qabne yoo balaan xiqqoon itti dhufe akka sababaatti fayyadamee guutummaatti of gata
Meaning_EN: She was untidy to begin with, and now the downpour has drenched her; an already lazy person finds the perfect excuse in a setback to quit altogether
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hojiif dhibaa'aa ta'e rakkoo uumame akka sababaatti dhiheeffatee hojii dhaabu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose an inherently lazy, slovenly individual who seizes upon a minor external misfortune as an alibi for their total lack of effort
Keywords_AO: goomuu; boosattii; bokkeenya; dhaanuu; dhibaa'ummaa; sababa
Keywords_EN: tidy; slovenly; rain; drenched; laziness; excuses

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysaan dheeysattiin, leenca afaan bu'e
Translation_Literal_EN: Fleeing from the hyena, I fell straight into the mouth of the lion
Meaning_AO: Balaa xiqqaa jalaa baqachuuf yaalanii balaa isa duraanii caalaa sodaachisaa fi lubbuu galaafatu keessa of buusuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Running away from the hyena, I plunged right into the jaws of the lion; escaping a lesser threat only to fall into fatal, insurmountable peril
Theme_EN: Escaping a Lesser Hazard into Greater Peril
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko rakkoo duraaniirraa dheessa jedhee balaa lubbuu galaafatu keessatti of arge ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an attempt to escape a manageable danger or oppressive condition ends in confronting a far more lethal and merciless catastrophe
Keywords_AO: waraabessa; dheessuu; leenca; afaan; bu'uu; balaa
Keywords_EN: hyena; fleeing; lion; jaws; landing; fatal peril

Mammaaksa_AO: Fanxoo, kan maqaa isii irra kan madaa isii haa caalu
Translation_Literal_EN: Syphilis, may its physical wound surpass its shameful reputation
Meaning_AO: Salphinni, yeelloon fi qaanfiin maqaa balleessaan fidu madaa qaamaa caalaa nama miidha; madaan fayyuu danda'a garuu salphinni hin fayyu
Meaning_EN: The social dishonor and infamy of a shameful affliction are far more agonizing than physical pain; wounds can heal, but a tainted reputation lingers
Theme_EN: The Stigma of Shame vs. Physical Pain
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko salphina maqaa fi qaanfii uummata duraatiin dhiphatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone suffers deep public disgrace, noting that the social stigma of an affliction cuts far deeper than physical suffering
Keywords_AO: fanxoo; maqaa; madaa; caaluu; yeelloo; salphina
Keywords_EN: syphilis; reputation; wound; shame; social stigma; dishonor

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeeysa hoggaa bakka bulu dhoorku, dhuufu itti guddisa
Translation_Literal_EN: When seeking to deny a poor person a place to sleep, [fate/one] increases his flatulence
Meaning_AO: Carraan yookaan namni hiyyeessa dhoowwatu dhiphina itti dabala; carraan yoo itti jallatte wanti hunduu dhufee hiyyeessa saaxila, yookaan ormi bakka bulmaa dhoowwachuuf sababa kajeelchaa fi komii dhuufuu itti guddisa
Meaning_EN: Reflects the compounded misfortune of the poor where even fate and bodily digestion betray a destitute person at the worst moment to deny him shelter; alternately satirizes an inhospitable host inventing or exaggerating a poor guest's flatulence as a petty excuse to turn him out into the cold
Theme_EN: Compounded Misfortune and Pretexts Against the Poor
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessarratti rakkinni wal hordofee carraan kamuu jalaa dhabamu, yookaan namni tokko harka-qalleessa manaa ari'uuf sababa qishnaa uumu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when bad luck relentlessly conspires against an already struggling person at the worst possible hour, or to call out an inhospitable host manufacturing absurd pretexts to turn away the poor
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa; bakka buluu; dhoorkuu; dhuufuu; carraa dhabuu; sababa sobaa; gadadoo
Keywords_EN: poor person; shelter; denying lodging; flatulence; compounded bad luck; pretexts; tragicomedy

Mammaaksa_AO: Fardaa bade, kan jiruun badde
Translation_Literal_EN: For the horse that is lost, one whose very livelihood is destroyed
Meaning_AO: Kasaaraan qabeenya bu'uuraa tokkoo jireenyaa fi jiruu namaa guutummaatti mancaasee hiyyummaa keessa nama galchuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Losing a vital asset shatters one's entire livelihood; the collapse of a central foundation brings down the entire life and functioning of a person
Theme_EN: Loss of Vital Assets and Downfall of Livelihood
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qabeenyi murteessaan badee jireenyi nama sanaa guutummaatti rakkina keessa galu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when the loss of a single indispensable resource or breadwinner leads to the complete destitution and ruin of an entire household
Keywords_AO: farda; baduu; jireenya; jiruu; kasaaraa; miidhaa
Keywords_EN: horse; lost; livelihood; life; asset loss; ruin

Mammaaksa_AO: "Tiyya tana, kan ballisu malee, kan dhiphisu hin agarre" jette, namittiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'This thing of mine, I have only seen what widens it, never what narrows it,' said the woman
Meaning_AO: Rakkina, dhibee yookaan ba'aa yeroo hunda babal'atu malee xiqqaachuu hin beekne qishnaadhaan ibsa; dhiphinni guddachaa deema
Meaning_EN: 'This affliction of mine only ever expands, never contracts,' said the woman; satirizes problems, debts, or grievances that perpetually grow larger without relief
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon yookaan dhibeen tokko yeroo gara yerootti hammaachaa fi bal'achaa deemu qishnaadhaan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously or ruefully when a nagging problem, debt, or illness continuously expands instead of diminishing
Keywords_AO: ballisuu; dhiphisuu; arguu; namittii; rakkina babal'atu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: widening; narrowing; seeing; woman; expanding trouble; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: "Hiyyeeysaaf maaltu dawa" jennaan, "xanne" je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked 'What is the medicine for a poor person?', he replied, 'Xanne (acute diarrhea/dysentery)'
Meaning_AO: Hiyyummaa fi beela hamaa addunyaa kanaa irratti qishnaa hadhaawaa dubbatamuudha; namni hiyyeessi garaa duwwaa qabaachuu isaatiif yookaan dhiphina jireenyaa jalaa dafee du'aan boqochuuf dhibeen albaatii hamaa akka xannee akka qorichaatti qishnaan dubbatame
Meaning_EN: A grim, dark satirical proverb on the agony of extreme poverty: when asked what 'medicine' exists for a starving pauper, the cynical answer is 'xanne' (acute diarrhea/dysentery)—a fatal purging illness that empties an already starving stomach and brings quick release from lifelong misery
Theme_EN: Dark Satire, Poverty, and Fatal Afflictions
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyummaan daangaa darbee rakkina furmaata hin qabne ta'u qishnaa hadhaawaa fi abdii kutannaatiin dubbatamutti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used with bitter, dark humor when commenting on the hopeless, agonizing reality of chronic poverty, where even a devastating, purging illness like diarrhea is cynically framed as a 'cure' that ends the pauper's suffering
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa; dawaa; qoricha; xanne; albaatii; beela; qishnaa; gadadoo
Keywords_EN: poor person; medicine; remedy; xanne; diarrhea; dysentery; dark humor; cynical; poverty

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan cicherratti, kan gaggabu dhufe

Meaning_AO: Rakkina duraan jiru isa furmaata hin arganne irratti, dhimmi dadhabaan biraa dhufee ba'aa dabalataa ta'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: On top of a situation already strained to the breaking point, arrives another who is collapsing; compounding crises where the strained must carry the fainting
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni duraanuu dhiphachaa jiru tokko ba'aa nama biraa isa caalaa dadhabaa ta'ee dabalataan baachuuf dirqamu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an already exhausted, financially strapped person is suddenly burdened with another completely helpless dependent or disaster
Keywords_AO: cichuu; gaggabuu; dhufuu; rakkina; ba'aa; dhiphina
Keywords_EN: strained; fainting; arriving; compounded burden; crisis

Mammaaksa_AO: Raammoo baqattee, bofa afaan buute
Translation_Literal_EN: Fleeing from an earthworm, she fell into the mouth of a snake
Meaning_AO: Wanta xiqqoo fi balaa hin qabne sodaatanii baqachuudhaan, balaa lubbuu galaafatu isa guddaa keessa of buusuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Fleeing in panic from a harmless earthworm, she plunged right into the jaws of a deadly snake; panicking over petty fears only to land in fatal peril
Theme_EN: Petty Panic Leading to Fatal Peril
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko rakkoo salphaa baqachuu yaalee wanta lubbuu balleessu keessa of buusu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against irrational overreaction to small discomforts, which often drives people directly into the path of lethal catastrophe

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan beekaa mugu, yaaman hin owwaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: He who pretends to doze off deliberately does not answer when called
Meaning_AO: Namni beekaa dantaa dhabuuf jedhee rafe fakkaatu yookaan gurra cufate, hangamiyyuu yoo waaman deebii hin kennu
Meaning_EN: One who is deliberately feigning sleep will never answer when summoned; there is no waking someone who is intentionally pretending to be oblivious
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko beekaa dhimma tokko jalaa miliquuf callisee akka nama hin beekneetti of fakkeessu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when attempting to engage someone who deliberately plays dumb, pretending not to hear or understand in order to shirk duty
Keywords_AO: beekaa; muguu; yaamuu; owwaachuu; fakkeessummaa; callisuu
Keywords_EN: feigned; dozing; summoning; answering; pretense; avoidance

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhagayaa didaan, yaaman hin owwaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: He who refuses to listen does not answer when called
Meaning_AO: Namni gurra qabaatee dhaga'uu didee fi mata-jabeessa ta'e, waamicha fi gorsa hundaaf gurra cufata malee deebii hin kennu
Meaning_EN: One who is obstinately determined not to listen will never respond when summoned; willful deafness cannot be penetrated by reasoning
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsa fi waamicha hunda tuffatee mata-jabinnaan diddaa agarsiisu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize an obstinate individual who willfully turns a deaf ear to all appeals, advice, and instructions

Keywords_EN: refusing to hear; summoning; answering; obstinacy; willful deafness

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama beekaa dhukate, yaamiinsi godaa isa hin baasu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who hid himself deliberately, shouting will not draw him from the valley
Meaning_AO: Namni beekaa dhimma tokko jalaa dhokatee fi hirmaachuu dide, hangamiyyuu yoo waamanii fi kadhatan bakka dhokateetii hin bahu
Meaning_EN: A person who has deliberately concealed himself will not be drawn out of the hollow by shouting; you cannot retrieve someone determined to hide

Keywords_EN: deliberate; hiding; shouting; valley; retrieval; evasion

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaalli diddaaf deemu cancala hin seenu
Translation_Literal_EN: A camel set on defiance does not enter the halter
Meaning_AO: Namni yookaan bineensi fincilaa fi diddaadhaaf qophaa'e qajeelfamaa fi to'annoo jala galuu dida; diddaan guutame to'achuun ulfaataadha
Meaning_EN: A camel bent on resistance will not let its head enter the halter; an individual determined on defiance cannot easily be reined in or disciplined

Translation_Literal_EN: A hand bent on resistance does not enter the mouth of the sack
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii fi gargaarsa diduuf murteeffate carraa fi qajeelfama kamiyyuu keessa hin seenu; harki hojjechuu dide firii hin argatu

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand someone whose stubborn refusal to cooperate or work keeps them destitute and excludes them from shared rewards

Keywords_EN: hand; defiance; sack mouth; entering; refusing work; exclusion

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki fuudhutti hin jirre, daduu Balloo hin seenu
Translation_Literal_EN: A hand not set to take does not enter the wide pouch
Meaning_AO: Namni carraa yookaan bu'aa tokko argachuuf fedhii fi kutannoo hin qabne, carraan bal'aan yoo dhufe iyyuu itti hin fayyadamu; fedhii dhabuun carraa dhabsiisa
Meaning_EN: A hand that does not reach out to receive will not enter even a wide pouch; one who lacks the initiative to grasp an opportunity gains nothing even in abundance
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo carraan bal'aan dhufee garuu namni tokko dhibaa'ummaan fudhachuu dhabu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an abundance of opportunity is presented but someone loses out purely due to lack of effort, initiative, and eagerness to reach out

Keywords_EN: hand; receiving; pouch; wide; opportunity; initiative

Mammaaksa_AO: Tika didaan, dhihana dida
Translation_Literal_EN: He who refuses to herd refuses his evening meal
Meaning_AO: Namni hojjechuufi tattaaffii gochuu dide nyaata fi bu'aa hojii sana irraa argamu argachuuf mirga hin qabu; hojiin malee nyaanni hin jiru
Meaning_EN: He who refuses to tend the flock has no claim to the evening meal; if you do not labor, you shall not eat; work is the prerequisite for sustenance
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhibaa'aan hojii didee garuu qooda nyaataa fi qabeenyaa barbaadu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke idle, lazy individuals who refuse to contribute their share of labor but demand equal portions of food and wealth

Keywords_EN: herding; refusal; dinner; work; food; entitlement

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama dhagayaa rafu, dammaysuun nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who sleeps while hearing, waking him exhausts a person
Meaning_AO: Namni beekaa akka waan hin hubatinitti of fakkeessu yookaan gorsa dhaga'uu dide gorsanii qajeelchuun baay'ee ulfaataadha; fedhii ofii malee namni hin jijjiiramu
Meaning_EN: It is impossible to wake someone who is pretending to sleep; one who willfully feigns ignorance and refuses to listen cannot be reasoned with or helped
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko beekaa dhugaa jiru arguufi dhaga'uu didee akka gowwaatti of dhiheessu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama

Keywords_EN: person; hearing; sleeping; waking; pretense; willful ignorance

Mammaaksa_AO: Sagaliin akhaafe, diddu diddiimaatti
Translation_Literal_EN: I shoveled nine times, yet the red soil stubbornly refuses
Meaning_AO: Dhimma tokko yookaan nama tokko qajeelchuuf hangamiyyuu yoo dhama'anii fi yaalan, amalli isaa jijjiiramuu didee akkuma duraatti diddaa fiduu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Having shoveled nine times, the stubborn red soil still refuses to yield; describes exhausting, repeated efforts to reform an obstinately intractable problem
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoo yookaan amala nama tokkoo jijjiiruuf carraaqqii hedduun godhamee bu'aa dhabu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express exhaustion when repeated attempts to reason with, correct, or resolve a stubborn issue yield zero progress
Keywords_AO: sagali; akhaafuu; diduu; diddiimaa; dadhabbii; amala
Keywords_EN: nine times; shoveling; refusal; red soil; frustration; obstinacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhaannaan weywaachuu diddee, yaamnaan owwaachuu diddee, niitiin hamtuun dhiirsa ofii qaanyeeysite
Translation_Literal_EN: Beaten, she refused to wail; called, she refused to answer; the bad wife humiliated her husband
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa amala badaa fi mata-jabeettiin toftaa kamiyyuu diddee dhiirsa ishee orma duratti qaaneessituu fi bultii keessatti to'annoo dhabsiiftu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: When disciplined, she refused to cry; when summoned, she refused to answer; an incorrigible, defiant wife completely humiliates her husband by denying him respect
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haati manaa amala dhabeessi tokko diddaa fi boonaan abbaa manaa ishee hawaasa duratti salphistu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe an utterly defiant, unyielding spouse who deliberately disrespects and humiliates her husband through obstinate silence and rebellion
Keywords_AO: dhaanuu; weywaachuu; yaamuu; owwaachuu; niitii hamtuu; qaaneessuu
Keywords_EN: beating; wailing; calling; answering; bad wife; humiliation

Mammaaksa_AO: Harkifnaan deemuu diddee, yaabbannaan saggaaruu diddee, gaangeen hamtuun abbicha qaanyeeysite
Translation_Literal_EN: Pulled, she refused to walk; mounted, she refused to trot; the bad mule humiliated its owner
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan yookaan namni amala hin qabne yeroo barbaadame hundatti tajaajila dhoowwatee abbaa dhimmaa qaanii fi dhiphina keessa buusuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Pulled by the rein, she refused to budge; mounted, she refused to trot; a stubborn mule humiliates its master; obstinate assets bring public shame
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojjetaan, tajaajilaan yookaan meeshaan tokko bakka ulfinaatti diddaa agarsiisee abbaa dhimmaa saalfachiisu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an obstinate employee, companion, or animal embarrasses their master by completely refusing to cooperate in public
Keywords_AO: harkisuu; deemuu; yaabbachuu; saggaaruu; gaangee; qaaneessuu
Keywords_EN: pulling; walking; mounting; trotting; bad mule; embarrassment

Mammaaksa_AO: Diinni michii jiruuti
Translation_Literal_EN: An enemy is the fever and ailment of living
Meaning_AO: Diinni jireenya keessatti akkuma dhibee michiitti nagaa, tasgabbii fi gammachuu namaa dhabamsiisa; jireenyi diina qabu yeroo hundumaa dhukkubbii fi dhiphinaan kan guutamedha
Meaning_EN: An enemy is like an acute, distressing fever of life; having an adversary continually drains a person's peace of mind, poisons daily well-being, and serves as an unceasing affliction throughout existence

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko diinummaan nagaa dhabee jireenyi itti ulfaatu, diinni akka dhibee dhukkubsuutti jireenya namaa booressuu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reflecting on the exhausting mental and physical toll of living with a bitter adversary, noting that an enemy is a ceaseless illness that deprives life of sweetness
Keywords_AO: diina; michii; jiruu; dhukkuba; dhiphina; nagaa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: enemy; fever; ailment; michii; adversity; torment; peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhamalli daaraa keeysaa, osoo hin agarre nama guba

Meaning_AO: Hariiroon namoota uumamaan diina ta'anii yookaan gartuu wal caalu gidduu jiru soba; taphaa fi nagaa fakkeessanis dhuma irratti miidhaan dhufuun hin oolu

Meaning_EN: Do not delegate the elimination of an enemy to another; dispatch him with your own hands to verify he is dead; verify decisive actions personally

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati hamtuun waraanaa, aayyadaan hamtuun diina
Translation_Literal_EN: A cruel mother is a spear; a cruel maternal aunt is an enemy
Meaning_AO: Namni dhihoo fi fira dhiigaa ta'ee osoo kunuunsuu qabuu nama miidhu akkuma waraanaatti laalessa; firoonni amala hamaa qaban miidhaa guddaa geessisu
Meaning_EN: A cruel mother pierces like a spear, and a cruel aunt acts like an enemy; cruelty from one's own flesh and blood inflicts deeper, more agonizing trauma than attacks by strangers

Meaning_AO: Diinni fagoo jiru salphaatti nama hin miidhu; miidhaan inni cimaan kan nama mudatu yoo inni fira fakkaatee mana namaa seene yookaan iccitii namaa bare qofaadha

Meaning_EN: The very person who saw my poverty and nakedness stole my most prized camel; those who know your deepest vulnerabilities are the ones who rob you of your wealth

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhihoo fi hanqina ofii beeku tokko gantummaadhaan qabeenya namaa saametti itti fayyadama

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka irraa hin oolle, kokkoflaati dhaqani

Meaning_EN: What could not be gained or saved through tears and mourning, let go with a smile; since weeping cannot alter the outcome or restore what was lost, accept the forfeit with good cheer and stoic equanimity

Mammaaksa_AO: Aannan gadi naqame, hammuma dhaqqaban ol qabani

Meaning_EN: Captures the bitter, tragicomic irony of complete physical and political powerlessness: one's aching back prevents bending down for one's own needs, yet sheer lack of strength leaves one unable to refuse subjugation and tribute to an enemy

Meaning_EN: He who loves and cherishes my sister is an in-law to me; whoever shows honor, protection, and affection to one's family earns a cherished place of kinship

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to welcome and honor someone who treats your sister or family with love, affirming that respect for one's kin establishes sacred bonds of kinship

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan aayyoo fuudhe, anaaf aabboo dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Whoever married my mother is a father to me

Meaning_EN: Whoever marries my mother is a father to me; pragmatic acceptance of unfolding reality and acknowledging whoever legitimately holds the seat of authority
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni haaraa aangoo qabate yookaan haalli jireenyaa jijjiiramee dirqamaan fudhachuu qabanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when counseling pragmatic realism, reminding someone to accept and respect whoever currently holds leadership or authority over them

Keywords_EN: mother; marriage; father; authority; pragmatic acceptance; respect

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort someone frustrated by uncontrollable life circumstances, reminding them that not even our own flesh completely obeys our will

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin dhiirsi irraa du'e, niitii nama hafeeti

Meaning_AO: Namni wanta bu'uuraa dhabe dhiphina sana mo'achuuf wanta argamee fi salphaa ta'e akka qabeenya ofiitti kunuunsuuf dirqama
Meaning_EN: A childless woman raises the child of a bondservant as her own; deep lack compels a person to pour love and investment into whatever substitute exists
Theme_EN: Finding Substitutes in Times of Deprivation
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhabamuu cimaa keessa jiru wanta argame qabatee of jajjabeessu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how human beings cope with painful deprivation by wholeheartedly adopting and nurturing modest alternatives
Keywords_AO: dhabduu; ilmoo; gabra; guddisuu; bakka bu'uu; dhabamuu
Keywords_EN: childless; child; servant; raising; fosterage; substitute

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni ilma dhabe, intala taphsiisa
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who lacks a son plays with his daughter
Meaning_AO: Wanta hawwan yoo dhaban wantuma qabanitti gammaduu fi galateeffachuun jireenya tasgabbeessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: A person who lacks a son lavishes affection on his daughter; learning to appreciate, celebrate, and find joy in the blessings one has
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko wanta dhabeef gadduu dhiisee wanta qabutti quufee gammadu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage counting one's blessings, urging someone to find joy and fulfillment in what they possess rather than grieving over what was denied
Keywords_AO: ilma; dhabuu; intala; taphsiisuu; quufa; maatii
Keywords_EN: son; lacking; daughter; playing; contentment; family

Mammaaksa_AO: Fardi hokkollaan, dhabaaf harree qabani
Translation_Literal_EN: When the horse is lame, for lack of choice one hitches a donkey
Meaning_AO: Yeroo meeshaan yookaan namni cimaan dhibame, dhimma ofii xumuruuf wantuma argametti dhimma bahuun dirqama ta'a
Meaning_EN: When the horse is lame, for want of better, one mounts a donkey; in the absence of prime tools, necessity obliges one to use modest substitutes
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gargaarsa cimaa dhabee wanta laafaadhaan hojii geggeeffachuuf dirqamu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when circumstances force someone to employ a slow or modest tool because the primary, faster option is damaged or unavailable
Keywords_AO: farda; hokkoluu; dhaba; harree; qabachuu; bakka bu'iinsa
Keywords_EN: horse; lame; lack; donkey; hitching; necessity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dirqii irrattuu Abdoon damiina
Translation_Literal_EN: Even under coercion, Abdo is still the chieftain
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko yoo jaalatamees yoo jibbames, dirqama ta'us aangoo fi sadarkaan isaa beekamtii argachuu qaba
Meaning_EN: Even grudgingly, Abdo is still the chieftain; whether one likes it or not, de facto authority, status, and reality must be acknowledged
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni hoggansa nama tokkoo jibbanis dirqamaan fudhachuu akka qaban hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama

Keywords_AO: dirqii; abdoo; damiina; aangoo; hoggansa; fudhachuu
Keywords_EN: coercion; Abdo; chieftain; authority; de facto power; realism

Mammaaksa_AO: Farda seheetiin, harree irratti kooraa fi'adhe
Translation_Literal_EN: Thinking it was a horse, I strapped a saddle onto a donkey
Meaning_AO: Nama dandeettii fi naamus-qabeessa seetanii nama dandeettii hin qabneetti dhimma guddaa kennanii booda gaabbuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: Mistaking it for a horse, I strapped my saddle onto a donkey; regretting a foolish error where one misjudged an incompetent person for a champion
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko nama dandeettii hin qabnetti amantee hojii guddaa kenneefii kasaaru ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to voice chagrin when one has wasted high honors, trust, or heavy responsibility on an incompetent person who failed utterly

Keywords_EN: horse; thinking; donkey; saddle; strapping; misjudgment

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirsa Tamboon huutetti, niitiin kofla duute
Translation_Literal_EN: While the husband choked on tobacco, the wife died laughing
Meaning_AO: Yeroo dhiirri rakkoo fi dhiphina keessa jiru haati manaa gargaaruu dhiistee itti qishnaa gochuu fi tuffachuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: While the husband was choking on tobacco smoke, the wife died laughing; satirizes an unfeeling, spiteful spouse who finds amusement in distress

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bultii keessatti jaalalli dhabamee wal irratti qishnaa godhan balaaleffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate severe domestic dysfunction where empathy has died, and a partner openly mocks the other's pain and physical distress
Keywords_AO: dhiirsa; tamboo; huutuu; niitii; kofla; dantaa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: husband; tobacco; choking; wife; laughter; spousal cruelty

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsa lubbuuf seequ, ijoolleen kan koflu seeti
Translation_Literal_EN: An elder grimacing for his life, children think he is smiling
Meaning_AO: Dhiphinaa fi gidiraa cimaa nama guddarra jiru ijoolleen yookaan namoonni dammaqina hin qabne akka taphaatti ilaaluu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: An old man grimacing in agony for his dying breath, children mistake for smiling; critiques naive observers who mistake mortal agony for amusement

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama Izraa'il Du'aa arihu Jaarsoon waa dhiiraa jettee faarsiti
Translation_Literal_EN: A man pursued by the Angel of Death, Jaarso praises as a dashing hero
Meaning_AO: Namni balaa fi du'a jalaa lubbuu baafachuuf fiigu tokko, namoonni dhimma isaa hin beekne akka waan gootummaan fiiguutti faarsuun gowwummaadha
Meaning_EN: A man desperately fleeing the Angel of Death is praised by naive onlookers as a dashing hero; outside observers mistake desperate flight for bold heroism
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiphinaa fi sodaa hamaa keessa jiru tokko ormaan akka nama jabaatti faarfamu qishnaadhaan ibsuuf itti fayyadama

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabricha lubbuu kaatu, ormi jabeenya jaja
Translation_Literal_EN: A slave running for his life, onlookers praise his strength
Meaning_AO: Namni rakkinaa fi dhiphina keessa jiru lubbuu ofii oolchuuf yeroo dhama'u, ormi garuu dhiphina isaa osoo hin hubatin akka jabinnaatti faarsa
Meaning_EN: A servant running in terror to save his life, yet spectators applaud his endurance; outsiders admire the speed of someone running in mortal agony

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique callous onlookers who marvel at the frantic struggles of an oppressed person instead of recognizing their desperate cry for survival
Keywords_AO: gabricha; lubbuu; kaachuu; orma; jabeenya; jajuu
Keywords_EN: slave; life; running; onlookers; strength; misplaced praise

Mammaaksa_AO: Takka dhuufuun Dhiirummaa, lama dhuufuun Harrummaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Passing gas once is manliness; passing gas twice is donkey behavior
Meaning_AO: Dogoggora yeroo tokko hojjechuun uumama namaa ta'us, dogoggora sanatti irra deddeebi'anii itti fufuun qaanii fi amala bineensummaa ta'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Slipping or making an embarrassing blunder once is human and excusable, but repeating it shamelessly is donkey behavior; errors must not become habits

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who repeats an uncouth mistake, reminding them that a first error is forgivable, but repeating it is shameless boorishness
Keywords_AO: takka; dhuufuu; dhiirummaa; lama; harrummaa; dogoggora
Keywords_EN: once; gas; manliness; twice; donkey behavior; repeated blunder

Mammaaksa_AO: Galataan guddisa je'eeti korbeessi haadha kora
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I will raise her with gratitude,' said the he-goat, and mounted his mother
Meaning_AO: Tola-oolmaa fi guddina maatiif galata deebisuu mannaa, wanta safuu cabsuu fi fokkisaa ta'een maatii ofii salphisuu balaaleffata
Meaning_EN: 'I will repay her with gratitude,' said the billy goat, and mounted his own mother; biting satire on monstrous ingratitude that repays love with dishonor
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni guddatee maatii isa guddise miidhuu fi salphisu balaaleffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn extreme filial ingratitude where a child repays a parent's lifelong nurturing and sacrifice with disgraceful disrespect and harm
Keywords_AO: galata; guddisuu; korbeessa; haadha; koruu; safuu
Keywords_EN: gratitude; raising; he-goat; mother; mounting; filial betrayal

Mammaaksa_AO: Si akeekkadhe yaa gabaa biyyaa teenyaa, Korbeessa Jetteeti goromtii natti gugurte
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I know your tricks, oh local market: calling it a he-goat, you sold me a female kid'
Meaning_AO: Daldala, marii yookaan hariiroo keessatti gowwoomsaan fi sobni jiraachuu isaa hubatanii eeggannoo cimaa gochuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: 'I have seen through you, local market: calling it a he-goat, you sold me a female kid'; learning from experience to see through fraud and false advertising
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gowwoomsaa ormaa duraan arge beekee lammata akka hin sobamne of eeggatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an experienced buyer or negotiator rejects a deceptive offer, letting the swindler know their trickery has been spotted and will not work
Keywords_AO: akeekkachuu; gabaa; korbeessa; goromtii; gurguruu; gowwoomsaa
Keywords_EN: discerning; market; he-goat; female kid; selling; fraud

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama takka gufateen eeggadhu ja'ani, kan lama gufateen amala isaati ja'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: To one who stumbles once they say 'Take care!'; to one who stumbles twice they say 'It is his character'
Meaning_AO: Dogoggorri jalqabaa akka tasaatti ilaalamus, namni yeroo lammataaf dogoggora walfakkaataa raawwate akka amala fi dhibaa'ummaa isaatti lakkaa'ama
Meaning_EN: One who stumbles once is told to take care; one who stumbles twice is told it is his innate character; a repeated mistake defines an ingrained defect
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dogoggora duraanii irraa barachuu dadhabee ammas kufu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone that while a first mistake earns community sympathy, repeating the exact same blunder brands them as inherently incompetent
Keywords_AO: gufachuu; takka; eeggachuu; lama; amala; dogoggora
Keywords_EN: stumbling; once; caution; twice; character; repeated mistake

Mammaaksa_AO: Bosonni dhiiraa, lama hin gubatu
Translation_Literal_EN: The forest of a brave man does not burn twice
Meaning_AO: Namni jabaa fi beekaan balaa yookaan gowwoomsaa yeroo tokko isa mudaterraa barata malee, lammata bakka sanatti hin miidhamu
Meaning_EN: The forest of a real man does not burn twice; a resolute and intelligent person learns thoroughly from past misfortune and never falls into the same trap
Theme_EN: Learning from Misfortune and Unrepeatable Errors
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko balaa kanaan dura isa mudaterraa baratee of eeggannoo cimaa godhatu faarsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise someone who instituted strict defenses after a past setback, declaring that a competent person never allows the same disaster twice
Keywords_AO: bosona; dhiira; gubachuu; lama; muuxannoo; eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: forest; brave man; burning; twice; experience; vigilance

Mammaaksa_AO: Tan oolte irra, tan bulte haa caaltuu
Translation_Literal_EN: May what stays the night surpass what spent the day
Meaning_AO: Wanta darberratti gaddaa hafuu dhiisanii, jireenyi, carraanii fi nagaan bor dhufu isa har'aa fi kaleessaa caalaa akka tolu hawwuu fi eebbisuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: May tomorrow surpass what has already passed; an auspicious traditional blessing wishing that the future brings greater fortune and peace than the past
Theme_EN: Future Hope and Blessing of Better Days

Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a warm blessing at dusk or farewell, wishing that the unfolding days bring greater prosperity, rest, and happiness than past trials
Keywords_AO: ooluu; buluu; caaluu; eebba; abdii; fuuldura
Keywords_EN: day; night; surpassing; blessing; hope; better days

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan maaliif iyyita jennaaniin, jawweetu narra bahe je'e; duuba eega kutte maalif iyyita jennaan, akka lammada narra hin kunneefi je'e

Meaning_AO: Balaan erga darbee booda iyyanii fi wacaniin bu'aan akka hin jirre; gowwaan yeroo eeggannoo gochuu qabu dhiisee yeroo wanti darbe waca bu'aa hin qabne kaasa
Meaning_EN: Asked why he screams, the fool blamed a crawling python; asked why scream after it passed, he said 'So it doesn't cross again!'; mocks futile panic after danger is gone

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule someone who raises hysterical alarms long after an emergency has ended, accomplishing nothing through delayed commotion
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; iyyuu; jawwee; darbuu; qishnaa; waca boodaa
Keywords_EN: fool; screaming; python; passing; delayed panic; hysteria

Mammaaksa_AO: Niin beeka jedheeti namichi saree kolaasee ajjeese
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I know what I am doing,' said the man, and castrated a dog to death
Meaning_AO: Namni dandeettii fi beekumsa gahaa hin qabne beekaa of fakkeessuun hojii keessa seenee wanta balleessuu hin qabne barbadeessuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: 'I know how it's done,' said the man, and castrated the dog to death; satirizes overconfident meddlers who claim expertise in tasks they ruin catastrophically

Keywords_EN: knowing; man; dog; castrating; killing; false expertise

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage caution, affirming that an intelligent person never trusts a proven liar or walks into a trap that once stung them

Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi guddaan fi gati-jabeessi tokko dantaa dhablummaa fi of-dagannoo salphaatiin yeroo murteessaa keessatti jalaa badee nama hongaasa
Meaning_EN: A major asset lost through casual negligence: the prized horse gets lost at nightfall; grave consequences result from late-hour carelessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubartii seheetiin Qeeyransa fide
Translation_Literal_EN: Thinking she was a gentle woman, I brought home a leopard

Meaning_EN: Thinking I was marrying an agreeable woman, I brought home a leopard; satirizes discovering that an ostensibly gentle bride is ferocious and aggressive

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni aalaa nyaatu, haatee duute jennaan kofle

Translation_Literal_EN: The goat is on this side; the thrown club comes from the far side

Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone attempts to solve an immediate problem through irrelevant or distant maneuvers that fail to touch the actual issue
Keywords_AO: re'ee; gamanaa; furguggee; gamasi; tarkaanfii; dandeettii
Keywords_EN: goat; near side; thrown club; far side; misdirected effort; distance

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo ambaatii Gabrichaatu loqoda, yoo gabrichaatii, ambaatu loqoda
Translation_Literal_EN: When it concerns an outsider, the servant babbles; when it concerns the servant, the outsider babbles
Meaning_AO: Namoonni yeroo dhimmi isaanii hin taane ormarratti oduu fi qeeqa baay'isu; namni hundi dhimma nama biraa irratti afaan banata
Meaning_EN: When it involves an outsider, the servant gossips; when it involves the servant, the outsider gossips; people eagerly meddle and chatter about others' business
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni hanqina ofii dagatanii dhimma nama biraarra qubatanii wal hamatan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique mutual backbiting and gossip, noting that people readily criticize and mock others while blind to identical flaws in themselves
Keywords_AO: amba; gabricha; loqoduu; oduu; hamii; qeeqa
Keywords_EN: outsider; servant; babbling; gossip; double standard; rumor

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan nyaataa yaamnaan, kan ergaa yaaman sehee hafe
Translation_Literal_EN: Summoned to a feast, the fool thought he was called for an errand and stayed away
Meaning_AO: Namni qalbii hin qabne carraa fi tola-oolmaa isaaf qophaa'e akka waan miidhaatti yaadee of jalaa balleessa; carraatti fayyadamuu dadhabuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: Called to a feast, the fool assumed he was being summoned for hard chores and stayed home; suspicious fools miss out on golden opportunities through ignorance

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka dubartiin hin jirre, diggisiin hin tolu
Translation_Literal_EN: Where there are no women, a feast is never pleasant
Meaning_AO: Qophiin, cidhnii fi gammachuun kamiinuu bareedina, soorata mi'aawaa fi ilillee dubartootaa malee mi'aa hin qabu; dubartiin burqaa gammachuuti
Meaning_EN: Where there are no women, a feast lacks warmth and joy; without women's culinary mastery, singing, and welcoming presence, celebrations are sterile
Theme_EN: Essential Radiance of Women in Celebrations
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ayyaanaa fi cidha irratti qooda dubartootaa isa bakka bu'aa hin qabne faarsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise women at community banquets and weddings, affirming that true joy, flavor, and festivity are impossible without their presence
Keywords_AO: dubartii; diggisi; toluu; cidha; soora; gammachuu
Keywords_EN: woman; feast; pleasant; wedding; celebration; culinary joy

Mammaaksa_AO: Udaan handaaqqoo fi dubbiin dubartii buburree hin dhabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Chicken droppings and a woman's speech never lack speckles
Meaning_AO: Akkuma udaan lukkuu bifa garaagaraa qabu, haasaan dubartootaas yeroo tokko tokko jijjiiramaa fi iftoomina dhabuu danda'a jedhanii qishnaan ibsu
Meaning_EN: Chicken droppings and women's talk are never without variegated speckles; folk satire claiming that women's speech is nuanced, shifting, and indirect
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haasaan dubartii tokkoo marfatee fi kallattii jijjiirratee dhihaatu qishnaadhaan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in humorous folk banter to poke fun at speech that is indirect, multicolored, or continually changing direction in conversation
Keywords_AO: udaan handaaqqoo; dubbii; dubartii; buburree; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: chicken droppings; speech; woman; speckled; shifting; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Mootummaan dubartii, karra cufaa oolcha
Translation_Literal_EN: The rule of a woman keeps the cattle gate closed all day
Meaning_AO: Hoggansi sodaa fi of eeggannoo daangaa darbeen guutame tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhowwee hojii fi guddina uggura; murannoo dhabuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: The governance of a woman leaves the cattle-pen gate closed all day; traditional critique alleging that overcautious leadership paralyzes enterprise
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hoggansi tokko sodaa dabalataatiin socho'uu dadhabee qabeenyi cufamee hafu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in traditional political critiques to criticize overcautious or indecisive leadership that halts action out of excessive hesitation
Keywords_AO: mootummaa; dubartii; karra cufuu; hoggansa; sodaa
Keywords_EN: rule; woman; gate closed; leadership; hesitation; overcaution

Mammaaksa_AO: Mootummaan dubartii, bishaan ol yaafti
Translation_Literal_EN: The rule of a woman makes water flow uphill
Meaning_AO: Hoggansi uumamaa fi seera ganamaatiin ala ta'e haala hin taane fi wanta hin danda'amne uumee jeequmsa fida jedhanii amanuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: The rule of a woman makes water flow uphill; a traditional patriarchal hyperbole claiming that placing women in political command defies the natural order
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aadaa durii keessatti dubartoonni hoggansa siyaasaatiif hin ta'an jedhanii morkatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in historical patriarchal discourse to argue against female political authority, claiming it inverts established customary order
Keywords_AO: mootummaa; dubartii; bishaan; ol yaasuu; jeequmsa; aadaa
Keywords_EN: rule; woman; water uphill; unnatural; patriarchal politics; disorder

Mammaaksa_AO: Manni dansa jechuun, yoo haadha qabaate qofa
Translation_Literal_EN: To call a house pleasant is only if it possesses a mother
Meaning_AO: Manni qabeenyaan yoo guutameyyuu haati manaa yoo keessa hin jirre nagaa fi qabbana hin qabu; manni kan bareedu haadhaani
Meaning_EN: A house is only truly pleasant and good if it has a mother; no amount of material wealth makes a home truly blessed without the warmth of a mother
Theme_EN: The Mother as the True Soul of the Home
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haati manaa utubaa fi mi'aa manaa ta'uu ishee dinqisiifatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise the irreplaceable warmth of a mother, affirming that an affluent house remains cold and hollow without her nurturing presence
Keywords_AO: mana dansaa; haadha; maatii; nagaa; qabbana
Keywords_EN: pleasant house; mother; family; peace; warmth; soul of home

Mammaaksa_AO: Wanti dhiirti tolchite, takkaa hin tolle
Translation_Literal_EN: What men prepare alone has never turned out pleasant
Meaning_AO: Hojiin mana keessaa fi kunuunsi maatii kan dubartootaa waan ta'eef, dhiirri yoo itti seene qulqullinaa fi mi'aa dhabee manca'a; dandeettii dubartootaa faarsa
Meaning_EN: What men prepare alone never turns out right; celebrates women's domestic mastery, teasing men that when they attempt cooking alone, it ends in clumsy disaster
Theme_EN: Domestic Incompetence of Men vs. Female Skill
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiirri manatti soora tolchuuf yaalee balleessu dubartoonni qishnaadhaan itti fayyadaman
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in playful domestic banter by women when men attempt cooking or household tasks and make a mess, highlighting women's superior domestic touch
Keywords_AO: dhiira; tolchuu; toluu; soora; bultii; dubartii
Keywords_EN: men; cooking; pleasant; domestic skill; botched tasks; teasing

Mammaaksa_AO: Intalti dubraa siree qaraatii, waan niin qaba ja'anii abdatan hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: A maiden daughter is like a lightweight sorghum-root bed; you cannot rely on possessing her permanently
Meaning_AO: Akkuma sireen hundee bishingaarraa (qaraarraa) tolfamte laaftuu fi yeroo gabaabaa qofa turtee dhumattu, intalli dubraas guddannaan heerumtee gara mana dhiirsaatti waan deemtuuf qabeenya dhaabbataa mana abbaatti hafu miti; heerumtee deemuu ishee agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Just as a bed constructed from lightweight sorghum roots/stalks (siree qaraa) is fragile, temporary, and lacks durability, an unmarried maiden is not a permanent domestic fixture in her parents' home, for she will inevitably marry and depart for her husband's clan
Theme_EN: Transience of Daughters in the Natal Home
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo maatiin intala isaanii guddifatan bor heerumtee akka biraa deemtu beekanii akka qabeenya dhaabbataatti hin lakkaa'amu jedhanii ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when parents reflect with bittersweet acceptance on raising a daughter, recognizing that unlike sons who anchor the homestead, a daughter will soon marry out, like a temporary sorghum bed
Keywords_AO: intala dubraa; siree qaraa; bishingaa; heeruma; qabeenya yeroo; maatii; aadaa
Keywords_EN: maiden daughter; sorghum-root bed; temporary bed; marriage; transience; natal home; Hararghe

Mammaaksa_AO: Handhura intalaa alatti awwaalan, tan gurbaa mana keessatti awwaalan
Translation_Literal_EN: The umbilical cord of a girl is buried outside; that of a boy is buried inside the house
Meaning_AO: Aadaa ganamaa keessatti gurbaan dhaaltuu fi eegduu mana abbaa yoo ta'u, intalli garuu heerumtee qe'ee ormaa akka ijaartu sirnaan agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The umbilical cord of a daughter is buried outside, while that of a son is buried inside; symbolizes that sons anchor the homestead while daughters marry out
Theme_EN: Umbilical Rites and Traditional Gender Roles
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo sirna dhalootaa keessatti carraa gara fuulduraa ijoollee dhiiraa fi durbaa aadaan ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in traditional cultural contexts to explain ancient birth rituals that symbolized the son's destiny as heir and the daughter's destiny in marriage outside
Keywords_AO: handhura; intala; alatti; gurbaa; mana keessa; awwaaluu; aadaa
Keywords_EN: umbilical cord; daughter; outside; son; inside; birth ritual; destiny

Mammaaksa_AO: Jette, jettee nadhoo, balbala booni
Translation_Literal_EN: Against the 'she said, she said' of women, take pride in having a door to shut
Meaning_AO: Oduu, hasasaa fi 'jette-jettee' ormaa isa nagaa nama dhowwu jalaa of baraarsuuf, manni ofii balbala cufamu qabaachuun qananii fi dahoo guddaa ta'uu ibsa; nagaa fi iccitii manaa eeggachuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: When endless neighborhood rumors and 'she said, she said' gossip swirl outside, take pride that you have a solid door to shut them out; emphasizes the immense dignity, peace, and sanctuary of domestic privacy against outside intrusions
Theme_EN: Domestic Privacy and Shielding from Gossip
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni naannoo jiran oduu fi hamii baay'isanii nagaa nama dhowwanitti, manuma ofii cufatanii tasgabbiin taa'uun ulfina fi furmaata ta'uu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when advising someone distressed by community gossip or neighborhood drama to simply shut their door and enjoy their private household sanctuary, letting outside chatter stay on the street
Keywords_AO: jette jettee; nadhoo; balbala; boonuu; iccitii manaa; nagaa; dahoo
Keywords_EN: she said; gossip; doorway; door; domestic sanctuary; privacy; shutting out gossip

Mammaaksa_AO: Taa'uu mannaa, dubra dhalchuu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than childlessness, giving birth to a daughter is better
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokkollee dhabuu yookaan qullaa taa'uurra, wantuma xiqqoo yookaan isa tuffatamu illee argachuutu caala; dhabuurra xiqqoon wayya
Meaning_EN: Rather than remaining entirely childless or idle, having a daughter is better; possessing something modest is far better than suffering complete lack
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta guddaa dhabee wanta xiqqoo argatetti quufuu qabu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel gratitude and contentment, reminding someone that possessing a modest blessing is infinitely superior to suffering total deprivation
Keywords_AO: taa'uu; dubra; dhalchuu; wayyuu; dhabuu; quufa
Keywords_EN: sitting; daughter; birth; better; childlessness; compromise

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubartiin beeka dhalti malee, waan beektu hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: A woman gives birth to a wise man, but she knows nothing herself
Meaning_AO: Aadaa durii isa gahee dubartootaa dhalchuu qofatti daangessee beekumsa isaanii tuffachaa ture calaqqisa
Meaning_EN: Traditional patriarchal saying claiming that while a woman mothered great leaders, she lacked wisdom herself; reflects historical devaluation of women's intellect
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aadaa durii keessatti ilaalcha dhiirri beekumsa dubartootaatiif qabu ture ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in historical and cultural commentary to examine traditional patriarchal beliefs that recognized female fertility while denying female intellectual authority
Keywords_AO: dubartii; beekaa; dhaluu; beekuu; aadaa durii; daangaa
Keywords_EN: woman; wise man; birthing; knowledge; patriarchal bias; history

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyyeen, namaaf galata hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: The earth has no gratitude for humanity
Meaning_AO: Namni umrii isaa guutuu dacheerra jiraatee, misoomsee, jaareeyyuu, dhuma irratti biyyeen nama liqimsitee awwaalti malee galata hin qabdu
Meaning_EN: The earth has no gratitude for man; no matter how much a person toils, builds, and cultivates the soil, in the end the earth swallows and buries them without thanks
Theme_EN: The Ungrateful Earth and Inevitable Mortality
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dadhabbiin namaa hunduu dhuma irratti du'aan akka dhumatu fi addunyaan galata akka hin qabne ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when contemplating the vanity of worldly toil, observing that all earthly labor and glory ultimately conclude in an ungrateful, silent grave
Keywords_AO: biyyee; nama; galata; du'a; awwaala; dachee
Keywords_EN: earth; soil; gratitude; death; grave; inevitable mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Qorichi du'aa, du'a
Translation_Literal_EN: The cure for death is death itself
Meaning_AO: Duuti dhibee qorichi biraa hin jirre waan ta'eef, furmaanni isaa isa dhumaa du'a fudhatanii boqochuu qofa; duuti hin oolamu
Meaning_EN: The only cure for death is death itself; mortality has no earthly remedy or escape; death is an absolute certainty that can only be resolved by passing through it
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo du'a jalaa miliquun akka hin danda'amnee fi hundumtuu akka qooda uumamaatti fudhachuu qabu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to articulate stoic resignation before the absolute finality of mortality, affirming that no medicine exists to reverse human death
Keywords_AO: qoricha; du'a; furmaata; boqonnaa; uumama
Keywords_EN: medicine; cure; death; finality; mortality; inevitability

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan du'uuf eegani, kan du'u hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: Among those expected to die, they do not know who actually dies
Meaning_AO: Namni dhukkubsatee du'aaf eegamu jiraatee, inni fayyaa fakkaatu tasa du'uu danda'a; ajalli fi yeroon du'aa harka Waaqayyoo qofa jira
Meaning_EN: Among those expected to die, one never knows who truly dies first; an ailing person may survive while a healthy youth dies suddenly; death is unpredictable
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni fayyaa jiru tasa du'ee inni dhukkubsataan lubbuun hafu dinqisiifatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an apparently healthy person dies unexpectedly while a bedridden invalid lingers, proving that human expectations cannot fathom life's span
Keywords_AO: du'uu; eeguu; beekuu; ajala; carraa; rabbi
Keywords_EN: dying; waiting; knowing; unpredictable; lifespan; destiny

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan keessa hin beeytuu, duuti keessa hin laallattu
Translation_Literal_EN: A guest knows not the home's trouble; death checks not one's readiness
Meaning_AO: Akkuma keessummaan rakkoo manaa hin beekne, duutis namni qophaa'eera moo hin qophoofne osoo hin laalin tasa dhufti; duuti eeyyama hin gaafattu
Meaning_EN: A guest knows nothing of domestic distress, and death never checks if one is ready; death strikes without warning, indifferent to financial plight or unfinished tasks
Theme_EN: Unannounced and Indifferent Arrival of Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo duuti tasa dhufee nama hin qophoofne fudhatu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge spiritual and practical preparation for mortality, reminding people that death arrives without inquiring into one's readiness
Keywords_AO: keessummaa; keessa; beekuu; du'a; laallachuu; tasa dhufuu
Keywords_EN: guest; interior; death; inspecting; unannounced; mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Du'aan wal hin dhaalani
Translation_Literal_EN: Through death, they do not inherit one another
Meaning_AO: Duuti dhimma dhuunfaati; namni tokko nama biraatiif jedhee du'uu yookaan ajala ormaa baachuu hin danda'u; duuti dhuunfaan nama mudatti
Meaning_EN: Through death people cannot substitute for one another; death is strictly an individual journey, and no one can die in another's stead or inherit another's mortality
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hundi gaafa du'aa qofaa isaa dhaabbachuu akka qabu hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize personal accountability and existential loneliness before mortality, reminding that no proxy can shoulder one's final hour
Keywords_AO: du'a; dhaaluu; walii du'uu; dhuunfaa; ajala
Keywords_EN: death; inheriting; substitution; individuality; mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Du'aa mormi muka
Translation_Literal_EN: The neck of a corpse is as unresponsive as wood
Meaning_AO: Namni du'e erga lubbuun keessaa baatee deebii kennuu, morkachuu fi ofirraa ittisuu hin danda'u; wanti dhumate hunduu jabinna dhaba
Meaning_EN: The neck of a dead person is as stiff and unresponsive as wood; once life departs, resistance, defense, and human agency are entirely extinguished
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni lubbuu dhabe tokko wanta itti godhan hundaaf deebii kennuu dadhabu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing the chilling, absolute passivity of the dead, noting that once life is snuffed out, all capability to resist or answer back is gone
Keywords_AO: du'aa; morma; muka; lubbuu dhabuu; dadhabina
Keywords_EN: corpse; dead; neck; wood; stiffness; helplessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaa ifii, kan ajjeesu hin jaalatani, kan du'uus hin jaalatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Regarding one's friend, one wishes neither that he kills nor that he dies
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaa ofiitiif badii fi salphinni kamiinuu akka hin geenye hawwuu; ajjeesee yoo adabamus ta'ee du'ee yoo dhabamus gadda guddaadha
Meaning_EN: For one's friend, one desires neither that he become a killer nor that he be killed; an ethical dilemma wishing to spare loved ones from both crime and victimhood
Theme_EN: Wishing Protection from Both Crime and Victimhood
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo lolaa fi wal-dhabdee keessatti fira ofiitiif yaadda'anitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used during communal conflicts to express deep anguish for loved ones, praying that they neither suffer violence nor commit bloodshed against others
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa; ajjeesuu; jaalachuu; du'uu; nagaa; safuu
Keywords_EN: friend; companion; killing; dying; peace; moral dilemma

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan sodaatan du'a, kan hin oollees isuma
Translation_Literal_EN: What they fear is death, and what is unavoidable is also death
Meaning_AO: Namni hundi du'a sodaatee baqachuuf yaalus, duuti wanta hin oolle fi dhuma irratti hundumaa eeggatuudha; sodaan du'a jalaa nama hin oolchu
Meaning_EN: What people fear most is death, yet what is most absolutely certain and unavoidable is also death; paradoxical human anxiety over life's only certainty
Theme_AO: Sodaa Du'aa fi Wanta Hin Oolle
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni du'a sodaatee dhiphatu sodaan bu'aa akka hin qabne gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel courage in the face of mortality, arguing that since death is the one universal inevitability, living in paralyzing dread is futile
Keywords_AO: sodaachuu; du'a; ooluu; ajala; uumama; dhugaa
Keywords_EN: fear; death; unavoidable; certainty; human condition; mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuun dhaloota hin oolin, du'a hin ooltu
Translation_Literal_EN: A soul that could not avoid birth cannot avoid death
Meaning_AO: Lubbuun dacheerra dhalattee uumamte hundi dhuma irratti du'uu qabdi; dhalachuun qofti du'aaf wabii ta'uu ibsa
Meaning_EN: A soul that could not escape being born will never escape dying; the very fact of entry into biological life carries the absolute inevitability of departure
Theme_EN: The Inseparable Cycle of Birth and Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo duuti hunda akka qaqqabdu fi uumama wajjin walqabattu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on the universal human condition, reminding that entering earthly existence guarantees an eventual appointment with the grave
Keywords_AO: lubbuu; dhaloota; ooluu; du'a; uumama; jireenya
Keywords_EN: soul; birth; escape; death; cycle of life; mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Fagoon, bakkuma irraa hin galle
Translation_Literal_EN: The only distant place is the place from which one never returns
Meaning_AO: Fageenyi dhugaan fageenya lafaa osoo hin taane, du'a isa namni deebi'ee hin galleedha; namni lubbuun jiru fagoodhaas ni deebi'a
Meaning_EN: The only truly distant place is the place from which no one ever returns; so long as a traveler is alive, no geographic distance is insurmountable
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo fageenya imalaa caalaa duuti addaan fageessuu isaa ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort those separated by geographic distance, reminding them that worldly miles can be crossed, whereas death alone constitutes permanent separation
Keywords_AO: fagoo; bakka; galuu; du'a; imala; jireenya
Keywords_EN: distance; place; return; death; grave; final journey

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuu lubbuun dhufte, qaroon hin hidhu
Translation_Literal_EN: A death destined for a soul, no cleverness can tie down
Meaning_AO: Yeroon du'aa yoo gahe, beekumsi, qarummaan fi toftaan namaa kamiinuu lubbuu baqachuu hin danda'u; ajala uumaatu murteessa
Meaning_EN: When death comes for a soul, no cleverness, wisdom, or binding charms can restrain it; mortal human ingenuity is powerless against divine decree
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo beekumsaa fi qabeenyaan du'a dhowwuun akka hin danda'amne hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humble human intellect, teaching that when God decrees the end of a lifespan, no medical expertise, wealth, or cleverness can stay the soul
Keywords_AO: lubbuu; dhufuu; qaroo; hidhuu; ajala; beekumsa
Keywords_EN: soul; arrival; cleverness; binding; destiny; mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Muka lubbuu, lubbuuf hin hanqatanii, lubbuun jalaa hin bahani
Translation_Literal_EN: For the tree of life, provisions lack not, yet life escapes not its felling
Meaning_AO: Jireenya keessatti wanti lubbuuf barbaachisu hundi yoo guutameyyuu, du'a jalaa miliquun hin danda'amu; qabeenyi lubbuu hin oolchu
Meaning_EN: For the tree of life, resources may not be lacking for survival, yet life can never escape its final felling; earthly provisions cannot buy exemption from death
Theme_EN: Limits of Material Wealth Before Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo sooreessi qabeenya qabu illee du'a jalaa ooluu akka hin dandeenye ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reflecting that all the nourishment, wealth, and medicine in the world cannot perpetually protect the fragile tree of mortal life from falling
Keywords_AO: muka; lubbuu; hanqachuu; bahuu; du'a; jireenya
Keywords_EN: tree; life; lacking; escaping; mortality; material limits

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuu abbaa warraatiif dhufte, garbichaan hin bitani
Translation_Literal_EN: Death that comes for the householder cannot be ransomed with a servant
Meaning_AO: Duuti murtii dhuunfaati; yeroon ajala nama tokkoo yoo gahe, qabeenyaan yookaan nama biraa bakka buusuun lubbuu oolchuun hin danda'amu
Meaning_EN: Death that arrives for the master of the house cannot be bought off by offering a servant; death takes its designated soul without accepting substitutes
Theme_EN: No Substitutes or Ransoms in Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni kamuu du'a ofiitiif ofumaan itti gaafatamu ta'uu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that before death, all worldly status is stripped away; no potentate can pay a ransom or dispatch a substitute to take their fatal turn
Keywords_AO: lubbuu; abbaa warraa; dhufuu; garbicha; bituu; ajala
Keywords_EN: soul; master; arriving; servant; ransoming; substitution; death

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa du'a, yaa dulluma, wanti hamtuun isinuma
Translation_Literal_EN: Oh death, oh old age, the truly terrible things are the two of you!
Meaning_AO: Jireenya namaa keessatti wanti akka dullumaa humna nama dhabsiisuu fi akka du'aa lubbuu galaafatu wanti hamaan hin jiru
Meaning_EN: Oh death, oh old age, the most terrible afflictions are indeed you two!; laments the physical degradation of aging and the finality of death as ultimate trials
Theme_EN: The Dual Tribulations of Aging and Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dulloomee dadhabee fi du'i itti dhihaatte gaddaan dubbatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when lamenting the tragic trajectory of mortal human existence, where youthful strength gives way to infirmity and ends in the cold grave
Keywords_AO: du'a; dulluma; hamtuu; jireenya; humna dhabuu
Keywords_EN: death; old age; terrible; frailty; mortality; lament

Mammaaksa_AO: Achi na qabi, as na qabiin, du'a nama hin oolchitu
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying 'Support me there, hold me here' does not save one from death
Meaning_AO: Dhukkubni cimaan yeroo qabee fi ajalli yeroo gahe tattaaffiin fi kunuunsi namaa du'a jalaa nama hin oolchu; wanta hin oolle danda'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Saying 'Support me here, hold me there' cannot save a dying person; when the appointed hour strikes, no amount of physical propping can ward off mortality
Theme_EN: Futility of Struggling Against the Appointed Hour
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhukkubsataan baay'ee dadhabee kunuunsi hunduu gatii dhabutti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when desperate medical care and loving bedside nursing fail to stop a terminal patient's decline, bowing to the inevitable reality of death
Keywords_AO: qabachuu; du'a; oolchuu; dhukkuba; ajala; kunuunsa
Keywords_EN: holding; death; saving; illness; appointed hour; helplessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Waywaanni, du'a nama hin oolchine
Translation_Literal_EN: Wailing did not save a person from death
Meaning_AO: Booyichii fi iyyi gaddaa nama du'e hin deebisu, du'as hin dhowwu; gadda keessatti obsaa fi tasgabbii qabaachuun barbaachisaadha
Meaning_EN: Loud weeping and wailing have never saved anyone from death; grieving and tears, however heartfelt, cannot reverse mortality or stay the hand of fate
Theme_EN: The Inability of Mourning to Reverse Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gaddaan iyyee of miidhu tasgabbeessanii obsa barsiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to console the bereaved and counsel emotional composure, reminding them that desperate screaming and self-harm cannot bring back the dead
Keywords_AO: waywaanna; du'a; oolchuu; booyicha; obsa; gadda

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen warra godaantotaa fi joolleen warra taa'uu walitti hin dhuftu
Translation_Literal_EN: Children of nomads and children of settled farmers do not mix together
Meaning_AO: Namoonni haala jireenyaa, aadaa fi ilaalcha garaagaraa qaban salphaatti waliigaluu yookaan michoomuu hin danda'an; akkaataan jireenyaa amala addaan baasa
Meaning_EN: The children of nomads and the children of settled farmers do not readily mix; people shaped by fundamentally different lifestyles struggle to integrate
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gartuuwwan jireenyaan wal hin fakkaanne waliin jiraachuu dadhabanii walitti bu'an ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when examining cultural or domestic friction between people of mobile, pastoralist habits and those rooted in agrarian settlements
Keywords_AO: joollee; godaantota; taa'uu; walitti dhufuu; aadaa; garaagarummaa
Keywords_EN: children; nomads; settled farmers; mingling; cultural divide; lifestyles

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan quufe, akka kan beelawe itti nyaatu ajaa'iba
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who is full marvels at how the starving one devours food
Meaning_AO: Namni qananii fi quufa keessa jiru dhiphina, ariifannaa fi beela nama harka-qalleessaa hubachuu hin danda'u; quufaan beela'aa hin beeku
Meaning_EN: The well-fed person watches in bewildered astonishment at how the starving person wolfs down food; the wealthy cannot comprehend the urgency of hunger
Theme_EN: The Total Empathy Gap Between the Satiated and the Starving
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni sooreeyyiin dhiphinaa fi ariifannaa hiyyeeyyii akka waan addaatti laalanii tuffatan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn the callous, detached gaze of affluent observers who look down on the desperate eating habits or panic of the starving
Keywords_AO: quufuu; beelawuu; nyaachuu; ajaa'ibuu; dhiphina; mararfannaa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: satiated; starving; eating; marveling; empathy gap; hunger

Mammaaksa_AO: Garbuu coraatu gubata, qamadii qaamaatu (nafaatu) gubata
Translation_Literal_EN: With barley the husk burns; with wheat the actual grain burns
Meaning_AO: Namoonni qorumsa keessatti bifa garaagaraatiin miidhamu; tokko miidhaan isaa alarratti mul'ata, kaan ammoo keessi isaa gubatee hubama
Meaning_EN: In roasted barley, only the outer husk scorches; in wheat, the core grain itself burns; different people absorb trials superficially or to the very core
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qorumsi walfakkaataan nama tokko irraan qofa miidhee isa kaan garuu bu'uuraan barbadeessu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that individuals possess varying resilience: one person sheds adversity like burnt chaff, while another is wounded to their core
Keywords_AO: garbuu; coraa; qamadii; qaama; gubachuu; garaagarummaa
Keywords_EN: barley; husk; wheat; grain body; burning; resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Ani gamana ilaaleetiin, fardi koo gamas ilaale
Translation_Literal_EN: I looked over here, while my horse looked over there
Meaning_AO: Namoonni walfaana hojjetan yookaan michoonni yaadaa fi galma faallaa qabaachuun waldhabdee fida; dursa xiyyeeffannaan tokko ta'uu qaba
Meaning_EN: While I looked this way, my horse gazed across the other way; describes divided attention, conflicting purposes, and misalignment with a partner
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo geggeessaan fi hordoftoonni yookaan hiriyyoonni dhimma tokkorratti gara adda addaatti ilaalan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an initiative stalls because the leader and his team pull in opposite directions, having failed to align their focus and will
Keywords_AO: gamana; ilaaluu; farda; gamas; yaada addaan ba'uu; walsimuu dhabuu
Keywords_EN: this way; looking; horse; that way; divided focus; misalignment

Mammaaksa_AO: Wanni biyya takkatti haalaa biyya takkatti saala
Translation_Literal_EN: What is an honorable custom in one land is a shameful taboo in another
Meaning_AO: Wanti bakka tokkotti akka aadaa gaariitti fudhatamu biyya biraatti akka fokkisaatti lakkaa'amuu danda'a; garaagarummaa aadaa hubachuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: What is an accepted custom in one country is a disgraceful shame in another; cultural norms and moral taboos are relative to regional traditions
Theme_EN: Cultural Relativity of Shame and Honor
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aadaa fi amala biyya ormaa ilaaluun safeeffannaa fi daangaa naannoo sanaa kabajuun barbaachisu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach cultural humility to travelers, advising that what is celebrated at home may be viewed with horror abroad, demanding local respect
Keywords_AO: biyya; haala; saala; aadaa; safuu; garaagarummaa
Keywords_EN: land; custom; shame; culture; taboo; cultural relativity

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo wal bira jirtuu, ijji wal hin argitu
Translation_Literal_EN: Though placed side by side, the two eyes never see each other
Meaning_AO: Namoonni dhihoo wal bira taa'an garuu jaalala, wal-hubannoo fi qunnamtii dhugaa dhabuu danda'u; dhiheenyi qaamaa kan qalbii hin ta'u
Meaning_EN: Though positioned right beside each other, the two eyes never see one another; physical proximity does not guarantee emotional intimacy or insight
Theme_EN: Physical Proximity Devoid of Mutual Insight
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni wal bira jiraatanis wal hin beekne fi jaalalaan walitti hin dhihaanne ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on emotional alienation between cohabitants or neighbors, noting that sharing physical space does not mean truly seeing each other
Keywords_AO: wal bira; ija; arguu dhabuu; dhiheenya; fageenya qalbii
Keywords_EN: beside; eyes; unseeing; physical proximity; emotional distance

Mammaaksa_AO: Qorsoon ilkaanii cidhaa, garaa boo'insa
Translation_Literal_EN: Parched grain between the teeth looks like a feast; in the belly it is weeping
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko alaan akka waan quufaatti kolfisiisee mul'atus keessoo isaatti beela fi dhiphina hamaa ta'uu ibsa; bifa alaan gowwoomuu
Meaning_EN: Parched grain between the teeth gives the sound of a feast, but in the stomach it causes weeping; a superficial crunch leaving the belly starved
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya bu'uuraa hin qabne akka waan quufeetti alaan of mul'isu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe noisy, ostentatious poverty, where someone makes a loud show of consumption while their fundamental household remains destitute
Keywords_AO: qorsoo; ilkaan; cidha; garaa; booyicha; beela; fakkeessaa
Keywords_EN: parched grain; teeth; feast; belly; weeping; surface illusion

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma joolleen muka kuttu, dubbiin kutti
Translation_Literal_EN: In the time it takes children to snap a twig, speech cuts through completely
Meaning_AO: Jechi afaaniin baatu saffisaan qalbii madeessa yookaan dubbii murteessa; arrabni yeroo gabaabaa keessatti miidhaa guddaa geessisa
Meaning_EN: In the mere moment it takes a child to break a twig, sharp words can permanently sever relationships; a reckless tongue snaps lifelong bonds
Category_EN: Power and Speed of Destructive Words
Theme_EN: The Instantaneous Severing Power of the Tongue
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haasaan gabaabaan namoota gidduutti mufannaa fi wal-dhabdee cimaa uumu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against hasty, cutting insults, reminding that while snapping a twig takes a second, a careless sentence can sever lifelong relationships
Keywords_AO: joollee; muka; kutuu; dubbii; arraba; saffisa
Keywords_EN: children; twig; snapping; speech; tongue; severing bonds

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan marihattee dhufti, warri manaa marihatee hin eegu
Translation_Literal_EN: The guest arrives having consulted; the hosts do not wait having consulted
Meaning_AO: Keessummaan yookaan balaan dhuftu itti qophooftee dhufti, abbaan manaa garuu duraan dursee qophaa'uu dhabuun dhiphina uuma; qophii duraa barsiisa
Meaning_EN: The guest arrives having carefully planned; the hosts sit unprepared without prior consultation; the initiator holds the advantage over the unprepared
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti tasa dhufe tokko maatii qophii hin qabne muddutti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an unforeseen delegation or sudden crisis arrives on the doorstep, noting that the visitors planned their visit while the hosts are caught unawares
Keywords_AO: keessummaa; marii; dhufuu; warra manaa; eeguu; qophii
Keywords_EN: guest; consultation; arriving; hosts; unprepared; element of surprise

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubartiin deessu lubbu eeggatti, biyyi ammoo marqa eeggatti
Translation_Literal_EN: The birthing mother struggles for her life; the community waits for the porridge
Meaning_AO: Namni qorumsa hamaa keessa jiru lubbuu baafachuuf cinqama, ormi garuu bu'aa fi bashannana dhimma sana duubaa eeggata; dantaa dhabummaa ormaa ibsa
Meaning_EN: The birthing mother struggles in agony to save her life, while the community waits for celebratory porridge; stark contrast between suffering and spectators
Theme_EN: Solitary Struggle for Life vs. Public Appetite
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko balaa lubbuu keessa jirutti ormi faayidaa fi gammachuu ofii qofa eeggatu balaaleffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn selfish onlookers who salivate over the expected celebrations or benefits of an ordeal while ignoring the mortal agony of the sufferer
Keywords_AO: dubartii deessu; lubbuu; marqa; biyya; eeggachuu; dantaa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: birthing woman; life; porridge; community; waiting; selfish spectators

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabrittiin na gurgurani boochi, warri horiin xinnaate booya
Translation_Literal_EN: The captive maid weeps that she was sold; the sellers weep that the price was small
Meaning_AO: Namni miidhame gidiraa fi salphina isaatiif booyu, warri roorristoonni ammoo bu'aan saamicha isaanii xiqqachuu isaatiif komatu; roorroo hamaa saaxila
Meaning_EN: The captive maid weeps because her humanity was sold; the sellers weep because the price was too low; exposes the cruelty of oppressors prioritizing profit
Theme_EN: The Grotesque Greed of Oppressors vs. Victim Agony
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni miidhame lubbuuf iyyu, inni miidhaa geessise ammoo faayidaan koo xinnaate jedhee komatu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose the grotesque depravity of exploiters who complain about meager financial returns while their victims mourn their stolen lives and freedom
Keywords_AO: gabrittii; gurguruu; booyuu; horii; xinnaachuu; roorroo
Keywords_EN: captive maid; selling; weeping; cattle price; low profit; cruelty

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadhaan caala jetti niitiin adeeraa, hammaattuus haati haadhuma, toltuus niitiin adeeraa niitii adeeraati
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I surpass your mother,' claims the aunt; yet a mother is a mother, and an aunt is an aunt
Meaning_AO: Haati hangamiyyuu hanqina qabaattus jaalala fi mararfannaa ishee namni biraa bakka bu'uu hin danda'u; bakka haadhaa wanti gahu hin jiru
Meaning_EN: 'I surpass your mother,' boasts the aunt; yet flawed as a mother may be, she is still your mother, and an aunt remains an aunt; none can replace a mother
Theme_AO: Ulfina Haadhaa fi Bakka Bu'iinsa Dhabuu
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ormi haadha ofiitti dhihaachuu yaalu haati bakka bu'aa akka hin qabne jabeessanii ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert the unique, irreplaceable sanctity of biological motherhood, reminding that even a stern mother's love outstrips the sweetest stepmother or aunt
Keywords_AO: haadha; caaluu; niitii adeeraa; hammaachuu; jaalala; maatii
Keywords_EN: mother; surpassing; uncle's wife; flawed mother; irreplaceable; filial bond

Mammaaksa_AO: Warra ijoollee sagalii beelli fixe, warra ijoollee hin qabne quufni fixe
Translation_Literal_EN: The family of nine children was ruined by hunger; the childless family was ruined by satiety
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi gama hundaan madaallii barbaaddi; ijoollee baay'ee qabaachuun ba'aa fida, ijoollee dhabuun ammoo kophummaa fi dhabama dhalootaa fida
Meaning_EN: The family with nine children was ruined by hunger; the childless family was ruined by lonely fullness; the paradox where large broods bring hunger, yet barrenness brings extinction
Theme_EN: The Tragic Paradoxes of Progeny and Scarcity
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo baay'inni ijoollee rakkina nyaataa fiduu fi dhabamuun ijoollee ammoo kophummaa fi gadda fidu madaalanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reflecting on the bittersweet paradoxes of fortune: excessive progeny strains resources to starvation, while barren wealth dies in lonely silence
Keywords_AO: ijoollee sagal; beela; fixuu; ijoollee dhabuu; quufa; madaallii
Keywords_EN: nine children; hunger; childless; satiety; family paradox; balance

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama keessa, namni jira
Translation_Literal_EN: Inside humanity, true humans exist
Meaning_AO: Uummata baay'ee keessaa namoota amala gaarii, gara-laafina fi qalbii qaban argachuun ni danda'ama; hundumtuu walfakkaataa miti
Meaning_EN: Inside humanity, true human beings exist; amidst the teeming crowd of superficial people, there exist rare individuals of genuine nobility and integrity
Theme_EN: True Nobility Found Amidst the Crowd
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gaarii fi arjaan tokko hawaasa amala dhabe keessaa ifee mul'atu galateeffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express renewed faith in humanity, celebrating a truly compassionate and principled individual discovered amidst a sea of selfish people
Keywords_AO: nama keessa; namummaa; gaarummaa; qalbii; filannoo
Keywords_EN: humanity; true person; integrity; compassion; noble character; rarity
