Mammaaksa_AO: Gurraattiin gurraaf boochi, diimtuun fororaaf boochi.
Translation_Literal_EN: The dark-skinned woman cries for fame (or reputation); the fair-skinned woman cries over freckles.
Meaning_AO: Namni hundi hanqinaafi yaaddoo mataa isaa qaba; wanti tokko nama tokko dhiphisu kan nama biraarraa adda ta'a (namni wanta qabu dhiisee isa dhaberratti booya).
Meaning_EN: Everyone laments their own specific insecurity, perceived flaw, or lack; while one worries about social recognition or status, another frets over minor physical blemishes like freckles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni haalaafi dhimma adda addaa irratti dhiphatan ykn namni hundi yaaddoo dhuunfaa ofiitti qabamu ibsuuf gargaara.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when highlighting how different individuals are consumed by their own distinct concerns, insecurities, or personal priorities.
Keywords_AO: gurraattii, diimtuu, gurra, forora, boochu, amala
Keywords_EN: dark-skinned, fair-skinned, reputation, freckles, weeping, insecurity

Mammaaksa_AO: Hawween, yaada yaada.
Translation_Literal_EN: Wishing (mere longing) contemplates thoughts.
Meaning_AO: Hawwii qofti osoo gara hojiitti hin jijjiiramin bu'aa hin fidu; nama dhiphisaafi yaada baay'isa malee homaa hin dhiyeessu.
Meaning_EN: Mere wishing without concrete action yields no results; it only leads to endless contemplation, anxiety, and daydreaming.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko osoo hin hojjetiin hawwii qofaan milkaa'ina eegu gorsuuf ykn qeequuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise or caution someone who spends time daydreaming and wishing instead of taking practical action to achieve their goals.
Keywords_AO: hawwii, yaada, hojii, milkaa'ina, kajeellaa
Keywords_EN: wishing, thoughts, daydreaming, action, diligence

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni waa lama beeka, garii lola beeka, garii dada beeka.
Translation_Literal_EN: People know two things: some know war/fighting, some know peace.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni dandeettiifi amalaan bakka lamatti qoodamu; gariin lolaafi falmatti cima, gariin immoo nagaa, araaraafi tasgabbii beeka.
Meaning_EN: People naturally possess different dispositions and abilities: some are inclined toward conflict and war, while others are gifted in maintaining peace, harmony, and reconciliation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo garaagarummaa amala namaa, fedhii nagaa fi fedhii lolaa ibsuun barbaadame itti fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the fundamental difference in human nature and tendencies between those drawn to conflict and those inclined toward peace.
Keywords_AO: lola, dada, nagaa, beekumsa, amala
Keywords_EN: war, conflict, peace, harmony, temperament, skill

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo osoo jirruu wal gargaaruu baanne, duunu biyyee walirraa harraa?
Translation_Literal_EN: If we do not help each other while alive, will we dust the earth off one another in death?
Meaning_AO: Namoonni osoo lubbuun jiranitti wal gargaaruu fi wal qaqqabuu qabu; erga du'anii booda gadda fakkeessuun bu'aa hin qabu
Meaning_EN: If we do not support each other while living, shall we brush the dirt off one another when dead?; care must be shown in life rather than in empty funeral tears
Theme_EN: Active Support in Life vs. Empty Funerary Regret
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni osoo nama gargaaruu danda'anii dhiisanii gaafa inni du'u booyichaaf fiigan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shame hypocrites who neglect living relatives in poverty, but spend lavish fortunes and shed theatrical tears at their funerals
Keywords_AO: jiraachuu; wal gargaaruu; du'uu; biyyee; harcaasuu; safuu
Keywords_EN: living; helping; dying; dirt; dusting; active solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Maraataa firaatu hidha, caphaa ogeeysaatu hidha
Translation_Literal_EN: A madman his own kin bind; a broken bone a skilled bonesetter binds
Meaning_AO: Namni sammuu dhabee balaa fidu maatiitu itti-gaafatamummaa fudhatee to'ata; rakkina maatiis maatiitu fala kennaaf
Meaning_EN: A madman is restrained by his own kin, just as a fracture is bound by a skilled bonesetter; a family must take direct ownership of managing troubled members
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo maatiin miseensa isaanii isa rakkisaa to'achuu didanii ormatti dhiisanitti itti gaafatamummaa isaanii yaadachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind families that they bear the primary moral and legal duty to manage, restrain, and care for their own volatile or unruly kin
Keywords_AO: maraataa; fira; hidhuu; cabaa; ogeessa; itti-gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: madman; kin; binding; fracture; bonesetter; family duty

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'a gaafa hin qabne, fira gaafa qabuutu jiraachisa
Translation_Literal_EN: A hornless cow survives through its horned companions
Meaning_AO: Namni harka-qalleessa ta'e yookaan ofirraa ittisuu hin dandeenye deeggarsa fi eegumsa firoota isaatiin jiraata; firi gaachana dadhabaati
Meaning_EN: A hornless cow survives through the protection of its horned companions; defenseless individuals survive under the protective shield of capable kin
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dadhabaan deeggarsa fira cimaatiin nagaa fi jireenya argatu galateeffatanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how powerful, influential relatives shield their vulnerable and impoverished kin from predation, acting as their defensive horns
Keywords_AO: sa'a; gaafa; fira; jiraachisuu; eegumsa; harka-qalleessa
Keywords_EN: cow; horns; kin; survival; protection; vulnerable kin

Mammaaksa_AO: Ibiddi wahirra laga baha
Translation_Literal_EN: Fire crosses a river by leaping from one thing to another
Meaning_AO: Balaa yookaan waldhabiinsi xiqqoon wanta biraatti daddarbaa deemee balaa guddaa laga ce'u ta'a; gargaarsa walitti aanuun wanta ulfaataa milkeessuun ni danda'ama
Meaning_EN: Fire crosses a river by jumping from brush to brush; small disputes spread across barriers through intermediaries; obstacles are cleared step by step
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wal-dhabdeen xiqqoon gara bal'aatti daddarbee diigumsa uumu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn how minor feuds leap across family boundaries to ignite widespread conflict, or to show how formidable barriers are bridged step by step
Keywords_AO: ibidda; laga bahuu; ce'uu; daddarbuu; balaa; toftaa
Keywords_EN: fire; river; leaping; spreading; escalation; step by step

Mammaaksa_AO: Ibiddi Okkotetti dahateeti, bishaan danfisa
Translation_Literal_EN: Fire, taking cover behind the clay pot, makes the water boil
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko wanta yookaan nama biraatti dahatee dhiibbaa fi jijjiirama guddaa fida; qindoomina meeshaa fi humnaatiin galma gahuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Shielding itself behind the earthen pot, the fire brings water to a boil; working through a proper vessel allows heat to accomplish constructive work
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko tooftaadhaan karaa nama biraatiin dhimma guddaa raawwachiisu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe smart delegation and diplomatic shielding, where an agent achieves a powerful outcome without exposing themselves to quenching
Keywords_AO: ibidda; okkotee; dahachuu; bishaan; danfisuu; toftaa
Keywords_EN: fire; clay pot; shielding; water; boiling; strategic agent

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen ilmoorratti, hara baafatti
Translation_Literal_EN: The donkey vents her fatigue upon her foal
Meaning_AO: Namni bakka dhimma isaatiitti roorrifamee yookaan dadhabee aarii isaa nama laafaa fi dadhabaa isa jala jiru irratti baasa; roorroo laafaatti agarsiisuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: The donkey catches her breath by venting upon her foal; displaced aggression where an overburdened person unfairly vents frustration on vulnerable young
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan yookaan haati alatti aartee galtee ijoollee nagaa irratti dheekkamtu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn parents or superiors who suffer abuse or stress outside and come home to take out their bitter rage on defenseless children
Keywords_AO: harree; ilmoo; hara baafachuu; aarii; roorroo; dadhabaa
Keywords_EN: donkey; foal; venting; displaced anger; bullying the weak

Mammaaksa_AO: Quba caphe kan itti aanutti hidhani
Translation_Literal_EN: A fractured finger is bound to the adjacent one
Meaning_AO: Namni miidhame yookaan kufaatiin mudate nama dhihoo isaatti hirkatee fi walitti hidhatee bayyanata; fira dhihootti hirkachuun furmaata fida
Meaning_EN: A broken finger is splinted to the neighboring one; in times of injury or breakdown, an individual recovers by leaning on the nearest kin
Theme_EN: Leaning on Neighboring Support to Heal
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni rakkate fira dhihoo isaatti hirkatee akka jabaatu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel someone in distress to lean closely upon immediate family or neighbors, reminding that splinting oneself to adjacent kin brings healing
Keywords_AO: quba; cabuu; aanuu; hidhuu; fira; bayyanachuu
Keywords_EN: finger; fracture; adjacent; binding; kinship support; recovery

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo mana eegan, saree dhaaf qoricha ta'u
Translation_Literal_EN: If they guard the house, they become medicine against the dog
Meaning_AO: Abbaan qe'ee dammaqee manaa fi qabeenya isaa yoo eeggate, hattuun yookaan diinni akka sareetti isa sodaatee deebi'a; of eeggannoon diina dura dhaabbata
Meaning_EN: If the owners stay vigilant and guard the house, they serve as the best antidote against dogs and thieves; active vigilance deters intruders
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dammaqinaan qe'ee eeggachuun diina akka dhoowwu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advocate strict domestic and community vigilance, showing that being visibly alert and prepared naturally wards off prowling troublemakers
Keywords_AO: mana; eeguu; saree; qoricha; dammaqina; ittisa
Keywords_EN: house; guarding; dog; medicine; vigilance; deterrence

Mammaaksa_AO: Eessumaa gootaatu tolaa, soddaa dureeysaatu tola
Translation_Literal_EN: For a maternal uncle, a brave warrior is best; for an in-law, a wealthy man is best
Meaning_AO: Eessumni goota ta'e eegumsa fi gootummaa namaaf kenna, soddaan sooressa ta'e ammoo qabeenya fi gargaarsaan nama utuba; faayidaa hariiroo adda addaa ibsa
Meaning_EN: For a maternal uncle, a brave warrior is best; for an in-law, a wealthy man is best; maternal kin provide protective valor, while in-laws offer economic backing
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gahee fi bu'aa firoonni garaagaraa jireenya keessatti qaban madaalanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when examining complementary family networks, observing that maternal uncles provide fierce protective shelter while marital alliances provide wealth
Keywords_AO: eessuma; goota; soddaa; dureessa; tola; aadaa
Keywords_EN: maternal uncle; warrior; in-law; wealthy; kinship roles; alliances

Mammaaksa_AO: Argitee himi, fuutee kenni na baasi (oolchi)
Translation_Literal_EN: [From being told] 'Tell what you saw' and 'Return what you took', deliver me (spare me)!
Meaning_AO: Kadhannaa fi eeggannoo uumaatti dhiyaatuudha; waan ijaan hin argin 'ragaa bahi' jedhamanii qorumsa keessa galuu fi waan hin fudhatin 'deebisi' jedhamanii yakka hin qabneen sobaan himatamuufi itti-gaafatamuurraa Waaqayyo akka nama baraaru (oolchu) kadhachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: A traditional supplication seeking protection from false accusation and wrongful liability: praying to be delivered from being coerced into testifying about events one never witnessed ('tell what you saw') and from being unjustly accused of taking something one never touched ('return what you took')
Theme_EN: Deliverance from False Accusations and Perjury
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko sobaan akka hin himatamne, ragaa sobaatti akka hin saaxilamneefi yakka hin raawwatinitti akka hin qabamne Waaqa kadhatu ykn eeggannoo gochuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a protective prayer or expression seeking divine deliverance from being framed, coerced into false testimony, or wrongfully blamed for deeds one never committed
Keywords_AO: argitee himi; fuutee kenni; na baasi; na oolchi; kadhannaa; sobaan himatamuu; haqa; eegumsa
Keywords_EN: testify; return; deliver me; spare me; supplication; prayer; false accusation; wrongful liability

Mammaaksa_AO: Ballaan kan arraba dabsu anuu niin beekaa, kan funyaan butu narraa eegaa je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: 'The one sticking out his tongue I know myself; guard me from the one hitting my nose,' said the blind man
Meaning_AO: Arrabsoo fi ceephoo afaanii dhiisanii miidhaa qabatamaa fi balaa qaamaa nama irra gahuuf dursa kennanii of eeguu akka qaban agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: 'The one sticking out his tongue I already perceive; protect me from the one swinging at my nose,' said the blind man; disregard harmless taunts for real threats
Theme_EN: Disregarding Harmless Taunts for Real Threats
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko afaan ormaatiif dhiphachuu dhiisee balaa qabatamaa ofirraa ittisuu qabu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone not to waste energy worrying about petty insults or behind-the-back mockery, but to stay focused on defending against real strikes
Keywords_AO: ballaa; arraba dabsuu; funyaan butuu; eeguu; balaa; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: blind man; sticking out tongue; hitting nose; real threat; prioritization

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni xiqqoo namaaf godhe, guddaa humnaaf dadhaba
Translation_Literal_EN: One who did a little favor for you lacked the strength for a greater one
Meaning_AO: Namni tola xiqqoo siif oole waanuma danda'e waan gumaacheef galateeffachuu qabda malee wanta humna isaatiin ol ta'e irraa eeguun dogoggora
Meaning_EN: One who did a modest favor for you simply lacked the means to do more; appreciate small assistance and never resent a benefactor for their limited strength
Theme_EN: Appreciating Modest Help and Respecting Capacity
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gargaarsa xiqqoo argatetti mufatee isa guddaa barbaadu gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish an ungrateful recipient who belittles a modest gift, reminding them that the giver gave according to the limits of their humble means
Keywords_AO: nama; xiqqoo; gochuu; guddaa; humna; dadhabuu; galata
Keywords_EN: person; small favor; great; strength; capacity; gratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni du'e ofiif hin booyu
Translation_Literal_EN: A dead person does not weep for himself
Meaning_AO: Namni erga kufee yookaan balaan dhumatee booda of gargaaruu hin danda'u; kan gargaaruu fi booyichaan yaadu warra hafe qofa; jiraattotatu itti gaafatama
Meaning_EN: A dead person does not weep for himself; those who have fallen can no longer advocate, mourn, or fend for themselves; the living must speak on their behalf
Theme_EN: The Living Must Advocate for the Fallen
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota kufaniif yookaan warra miidhamaniif birmachuun barbaachisaa ta'e barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rally the community to defend and remember those who have perished or fallen silent, emphasizing that the dead depend upon the living for justice
Keywords_AO: nama; du'uu; ofiif; booyuu; hafuu; itti-gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: person; dying; self; weeping; survivors; advocacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Qottoon of hin qortu
Translation_Literal_EN: An axe cannot carve its own handle
Meaning_AO: Namni dandeettii fi ogummaa qabaatuyyuu hanqina mataa isaa qorachuu yookaan of yaaluu hin danda'u; gargaarsa nama biraa barbaada
Meaning_EN: An axe cannot hew its own wooden handle; no matter how skilled or sharp a person may be, they cannot operate on themselves without external help
Theme_EN: The Need for External Help to Shape Oneself
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hayyuun yookaan ogeessi tokko gorsa nama biraa barbaaduu isaa ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach humility to experts and leaders, reminding them that just as an axe needs outside hands to craft its handle, the wisest minds need outside counsel
Keywords_AO: qottoo; qoruu; dandeettii; hanqina ofii; gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: axe; hewing; handle; self-correction; interdependence; limitation

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati mucaa jalaan oolti
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother spends the day sustained/benefited through her child
Meaning_AO: Nyaata, aannan, kennaa fi kunuunsa daa'imaaf dhihaatu irraa haatis ni quufti, tajaajilamti, jalaanis oolti; akkasumas kabajaa fi eegumsi mucaaf godhamu haadhaafis dabalatee bu'aa fida
Meaning_EN: A mother is nourished, cared for, and sheltered through her child; whatever nutritious food, milk, gifts, or honors are provided for the child directly sustain and benefit the mother as well
Theme_AO: Bu'aa fi Kunuunsa Mucaa Jalaan Argamu
Theme_EN: Sustenance and Benefits Derived Through the Child
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo kennaan, sooranni ykn tajaajilli daa'imaaf dhihaate haadhaafis quufa fi nagaa ta'u, yookaan dhimma mucaatiin haatis jalaan fayyadamtu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing how special care, food, and gifts provided for a child directly nourish and benefit the mother, or how a mother's well-being is elevated through her child
Keywords_AO: haadha; mucaa; jalaan ooluu; quufa; soorata; tajaajila; eegumsa
Keywords_EN: mother; child; sustained through; indirect benefit; nourishment; family care; provision

Mammaaksa_AO: Obboleeysa jechuun kan ati rifattu rifatee ati gammadu gammadu
Translation_Literal_EN: A brother is one who trembles when you are startled and rejoices when you rejoice
Meaning_AO: Obbolummaan dhugaan dhiphina fi gammachuu kee guutummaatti kan qooddatuudha; miira walii hubatanii cinaa dhaabbachuu ibsa
Meaning_EN: To call someone a brother means one who trembles in shock when you are startled, and rejoices when you celebrate; authentic brotherhood is emotional solidarity
Theme_EN: Emotional Solidarity in Joy and Tribulation
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo michuun yookaan obboleessi dhugaan gadda fi gammachuu namaa keessatti walqixa cinaa dhaabbatu faarsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to define authentic brotherhood, affirming that true kin are those whose hearts beat in unison with your own through both panic and celebration
Keywords_AO: obboleessa; rifachuu; gammaduu; tokkummaa; jaalala; dhiiga
Keywords_EN: brother; startling; rejoicing; emotional solidarity; kinship; loyalty

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka kennu tahi, kan fudhatu hin tahin.
Translation_Literal_EN: Be the giving hand, do not be the receiving hand.
Meaning_AO: Harka namaa eeggachuu irra arjummaa qabaatanii of danda'uufi nama gargaaruutu caala; arjummaafi of danda'uun kabaja fida.
Meaning_EN: It is better to be generous, self-reliant, and helpful to others than to depend perpetually on charity and handouts.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota arjummaaf, hojjatanii of danda'uufi harka namaa eeggachuu dhiisuuf gorsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to encourage industriousness, benevolence, and economic self-sufficiency rather than reliance on begging.
Keywords_AO: harka, kennu, fudhachuu, arjummaa, of danda'uu
Keywords_EN: hand, give, receive, generosity, self-reliance, charity

Mammaaksa_AO: Sadaqaan hammuma abbaan kennate.
Translation_Literal_EN: Charity is only as much as one gives oneself.
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko wantuma ofuma isaatiin tola oole ykn sadaqatee qofatu galataafi bu'aa isaaf ta'a malee kan biraa isaaf hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: A person receives spiritual merit and blessings strictly in proportion to what they themselves give and sacrifice willingly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama tokko tola ooltummaaf, sadaqaa kennachuu fi qooda ofii gumaachuuf jajjabeessan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage individuals to give alms and do good deeds according to their own capacity.
Keywords_AO: sadaqaa, kennachuu, abbaa, bu'aa, galata
Keywords_EN: charity, alms, giving, reward, sacrifice, deeds

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan waa himu hin dhabani, kan waa kennu hin argani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One never lacks someone who speaks/advises, but one cannot find someone who gives.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiifi gorsi baay'eedha, garuu nama rakkina qabatamaan qabeenyaan ykn gargaarsaan furu argachuun baay'ee rakkisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Advice and empty words are abundant, but finding someone willing to give tangible assistance or material help is exceedingly rare.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni afaaniin gorsa baay'isanii garuu qabatamaan gargaarsa kennuu dhaban itti gaddan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Expressed when people offer plenty of gratuitous advice but are unwilling to offer actual material or practical support.
Keywords_AO: himuu, kennuu, gorsa, gocha, arjummaa
Keywords_EN: talk, advice, giving, action, hollow words, assistance

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan kadhatu qofa hin jajani(ajaa'ibani)kan kadhatuus nama jaja(ajaa'iba).
Translation_Literal_EN: One should not only marvel at/criticize the beggar; the beggar also marvels at/criticizes people.
Meaning_AO: Namni hundi qoodaafi ilaalcha mataa isaa qaba; namni akka salphaatti ilaalamu illee nama biraa madaaluu fi qeequu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Do not merely mock or judge the disadvantaged; they too observe, judge, and hold opinions about the people around them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni namoota rakkatoo ykn kadhattoota tuffatanii kolfanitti, tuffatamaanis hubannoo akka qabu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said to remind arrogant individuals not to look down upon beggars or the poor, as they too discern and evaluate human hypocrisy.
Keywords_AO: kadhachuu, jajuu, ajaa'ibuu, tuffii, kabaja
Keywords_EN: begging, marvel, criticize, beggar, mutual respect, perspective

Mammaaksa_AO: Kennaan namaa, nama hin quubsitu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A human's gift does not satisfy a person.
Meaning_AO: Gargaarsi namarraa argamu yeroo muraasaaf malee jireenya guutuu nama hin dhaabu; of danda'uufi eebba Waaqayyoo qofaatu nama quubsa.
Meaning_EN: Handouts from fellow humans never provide true, lasting fulfillment; genuine sufficiency comes through self-reliance and God's providence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gargaarsa nama biraa irratti rarra'uu dhiisee ofumaan hojjatee akka quufu gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to dissuade individuals from living on dependence, reminding them that charity from men is finite and incomplete.
Keywords_AO: kennaa, nama, quufinsa, of danda'uu, rarra'iinsa
Keywords_EN: gift, charity, satisfaction, self-reliance, dependence, sufficiency

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama kennee hin beekne, kennaan hija itti fakkaata.
Translation_Literal_EN: To one who has never given, giving feels like a great loss/injury/harm.
Meaning_AO: Namni doqni yookiin arjummaa hin beekne, waan xiqqoo kennuun illee akka miidhaa, kasaaraa ykn balaatti itti dhaga'ama.
Meaning_EN: To a stingy person who has never practiced generosity, parting with anything feels like an intolerable loss or outright injury.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni doqnoon waan xiqqoo kennuun akka waan lubbuun isaanii baatee iyyanii dhiphatan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock or illustrate the agony experienced by habitual misers whenever they are expected to contribute or give.
Keywords_AO: kennuu, doqna, hija, miidhaa, arjummaa
Keywords_EN: stinginess, miser, giving, perceived loss, selfishness

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaalli hin waakkatu, yoo abbaan waakkate malee.
Translation_Literal_EN: The camel does not refuse, unless its owner refuses.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko akka nama hin fayyanne kan taasisuu fi qabeenya kan dhoowwatu qabeenyicha osoo hin taane doqnummaa abbaati.
Meaning_EN: A possession or resource itself does not withhold its benefit; it is the selfish owner who refuses to share.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya qabu tokko gargaarsa kennuu dhoowwatee qabeenyicha sababa godhachuuf yaalu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Uttered when someone blames external circumstances or property for not helping, pointing out that stinginess lies with the person.
Keywords_AO: gaala, waakkachuu, abbaa, qabeenya, dhoowwachuu
Keywords_EN: camel, refuse, owner, stinginess, sharing, withholding

Mammaaksa_AO: Sheenyoon gaafa Doobbaa jalaan bishaan dhuga
Translation_Literal_EN: The hornless cow drinks water from beneath the horns of the long-horned cow
Meaning_AO: Namni humna, meeshaa ykn gaafa ittiin orma lolu hin qabne, malaa fi tooftaadhaan isa humna qabu (isa gaafa dheeraa) jalatti dhihaatee osoo hin miidhamin dantaa fi rizqii isaa argata. Meeshaa dhabanis tooftaan jabaa jalaan jireenya ofii gaggeeffachuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The hornless cow drinks water from right beneath the sprawling horns of the long-horned cow; someone lacking weapons or brute force uses clever positioning, humility, and tact to secure sustenance and thrive under the very span of the mighty
Theme_EN: Resourcefulness of the Weaponless Amidst the Mighty
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dadhabaan ykn meeshaa hin qabne tokko malaan nama humna qabu jalaan dantaa isaa guuttatee nagaan jiraatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an unassuming, weaponless person uses shrewd tact to access resources and survive peacefully under the wings or presence of powerful figures
Keywords_AO: sheenyoo; doobbaa; gaafa; bishaan dhuguu; tooftaa; mala; humna dhabuu
Keywords_EN: hornless cow; long-horned cattle; horns; drinking water; tactics; shrewdness; weaponless

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen faraqa wal hooyxi.
Translation_Literal_EN: Donkeys scratch/groom each other by turns.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni hawaasa keessatti wal deggeruu, dabareen wal gargaaruu fi waliif tumsuun jireenya akka geggeeffatan ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Mutual cooperation and reciprocity are essential in community life; individuals help each other in turn.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni wal-ta'anii, dabaree eeggachuun wal gargaaranii hojii hojjetan jajjabeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to encourage mutual aid, reciprocal favors, and teamwork within a community setting.
Keywords_AO: harree, faraqa, wal hooyxuu, dabaree, wal-gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: donkeys, turns, grooming, cooperation, reciprocity, mutual assistance

Mammaaksa_AO: Addunyaan wasaasaadha
Translation_Literal_EN: The world is a funeral bier
Meaning_AO: Akkuma wasaasaan reeffa namaa tokko baattee awwaala geessitee gattee deebitee kan biraa eeggattu, addunyaan kunis nama hundumaa dabaree dabareedhaan gara du'aatti baatti malee namuu irratti hin hafu; jireenyi addunyaa kan yerooti malee qabeenya dhaabbataa miti
Meaning_EN: Just as a funeral bier (wasaasaa) carries one corpse to the grave, unloads it, and returns to carry the next, this mortal world is merely a vehicle steadily carrying each human being by turn toward death; earthly existence belongs permanently to no one
Theme_EN: Transience of Worldly Life and Inevitable Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko qabeenyaa fi qananii addunyaatti boonee du'aa fi xumura jireenyaa dagatu, addunyaan akka wasaasaa dabaree dabareen nama gara awwaalaatti baattu ta'uu yaadachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to sober up someone overly attached to worldly riches or arrogance, reminding them that the world is merely a funeral bier ferrying all mortals toward the grave
Keywords_AO: addunyaa; wasaasaa; reeffa; awwaala; du'a; darbiinsa; dabaree
Keywords_EN: world; funeral bier; stretcher; corpse; grave; mortality; transience; death

Mammaaksa_AO: Kennaa namaa irra, kennaa Rabbiitu caala.
Translation_Literal_EN: God's gift is greater than the gift of humans.
Meaning_AO: Wanta namarraa eeggatan caalaa eebbaafi kennaan Waaqayyo namaaf kennutu guutuufi ulfina qaba; namni si komachuu danda'a, Waaqni garuu arjaadha.
Meaning_EN: The blessings and providence of God are far superior to human charity; humans may reprove and boast, but divine grace sustains abundantly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gargaarsa namaatiin quufuu dhabee gara Waaqaatti iyyatu ykn eebba Waaqaa dinqisiifatu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said when seeking solace in God’s provision rather than relying on fickle, begrudging human charity.
Keywords_AO: kennaa, nama, Rabbi, caaluu, eebba
Keywords_EN: gift, God, man, divine grace, blessings, providence

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama namaa waa kennuuf waaqni ni kennaaf.
Translation_Literal_EN: To the person who gives to another person, God gives.
Meaning_AO: Namni arjaa ta'ee namoota gargaaru, Waaqayyo qabeenyaafi eebba isaaf dabalata; tola ooltummaan eebba fida.
Meaning_EN: Whoever shows compassion and gives generously to their fellow man is rewarded and sustained by God with abundant blessings.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama arjummaa raawwatu eebbisaniifi namoota akka wal gargaaran kakaasanitti dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Expressed to encourage selfless charity and assure givers that generosity invites divine enrichment.
Keywords_AO: nama, kennuu, Waaqa, eebba, tola ooltummaa
Keywords_EN: person, giving, God, reward, generosity, charity

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka barsiisan hin dhoowwani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not withhold from the hand that one has accustomed to receiving.
Meaning_AO: Wanta baratame ykn aadeffatame tokko tasa addaan kutuun rakkisaadha; yoo nama tokko gargaarsa barechite yeroo mara eeggata.
Meaning_EN: It is difficult to deny support once you have accustomed someone to expecting it; habits and established dependencies cannot be easily broken.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dur gargaaraa turaniif ammallee gargaarsa itti fufuu akka dirqamaatti ilaalan ykn barsiifata dhaabuu dadhaban.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when feeling obliged to continue aiding someone who has grown accustomed to relying on one's regular assistance.
Keywords_AO: harka, barsiisuu, dhoowwachuu, aadeffannaa, eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: hand, accustomed, habit, withholding, dependency, routine

Mammaaksa_AO: Ibidda hin liqeeffatani, kan qabu irraa qabsiifatan malee.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not borrow fire, one only rekindles/lights from the one who has it.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko tokko liqii ta'uu hin danda'u; qabeenya ykn beekumsa qooddachuu fi madda irraa fudhachuudha malee akka meeshaatti hin deebifamu.
Meaning_EN: Certain things cannot be borrowed and returned; rather, they are shared, lit, or learned from the existing source without diminishing it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni waan liqeeffamuu hin danda'amne qooddachuuf mari'atan ykn beekumsi qoodamuun akka ibiddaa ta'uu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate things that should be freely shared or transmitted (like knowledge, light, inspiration) rather than lent as debts.
Keywords_AO: ibidda, liqeeffachuu, qabsiifachuu, qooddachuu, beekumsa
Keywords_EN: fire, borrow, rekindle, share, light, wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan jagnaa akka leencaatti koqaa, garaan luynaa akka dhadhaatti baqa.
Translation_Literal_EN: The brave one's heart roars like a lion; the coward's heart melts like butter.
Meaning_AO: Gootni yeroo qormaataa fi diinaa akkuma leencaa ni daggala, ni jabaata; sodaataan garuu battalatti rifatee humna dhabee bada.
Meaning_EN: In the face of peril, a hero's heart roars with unshakeable courage like a lion, whereas a coward's resolve liquefies like butter.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo goota onnee qabu faarsanii fi nama sodaataa ta'e qeequuf wal bira qaban.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise the stalwart heart of a courageous person while satirizing the spinelessness of a coward.
Keywords_AO: garaan, jagna, leenca, koqaa, luyna, dhadhaa, baqa
Keywords_EN: brave, lion, roar, coward, butter, melting, fortitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan jagnaa hurrumaa, kan luynaa marrimaani.
Translation_Literal_EN: The brave one's belly is dense bush, while the coward's is mere intestines.
Meaning_AO: Jagni icciitii qabata, obsa guddaa qaba, miira isaas ni dhoksa; sodaataan garuu dafee rifata, waan garaa qabus amansiisaa miti.
Meaning_EN: A hero possesses the impenetrable depth, secrecy, and resilience of dense thicket, whereas a coward is shallow, transparent, and gutless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo obsa, icciitii eeggachuu fi garaa jabina gootaa ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to characterize the emotional reserve, courage, and composure of a true warrior against a flighty person.
Keywords_AO: garaan, jagna, hurrumaa, luyna, marrimaan, obsa
Keywords_EN: hero, dense bush, thicket, coward, intestines, composure, resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati gootaa, baddu barbaacha qabdi, duutu awwaala qabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: The mother of a hero, if she goes missing, has a search party; if she dies, she has an honorable burial
Meaning_AO: Gootummaan ilma dhiiraa maatii fi keessattuu haadha isaatiif kabajaa fi eegumsa olaanaa fida; haati gootaa yoo badde ummanni guutuun birmatee ishee barbaada, yoo duutes ulfina guddaadhaan awwaalcha argatti. Dhiirummaan ilmaa haadha isaatiif dahoo fi kabaja ta'uu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The mother of a valiant warrior enjoys great communal reverence and protection because of her son's courage: if she goes missing, the entire community mobilizes a search for her, and when she dies, she receives an honorable, well-attended burial. A child's valor shields and honors his mother in both life and death
Theme_EN: Communal Reverence for the Mother of a Hero
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gootummaan ilma namaa maatii isaatiif, keessattuu haadha isaatiif, hawaasa keessatti kabajaa fi eegumsa olaanaa argamsiisu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how a warrior's heroic stature directly elevates his mother, ensuring she is protected, sought after, and honored by the whole community in life and in death
Keywords_AO: haadha jagnaa; goota; baddu; barbaacha; duutu; awwaala; ulfina; kabaja
Keywords_EN: mother of a hero; warrior; search party; burial; honor; filial valor; community respect

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan leencaa, citaan hin seenu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Straw/grass does not enter the lion's mouth.
Meaning_AO: Gootni ykn namni jabaan wantoota salphaa, arrabsoo fi gochoota xixinnoo gatii hin qabne keessa hin galu.
Meaning_EN: A formidable predator like a lion does not graze on straw; a dignified, powerful leader does not stoop to petty squabbles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni iddoo guddaa qabu waan salphaa akka tuffatu gorsan fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise an honorable person not to engage in trivial, low-minded arguments or beneath-dignity activities.
Keywords_AO: afaan, leencaa, citaan, ulfina, goota
Keywords_EN: lion mouth, straw, nobility, magnanimity, stature, pride

Mammaaksa_AO: Sodaataan, bishaan jannataa hin dhugu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The fearful person does not drink the water of paradise.
Meaning_AO: Namni sodaa of keessatti baatu milkaa'ina guddaa, boona fi qooda olaanaa gonfachuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A fearful person who avoids risk and hardships will never taste the sweetest fruits of victory or divine reward.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama sodaa irra aanee tarkaanfii barbaachisaa akka fudhatu kakaasan fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to challenge someone to overcome hesitation and fear to attain supreme success and blessings.
Keywords_AO: sodaataa, bishaan, jannata, dhuguu, ija-jabina
Keywords_EN: coward, water of paradise, fear, courage, triumph, paradise

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati dhiiraa waaqa.
Translation_Literal_EN: The mother of a brave man is God [under God's care].
Meaning_AO: Gootni eegumsa Waaqaatiin jiraata; haati ilma goota deesses eegumsa Waaqayyoo qabdi.
Meaning_EN: The life of a courageous man and the destiny of his mother rest entirely in God's supreme protection and providence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo eegumsaa fi amantaa gootni Waaqarratti qabu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express that the destiny of a valiant hero is ordained and sheltered by divine will.
Keywords_AO: haadha, dhiira, waaqa, eegumsa, goota
Keywords_EN: mother, brave man, God, divine protection, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Leencaa fi jagni biyya hin jiru hin ja'inaa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Never say there is no lion or brave man in the land.
Meaning_AO: Biyya tokko keessatti yeroo hundumaa gootonni fi jajjaboon ni jiru; tuffatamuu hin qaban, yeroo isaaniitti mul'atu.
Meaning_EN: Never disparage a country by claiming it lacks lions or champions; heroes are always present and arise when crisis strikes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko saba ykn naannoo tokko goota hin qabu jedhee tuffatu deebii kennuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against underestimating any community, asserting that valiant defenders always dwell within its midst.
Keywords_AO: leenca, jagna, biyya, jiru, tuffii, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: lion, brave man, country, nation, valor, resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuun, gaafa dhalatte duute.
Translation_Literal_EN: The soul died on the day it was born.
Meaning_AO: Duuti guyyaa dhalatan irraa eegalee kan murtaa'e waan ta'eef, du'a sodaatanii wareegama gootummaa dhiisuun hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Since mortality is sealed the very instant of birth, paralyzing fear of death should never compromise one's honor and courage.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni du'a sodaatee waan qajeelaa fi gootummaa dhiisuuf jedhu jajjabeessan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used on the battlefield or in crisis to instill fearless resolve by reminding that physical death is preordained.
Keywords_AO: lubbuu, dhaloota, du'a, gootummaa, hiree
Keywords_EN: soul, life, birth, death, destiny, mortality, fearlessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi dhiiraa, gaafa dhalate du'e.
Translation_Literal_EN: A brave son died the day he was born.
Meaning_AO: Dhiirri gootni lubbuu isaaf hin mararfatu; kaayyoo fi saba isaatiif jedhee du'a fudhatee jiraata.
Meaning_EN: A true warrior reckons himself dead to self-preservation from birth, committing fully to valor, duty, and sacrifice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gootni qabsootti seenu kutannoo fi ija-jabina isaa calaqqisiisuuf dhiyeessan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to steel the nerves of young warriors embarking on perilous missions of collective defense.
Keywords_AO: ilma dhiiraa, dhalachuu, du'a, kutannoo, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: brave son, birth, death, resolve, heroic sacrifice, warrior

Mammaaksa_AO: Jagni beela hin sodaanne.
Translation_Literal_EN: The hero does not fear hunger.
Meaning_AO: Gootni beela, dheebuu fi rakkoolee qaamaa danda'ee kaayyoo isaarratti cicha malee hin laafu.
Meaning_EN: A true hero is hardened against physical privation, enduring hunger and hardship without relinquishing the objective.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qabsaa'onni ykn namoonni kaayyoo qaban rakkoo danda'anii akka jabaatan gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to motivate resilience, teaching that physical discomfort and deprivation must never deter a warrior.
Keywords_AO: jagna, beela, sodaa, obsa, cichoomina
Keywords_EN: hero, hunger, hardship, endurance, fortitude, stamina

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiiraa fi leenca, yeroo galan hin beekani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One never knows the exact time a brave man and a lion return home.
Meaning_AO: Gootnis ta'e leenci hanga kaayyoo isaanii galmaan ga'anii fi adamsanii xumuranitti yeroo hin qabatan; sochiin isaanii hin tilmaamamu.
Meaning_EN: Neither a heroic man nor a hunting lion adheres to predictable timetables; they return only when their conquest is fulfilled.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojii cimaa fi sochii kutannoo qabu raawwatanitti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the tireless, unpredictable dedication of purpose-driven heroes on dangerous quests.
Keywords_AO: dhiira, leenca, galuu, yeroo, kaayyoo
Keywords_EN: man, lion, returning, mission, prowess, tenacity

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuu abbaan Rabbumaa maaliif mukaan korani?
Translation_Literal_EN: Why climb a tree in panic when the owner of the soul is God Himself?
Meaning_AO: Duuti fi jireenyi harka Waaqaa waan jiruuf, sodaa hamaadhaan dhiphachuun ykn baqachuun hiree hin jijjiiru.
Meaning_EN: When life and mortality reside solely in God's hands, frantically climbing trees in desperate panic will not alter destiny.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni sodaa humnaa oliitiin raafamanii dhiphatan akka tasgabbaa'an gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used rhetorically to rebuke undignified panic, counseling faith and calm courage under threat.
Keywords_AO: lubbuu, abbaa, Rabbumaa, muka, koruu, sodaa
Keywords_EN: soul, sovereign God, tree, panic, fear, destiny, tranquility

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dubartiin ergite, du'a hin sodaatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person sent by a woman does not fear death.
Meaning_AO: Namni kabaja, jaalala, waadaa fi quuqama dubartiin kaka'ee socho'u onnee guutuu fi ija-jabina olaanaadhaan lola.
Meaning_EN: A man dispatched on a mission by a woman's honor, trust, or love fights with unbridled valor, immune to the fear of death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gootni waadaa fi kabaja dubartiif jedhee onnee guutuun qabsoo jabeessu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how profound personal honor, devotion, and female inspiration propel men to heroic feats.
Keywords_AO: nama, dubartii, erguu, du'a, sodaa, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: woman, dispatched, fearless, death, chivalry, heroic devotion

Mammaaksa_AO: Jeyna Rabbiitu tiysa, luyni ifiif if tiysa.
Translation_Literal_EN: God protects the hero, while the coward tries to protect himself.
Meaning_AO: Gootni haqaaf falmee Waaqarratti hirkata, Waaqnis isa eega; sodaataan garuu of qofa eeguuf jecha salphina seena.
Meaning_EN: God watches over and preserves the hero who stands boldly for truth, while the coward obsesses over self-preservation and falls into shame.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama goota ta'ee Waaqa abdatee fi nama sodaataa of jaallatu wal bira qaban.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast righteous courage relying on divine justice against selfish, paranoid cowardice.
Keywords_AO: jagna, Rabbi, tiysaa, luyna, of tiysuu, eegumsa
Keywords_EN: hero, God, protect, coward, self-preservation, divine grace

Mammaaksa_AO: Jeynummaan horii rabbiiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Bravery is God's wealth/endowment.
Meaning_AO: Gootummaan kennaa guddaa fi qabeenya Waaqayyo namaaf kennuudha malee kan humnaan ykn qarshiin bitamu miti.
Meaning_EN: True courage is a divine wealth and spiritual endowment bestowed by God, rather than a commodity that can be bought or manufactured.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gootummaan uumamaa fi kennaa Waaqaa ta'uu isaa dubbatan fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind individuals that innate bravery is a sacred gift from the Creator to be handled with humility and honor.
Keywords_AO: jagnummaa, horii, Rabbi, kennaa, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: bravery, wealth, endowment, God, valor, divine virtue

Mammaaksa_AO: Eeboon jeynaa jeynummaa namaa hin taatu, akka abaluutiin tahaan dhiirummaa namaa hin taatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Carrying a hero's spear does not make one heroic; imitating someone else does not constitute manhood.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan ykn fakkeessuun gootummaa namaaf hin fidu; gootummaan onnee ofii keessaa madda malee nama fakkaachuun hin argamu.
Meaning_EN: Bearing the weapons of a warrior does not make one brave, nor does superficial imitation produce authentic valor; courage stems from within.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota meeshaa fi uffataan goota fakkaatanii onnee dhaban qeequuf fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose pretenders who borrow emblems of courage without possessing inner fortitude.
Keywords_AO: eeboo, jagna, jegnummaa, dhiirummaa, fakkeessuu
Keywords_EN: spear, hero, bravery, manhood, imitation, authentic courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan miilaan dhoqqee baqateeti, cinaachaan keessa ciisa.
Translation_Literal_EN: The fool flees mud with his feet, then lies down in it on his side.
Meaning_AO: Namni hubannaa hin qabne rakkoo xiqqoo baqachuuf jedhee balaa fi badii guddaa caalu keessa of buusa.
Meaning_EN: A fool attempts to avoid a minor inconvenience only to plunge headlong into a far greater disaster.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni mala dhabuudhaan rakkoo salphaa jalaa miliquuf badii guddaa ofitti fidu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone's clumsy attempt to escape a petty nuisance results in their complete ruin.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, miila, dhoqqee, baqachuu, cinaacha, ciisuu
Keywords_EN: fool, mud, fleeing, lying down, disaster, poor judgment

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan kennaniif gadi naqa, himaniif gandaan dhaqa.
Translation_Literal_EN: If you give to a fool, he pours it out; if you tell him a secret, he takes it to the village.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan qabeenya kennameef hin qusadhu, hin kunuunsu; icciitii itti himames dhoksuu hin danda'u, hundaaf labsa.
Meaning_EN: A foolish person squanders material gifts and immediately broadcasts confidential secrets to the entire community.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama icciitii hin eegnee fi qabeenya qusachuu hin dandeenyetti qabeenya ykn icciitii kennuu dhowwatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a warning against confiding secrets in, or entrusting resources to, an indiscreet and wasteful person.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, kennuu, gadi naquu, icciitii, ganda, himuu
Keywords_EN: fool, gift, spill, squander, secret, gossip, village

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan hin weeddisu, weeddisu hin callisu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool does not sing, but once he sings, he never shuts up.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan dura waan tokko jalqabuuf dafee hin hubatu, yoo eegale immoo daangaa dhabee dafqa itti dhangalaasee nama nuffisiisa.
Meaning_EN: A fool is slow to participate, but once he starts, he lacks all moderation and does not know when to stop.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan tokko irratti daangaa dhabee yeroo fi bakka osoo hin madaalin nama nuffisiisu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone lacks social awareness and moderation, overdoing an activity to the point of annoyance.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, weeddisuu, callisuu, daangaa, nuffisiisuu
Keywords_EN: fool, singing, silence, moderation, excess, social cues

Mammaaksa_AO: Hoolaan gaafa du'u samii arga.
Translation_Literal_EN: A sheep sees the sky only on the day it dies [is slaughtered].
Meaning_AO: Namni dantaa dhabeessi ykn gowwaan hanga badiin guddaan ykn balaan dhumaa irra ga'utti dammaqee hin argu; erga hundi darbee booda baru.
Meaning_EN: An oblivious person or fool only opens their eyes to reality when facing imminent destruction or after it is too late.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni balaan osoo itti dhufuu hin yaaddofne, gaafa badiin qaqqabe qofa dammaqu qeequuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize an individual who remains blissfully ignorant until catastrophic consequences strike.
Keywords_AO: hoolaa, du'a, samii, arguudha, dammaqina
Keywords_EN: sheep, death, sky, slaughter, late realization, oblivious

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwummaan dhukkuba qoricha hin qabne.
Translation_Literal_EN: Foolishness is a disease that has no cure/medicine.
Meaning_AO: Gowwummaa fi hubannaa dhabuun amala yaalii fi gorsaan jijjiiruu ykn fayyisuun baay'ee ulfaataa ta'eedha.
Meaning_EN: Foolishness is an incurable affliction; no amount of external advice or remedy can easily fix innate lack of wisdom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama gorsanii fi barsiisanii jijjiiruu dadhaban abdii kutachuun ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when throwing one's hands up in despair after repeatedly trying to advise an incorrigible fool.
Keywords_AO: gowwummaa, dhukkuba, qoricha, fayyisuu, gorsa
Keywords_EN: foolishness, disease, cure, medicine, incurable folly

Mammaaksa_AO: "Akkana goonee bira teenya" je'e, gowwaan niitii isaa ajjeesee.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'This is how we sit beside her in peace,' said the fool after killing his wife.
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan rakkoo salphaa furuuf jedhee tarkaanfii badiisaa fi deebii hin qabne fudhatee wanta qabu balleessa.
Meaning_EN: A fool destroys what is precious under the absurd delusion of fixing a problem or creating convenience.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni furmaata fida jedhee gocha badiisa guddaa hordofsiisu raawwatu qeequuf dhiyaata.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone implements a disastrous, irreversible 'solution' that annihilates the very thing they wished to manage.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, niitii, ajjeesuu, furmaata, badii
Keywords_EN: fool, wife, killing, absurd solution, destruction, folly

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaaf cooma hin waadani, moora je'eeti namatti dida.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not roast fatty prime meat for a fool; he calls it mere tallow/suet and rejects it.
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan wanta gati-jabeessaa fi gaarii ta'e addaan baasee hin beeku; waan gaarii kennameefiyyuu tuffata.
Meaning_EN: A fool cannot distinguish prime quality from worthless matter; he will reject the finest offering believing it is inferior.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama waan gaarii fi kabajaa isaaf godhame hin hubatin tuffatee mormu ibsuuf fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone fails to appreciate high value or generosity and complains out of pure ignorance.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, cooma, waaduu, moora, diduu, tuffii
Keywords_EN: fool, prime fat, roast, tallow, rejection, ingratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen qalbii hin qabne, hiraata goftaa kajeelti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog lacking sense/discernment covets its master's dinner.
Meaning_AO: Namni sadarkaa fi dandeettii isaa hin beekne waan isaaf hin malle ykn kan isa caalu argachuuf kajeela.
Meaning_EN: A senseless person oversteps their boundaries, shamelessly coveting what is reserved for their superiors.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni daangaa isaa dabree waan humnaa fi sadarkaa isaatiin ol ta'e kajeelu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who covets things far above their station or entitlement.
Keywords_AO: saree, qalbii, hiraata, goftaa, kajeellaa
Keywords_EN: dog, senseless, dinner, master, coveting, boundaries

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan manaa gowwaan, eelee caphxetti kofla.
Translation_Literal_EN: The foolish husband laughs when the baking griddle breaks.
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan miidhaa fi balaa maatii isaarratti ga'e hin hubatu; badii ofiirratti qaqqabe akkuma waan nama biraatti kolfata.
Meaning_EN: A foolish head of household laughs when disaster strikes his own home, blind to the fact that the loss is his own.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni badii mana isaa ykn qaama isaa miidhe utuu hin gaddin salphisee kolfu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who is foolishly amused by an accident or damage that directly undermines their own household.
Keywords_AO: abbaa manaa, gowwaa, eelee, caphuu, kofla
Keywords_EN: husband, fool, baking pan, griddle, breaking, laughing

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa fi sareen, nama kaafatan nama jalaa hin hafani.
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool and a dog, once they latch onto a person, never let them go.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan fi sareen yeroo nama hordofuu jalqaban addaan cituu hin beekani; nama nuffisiisanii hordofu.
Meaning_EN: A fool and a stray dog are alike: once encouraged or provoked, they cling relentlessly and become an unshakeable nuisance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota gowwaa ofitti madaqsuun ykn jajjabeessuun rakkina fidu akeekkachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a warning against engaging or encouraging fools, lest they attach themselves permanently to you.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, saree, nama kaafachuu, hordofuu, nuffisiisuu
Keywords_EN: fool, dog, latching on, clingy, nuisance, pestering

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo faaxee teenyaatii, walleen tanuma gaafa isiin gurra qabduuti.
Translation_Literal_EN: If it is about our Faaxe [she-goat/cow], the song is the very same one from when she had ears.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko yeroo dheeraaf jijjiirama malee bifa tokkoon irra deddeebi'amee faarfamu ykn dubbatamu; haalli isaa duraan beekamaadha.
Meaning_EN: The same old tired tale or excuse is endlessly repeated without any change; nothing new is being offered.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo oduu ykn dhimmi durii tokko jijjiirama malee irra deddeebi'amee nama nuffisiisu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone brings up the same obsolete excuse or repetitive story that everyone already knows by heart.
Keywords_AO: faaxee, wallee, gurra, irra-deddeebii, nuffii
Keywords_EN: Faaxe, song, ear, repetition, monotony, old story

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama mataa hin qabne, gurraatu dhadhaabbata.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who has no head wears ornaments on his ears.
Meaning_AO: Namni bu'uura ykn sammuu hin qabne wantoota alaa fi faaya qofaan of mul'isuuf tattaafata.
Meaning_EN: A brainless person with no substance focuses on superficial ornaments and outward appearances rather than genuine intellect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni beekumsa fi sammuu qabaachuu dhiisee uffataa fi miidhagina alaa qofaan of tuulu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose someone lacking intellect and character who relies purely on showy accessories and vanity.
Keywords_AO: mataa, gurra, dhadhaabbachuu, faaya, sammuu dhabuu
Keywords_EN: head, ear, adornment, earrings, superficial, brainless

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa qabrii hin agarsiisani, mana je'eeti itti didaa
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not show a grave to a fool; he calls it a house and refuses to leave
Meaning_AO: Nama hubannoo hin qabne wanta qorumsa qabu, daangaa qabu ykn iddoo eeggannoo barbaadu agarsiisuun balaadha; inni akkuma gowwaa qabrii argee 'kunoo manaa' jedhee keessaa bahuu dideetti, wanta sana dogoggoraan hubatee gadhiisuu dida
Meaning_EN: Never introduce an undiscerning fool to a sacred, private, or hazardous place, for he will misinterpret its purpose, make himself at home, and stubbornly refuse to leave; fools misunderstand serious boundaries and cling to them inappropriately
Theme_EN: Fools Misjudging Boundaries and Refusing to Depart
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dammaqina hin qabne tokko dhimma ykn bakka isaaf hin malle seensifamee ergasii keessaa bahuu ykn dhiisuu didee nama rakkisu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against exposing simpletons to sensitive matters or locations, warning that they will misread the situation, dig in their heels, and refuse to step away
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; qabrii; mana; itti diduu; agarsiisuu; qishnaa; daangaa
Keywords_EN: fool; grave; house; refusing to leave; misunderstanding; boundaries; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaadii gowwaan hidhan, hidhii isaa irraa baqayfatani
Translation_Literal_EN: The tether with which a fool is bound is sliced straight from his own lips
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan ofuma isaatii afaan baasee waan dubbatuun kiyyoo keessa of galcha; nama gowwaa qabuuf ykn kuffisuuf meeshaa alaa barbaaduun hin barbaachisu, jechaa fi arrabuma isaatiin kiyyoo ofii tolfata
Meaning_EN: The rope used to bind a fool is stripped right from his own lips; a foolish person incriminates and entraps himself entirely through his own loose, indiscreet words. You need no outside snare to defeat a fool—his own mouth provides all the cord needed to tie him up
Theme_EN: Self-Incrimination and the Traps of Loose Lips
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gowwaan tokko afaan isaa eeggachuu dadhabee ofuma isaatii jecha isaatiin kiyyoo seeraa ykn salphina keessa of galchu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an indiscreet person incriminates or exposes himself through his own careless talk, effectively handing opponents the rope for his own undoing
Keywords_AO: gaadii; gowwaa; hidhuu; hidhii; baqayfachuu; afaan; of-saaxiluu; kiyyoo
Keywords_EN: tether; fool; binding; lips; slicing; self-incrimination; loose tongue; trap

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwatti mana hin cufani, meesha(mi'a) caccabsa.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not lock a house upon a fool; he breaks all the utensils/belongings.
Meaning_AO: Nama itti gaafatamummaa hin qabne qofaa isaa dhiisanii ykn dhimma guddaa irratti hin dhiisan; waan hundumaa mancaasa.
Meaning_EN: Never leave an irresponsible fool unattended in charge of valuable property, for he will break and destroy everything.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qabeenya ykn mana nama gowwaa fi dantaa hin qabneetti dhiisanii deemuu dhowwan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against entrusting an irresponsible person with domestic affairs or valuable assets.
Keywords_AO: gowwatti, mana cufuu, meeshaa, mi'a, caccabsuu
Keywords_EN: fool, lock house, household items, breaking, destruction

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan yoo ija guddinaatiin ilaalan, kani sodaatani itti fakkaata.
Translation_Literal_EN: If you look upon a fool with magnanimous/respectful eyes, he assumes you are afraid of him.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaaf yoo kabajaa fi obsa guddaa agarsiifte, akka waan sodaa qabdutti hubatee of tuula.
Meaning_EN: If you treat a fool with patience and courteous restraint, he misinterprets your gentleness as fear and becomes arrogant.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo obsa fi kabajaa namoota gowwaaf kennan akka sodaa fi laafinaatti hiikamu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind leaders and polite people that fools mistake benevolence and respectful restraint for cowardice.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, ija guddinaa, ilaaluu, sodaachuu, of tuuluu
Keywords_EN: fool, magnanimity, respect, fear, arrogance, misconception

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa fi hoolaan, deebii hin qabani.
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool and a sheep have no reply/response.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaanii fi hoolaan waan itti dubbataniif deebii quubsaa fi yaada qajeelaa hin qaban; dubbii isaaniirraa deebii eeguun gatii hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: A fool and a sheep offer no meaningful answer; trying to reason with an unintelligent person is as futile as expecting a reply from livestock.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hubannaa dhabuudhaan deebii sirrii kennuu dadhabu ykn mormuun faayidaa hin qabaanne ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when dealing with someone who cannot comprehend basic logic or give a coherent answer.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, hoolaa, deebii, dubbii, hubannaa
Keywords_EN: fool, sheep, response, reply, senseless, futility

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwittiin haadha dhiirsaa dhiiftee, haadha kanniisaatiin bultee jette.
Translation_Literal_EN: The foolish bride neglected her mother-in-law and greeted the queen bee: 'Good morning.'
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan nama kabajuu qabuu fi dhimma isaaf murteessaa ta'e dhiisee, waan gatii hin qabnee fi orma ta'e faana fiiga.
Meaning_EN: A foolish woman neglects the person she owes the most honor and respect (her mother-in-law), prioritizing irrelevant outsiders instead.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma ykn nama isaaf dursa kennamuu qabu dhiisee waan biraa duukaa bu'u qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize someone whose priorities are inverted, slighting important relatives while fawning over strangers.
Keywords_AO: gowwittii, haadha dhiirsaa, haadha kanniisaa, bultee, kabaja
Keywords_EN: foolish woman, mother-in-law, queen bee, morning greeting, misplaced honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan ifii koflee, nama kofalchiisa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool laughs by himself, then makes others laugh [at him].
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan bakka kolfi hin malletti ofumaa kolfuun nama isa ilaalu kofalchiisa; kolfi namaas isa faana utuu hin ta'in isarratti.
Meaning_EN: A fool laughs at inappropriate moments, prompting onlookers to laugh not with him, but at his absurdity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni bakka hin taanetti kolfuudhaan of salphisee namoota biraatti qoosaa ta'u.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone's mindless giggling or inappropriate behavior exposes them to public amusement and mockery.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, kofla, kofalchiisuu, ofii, salphina
Keywords_EN: fool, laughing, ridicule, inappropriate humor, mockery

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan, gaafa cidha ofiiti quufa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool gets his fill [eats to satisfaction] on his own wedding day.
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan carraa fi waan gaarii harka isaa jiru kan hubatu ykn kan itti fayyadamu gaafa waan hundi isa jalaa darbe ykn yeroo hin taanetti.
Meaning_EN: A fool is so thoughtless that he only manages to eat heartily when it is his own wedding, rather than managing his daily welfare properly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni jireenya idilee keessatti of hin qopheessine gaafa ayyaanaa fi dhimma addaa qofa guuttatu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule someone who lives improvidently and only feasts when external ceremony forces plenty upon him.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, cidha, quufuu, jireenya, karoora dhabuu
Keywords_EN: fool, wedding, satisfaction, feasting, improvidence, planning

Mammaaksa_AO: Lallaba gowwaa, firaatu itti qaanfata.
Translation_Literal_EN: At the fool's loud shouting/boasting, it is his kin who feel ashamed.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan waan fokkisaa fi qaanii hin qabne dubbatee lallaba; miidhaa fi qaaniin isaa garuu maatii fi firoottan isaa irratti kufa.
Meaning_EN: A fool shouts his nonsense brazenly without shame, while his family and relatives bear the embarrassment and disgrace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo jechi ykn gochi nama tokkoo firoottan isaa akka qaanfatan godhu dubbatamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a foolish family member's indiscreet or boastful shouting embarrasses their entire family.
Keywords_AO: lallaba, gowwaa, fira, qaanfii, qaanii
Keywords_EN: fool, shouting, proclamation, kin, shame, embarrassment

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan ofii jedhee, udaan ulate.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'It is my own,' he said, and smelled his own excrement.
Meaning_AO: Wanti kan ofii ta'e hundi gaarii akka hin taane hubachuu dhabuu; balleessaa fi xuraa'ummaa ofii sababa 'kan kooti' jedhuun faarsuu qeeqa.
Meaning_EN: Blindly defending or cherishing something repulsive merely because it belongs to oneself; irrational pride in one's own defects.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni balleessaa ykn amala fokkisaa ofii sababa kan kooti jedhuuf qofa faarsu ykn dhiifama itti kennu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to censure absurd nepotism or someone defending their own gross misdeeds simply out of blind ego.
Keywords_AO: waan ofii, udaan, ulafachuu, gowwummaa, of-jaallachuu
Keywords_EN: own, feces, smelling, self-delusion, gross partiality, ego

Mammaaksa_AO: Dukkanti gara gowwaati galti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Darkness settles upon the fool's side/quarter.
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan ykn dantaa hin qabne qophii yeroo malee waan hafuuf, rakkoon, dhiphinnii fi gadadoon yeroo hunda isa qunnama.
Meaning_EN: Darkness and misfortune always overtake the unprepared fool, who fails to plan ahead before night falls.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni osoo yeroon jiru hin qophoofne gaafa rakkon dhufe itti dukkanawu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that negligence and lack of foresight inevitably invite distress and trouble upon the foolish.
Keywords_AO: dukkana, gara, gowwaa, galuu, qophii dhabuu
Keywords_EN: darkness, fool, nightfall, unpreparedness, misfortune

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo himinaa nutti hin hafnee, warri gowwaa dhale hin rafne.
Translation_Literal_EN: If telling them achieves nothing, those who gave birth to a fool never sleep.
Meaning_AO: Nama gowwaa gorsanii jijjiiruun akka hin danda'amnee fi maatiin ilma akkasii qabu yeroo hundumaa yaaddoo fi hirriiba dhabuu keessa akka jiraatan ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Since advice never deters a fool, the parents who bore him are doomed to perpetual anxiety and sleepless nights.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gowwaan gorsa diduun maatii fi namoota isa jaallatanitti yaaddoo ta'uu isaa dubbatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when describing the endless worry and grief brought upon loved ones by an obstinate, foolish child.
Keywords_AO: himina, warra, gowwaa, dhaluu, rafuu, yaaddoo
Keywords_EN: advice, parents, birth, fool, sleeplessness, grief

Mammaaksa_AO: Na hin argani jetteeti, haadha ofii kabalti.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Nobody sees me,' she said, and slapped her own mother.
Meaning_AO: Namni badii dhoksaatti raawwadha jedhee yaadu bu'uura amala badaa fi gowwummaa isaatiin badii hunda caalu ofirratti dalaga.
Meaning_EN: Deluded by secrecy, a fool commits the most heinous sacrilege, unaware that moral destruction cannot be hidden.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni nama biraan hin argu se'ee wanta safuu hin qabnee fi maatii miidhu raawwatu balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn someone who commits appalling wrongs behind closed doors under the foolish illusion of concealment.
Keywords_AO: arguudha, haadha, kabaluu, dhoksaa, safuu
Keywords_EN: unseen, mother, slapping, sacrilege, delusion, moral breach

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama dheeraa, ayliin miila jala kutti.
Translation_Literal_EN: For a tall person, intelligence falls short beneath the feet.
Meaning_AO: Dheerina qaamaa qabaachuun beekumsaa fi qalbii qabaachuu wajjin wal hin simatu; namni qaamaan dheeraan sammuun hir'achuu mala.
Meaning_EN: Physical height does not equate to wisdom; a person may be imposing in stature yet deficient in intellect and good sense.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dheerinni qaamaa qabu garuu hubannaan isaa xiqqoo ta'e kolfisiisuun ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously to tease a tall individual whose wit and foresight do not match their towering height.
Keywords_AO: nama dheeraa, aylii, miila, kutuu, sammuu
Keywords_EN: tall person, intellect, wisdom, feet, shortness, wit

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama dheeraa, takkaa beekkomsaa hanqataa, takkaa huccuu hanqata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A tall person either falls short of wisdom, or falls short of cloth [clothing].
Meaning_AO: Namni dheeraan yeroo tokko hubannaan isaa hir'ata, yoo beekumsa qabaate immoo uffanni qaama isaa gahu rakkisa; guutuu ta'uun hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: A tall person is said to lack either wisdom in his head or enough cloth to fit his frame; flawlessness is hard to find.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota dheeroo qoosaan qeeqanii fi hir'ina jireenyaa ibsanitti fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as lighthearted banter to poke fun at tall people regarding either their clothes or their practical judgment.
Keywords_AO: nama dheeraa, beekumsa, huccuu, hanqachuu, hir'ina
Keywords_EN: tall person, wisdom, clothing, deficiency, humor

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan bishila eeggatee, qabbana eeggachuu dadhabe.
Translation_Literal_EN: The fool waited for the food to cook, but failed to wait for it to cool down.
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan wanta dheeraaf itti dhama'e daqiiqaa dhumaatti obsa dhabuudhaan gubatee of miidha; obsa dhabuutu hojii mancaasa.
Meaning_EN: A fool endures the long wait while food is boiling, yet ruins everything at the last minute because he lacks the patience to let it cool.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni bu'aa hojii isaa argachuuf gahu obsa dhabee wanta hunda balleessu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against ruining long-term efforts through rash impatience at the critical final stage.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, bishila, eeggachuu, qabbana, obsa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: fool, cooked food, boiling, cooling, impatience, rashness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii guddinaa hin guddatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not compete in speech just to make it big.
Meaning_AO: Dubbii baay'isuun ykn dubbii irratti dubbii fe'uun faayidaa hin qabu; dubbiin gabaabinaan fi iccitiin dubbatamuu qaba.
Meaning_EN: One should not exaggerate speech or speak excessively just to dominate an argument; moderation in talk is wisdom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni dubbii dhiisanii wal dorgoman ykn dubbii dhedheereessan gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to advise against unnecessarily prolonging disputes or exaggerating arguments.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, guddina, guddate, haasawa
Keywords_EN: word, speech, exaggeration, argument

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan dubbii bare utubatti haasawa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mouth accustomed to talking speaks even to a pillar.
Meaning_AO: Namni baay'ee haasa'uufi oduu bare, nama dhabullee waanuma argatetti haasa'uu hin dhiisu; amala afaan qaqallaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: A talkative or gossipy person cannot remain silent and will talk to inanimate objects if there is no one around to listen.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama afaan dhaabuu hin dandeenyeefi oduu baay'isu qeeqan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock or criticize someone who talks endlessly and cannot keep quiet.
Keywords_AO: afaan, dubbii, baruu, utubaa, haasawuu
Keywords_EN: mouth, accustomed, pillar, chatter, loquacity

Mammaaksa_AO: Bagaan jedhee irra, bagaan hin jedhiniitu caala.
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than 'I am glad I said it', 'I am glad I didn't say it' is better.
Meaning_AO: Dubbachuurra callisuutu gaabbii irraa nama oolcha; waan dubbatan gaabbuu mannaa callisanii darbuutu filatamaadha.
Meaning_EN: Regretting remaining silent is far better than regretting spoken words; restraining one's tongue avoids remorse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama afaan isaa to'atee callisuu akka qabuufi akka hin gaabbine akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to caution someone to weigh their words carefully and choose silence to avoid future regret.
Keywords_AO: bagaan, dubbii, callisa, gaabbii
Keywords_EN: speak, silence, regret, restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamtuu nu haasoysiiftee, arraba nu hin muriniin tan ifirra kadhatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Do not make us speak evil and then cut our tongue', is what one prays for oneself.
Meaning_AO: Wanta badii fi mufannaa fidu akka hin dubbanne Waaqa kadhachuu; dogoggora arrabaa irraa of eeguu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: One must pray to be saved from speaking hurtful words that bring punishment, disgrace, or retribution upon oneself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni arraba isaatiin balaatti akka hin buune of eeggannoo cimaa gochuu qabu yaadachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when praying or warning against reckless utterances that invite trouble or retribution.
Keywords_AO: hamtuu, haasofsiisuu, arraba, muruu, kadhachuu
Keywords_EN: evil, speak, tongue, punishment, prayer

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin guddatteef, harretti hin fe'ani.
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because a matter has grown big, it cannot be loaded onto a donkey.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin wanta qabatamaa harkaan baatan miti; furmaata kan argatus humnaan osoo hin taane mariifi sammuudhaani.
Meaning_EN: Verbal disputes or serious issues cannot be resolved by physical force or treated like material loads; they require intellect and dialogue.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbii cimaa fi dhimma ulfaataa karaa nagayaatiin mariidhaan furuun barbaachisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to remind disputants that verbal and social conflicts require mental tact and deliberation rather than brute force.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, guddachuu, harree, fe'uu
Keywords_EN: matter, dispute, donkey, wisdom, dialogue

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii boolla hin guuttatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not fill a pit with mere words.
Meaning_AO: Haasa'uun qofti rakkoo hin furu; hojii qabatamaatu barbaachisa malee afaaniin wanti godhamu hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Empty talk and endless discussion cannot solve tangible problems; practical action is required.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni hojii dhiisanii afaan qofaan dhimma furuu barbaadan itti himan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to stop debating endlessly and start taking concrete action to fix an issue.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, boolla, guuttachuu, hojii
Keywords_EN: words, pit, fill, action, pragmatism

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin shinbirroo nama afaanii baati.
Translation_Literal_EN: A word is like a bird that flies out of a person's mouth.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin takkaa afaan keessaa baanaan hin deebitu; akka shinbirroo barrifteeti waan ta'eef of eeggannoon dubbachuu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Once a word leaves your mouth, it takes flight like a bird and can never be retrieved; hence one must speak cautiously.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama osoo hin yaadin dubbatu akka dubbiin deebi'uu hin dandeenye akeekkachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to warn someone to think carefully before speaking, because spoken words can never be taken back.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, shinbirroo, afaan, ba'uu
Keywords_EN: word, bird, mouth, flight, irreversible

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma hancufa tufan dubbii daddarban.
Translation_Literal_EN: One casts words in the brief span of spitting saliva.
Meaning_AO: Dubbii gabaabduu fi ifa taate yeroodhaan dubbatanii dhimma murteessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Speech should be concise, punctual, and delivered with measured timing rather than dragging on uselessly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo yaada ofii ifaa fi gabaabinaan yeroodhaan dhiheessuu barbaachisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage speaking briefly, directly, and in a timely manner during meetings or councils.
Keywords_AO: hancufa, tufuu, dubbii, daddarbuu
Keywords_EN: saliva, spit, words, brevity, directness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin meeshaa dhaa, bakkuma rabbi kaaye jirti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Words are tools; they exist right where God placed them.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin hundi yeroofi bakka mataa isaa qaba; waan hundumaafuu wanti Waaqayyo murteesse jira.
Meaning_EN: Truth and spoken matters have their proper place and divine destiny; whatever is meant to be revealed will come to pass.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbii ykn dhimma tokko bakka isaatiin ala jijjiiruun akka hin danda'amne ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that truth and destiny have their established place and will prevail in their proper time.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, meeshaa, Rabbii, bakka
Keywords_EN: speech, tool, divine, truth, destiny

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni beekaan, yoo si dura dubbate dubbii si duraa fixa, yoo si booda dubbate dubbii si duraa ballessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wise person, if he speaks before you finishes the matter, and if he speaks after you dismantles your argument.
Meaning_AO: Beekaan dubbii sirriitti beeka; yoo dursitee isa dhaggeeffatte furmaata argatta, yoo isa dura sobde immoo dogoggora kee saaxila.
Meaning_EN: An articulate wise person covers everything if he speaks first, and exposes all flaws if he speaks after you; one should respect true intellect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo beekumsaafi dandeettii dubbii nama hubataa tokkoo dinqisiifatan ykn of eeggannoo beekaa biratti godhamu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight the superior eloquence of an intelligent person who can either resolve an issue or thoroughly dismantle weak arguments.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, dubbachuu, fixuu, balleessuu
Keywords_EN: wise, articulate, dismantle, resolve, eloquence

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaa biratti dubbii guddisuun, wallaalummaa ifii mul'isuu dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Enlarging speech in front of a wise person is displaying one's own ignorance.
Meaning_AO: Nama beekaa fi hubataa duratti haasaa baay'isuun doofummaa ofii saaxila malee beekumsa namaaf hin tahu.
Meaning_EN: Talking excessively in the presence of someone truly knowledgeable only exposes one's own ignorance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama beekaa duratti waan hunda beeka of se'ee lallabu gorsan ykn qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to admonish someone who boasts or talks too much in the company of respected experts or elders.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, dubbii, guddisuu, wallaalummaa
Keywords_EN: wise, boast, ignorance, etiquette, modesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Himanii hin fixanii, birumaa lixani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One cannot finish recounting everything; one simply moves past it.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin ykn dhimmi addunyaa dubbatamee hin dhumu; bakka murtaa'etti dhaabanii dhiisuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: There is no end to grievances, news, or complaints; at some point, one must let them go and move on.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbiin dheeratee hin dhumne tokko hafuun isaa akka wayyu murteessan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when terminating an endless debate or storytelling session, acknowledging that not everything needs to be said.
Keywords_AO: himuu, fixuu, lixuu, dubbii
Keywords_EN: speak, finish, move on, boundary

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabbinni arrabaa, ilkee jidduu seenuu dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: The fattening of the tongue is getting caught between the teeth.
Meaning_AO: Arrabi yoo of wallaalee baay'ee socho'e ni ciniinama; nama afaan qaqallaa balaatu isa eeggata.
Meaning_EN: A loose or overly proud tongue inevitably gets bitten by the teeth; reckless talk brings suffering upon the speaker.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama afaan isaa to'achuu dadhabee ofii isaatiif balaa fidu akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn an indiscreet or arrogant person that reckless chatter will eventually harm them.
Keywords_AO: gabbina, arraba, ilkee, ciniinamuu
Keywords_EN: fat, tongue, teeth, bite, reprimand

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbannaan dubbii tahe, hooqqannaan cittoo tahe.
Translation_Literal_EN: Upon speaking it became a dispute, upon scratching it became scabies.
Meaning_AO: Wanta xiqqoo kaasanii irratti dubbachuun dhimma guddaa fi lola fida; akkuma xannacha xiqqoo hooqqatanii balleessan.
Meaning_EN: Minor matters escalate into major conflicts when constantly argued over, just as gentle scratching turns an itch into a severe wound.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimma salphaa irratti waldhabanii gara lolatti ce'an akeekkachiisuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a small, insignificant dispute gets blown out of proportion through relentless argumentation.
Keywords_AO: dubbachuu, dubbii, hooqqachuu, cittoo
Keywords_EN: speaking, dispute, scratch, scabies, escalation

Mammaaksa_AO: Anaatu hafeef dubbatta moo dubbiitu hafeef dubbatta?
Translation_Literal_EN: Do you speak because I am left, or do you speak because speech remains?
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin dubbatamuu qabu dhumee osoo jiruu, na arrabsuu ykn na faana loluu qofaaf haasofta moo dhuguma dhimmatu jira?
Meaning_EN: Are you talking because there is an actual point left to discuss, or are you just targeting me personally to argue?
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma qabatamaa dhiisee nama irratti dubbii barbaadu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to challenge someone who engages in personal attacks rather than sticking to the substantive subject of discussion.
Keywords_AO: ana, dubbii, hafuu, dubbachuu
Keywords_EN: me, speech, remaining, pointless, quarrel

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin saara buqqeeti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Speech is like the spreading vine of a pumpkin.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin akkuma rifeensa ykn saara buqqee kutee kutee hin dhumu, baay'ee fagaatee faca'a.
Meaning_EN: Words and rumors spread continuously and branch out endlessly, just like the spreading runners of a pumpkin vine.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbiin tokko bakkaa bakkatti babal'atee bal'inaan tamsaa'u ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to illustrate how rumors and idle gossip easily spread far and wide beyond control.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, saara, buqqee, babal'achuu
Keywords_EN: speech, vine, gourd, rumors, spreading

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin hundee manaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: Speech is the foundation of a household.
Meaning_AO: Haasawa gaariifi marii qajeelaatu maatiifi biyya ijaara; waldhabdeen hundis dubbiidhaan sirreeffama.
Meaning_EN: Proper communication, truthful speech, and wise counsel are the very bedrock that keeps families and communities united.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbii fi marii qajeelaan bu'uura jireenya hawaasaa ta'uu hubachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that healthy dialogue and mutual understanding form the pillar of any lasting household or institution.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, hundee, mana, ijaarsa
Keywords_EN: speech, foundation, home, dialogue, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbataan, qullaa haadha isaati hima.
Translation_Literal_EN: A loose talker reveals his own mother's nakedness.
Meaning_AO: Namni arraba hin qabne iccitii guddaa fi salphina maatii isaa illee osoo hin dhowwatin baasee hima.
Meaning_EN: A person lacking discretion and self-control in speech will shamelessly expose the most intimate and shameful family secrets.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni iccitii ofii fi kan maatii isaa alatti baasee odeessu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to condemn someone with zero filter or discretion who recklessly leaks private or scandalous personal secrets.
Keywords_AO: dubbataa, qullaa, haadha, himuu, iccitii
Keywords_EN: talker, nakedness, mother, secret, indiscretion

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurrinuu dhagayee, afaan maaliif lallaba?
Translation_Literal_EN: Even the ear has heard it, so why does the mouth scream?
Meaning_AO: Wanta ifatti beekamuufi gurri dhaga'e waantee lallabanii dhimma guddaa fakkeessuun hin barbaachisu.
Meaning_EN: When something has already been clearly heard and acknowledged, there is no need to shout or be dramatic about it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta salphaatti hubatamu irratti afaan dhedheereessuufi lallabu dhaabsifamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to calm down someone shouting or overreacting to information that everyone has already understood.
Keywords_AO: gurra, dhaga'uu, afaan, lallabuu
