Keywords_EN: ear, hear, mouth, shout, calm

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmarra, dubbiitu abbaa fakkaata.
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than the son, it is speech that resembles the father.
Meaning_AO: Amalliifi ilaalchi nama tokkoo bifa isaarrayyuu caalaa jechaafi dubbii isaatiin mul'ata; akkaataan haasawaa eenyummaa namaa saaxila.
Meaning_EN: A person's true character and heritage are revealed far more through their words and principles than through mere physical resemblance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haasofni nama tokkoo amala ykn dhaloota isaatii wajjin wal fakkaatu dinqisiifatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a person's eloquent speech or conduct mirrors the wisdom or distinctive mannerisms of their family background.
Keywords_AO: ilma, dubbii, abbaa, fakkaachuu
Keywords_EN: son, speech, father, resemble, identity

Mammaaksa_AO: Coomni foonii qalma keessaa mul'ata, coomni dubbii haasawa keessaa mul'ata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The fatness of meat appears at slaughter, the richness of speech appears in conversation.
Meaning_AO: Mi'aaniifi qulqullinni dubbii tokkoo yeroo haasa'an mul'ata; akkuma foon coomaa yeroo qalmaatti beekamu.
Meaning_EN: Just as the richness and quality of meat are revealed during butchering, the depth, wit, and wisdom of words shine through natural dialogue.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haasawa mi'aawaa, sirrii fi ogummaan guutame dinqisiifatan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise a well-delivered, wise, and enriching speech or dialogue in a formal or informal setting.
Keywords_AO: cooma, foon, qalma, dubbii, haasawa
Keywords_EN: fat, meat, slaughter, speech, eloquence

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dubbii guddatu, afaan qaban cinaan dubbata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person possessed by excessive talk speaks from the side even when their mouth is held shut.
Meaning_AO: Namni arraba to'achuu hin dandeenye waan hundumaa keessa seenee dubbachuuf qorqalbii dhabuu isaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Someone who is hopelessly addicted to arguing or speaking will find any crack or side angle to insert their commentary, even when told to keep quiet.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dubbii dhiisi jedhanii diduun haasawuuf dhama'u ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to describe an inveterate meddler or talker who insists on having the last word even after being silenced.
Keywords_AO: nama, dubbii, afaan, cinaa, dubbachuu
Keywords_EN: talkative, mouth, side, compulsion, argue

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dubbii guddatu, ciniimmuu haadhaa hima.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person whose speech exceeds all bounds recounts his mother's labor pains.
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta dubbatu hin beekne wanta dubbatamuu hin malle hunda dubbatee of salphisa.
Meaning_EN: A person devoid of boundaries in conversation will shamelessly disclose sacred or taboo matters, like the intimacy of maternal labor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni daangaa safuu fi naamusaa cabsee waan safuu ta'e dubbatu balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to strongly condemn a person who transgresses cultural taboos and decency by talking about inappropriate topics.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, guddachuu, ciniimmuu, haadha, safuu
Keywords_EN: speech, boundary, labor pains, mother, taboo

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan muka alaati, haati utubaa manaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: The father is the tree outside, the mother is the pillar of the house.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan gaaddisaafi dahoo maatii kan alaa yoo ta'u, haati immoo utubaa fi bu'uura maatiiti; ga'ee abbaafi haadhaa ibsa.
Meaning_EN: The father provides external protection and shelter, while the mother is the central pillar supporting internal harmony and domestic life.
Category_AO: Maatii fi Ga'ee Haadhaa fi Abbaa
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ga'ee fi ulfina abbaafi haadha maatii keessatti qaban ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to describe the complementary roles and indispensable importance of both father and mother in running a home.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, muka, alaa, haadha, utubaa, mana
Keywords_EN: father, tree, mother, pillar, family, household

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati hamtuu hin qabdu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother has no evil.
Meaning_AO: Haati yoomiyyuu ijoollee isheef gaariifi jaalala qofa qabdi; haati ijoollee ofiitiif hammeenya hin hawwitu.
Meaning_EN: A mother's intentions for her offspring are purely loving and benevolent; a mother bears no malice towards her children.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo jaalala fi gaarummaa haadha ofiitiif qaban ibsuufi kabajuu barbaadan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express reverence and appreciation for the unconditionally loving nature of mothers.
Keywords_AO: haadha, hamtuu, jaalala, ijoollee
Keywords_EN: mother, evil, pure, love, children

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadhaa fi bishaan hamtuu hin qabani.
Translation_Literal_EN: Mothers and water have no evil.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma bishaan jireenyaaf murteessaa ta'ee fi nama hin miine, haatis jireenyaaf bu'uura, jaalalli ishees qulqulluudha.
Meaning_EN: Just as water is pure and essential for sustaining life, a mother's presence and care are fundamentally benevolent and indispensable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gatii guddaa haati fi wantoonni bu'uura jireenyaa qaban dinqisiifatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm the sacred and life-giving importance of mothers alongside basic natural elements like water.
Keywords_AO: haadha, bishaan, hamtuu, qulqullina
Keywords_EN: mother, water, life, essential, purity

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati namaa gaariin, haadha namaa hin taane, haati ofii hamtuun duutu namaa hin kaane.
Translation_Literal_EN: Another person's good mother does not become one's own mother; one's own mother, even if stern, will not rise for you once dead.
Meaning_AO: Haadha ofii qaban kunuunsuu fi jaallachuun barbaachisaadha; nama biraa kamiyyuu bakka haadha ofii bu'uu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: No other woman, however kind, can replace your biological mother; cherish your own mother because once lost, she is gone forever.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama haadha ofiitti dallanu ykn mufatu akka haadha ofii kabaju gorsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise people to honor and tolerate their own mothers, emphasizing that a mother's place is completely irreplaceable.
Keywords_AO: haadha, gaarii, hamtuu, du'a, ofii
Keywords_EN: mother, stepmother, own mother, irreplaceable, death

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati harma guufti malee, harka hin guuftu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother may hold back the breast, but she never withholds her helping hand.
Meaning_AO: Haati yeroo ijoolleen guddatan harma hoosisuu dhaabduus, gargaarsaafi kunuunsa ishee hamma dhumaatti ijoollee isheerraa hin kutu.
Meaning_EN: A mother may eventually wean her child off milk, but she never stops providing lifelong guidance, support, and care.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo deggersaafi jaalalli haadhaa daangaa akka hin qabne ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to express how a mother's nurturing assistance and compassion endure throughout one's entire life.
Keywords_AO: haadha, harma, harka, guufuu, gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: mother, breast, hand, withhold, care, support

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadha guutee mannaa, haadha duute wayya.
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than a mother whose milk has dried up, a mother who has died is better
Meaning_AO: Daa'imaaf haati yoo duute ormi yeruma sana birmatee madda aannanii yookaan haadha hoosiftu barbaadaaf; garuu haati yoo guutte (harmi goge), ormi waan haati jirtuuf quba hin qabu, daa'imnis harma gogaatti marfatee osoo hin beekamin beelaan miidhama. Akkasumas, madda ifatti dhabame caalaa waan jira fakkaatee bu'aa hin qabnetti hirkachuun balaadha.
Meaning_EN: When a nursing mother dies, the crisis is visible, so the community immediately steps in to find a wet nurse, milk, and foster care to save the infant. But when a mother's milk dries up, outsiders assume the child is fed and do not intervene, leaving the baby to quietly starve at a dry breast. Metaphorically, an open, total absence is better than relying on a hollow source that appears present but yields no sustenance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko madda duraanuu dhumate ykn nama bu'aa hin qabne irratti hirkatee, ormi akka waan inni homaa hin dhabnetti dhiisee inni garuu keessaan beela'u ibsuuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone is trapped relying on an empty, dried-up provider that gives nothing yet gives the outside world the false impression that they are cared for, denying them real help.
Keywords_AO: haadha; guutee; gu'uu; duute; harma gogu; aannan; daa'ima; gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: mother; dried-up milk; weaned; lactation; dry breast; infant; hidden starvation; false security

Mammaaksa_AO: Gadaamessi haadhaa, saara buqqeeti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother's womb is like pumpkin vines.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma saarri buqqee buqqee bifaafi gosa adda addaa godhatu, gadaamessi haadhaas ijoollee amalaafi bifa garaagaraa qaban dhalcha.
Meaning_EN: Just as pumpkin vines produce diverse gourds from the same root, a single mother gives birth to children with vastly different characters.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ilmaan haadha tokkoo amalaan wal dhaban ykn wal fakkaachuu didan ibsuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when noting stark differences in temperament, ethics, or appearance among biological siblings.
Keywords_AO: gadaamessa, haadha, saara, buqqee, ijoollee
Keywords_EN: womb, mother, pumpkin vine, diversity, siblings

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni haati tiyya fokkattuu dha ja'u hin jiru.
Translation_Literal_EN: There is no one who says 'My mother is ugly.'
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiyyuu haadha ofiitiif jaalalaafi kabaja guddaa qaba; wanti kan ofii yoomiyyuu mi'aawaafi bareedaadha.
Meaning_EN: Every child perceives their own mother as beautiful and precious; one's own kin and origin are universally cherished without criticism.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni kamiyyuu waan qabuufi maatii ofiitiif dhimmu ykn itti boonu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to illustrate that everyone defends and values their own mother, roots, and identity regardless of outside judgment.
Keywords_AO: nama, haadha, fokkattuu, jaalala, kabaja
Keywords_EN: person, mother, ugly, love, honor, pride

Mammaaksa_AO: Yemmuu ilma cidhaan diimatu, haadha ijaatu diimata.
Translation_Literal_EN: When the son's testicles become inflamed with pain, the mother's eyes turn red with tears.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo daa'imni ykn ilmi dhiiraa dhibee, dhukkubbii ykn dhiitoo cidhaaniitiin (cidhaan diimatee) waraanamu, haati dhukkubbii isaa danda'uu dadhabdee mararfannaa fi boo'icha cimaadhaan iji ishee diimata. Dhukkubbiin ilmaa haadhaaf waraansa qalbii fi imimmaan walirraa hin cinne ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: When a young boy suffers agonizing pain, swelling, or acute inflammation of the testicles, his mother weeps so uncontrollably in shared anguish that her own eyes turn bloodshot red. It expresses the depth of visceral maternal empathy: when a child hurts in the most sensitive place, the mother's eyes and heart bear the pain.
Theme_EN: Visceral Maternal Empathy and Shared Pain
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiphinni fi dhukkubbiin daa'imaa haadha akkamitti akka madeessu ykn haati miira ilmoo isheetiif akkamitti akka gadditu ibsuuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the intense, shared physical and emotional agony a mother feels when her child is in severe pain or distress.
Keywords_AO: ilma; cidhaan; diimatu; haadha; ija; dhukkubbii; imimmaan; mararfannaa
Keywords_EN: son; testicles; inflammation; pain; mother; bloodshot eyes; tears; maternal empathy

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati hoggaa quufte ilmoo tiyyaaf jetti, ilmoon hoggaa quufte ammoo boruuf kaayatti.
Translation_Literal_EN: When the mother is full, she says 'for my child'; when the child is full, however, he saves it for tomorrow.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli haadhaa ofittoo hin qabu, yeroo hunda ijoollee dursiti; ilmoon immoo ofuma isaatiif dursa kenna.
Meaning_EN: A mother selflessly prioritizes her child before anything else, whereas offspring naturally prioritize their own personal future and self-preservation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo arjummaa haadhaafi amala ofittummaa ijoollee wal bira qabanii ilaalan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to highlight the peerless, unconditional selflessness of mothers compared to children's natural self-interest.
Keywords_AO: haadha, quufuu, ilmoo, boru, arjummaa
Keywords_EN: mother, satisfied, child, tomorrow, selfless

Mammaaksa_AO: Aawliyaan duraa abbaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: The first guardian saint is the father.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan duraan dursee eegduu, barsiisaa fi dahoo namaati; eebba abbaa argachuun eebba hundumaa caala.
Meaning_EN: One's father is the primary earthly guardian, protector, and spiritual shelter whose blessing must be honored first.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaa ofii kabajuu fi eebba isaa barbaaduun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge children to honor their father above all other external patrons or counselors.
Keywords_AO: aawliyaa, duraa, abbaa, eebba, kabaja
Keywords_EN: saint, first, father, guardian, blessing

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan namaa, abbaa namaaf hin tahu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Another person's father does not become a father to you.
Meaning_AO: Namni ormaa hammam gaarii ta'us abbaa dhugaa namaaf ta'uu hin danda'u; abbaa ofiitu dhimma ofii baata.
Meaning_EN: No other man can replace the genuine care, authority, and protective instinct of your biological father.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama abbaa ormaatti amanamee abbaa ofii dagate gorsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to remind someone that outsiders, no matter how benevolent, will never possess the same devotion as one's real father.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, nama, orma, maatii
Keywords_EN: father, person, stranger, biological, family

Mammaaksa_AO: Intala abbaa qabdu mariin mana, tan abbaa hin qabne mariin ala.
Translation_Literal_EN: The daughter with a father has her affairs decided indoors; the one without a father has hers debated outside.
Meaning_AO: Intalli abbaa qabdu kabajaafi eegumsa maatii qabdi; tan abbaa hin qabne garuu salphinnaafi qeeqa ormaatiif saaxilamti.
Meaning_EN: A girl with a protective father is treated with dignity and proper domestic deliberation; an orphan girl lacks that shield and faces public vulnerability.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ga'ee abbaan kabajaafi dahoo ijoollee dubaraatiif qabu ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the vital protective shield and social dignity a father confers upon his daughter.
Keywords_AO: intala, abbaa, marii, mana, ala
Keywords_EN: daughter, father, council, indoors, outdoors, protection

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan gaariin gaaddisa ilmaaf jaara.
Translation_Literal_EN: A good father builds shade for his son.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan amala gaarii qabu egeree ilma isaatiif wanta gaarii qopheessa, qabeenyaafi maqaa bareedaa dhalootaaf dabarsa.
Meaning_EN: A prudent and loving father prepares a stable future, honorable reputation, and protective shelter for his offspring.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan carraaqqii isaatiin ijoollee isaatiif egeree amansiisaa uumu galateeffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to commend a responsible father who works tirelessly to secure the comfort and future of his descendants.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, gaarii, gaaddisa, ilma, jaaruu
Keywords_EN: father, good, shelter, son, legacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan laalee hin quufu, ilmoon nyaattee hin quuftu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The father never tires of looking lovingly, the child never gets tired of eating.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli abbaan ijoollee isaatiif qabu daangaa hin qabu; ilmoonis yeroo hunda kennaafi jaalala abbaa barbaaddi.
Meaning_EN: A father derives endless fulfillment simply gazing upon his child's well-being, while a child has an endless appetite for parental care.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo jaalala guddaa abbaan ijoollee isaatiif qabuufi fedhii ijoollee ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the mutual dynamic of deep, affectionate paternal oversight and continuous filial need.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, laaluu, quufuu, ilmoo, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: father, gaze, satisfy, child, eat, affection

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan gaariin dayma namaa guduunfa, abbaan hamaan heexo namaa guduunfa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A good father bundles honey for you; a bad father bundles kosso for you.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan qajeelaan ilmaan isaatiif eebba, beekumsaafi qabeenya mi'aawaa dhaala; abbaan badiin immoo salphinaafi rakkoo dhiisee darba.
Meaning_EN: A virtuous father leaves behind a sweet legacy of wisdom, wealth, and honor, whereas an irresponsible father leaves bitter shame and suffering.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiibbaa abbaan jireenya ijoollee isaa irratti qabu gaarii ykn hamaa ta'uu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to contrast the lifelong blessings left by a wise father against the hardships inflicted by a neglectful one.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, gaarii, hamaan, dayma, heexo, guduunfuu
Keywords_EN: father, good, bad, honey, bitter kosso, bundle, legacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Hanga aduun jirtu kaadhu, hanga abbaan kee jiru nyaadhu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Run while the sun is up; eat and enjoy while your father is alive.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo abbaan jiru eegumsaafi nyaata gaarii argatan waan ta'eef, carraa qabanitti fayyadamanii jireenya qananiin dabarsuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Seize the day while you have light, and cherish life's provisions while your father is alive to protect and sustain you.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama abbaan jiruuf carraa qabuun akka fayyadamu gorsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge young people to appreciate the unique safety, abundance, and comfort they have under their father's roof.
Keywords_AO: aduu, kaachuu, abbaa, nyaachuu, qananii
Keywords_EN: sun, run, father, eat, enjoy, opportunity

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan gaangee harree dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: The father of a mule is a donkey.
Meaning_AO: Gaangeen hammam boonus ykn faayamus abbaan isaa harreedha; namni bu'uuraafi dhaloota ofii ganuu ykn itti qaana'uu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: No matter how proud or elevated a mule appears, its sire is still a donkey; one cannot disguise or disown one's humble origins.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama sadarkaa ol'aanaa ga'ee maatii ykn dhaloota ofii irratti boonu gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to deflate snobbery or pretense, reminding someone that high status does not erase modest ancestry.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, gaangee, harree, hundee
Keywords_EN: father, mule, donkey, origins, roots

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan xiqqaa hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A father has no 'small'.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan yeroo hunda ulfinaafi aangoo maatii qaba; abbaa ofii xiqqeessanii ilaaluun hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: A father's authority, dignity, and position of respect are never minor or negligible, regardless of his material standing or physical stature.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaa ofii kabajuu fi sadarkaa isaa eeguun dirqama ta'uu ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that every father commands fundamental respect and should never be demeaned or dismissed.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, xiqqaa, kabaja, ulfina
Keywords_EN: father, small, respect, authority, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Dachii fi haadha waan itti kennan irrumaa fudhatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: From the earth and a mother, one only receives what has been given to them.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma dachiin wanta facaasan qofa magarsitu, haatis jaalalaafi kunuunsa itti kennan deebistee namaaf laatti; akkuma itti tolan tolti.
Meaning_EN: The earth yields only according to what is planted, and a mother reciprocates with the love and honor she is given.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haadha ofiitiif kunuunsaafi jaalala kennuun eebba guddaa akka qabu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to teach that caring generously for one's mother brings profound, reciprocal blessings, just as cultivating fertile soil does.
Keywords_AO: dachii, haadha, kennuu, fudhachuu
Keywords_EN: earth, mother, give, receive, reciprocity

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadhaa fi adurree hin dhaanani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not beat a mother or a cat.
Meaning_AO: Haadha rukutuun safuu fi abaarsa fida; adurreenis bineensa manaa kan miidhaan irra ga'uu hin qabneedha; safuu maatii eeguu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Striking a mother is a grievous cultural and spiritual taboo; gentle treatment and absolute non-violence are owed to maternal figures and domestic companions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo safuu fi araara maatii eegsisuuf nama daangaa darbe dhaabsisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to enforce the cultural taboo against laying hands or violence upon a mother or domestic pets.
Keywords_AO: haadha, adurree, dhaanuu, safuu
Keywords_EN: mother, cat, beat, taboo, reverence

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni abbaa fi haadha hin sodaanne waaqa hin sodaatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who does not fear their father and mother does not fear God.
Meaning_AO: Kabajni maatii bu'uura amantii fi amala gaariiti; nama maatii ofii hin kabajne Waaqayyoon hin sodaatu.
Meaning_EN: Piety, morality, and reverence for God begin with honoring one's parents; someone who disrespects their parents has no fear of the divine.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama abbaafi haadha isaatti tuffii agarsiise adaban ykn akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to severely rebuke anyone who treats their parents with disrespect, linking parental honor to spiritual integrity.
Keywords_AO: nama, abbaa, haadha, sodaachuu, Waaqa
Keywords_EN: person, father, mother, fear, God, filial piety

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamaan hamadayaa, qabatan nama guba.
Translation_Literal_EN: The wicked one is like frost; touch it and it burns you.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan akka amadaa ykn qorra nama waxaluuti; itti siquun miidhaa fi balaa fida.
Meaning_EN: A toxic, malevolent person is like frost or burning embers; getting close to them inevitably brings pain and harm.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni nama hamaa irraa fagaachuu qaban akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to warn others against associating with malicious or dangerous individuals.
Keywords_AO: hamaa, hamadayaa, qabachuu, gubuu
Keywords_EN: wicked, frost, touch, burn, harm

Mammaaksa_AO: Mukni badaan hin daraaru.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad tree does not blossom.
Meaning_AO: Namni ykn wanti jalqabumaan badii fi faayidaa-dhabeessa ta'e bu'aa gaarii hin argamsiisu.
Meaning_EN: An inherently corrupt or useless person or thing will never produce good, fruitful results.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama amalli isaa badaan wanta gaarii akka hin fidne ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that good deeds and positive outcomes cannot be expected from a fundamentally wicked character.
Keywords_AO: muka, badaa, daraaruu, firii
Keywords_EN: tree, bad, blossom, fruit, character

Mammaaksa_AO: Xannacha xiqqaatu foon ajeeysa.
Translation_Literal_EN: It is a small gland that spoils the meat.
Meaning_AO: Wanti xiqqoon tokko yoo amala badaa qabaate waan guddaa hunda xureessa; nama tokkoon maatiin ykn hawaasni xuraa'a.
Meaning_EN: A tiny tainted lymph gland ruins the whole carcass; similarly, a single corrupt individual can spoil an entire group.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo balleessaan nama tokkoo maqaa maatii ykn hawaasa guutuu balleessu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a single misbehaving person tarnishes the reputation or disrupts the peace of an entire community.
Keywords_AO: xannacha, xiqqaa, foon, ajjeessuu
Keywords_EN: gland, small, meat, spoil, stink, corruption

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama hamaa duuti lama.
Translation_Literal_EN: For a wicked person, death is twice.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan jireenya isaatti jibbaafi salphinnaan du'a, gaafa du'us gaddaa fi yaadannoo gaarii dhabuun du'a.
Meaning_EN: A wicked person dies twice: once through social contempt and isolation in life, and again when they perish unmourned.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hammeenyi jireenyas ta'ee du'a booda salphina akka fidu akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to remind wrongdoers that their evil deeds result in both a ruined life and a disgraceful end.
Keywords_AO: nama, hamaa, du'a, lama, salphina
Keywords_EN: person, wicked, death, twice, disgrace

Mammaaksa_AO: Badaa qalbiin lama.
Translation_Literal_EN: The wicked one has two minds.
Meaning_AO: Namni amalli isaa badaa ta'e murtee dhaabbataa hin qabu; shakkiifi shira keessa jiraata.
Meaning_EN: A corrupt or deceitful person is always double-minded, inconsistent, and plagued by guilt and suspicion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama amanamaa hin taaneefi amala sobaa agarsiisu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe untrustworthy, fickle, or hypocritical people who harbor ulterior motives.
Keywords_AO: badaa, qalbii, lama, shakki
Keywords_EN: wicked, mind, two, double-minded, deceit

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi badaan, warra hin badhaadhu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad son does not prosper into a household (does not build a flourishing family).
Meaning_AO: Ilmi amala badaa qabu, kan dhibaa'aa fi naamus-dhabeessa ta'e, of danda'ee bultii dhaabbachuu fi maatii badhaadhaa ijaarrachuu hin danda'u; amalli hamaan warroomuu fi milkaa'ina bultii nama dhowwa.
Meaning_EN: An ill-mannered, reckless, or delinquent son never flourishes into establishing a stable, prosperous household of his own. Flawed character and lack of discipline prevent a young man from maintaining a marriage, settling down, and building a thriving family.
Theme_EN: Defective Character and Inability to Build a Household
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dargaggoo amala hin qabne tokko amala isaa yoo sirreeffachuu baate bor bultii ijaarratee warra ta'uu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisanitti itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn an unruly, undisciplined young man that his bad habits will prevent him from ever settling down, maintaining a family, and building a respected household.
Keywords_AO: ilma; badaa; warra; badhaadhuu; bultii; maatii; amala; dhibaa'ummaa
Keywords_EN: son; bad character; household; flourish; prosper; family building; delinquency; domestic failure

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni hamaan, bofa afaa jalaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wicked person is a snake under the sleeping mat.
Meaning_AO: Namni amala hamaa qabu osoo hin beekamin dhihootti nama miidha; diina keessaa kan balaan isaa ulfaatuudha.
Meaning_EN: A treacherous person is like a venomous snake hidden beneath one's bedding: close, stealthy, and fatally dangerous.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama michuu fakkaatee keessaan shira xaxu akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to alert someone against a covert enemy or untrustworthy associate posing as a close insider.
Keywords_AO: nama, hamaa, bofa, afaa, shira
Keywords_EN: person, wicked, snake, mat, treachery, concealed

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamtuun, fardaa fi garbu adda baafti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Hardship separates the horse from the barley.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoon yeroo dhufu wanti gaarii fi wanti dhimma hin baafne adda ba'a; yeroo rakkinaatu eenyummaa dhugaa saaxila.
Meaning_EN: Adversity and critical trials test true worth, separating what is genuine and durable from what is superficial.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon dhufee nama dhugaa fi nama sobaa addaan baasu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when difficult circumstances reveal people's true resilience, loyalty, and authentic capabilities.
Keywords_AO: hamtuu, farda, garbuu, adda baasuu
Keywords_EN: hardship, horse, barley, separate, test

Mammaaksa_AO: Saani eegee dhiigaa, eegee dhaan loon balleessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A cow with a bleeding tail ruins the whole herd with its tail.
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko amala badaa qabaannaan, amala isaa sanaan namoota nagaa fi qulqulluu ta'an hunda xureessa.
Meaning_EN: A single bleeding cow spatters the entire herd; likewise, one miscreant spreads corruption and taint to everyone around.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko hawaasa ykn garee tokko amala isaatiin faalu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when the misconduct or scandalous behavior of one individual drags down and soils the entire group.
Keywords_AO: saa, eegee, dhiiga, loon, balleessuu
Keywords_EN: cow, tail, blood, herd, spoil, contagion

Mammaaksa_AO: Badaa, fageenyi hin teessifne.
Translation_Literal_EN: Distance does not settle the wicked.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan bakka kamiyyuu yoo deeme amala isaa hin dhiisu; fageenyi amala badaa hin jijjiiru.
Meaning_EN: Relocation cannot change a wicked nature; troublemakers carry their malice wherever they go.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amala badaa qabu bakka biraa deemus amalauma durii agarsiisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing that a corrupt person continues causing mischief even after moving to a new place.
Keywords_AO: badaa, fageenya, taa'uu, amala
Keywords_EN: wicked, distance, settle, character, incurable

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaangeen hamtuun, abba qaanessiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad mule brings shame to its owner.
Meaning_AO: Wanti ykn namni of jala jiru yoo amala dhabe, salphinni isaa gara abbaatti deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: A recalcitrant mule disgraces its master in public; similarly, the misdeeds of dependents embarrass those responsible for them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko amala badaadhaan maatii ykn hooggana isaa qaanesse ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a rebellious child, servant, or subordinate publicly embarrasses their guardian.
Keywords_AO: gaangee, hamtuu, abbaa, qaaneessuu
Keywords_EN: mule, bad, owner, shame, disgrace

Mammaaksa_AO: Warri badaan, wal faana bada.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wicked household perishes together.
Meaning_AO: Warri hundi isaanii amala badaa qaban yoo walitti qabaman, wal deggaranii waliin badu.
Meaning_EN: A family or group united in corruption and wrongdoing will drag each other down into collective destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni hammeenyaan wal ta'an waliin barbadaa'an dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an unscrupulous clique or dysfunctional household collapses under the weight of shared misconduct.
Keywords_AO: warra, badaa, wal faana, baduu
Keywords_EN: household, wicked, together, perish, downfall

Mammaaksa_AO: Irraa eegan malee, hamaan naanniga boorata.
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless closely guarded, the foul beast will muddy the watering trough.
Meaning_AO: Nama amala badaa qabu yoo to'annoo jala hin oolchin wanta qulqulluu hunda ni xureessa.
Meaning_EN: Unless strictly watched and kept in check, a reckless troublemaker will foul the drinking trough and ruin shared peace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama badii fidu irraa of eeguun fi to'achuun barbaachisaa ta'e akeekkachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to urge constant vigilance against malicious actors who spoil shared communal harmony.
Keywords_AO: eeguu, hamaa, naanniga, boorachuu
Keywords_EN: guard, wicked, trough, muddy, spoil

Mammaaksa_AO: Waa lamaatu nama guba, takka qondoo soogidda hin qabne tan lammadaa kofoo injiree qabdu dhukkuba gaaffii hin qabne.
Translation_Literal_EN: Two things burn a person: stew without salt, and trousers infested with lice—a torment beyond questioning.
Meaning_AO: Wanti akka malee nama dhiphisuufi nagaa nama dhowwu wantoota salphoo fakkaatanii nama cinqaniidha.
Meaning_EN: Insipid nourishment and constant hidden irritation are maddening domestic afflictions that torment a person relentlessly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkina xiqqoo fakkaatee garuu nama dhiphisuufi nagaa dhowwu ibsuu barbaadan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken with wry humor to describe seemingly minor yet thoroughly agonizing daily irritations.
Keywords_AO: gubuu, qondoo, soogidda, kofoo, injiree
Keywords_EN: burn, stew, salt, trousers, lice, torment

Mammaaksa_AO: Qaceelaan dhibbaa fi tokko, hamaan dhibbaa fi shantami.
Translation_Literal_EN: The righteous is one in a hundred, the wicked is one hundred and fifty.
Meaning_AO: Namni qajeelaan baay'ee muraasa, garuu namni hamaan fi badii hojjetu lakkoofsa hin qabu, lakkoofsaanis baay'eedha.
Meaning_EN: Upright, noble individuals are exceedingly rare, whereas corrupt and wicked people are found everywhere in abundance.
Theme_EN: Rarity of Goodness / Abundance of Evil
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni gaariin xiqqaatanii fi warri badaan baay'atanii jiran ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament the rarity of honest people compared to the overwhelming prevalence of deceitful individuals.
Keywords_AO: qaceelaa, dhibba, hamaa, shantama
Keywords_EN: righteous, hundred, wicked, fifty, rarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Badaan yoo gorsan ni lola.
Translation_Literal_EN: When you advise the wicked, he fights back.
Meaning_AO: Namni amalli isaa badaan gorsa qajeelaa hin fudhatu; balleessaa isaa itti himnaan aaree lola kakaasa.
Meaning_EN: A foolish or ill-natured person resents wise counsel and reacts with anger and hostility when corrected.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dogoggora isaa sirreessuu dhiisee nama gorse irratti dheekkamu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when someone takes constructive counsel as an offense and aggressively lashes out at the advisor.
Keywords_AO: badaa, gorsuu, loluu, aaruu
Keywords_EN: bad, advise, fight, hostility, arrogance

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan hamtuun galuu hin feetu, warri hamaan keessummaa ofirraa hin galchu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad guest does not want to leave, a bad host does not see a guest off properly.
Meaning_AO: Namni daangaa hin beekne bakka isaaf hin malle tura; warri doqnis simannaa gaarii dhowwata; lamaanuu hanqina naamusaa qabu.
Meaning_EN: An inconsiderate guest overstays their welcome, while an inhospitable host refuses to bid guests a proper farewell.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo keessummaa dadhabsiisaa fi warra mana doqna wal bira qabanii qeeqan fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize both the insensitive guest who never departs and the stingy host who lacks basic hospitality.
Keywords_AO: keessummaa, hamtuu, galuu, warra, hamaan
Keywords_EN: guest, bad, leave, host, hospitality

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaagura seenu damma balleessa amaan, ofii badee nama balleessa hamaan.
Translation_Literal_EN: The pest entering the hive ruins the honey; the wicked, being ruined himself, ruins others.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma bineensi gaagura keessa seenee damma barbadeessu, namni hamaanis ofii barbadaa'ee namoota kaanis waliin balleessa.
Meaning_EN: Just as a destructive pest invades a beehive only to ruin the honey, a corrupt individual self-destructs while dragging others down.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amala badaa qabu nagaa fi qabeenya namaa barbadeessu akeekkachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to describe a self-destructive spoiler who takes pleasure in wrecking peace and prosperity for everyone else.
Keywords_AO: gaagura, damma, amaan, badaa, hamaa
Keywords_EN: beehive, honey, pest, ruin, wicked

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamaan kan ofiituu hamaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wicked person of one's own kin is still wicked.
Meaning_AO: Fira ta'us alagaa, namni hamaan yoomiyyuu miidhaa fida; firummaan hammeenya nama jalaa hin dhoksu.
Meaning_EN: Evil does not become harmless merely because it comes from a relative; a malevolent kinsperson remains toxic and destructive.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni fira ofii waan ta'eef qofa hammeenya isaa dhoksuu barbaadu gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against blindly excusing cruelty or malice simply because the perpetrator is family.
Keywords_AO: hamaa, ofii, fira, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: wicked, kin, family, harmful, realism

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamaan waarii du'eeti, warra hirriiba dhoowwa.
Translation_Literal_EN: The wicked person died at midnight and deprived the household of sleep.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan jireenya isaattis rakkoo fida, gaafa du'us namoota nagaa dhowwee dhiphisa.
Meaning_EN: A troublesome individual causes distress even in passing, choosing midnight to die just to disrupt everyone's peace and rest.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama jireenyaanis ta'ee haala du'a isaatiin namatti nagaa dhowwu ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken with dark irony about someone whose knack for causing inconvenience and stress persists until their final breath.
Keywords_AO: hamaa, waarii, du'uu, hirriiba, dhoowwuu
Keywords_EN: wicked, midnight, die, sleep, deprive

Mammaaksa_AO: "Balleeyso foon hiri" jennaan, "tole inninuu baktii dhaa" je'e.
Translation_Literal_EN: When told 'O Balleeyso (Spoiler), divide the meat!', he replied, 'Gladly! It is carrion anyway!'
Meaning_AO: Nama duraanuu mancaasuu fi badiidhaan beekamu (Balleeysoo) dhimma gati-jabeessa irratti itti-gaafatamummaan akka qoodu yoo itti kennan, inni dantaa fi gammachuun itti seenee wanticha akka baktii fi gati-dhabeessaatti xiqqeessee mancaasuuf qophii ta'uu agarsiisa. Qabeenyaa fi dhimma murteessaa nama amala badii qabuuf kennuun gowwummaa ta'uu akeekkachiisa.
Meaning_EN: When a notorious ruiner or corrupt figure (addressed by the moniker 'Balleeyso', meaning Spoiler) is foolishly tasked with distributing prized meat, he complies with malicious eagerness, immediately disparaging the meat as mere carrion (baktii) to justify spoiling and plundering it without remorse. It cautions against the folly of entrusting valuable resources or stewardship to someone with a proven track record of destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojiin, qabeenyi yookaan itti-gaafatamummaan guddaan nama duraanuu badii fi mancaasuun beekamuutti kennamee inni wanticha qisaasee salphisu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against or satirize the foolishness of putting a known embezzler, saboteur, or corrupt actor in charge of valuable community resources, as they will eagerly ruin them and cynically dismiss the assets as worthless.
Keywords_AO: balleeyso; foon hiru; tole; baktii; mancaasuu; saamicha; amanamummaa dhabuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: Balleeyso; spoiler; meat distribution; gladly; carrion; sabotage; misplaced trust; corruption; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan ciniinsa beeku, dhungoo hin beeku.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mouth that knows how to bite does not know how to kiss.
Meaning_AO: Namni hammeenyaafi miidhaa nama irratti raawwachuu bare, jaalalaafi gara-laafina agarsiisuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A person whose nature is cruelty and hostility is incapable of genuine tenderness and affection.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama gara-jabeessa irraa gaarummaa ykn jaalala eeguun akka hin danda'amne ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to remind someone that warmth and affection cannot be expected from a habitually cruel person.
Keywords_AO: afaan, ciniinsa, dhungoo, beekuu, hammeenya
Keywords_EN: mouth, bite, kiss, cruelty, tenderness

Mammaaksa_AO: Liqii nama hamaa, bishaan raafuu fudhatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: For the debt owed by a wicked person, one accepts even cabbage broth.
Meaning_AO: Nama hamaa ykn doqna irraa waanuma argatan xiqqoollee taatu fudhatanii irraa fottoquutu wayya; guutuu eeggachuun harka qullaa nama hambisa.
Meaning_EN: When recovering a debt from a dishonest or hostile person, accept whatever little settlement is offered and cut ties rather than waiting in vain for full repayment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama hamaa irraa waanuma argatan fudhatanii lola irraa fagaachuuf gorsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone to cut their losses and settle for any minimal payment rather than prolonging a dispute with an intractable rogue.
Keywords_AO: liqii, nama hamaa, bishaan, raafuu, fudhachuu
Keywords_EN: debt, wicked, broth, cabbage, settle, pragmatism

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamaan fira gaariiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The wicked is the foil of the good.
Meaning_AO: Gaarummaan kan ifee mul'atu yoo hammeenyi jiraatedha; wanti gaariin gatii kan argatu wanta hamaa wajjin yoo dorgomedha.
Meaning_EN: The value of goodness and virtue shines most brilliantly in contrast with wickedness; the bad serves to illuminate the good.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti hamaan wanta gaarii akka dinqisiifataniif sababa ta'e ibsuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to reflect on how evil and malice heighten human appreciation for benevolence and righteousness.
Keywords_AO: hamaa, fira, gaarii, madaallii
Keywords_EN: wicked, relative, good, contrast, virtue

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaariin jiraannaan, hamtuun jiraatte.
Translation_Literal_EN: Because good exists, evil also exists.
Meaning_AO: Addunyaa kanarratti wanti hundi faallaa mataa isaa qaba; gaariin qofti osoo hin taane hamaanis wajjuma jiraata.
Meaning_EN: Good and evil are perpetually intertwined aspects of existence; duality is an inherent reality of human life.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo jiraachuu hammeenyaa akka seera uumamaatti fudhatanii hubatan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to explain the inevitable presence of trials and malice alongside virtue and harmony in this world.
Keywords_AO: gaarii, hamtuu, jiraachuu, uumama
Keywords_EN: good, evil, existence, duality, balance

Mammaaksa_AO: Hanga tolli ture, hammeenyi hin turre.
Translation_Literal_EN: However long goodness endured, malice has never lasted as long.
Meaning_AO: Gaarummaafi toli yeroo hunda dhiibbaa hamaa caalaatti tura; hammeenyi yeroof malee bu'uura hin qabu, ni bada.
Meaning_EN: Benevolence, justice, and good deeds endure across generations, whereas evil and tyranny are ephemeral and doomed to collapse.
Category_EN: Hope and the Triumph of Good
Theme_EN: Endurance of Good / Transience of Evil
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota hammeenyaan rakkatan jajjabeessanii gaarummaan akka mo'u abdachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to console and uplift victims of wrongdoing by reminding them that virtue outlasts all fleeting evil.
Keywords_AO: tola, turuu, hammeenya, mo'achuu
Keywords_EN: goodness, endure, malice, outlast, triumph

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni wajji galanii nama nyaatu, bineensa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person with whom you live who preys upon you is a wild beast.
Meaning_AO: Namni nama wajjin nagaan jiraata jedhanii mana ofiitti amananii galchan garuu nama miidhu, bineensa caalaa hamaadha.
Meaning_EN: An intimate companion or housemate who exploits, backstabs, or preys upon you is no human, but a predator.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama amananii mana ofiitti galchanii boodarra nama miidhe balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to strongly denounce an insider or trusted relative who betrays their host or household from within.
Keywords_AO: nama, galuu, nyaachuu, bineensa, shira
Keywords_EN: person, dwell, devour, beast, betrayal

Mammaaksa_AO: Heexoo fi niitiin namatti hin dabin.
Translation_Literal_EN: May kosso and a wife never turn bitter against you.
Meaning_AO: Heexoon akkuma dhukkubsaatti ulfaattu, haati manaa yoo nama jibbite jireenyi manaa abidda ta'a; nagaa maatii eeggachuu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Just as an adverse dose of kosso is agonizing, an antagonistic spouse makes life unbearable; domestic peace is vital.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gaa'ela keessatti waldhabdee fi hammeenya haadha manaa irraa eegumsa kadhatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken as a prayer or caution highlighting the misery of domestic acrimony and wishing for marital peace.
Keywords_AO: heexoo, niitii, dabuu, jireenya
Keywords_EN: kosso, wife, bitter, marital peace, discord

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan hamaan ofii foon ciratee nyaateeti, ilma shuumoo nyaachisa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad father cuts and eats the meat for himself, and feeds his son boiled grains.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan ofittoo ta'e ofii isaatiif qananii barbaadee ijoollee isaa beelaafi dararaaf dhiisa; itti-gaafatamummaa abbummaa dhabuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: A selfish and cruel father indulges in luxury and delicacies for himself while leaving his child with dry, meager scraps.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan ofii isaatiif qofa jiraatee ilmaan isaa miidhu qeeqan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize an irresponsible, narcissistic parent who hoards comfort while neglecting their offspring.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, hamaan, foon, ilma, shuumoo
Keywords_EN: father, bad, meat, son, boiled grain, neglect

Mammaaksa_AO: Balaan sigicha teesseeti Boorteetti faraqaa seenti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Disaster sits at Sigicha and takes its turn at Boorte.
Meaning_AO: Balaan ykn hammeenyi bakka tokkotti hin hafu; dabaree dabareedhaan hunda bira ga'a waan ta'eef of eeggannoon barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Trouble and calamity do not remain stationary; misfortunes make their rounds from one community to the next.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon nama biraa ga'e bor gara keenyattis dhufuu akka danda'u yaadachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to remind communities that disaster is rotational, and one should never gloat over a neighbor's misfortune.
Keywords_AO: balaa, sigicha, boortee, faraqaa, dabaree
Keywords_EN: calamity, Sigicha, Boorte, turn, disaster cycle

Mammaaksa_AO: Daddabee na dhibee karaan goda goraa, hamaan sinqii sii hin dhiisu muka keessaan goraa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Tired and baffled, the road winds into the valley; the wicked will not spare your provisions, so detour through the woods.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo nama hamaa wajjin walitti dhufan, humnaan wal dura dhaabbachuu mannaa karaan dabarfachuufi irraa fagaachuutu furmaata.
Meaning_EN: When facing an aggressive rogue who aims to plunder your provisions, it is wiser to bypass them through the trees than invite destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama hamaa fi qabeenya namaa saamurraa tooftaadhaan fagaachuun filatamaa ta'u gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to urge travelers and vulnerable persons to actively bypass dangerous predators through discretion.
Keywords_AO: karaa, daddabuu, hamaa, sinqii, muka, goruu
Keywords_EN: road, valley, wicked, provisions, bypass, caution

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi hamaan, abbaa duubaa kasha hata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wicked son steals grain from behind his father's back.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen amala dhabduun maatii ofii amanamummaa dhowwattee qabeenya isaanii hatee salphisa.
Meaning_EN: A disloyal and wicked son betrays his father's trust, stealthily plundering the family stores from behind his back.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ilmi abbaa ofiitiif amanamuu dideefi qabeenya maatii dhoksaan dhabamsiisu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to denounce an ungrateful, thieving child who betrays parental trust and steals from the homestead.
Keywords_AO: ilma, hamaan, abbaa, kasha, hatuu
Keywords_EN: son, bad, father, grain, steal, betrayal

Mammaaksa_AO: Obbolleessi hamaan, bineensa duratti si dhiiseeti si biraa dheessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad brother leaves you before the wild beast and flees from you.
Meaning_AO: Obboleessi amala hamaa qabu gaafa balaafi qormaatni dhufu nama dhiisee baqata; obbolummaan gaafa rakkinaa beekama.
Meaning_EN: A false, cowardly brother abandons you in the face of mortal peril and saves his own skin; true brotherhood is proven in adversity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo obboleessi ykn michuun gaafa rakkinaa nama gatatee dheesse komatan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when condemning a close relative who shows cowardice and leaves their kin to face danger alone.
Keywords_AO: obboleessa, hamaan, bineensa, dhiisuu, dheessuu
Keywords_EN: brother, bad, beast, abandon, flee, betrayal

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabessi kan boodaa irra hamaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: The hyena that comes last is the most vicious.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo balaan ykn hanni dhufu, inni boodarra dhufu waan duraan hafellee guuree fixa; wanti dhumarratti nama mudatu daran ulfaataadha.
Meaning_EN: The last scavenger to strike is often the most ruthless, stripping away whatever meager scraps were spared earlier.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni ykn rakkoowwan dhuma irratti dhufan daran nama barbadeessan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when warning that subsequent exploiters or trailing misfortunes will be even more merciless than the first.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, boodaa, hamaa, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: hyena, last, vicious, ruin, aftermath

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamaan kakachuu hin sodaatu, kakateeti du'a.
Translation_Literal_EN: The wicked does not fear swearing; he swears falsely and perishes.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan kakuu sobaatiin Waaqayyoo fi safuu hin sodaanne, garuu kakuun sun boodarra badiisa isa irratti fida.
Meaning_EN: An unscrupulous person has no qualms about swearing false oaths, but divine retribution eventually catches up and destroys them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni sobaan kakatee haqaa fi safuu cabsuuf yaalu akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to warn against perjury, reminding people that swearing falsely brings a curse and destruction upon the perpetrator.
Keywords_AO: hamaa, kakachuu, sodaachuu, du'a
Keywords_EN: wicked, swear, oath, perjury, perish

Mammaaksa_AO: Cubbuun harka walirraa murti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Sin severs hands from one another.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin cubbuu fi hammeenyaa walitti-dhufeenya obbolummaa, michummaa fi wal-gargaarsa gidduu jiru hunda barbadeessa.
Meaning_EN: Sin, treachery, and injustice sever the mutual bonds of brotherhood and cooperation that make people assist one another.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo cubbuun maatii ykn hawaasa wal-deggaru addaan faffacaase ibsuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to highlight how moral corruption and betrayal dissolve sacred ties of solidarity and mutual assistance.
Keywords_AO: cubbuu, harka, muruu, walitti-dhufeenya
Keywords_EN: sin, hand, cut, sever, solidarity, mutual aid

Mammaaksa_AO: Bofa summii isaatiif sodaatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: A snake is feared because of its venom.
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko kan sodaatamu ykn kan kabajamu humna miidhuu ykn qulqullina amala isaa isa iccitii ta'eeni.
Meaning_EN: Respect or fear is commanded by one's capability to defend oneself or strike back, just as a serpent is dreaded for its venom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dandeettii ykn humna qabuuf kabajamu ykn sodaatamu ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that deterrence and respect often stem from an entity's known capacity to deliver a decisive strike.
Keywords_AO: bofa, summii, sodaachuu, humna
Keywords_EN: snake, venom, poison, fear, deterrence

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka sareen itti dhuufte, waraabessi hin hanqatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Where the dog farts, the hyena will not be absent.
Meaning_AO: Mallattoon ykn malli balaa tokko yoo mul'ate, wanti hamaaniifi guddaan itti aanee dhufuun isaa hin oolu.
Meaning_EN: Where preliminary signs of vulnerability or disorder appear, greater predators and disasters will inevitably follow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dogoggorri ykn hanqinni xiqqoon balaa guddaadhaaf karaa banu akeekkachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an early sign of negligence or disorder signals that a major crisis or predator is looming.
Keywords_AO: saree, dhuufuu, waraabessa, balaa, mallattoo
Keywords_EN: dog, fart, hyena, danger, omen, predator

Mammaaksa_AO: Waa qalle jennaan, keessummaan taa'aa bulte.
Translation_Literal_EN: When they said 'We have slaughtered something', the guest stayed awake all night waiting.
Meaning_AO: Namni abdii sobaa ykn wanta dhihootti hin argamne hawwu, dharraafi yaaddoodhaan nagaa dhabee bula.
Meaning_EN: Lured by grand promises or the prospect of a feast, an eager person waits all night in restless anticipation only to be disappointed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan abdachiifame dharra'ee nagaa dhabu ykn waan hin argamne eegu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to mock someone keeping an exhausting, eager vigil over empty promises of food, wealth, or favors.
Keywords_AO: qaluu, keessummaa, taa'uu, buluu, abdii
Keywords_EN: slaughter, guest, wait, feast, anticipation

Mammaaksa_AO: Suguyyaan, sangaa jaalatte arrabsiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The butcher disparages/insults the ox he wants to buy (loves).
Meaning_AO: Daldalaan foonii (suguyyaan) gabaa keessatti sangaa gabbataa fi qaalii isa qalmaaf jaalate sana gatii gadi buusuuf jedhee 'ni huqqata, amala hin qabu' jechuun hanqina itti barbaadee arrabsa. Akkasumas, namni wanta tokko garaadhaa kajeelu ykn nama tokko barbaadu salphaatti argachuuf jedhee afaaniin wanta sana tuffatee xiqqeessa.
Meaning_EN: At the cattle market, a butcher who spots a prime, fat ox he eagerly wishes to buy will deliberately criticize, nitpick, and belittle it—calling it lean, old, or defective—solely to drive down the seller's asking price. Metaphorically, it describes how buyers, competitors, or suitors feign contempt and disparage what they secretly desire in order to deflate its value and secure it cheaply.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko wanta yookaan nama garaa keessaa baay'ee dharra'u tokko salphaatti harkatti galfachuuf jedhee afaaniin tuffatee fi xiqqeessee komatu saaxiluuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an opportunist, buyer, or suitor hypocritically finds fault with an asset, person, or position they actually covet, trying to undermine its worth so they can acquire it at a bargain.
Keywords_AO: suguyyaa; butcher; sangaa; jaalachuu; arrabsuu; daldala; gabaa; tooftaa; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: suguyyaa; butcher; ox; coveting; disparaging; haggling; bargaining tactic; feigned contempt; market psychology

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan shuumoo naa qiciin, shuumoo keessa barbaaduu dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying 'Pour me the broth of boiled beans' is secretly seeking the beans inside.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan xiqqoo gaafatu yeroo baay'ee wanta guddaa fi dantaa dhokataa qabaachuu isaa agarsiisa; tooftaadhaan dhiyaachuu.
Meaning_EN: Asking meekly for the broth of boiled grains is just a polite pretext to get the actual grains; a modest request concealing real desire.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni fedhii guddaa qabu karaa salphaadhaan kadhachuu barbaadu saaxilan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when detecting that someone's seemingly minor inquiry is actually a calculated step toward obtaining something much bigger.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, shuumoo, qicuu, barbaaduu, fedhii
Keywords_EN: water, boiled grain, pour, search, pretext, motive

Mammaaksa_AO: Harma halaalaa, qalbiin ishii ilaala.
Translation_Literal_EN: Breasts seen from afar, the mind fixates on them.
Meaning_AO: Wanti fagootti mul'atu yeroo hunda dharraafi yaada namaa kakaasa; fageenyi wantoota akka mi'aawaa fakkaatan godha.
Meaning_EN: Distant attractions or unattainable desires constantly preoccupy the mind; things viewed from afar appear overwhelmingly alluring.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan fagootti argu tokko hawwuun qalbii dhabu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how distance magnifies fascination and desire, making distant objects or people obsess one's thoughts.
Keywords_AO: harma, halaalaa, qalbii, ilaaluu, hawwii
Keywords_EN: breast, distance, mind, gaze, longing, allure

Mammaaksa_AO: Olii dhabee, oli dhaqa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Lacking from above, he goes upwards.
Meaning_AO: Namni bakka dhimmi isaa hin furamin irraa abdii kutee, ammas gara gubbaatti carraaqqii fi gargaarsa dabalataa barbaada.
Meaning_EN: Having failed to find help or sustenance from regular higher sources, one ventures even further upward in desperate pursuit.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhabee rakkoon itti hammaatu bakka biraatti barbaacha fagaatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken of someone who, finding no relief from immediate superiors, is driven to seek remedies further afield.
Keywords_AO: olii, dhabuu, dhaquu, carraaqqii
Keywords_EN: above, lack, go up, pursuit, desperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Kajeellaan, ijaaf hammaatteeti, garaaf tolti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Covetousness is shameful for the eye, but pleasing to the stomach.
Meaning_AO: Wanta namaa kajeeluun ykn kadhachuun qaanii fi salphina ijaaf fiduus, garaa beela'eef garuu quufa fida.
Meaning_EN: Begging or coveting another's food embarrasses one's pride and eyes, but satisfies the desperate physical demands of the belly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni beelaan qabame qaanii dhiisee kajeellee nyaata argatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when extreme necessity or hunger forces someone to endure the social embarrassment of asking for food.
Keywords_AO: kajeellaa, ija, hammeenya, garaa, tola
Keywords_EN: covet, eye, shame, stomach, pleasure, hunger

Mammaaksa_AO: Qalbiin saree, gara mataa.
Translation_Literal_EN: The dog's mind is toward the head.
Meaning_AO: Namni fedhii foonii ykn faayidaa qofarratti xiyyeeffatu, qalbiin isaa yeroo mara gara dantaa isaatti qajeela.
Meaning_EN: A dog's entire attention is fixated on the butchered head and scraps; similarly, a self-serving opportunist thinks solely of their immediate cut.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan biraa dhiisee faayidaa dhuunfaa qofarratti xiyyeeffatu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock an opportunist who ignores all broader concerns and stays laser-focused on acquiring their personal spoils.
Keywords_AO: qalbii, saree, garaa, mataa, dantaa
Keywords_EN: mind, dog, head, focus, greed, opportunistic

Mammaaksa_AO: Ayliin Adurree funyaanirra.
Translation_Literal_EN: The cat's intelligence is on its nose.
Meaning_AO: Namni hubannoo fagootti hin yaanne, wantuma dura isaatti mul'atu ykn dhihootti dhuunfatu qofa arga; yaada gabaabaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: A cat's wit extends no further than the tip of its nose; said of short-sighted individuals who only react to what is directly in front of them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama wanta fagoo hin yaanneefi dhihootti qofa burjaaja'u qeeqan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to criticize someone who lacks foresight and is driven purely by immediate instinct and proximity.
Keywords_AO: aylii, adurree, funyaan, hubannoo
Keywords_EN: wits, cat, nose, short-sighted, impulsive

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni ilkee hin qabne, foonitti maraata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A toothless person goes crazy for meat.
Meaning_AO: Namni dandeettii wanta tokko itti fayyadamuu hin qabne, wantichuma sana daran hawwa; wanti hin danda'amne nama kajeelchiisa.
Meaning_EN: A person lacking teeth craves tough meat the most; people often passionately desire what they are least equipped to consume or handle.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta humnaa fi dandeettii isaatiin ol ta'e dharra'u qeeqan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to poke fun at someone yearning desperately for something they cannot properly enjoy, manage, or utilize.
Keywords_AO: nama, ilkee, foon, maraachuu, hawwii
Keywords_EN: person, toothless, meat, crazy, futile desire

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishingaan bilchaate, kan muru hin dhabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Ripe sorghum will never lack someone to harvest it.
Meaning_AO: Wanti gaariin, bilchaateefi faayidaaf qophii ta'e yoomiyyuu gatii fi fudhatama hin dhabu; dandeettiin mul'ataan barbaadama.
Meaning_EN: Ripe grain never lacks harvesters; when talent, beauty, or a valuable opportunity reaches maturity, eager takers will naturally appear.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dandeettii qabuufi bilchaate abdachiisan ykn intala fuudhaaf geesse ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure someone accomplished or mature that their worth will inevitably attract recognition or marriage proposals.
Keywords_AO: bishingaa, bilchaachuu, muruu, qophii
Keywords_EN: sorghum, ripe, harvest, maturity, value

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni nagaan guddate, boo'ichaaf dharra'a.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who grew up in peace craves weeping.
Meaning_AO: Namni rakkinaafi qormaata jireenyaa argee hin beekne, wanta nagaa fi tasgabbii qabu tuffatee balaa fi jeequmsa hawwa.
Meaning_EN: Someone who has known only sheltered tranquility takes peace for granted and perversely flirts with drama or conflict.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni nagaan jiraachuu dadhabee ofii isaatiif lola ykn dhiphina uumu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a privileged person who has never suffered creates needless trouble or drama out of boredom.
Keywords_AO: nama, nagaa, guddachuu, boo'icha, dharra'uu
Keywords_EN: person, peace, grow up, crying, drama, restless

Mammaaksa_AO: Allaattiin foon argitee, samii'rra marsiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The vulture seeing meat circles in the sky.
Meaning_AO: Namni dantaa fi faayidaa argachuuf qophaa'e, osoo ifatti hin seenin fagoodhaa naanna'ee carraa eeggata.
Meaning_EN: When an opportunist spots a lucrative prize, they hover patiently from a distance, watching and circling until the right moment to strike.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dantaa argachuuf haala eeggatee naanna'u ibsuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when an opportunist hovers nearby waiting to swoop down upon a profitable opening or vulnerable asset.
Keywords_AO: allaattii, foon, samii, marsuu, dantaa
Keywords_EN: bird, vulture, meat, sky, circle, opportunist

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijji waan namaa hin fuune.
Translation_Literal_EN: The eye does not take what belongs to another.
Meaning_AO: Ilaaluun qofti miidhaa hin fidu; namni wanta namaa arguun dhoorkamuu hin danda'u, ilaalchi hanna miti.
Meaning_EN: Merely looking at something does not deplete it or constitute theft; looking is harmless and costs nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan tokko ilaale jedhamee qeeqamu ofirraa deebisuuf dubbatu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken in defense when someone is accused of staring or gazing, reminding others that looking steals nothing and harms nobody.
Keywords_AO: ija, waan namaa, fuudhuu, ilaaluu
Keywords_EN: eye, belong to another, take, look, harmless

Mammaaksa_AO: "Ballaa maal barbaadda" jennaan, "ifa" jedhe.
Translation_Literal_EN: When they asked the blind man 'What do you seek?', he replied 'Light.'
Meaning_AO: Wanta namatti hir'ate ykn barbaachisaa ta'e ifatti beekuun nama hin dhibu; fedhiin bu'uuraa nama hundumaa ifaadha.
Meaning_EN: The most urgent need of any deprived person is obvious; one should not ask superfluous questions when the essential necessity is evident.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti namni tokko barbaadu baay'ee ifa ta'ee osoo jiruu gaaffii bu'aa hin qabne gaafatan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone asks a painfully redundant question about what someone in obvious need actually desires.
Keywords_AO: ballaa, barbaaduu, ifa, gaaffii
Keywords_EN: blind man, seek, light, obvious need, redundant

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka garaan jiru, miilli nama geessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Where the heart lies, the feet will carry a person.
Meaning_AO: Namni bakka dantaan, jaalallii fi faayidaan isaa jiru kamiyyuu akka fedhetti qaxxaamuree ni deema.
Meaning_EN: Wherever one's desire, heart, or food lies, one's feet will inevitably find a way to travel there; longing motivates action.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma jaallatu ykn dantaa isaatiif fageenya utuu hin jenne deemuu isaa ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to explain why someone travels great distances or overcomes obstacles to reach where their true affections lie.
Keywords_AO: garaa, miila, geessuu, fedhii, jaalala
Keywords_EN: stomach, heart, feet, lead, desire, journey

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waan galgala jedhan san laata ni irraanfatanii" jedhe, waraabessi.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Could they have possibly forgotten what they said in the evening?', wondered the hyena.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan ykn dantaa barbaadu waan namoonni jedhan irratti qabamee carraa eeggata; yaaddoo dhuunfaatiin burjaaja'a.
Meaning_EN: An anxious opportunist continually frets that people might have forgotten their promises, hoping against hope to exploit the situation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dantaa barbaadu waan kanaan dura waadame eegaa yaaddoodhaan rakkatu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock an outsider or predator who restlessly wonders whether people will drop their guard or fulfill casual words.
Keywords_AO: galgala, jedhan, irraanfachuu, waraabessa
Keywords_EN: evening, promises, forget, hyena, anticipation

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan takka bultii, ijji sagal bulti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A guest stays for one night, but the eye stays for nine [nights].
Meaning_AO: Keessummaan mana namaa kan turtu halkanuma tokko qofa ta'ullee, simannaan, kabajni, amallii fi wanti ijaan argan sun garuu yeroo dheeraaf (halkan sagal) yaadatamaa, odeeffamaa fi qalbiitti hafa. Kanaafuu, keessummaa kabajaan simachuun fi keessummaanis naamusaan of qabuun barbaachisaadha; oolmaan halkan tokkoo maqaa yeroo dheeraa fida.
Meaning_EN: A guest may lodge under your roof for only a single night, but the eye—the impression, memory, reputation, and social scrutiny of that visit—lingers for nine nights. The conduct of both guest and host leaves an enduring legacy long after the visit concludes; therefore, hosts must offer generous hospitality and visitors must observe impeccable decorum.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo keessummaa simatanitti turtii ishee gabaabaa laalanii dantaa dhabuu dhiisanii kabaja guutuu akka kennan gorsuuf, yookaan keessummaan amala isaa akka eeggatu yaadachiisuuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct hosts to receive visitors with utmost warmth and generosity because their hospitality will be talked about for days, or to remind guests that their conduct during a brief stay leaves a lasting social impression.
Keywords_AO: keessummaa; takka; sagal; buluu; ija; simannaa; maqaa gaarii; aadaa
Keywords_EN: guest; one night; nine nights; eye; lasting impression; hospitality; memory; reputation

Mammaaksa_AO: "Osoo akka kiyyaatii, warri hundi karra hin cufatu"  jedhe, waraabessi.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'If it were up to me, no household would ever close its gate,' said the hyena.
Meaning_AO: Namni hataan ykn dantaa qabu namoonni hundi of eeggannoo akka dhiisanii fi akka saamamaniif mijatu hawwa.
Meaning_EN: A predator naturally wishes that all gates be left unlocked; enemies always wish for their targets to abandon their defenses.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo diinni ykn hataan gorsa sobaa kennuun akka namni of eeggannoo dhiisu godhu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a malicious party advises people to lower their defenses, illustrating the absurdity of trusting an adversary's counsel.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, karra, cufachuu, diina, hawwii
Keywords_EN: hyena, gate, close, predator, vulnerability, defense

Mammaaksa_AO: "Tiyyaaf illee hin jennee, gurbaan keeysan sun fuudha hin dubbatuu?" jette, haftuun.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Not that I'm asking for myself, but isn't that son of yours speaking of marriage?' asked the spinster.
Meaning_AO: Namni dantaa ofii dhoksaan barbaadu akka waan nama biraatiif yaaduutti fakkeessaa haasa'a; sobatti fayyadamu.
Meaning_EN: Feigning pure altruism or casual curiosity, an eager spinster probes about an eligible bachelor to advance her own marital prospects.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dantaa dhuunfaa qabu karaa nama biraatiin akka waan dhimma hin qabneetti dhiheessu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to tease someone who asks a leading question while pretending total detachment, when in reality they are fishing for themselves.
Keywords_AO: haftuu, gurbaa, fuudha, dubbachuu, dantaa
Keywords_EN: spinster, boy, marriage, feigned disinterest, subtle inquiry

Mammaaksa_AO: "Addaan ooluu dhoorkaa, armaa yaa'uu dhoorkaa"  jette, haftuun.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Prevent them from staying separate, prevent them from dispersing here,' said the spinster.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofiif bakka dhabe ykn hireen irra dabre, walitti dhufuun nama biraa akka hin milkoofneef shiraafi jeequmsa fida.
Meaning_EN: Having missed her own opportunities, an envious person seeks to dictate, confuse, and obstruct the harmonious unions of others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan ofiif dhabeef jireenya nama biraa danquu barbaadu balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to mock an envious meddler who imposes contradictory, impossible restrictions on others out of sheer jealousy.
Keywords_AO: addaan, ooluu, dhoorkuu, yaa'uu, haftuu
Keywords_EN: separate, prevent, disperse, spinster, envy, meddling

Mammaaksa_AO: Karra masheenaa, kan haftuun hawwite.
Translation_Literal_EN: The cattle pen of barren cows, which the unmarried woman covets.
Meaning_AO: Wanta dhugoomuu hin dandeenye ykn bu'aa hin qabne dharra'uun faayidaa hin fidu; hawwii sobaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Desiring barren livestock or empty prospects brings no real benefit; wishing desperately for unproductive things.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta bu'aa hin qabneefi dhaloota hin godhanne tokko hawwu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone longing eagerly for something fundamentally barren or unproductive.
Keywords_AO: karra, masheena, haftuu, hawwuu
Keywords_EN: pen, barren cow, spinster, covet, futile

Mammaaksa_AO: Asiitu laafa jennaan shilmiin gamaa dhufte.
Translation_Literal_EN: When told 'Here the skin is tender', the tick came from across the river.
Meaning_AO: Namni dantaa fi faayidaa barbaadu bakka wanti salphaatti argamu dhaga'ee dafee itti dhangala'a.
Meaning_EN: When freeloaders hear of an easy opportunity or tender mark, they flock there immediately from far away.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni faayidaa salphaa fi dahoo dadhabaa argatanii itti rarra'an balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to criticize parasites and opportunists who swarm upon hearing of an easy, defenseless mark.
Keywords_AO: laafa, shilmii, gamaa, dhufuu, dantaa
Keywords_EN: tender, tick, across, opportunism, parasite

Mammaaksa_AO: "Baasaan baasaa, gadi na baasaa"  jette, haftuun.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Under whatever pretext, just bring me out!', cried the spinster.
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta tokko baay'ee dharra'e haalaafi qajeelfama osoo hin filatin akkamittiyyuu haa ta'u jedhee wawwaata.
Meaning_EN: Desperate for a husband or resolution, someone drops all standards, pleading to be accommodated under any condition.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni haala rakkisaa keessatti qajeelfama dhiisee maalumaafuu haa ta'u jedhu itti qoosuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to tease someone so desperate to achieve a goal that they discard all dignity, criteria, and discretion.
Keywords_AO: baasuu, gadi, haftuu, jarjaruu
Keywords_EN: pretext, bring out, spinster, marriage, desperate

Mammaaksa_AO: Silaa hin ooluu, kajeelaa dura waamaa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Since he won't stay away anyway, invite the covetous one beforehand.
Meaning_AO: Namni osoo hin waaminis dhufuun isaa hin oolle, duraan dursa waamanii kabajaan simachuutu rakkina irraa nama oolcha.
Meaning_EN: Since an insistent freeloader will inevitably show up uninvited, it is wiser to invite them formally from the start.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama waamicha malee dhufuuf jiru duraan dursanii affeeruun akka mufannaa dhabamsiisu murteessan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when proactively including a persistent hanger-on to avoid awkward gatecrashing later.
Keywords_AO: ooluu, kajeelaa, dura, waamuu
Keywords_EN: unavoidable, coveter, before, invite, diplomacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Foon hin nyaannuun, osoo garaachi hin urgaawini.
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying 'We don't eat meat' only lasts until the tripe smells appetizing.
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta tokko hin barbaadu ykn hin jaalladhu jedhee waakkatus, yeroo wantichi mi'aawaa dhiyaatu amala jijjiirrata.
Meaning_EN: People proudly claim they have no appetite for something, right up until the enticing aroma tempts them to indulge.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan tokko hin kajeelu jedhee boodarra kajeellaadhaan harkifamu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when someone vehemently denies wanting something, but eagerly dives in the second it becomes available.
Keywords_AO: foon, nyaachuu, garaacha, urgaawuu, fakkeessaa
Keywords_EN: meat, eat, tripe, aroma, temptation, pretense

Mammaaksa_AO: Saree warri guddise dhabe, warri raqaa argata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The dog that the family raised is lost to them, but the owners of the carcass find it.
Meaning_AO: Namni ykn meeshaan maatiin guddisanii fi kunuunsan dhimma maatiitiif dhabamee, bakka faayidaa hin qabneetti argama.
Meaning_EN: A household nurtures a dog only to lose its loyalty, while strangers with carcass scraps easily command its presence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama gargaaranii guddisan tokko maatii ganuu fi warra bu'aa yeroof kenneef bulu komatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament how ungrateful people abandon their dedicated benefactors the moment superficial treats appear.
Keywords_AO: saree, warra, guddise, raqa, argachuu
Keywords_EN: dog, raise, family, carcass, ingratitude, disloyalty

Mammaaksa_AO: "Akkam foon jaaladhullee huqqattuu hin nyaadhu" jette, jeedalloon.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'However much I love meat, I won't eat an emaciated carcass,' said the jackal.
Meaning_AO: Namni dharraa fi fedhii qabaatuyyuu sadarkaa fi ulfina ofii dhiisee wanta gatii hin qabne hin fudhatu.
Meaning_EN: Despite intense craving, one pretends to maintain high standards and scorns inferior offerings to save face.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan argate tuffachuun akka waan filatuutti boonu qeeqan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to tease someone in deep need who hypocritically turns their nose up at modest help to save face.
Keywords_AO: foon, jaallachuu, huqqattuu, nyaachuu, jeedalloo
Keywords_EN: meat, love, skinny, jackal, false pride, pickiness

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni waan hin argin hin abjootu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person does not dream of what they have never seen.
Meaning_AO: Yaada, hawwii fi abjuun namaa wantuma jireenya keessatti argeefi beeku irratti hundaa'a; beekumsa malee dharraan hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Human imagination and desires are bounded by what one has observed; you cannot covet what you have never known.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo fedhiin namaa bu'uura muuxannoo isaa irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to explain that a person's ambitions, dreams, and yearnings are strictly shaped by their exposure.
Keywords_AO: nama, argu, abjoomuu, muuxannoo
Keywords_EN: person, see, dream, experience, imagination

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkaan foonii, garaa keessa jira.
Translation_Literal_EN: The tooth for meat is inside the belly.
Meaning_AO: Fedhiin wanta tokko argachuu fi mi'aa isaa dhandhamuu garaadhaani; dharraan dhugaa keessa namaatii madaala.
Meaning_EN: The true appetite and drive to acquire meat reside deep within the stomach; true determination is fueled by inner hunger.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo fedhiin wanta tokkoo garaa keessaa kan maddu ta'uu fi qalbii namaa hogganu ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that real drive and motivation come from deep-seated visceral desire and inner hunger.
Keywords_AO: ilkaan, foon, garaa, fedhii
Keywords_EN: tooth, meat, stomach, appetite, desire

Mammaaksa_AO: Minniin, qabbana diddeeti, oowwatti gamti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The tapeworm, refusing the cold, plunges into heat.
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta nagaa fi tasgabbii qabu didee fedhii dhuunfaatiin balaa fi dhiphina keessa of seensa.
Meaning_EN: Recklessly fleeing modest discomfort, the foolish plunge headlong into blazing danger; jumping from the pan into the fire.
Theme_EN: Self-destructive Choice / Fire vs Frying Pan
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta salphaa baqachuuf jedhee balaa hamaa keessatti kufu akeekkachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when someone hastily escapes a minor inconvenience only to entrap themselves in a fatal catastrophe.
Keywords_AO: minnii, qabbana, oowwa, gamuu, balaa
Keywords_EN: tapeworm, cold, heat, plunge, frying pan, folly

Mammaaksa_AO: "Hamma ija kootii naaf hin kajeeltu" jette, sareen.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'You don't wish for me as much as my eye desires,' said the dog.
Meaning_AO: Hawwii fi fedhiin namni dantaa barbaadu qabu hamma namoonni isaaf kennan caalaa baay'ee guddaadha.
Meaning_EN: The expectations and hungry gaze of the needy far exceed what anyone is willing or able to give them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo fedhiin kajeelaa dandeettii nama kennuutiin ol ta'uu ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to illustrate that a recipient's internal yearning is far greater than the modest charity offered to them.
Keywords_AO: ija, kajeeluu, saree, fedhii
Keywords_EN: eye, covet, dog, desire, disparity

Mammaaksa_AO: Kajeellaan, waan namaa, nama hin nyaachisu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Coveting another's goods does not feed a person.
Meaning_AO: Wanta nama biraa ijaan ilaaluufi hawwuun garaa namaa hin quubsu; of danda'anii hojjechuutu furmaata.
Meaning_EN: Simply lusting after other people's possessions puts no food in your belly; only one's own hard work sustains life.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama wanta namaa irratti ija buusee ofii hojjechuu dide gorsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who wastes time envying other people's wealth instead of working for their own.
Keywords_AO: kajeellaa, waan namaa, nyaachisuu, hojii
Keywords_EN: covet, property, eat, work, self-reliance

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama fardaan barbaadani, laffatti argatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: The person searched for on horseback is found right on foot.
Meaning_AO: Wanti fagootti baay'ee itti dhama'anii barbaadan salphaatti fi dhihootti osoo hin yaadin argama.
Meaning_EN: Someone or something sought far and wide with massive effort turns out to be right nearby within easy reach.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti fagootti barbaadamaa ture dhihootti salphaatti argamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a difficult, exhausting search unexpectedly resolves easily and close at hand.
Keywords_AO: farda, barbaaduu, lafa, argachuu, carraa
Keywords_EN: horse, search, foot, find, unexpected

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waan jaalatan nyaatanii, kan jibban namni haa nyaatuuf hin kennanii?" jedhe, waraabessi.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'They eat what they like, so why won't they let someone else eat what they dislike?' asked the hyena.
Meaning_AO: Namni doqni wanta ofiif hin barbaanne illee nama dhabeef kennuu hin fedhu; amala doqnummaa qeeqaa.
Meaning_EN: Misers hoard even discarded remnants that they despise rather than letting needy scavengers partake.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni wanta ofiif hin fayyadamne illee namaaf dhowwatan balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock dog-in-the-manger behavior where people refuse to share leftovers they have no use for.
Keywords_AO: jaallachuu, jibbuu, nyaachuu, kennuu, waraabessa
Keywords_EN: like, hate, eat, give, hyena, stinginess

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni bakka ciisu argate, bakka diriirfatu barbaada.
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who finds a place to lie down seeks a place to stretch out.
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta muraasa yoo argate daangaa dhabee dabalata barbaada; quubsa dhabuu fi kajeellaa babal'atu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Give someone an inch and they will take a mile; once a basic privilege is granted, greed immediately demands full comfort.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gargaarsa xiqqoo argatee booda dabalata dursa hin turre barbaadee dhiphisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when someone takes advantage of hospitality or leeway and demands ever more accommodations.
Keywords_AO: bakka, ciisuu, diriirfachu, barbaaduu
Keywords_EN: place, lie down, stretch out, seek, entitlement

Mammaaksa_AO: Abjuun bara beelaa, biddeena biddeena jetti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The dream of a famine year chants: 'Bread, bread!'
Meaning_AO: Yeroo rakkinaafi beelaa, yaadaafi hawwiin nama hundumaa wantuma bu'uuraa dhabame sana qofarratti xiyyeeffata.
Meaning_EN: In times of severe deprivation, all thoughts, hopes, and dreams are obsessively centered on basic survival and food.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni rakkoo hamaa keessatti waan biraa yaaduu dadhabanii wantuma dhabaniif wawwaatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how crisis and famine strip away luxuries, focusing all human desire strictly on daily sustenance.
Keywords_AO: abjuu, beela, biddeena, dharraa
Keywords_EN: dream, famine, bread, hunger, survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Rarra'aa foon magaalaa, ijji hin fuune.
Translation_Literal_EN: Hanging meat in the market, the eye does not take it.
Meaning_AO: Wanta bareedaa fi mi'aawaa ilaaluun qofti nama hin miidhu; wanta fagootti mul'atu arguun dhoorkaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: The hanging cuts of meat in the butchery can be admired by any passerby without penalty; looking costs nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan tokko ilaaluun isaa yakka akka hin taane ibsuuf itti fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss complaints about gazing at attractive goods on display, affirming that looking violates no laws.
Keywords_AO: rarra'aa, foon, magaalaa, ija, fuudhuu
Keywords_EN: hanging, meat, market, eye, gaze, harmless
