Mammaaksa_AO: "Isa kanniisni arge argi" jedheeti, bookee ule.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Experience what the bee experienced!' he said, striking at the gnat.
Meaning_AO: Wanta namni humna qabu tokko dandamatee dabarse, nama dadhabaa irratti fe'anii adabuun miidhaa fida; wal hin madaalu.
Meaning_EN: Punishing a frail gnat with the ferocity intended for a bee is disproportionate and unjust; treating unequal things equally.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dadhabaa tokkorratti humna guddaa fi adabbii wal hin gitne raawwatan balaaleffatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to criticize someone who unleashes excessive anger or punishment upon a weak, defenseless scapegoat.
Keywords_AO: kanniisa, argu, bookee, uluu, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: bee, experience, gnat, strike, excessive, disproportionate

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma kan nyaatu fixutti, kan kajeelu hin deemu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Until the one who eats finishes, the one who covets will not depart.
Meaning_AO: Namni dantaa barbaadu hamma carraan dhumatutti ykn abdii kutatutti bakka dantaa sanarraa hin fagaatu.
Meaning_EN: An expectant freeloader or beggar will not budge an inch until the eater has swallowed the very last morsel.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dantaa eeggatu tokko hanga dhumatti rakkisee nama biraa hin deemne ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a persistent observer lingers uncomfortably until every scrap of food or opportunity is completely exhausted.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, fixuu, kajeeluu, deemuu
Keywords_EN: eat, finish, covet, linger, wait

Mammaaksa_AO: "Lukkuun sireerra taa'uun qaanii dha" jette, jeedalloon.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'It is a disgrace for a chicken to sit on a bed,' said the jackal.
Meaning_AO: Diinni ykn inaaffaan namaa bakka ulfinaa namaaf hin hawwu; waan ofiif dhabeef nama biraatti hinaafa.
Meaning_EN: The predator complains of impropriety when its prey is safely elevated out of reach; masking envy as moral outrage.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dantaa dhabe tokko milkaa'ina nama biraa akka waan badii ta'eetti qeequ saaxilan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock an envious adversary who invents bogus moral complaints when their target enjoys safety beyond their reach.
Keywords_AO: lukkuu, siree, taa'uu, qaanii, jeedhalloo
Keywords_EN: chicken, bed, shame, jackal, envy, sour grapes

Mammaaksa_AO: Sirba tole, namuu ni jaalata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A song that turned out well is loved by everyone.
Meaning_AO: Wanti qulqullinaan hojjetameefi bareede hunda biratti fudhatamaafi jaalala argata; hojiin gaariin ofiisaa beeksisa.
Meaning_EN: Excellence, beauty, and harmonious work are universally appreciated; fine craftsmanship wins universal praise.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojiin ykn dubbiin mi'aawaan hunda gammachiise dinqisiifamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken in praise of a well-executed initiative, captivating song, or articulate speech that delights all listeners.
Keywords_AO: sirba, toluu, jaallachuu, qulqullina
Keywords_EN: song, pleasant, love, excellence, acclaim

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan dhoksaan rakkatan, ijaatu keessa jira.
Translation_Literal_EN: Whatever one suffers in secret, the eye carries the evidence.
Meaning_AO: Rakkinaafi dhiphina keessa namaa dhoksuun hin danda'amu; kophummaan dhokatullee ijaafi bifa namaarratti mul'ata.
Meaning_EN: Internal grief, hunger, or secret anguish cannot stay hidden; the eyes and facial countenance inevitably betray inner torment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiphina isaa dhoksuuf yaalus fuulaafi ija isaarratti mul'atu hubachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when discerning someone's secret sorrows or hardships plainly reflected in their weary eyes and demeanor.
Keywords_AO: dhoksaa, rakkachuu, ija, miira
Keywords_EN: secret, suffer, eye, emotion, betrayed sorrow

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan humnaan lafaa hin kaane, yaadaan Awroophatti daldala.
Translation_Literal_EN: He who cannot physically rise from the ground trades in Europe in his imagination.
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii qabatamaa xiqqoollee raawwachuu hin dandeenye, abjuu fi yaadaan waan guddaa haasa'a; dhibaa'ummaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: One who lacks the energy to get off the floor concocts grandiose fantasies of trading across Europe; idle daydreaming.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hojii dhiisee abjuu fi haasaa gurguddaan of gowwoomsu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock an idle, lazy braggart whose grand ambitions exist solely in their head while they do no actual work.
Keywords_AO: humna, lafa, yaada, Awrooppaa, daldala
Keywords_EN: strength, ground, thoughts, Europe, trade, daydream

Mammaaksa_AO: Sagalee kee dhagayeetiin, sagal manaa bahe.
Translation_Literal_EN: Upon hearing your voice, I came out of the house nine times.
Meaning_AO: Jaalala, fedhiifi dharraa guddaa irraa kan ka'e, mallattoo xiqqoo dhaga'uun tarkaanfii deddeebi'anii fudhachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Driven by intense affection and anticipation, one rushes outdoors repeatedly at the slightest sound of a beloved voice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama jaallatan tokko simachuuf hawwiidhaan deddeebi'anii eegan ibsuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to express intense yearning and delighted anticipation at the arrival of a loved one or cherished friend.
Keywords_AO: sagalee, dhaga'uu, sagal, ba'uu, jaalala
Keywords_EN: voice, hear, nine times, exit, anticipation, affection

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabessi waan halkan nyaatu, guyya abjuudhaan arga.
Translation_Literal_EN: What the hyena will eat at night, it envisions in daytime dreams.
Meaning_AO: Namni fedhii hamaa ykn dantaa qabu, yeroo hunda waan fuulduratti saamuufi miidhu yaadaatiin qophaa'a.
Meaning_EN: A predator constantly meditates upon its forthcoming nightly plunder even during broad daylight; ceaseless scheming.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dantaa barbaadu wanta saamuuf yaada keessa qabatee fiigu qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to describe a greedy schemer who spends all their waking hours plotting future exploitation.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, halkan, guyyaa, abjuu, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: hyena, night, day, dream, plotting, appetite

Mammaaksa_AO: Adurree nyaattee, sareen afaan haxaawatti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Having eaten a cat, the dog wipes its mouth.
Meaning_AO: Namni gocha badaa, dhowwamaa yookaan qaanii ta'e dhoksaan raawwatee, akka waan qulqulluu ta'etti badii isaa dhoksuuf fakkeessu yookaan of qulqulleessu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: It describes a hypocritical person who secretly commits a shameful or wrongful act and then wipes away the evidence to pretend they are innocent and blameless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni balleessaa yookaan gocha fokkisaa raawwate tokko akka waan homaa hin hojjetinitti of qulqulleessuu fi fakkeessuu yaalu balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose or mock someone who pretends innocence and acts upright after secretly committing a disgraceful or deceitful deed.
Keywords_AO: adurree, saree, afaan, haxaawuu, fakkeessummaa
Keywords_EN: cat, dog, mouth, wipe, hypocrisy, deception, guilt

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhaltee hin beektuu, dhalaaf jarjarti.
Translation_Literal_EN: She has never given birth, yet she rushes for childbirth.
Meaning_AO: Namni ulfina, rakkinaa fi itti gaafatamummaa hojii yookaan dhimma tokkoo osoo muuxannoo hin qabaatin, salphaa itti fakkaatee gara sanatti kan jarjaru ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: It illustrates how an inexperienced person eagerly rushes into a heavy responsibility or difficult challenge without truly understanding the pain, hardship, and effort it demands.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni muuxannoo hin qabne ulfina hojii yookaan jireenyaa osoo hin hubatin dhimma guddaatti jarjaree seenu gorsuuf yookaan itti qoosuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution or tease an inexperienced person who rashly undertakes or comments on serious obligations before experiencing their true weight.
Keywords_AO: dhaluu, dhala, jarjarsuu, muuxannoo, gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: childbirth, rushing, inexperience, responsibility, impatience

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan gowwaan, ganaana dinnichaati kajeela.
Translation_Literal_EN: A foolish stomach craves potato foliage.
Meaning_AO: Gowwaan waan gatii hin qabne, hin nyaatamne yookaan nama miidhu hawwuu fi kajeeluun bu'aa dhugaa akka dhabu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: A foolish mind or undisciplined desire covets worthless, inedible, or harmful things instead of seeking genuine value and true nourishment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gowwummaadhaan waan faayidaa hin qabne yookaan kan isa miidhu kajeelu yoo argu akka gorsaatti yookaan itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock or warn someone whose greed or lack of discernment leads them to long for useless, inferior, or detrimental things.
Keywords_AO: garaa, gowwaa, ganaana, dinnicha, kajeellaa
Keywords_EN: stomach, foolish, foliage, potato, craving, desire

Mammaaksa_AO: Heerri heeraa, aadaan diqaala.
Translation_Literal_EN: The constitutional law is pure law, while custom is hybrid.
Meaning_AO: Heerri Oromoo seera bu'uuraa kan jijjiiramuu hin dandeenyee fi haqa qajeelaadha; aadaan garuu yeroofi bakkaan jijjiiramuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: The supreme customary law is immutable and authoritative; local traditions and cultural variations are secondary and flexible.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo falmiin heeraafi aadaa gidduutti uumamu heeratu caala jechuuf fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken during traditional assemblies or legal deliberations to assert that constitutional law supersedes mere cultural variance.
Keywords_AO: heera, aadaa, diqaala, seera, haqa
Keywords_EN: heera, customary law, culture, hybrid, supremacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Heerri mana qaba, manni abba qaba.
Translation_Literal_EN: The law has a house, and the house has a master.
Meaning_AO: Seerri bakka itti murtaa'uu fi hooggana seera eegsisu qaba; seerri akkasumaan lafatti hin dhiifamu, sirnaan gaggeeffama.
Meaning_EN: Law resides in an established institutional council, and every council has recognized authority; justice operates through legitimate institutions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni seeraan alatti dhimma furuu barbaadan gara sirna seeraafi qajeelfamaatti deebisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to insist that legal disputes must be channeled through recognized customary institutions and sanctioned elders.
Keywords_AO: heera, mana, abbaa, sirna, seera
Keywords_EN: law, house, authority, institution, due process

Mammaaksa_AO: Leeccaallo soddaaf dhiisan malee, heera soddaaf hin dhiisani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One may concede a gift to an in-law, but one never compromises the law for an in-law.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyaan ykn arjummaan soddaa kabajuun danda'ama, garuu dhimma haqaa fi seeraa irratti firummaan hin hojjetu; seerri hundaaf wal qixa.
Meaning_EN: One can be generous with gifts or property toward in-laws, but the rule of law must never be bent or waived for family ties.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo murtee seeraa keessatti firummaan akka loogiin hin godhamne dhaabbatan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken by elders or judges to affirm that familial connections will not sway the impartial execution of justice.
Keywords_AO: leeccaallo, soddaa, dhiisuu, heera, haqa
Keywords_EN: concession, in-law, compromise, law, impartiality

Mammaaksa_AO: Oromoon seeraan bulti, sidaamni firdiin bula.
Translation_Literal_EN: The Oromo live by constitutional consensus, while other nations live by top-down decrees.
Meaning_AO: Oromoon heeraafi seera walta'iinsaan tumamee fi waliigalteedhaan kabajamee bula malee firdii gubbaadhaa fe'amuun hin hoogganamu.
Meaning_EN: The Oromo society governs itself through democratic consensus and internalized constitutional law, rather than imposed authoritarian rulings.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo addunyaa fi hawaasaaf bu'uura bulchiinsa Oromoo kan walta'iinsaa fi heera irratti hundaa'e ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to articulate the fundamental philosophy of participatory, consensus-based governance in Oromo traditional democracy.
Keywords_AO: Oromoo, seera, buluu, sidaama, firdii
Keywords_EN: Oromo, consensus law, governance, verdict, democracy

Mammaaksa_AO: Barcumarraa waliif ka'an malee, heerarraa waliif hin ka'ani.
Translation_Literal_EN: People yield a seat out of courtesy, but they never yield the law for anyone.
Meaning_AO: Ulfinaafi kabajaaf teessuma namaa kennuun ni danda'ama, garuu haqaafi seera namarra dabsanii dabarfatanii kennuun hin danda'amu; heerri hin cabeessu.
Meaning_EN: One yields a physical seat out of politeness and respect, but justice and the law can never be surrendered or compromised for anyone.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni aangoo ykn kabaja qaban seeraan ol of gochuuf yaalan dhaabsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used by customary judges to demonstrate that while elders are shown personal courtesy, the law itself favors no individual.
Keywords_AO: barcuma, ka'uu, heera, haqa, seera
Keywords_EN: stool, seat, yield, law, integrity, justice

Mammaaksa_AO: Himannoon bilisummaa dha, heera fudhachuuniis bilisummaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Filing a grievance is freedom, and accepting the customary ruling is also freedom.
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiyyuu mufannaa isaa seeraan himachuuf mirga guutuu qaba; murtee seeraas amanee fudhachuun nagaafi bilisummaa dhugaa mirkaneessa.
Meaning_EN: Having the right to petition and voice grievances embodies liberty, and willingly submitting to fair judicial verdicts ensures mutual civil freedom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo sirna haqaatiin falmachuu fi murtee seeraa kabajuun nagaa fidu ibsan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken during dispute settlements to encourage both the voicing of complaints and the dignified acceptance of community mediation.
Keywords_AO: himannoo, bilisummaa, heera, fudhachuu, haqa
Keywords_EN: complaint, petition, freedom, accept law, liberty

Mammaaksa_AO: Lammiin namatti jiguurra, gaarri namatti jiguu wayya.
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than one's own clan collapsing upon you, it is better that a mountain collapse upon you.
Meaning_AO: Firiifi lammiin ofii yoo nama ganan ykn namatti duulan miidhaan isaa ulfaataadha; dhibdee fira ofiirraa dhufu baachuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Better that an entire mountain fall on you than to face the devastating betrayal, wrath, and total ostracism of your own clan.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gosti ykn maatiin nama tokkotti dammaqanii murtee ulfaataa irratti dabarsan miidhaa isaa ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to express the crushing, unendurable agony of facing hostility, boycott, or ostracism from one's own people.
Keywords_AO: lammii, jiguu, gaara, gosa, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: kin, collapse, mountain, clan, betrayal, ostracism

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaara namatti jige gosaatu namarraa kaasa, gosa namarratti jiiyde wanni namarraa kaasaa hin jiru.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mountain that collapsed on you can be lifted by your clan, but if your clan collapses upon you, nothing can lift it.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina guddaa kamiyyuu gargaarsa gosaafi firaatiin dhabamsiisuun ni danda'ama; garuu yoo gosti ofii namatti dallante wanti nama baraaru hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: If a mountain falls upon you, your clan can unite to dig you out; but if your own clan turns against you, no earthly power can save you.
Theme_EN: Primacy of Kin Solidarity / Total Ostracism
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gosa ofii waliin nagaan jiraachuun murteessaa ta'uu fi dallansuu gosaa irraa of eeguu qaban ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the supreme importance of maintaining peace with one's kin and the utter hopelessness of communal alienation.
Keywords_AO: gaara, jiguu, gosa, kaasuu, fira
Keywords_EN: mountain, collapse, clan, lift, solidarity, alienation

Mammaaksa_AO: Mormi, qadaaddaa garaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: The neck is the lid of the belly.
Meaning_AO: Waan garaa keessatti yaadamu yookaan iccitii jiru hunda afaaniin baasanii dubbachuun akka hin malleefi namni iccitii qabachuu akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Just as a lid covers a pot, the neck and throat should contain what is inside the belly; a person must possess self-restraint and keep secrets rather than revealing everything.
Theme_EN: Keeping Secrets and Restraint of Speech
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko iccitii garaa keessaa baasee odeessuuf jedhutti akka arraba isaa qabatu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone to practice discretion and guard their secrets instead of blurting out everything they know.
Keywords_AO: morma, qadaaddaa, garaa, iccitii, arraba
Keywords_EN: neck, lid, belly, secret, discretion, restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan minnii ba'atu, maaliif dubbii ba'achuu dadhaba.
Translation_Literal_EN: Why does a stomach that endures tapeworms fail to bear words?
Meaning_AO: Garaan namaa dhukkubaa fi wantoota ulfaatoo ba'atee danda'u, maaliif iccitii fi dubbii dhagaye garaatti qabachuu dadhaba jechuun nama arraba laafaa qeequuf dubbatama.
Meaning_EN: If the human belly can endure physical parasites like tapeworms, it should certainly have the fortitude to hold onto confidential words and keep secrets.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko iccitii dhagahe garaatti qabachuu dadhabee ariitiin namatti odeessu ceepha'uuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand someone who lacks the self-control to keep confidences and leaks secrets easily.
Keywords_AO: garaa, minnii, dubbii, iccitii, obsa
Keywords_EN: stomach, tapeworm, words, secrets, patience, gossip

Mammaaksa_AO: Hunda dubbatan, garaan duwwa hafa.
Translation_Literal_EN: If one speaks everything, the belly remains empty.
Meaning_AO: Waan beekan, arganii fi dhagahan hunda namatti himuun ulfina nama dhabsiisa; namni waan hunda dubbatu iccitii fi kabaja dhabee gatii dhaba.
Meaning_EN: Speaking out every single thing one knows drains a person of mystery, dignity, and strategic advantage, leaving them vulnerable and empty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan qabuufi hin qabne hunda afaaniin baasee dubbatu gorsanii akka arraba isaa qusatu taasisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone against oversharing and to teach that preserving some thoughts in confidence preserves one's dignity.
Keywords_AO: hunda, dubbachuu, garaa, duwwaa, kabaja
Keywords_EN: everything, speaking, belly, empty, discretion, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan waa heddu ba'ata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The belly bears many things.
Meaning_AO: Namni hubataan waan hedduu argaa fi dhagayaa ta'us, hunda namatti baasuu mannaa garaatti qabatee obsaan danda'uu akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: A mature and wise person absorbs, endures, and conceals numerous experiences, grievances, and secrets without reacting or exposing them carelessly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko miidhaa yookaan iccitii ulfaataa obsee danda'uudhaan hawaasa keessatti nagaa uumu galateeffachuuf yookaan gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise emotional maturity, patience, and the ability to hold back heavy confidences or tolerate grievances silently.
Keywords_AO: garaa, hedduu, ba'achuu, obsa, iccitii
Keywords_EN: belly, endurance, tolerance, patience, secrets, fortitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Duugda hin dhungatani, hunda hin dubbatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One cannot kiss one's own back, and one should not speak everything.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma dugda ofii dhungachuun hin danda'amne, waan sammuu fi garaa namaa keessa jiru hunda afaaniin baasanii fixuunis gonkumaa kan hin taaneefi hin malledha.
Meaning_EN: Just as it is physically impossible to kiss one's own back, it is socially unacceptable and foolish to utter every single thing that crosses one's mind.
Theme_EN: Restraint of Speech and Verbal Boundaries
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko daangaa malee waan arges ta'ee waan dhagahe hunda namatti odeessu akka dhaabu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize verbal discipline and remind someone that some things are naturally meant to remain unsaid.
Keywords_AO: dugda, dhungachuu, dubbachuu, arraba, daangaa
Keywords_EN: back, kiss, speak, limitation, restraint, speech

Mammaaksa_AO: Hundumatti, dubbii hin himani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not tell secrets to everyone.
Meaning_AO: Namni hundi nama amanamaa fi iccitii eegu waan hin taaneef, dhimma ofii fi iccitii jireenyaa nama hundaaf facaasuun akka hin taane gorsa.
Meaning_EN: Not everyone is trustworthy or capable of keeping confidence; therefore, sensitive personal affairs should not be disclosed indiscriminately.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama nama argate hunda amanee iccitii ofii himatuuf akka of eeggatu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone against being too trusting and indiscreet with acquaintances regarding their private matters.
Keywords_AO: hundumaa, dubbii, himuu, iccitii, of eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: everyone, words, confide, secrecy, prudence, trust

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessa marqaa, kokorsaatu beeka.
Translation_Literal_EN: The inside of porridge is known by the stirring stick.
Meaning_AO: Iccitii fi haala dhokataa keessa mana yookaan dhimma tokkoo kan beeku nama dhimma sana keessa jiru yookaan itti dhiyaatee qoratu qofadha.
Meaning_EN: Only the person directly involved, living within a situation, or intimate with the circumstances truly understands what goes on behind the scenes.
Theme_AO: Dhoksaa Keessaa fi Dhugaa Bira Ga'uu
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni alaa tokko dhimma keessoo mana namaa yookaan iccitii gosaa osoo hin beekin yaada kennuuf jedhu dhugaa ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when outsiders try to judge or comment on private family or institutional matters without knowing the real inside story.
Keywords_AO: keessa, marqaa, kokorsaa, bojjitoo, beekuu
Keywords_EN: porridge, stirring stick, inside, insider, truth, knowledge

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaa ilaalaa ooluun, mudaa isaa mullisuu dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Spending the day watching the belly exposes its flaws.
Meaning_AO: Waan hanquu yookaan hanqina ofii irra deddeebi'anii namatti himuu fi qeequun, salphinaa fi miidhaa ofii amba duratti fiduu akka ta'e ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Constantly drawing attention to one's own deficiencies, private shortcomings, or hunger only reveals one's vulnerability and invites pity or disrespect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko rakkoo fi dhabinsa mana isaa yeroo hunda haasa'ee of salphisu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone not to parade their financial, emotional, or domestic shortages before others.
Keywords_AO: garaa, ilaaluu, muddaa, mul'isuu, kabaja
Keywords_EN: belly, watching, shortage, vulnerability, dignity, exposure

Mammaaksa_AO: Boolliti qayyaa, "akka agarruun waa hunda hin dubbannu" jette.
Translation_Literal_EN: The censer hole said, 'Though we see, we do not speak of everything.'
Meaning_AO: Bakka dhokataa fi iccitii hawaasaa yoo argan illee, safuu fi kabaja eeganii wantoota qaanii ta'an garaatti qabachuu malee dubbachuun akka hin taane agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Even if one happens to witness the most intimate, embarrassing, or private occurrences, decency and modesty demand absolute silence and discretion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko waan nama dhuunfaa yookaan qaanii arge tokko namatti oduu gochuuf ka'u safuu barsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to discourage gossip regarding private, intimate, or embarrassing situations that an observer witnessed.
Keywords_AO: boolla, qayyaa, arguu, dubbachuu, safuu
Keywords_EN: censer hole, seeing, silence, modesty, privacy, decency

Mammaaksa_AO: Rifeensi lama, tokko kan dirretti haadani, tokko kan dhoksatti haadani.
Translation_Literal_EN: Hair is of two kinds: one shaved in public, and one shaved in private.
Meaning_AO: Jireenya keessatti wanti hawaasa duratti mul'ifamuu fi wanti dhoksaatti qabamuu qabu jiraachuu, safuu fi daangaa jireenyaa eeguu akka barbaachisu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Life consists of public matters that can be openly displayed and private matters that must remain strictly concealed behind closed doors.
Theme_EN: Separation of Public and Private Spheres
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma dhuunfaa fi safuu ta'e tokko dirreetti baasee haasa'u gorsanii daangaa beeksisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reminding people of boundaries between public discussions and confidential or intimate matters.
Keywords_AO: rifeensa, dirree, dhoksaa, haaduu, safuu
Keywords_EN: hair, public, private, shaving, boundaries, modesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Saddeeta lagatti miicaniiti, guftaa manatti miican.
Translation_Literal_EN: Coarse clothes are washed at the river, but a woman's headscarf is washed at home.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko tokko hawaasa duratti furmaata kan argatu yoo ta'u, dhimmi iccitii fi kabaja maatii garuu manuma keessatti dhoksaan furamuu akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Ordinary public issues may be aired openly, but delicate, honorable, and intimate family matters must be resolved privately at home.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoo fi komii maatii yookaan abbaa manaa fi haadha manaa namoota alatti baasanii odeessan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge couples and families not to wash their dirty linen in public and to keep domestic disputes private.
Keywords_AO: saddeeta, laga, guftaa, mana, miicuu
Keywords_EN: cloth, river, headscarf, home, washing, family privacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa hin gorsani, maraataa itti hin himani.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not advise a fool, nor does one confide in a madman.
Meaning_AO: Nama gowwaa gorsanii bu'aa hin argatan, nama sammuun isaa hin guunneettis iccitii fi dhimma ulfaataa himachuun balaa ofitti fiduu ta'uu akeekkachiisa.
Meaning_EN: Giving advice to a fool is wasted effort, and confiding secrets in an unstable person is disastrous as they cannot maintain discretion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko nama amanamummaa fi hubannoo hin qabneetti iccitii himee of miidhu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone against wasting counsel on fools or entrusting sensitive secrets to unreliable individuals.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, gorsuu, maraataa, himuu, iccitii
Keywords_EN: fool, counsel, madman, confide, secrets, discretion

Mammaaksa_AO: Heexoo, abba duubatti obaasan.
Translation_Literal_EN: Hagenia medicine is given behind a person's back.
Meaning_AO: Qoricha akka heexoo kan nama haqqisiisu dhoksaan kennan; akkasumas waan nama miidhu yookaan nama dhibu tokko haala eeganii fi of eeggannoodhaan raawwachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Strong traditional medicine like Hagenia (heexoo) is administered with discretion; delicate or harsh remedies and decisions must be executed with careful tact and privacy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimmi hadhaawaa yookaan gorsi cimaan tokko tooftaa fi dhoksaadhaan namaaf kennamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when describing an unpleasant but necessary action or truth that must be delivered cautiously and discreetly.
Keywords_AO: heexoo, duubatti, obaassuu, qoricha, tooftaa
Keywords_EN: hagenia, medicine, discretion, administer, tact, secrecy

Mammaaksa_AO: Ija nama agartu, udaan nama hin dhufu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Before an eye that watches, excrement does not come.
Meaning_AO: Namni safuu fi qaanii qabu ija namaa duratti waan fokkisaa fi salphisaa hin raawwatu; namoota duratti kabajaa fi of eeggannoon jiraachuu akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Natural shame and moral propriety prevent a person from committing indecent, shameful, or degrading acts in the presence of observers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko nama sodaatee yookaan safuu eegee gocha badaa fi qaanlessaa irraa of qusatu itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how public scrutiny and a sense of shame enforce moral behavior and prevent misconduct.
Keywords_AO: ija, arguu, safuu, qaanii, of eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: eye, watch, modesty, shame, propriety, restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Aannan dhiiraaf kaayan, hafuura hin kakaayan.
Translation_Literal_EN: When keeping milk for a husband, one does not breathe repeatedly over it.
Meaning_AO: Waan kabajamaa namaaf kennamu yookaan dhimma amanamaa qulqullummaan eeguu malee, shakkiifi amala fokkisaadhaan faaluun akka hin malle agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: When reserving something special out of respect and duty, one must keep it pristine and untainted by carelessness, suspicion, or deceit.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimma kabajamaa fi qulqulluu ta'e tokko of eeggannoo guddaadhaan qabuu fi faaluu irraa of qusachuu barbaadan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct someone to treat an honorable duty or trust with pristine care, without spoiling it through thoughtless habits.
Keywords_AO: aannan, dhiira, hafuura, qulqullina, kabaja
Keywords_EN: milk, husband, breath, respect, purity, trust

Mammaaksa_AO: Asuu oolle jette, kan gurguramte.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'We merely spent the day here,' said she who was sold.
Meaning_AO: Namni salphinni yookaan balaan guddaan irra ga'e tokko, qaanii fi gadda isaa dhoksuuf waan salphaa fakkeessee dubbatu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Describes a person who attempts to cover up their severe misfortune, humiliation, or subjugation by trivializing it to save face.
Theme_AO: Qaanii Dhoksuu fi Rakkina Salphaatti Fakkessuu
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni miidhamee yookaan salphatee jiru tokko akka waan homaa hin taanetti dubbii laaffisee qaanii dhokfachuu yaalu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing someone downplaying their severe loss, enslavement, or humiliation in an attempt to protect their remaining pride.
Keywords_AO: ooluu, gurguramuu, qaanii, dhoksuu, salphina
Keywords_EN: day, sold, humiliation, saving face, pretense, tragedy

Mammaaksa_AO: Aamminiin dubartii fi dhaga'aan lukkuu garaa keessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A woman's supplication (saying 'Amen') and a hen's hearing are in the stomach.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma gurri ykn dhageettiin lukkuu alaan hin mul'anneefi garaa keessa jirti jedhamu, aammiiniin (kadhannaan) dubartiis wadaaja fi sirna keessatti sagalee olkaaftee osoo hin taane garaa keessatti dhoksaadhaan qabatti. Wanti tokko alatti osoo hin mul'atin qalbii fi keessa namaatti kan dhokate ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Just as a chicken has no external visible ears and its hearing is proverbially concealed inside, a woman's 'Amen' (supplication and prayer assent) in traditional gatherings is not proclaimed aloud, but whispered and held silently within her chest. Metaphorically, it refers to thoughts, prayers, perceptions, and sentiments that are kept strictly internal, deeply private, and hidden from outside view.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko yaada, kadhannaa yookaan miira isaa garaa keessatti qabatee alatti ifatti hin baafne ibsuuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing that certain feelings, convictions, or prayers are kept entirely private and silent within the heart, without any outward display.
Keywords_AO: aamminii; dubartii; dhaga'aa; lukkuu; garaa keessa; kadhannaa; iccitii; safuu
Keywords_EN: aamminii; Amen; supplication; woman; hen's hearing; inside stomach; hidden perception; private prayer; discretion

Mammaaksa_AO: Wahalle nyaatan malee, wahalle hin dubbatan.
Translation_Literal_EN: One may eat whatever, but one must not say whatever.
Meaning_AO: Nyaanni nyaatamu garaa qofa miidhuu danda'a; dubbiin arrabaan ba'u garuu jireenya, nagaa fi hawaasummaa waan balleessuuf of eeggannoo guddaa barbaada.
Meaning_EN: Indiscreet eating only affects one's stomach, but reckless words can destroy relationships, reputations, and entire communities; speech requires utmost restraint.
Theme_EN: Restraint of Speech and Verbal Responsibility
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko afaan qabachuu dadhabee waan hunda dubbatee rakkoo uumuuf jedhutti akka arraba isaa eeggatu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone that words have far more dangerous consequences than food and must be weighed carefully before being spoken.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, dubbachuu, arraba, safuu, of eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: eat, speak, tongue, restraint, consequences, words

Mammaaksa_AO: Kofa ofii amba hin argisiisan.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not show one's groin to strangers.
Meaning_AO: Iccitii fi qaanii mana ofii, hanqina maatii yookaan dhimma dhuunfaa nama ormaatti baasanii mul'isuun salphina waan ta'eef eeggatamuu akka qabu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: One should never expose their private family shame, domestic weaknesses, or intimate vulnerabilities to outsiders and strangers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hanqina fi dhimma dhuunfaa maatii isaa ambaaf odeessu gorsanii safuu barsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reproach someone who reveals sensitive domestic disputes or personal vulnerabilities to external onlookers.
Keywords_AO: kofa, ofii, amba, agarsiisuu, qaanii
Keywords_EN: groin, self, stranger, expose, privacy, family shame

Mammaaksa_AO: Kofa ifii ajaawaa, abbaatu walitti qabata.
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if one's groin smells foul, the owner covers and gathers it themselves.
Meaning_AO: Firaan yookaan maatiin ofii yoo bade illee, ormatti baasanii salphisuu dhiisanii abbumatu dhoksee sirreeffachuu akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: No matter how flawed, difficult, or embarrassing one's own kin or domestic situation is, the family must shield it and handle it internally rather than exposing it.
Theme_AO: Balleessaa Firaa Dhoksuu fi Wal Qabachuu
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko badii fira ofii orma duratti saaxilee salphisuuf jedhu akka of qabuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge relatives to resolve domestic faults and personal embarrassments among themselves with discretion.
Keywords_AO: kofa, ajaawaa, abbaa, walitti qabachuu, maatii
Keywords_EN: groin, foul, owner, cover, kinship, domestic solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana haajiiti bullee malee, afaan lama nu hin tahin.
Translation_Literal_EN: Other than saying 'We spent the night at the Haji's house', let us not become double-tongued.
Meaning_AO: Mana kabajamaa fi amantii kan akka mana Haajii erga bulanii booda, oduu fi soba adda addaa uumuun afaan lama ta'uu dhiisanii dubbii qajeelaa fi tokkicha dubbachuu barsiisa. Hiriyyoonni ykn warri waliin oolan bakka tokkotti waan argan irratti afaan wal hin faallessine fi amanamummaa eeggachuu akka qaban agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Beyond simply stating the plain truth that we lodged at the Haji's home, let us not split our story or become double-tongued. When companions share hospitality in an honorable household, they must maintain consistent honesty, avoid gossip, and speak with one unified, truthful voice rather than spreading contradictory or two-faced accounts.
Theme_EN: Singleness of Voice and Avoiding Double-Talk
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni waliin imalan ykn bakka tokko bulan wanta argan irratti oduu fi soba uumuun akka afaan lama hin taane wal gorsanitti itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reminding traveling companions or confidants to stick strictly to the simple, shared truth and refrain from contradictory gossip, two-faced rumors, or double-talk after visiting a home.
Keywords_AO: mana haajii; buluu; afaan lama; amanamummaa; dubbii qajeelaa; safuu; iftoomina
Keywords_EN: Haji's house; lodging; double-tongued; integrity; single voice; honesty; no gossip; unity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin, hammuma abbaa garaa jirtu mi'ooyti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Words are sweet as long as they remain inside their owner's belly.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin yookaan iccitii tokko hanga garaa abbaa keessa jirtutti kabajamaa fi mi'aawaadha; yoo afaaniin baatee facaate garuu bu'aa dhabdee rakkoo uumti.
Meaning_EN: A word or secret retains its sweetness, value, and safety as long as it remains kept in one's own chest; once spoken, its sanctity and advantage are lost.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko iccitii garaa qabu baasee dubbachuuf jedhutti akka qusatu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone to treasure their unspoken confidences and refrain from revealing them carelessly.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, garaa, abbaa, mi'ooytuu, iccitii
Keywords_EN: words, belly, owner, sweet, secret, restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Boolla gaafa beelaa, halkan banan.
Translation_Literal_EN: A grain pit of famine days is opened at night.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo beelaa fi rakkinaa qabeenya dhokfame halkan namatti hin beekamin baafatu; akkasumas dhimmi iccitii fi yeroo rakkinaaf kuufame dhoksaadhaan to'atama malee dirreetti hin baafamu.
Meaning_EN: The emergency grain pit kept for drought or famine is opened under the cover of night to avoid alerting others and causing desperation; critical survival measures must be managed with utmost discretion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimma murteessaa fi yeroo rakkinaaf kuufame tokko akka hin saaxilamneef dhoksaan raawwachuu barbaadan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when advising extreme discretion in managing emergency savings, confidential solutions, or critical private resources during tough times.
Keywords_AO: boolla, beela, halkan, banuu, dhoksaa
Keywords_EN: pit, famine, night, open, emergency, secrecy, survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Sagalee jibbu garaan diddiga malee, dubbii jibbu garaan hin didigu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A belly may vomit food it dislikes, but it does not vomit words it dislikes.
Meaning_AO: Nyaanni nama jibbisiise yoo nyaatame namni didigee ofirraa baasuu danda'a; dubbii yookaan iccitii badaa dhagahe garuu didiganii ofirraa baasuun hin danda'amu, garaa keessatti nama guba.
Meaning_EN: While a stomach can purge unpalatable food by vomiting, it cannot vomit out offensive words or painful secrets once heard; they remain inside to torment or burden the mind.
Theme_EN: Power of Words and Emotional Burden
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbiin hamaan yookaan iccitii nama dhibu dhagahamee garaatti nama hafuu fi dhiibbaa uumu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how hurtful speech or disturbing confidences leave indelible, unpurgeable marks on the soul.
Keywords_AO: sagalee, didiguu, dubbii, garaa, jibbuu
Keywords_EN: food, vomit, words, belly, burden, speech

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana manaatu waa daha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Every houses shield something.
Meaning_AO: Tokko tokkoon maatii yookaan namni kamuu qe'ee fi mana ofii keessatti iccitii fi rakkoo dhokfatu qaba; namni marti mana ofii keessatti safuu fi qaanii ofii eeggata.
Meaning_EN: Every household possesses its own hidden realities, privacies, and shortcomings that are shielded within its walls; homes provide mutual privacy and cover for each other's vulnerabilities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko mana nama biraa keessa qorachuuf ka'u, manni hunduu dhoksaa akka qabu hubachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind nosy individuals that every family has private matters and shortcomings that deserve respect and privacy.
Keywords_AO: mana, dahachuudha, iccitii, safuu, maatii
Keywords_EN: house, shield, concealment, privacy, domestic, secrets

Mammaaksa_AO: Maal agarte - Ji'a, maal dhageeyse - Azaana.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'What did you see? – The moon. What did you hear? – The adhan (call to prayer).'
Meaning_AO: Namni iccitii eegu tokko gaaffii dhimma namaa irratti dhiyaatuuf deebii waliigalaa fi kan eenyullee hin miine kennuudhaan, iccitii fi dhimma ormaa akka hin agarree fi hin dhageenyetti amala dhoksuu qabaachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: When questioned about sensitive private matters or community gossip, the wise answer with obvious, harmless public phenomena (the moon, the call to prayer) to protect confidences and avoid stirring trouble.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhimma nama biraa irratti gaafatamee qorumsa jalaa ba'uuf deebii qajeelaa fi iccitii eegu kennutti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when praising or recommending clever evasiveness and total discretion to protect others' confidential affairs.
Keywords_AO: arguu, ji'a, dhageeyte, azaana, iccitii
Keywords_EN: seeing, moon, hearing, call to prayer, discretion, evasion

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan haa beeku, afaan haa wallaalu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Let the belly know, let the mouth be ignorant.
Meaning_AO: Waan beekan hunda afaaniin baasanii facaasuun balaa waan ta'eef, namni waan hedduu garaatti beekee haa qabatu garuu afaaniin akka waan hin beeknetti of haa qusatu jechuudha.
Meaning_EN: Even when one knows the truth or holds sensitive information in one's heart, the mouth should act ignorant and keep silent to avert harm and maintain peace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni tokko iccitii beeku akka hin dubbanneef, afaan isaa qabatee callisuu akka qabu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct someone to hold sensitive knowledge inside their chest while playing dumb publicly for safety and peace.
Keywords_AO: garaa, beekuu, afaan, wallaaluu, iccitii
Keywords_EN: belly, know, mouth, ignorant, restraint, silence

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaldessi waan dhagaa jalaa "yambar" je'e.
Translation_Literal_EN: The baboon said 'yambar' (nothing) about what was under the stone.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan barbaadu dhabe yookaan dhimma tokko dhoksuu fedhu, akka waan homaayyuu hin jirretti 'homaa hin jiru' jedhee callisuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: When the baboon overturns a rock and finds nothing (or wishes to conceal what it found), it declares 'nothing'; used to describe brushing off an inquiry or moving on as if nothing exists.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko waan arge yookaan barbaade dhabee akka waan homaa hin taanetti dhiisee deemu itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone discovers nothing from their prying or pretends there is nothing to report after investigating.
Keywords_AO: jaldeessa, dhagaa, yambar, homaa, dhoksuu
Keywords_EN: baboon, stone, nothing, empty, concealment, dismiss

Mammaaksa_AO: Haa teeysu garaa, haa nyaattu coraa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Let it stay in the belly, let it eat the vitals.
Meaning_AO: Dubbii yookaan iccitii namatti hadhooftu baasanii lola uumuu mannaa, garaa keessatti obsaan danda'anii qaama ofii gubduu illee garaatti qabachuun wayya jechuudha.
Meaning_EN: Better for painful grievances or heavy secrets to remain sealed inside the chest, even if it eats at one's inner vitals, rather than venting them and causing destructive conflict.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko aarii fi gadda garaa isaa keessa jiru baasee lola uumuu dhiisee of keessatti liqimsee obsu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone chooses deep internal endurance and swallows painful truths rather than causing communal strife.
Keywords_AO: garaa, teessuu, coraa, nyaachuu, obsa
Keywords_EN: belly, reside, vitals, endurance, restraint, grief

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin, dhiirsaaf kafana.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wife is a shroud and covering for her husband.
Meaning_AO: Niitiin gaariin hanqina, qullaa, qaanii fi iccitii dhiirsa ishee hawaasa duratti akka hin saaxilamneef kan dandeessu hundaan dhoksitee kabaja isaa eegdi.
Meaning_EN: A virtuous wife serves as a protective cloak for her husband, shielding his faults, poverty, and vulnerabilities from the outside world and preserving his honor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ga'ee haadha manaa kabaja fi iccitii dhiirsa ishee eeguu keessatti qabdu dinqisiifachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the duty and virtue of a spouse in safeguarding her partner's dignity and concealing his shortcomings.
Keywords_AO: niitii, dhiirsa, kafana, dhoksuu, kabaja
Keywords_EN: wife, husband, shroud, cover, dignity, protection

Mammaaksa_AO: Ani nama hin agarree malee, namni ana hin agarre hin je'in.
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not say 'nobody sees me', but rather say 'I did not see anyone.'
Meaning_AO: Namni gocha badaa yookaan dhokataa tokko raawwatu, eenyullee na hin argine jedhee of gowwoomsuu akka hin qabne, yeroo hunda iji nama ilaalu akka jiru ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Do not deceive yourself into believing no one witnessed your secret misdeeds just because you didn't see anyone watching; someone or the divine always watches.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhoksaatti badii hojjetee eenyummaanuu na hin argine jedhee of amansiisu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish someone who thinks their secret transgressions are hidden, warning them that wrongdoings are never truly invisible.
Keywords_AO: arguu, nama, of eeggannoo, dhoksaa, safuu
Keywords_EN: see, witness, secret, oversight, accountability, conscience

Mammaaksa_AO: "Ar'aas waan kiyya hin dubbatanii?" jette, haftuun.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Are they not talking about me today as well?' said the spinster.
Meaning_AO: Namni amala of jaalachuu yookaan of tuulummaa qabu tokko, yeroo hunda akka waan dhimmi isaa hawaasa mara keessatti haasa'amuufi namuu isa yaaduutti of he'u ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Highlights the vain illusion of self-important individuals who narcissistically assume that they are the perpetual topic of everyone else's conversation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama xiyyeeffannoo ambaa barbaadu yookaan namni hundi waa'ee koo haasa'a jedhee yaadu itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule someone who imagines they are the center of the world and that everyone is constantly gossiping about them.
Keywords_AO: haftuu, dubbachuu, of tuulummaa, qishnaa, oduu
Keywords_EN: spinster, talk, vanity, gossip, self-centered, mockery

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan maraatu hin mari'atu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who goes mad does not consult.
Meaning_AO: Namni gara badiisaa, dogoggora guddaa ykn maraatummaatti deemu duraan dursee firaa fi jaarsa hin mari'atu; ofumaan fedhii fi aariidhaan ka'ee of balleessa. Namni marii didee kophaa tarkaanfatu akka nama maraatetti kan lakkaa'amu ta'uu fi mariin qoricha maraatummaa ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: One who is losing their mind or plunging into ruin never pauses to seek counsel; reckless folly and madness always act unilaterally. When someone makes a shocking, irrational, or self-destructive move without consulting family or elders, this proverb is invoked to show that acting without advice is the very mark of madness—had they consulted, they would not have acted so crazily.
Theme_EN: Acting Without Counsel as the Mark of Madness
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko maatii fi jaarsolii osoo hin mari'atin tasa tarkaanfii maraatummaa fi badiisaa fudhatee of miidhu saaxiluuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone makes an impulsive, irrational, or ruinous decision without consulting anyone beforehand, noting that reckless madness never seeks advice.
Keywords_AO: maraatuu; maraachuu; mari'achuu; marii; gorsa dhabuu; qishnaa; dogoggora
Keywords_EN: going mad; consulting; deliberation; counsel; acting without advice; unilateral recklessness; folly

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan gabaan dhaga'e, gowwaan galee niitii dhoksa.
Translation_Literal_EN: What the market has already heard, the fool goes home and hides from his wife.
Meaning_AO: Oduu yookaan iccitii ummanni bal'aan duraan beekee hundi odeessaa jiru, gowwaan akka waan iccitii guddaa ta'etti galee nama jalaa dhoksuu yaala.
Meaning_EN: A fool tries to secretly hide from his wife news that is already common public knowledge throughout the entire market, exposing his utter lack of awareness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan ifa bahee namni hunduu beeku akka iccitii dhokaataatti qabee dhoksuuf carraaqu itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who treats an open, widely known public fact as a top secret and conceals it from their close companions.
Keywords_AO: gabaa, dhagahuu, gowwaa, niitii, dhoksuu
Keywords_EN: market, news, fool, wife, conceal, public knowledge

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan garatti unu ni machaa'a, kan garaachatti unu ni maraata.
Translation_Literal_EN: He who drinks into the stomach gets drunk, but he who drinks into the belly/mind goes mad.
Meaning_AO: Dhugaatiin yookaan waanti tokko yoo madaallii eegee fudhatame miidhaa salphaa qaba; garuu yoo daangaa darbee sammuu fi qalbii namaa keessa seene nama maraacha.
Meaning_EN: Imbibing moderately or appropriately merely causes temporary intoxication, but letting excess consume one's core sanity and inner conscience drives a person into total madness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko amala yookaan araada daangaa hin qabneen qabamee qalbii dhabu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against excessive indulgence and unchecked passions that undermine a person's reason and sanity.
Keywords_AO: unu, machaa'uu, garaa, maraachuu, madaallii
Keywords_EN: drink, drunk, stomach, madness, excess, moderation

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan balbalaan bahe nama dhiba, kan booroon bahe of dhiba.
Translation_Literal_EN: He who went out by the front door troubles others, but he who went out by the back door troubles himself.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan hundaa ifatti fi seeraan raawwatu nama biraa mormuu danda'a; namni karaa dhoksaa fi dabaan hojjetu garuu ofuma isaatii badii fi salphinatti of geessa.
Meaning_EN: Acting openly and directly through the front entrance might challenge others, but sneaking out dishonestly through the back door brings self-ruin, shame, and trouble onto oneself.
Theme_AO: Iftoomina fi Daba Irraa Of Eeguu
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko iftoomina dhiisee karaa dhoksaa fi dabatiin hojjechuuf ka'u balaa isaa hubachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against covert, cowardly, or deceitful methods, emphasizing that underhanded tactics ultimately backfire on the perpetrator.
Keywords_AO: balbala, booroo, bahuu, dhibuu, iftoomina
Keywords_EN: front door, back door, exit, trouble, honesty, deception

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa'ii irratti, killa hin qalani.
Translation_Literal_EN: At a public assembly, one does not slaughter into a small sacred vessel.
Meaning_AO: Dhimmi dhuunfaa fi aadaa dhoksaadhaan raawwatamuu qabu bakka koraa fi yaa'ii hawaasaa duratti hin raawwatamu; bakka fi yeroo waan hundaa eeguu akka barbaachisu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Sacred, delicate, or intimate rituals and private disputes must not be exposed or conducted at a large public assembly; every matter has its appropriate place, decorum, and time.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma iddoo hin malleetti yookaan kora ummataa irratti dhimma dhuunfaa qabatee dhihaatu seera barsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to restrain individuals from raising inappropriate, private, or disruptive personal rituals and grievances in public assemblies.
Keywords_AO: yaa'ii, killa, qaluu, seera, safuu
Keywords_EN: assembly, sacred vessel, slaughter, decorum, procedure, context

Mammaaksa_AO: Hinaafaan haqa qaba.
Translation_Literal_EN: A jealous person has a justification.
Meaning_AO: Namni hinaafaa ta'e yeroo hunda hinaaffaa isaa qajeelfachuuf sababa fi komii uumee of amansiisa; keessi isaa garuu haqa osoo hin taane waanyoodhaan kan guutame ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: An envious or jealous person always invents a grievance or rationalization to justify their resentment, convincing themselves that their malice is warranted.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hinaaftuun tokko waan nama biraa irratti hinaafuuf sababa qajeelaa fakkeessu argu ceepha'uuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing a jealous person rationalizing their resentment under the guise of an unfair slight or self-righteous complaint.
Keywords_AO: hinaafaa, haqa, hinaaffaa, qajeelcha, amala
Keywords_EN: jealous, right, justification, envy, resentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Hinaafaan if nyaata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A jealous person consumes themselves.
Meaning_AO: Hinaaffaan nama itti hinaafan miidhuu mannaa, abbuma hinaafu sana keessaa gubee, boqonnaa fi nagaa dhabsiisee qaamaa fi sammuu isaa miidha.
Meaning_EN: Jealousy harms the envious person far more than the target of their envy, steadily devouring their peace of mind, health, and happiness from within.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni tokko hinaaffaadhaan qabamee jireenya isaa akka hin balleessineef gorsuu fi akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn an envious person that their bitterness and jealousy only poison their own life and well-being.
Keywords_AO: hinaafaa, of nyaachuu, hinaaffaa, aarii, gubachuu
Keywords_EN: jealous, self-consuming, envy, bitterness, self-destruction

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan hinaafi je'een haadha isaatti hinaafa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Told 'Be jealous / suspicious', he becomes obsessively jealous even of his own mother.
Meaning_AO: Hinaaffaan daangaa dhabee fi shakkii araada ta'e qalbii fi sammuu namaa jaamsee gara maraatummaatti akka nama geessu agarsiisa. Namni hinaaffaa dhaabbataatiin qabame daangaa safuu hundumaa dagatee, haadha ofiirrattillee shakkii fi waanyoo hamaa qabaachuun amala jeeqamaa fi qalbii dhabuu isaa saaxila.
Meaning_EN: Illustrates pathological, compulsive jealousy and unbridled suspicion that has completely severed all ties with reason. When someone is consumed by obsessive jealousy, their paranoia spirals beyond all logic, decency, and sacred taboos, driving them to direct absurd suspicion and resentment even toward their own mother.
Theme_EN: Obsessive Jealousy, Compulsive Envy, and Paranoia
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko hinaaffaa fi shakkiidhaan qabamee daangaa safuu hunda cabsee, namoota qulqulluu fi maatii dhihoo irrattillee amala jeeqamaa mul'isu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when describing an obsessively jealous, envious, or pathologically suspicious individual whose unhinged paranoia blinds them to common sense and sacred boundaries, causing them to suspect even their closest kin.
Keywords_AO: hinaafi; haadha; hinaaffaa; shakkii; maraatummaa; qalbii dhabuu; safuu
Keywords_EN: jealousy; suspicion; paranoia; mother; compulsive envy; obsessive jealousy; unhinged; boundary violation

Mammaaksa_AO: If jibboon, ilma haadhatti hinaafu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Those who hate themselves are the ones who envy a son because of his mother.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofitti hin amanne fi of jibbu milkaa'ina fira dhiyoo fi nama isa gargaaru illee hin fedhu; guddinni nama biraa isa guba.
Meaning_EN: Individuals plagued by self-hatred and deep insecurity resent even the natural love, blessings, and success between a mother and her child.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gammachuu fi milkaa'ina fira dhiyoo illee ija hamaadhaan ilaalu balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize people whose own profound inadequacy leads them to begrudge even the most innocent blessings of close relatives.
Keywords_AO: of jibbuu, ilma, haadha, hinaaffaa, amala
Keywords_EN: self-loathing, son, mother, envy, insecurity, malice

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaa hinaafaan dhabe, namuu hin argatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A truth that the jealous person failed to find, no one will ever find.
Meaning_AO: Namni hinaafaa ta'e nama biraa irratti komii, balleessaa fi sababa barbaadee dhabeera taanaan, namni sun dhugumaan qulqulluu fi balleessaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: If even a hypercritical, envious person—who scrutinizes every detail to find fault—cannot find any flaw or blame, then that person is undeniably innocent and blameless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qulqullummaa fi amanamummaa nama tokkoo mirkaneessuu barbaadan, hinaaftonni illee balleessaa akka irratti hin arganne ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm someone's absolute integrity by noting that even their worst detractors and jealous rivals failed to uncover any fault.
Keywords_AO: dhugaa, hinaafaa, dhabuu, qulqullummaa, argachuu
Keywords_EN: truth, jealous, fault, blamelessness, integrity, scrutiny

Mammaaksa_AO: "Hinaafuun gaafuma dhaga'ani" jedhee, jaarsi saglii (90) keessa jiru niitii dhaane.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'One gets jealous the day one hears about it,' said the ninety-year-old elder, and beat his wife.
Meaning_AO: Hinaaffaan umrii, yeroo fi sammuu qabaachuu hin beektu; yeroo hin malleetti aarii fi hinaaffaadhaan kaka'anii gocha gowwummaa fi qaanii raawwachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Jealousy defies age, dignity, and timing; it illustrates how sudden irrational jealousy drives even an old person into absurd and embarrassing behavior.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko umrii fi haala isaa osoo hin ilaalin dhimma darbe yookaan kan isa hin malleef hinaaffee amala gowwummaa agarsiisu itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who acts out in irrational jealousy over stale or irrelevant matters long after the time has passed.
Keywords_AO: hinaafuu, jaarsa, sagaltama, niitii, dhaanuu
Keywords_EN: jealousy, old man, ninety, wife, beat, absurdity

Mammaaksa_AO: Hinaaffaa fi dhagaa wajji ibidda irra kaayaniiti, dhagaan bilchaatee hinaaffaan bilchaachuu didde.
Translation_Literal_EN: They put jealousy and a stone together on the fire; the stone cooked, but jealousy refused to cook.
Meaning_AO: Hinaaffaan amala akkaan jabaa, hadhaawaa fi dhiifama hin qabne waan ta'eef, dhagaan illee ibiddatti baqee yoo sirraa'e hinaaffaan garuu tasuma hin dhabamtu.
Meaning_EN: Stone itself can be melted or softened by fire, but the stubborn bitterness of jealousy can never be cured, softened, or reasoned with.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hinaaffaan amala jabaa qoricha hin qabneefi namni hinaafaan salphaatti kan hin jijjiiramne ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to convey how deeply entrenched, intractable, and impervious to change the spirit of envy is.
Keywords_AO: hinaaffaa, dhagaa, ibidda, bilchaachuu, jabaa
Keywords_EN: jealousy, stone, fire, cook, melt, obstinate, incurable

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirsi niitiin hinaaftuu fi namni manni itti dhimmisu tokko.
Translation_Literal_EN: A husband whose wife is jealous and a person whose house leaks are the same.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma manni dhimmisu yeroo hunda boqonnaa nama dhowwatu, niitii hinaaftuu wajjin jiraachuunis jireenya nagaa fi tasgabbii nama dhowwata.
Meaning_EN: Just as living in a house with a leaky roof causes unending irritation and prevents rest, living with an obsessively jealous spouse robs one of daily peace and joy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoo fi dhiphina jireenya maatii hinaaffaa daangaa darbeen faalame ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when commiserating with someone trapped in a relationship plagued by ceaseless suspicion, badgering, and petty jealousy.
Keywords_AO: dhiirsa, niitii, hinaaftuu, mana, dhimmiisuu
Keywords_EN: husband, wife, jealous, roof, leaking, torment, unrest

Mammaaksa_AO: Hawwisoo sagalee tolu dubri ni jaalata, gadheen ni jibbiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Young women love an artist with a sweet voice, but the spiteful person hates him.
Meaning_AO: Waan gaarii, dandeettii fi bareedina namni qabu namoonni qulqulluun yoo jaallatan, namni amala hamaa fi hinaaffaa qabu garuu waan gaarii sana jibbee balaaleffata.
Meaning_EN: Noble and appreciative people admire talent, beauty, and virtue, whereas the petty and envious despise and resent excellence out of sheer spite.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni hinaaftuun dandeettii yookaan milkaa'ina nama tokkoo jibbuufi ceepha'uun of saaxilan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast genuine appreciation of talent and goodness with the bitter, sour rejection typical of envious minds.
Keywords_AO: hawwisoo, sagalee, dubra, jaalachuu, gadhee
Keywords_EN: singer, sweet voice, youth, admire, spiteful, envy

Mammaaksa_AO: Manni namaani cufaa dhaa, hinaafaa ooyruun gaffaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: People's house is closed, and for the jealous person the farmland is open and thorny.
Meaning_AO: Manni abbaa iccitii fi kabajaan cufamee kan eegamu ta'us, namni hinaafaan garuu dantaa namaa qorachuuf ooyruu fi qe'ee namaa keessa asii fi gadi fiiga.
Meaning_EN: While decent people keep their doors closed and mind their own private homes, the restless, jealous person constantly prowls across open fields trying to pry into others' affairs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dantaa ofii dhiisee dhimma nama biraa qoratuu fi hinaaffaadhaan qe'ee namaa sakatta'u balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn nosy, intrusive, and envious neighbors who obsess over others' properties and business while ignoring their own.
Keywords_AO: mana, cufaa, hinaafaa, ooyruu, gaffaa
Keywords_EN: house, closed, jealous, farm, nosiness, intrusion

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaan kafana.
Translation_Literal_EN: A friend is a shroud and covering.
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaan dhugaa akkuma kafanaa hanqina, qullaa fi iccitii namaa hunda dhoksee kabaja namaa hawaasa duratti eega.
Meaning_EN: A true friend acts as a protective cloak, shielding one's secrets, shortcomings, and vulnerabilities from public humiliation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ga'ee fi faayidaa hiriyaan dhugaa kabaja namaa eeguu keessatti qabu dinqisiifachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise a faithful companion who guards your flaws and upholds your dignity before others.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, kafana, kabaja, dhoksuu, hiriyyummaa
Keywords_EN: friend, shroud, loyalty, dignity, protection

Mammaaksa_AO: Horii dhabuu mannaa, haadha dhabuu wayya, hiriyaa dhabuu mannaa, horii dhabuu wayya.
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than lacking wealth, it is better to lack a mother; rather than lacking a friend, it is better to lack wealth.
Meaning_AO: Jireenya keessatti qabeenyi barbaachisaa ta'us, hiriyaan dhugaa kan rakkina keessatti nama bira dhaabbatu qabeenya kamiyyuu caalaa gatii guddaa akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Illustrates the supreme value of true companionship in life; having a loyal, dependable friend outweighs material possessions and wealth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gatii guddaa hiriyaan dhugaa qabeenya caalaa qabu nama hubachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that genuine human bonds and true friends are far more precious than accumulating cattle and gold.
Keywords_AO: horii, haadha, hiriyaa, dhabuu, jireenya
Keywords_EN: wealth, mother, friend, companionship, value

Mammaaksa_AO: Obboleessi, kan wajji dhalatan qofaa miti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A brother is not only the one with whom you were born.
Meaning_AO: Obbolummaan kan dhiigaa qofa osoo hin taane, namni yeroo rakkinaa si bira dhaabbatee fi jaalalaan si gargaarus obboleessa dhugaati.
Meaning_EN: Brotherhood transcends mere biological birth; anyone who stands by you in times of adversity with sincere loyalty and love is truly your brother.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiriyaan dhiyoo tokko akka obboleessaatti nama gargaaree jaalala dhugaa agarsiisutti dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to acknowledge that loyal friends who share your struggles are as close as, or closer than, biological siblings.
Keywords_AO: obboleessa, dhalachuu, jaalala, hiriyyaa, obbolummaa
Keywords_EN: brother, birth, loyalty, friendship, brotherhood

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'a tokkootu, sa'a baay'ee barbaada.
Translation_Literal_EN: A single cow seeks out many cows.
Meaning_AO: Namni qofaa isaa jiraachuu hin danda'u; hawaasummaa, hiriyyummaa fi waliin jiraachuun uumama namaa waan ta'eef namni hiriyaa fi nama biraa barbaada.
Meaning_EN: An individual naturally seeks community and companionship; humans are inherently social beings who cannot thrive in solitude.
Theme_EN: Inherent Need for Community and Companionship
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni hiriyaa fi hawaasa dhabee qofaa ta'uu akka hin dandeenye barsiisuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the universal human instinct to seek out companions, peers, and communal fellowship.
Keywords_AO: sa'a, tokko, baay'ee, barbaaduu, hawaasummaa
Keywords_EN: cow, solitary, herd, community, belonging, companionship

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaa malee dhaqxee, geggessaa malee galte.
Translation_Literal_EN: She went without a friend, and she returned without an escort.
Meaning_AO: Namni hiriyaa fi nama waliin deemu hin qabne kabajaa fi gargaarsa dhabee qofummaan akka salphatu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Going forth without a companion leads to returning without an escort; illustrates how isolating oneself leaves a person without honor, security, or support.
Theme_EN: Perils of Isolation and Lack of Companions
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko hiriyaa fi gargaarsa namaa didee qofaa deemee salphinatti kufe ceepha'uuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against isolation and antisocial behavior, showing that one who refuses companions will find no one to honor them.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, dhaquu, geggeessaa, galuu, qofummaa
Keywords_EN: friend, journey, escort, return, isolation, companionship

Mammaaksa_AO: Obbolessa jechuun, kan ati rifattu rifatee ati gammaddu gammadu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A brother means one who is distressed when you are distressed and rejoices when you rejoice.
Meaning_AO: Obboleessi yookaan hiriyaan dhugaa nama miira kee qooddatee gadda keetti gaddus, gammachuu keetti gammadu ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: A true brother is someone who genuinely shares your emotional states, suffering when you are distressed and celebrating when you are joyful.
Usage_Situation_AO: Amala fi amanamummaa obbolummaa dhugaa barsiisuuf yookaan hiriyaa gaarii faarsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to define true brotherhood and friendship as deep, reciprocal empathy in both hardship and triumph.
Keywords_AO: obboleessa, rifachuu, gammaduu, jaalala, miira
Keywords_EN: brother, startle, distress, rejoice, empathy, solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Akaayiin gita qabaa, mulluun hiriya qaba.
Translation_Literal_EN: Roasted grain has its match, and boiled grain has its companion.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hundi fira, hiriyyaa fi gita walmadaalu qaba; namni kamiyyuu nama isa madaaluu fi isa fakkaatu wajjin hiriyaa ta'uu akka qabu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Everything in life has its proper counterpart and peer; individuals should choose companions who match their temperament, values, and standing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni lama amalaan, umriin yookaan ilaalchaan wal fudhatanii waliin hiriyaa ta'an mirkaneessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comment on natural compatibility, noting that birds of a feather flock together and every person finds their rightful match.
Keywords_AO: akaayii, gita, mulluu, hiriyaa, madaallii
Keywords_EN: roasted grain, match, boiled grain, peer, compatibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan saree, dhaga wal arraabsifti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog's guest makes host and guest lick stones together.
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaan yookaan keessummaan hiyyeessa fi qabeenya hin qabne waan kennuuf hin qabu; hiriyaa gadhee wajjin ooluun beelaa fi rakkoo qofa nama dhaalchisa.
Meaning_EN: Entertaining a worthless or destitute companion leads only to licking bare stones together; associating with incompetent companions yields nothing but shared hardship.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni lama walitti dhufanii waan tokkollee wal gargaaruu dadhabanii qorii duwwaatti hafan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock a partnership between two resourceless people where neither can help the other, resulting in shared deprivation.
Keywords_AO: keessummaa, saree, dhagaa, arraabsuu, rakkoo
Keywords_EN: guest, dog, stone, lick, poverty, useless companion

Mammaaksa_AO: Kophaa, udaan qofaatu gaarii dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Only excrement is good in solitude.
Meaning_AO: Qofummaan waan gaarii miti; hawaasummaan, waliin jiraachuu fi hiriyyummaan jireenya namaaf bu'uura ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Solitude is only fitting when relieving oneself; in all other aspects of life, human beings need companionship, teamwork, and fellowship.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kophaa ta'uu filatee nama irraa fagaatu gorsanii gara hawaasaatti fiduuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in a humorous, blunt manner to discourage antisocial isolation and urge someone to join community activities.
Keywords_AO: kophaa, gaarii, hawaasummaa, hiriyyummaa, qofummaa
Keywords_EN: alone, solitude, community, fellowship, antisocial

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaan wajji baate osoo wajji galtee, akkam gaarii dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: If only the friend with whom you set out returned home with you, how wonderful it would be.
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaan jalqaba dhimma tokkootti nama wajjin ba'e hanga dhumaatti amanamummaan osoo nama bira dhaabbatee gaarii ture; garuu hiriyaa gantummaa fi amanamummaa dhabuu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Expresses sorrow over fickle companions who start a journey or project enthusiastically but abandon you halfway through adversity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiriyaan tokko rakkina keessatti nama dhiisee baqatu yookaan ganee biraa hafu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when lamenting a companion who deserted you during a difficult journey or enterprise after starting out together.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, ba'uu, galuu, gaarii, amanamummaa
Keywords_EN: friend, set out, return, loyalty, desertion, fidelity

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama dhabaaf, arba dhaban.
Translation_Literal_EN: For lack of men, an elephant was lost.
Meaning_AO: Tokkummaa fi gargaarsa namaa dhabuudhaan milkaa'ina guddaa fi carraa guddaa dhabuu agarsiisa; humna namaa fi hiriyyummaan waan hundaa akka caalu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Due to a lack of manpower and cooperative companions, a great prize (an elephant) slipped away; emphasizes that great achievements require teamwork.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo carraan guddaan tokko sababa namni wal gargaaru dhabameef nama jalaa badutti itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a major opportunity is lost simply because there weren't enough united people or loyal comrades to seize it.
Keywords_AO: nama, dhabuu, arba, tokkummaa, gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: people, lack, elephant, teamwork, opportunity, cooperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaan allaattii raqa irra nama geessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bird of prey's friend leads one to a decaying carcass.
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaa gadhee fi amala hamaa qabu wajjin ooluun bakka badii, salphinaa fi wanta fokkisaatti nama geessa.
Meaning_EN: Associating with a vulture-like, corrupt companion will only lead you to foul, decaying, and dishonorable places.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hiriyaa gadhee fi amala fokkisaa qabu wajjin ooluuf akka of eeggatu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone that choosing degenerate, predatory friends will inevitably drag them into disgrace and ruin.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, allaattii, raqa, badii, akeekkachiisa
Keywords_EN: friend, vulture, carcass, corruption, bad company, ruin

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaan saree, dikee irra nama geeysa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog's friend leads one onto the dung heap.
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaa qaan-dhabeessa fi salphaa ta'e wajjin michoomuun salphinaa fi iddoo fokkisaa qofaatti nama geessa.
Meaning_EN: Befriending an undignified, base companion will inevitably lead you to end up on the trash heap of social disrespect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni hiriyaa isaatiin salphina keessa seene tokko akka irraa of qusatu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish someone for associating with low-character companions whose crude habits soil their reputation.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, saree, dikee, salphina, amala
Keywords_EN: friend, dog, dung heap, degradation, dishonor, companion

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaan tiitichaa, udaan irra nama geeysa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A fly's friend leads one onto excrement.
Meaning_AO: Hiriyaa xuraa'aa fi amala badaa qabu wajjin ooluun waan fokkisaa fi xuraawaa keessatti nama kuffisa.
Meaning_EN: Associating with a fly-like companion will inevitably land you in filth; bad company draws you directly into moral contamination.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hiriyaa amala badaa qabu wajjin deemuuf akka of eeggatu gorsanii akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to give a vivid, blunt warning against keeping company with filthy-minded or corrupt individuals.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, tiiticha, xuraa'aa, akeekkachiisa, amala
Keywords_EN: friend, fly, excrement, filth, corruption, peer influence

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiriyaa deesse mannaa, hiriyaa duute wayya (dubra Osoo hin heerumin deesse).
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than a young companion who gave birth out of wedlock, a dead companion is better.
Meaning_AO: Aadaa fi safuu durii keessatti dubarri osoo hin heerumin ulfooftee da'uun qaanii fi salphina maatii fi hiriyaa hundaa waan ta'eef, salphina sana baachuu mannaa du'atu salphata jechuudhaan qaanii guddaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: In traditional Oromo customary honor (safuu), giving birth out of wedlock brought severe, unbearable stigma to the family and peer group; highlights the extreme cultural horror of social dishonor over death.
Theme_EN: Social Stigma and Traditional Honor Codes
Usage_Situation_AO: Aadaa fi safuu durii keessatti kabajaa fi qulqullina dubrummaa eeguun hangam murteessaa akka ture ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in historical/cultural contexts to illustrate the devastating social shame associated with premarital pregnancy under traditional honor codes.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, deessuu, du'uu, dubra, qaanii, safuu
Keywords_EN: companion, unmarried birth, death, honor, shame, cultural taboo

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa shuumoo, si nyaachuullee baadhu si tortorse" je'e, jaarsi ilkee hin qabne.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'O boiled grain, even if I cannot eat you, I have spoiled you,' said the toothless old man.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan tokkotti dhimma ba'uu hin dandeenye, namni biraas akka itti hin fayyadamneef hinaaffaadhaan balleessuu fi mancaasuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: It illustrates a spiteful person who, unable to enjoy or benefit from something themselves, deliberately ruins or spoils it so that no one else can have it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ofii fayyadamuu hin dandeenye tokko dantaa fi carraa nama biraa mancaasuuf yaalu balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn a jealous person who acts like a dog in the manger, ruining opportunities for others simply out of personal spite.
Keywords_AO: shuumoo, nyaachuu, tortorsuu, jaarsa, ilkee
Keywords_EN: boiled grain, toothless, spoil, spite, sabotage, envy

Mammaaksa_AO: Histiin michii jiruuti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Envy is the fever and ailment of living.
Meaning_AO: Hinaaffaan akkuma dhukkuba michii tasa nama qabee jireenya gubuu fi boqonnaa dhowwatu, jireenya hawaasummaa keessatti balaa fi madaa guddaadha.
Meaning_EN: Envy is a chronic affliction of human life that, like a sudden fever, strikes from within and continuously poisons peace, joy, and social harmony.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hinaaffaan jireenya namaa fi hawaasaa keessatti balaa guddaa akka ta'ee fi nama nagaa dhowwatu barsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how jealousy acts as an unrelenting spiritual illness that disrupts human coexistence and well-being.
Keywords_AO: histii, michii, jiruu, hinaaffaa, amala
Keywords_EN: envy, fever, life, living, affliction, malice

Mammaaksa_AO: Allaattiin waan dhumuu jettee, lafa irratti wal fixxi.
Translation_Literal_EN: Birds of prey, fearing it will run out, wipe each other out on the ground.
Meaning_AO: Waan darbuu fi dhumu tokkoof bololuun, namoonni dantaa fi qabeenya yeroof jecha wal nyaatanii wal balleessuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Driven by greed and fear of scarcity over a perishable carcass, birds destroy one another; illustrates how humans foolishly kill each other over fleeting worldly goods.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni qabeenya yookaan dantaa xiqqoo darbituu taateef jecha wal loluu fi wal miidhan ceepha'uuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand people who engage in cutthroat, destructive rivalry over material gains that are ultimately temporary and perishable.
Keywords_AO: allaattii, dhumuu, lafa, wal fixuu, bolola
Keywords_EN: vulture, running out, ground, mutual destruction, greed

Mammaaksa_AO: Allaattiin waan lafaatiif, samiirratti wal fixxe.
Translation_Literal_EN: For the sake of what was on the ground, birds of prey fought and destroyed each other in the sky.
Meaning_AO: Waan harkatti hin galin yookaan fagoo jiru tokkoof jecha, osoo bira hin ga'in dursee wal loluu fi diinummaa uumuu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Fighting in the air over something that still lies untouched on the ground represents premature, senseless conflict over distant or uncertain spoils.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni bu'aa harka hin gahin yookaan hin mirkanaayin tokkoof jecha dursanii wal dhaban itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when rival parties destroy their relationship quarreling over potential spoils or prizes before anyone has actually secured them.
Keywords_AO: allaattii, lafa, samii, wal fixuu, gowwummaa
Keywords_EN: vulture, ground, sky, fighting, premature greed

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo abbaan manaa hin jibbine, kajeeltuun maalif wal jibbiti?.
Translation_Literal_EN: While the master of the house has not refused, why do those who crave it hate one another?
Meaning_AO: Abbaan qabeenyaa arjummaadhaan osoo homaa hin mormin, namoonni alaa dantaa sana hawwan hinaaffaadhaan wal jibbuu fi wal ceepha'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: When the generous owner of the property has no objection to giving, it is absurd for envious beggars or rivals to despise and fight one another over it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni dantaa abbaan eeyyameef tokko irratti walitti hinaafanii wal ceepha'an balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shame individuals who squabble and harbor bitter resentment against fellow beneficiaries when the benefactor himself is willing to share.
Keywords_AO: abbaa manaa, jibbuu, kajeeltuu, hinaaffaa, dantaa
Keywords_EN: master, refuse, crave, envy, rivalry, jealousy

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan abbaan kennuuf, gabrittii hudduun dhukkube.
Translation_Literal_EN: Over what the master was giving away, the servant woman's buttocks ached.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya abbaan fedhii isaatiin arjoomu irratti, namni dhimmi hin ilaallanne hinaaffaadhaan gubachuu fi dhiphachuu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Someone with no claim or ownership over the wealth becomes deeply grieved and resentful simply witnessing the rightful owner generously giving it away.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimmi hin ilaallanne tokko arjummaa fi kennaa namni biraa godhu irratti hinaafee dhiphatu itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who becomes spiteful and distressed over another person's charitable giving or generous spending of their own assets.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, kennuu, gabrittii, dhukkubuu, hinaaffaa
Keywords_EN: master, give, servant, ache, envy, generosity

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan waaqni namaa tolchetti, namni namatti hammaata.
Translation_Literal_EN: Over what God has done well for someone, people become malicious toward that person.
Meaning_AO: Eebbaa fi milkaa'ina Waaqayyo namaaf kenne irratti, namoonni hinaaffaadhaan kaka'anii nama sana jibbuu fi miidhuuf yaaluu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: People often direct hostility, bitterness, and envy toward an individual simply because God has favored, prospered, and blessed them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo milkaa'inaa fi carraa gaarii namaaf dhufe irratti namoonni hinaaffaa fi jibba mul'isan gaddaan ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing bitter resentment from peers against someone who has legitimately succeeded through divine favor and good fortune.
Keywords_AO: waaqa, tolchuu, nama, hammaachuu, hinaaffaa
Keywords_EN: God, blessing, malice, envy, hostility, success

Mammaaksa_AO: Foon fannoo jiraatiif, adurreen lafatti wal fixxi.
Translation_Literal_EN: Because meat is hanging up high, cats destroy each other on the ground.
Meaning_AO: Waan harkatti hin galamneef fagootti mul'atu tokkoof jecha, namoonni lafarratti wal loluu fi nagaa wal dhowwachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Cats tear each other apart on the ground over hanging meat they cannot even reach; people fight among themselves over unattainable desires.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni waan tokkollee bira ga'uu hin dandeenye irratti dorgommii fi diinummaa uuman itti qoosuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock rivals tearing each other down over an objective or ambition that neither of them has any realistic way of achieving.
Keywords_AO: foon, fannoo, adurree, lafa, wal fixuu
Keywords_EN: meat, hanging, cats, ground, mutual slaughter, folly

Mammaaksa_AO: Lafee laagaa danqarte hammeenya.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bone stuck across the throat is pure torment.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoon yookaan amalli hamaan yeroo nama keessatti cimee furmaata dhabu, akkuma lafee qoonqotti haftee nama hudhuutti rakkisaa fi dhiphisaa ta'uu ibsa.
