Meaning_EN: A bone caught across the throat brings suffocating agony; represents deep-seated malice, unresolved bitterness, or a suffocating crisis that neither goes down nor comes up.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimmi hamaan yookaan aariin garaa namaa hudhee furmaata dhabu ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when describing an intractable grievance, suffocating hostility, or an agonizing dilemma that chokes progress.
Keywords_AO: lafee, laagaa, danqaruu, hammeenya, rakkina
Keywords_EN: bone, throat, choke, malice, torment, dilemma

Mammaaksa_AO: Lafee okkotee danqarte jabeenya.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bone wedged across the cooking pot is strength.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko jabaatee iddoo isaatti dhaabbatee rakkoof hin jilbiffanne, akkuma lafee cimee danqareetti jabinnaa fi obsa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: A sturdy bone that stands wedged across a boiling clay pot resists destruction; symbolizes unwavering fortitude, steadfast endurance, and formidable strength.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko qorumsaa fi rakkina cimaa dura dhaabbatee hin cabne jajjabeessuuf yookaan galateeffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise an unyielding leader or resilient person who stands firm amidst pressure and cannot be broken by adversity.
Keywords_AO: lafee, okkotee, danqaruu, jabeenya, obsa
Keywords_EN: bone, pot, wedged, strength, resilience, fortitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Huqquu nam sadii kaasuu dadhabe, kan nyaachuu fedhuutu keysa jira.
Translation_Literal_EN: If three people fail to lift a weakened cow, one who wishes to eat it is among them.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin yookaan rakkoon namoonni baay'een irratti wal ta'anii furan yoo fashale, namoota sana keessaa namni dhimmi sun akka fashalu barbaadu akka jiru ibsa.
Meaning_EN: When multiple people fail to rescue a struggling beast, someone among the helpers secretly wants it to die so they can consume its meat; reveals internal sabotage and conflict of interest.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo gargaarsi yookaan hojiin waloo sababa nama keessa jiruun dhoksaatti gufatee fashalu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a joint endeavor fails suspiciously because a participant secretly profits from its demise and subtly sabotages the effort.
Keywords_AO: huqquu, kaasuu, dadhabuu, nyaachuu, gantummaa
Keywords_EN: weak cow, lift, fail, eat, sabotage, betrayal, hidden motive

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan biraa hunda obseetiin, cirracha anaa fi kophee tiyya jidduu seene obsuu dadhabe.
Translation_Literal_EN: Having endured everything else, I could not endure the pebble inside my shoe.
Meaning_AO: Namni balaa fi rakkina gurguddaa alaa obsee danda'uu danda'a; garuu miidhaa fi rakkina xixiqqoo kan firaa fi keessoo namaa irraa dhufu obsuun ulfaataadha.
Meaning_EN: One can tolerate immense external hardships, but an intimate, persistent irritation or betrayal from within one's immediate inner circle is impossible to endure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoo guddaa danda'anii garuu miidhaa nama dhiyoo irraa dhufe obsuun rakkisaa ta'u ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express how small, constant irritations or personal betrayals close to home are far more unbearable than monumental external trials.
Keywords_AO: obsuu, cirracha, kophee, keessoo, rakkina
Keywords_EN: endure, pebble, shoe, intimate betrayal, irritation, limits

Mammaaksa_AO: Beela anaatu isinitti hin dhiifne, quufa isiniitu walitti hin dhiifne.
Translation_Literal_EN: 'As for famine, it is I who spared you; but as for abundance, it is you who showed no mercy to one another,' [says God].
Meaning_AO: Sagalee Waaqayyoo kan ilmaan namaatti dubbatu dha; Waaqayyo arjummaa fi mararfannaa isaatiin beela hamaadhaan akka uummanni hin dhumne yeroo hundumaa nama baraara (anaatu beela isinitti hin dhiifne). Garuu namoonni gaafa quufanii fi badhaadhan of tuuluu, doqnummaa, fi roorroodhaan wal nyaatu (quufa isiniitu walitti hin dhiifne). Badiin guddaan beela uumaa osoo hin taane, quufa keessatti gara-jabina namootaa ta'uu saaxila.
Meaning_EN: Framed as the Creator indicting humanity: 'As for famine, it is I who showed mercy and spared you from starvation; but as for abundance, it is you yourselves who showed no mercy to one another.' While God sustains and spares mortals from being destroyed by famine, human beings respond to blessings of plenty with arrogance, hoarding, and ruthless exploitation of their fellows. It condemns human greed and social cruelty during seasons of prosperity.
Theme_EN: Divine Mercy vs. Human Injustice in Abundance
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni yookaan hawaasni badhaadhina argatee nagaa dhabee, wal saamee fi wal miidhu uumaa akka sodaatanii fi haqa akka eegan akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke economic greed, hoarding, and oppression in affluent times, reminding people that while God spared them from famine, their own lack of mercy in times of plenty is their true undoing.
Keywords_AO: beela; anaatu; quufa; isiniitu; dhiisuu; rabbi; roorroo; safuu; bolola
Keywords_EN: famine; Creator; abundance; satiety; divine mercy; human greed; oppression; hoarding; divine indictment

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessa hidhiin korbeessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: A poor man's lips are like those of a billy goat.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi waan nyaatu dhabee yookiin qabbanni rukutee hidhiin isaa qoora; hiyyummaan bifa balleessa.
Meaning_EN: Deprivation and malnutrition leave stark, dry, weathered marks on the physical appearance of the poor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyummaan nama miitee jireenyi itti ulfaattu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the harsh, visible signs of poverty and undernourishment worn by the destitute
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, hidhii, deega
Keywords_EN: poor man, lip, deprivation

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyummaan dararummaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Poverty is misery and torment.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyummaan jireenya namaa hiraarsa; kabajaa fi nagaa nama dhabsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Poverty is sheer affliction and suffering that strips away comfort, dignity, and peace of mind.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ulfina dhibee hiyyummaa ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to articulate the profound misery and ceaseless suffering caused by poverty
Keywords_AO: hiyyummaa, dararama, jireenya
Keywords_EN: poverty, torment, misery

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessaa fi daaraan fira.
Translation_Literal_EN: The poor man and rags/nakedness are kin.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi yeroo hunda wayyaa qulqulluu fi gaarii dhabuun beekama.
Meaning_EN: Destitution and a lack of decent clothing are inseparable companions of impoverished people.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi huccuu dhabee rakkatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express how intimately tied chronic poverty is with having only ragged clothes
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, daaraa, huccuu
Keywords_EN: poor, rags, clothing

Mammaaksa_AO: Hidhiin hiyyeessaa hin xuraawu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The poor man's lip does not get greasy with meat.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi coomaa fi foon nyaatee afaan dibachuuf carraa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: The poor rarely enjoy the privilege of dining on rich, fatty meats and festive delicacies.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi wanta gaarii argachuu dhabu dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used ironically to note that the poor never display grease on their mouths from eating rich meat
Keywords_AO: hidhii, hiyyeessa, foon
Keywords_EN: lip, poor man, meat

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessaa fi qilleensi hin taa'ani.
Translation_Literal_EN: The poor man and the wind never sit still.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi qodhaa fi bu'aa guyyaa barbaachaaf akkuma qilleensaatti olii gadi fiiga.
Meaning_EN: Like the wandering wind, a poor person must hustle ceaselessly from dawn to dusk to find bread.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi boqonnaa dhabee jireenyaaf fiigu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the relentless, exhausting hustle that poverty imposes upon daily life
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, qilleensa, fiigicha
Keywords_EN: poor man, wind, hustle

Mammaaksa_AO: Qoonqoon saree nama gooteeti, daarri hiyyeessa nama godha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Hunger reduces one to a dog, and lack of clothes stamps one as destitute.
Meaning_AO: Beelli kabajaa namaa cabsa, huccuu dhabuun ammoo salphina namaa baasa.
Meaning_EN: Desperate hunger compromises human dignity, while threadbare rags expose vulnerability to the world.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiphina beelaa fi hiyyummaa nama muudate ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to capture how primal physical deprivation and raggedness degrade personal dignity
Keywords_AO: qoonqoo, saree, hiyyeessa
Keywords_EN: appetite, dog, destitution

Mammaaksa_AO: Daarrii hamaan, hudduun nama qullachuu dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: The most severe nakedness is when one's backside is exposed.
Meaning_AO: Salphinni hamaan yeroo hanqinni ofii orma hundatti ifa bahuudha.
Meaning_EN: The ultimate degradation occurs when one's deepest private vulnerabilities are exposed to all.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo salphinni daangaa darbe mudatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express reaching rock-bottom poverty where shielding oneself from public shame is impossible
Keywords_AO: daaraa, hamaa, qullaa
Keywords_EN: rags, severe, exposed

Mammaaksa_AO: Deegaa, haadha deeyseetu jibba.
Translation_Literal_EN: The pauper is resented even by the mother who bore him.
Meaning_AO: Namni deegaa ta'e yeroo hunda eeggataa waan ta'eef fira dhihoo birattillee gatii dhaba.
Meaning_EN: Unrelenting poverty and dependency are so exhausting that even a mother grows weary of her penniless son.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni deegaa ta'ee kabaja dhabu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express the tragic truth that endless destitution wears down even maternal sympathy
Keywords_AO: deegaa, haadha, jibba
Keywords_EN: pauper, mother, alienation

Mammaaksa_AO: Deegaan hiriyaa hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The destitute person has no friends.
Meaning_AO: Namni qabeenya hin qabne namni itti michoomu dhibee kophaa hafa.
Meaning_EN: A person without means is shunned; fair-weather companions vanish when one is penniless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo deegni nama qofaa hambisu hubachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on the painful social reality that poverty repels friends and leaves one isolated
Keywords_AO: deegaa, hiriyaa, qophummaa
Keywords_EN: pauper, friend, solitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Deegaa fi huqquun abbaa hin fakkaanne.
Translation_Literal_EN: The pauper and the emaciated do not resemble their father.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyummaan bifa, qomoo fi ulfina namaa dhabamsiisee nama jijjiira.
Meaning_EN: Crushing destitution and physical starvation disfigure a person until all noble lineage is masked.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo deegni bifa fi kabaja namaa sarbu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament how severe poverty and wasting hunger erase a person's vitality and family resemblance
Keywords_AO: deegaa, huqqaa, abbaa
Keywords_EN: pauper, emaciated, father

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkataan fira hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The troubled, destitute person has no kinfolk.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya dhabe firoonni duraan qabu hundi biraa fagaatu.
Meaning_EN: When misfortune and bankruptcy strike, relatives scatter and pretend they do not know you.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo firoonni nama hiyyoome irraa baqatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to decry how relatives quickly abandon kinfolk who fall into severe poverty
Keywords_AO: rakkataa, fira, dhabamuu
Keywords_EN: troubled, relatives, abandonment

Mammaaksa_AO: Deegaan, kaartuumittuu deegaa dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: A pauper is a pauper even in Khartoum.
Meaning_AO: Bakka jijjiirrataniif qabeenyi hin argamu; namni carraan isaa deega ta'e bakka deemetti deegaadha.
Meaning_EN: Migrating to a prosperous city changes nothing if one lacks the means and fortune to escape poverty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni iddoo jijjiiruun deegarraa bahuu dadhabu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remark that fleeing to faraway places does not magically dissolve the condition of poverty
Keywords_AO: deegaa, kaartuum, carraa
Keywords_EN: pauper, Khartoum, poverty

Mammaaksa_AO: "Amoolee dhibba ba'attaa" jennaan, "wahi deega caalaa ulfaattii" je'e.
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked to carry a hundred salt-slabs, he said, "Is anything heavier than destitution?"
Meaning_AO: Hojiin kamiyyuu akka deegaa fi hiyyummaatti nama hin ulfaatu; hojjetanii deega jalaa bahuun caala.
Meaning_EN: No physical toil, however exhausting, is heavier to shoulder than the humiliating misery of poverty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hojii cimaa hojjetee hiyyummaa mo'achuu fedhu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express determination to undertake backbreaking labor rather than endure destitution
Keywords_AO: amoolee, ulfaataa, deega
Keywords_EN: salt slab, heavy, poverty

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessi mala hin qabu, boosattiin hiree hin qabdu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The poor man lacks resources, and the slovenly woman lacks fortune.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi carraa fi tooftaa dhabee rakkata; boosattiin ammoo hireen ishii hin tolin hafti.
Meaning_EN: A poor man is handicapped by lack of capital and connections, while a lazy woman is abandoned by luck.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo carraa dhabuu fi dandeettii dhabuun walitti dhufu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe how systemic lack of resources immobilizes the poor
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, mala, boosattii
Keywords_EN: poor, strategy, slovenly

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessi, Osoo mana ambaatii foon nyaachuu baatee, addaateeti du'a.
Translation_Literal_EN: If the poor man did not eat meat at others' feasts, he would perish.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi gargaarsa fi cidha hawaasaatiin lubbuu tursa.
Meaning_EN: The destitute survive physically largely because of community feasts and neighborly charity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi eeggannoo hawaasaarratti rarra'u ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight the utter reliance of the destitute on communal solidarity and hospitality
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, foon, amba
Keywords_EN: poor, meat, charity

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessaa fi ibiddi tuttuqan ni dhaamani.
Translation_Literal_EN: A poor man and dying embers, if prodded continuously, go out completely.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessa tuttuqanii dhiphisuun humna isaa fixeeti isa balleysa; rakkataarraa of eeggatu.
Meaning_EN: Constantly harassing a poor, fragile soul completely snuffs out their spirit, just like poking dying embers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama rakkataa dhiphisuu dhowwan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish people not to push an already broken and vulnerable person over the edge
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, ibidda, dhaamuu
Keywords_EN: poor, fire, extinguish

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessaa fi ijji tuttuqaa hin danda'ani.
Translation_Literal_EN: A poor man and the eye cannot tolerate being touched/poked.
Meaning_AO: Akkuma ijji xiqqoo tuttuqamnaan boossu, hiyyeessis dhiphina dabalataa danda'uu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Just as the eye is hypersensitive to the slightest speck, an impoverished person is deeply vulnerable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama rakkataatti gara laafina agarsiisuun barbaachisu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge gentle treatment of the poor, recognizing how easily they can be hurt
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, ija, tuttuqaa
Keywords_EN: poor, eye, touch

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessa taraf itti ja'a malee, taraf irraa hin ja'u.
Translation_Literal_EN: For the poor man, troubles fall onto him, but never fall off him.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessarratti rakkinni walitti ida'ama malee salphaatti hin furamu.
Meaning_EN: Calamities continuously pile onto the poor, while relief and breakthroughs never seem to happen.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon hiyyeessarratti wal hordofu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when misfortunes relentlessly accumulate upon an already struggling household
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, taraf, rakkoo
Keywords_EN: poor, fall upon, trouble

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessi hin qalatu, kan Rabbi qale hin dhiisu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The poor man does not slaughter for himself, but doesn't pass by what God slaughtered.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi horii qalee nyaachuuf dandeettii dhabus, waan argate hunda nyaachuuf dirqama.
Meaning_EN: The poor cannot afford to slaughter livestock, but they gratefully accept whatever sustenance comes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi filannoo dhabee waan argametti fayyadamu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to convey how poverty strips away luxury and forces acceptance of whatever sustenance appears
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, qaluu, rabbi
Keywords_EN: poor, slaughter, God

Mammaaksa_AO: Deegaan deegaarra hamaa, nama deegni namaa itti gale.
Translation_Literal_EN: Worse than being a pauper is the person whose poverty becomes a burden to others.
Meaning_AO: Deegaa ta'uun miidhaa qaba, garuu deegaa nama biraatti ba'aa ta'ee nama qaanessuun caalaatti ulfaata.
Meaning_EN: Being poor is painful, but imposing the shameful burden of your poverty upon others is even worse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni deegaa ta'ee ormarratti ba'aa ta'uu isaatti hin qaanfanne
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to censure those who lack the dignity to bear their own lot and instead impose burdens on neighbors
Keywords_AO: deegaa, hamaa, ba'aa
Keywords_EN: pauper, worse, burden

Mammaaksa_AO: Madaan hiyyeessa, madaa bineensaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: A poor man's wound is like the wound of a wild beast.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi yaala fi wal'aansa dhabee akkuma bineensa bosonaa madaa'ee dhiiga.
Meaning_EN: An impoverished person's sickness or injury is neglected without medical care, just like a wild animal's.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi qoricha fi wallaansoo dhabee miidhamu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament the heartless neglect and lack of medical relief suffered by the destitute
Keywords_AO: madaa, hiyyeessa, bineensa
Keywords_EN: wound, poor, wild beast

Mammaaksa_AO: Fuulli namaa, ibidda caala nama guba.
Translation_Literal_EN: The human face burns hotter than fire.
Meaning_AO: Fuula namarraa tuffii fi dallansuu arguun ibidda nama gubu caalaa garaa nyaata.
Meaning_EN: Contemptuous scowls and disdainful human expressions inflict deeper pain than scorching flames.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni fuula jibbaatiin hiyyeessa simatee miidhu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express how devastating cold, haughty, and scornful looks are to a poor person's pride
Keywords_AO: fuula, ibidda, tuffii
Keywords_EN: face, fire, contempt

Mammaaksa_AO: Fuudha hiyyeessaarra, taaziyaa dureessaatu oowwa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than a poor man's wedding, a rich man's funeral is livelier.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni gammachuu hiyyeessaa caalaa iddoo dhiphina dureessaa deemuu filatu; qabeenyi nama hawwata.
Meaning_EN: Society eagerly gathers at a wealthy man's mourning wake, while ignoring a poor man's joyful wedding.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hawaasni namummaa caalaa qabeenyaaf kabaja kennu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose society's shallow hypocrisy in flocking around wealth regardless of the occasion
Keywords_AO: fuudha, taaziyaa, dureessa
Keywords_EN: wedding, wake, rich

Mammaaksa_AO: Deegaa dura rakkinni gabaa baha.
Translation_Literal_EN: Before the pauper arrives, hardship arrives at the market.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi yeroo gabaa dhaqu mi'aan gatiin isaa dabalee dhabamuu carraan isaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Whenever a poor man heads to market, prices spike and misfortunes precede his arrival.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi gabaatti carraa dhabee rakkinni itti caalu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how the ill fortunes of the marketplace always seem to anticipate and hit the poor first
Keywords_AO: deegaa, rakkina, gabaa
Keywords_EN: pauper, hardship, market

Mammaaksa_AO: Hantuunni haadha hin qabdu, ilmooniis akkoo hin qabdu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The mouse has no mother, and her offspring has no grandmother.
Meaning_AO: Namni deegaa fi dararama keessa jiru maatii fi gargaaraa hin qabu; kophaa isaa jiraata.
Meaning_EN: The utterly destitute have no protective relatives, elders, or lineage to turn to in times of distress.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama firri fi gargaarsi dhabameef dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express the complete absence of familial safety nets and sheltering elders for the poor
Keywords_AO: hantuuta, haadha, akkoo
Keywords_EN: mouse, mother, grandmother

Mammaaksa_AO: Dibichi deegaa, haalayyaarra oola.
Translation_Literal_EN: The pauper's bullock spends its day grazing by the precipice.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi hiyyeessaa yeroo hunda balaa fi badii jala jiraata; carraan isaa yaaddoo qofa.
Meaning_EN: The meager assets of a poor man are perpetually in peril and teetering on the brink of disaster.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qabeenyi xiqqaan hiyyeessaa balaaf saaxilamu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to portray the extreme fragility and vulnerability of whatever little the poor possess
Keywords_AO: dibicha, deegaa, balaa
Keywords_EN: bullock, pauper, peril

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkataan, buqqee kudha shani ba'ata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A troubled/needy person carries fifteen gourds.
Meaning_AO: Namni rakkatte dirqamaa fi ba'aa hedduu tokkummaatti baachuu qabaata; dhiphinni walirra dhangala'a.
Meaning_EN: An impoverished, desperate person is forced to juggle an overwhelming number of heavy burdens at once.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko ba'aa hedduun dhiphatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to depict the crushing, unsustainable accumulation of burdens piled onto the destitute
Keywords_AO: rakkataa, buqqee, ba'aa
Keywords_EN: troubled, gourd, heavy burdens

Mammaaksa_AO: Sheekni yoo dhuufe, darasaan ni albaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: If the sheikh farts, the disciple has diarrhea.
Meaning_AO: Hoggantoonni badii xiqqoo yoo hojjetan, hordoftoonni isaanii badii guddaa raawwatu.
Meaning_EN: If leaders commit a minor fault, their followers will commit far greater transgressions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hordoftoonni badii hoggantootaa caalchisanii balleessan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize followers who escalate the improper conduct modeled by their leaders
Keywords_AO: sheeka, darasaa, hoggansa
Keywords_EN: sheikh, student, leadership

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan harreen deemtuun galti goda waraabessaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: Wherever the donkey wanders, its final destination is the hyena's valley.
Meaning_AO: Namni of eeggannoo dhabee bakka balaan jirutti deddeebi'u dhumni isaa badiidha.
Meaning_EN: A careless person who repeatedly flirts with danger inevitably meets destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni balaa beekutti of dhiibu akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone that reckless behavior will inevitably lead to their destruction
Keywords_AO: harree, waraabessa, balaa
Keywords_EN: donkey, hyena, danger

Mammaaksa_AO: Kanniisni mooti qaba, tiitichi mootii hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The bee has a queen/ruler, but the housefly has no king.
Meaning_AO: Hawaasni qajeelaan hoggansa fi sirna qaba, kan heera hin qabne garuu bitaa gala.
Meaning_EN: An orderly, productive community thrives under leadership, unlike chaotic wanderers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo barbaachisummaa hoggansaa fi heeraa ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate that structured discipline leads to productivity while anarchy brings chaos
Keywords_AO: kanniisa, tiiticha, mootii
Keywords_EN: bee, fly, ruler

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan yaa'uutu, kan ciisu kaasa.
Translation_Literal_EN: It is flowing water that stirs up standing water.
Meaning_AO: Namoota dammaqoo fi carraaqqoo ta'antu warra rafee fi doofe kakaasa.
Meaning_EN: Active, energetic people inspire and mobilize those who are stagnant or passive.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dammaqaan warra kaan hojiif kakaasu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how an energetic individual activates passive people into action
Keywords_AO: bishaan, yaa'uu, kaka'umsa
Keywords_EN: water, flow, motivation

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaalli, hiriira duraati laallata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The camel keeps its eye on the front of the caravan line.
Meaning_AO: Namni karoora qabu fulduratti ilaalee deemedha; hoggantoota fi deemsa dhufu hordofa.
Meaning_EN: A wise traveler keeps focus on the leadership and the direction ahead.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni deemsa fi hoggansa fuulduraa hordofuu qabu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise staying focused on frontrunners, future goals, and leadership
Keywords_AO: gaala, hiriira, dura
Keywords_EN: camel, line, front

Mammaaksa_AO: Mootiin hayyuu hin qabne, bara tokko hin kunne.
Translation_Literal_EN: A ruler who has no wise counselor does not last a year.
Meaning_AO: Hoggantoonni gorsa hayyootaa hin fudhanne aangoo isaaniirra hin turan.
Meaning_EN: A ruler without wise counselors cannot sustain power and will quickly fall.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hoggansi gorsa hayyootaa didee kufu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn leaders that ruling without sound counsel guarantees downfall
Keywords_AO: mootii, hayyuu, gorsa
Keywords_EN: ruler, counselor, counsel

Mammaaksa_AO: Mootiin kanniisaa, nama hin ciniinu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The queen bee does not sting people.
Meaning_AO: Hoggantoonni dhugaa fi kabajamoon nama hin miidhan; kabajaan bulchu.
Meaning_EN: True noble leaders govern with dignity and do not stoop to petty cruelty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo amala gaarummaa fi kabaja hoggansaa ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise dignified, noble leaders who refrain from petty vindictiveness
Keywords_AO: mootii, kanniisa, ciniinuu
Keywords_EN: queen, bee, sting

Mammaaksa_AO: Kanniisaatu daraaraa guura malee, mootiin daraaraa hin guuru.
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the worker bees that gather nectar, not the queen.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi dadhabbii hunda uummatatu ba'ata; mootiin sirna qofa eega.
Meaning_EN: Labor and groundwork are done by the common workers, while leaders steer and manage.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo adda baasuu qooda hojii hoggansaafi hojjetaa ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that the masses do the heavy lifting while rulers guide
Keywords_AO: kanniisa, daraaraa, qooda
Keywords_EN: bee, flower, labor

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama biyyi jirtuun, duula hin geessani.
Translation_Literal_EN: A man whose heart is at home is not taken to military campaign.
Meaning_AO: Nama fedhii fi kutannoo hin qabne dhimma guddaaf qooda kennuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: One whose heart longs for home cannot be entrusted with the rigors of battle.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama garaankee hin jirre hojii cimaatti hin erginaa jedhan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against deploying uncommitted individuals for serious missions
Keywords_AO: nama, biyya, duula
Keywords_EN: man, home, battle

Mammaaksa_AO: karaan jaldeessaa fi firoomni waanbadee hallayyatti nama geessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: The baboon's path and friendship with an outlaw lead one to the cliff.
Meaning_AO: Karaa badaa hordofuu fi nama badii wajjin michoomuun gara hallayyaatti nama geessa.
Meaning_EN: Following reckless paths and befriending outlaws inevitably leads to catastrophe.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama amala badaa fi shiftaa wajjin michoome akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against traveling treacherous paths or associating with destructive individuals
Keywords_AO: jaldeessa, waanbadee, hallayyaa
Keywords_EN: baboon, outlaw, cliff

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki mootiin mure, dooluu hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A hand severed by the king bears no blood-money.
Meaning_AO: Murtiin seeraa fi mootummaa yoo dhufe komiin hin jiru; fudhatama qaba.
Meaning_EN: Justice administered legitimately by sovereign authority admits of no legal dispute.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo murtiin sirnaan darbe deebii hin qabne ibsamu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to indicate that rightful judgments rendered by legitimate authority must be accepted
Keywords_AO: harka, mootii, dooluu
Keywords_EN: hand, king, compensation

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa korma saree, atummaan seera murii, atummaan dhagaa arraabi.
Translation_Literal_EN: "Oh male dog, judge the law yourself and lick the stones yourself."
Meaning_AO: Namni amala fi kabajaa hin qabne murtii haqaas kennuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A base and unprincipled person cannot be trusted to judge or uphold justice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amala hin qabne seera muruuf dhufe koflan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock having an unprincipled and lowly individual serve as an arbiter of justice
Keywords_AO: saree, seera, dhagaa
Keywords_EN: dog, law, stone

Mammaaksa_AO: "Goftaan koo goofta qaba" jette, gabrittiin.
Translation_Literal_EN: "My master has a master," said the maidservant.
Meaning_AO: Namni hunduu abbaa aangoo ol'aanaa qaba; namni daangaa hin qabne hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Even the mightiest master is subject to higher authority; earthly power has limits.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni angoo qabu of tuule akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind arrogant rulers and bosses that they too answer to a higher authority
Keywords_AO: gooftaa, gabrittii, aangoo
Keywords_EN: master, maid, power

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waanuma nuti hadhaa gooneetu hadhaa taha" jette, buutiin.
Translation_Literal_EN: "Whatever we make bitter becomes bitter," said the viper.
Meaning_AO: Namni humnaa fi dhiibbaa qabu akka barbaadetti dhimma murteessa ykn summeessa.
Meaning_EN: Those with the power to poison determine how bitter things turn out.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dandeettii hamaa qabu humna isaan sodaachisu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone powerful and dangerous dictates the severity of consequences
Keywords_AO: hadhaa, buutii, summii
Keywords_EN: bitter, viper, poison

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaldeessa illee taatu, booyraa tahi.
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if you are a baboon, be the alpha male.
Meaning_AO: Sadarkaa kamiyyuu keessa yoo jiraatte, kutannoo fi hoggansa qabaadhu; mul'adhu.
Meaning_EN: Whatever your station in life, strive to lead and stand out with courage.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dandeettii qabu akka hoggansa fudhatu jajjabeessan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire someone to excel, lead, and demonstrate vigor regardless of status
Keywords_AO: jaldeessa, booyraa, hoggansa
Keywords_EN: baboon, alpha, leadership

Mammaaksa_AO: "Guutee si agarsiise, huursee si dhageeysisee, yoo didde kan azaabaa tahi" je'e, bishaan.
Translation_Literal_EN: "I showed you by flooding, I made you hear by roaring; if you refuse, meet your doom," said the water.
Meaning_AO: Mallattoon akeekkachiisaa ifatti erga kennamee namni of eeggachuu dide badii keessa gala.
Meaning_EN: When clear warnings have been both shown and sounded, ignoring them leads straight to doom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni akeekkachiisa ifaa didee balaatti of laatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone willfully ignores unmistakable warning signs and meets disaster
Keywords_AO: bishaan, guutuu, azaaba
Keywords_EN: water, flood, doom

Mammaaksa_AO: "Hanga'ee sitti ibsee, mandihee si dhageessisee, hammaan sitti titiifu na eeydaa" je'e, roobni.
Translation_Literal_EN: "I flashed lightning to show you, I thundered to make you hear; do you wait until I drizzle on you?" said the rain.
Meaning_AO: Mallattoon duraa osoo ifa jiruu namni hanga rakkoon isa qunnamutti caldhisee eeguu hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Obvious signs precede disaster; one should take precautions before catastrophe actually strikes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni osoo mallattoon jiru of hin qopheessine himamu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge taking shelter or precautions before imminent trouble begins pouring down
Keywords_AO: rooba, hangaasuu, mandisuu
Keywords_EN: rain, lightning, thunder

Mammaaksa_AO: Mukni adda dhawe, ija heere.
Translation_Literal_EN: The wood that struck the forehead aimed for the eye.
Meaning_AO: Balaan xiqqoon dhufe gara isa hamaatti deema; balaa xiqqaa tuffachuu hin qaban.
Meaning_EN: A blow that strikes the brow came perilously close to the eye; small threats signal grave danger.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo miidhaan xiqqaan dhufe akka of eeggannoo guddaa fidu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that a narrow escape is an omen of much worse danger to come
Keywords_AO: muka, adda, ija
Keywords_EN: wood, forehead, eye

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni qabrii hiriyaa arge, kan ifii arge.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who sees a friend's grave has seen one's own.
Meaning_AO: Balaa fi du'a nama biraarraa barnoota fudhachuun carraa ofiis yaadachuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: Witnessing the mortality and downfall of a peer is a sober reminder of one's own inevitable fate.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoo nama biraarraa of qoratan dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people that the misfortunes of neighbors will eventually reach them too
Keywords_AO: qabrii, hiriyaa, du'a
Keywords_EN: grave, friend, mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Aaggannoon cinaa dhawinaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: Aiming a blow is half the beating.
Meaning_AO: Nama sodaachisuun ykn itti aggaamuun akkuma miidhaa qaamaa geessisuuti.
Meaning_EN: Menacing intimidation and threatening gestures carry half the trauma of an actual physical blow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aggaammiin nama naasisu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that threatening violence creates almost as much fear and harm as violence itself
Keywords_AO: aaggannoo, dhawicha, sodaa
Keywords_EN: aiming, blow, fear

Mammaaksa_AO: Aaggannoon dhawina irraa hin oolle.
Translation_Literal_EN: A menacing aim does not fail to become a strike.
Meaning_AO: Wanti itti aggaamamee fi sodaachifame yeroo baay'ee gara rukuttaatti jijjiirama.
Meaning_EN: Threats and aggressive posturing rarely remain idle; they usually escalate into actual attacks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo sodaan duraa gara dhugaa deemutti akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that hostile intentions and gestures will inevitably turn into harmful actions
Keywords_AO: aaggannoo, dhawicha, balaa
Keywords_EN: aiming, strike, danger

Mammaaksa_AO: "Daandiin kun si hin baasu" jette, jaartiin.
Translation_Literal_EN: "This road will not lead you out," said the old woman.
Meaning_AO: Gorsa manguddootaa tuffachuun karaan namni filate kisaaraa fi badii fida.
Meaning_EN: Experienced elders perceive early when a reckless course of action is headed for a dead end.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni karaa badii deemu gorsa beektotaa didu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone stubbornly pursues a disastrous venture despite elder warnings
Keywords_AO: daandii, jaartii, gorsa
Keywords_EN: road, elder woman, counsel

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkee waraabeysaa, lafee irratti sodaatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: The hyena's teeth are feared when seen on bones.
Meaning_AO: Humnaa fi hammeenya nama tokkoo yeroo inni waan jabaa cabsu argan sodaatu.
Meaning_EN: The true destructive power of an enemy is respected when they are seen crushing tough obstacles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo humna diinaa lafee cabsurraatti argan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to recognize that an opponent's dangerous capabilities should never be underestimated
Keywords_AO: ilkee, waraabeessa, lafee
Keywords_EN: teeth, hyena, bone

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhukkubni funyaan qabe, hidhii hin hanqatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: An affliction that seizes the nose will not spare the lip.
Meaning_AO: Balaan ykn rakkoon nama dhihoo miidhe salphaatti gara ofiitti ce'a.
Meaning_EN: Misfortune or contagion that strikes an adjacent neighbor will inevitably spread to oneself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon ollaa gara ofiitti ce'uu danda'u hubachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that disaster affecting those close by will soon reach your own doorstep
Keywords_AO: dhukkuba, funyaan, hidhii
Keywords_EN: affliction, nose, lip

Mammaaksa_AO: Shinbirroon muka kanarra qubatte, kaaniif dinniinoyte.
Translation_Literal_EN: The bird perched on this tree twittered/threatened the other tree.
Meaning_AO: Namni bakka eeggannoo fi dawoo qabu ta'ee ormarratti of tuula ykn akeekkachiisa.
Meaning_EN: Someone from a position of absolute safety boldly taunts, boasts, or challenges rivals afar.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dawoo namaatti hirkatee orma arrabsu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who acts brave only because they are shielded by a safe vantage point
Keywords_AO: shinbirroo, muka, dinniina
Keywords_EN: bird, tree, boast

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysi guyyaa yuuse, mana seenuu hin oolu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A hyena that howls in broad daylight will not fail to enter the house.
Meaning_AO: Hammeenyi ifatti mul'ate gara badii guddaatti akka deemu beekamaadha.
Meaning_EN: When a predator acts with blatant boldness in daytime, a direct invasive attack is imminent.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo diinni ija laafina malee ifatti mul'atu akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that open brazenness by an adversary portends immediate, aggressive violation
Keywords_AO: waraabeessa, guyyaa, mana
Keywords_EN: hyena, daylight, house

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysi guyyaa yuuse, lixa aduutiin nama hin afu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A hyena that howls by day will spare nobody by sunset.
Meaning_AO: Diinni saafaa ija jabaatee mul'ate dhiheenya sanatti balaa geessisa.
Meaning_EN: An adversary displaying abnormal daytime boldness will strike ruthlessly before nightfall.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo diinni yeroo hin malleetti naanna'u argan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge immediate defense against an enemy acting with dangerous, overt confidence
Keywords_AO: waraabeessa, guyyaa, aduu
Keywords_EN: hyena, day, sunset

Mammaaksa_AO: Sii himee, sitti himee, hin fuudhin dubra Huumee.
Translation_Literal_EN: "I told you and warned you: do not marry the daughter of Hume."
Meaning_AO: Waan balaa qabu duraan dursa irra deddeebi'anii gorsu; gorsa diduun gaabbii fida.
Meaning_EN: Repeated and explicit warnings were given against a foolish choice; ignoring counsel brings ruin.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gorsa irra deddeebi'amee kennameef dide
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone regrets a disastrous decision after ignoring repeated explicit counsel
Keywords_AO: himuu, fuudha, dubra
Keywords_EN: tell, marriage, maiden

Mammaaksa_AO: " Siitu waa tan araddaa irraa hidhan tahee mitii, anaatu waa kan soban tahee mitii" je'e,waraabeysi harree dhaan.
Translation_Literal_EN: "You are not one to be tethered in the open yard, and I am not one to be fooled," said the hyena to the donkey.
Meaning_AO: Gammachuu fi nagaa sobaa hin amaninaa; diinni amala isaa hin jijjiiru.
Meaning_EN: False security cannot deceive a predator; a natural adversary will never abandon its true nature.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amala diinaa dagatee of dagatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock naive complacency in the presence of an incurable and ruthless enemy
Keywords_AO: waraabeessa, harree, soba
Keywords_EN: hyena, donkey, deceit

Mammaaksa_AO: "Eeysuma kiyyaatu qeerransa" jette, Adurreen.
Translation_Literal_EN: "My maternal uncle is the leopard," said the cat.
Meaning_AO: Namni humna hin qabne fira humna qabuun dhaaddata; of tuulummaa bu'uura hin qabneedha.
Meaning_EN: A small, weak individual boasts of a powerful relative to project false grandeur.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan ofii hin qabneen fira fakkeessee dhaaddatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule weak people who boast of mighty relatives they have no claim to emulate
Keywords_AO: adurree, qeerransa, eessuma
Keywords_EN: cat, leopard, uncle

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki taa'u, galata hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: An idle hand earns no gratitude.
Meaning_AO: Namni hin hojjenne kabajaa fi galata nama biraa hin argatu; hojiitu galata fida.
Meaning_EN: Idleness earns neither respect nor gratitude; only diligent labor brings honor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dhibaa'aa hojii hin hojjenne gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish lazy individuals that idleness brings no appreciation or reward
Keywords_AO: harka, taa'uu, galata
Keywords_EN: hand, idle, gratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki taa'u huji ballessa, garaan taa'u ilmo ballessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: An idle hand spoils work, and an idle womb/belly spoils offspring.
Meaning_AO: Hojii dhabuun jireenya balleessa, kunuunsa dhabuun ammoo ijoollee mancaasa.
Meaning_EN: Idleness ruins livelihoods, just as negligence spoils children.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhibaa'ummaan badii fidu hubachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that chronic inactivity destroys both economic output and family upbringing
Keywords_AO: harka, hojii, garaa, ilmoo
Keywords_EN: hand, work, belly, child

Mammaaksa_AO: Dalagan, sooratan.
Translation_Literal_EN: If one works, one eats.
Meaning_AO: Nyaata fi jireenya argachuuf hojiin dirqama; hojii malee quufi hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Sustenance is the direct fruit of labor; without working, one cannot eat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo barbaachisummaa hojii jireenyaaf ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to state the fundamental truth that honest labor is required for survival
Keywords_AO: dalagaa, soorata, hojii
Keywords_EN: work, eat, labor

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka taa'u irra, kan udaaniin haraniitu caala.
Translation_Literal_EN: Better a hand soiled by sweeping dung than an idle hand.
Meaning_AO: Hojii tuffatamaa hojjetanii of danda'uutu hojii malee taa'uu caala.
Meaning_EN: Any productive, humble labor—even cleaning filth—is far better than shameful idleness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojii xiqqoo tuffatanii taa'an gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that no honest work is beneath one compared to the disgrace of laziness
Keywords_AO: harka, taa'uu, haruu
Keywords_EN: hand, idle, sweep

Mammaaksa_AO: Eelanii, eelee dhaabbatan.
Translation_Literal_EN: One toils/sweats before placing the baking pan on the hearth.
Meaning_AO: Osoo hin dadhabin bu'aa fi nyaata qophaa'aa argachuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Hard labor and toil must precede the enjoyment of a hot, prepared meal.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bu'aan hojii dadhabbii booda dhufu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people that comfort and sustenance require strenuous prior effort
Keywords_AO: eeluu, eelee, hojii
Keywords_EN: toil, griddle, work

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaaruu malee, diiguun nama hin dhibu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Building is what is hard; tearing down troubles no one.
Meaning_AO: Waan tokko ijaaruun dadhabbii fi yeroo gaafata, garuu balleessuun salphaadha.
Meaning_EN: Constructing and creating require immense dedication, whereas destruction is effortless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni waan ijaarame salphaatti diigan gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that building institutions, wealth, or peace takes hard work, unlike destruction
Keywords_AO: jaaruu, diiguu, ijaarsa
Keywords_EN: build, demolish, construct

Mammaaksa_AO: Hedduu dubbachuu irra, xiqqo dalaguu wayya.
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to work a little than to talk a lot.
Meaning_AO: Odeessuu fi afaaniin dhaaddachuu irra hojii qabatamaa xiqqoo hojjechuutu caala.
Meaning_EN: A small tangible action is vastly superior to endless boasting and idle words.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dubbii qofa heddummeessu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to stop babbling and produce concrete results through labor
Keywords_AO: dubbachuu, dalaguu, hojii
Keywords_EN: speak, work, action

Mammaaksa_AO: Hedduu naannawuu irra, xiqqo dalaguu wayya.
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to do a little work than to roam around a lot.
Meaning_AO: Bakka malee asii fi achi fiiguu irra hojii bu'aa qabu hojjechuutu wayya.
Meaning_EN: Performing focused, modest labor is far more fruitful than aimless wandering.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni yeroo isaa naanna'uun balleessu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against wasting time on aimless loafing instead of productive work
Keywords_AO: naannawuu, dalaguu, yeroo
Keywords_EN: roam, work, time

Mammaaksa_AO: Facaasan malee, hin mayru/margu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one sows, it does not sprout.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi carraaqqii osoo hin jalqabin bu'aa eeggachuun gatii hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Without planting seeds of hard work, expecting a fruitful harvest is impossible.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bu'aa argachuuf duraan hojjechuu qaban himan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that success and prosperity require prior planting and investment
Keywords_AO: facaasuu, marguu, oomisha
Keywords_EN: sow, sprout, harvest

Mammaaksa_AO: Qotan malee, hin quufan.
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one plows, one does not get full.
Meaning_AO: Lafa qotanii midhaan oomishu malee beela ba'uun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Abundance and fullness can only be achieved through strenuous plowing and agricultural toil.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo qonnaan bultoota fi hojjettoota jajjabeessan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight that agricultural diligence is the bedrock of food security and fullness
Keywords_AO: qotuu, quufuu, midhaan
Keywords_EN: plow, full, grain

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan akkanaatu, qotaa midhaanii namatti singiggessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: It is things like this that make plowing for grain seem nauseating.
Meaning_AO: Wanti rakkisaan yookiin nama hin beekne mudannaan namni hojii isaa nuffa.
Meaning_EN: Frustrating interferences or petty nuisances make even essential labor feel exasperating.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimmi xiqqaan hojii nama jibbisiisu dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when exasperating circumstances make a person sick and tired of working
Keywords_AO: qotaa, midhaan, singiggessuu
Keywords_EN: plowing, grain, exasperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Boolla jaartii jalloo, jallisaniiti qotan.
Translation_Literal_EN: The grave for a crooked old woman is dug crookedly.
Meaning_AO: Haala dhimmi tokko qabu ilaaluun furmaata isaaf malu mijeessu.
Meaning_EN: Work must be adapted to fit the specific idiosyncrasies or shape of the task at hand.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo akkaataa haalatti toftaa jijjiirratan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise tailoring one's methods flexibly to fit the unique nature of the problem
Keywords_AO: boolla, jaartii, jalloo, qotuu
Keywords_EN: pit, elder woman, crooked, dig

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan taa'e ilaaluuf, daakuun boqqolloo dinbilaal.
Translation_Literal_EN: To one who merely sits and watches, grinding corn seems like tossing coriander seeds.
Meaning_AO: Nama alaan ilaaluuf hojiin hundi salphaa fakkaata; garuu keessi isaa dadhabbii qaba.
Meaning_EN: To a bystander who does no work, heavy labor appears completely effortless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hin hojjenne hojii namaa salphisee ilaalu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke arm-chair critics who dismiss the difficulty of tasks they do not perform
Keywords_AO: taa'uu, boqqolloo, daakuu
Keywords_EN: sit, corn, grind

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii guddoon qabaarra, dalagaa xiqqoon qabaa wayya.
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to say 'I have a little work' than 'I have a big dispute/talk'.
Meaning_AO: Odeessaa fi lola keessa jiraachuu irra hojii xiqqoo hojjetanii jiraachuutu caala.
Meaning_EN: Holding a small honest job is far better than being embroiled in endless talk and litigation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dubbii dhiisee hojii filatu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge choosing quiet, modest labor rather than getting involved in loud, contentious disputes
Keywords_AO: dubbii, dalagaa, hojii
Keywords_EN: words, work, dispute

Mammaaksa_AO: Waa guddifannaan, waa dhaba dhoowwiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Adopting/raising something protects against having nothing.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi horii xiqqoo kunuunsanii guddifachuun yeroo rakkinaa nama baasa.
Meaning_EN: Nurturing and investing in small assets or dependents shields one against future destitution.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo waan xiqqoo kunuunsanii guddisuu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise taking care of small beginnings, livestock, or children for long-term security
Keywords_AO: guddifachuu, dhabuu, qusannoo
Keywords_EN: raise, lack, saving

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurri ameysa hin qabu, ameysi isaa oduu dha.
Translation_Literal_EN: The ear owns no milking cow; its only dairy is gossip/news.
Meaning_AO: Gurri yeroo hunda oduu fi haasawa dhaga'uu barbaada malee hojii qabatamaa hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: The ear generates no tangible produce; its only endless intake is hearsay and rumors.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni oduu qofa dhaggeeffachuu aadaa godhatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people that listening to endless rumors brings no real sustenance
Keywords_AO: gurra, ameysa, oduu
Keywords_EN: ear, milking cow, news

Mammaaksa_AO: Hoggaa dalaydu gabra fakkaadhu, hoggaa nyaattu mootii fakkaadhu.
Translation_Literal_EN: When you work, look like a slave; when you eat, look like a king.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo hojjettu qullaa fi dadhabbii hin jibbini, yeroo nyaattu garuu kabajaan jiraadhu.
Meaning_EN: Work with relentless, unpretentious humility; then enjoy the fruits of your labor like royalty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hojiitti jabaatee of kabachiisu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire working with vigorous humility without being ashamed of sweat and dirt
Keywords_AO: dalaguu, gabra, mootii, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: work, slave, king, eat

Mammaaksa_AO: Halchaan, waan ormaa hin fuudhu
Translation_Literal_EN: Mere covetousness/craving does not take what belongs to another
Meaning_AO: Wanta nama biraa ijaan kajeeluun yookaan garaadhaa dharra'uun qofti qabeenya sana kan ofii hin godhu; kajeellaa fi hawwiin qofti bu'aa hin fidu, hojjetanii horachuu yookaan fedhii ofii to'achuun barbaachisaadha
Meaning_EN: Mere coveting, longing, or eyeing what belongs to others cannot make it yours; wishing or lusting after someone else's possessions acquires nothing; one must work to earn their own livelihood rather than harboring futile envy
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko qabeenya nama biraatiif bololuu fi kajeeluun bu'aa akka hin qabne, akkasumas wanta namaa hawwuun qofti wanticha akka namaaf hin fidne gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone against coveting or lusting after others' belongings, reminding them that yearning and envy cannot acquire another person's wealth
Keywords_AO: halchaa; kajeellaa; dharraa; waan ormaa; fuudhuu; qabeenya; bolola
Keywords_EN: covetousness; craving; longing; another's property; taking; envy; desire

Mammaaksa_AO: Okkoteen mukaa, osoo hin bilcheessine gubatti.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wooden cooking pot burns before it cooks the food.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan ykn namni dandeettii hin qabne dhimma guddaaf hin ta'u; osoo bu'aa hin argamsiisin bada.
Meaning_EN: An unfit tool or incompetent person fails and is ruined before accomplishing the task.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama dandeettii hin qabne hojii cimaatti muudan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against deploying incompetent people or unsuitable materials for heavy tasks
Keywords_AO: okkotee, muka, gubachuu
Keywords_EN: pot, wood, burn

Mammaaksa_AO: Okkoteen mukaa, ofii hin taatuu kan keeysaa hin baaftu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A wooden cooking pot is useless itself and cannot serve what is inside.
Meaning_AO: Namni of hin dandeenye nama kaaniifillee faayidaa kennuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: One who is inherently inadequate cannot take care of oneself, let alone help others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ofiifuu homaa hin taane nama gargaaruu yaalu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize someone who is helpless on their own yet claims to support others
Keywords_AO: okkotee, muka, faayidaa
Keywords_EN: pot, wood, useless

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkeen haancaan dhaaban, ilkee namaa hin taatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Teeth fashioned from resin/gum never become real human teeth.
Meaning_AO: Wanti namtolchee fi sobaa bakka dhugaa hin bu'u; faayidaa yeroo gabaabaa qofa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Artificial substitutes or superficial imitations never truly replace the genuine article.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti sobaa bakka dhugaa bu'uu dadhabu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that superficial fixes and fake personas cannot replace authentic substance
Keywords_AO: ilkee, haancaa, dhugaa
Keywords_EN: teeth, resin, real

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuun qubaan qabanii taa'ani, gaafa quba hin qabne baati.
Translation_Literal_EN: Life is held carefully by the fingers, but slips away on the day of unpreparedness.
Meaning_AO: Lubbuun namaa wanta laafaa fi eeggannoo guddaa barbaadduudha; gaafa hin yaadin dhumti.
Meaning_EN: Human life is fragile and held tentatively; it departs when least anticipated.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo duuti tasa nama dhibdu dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on the suddenness of mortality and the utmost fragility of human existence
Keywords_AO: lubbuu, quba, du'a
Keywords_EN: life, finger, death

Mammaaksa_AO: Buqqeen, buqqoominaaf caphuu hin oolle.
Translation_Literal_EN: A gourd, being fragile/brittle, does not escape shattering.
Meaning_AO: Wanti uumamaan laafaa ta'e balaa fi caccabuu jalaa bahuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: What is inherently fragile and vulnerable cannot avoid eventual fracture or destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti laafaan miidhamee badu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that brittle things and weak structures inevitably succumb to breaking
Keywords_AO: buqqee, caphuu, laafina
Keywords_EN: gourd, break, fragile

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaa fi humni wal quba hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The appetite/desire and one's strength have no knowledge of each other.
Meaning_AO: Fedhiin garaa guddaa ta'uu danda'a, garuu humni namaa isa raawwachuuf gahaa miti.
Meaning_EN: One's inner desires and ambitions often vastly exceed one's actual physical capacity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo fedhiin namaa humna isaa ol ta'u ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone wishes for grand achievements but lacks the requisite resources or strength
Keywords_AO: garaa, humna, fedhii
Keywords_EN: belly, strength, desire

Mammaaksa_AO: Hedduminaaf tiitichi, kaasa hin jiiysine
Translation_Literal_EN: Despite their numbers, flies did not knock over/topple the cup
Meaning_AO: Baay'inni namoota dadhaboo fi humna hin qabnee wanta jabaa yookaan dhimma bu'uuraa tokko diiguu ykn kuffisuu hin danda'u; qulqullinaa fi humnatu baay'ina caala malee waci lakkoofsaa gatii hin qabu
Meaning_EN: Despite their vast numbers, powerless individuals cannot topple a solid obstacle or overturn an established institution; sheer numerical quantity without strength or substance accomplishes nothing
Theme_EN: Impotence of Numbers Without Real Strength
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni humna hin qabne baay'achuu isaaniitti boonanii garuu wanta xiqqoo illee jijjiiruu yookaan kuffisuu dadhaban saaxiluuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that a disorganized mob or swarm of weak, ineffective individuals cannot overturn a solid institution or achieve meaningful impact
Keywords_AO: heddummina; tiiticha; kaasaa; jiiysuu; jigsuu; kuffisuu; humna dhabuu
Keywords_EN: numbers; flies; cup; toppling; knocking over; weakness; impotence

Mammaaksa_AO: Wadala hashara shifuutiin kufe.
Translation_Literal_EN: A full-grown donkey collapsed from a measly pinch of chaff.
Meaning_AO: Namni jabaan wanta xiqqoo fi salphaa taateen kufuu danda'a; tuffiin balaa fida.
Meaning_EN: Even a strong, sturdy individual can be brought down by a seemingly trivial blow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti xiqqaate jabaa kuffiftu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that even formidable persons can succumb to minor, neglected weaknesses
Keywords_AO: wadala, hashara, kufaatii
Keywords_EN: donkey, chaff, collapse

Mammaaksa_AO: Du'aan, du'a namatti hin dhaqu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A dead person does not attend another's funeral/mourning.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofiifuu rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru nama kaan gargaaruu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: One who is already ruined or in agony cannot offer assistance to others in distress.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni of hin dandeenye rakkoo namaatti qaqqabuu dadhabu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that a person crushed by their own crisis cannot rescue another
Keywords_AO: du'aa, du'a, gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: dead, funeral, help

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama taaytaan dadhabe, cidhaantu itti ulfaata
Translation_Literal_EN: To a man whose vigor/strength has failed him, even his own testicles feel heavy
Meaning_AO: Namni humni fi jabinnii isaa dhume yookaan dadhabbiin guddaan isa miidhe, wanti uumamaa isa wajjin jiruuyyuu akka ba'aa ulfaataatti itti dhaga'ama; dadhabbii fi humna dhabuu daangaa darbe agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: To a man whose physical strength and vigor have completely drained away, even his own testicles become a burdensome weight; when utterly depleted, even one's own natural body and basic existence feel heavy to bear
Theme_EN: Extreme Exhaustion and Loss of Vigor
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko garmalee dadhabee yookaan humna dhabee wanti salphaan fi uumama ofiituu akka ba'aatti itti ulfaatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe someone who is so physically depleted, worn down by labor, or enfeebled by age/illness that even the slightest natural burden feels completely overwhelming
Keywords_AO: taaytaa; humna; dadhabuu; cidhaan; ulfaachuu; qaama; dadhabbina
Keywords_EN: vigor; strength; exhaustion; testicles; heavy; frailty; worn out; burden

Mammaaksa_AO: Tan deeysu, ta deeysu jala hin teeysu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A woman in labor does not assist another woman in labor.
Meaning_AO: Namni dhiphina keessa jiru yeroo sanatti nama dhiphatu biraaf gargaarsa hin ta'u.
