Meaning_AO: Namni iddoo salphaa fi amansiisaatti bare iddoo balaa keessa seenee of guba.
Meaning_EN: Habituated to easy, harmless indulgences, one carelessly plunges into boiling, deadly traps.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amalaan of dagatee balaatti kufu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that casual carelessness formed in safe spaces proves fatal in dangerous arenas
Keywords_AO: tiiticha, baaduu, danfa
Keywords_EN: fly, buttermilk, boiling broth

Mammaaksa_AO: Hantuutni quufe, karaa irratti taphata.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mouse that has eaten its fill plays boldly on the open road.
Meaning_AO: Namni quufe sodaata dhabee bakka balaan jirutti of saaxila; quufi qalbii balleessa.
Meaning_EN: A mouse full of grain loses all fear, foolishly dancing in open sight of lurking predators.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo quufi nama of dagachiisee balaaf saaxilu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how sudden abundance makes foolish people discard caution and invite peril
Keywords_AO: hantuuta, quufuu, karaa
Keywords_EN: mouse, full, road

Mammaaksa_AO: Re'een farra qabdu, mataa qeerransaa arraabdi.
Translation_Literal_EN: An ill-omened goat licks the leopard's head.
Meaning_AO: Namni carraan isaa badii ta'e diina isa nyaatutti beekaa dhihaata; balaatti of kenna.
Meaning_EN: An ill-fated, doomed creature boldly courts death by caressing the head of the predator.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni of dhiibee balaa hamaa keessa seenu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe someone whose uncurbed foolishness drives them to flirt with certain doom
Keywords_AO: re'ee, farra, qeerransa
Keywords_EN: goat, ill-omened, leopard

Mammaaksa_AO: If qolli hin huqqatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The selfish/stingy person does not grow emaciated.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittoo ta'ee fi waan qabu ormarraa qusatu qabeenya fi qaamaan of hin miidhu.
Meaning_EN: A self-centered miser who hoards everything for oneself never suffers lack or wasting.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ofittummaan waan ofii nyaatu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe how stingy, self-absorbed individuals prioritize their own well-being above all
Keywords_AO: if qola, huqqachuu, ofittummaa
Keywords_EN: miser, emaciated, selfishness

Mammaaksa_AO: If hifanni hin dulloomu, if qolli hin huqqatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who spares oneself does not age quickly; a stingy person does not grow emaciated.
Meaning_AO: Namni dadhabbii fi dhiphina ofirraa qusatu umriin isaa ni tura, ofittoonis ni gabbata.
Meaning_EN: One who avoids grueling strain ages slowly, and one who hoards food stays well-fed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni of hin dhiphifne jireenyaan tursiisu dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that prioritizing one's own comfort and sustenance preserves vitality
Keywords_AO: if hifannaa, dulloomuu, huqqachuu
Keywords_EN: self-sparing, aging, emaciated

Mammaaksa_AO: If qolli, harka hin qabu.
Translation_Literal_EN: The miser/selfish person has no generous hand.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittoo ta'e nama gargaaruuf harka hin diriiyrfatu; kennuu hin beeku.
Meaning_EN: A tight-fisted, selfish person has no open hand to extend charity or help to others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya qabaatee nama gargaaruu didu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke misers who refuse to extend a helping hand to those in need
Keywords_AO: if qola, harka, doqnummaa
Keywords_EN: miser, hand, stinginess

Mammaaksa_AO: Arjaan dhadha kenna, if qolli bishaan dhoowwata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The generous person gives away butter, while the miser begrudges even plain water.
Meaning_AO: Namni arjaan waan mi'aawaa fi kabajamaa kenna, doqni garuu waan salphaallee hin kennu.
Meaning_EN: A magnanimous soul shares rich delicacies, whereas a stingy person withholds basic water.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo arjummaa fi doqnummaa wal bira qabanii madaalan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast the open-heartedness of the generous with the pettiness of the miser
Keywords_AO: arjaa, dhadha, bishaan, doqna
Keywords_EN: generous, butter, water, miser

Mammaaksa_AO: Of jettuun, dhiirsa koo hin jettu.
Translation_Literal_EN: She who is self-absorbed never says 'my husband'.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittummaan qabame nama kaaniif kabajaa fi jaalala hin kennu; of qofa yaada.
Meaning_EN: An entirely self-absorbed partner thinks only of herself and never honors her spouse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haati manaa ofittummaan maatii dagattu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize selfish partners who prioritize personal interests over domestic solidarity
Keywords_AO: of jettuu, dhiirsa, ofittummaa
Keywords_EN: self-absorbed, husband, egoism

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni garaa bal'atu, jaalala hin beeku.
Translation_Literal_EN: A gluttonous/greedy person knows nothing of true love.
Meaning_AO: Namni fedhii qodhaa fi garaa ofii qofa hordofu jaalala dhugaa namaaf hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: One whose heart is dominated by bottomless appetite and greed is incapable of selfless love.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bololli fi kajeellaan jaalala dhabsiisu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that unbridled self-indulgence and greed leave no room for genuine love
Keywords_AO: garaa, bal'ina, jaalala
Keywords_EN: appetite, greed, love

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin dhiirsa ishii irraanfattee, dinnichaa funaannatte.
Translation_Literal_EN: The woman forgot her dying husband and went gathering potatoes.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittoo ta'e dhiphina fira dhihoo dhiisee faayidaa xiqqaaf fiiga.
Meaning_EN: A self-serving individual completely ignores a grave family crisis to pursue trivial food.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni rakkoo guddaa dhiisee faayidaa dhuunfaaf fiigu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn callous individuals who prioritize petty personal gains over life-and-death crises
Keywords_AO: niitii, dhiirsa, dinnicha
Keywords_EN: wife, husband, potatoes

Mammaaksa_AO: Ati naa hooysi, ani niin luugaa.
Translation_Literal_EN: You warm it for me, and I will suck/drink it down.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi dadhabbii nama biraatti dhiisanii bu'aa qofa dhuunfaatti eeggatu.
Meaning_EN: Leaving all the labor and preparation to another while eagerly claiming the benefit for oneself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hojii namaatiin fayyadamuu barbaadu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose selfish opportunists who want others to toil so they can consume the reward
Keywords_AO: ho'isuu, luuguu, ofittummaa
Keywords_EN: warm, swallow, exploitation

Mammaaksa_AO: A'oon waraabeysaa, keysaa duubaan walitti qooyti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The jaws of a hyena crunch together from inside and behind.
Meaning_AO: Balaan yookiin diinni hamaan kallattii hundaan nama marsee nama liqimsa.
Meaning_EN: A ruthless predator or vicious predicament surrounds and crushes a victim from every direction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo balaan kallattii maraan nama miidhu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe being caught in an inescapable, multifaceted trap of a ruthless foe
Keywords_AO: a'oo, waraabeessa, qooyuu
Keywords_EN: jaws, hyena, crunch

Mammaaksa_AO: Of argaan, nama hin argu.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who is infatuated with oneself sees no one else.
Meaning_AO: Namni of tuuluu fi of qofa ilaalu hanqina ofiis ta'ee rakkoo nama biraa hin argu.
Meaning_EN: A narcissistic, arrogant person is so blinded by self-worship that they see no value in others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni of tuulee orma tuffatu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against arrogance that blinds people to the worth and suffering of others
Keywords_AO: of argaa, nama, of-tuulummaa
Keywords_EN: self-infatuation, others, vanity

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati if qaqqabdu, ilmoo isii hin dhaqqabdu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother obsessed with pampering herself never reaches her child in time.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittummaan jireenya dhuunfaa qofa eeggatu itti gaafatamummaa maatii dagata.
Meaning_EN: A mother or guardian preoccupied solely with her own grooming neglects the urgent needs of her child.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma ofii qofaaf fiigee ijoollee miidhu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize self-indulgent parents or leaders who neglect their vulnerable dependents
Keywords_AO: haadha, ilmoo, if qaqqabuu
Keywords_EN: mother, child, self-preoccupation

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni ollaaf hin hille, soddaaf hin hilu.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who has no sympathy for neighbors will have none for in-laws.
Meaning_AO: Namni amala gaarii fi gara laafina hin qabne nama dhihoo fi firaafuu hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: A cold-hearted person who lacks empathy for neighbors will never show genuine kindness to in-laws.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ollaa isaatti hammaate firas hin gargaarre ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate that someone who treats close neighbors poorly will never be good to in-laws
Keywords_AO: ollaa, soddaa, hiluu
Keywords_EN: neighbor, in-law, sympathy

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa rabbi na baasi, kan feete albaasi.
Translation_Literal_EN: "Oh Lord, save me, and let loose diarrhea on whoever else you wish."
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittoo ta'e ofii isaa baqachuuf jedhee ormi yoo badeyyuu hin dhimmu.
Meaning_EN: The selfish person prays only for personal salvation while wishing calamity on everyone else.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ofii qofa fayyee ormi akka badu yaadu koflan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock unashamed selfishness where someone cares solely for their own skin at others' expense
Keywords_AO: rabbi, baasuu, albaasuu
Keywords_EN: Lord, save, diarrhea

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana keetitti nyaannaa, mana kootitti udaanna.
Translation_Literal_EN: Let us eat at your house, and let us go defecate at mine.
Meaning_AO: Bu'aa fi waan gaarii ormarraa nyaatanii, rakkinaa fi kosii ammoo achitti dhiisu.
Meaning_EN: Exploiting another's hospitality for food and joy while reserving nothing valuable for them in return.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan namaa qofa nyaachuuf carraaqu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used bluntly to denounce shameless freeloaders who feast off neighbors while giving nothing back
Keywords_AO: mana, nyaachuu, ofittummaa
Keywords_EN: house, eat, freeloading

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan tokkoo kan barbaadu kan ofiiti dhaba.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who covets another's single possession ends up losing one's own.
Meaning_AO: Namni qabeenya ormaatti bololee fudhachuuf fiigu waan duraan qabu dhabee deegaa hafa.
Meaning_EN: One who covetously grasps for someone else's sole possession risks forfeiting their own goods.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bololli waan qaban nama dhabsiisu akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that greedy encroachment on others' meager belongings leads to self-ruin
Keywords_AO: barbaaduu, dhabuu, bolola
Keywords_EN: seek, lose, greed

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen, "ergaan ani du'e araddaan hin mayrin" jette.
Translation_Literal_EN: The donkey said, "After I die, let no grass sprout in the pasture."
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittoo ta'e yeroo inni hin jirretti wanti hundi yoo barbadaa'eyyuu homaa itti hin fakkaatu.
Meaning_EN: A thoroughly selfish soul cares nothing for the future or posterity once their own life ends.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni badii ormaatiif hin dhimmin ofii qofa yaadu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule cynical, selfish people who wish ruin upon the world once their own turn is over
Keywords_AO: harree, du'a, araddaa, marguu
Keywords_EN: donkey, death, pasture, sprout

Mammaaksa_AO: joolleen garaatu na dhukkubee malee, niin quufee hin beektu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Children know 'my stomach aches', but they never admit 'I am full'.
Meaning_AO: Namni kajeellaa qabu yeroo hunda dhabeera jedhee komata malee quufeera jedhee hin galateeffatu.
Meaning_EN: Insatiable people constantly complain of lack and pain, but never acknowledge their abundant blessings.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni yeroo hunda komatu malee galata hin qabne ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe chronic whiners who only speak up to complain and never express contentment
Keywords_AO: joollee, garaa, quufuu
Keywords_EN: child, belly, full

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama hoodhoo hin beeyne, kennii maaltu barsiise.
Translation_Literal_EN: For a person who never learned to say 'take this', who could teach them to give?
Meaning_AO: Namni uumamaan doqna ta'ee fi arjummaa hin beekne salphaatti nama gargaaruu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: One who was never habituated to sharing in childhood cannot easily be taught generosity in adulthood.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo doqna amala jijjiirsisuun rakkisaa ta'e himan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express that innate, deeply ingrained miserliness cannot be readily cured by instruction
Keywords_AO: hoodhoo, kennuu, barsiisuu
Keywords_EN: take this, give, teach

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen, "anaa wayyaawe nattti dhiitee, anaa du'a gaye naa bariite" jette.
Translation_Literal_EN: The donkey said, "It got dark when I felt better, and day broke just as I was on the brink of death."
Meaning_AO: Namni rakkataarratti carraan yeroo hunda micciiramee dhibee fi dhiphina itti dabala.
Meaning_EN: A wretched creature finds that timing is always perverse—respite arrives too late and toil resumes too soon.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo boqonnaan dhabamee rakkoon nama hordofu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament relentless toil where brief relief is instantly crushed by renewed hardship
Keywords_AO: harree, dhihuu, bari'uu
Keywords_EN: donkey, dusk, dawn

Mammaaksa_AO: "Ani waraabessaan tahee dhufaa, ati harree tahii na eegi" je'e namichi.
Translation_Literal_EN: "I will come disguised as a hyena; you wait for me posing as a donkey," said the man.
Meaning_AO: Waliigaltee sobaa fi miidhaa ifa ta'e namarratti fe'uun nama gowwoomsuuf carraaqu.
Meaning_EN: Proposing a preposterously one-sided, predatory arrangement that guarantees the partner's destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo walitti dhufeenyi tokko guutummaatti nama miidhuuf qophaa'e
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock blatantly rigged, predatory proposals where one party is destined to be slaughtered
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, harree, soba
Keywords_EN: hyena, donkey, deceit

Mammaaksa_AO: Soddaan hamaan kan waan qabu soddaa isaa dhoyfatu, kan san daran hamaa kan waan soddaan isaa hin qabne fidi ja'u.
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad in-law hides what he has from his kin; a far worse one demands what his in-law does not possess.
Meaning_AO: Doqnummaan hammaadha, garuu nama rakkataarraa waan inni hin qabne dirqiin barbaaduun daran hammaata.
Meaning_EN: Stinginess is offensive, but extorting and demanding nonexistent resources from an in-law is far worse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni dhibee fi ba'aa humnaa olii nama biraarraa barbaadan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn unreasonable, predatory relatives who extort and demand what cannot be given
Keywords_AO: soddaa, dhoksuu, fiduu
Keywords_EN: in-law, hide, demand

Mammaaksa_AO: Ho'o jennaan didde, achi keenyaan hatte.
Translation_Literal_EN: When told 'Take it freely,' she refused; when put aside, she stole it.
Meaning_AO: Namni amala badaa qabu waan kabajaan kennamuuf tuffatee dhoksaatti hatuu filata.
Meaning_EN: A perverse person spurns an honest, dignified gift only to dishonorably steal it when left unattended.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni amala fokkisaa agarsiisee waan ifaa dhiisee hatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn perverse individuals who reject honest generosity in favor of shameful stealth
Keywords_AO: kennuu, diduu, hatuu
Keywords_EN: give, refuse, steal

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa dagate, yammuu biyyi nyaattu ni dhokatte, yammuu biyyi rafu ni nyaatte.
Translation_Literal_EN: Oh heedless one: when the community dined, you hid; when the community slept, you ate alone.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittoo ta'e hawaasa wajjin qooddachuu dhiisee dhoksaatti nyaata; kabajaa fi firummaa dhabata.
Meaning_EN: The selfish glutton cowers in secret to avoid sharing with the village, only to feast alone in the dark.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni nyaata namaa dhowwatee kophaa nyaatu ceepha'an
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shame antisocial hoarders who isolate themselves from the community to devour food in secret
Keywords_AO: dhokachuu, rafuu, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: hide, sleep, eat

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen abbaa warraa hin jettu, ijoolleen haadha koo hin jettu.
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog does not say 'household master', and small children do not say 'my mother'.
Meaning_AO: Sareen nama nyaata kennuuf hunda hordofti, ijoolleeniis nama isaan gargaare hundatti fiigu.
Meaning_EN: A dog is loyal to anyone who feeds it, and naive infants gravitate toward whoever provides sustenance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo amanamummaan bu'aa qofaarratti hirkatu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe unprincipled, shallow loyalty that attaches purely to whoever offers food
Keywords_AO: saree, ijoollee, haadha
Keywords_EN: dog, children, mother

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama yoo du'an nama dhiqu, jiruun saala hin dhoyfatan.
Translation_Literal_EN: From the one who washes your corpse upon death, do not conceal your private parts in life.
Meaning_AO: Nama yeroo rakkinaa fi dhiphinaa sitti dhihaatutti iccitii fi rakkoo kee dhoksuun hin malle.
Meaning_EN: Do not hide your vulnerabilities or secrets in life from the trusted one who will handle you in death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama amanamaatti rakkoo ofii himachuu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise being completely honest and transparent with lifelong trusted confidants
Keywords_AO: du'a, dhiquu, saala, amantee
Keywords_EN: death, wash corpse, private, trust

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama yoggaa hamtuun dhufte gayaniin, gaafa nagayaa hin dhoyfatan.
Translation_Literal_EN: From the person you turn to in hard times, do not hide matters in times of peace.
Meaning_AO: Fira yeroo dhiphuu si bira dhaabbate gaafa nagayaas kabajuu fi iccitii qooduufiin barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Never keep secrets in prosperous peace from the loyal soul you rely upon during crises.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo fira yeroo rakkoo nama gargaare gaafa nagaa dagachuu dhowwan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people to maintain open trust with companions who stood by them in adversity
Keywords_AO: hamtuu, nagaya, dhoksuu
Keywords_EN: calamity, peace, conceal

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhukkuba himatan, qoricha argatan.
Translation_Literal_EN: If you confess your illness, you find the remedy.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo fi dhibee ofii yoo ifatti himatan furmaata fi gargaarsa argatu.
Meaning_EN: Concealing an affliction brings ruin; openly disclosing one's trouble invites relief and healing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni rakkoo isaa dhoksuu dhiisee akka himatu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage speaking up about difficulties so that solutions and help can be found
Keywords_AO: dhukkuba, himachuu, qoricha
Keywords_EN: illness, confess, remedy

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhukkuba dhoysan, qorichi dhokate.
Translation_Literal_EN: If an illness is hidden, the remedy remains hidden.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo ofii dhoksuun furmaata dhabuu fi miidhaa guddaa fida.
Meaning_EN: When an ailment or crisis is concealed, its cure and solution naturally stay out of reach.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhibee isaa dhoksee of miidhu akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that hiding mistakes, debts, or sickness prevents any hope of healing
Keywords_AO: dhukkuba, dhoksuu, qoricha
Keywords_EN: illness, conceal, cure

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin Yoo garaa baqaysan fayyiti, wanti biraa yoo garaa baqaysan duuti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Words heal when the belly is cut open, but anything else dies if the belly is cut open.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma fi aarii garaa keessaa baasanii dubbachuun araara fida, caldhisuun garuu nama miidha.
Meaning_EN: Speaking out inner grievances resolves them, whereas physical wounds to the belly prove fatal.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo aarii garaatti qabachuu dhiisanii ifatti dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that airing grievances brings emotional healing, while bottling them up is toxic
Keywords_AO: dubbii, garaa, fayyuu
Keywords_EN: words, belly, heal

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin adiitu tola.
Translation_Literal_EN: Plain, white (honest) speech is the best.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin iftoomina qabduu fi soba hin qabne nagaa fi haqa buufti.
Meaning_EN: Straightforward, transparent, and honest words are far superior to devious ambiguity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qajeelummaan akka dubbatu gorsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise candor and urge speaking plainly without deceit or hidden agendas
Keywords_AO: dubbii, adii, tola
Keywords_EN: words, white, plain truth

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan abbaan himate, yaadni guura.
Translation_Literal_EN: What the owner articulates, contemplation gathers and refines.
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo dhimma isaa ifatti baasee dubbatu, marii fi yaadaan furmaata argata.
Meaning_EN: Once an owner states their problem clearly, collective wisdom can assemble a solution.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimmi ifatti bahee yaadaan furmaata argatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that clearly voicing a problem allows others to provide constructive counsel
Keywords_AO: himachuu, yaada, guuruu
Keywords_EN: articulate, thoughts, gather

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan hidhiin geeyse, heerri mura.
Translation_Literal_EN: Whatever the lips have uttered, the customary law judges.
Meaning_AO: Waan afaaniin baatee dubbatamte hundaaf namni itti gaafatamummaa seeraa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Whatever words are spoken across the lips fall under the jurisdiction and judgment of the law.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbii namni dubbaterratti murtiin kennamu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people that one is legally and socially held accountable for all spoken words
Keywords_AO: hidhii, heera, muruu
Keywords_EN: lips, law, judge

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin fuula hammenyaaf nama hin nyaattu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Speech does not devour a person solely for being ugly.
Meaning_AO: Dubbii haqaa fi qajeelaan yoo dubbatame bifti nama dubbatuu rakkina hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: The validity and weight of truthful words do not depend on the physical beauty of the speaker.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhugaan nama bifa hin malleerraa dhufte fudhatama qabaattu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stress that truthful arguments must be judged on their merits, not on the speaker's look
Keywords_AO: dubbii, fuula, hammeenya
Keywords_EN: words, face, ugliness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii baha hin dhoorkan, gala dhoorkan malee.
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not forbid words from coming out, but rather forbids them from returning home (with bad consequences).
Meaning_AO: Namni akka fedhe dubbachuu danda'a, garuu miidhaa fi bu'aa dubbii sanaa to'achuutu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: You can easily utter words into the open, but you cannot stop the disastrous backlash they bring home.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni daangaa malee dubbachuuf ka'u akeekkachiisan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone to weigh the inevitable fallout before unleashing careless words
Keywords_AO: dubbii, ba'uu, galuu
Keywords_EN: words, exit, return

Mammaaksa_AO: Arrabni, waan garaa jiru hata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The tongue steals what is hidden in the heart/belly.
Meaning_AO: Yaada dhokataa nama keessa jiru arrabni osoo hin beekin baasee ifa godha.
Meaning_EN: The tongue inadvertently slips and reveals the innermost secrets locked in the heart.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni osoo hin yaadin iccitii afaaniin baasu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a slip of the tongue betrays what someone was secretly thinking inside
Keywords_AO: arraba, garaa, hatuu
Keywords_EN: tongue, belly, steal

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan garaan yaade, arrabni fuudha.
Translation_Literal_EN: What the heart meditates upon, the tongue takes up and speaks.
Meaning_AO: Wanti sammuu fi garaa namaa keessa deddeebi'u yeroo booda afaaniin bahee dubbatama.
Meaning_EN: Whatever deeply occupies the heart and mind will eventually find expression through the tongue.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan yaadu afaaniin mul'isu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that a person's constant speech is an accurate reflection of their true preoccupations
Keywords_AO: garaa, yaada, arraba
Keywords_EN: heart, thought, tongue

Mammaaksa_AO: Akkuma waa argan, waa haasa'an.
Translation_Literal_EN: Just as one observes things, so one speaks about them.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin namaa ragaa fi wanta ijaan argan irratti hirkatee dubbatama.
Meaning_EN: Speech naturally reflects what one has witnessed; observations shape conversation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan arge irratti hundaa'ee dubbatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that people speak based on tangible evidence and things they have observed
Keywords_AO: arguun, haasa'uu, ragaa
Keywords_EN: seeing, speaking, evidence

Mammaaksa_AO: Dullachi, waan garaa qabu qufa'a.
Translation_Literal_EN: An elder coughs up whatever is troubling his chest/belly.
Meaning_AO: Namni muuxannoo fi umrii qabu dhimma isa dhibe caldhisee hin dhiisu; dubbatee baasa.
Meaning_EN: An elder or experienced person cannot harbor grievances silently; they clear their chest openly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo manguddoon waan garaa isaanii dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when elders speak out candidly to unburden their minds of lingering concerns
Keywords_AO: dullacha, garaa, qufa'uu
Keywords_EN: elder, chest, cough

Mammaaksa_AO: Wal argan, dubbii argan.
Translation_Literal_EN: When people meet face to face, they find conversation/resolution.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni yoo wal argan dhimmoota jiran mari'atanii furmaata itti gooluu danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Meeting in person brings dialogue, clarity, and the natural resolution of standing disputes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo walitti dhufuun dubbii furuuf barbaachisu ibsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage direct, in-person meetings to resolve misunderstandings through dialogue
Keywords_AO: wal arguun, dubbii, marii
Keywords_EN: meeting, words, dialogue

Mammaaksa_AO: Lafa qabbanaan tiratu, waan dhufaniif ofiin himatu.
Translation_Literal_EN: When the terrain cools, one walks gently; why one came, one reveals of one's own accord.
Meaning_AO: Yeroon nagaa fi tasgabbiin dhufetti namni dhimma isaa ifatti dubbatee dhiheessa.
Meaning_EN: In a calm, cooled atmosphere, one proceeds unhurriedly and discloses one's true mission.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo tasgabbii fi nagaan dhimma ofii himatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise waiting for tempers to cool before presenting delicate business or requests
Keywords_AO: qabbana, tirachuu, himachuu
Keywords_EN: coolness, walk, disclose

Mammaaksa_AO: Waliisaa fi maraataan, waan garaa qabu dubbata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The inspired poet and the madman speak whatever is in their hearts.
Meaning_AO: Namni garaa qulqulluu qabu ykn maraataan waan keessa isaa jiru dhoksaa malee baasa.
Meaning_EN: Both the visionary poet and the madman speak without filters, blurting out raw unvarnished truths.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni sodaa malee waan garaa dubbatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe characters who speak raw, unadorned truth without diplomatic self-censorship

Keywords_EN: poet, madman, raw speech

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaada garaa namaa jiru, arraataatu irraa gad hin teenye.
Translation_Literal_EN: Over the thoughts churning inside one's heart, the tongue never rests idle.
Meaning_AO: Wanti namatti yaaddoo ta'e afaaniin bahee odeeffamuu jalaa hin oolu.
Meaning_EN: The tongue can never stay still over pressing concerns that continuously agitate the heart.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiphina keessoo afaaniin baasu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone repeatedly talks about a subject because it heavily weighs on their mind
Keywords_AO: yaada, garaa, arraata
Keywords_EN: thought, heart, tongue

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka gubbaa nama nyanyaattu, harkaa irraa gad hin teenye.
Translation_Literal_EN: From the spot where an itch burns on one's body, the hand never stays away.
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo hunda dhimma isa dhiphisee fi isa miidherratti xiyyeeffata.
Meaning_EN: One's hand constantly returns to the itchy spot; similarly, one's mind constantly attends to pain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma isa miidhe irra deddeebi'ee kaasu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain why someone cannot stop talking about or attending to their painful problem
Keywords_AO: gubbaa, nyanyaachuu, harka
Keywords_EN: itch, burn, hand

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan warri waarii dubbatu, jooleen waaree dubbatti.
Translation_Literal_EN: What the elders discuss late at night, the children blab at midday.
Meaning_AO: Iccitii maatii halkan dubbatame ijoolleen ifatti gabaatti baaftee odeessiti.
Meaning_EN: Confidential matters discussed by parents at night are innocently blurted out by children by day.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo iccitii maatii ijoollee duratti dubbachuu dhowwan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn parents against discussing delicate adult secrets in the presence of children

Keywords_EN: night, midday, children

Mammaaksa_AO: Waa'en garbaa qoraani.
Translation_Literal_EN: The affair/concern of the servant/slave is gathering firewood.

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct someone to mind their specific task rather than meddling in higher affairs
Keywords_AO: garba, qoraan, gahee

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan waraanaa, waan waraanaati dubbata.
Translation_Literal_EN: The warrior speaks of weapons and war.
Meaning_AO: Namni hundi dhimma ogummaa, hojii fi muuxannoo ofiirraan kan hafe hin odeessu.
Meaning_EN: Every professional or specialist naturally converses about their own craft and experience.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan ogummaa isaa qofa odeessu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that a person's talk naturally revolves around their trade, passions, or expertise
Keywords_AO: waraana, abbaa waraanaa, dubbachuu
Keywords_EN: warrior, weapon, speak

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii garaa argan, galataan dayani.
Translation_Literal_EN: When they find words spoken from the sincere heart, they reply with heartfelt thanks.
Meaning_AO: Dubbii qajeelaa fi dhugaan garaarraa madde namni kabajaan simatee galateeffata.
Meaning_EN: Sincere, heartfelt communication that touches the core is received with gratitude and peace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haasaan garaa qulqulluun dhiyaatee nagaa fidu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise open, honest dialogue that heals relationships and elicits genuine appreciation
Keywords_AO: dubbii, garaa, galata
Keywords_EN: words, heart, gratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhagaa, xiqqaa dha darbatani.
Translation_Literal_EN: It is a small stone that one hurls.
Meaning_AO: Wanti salphaa fi xiqqaatee mul'atu hojiif ykn balaaf salphaatti itti fayyadama.
Meaning_EN: A small, manageable stone is chosen to throw; small beginnings or small things are readily utilized.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanta xiqqaa fi mijaawaatti fayyadaman
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that smaller, lighter means are preferred when taking action or launching a venture
Keywords_AO: dhagaa, xiqqaa, darbachuu
Keywords_EN: stone, small, throw

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaldeessi, xixiqqaatu waa arga.
Translation_Literal_EN: Among baboons, it is the small ones that spot things first.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen yookiin warri xixinnoon waan haaraa fi balaa dhufe dafanii hubatu.
Meaning_EN: Among baboons (and people), the young, agile ones possess sharp eyes and spot changes first.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen waan gurguddoon hin argin argite dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to acknowledge that children and younger scouts are often the first to notice danger or opportunity
Keywords_AO: jaldeessa, xixiqqaa, arguun
Keywords_EN: baboon, small, spot

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi, fakkeessaa abbaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: A son is the reflection/likeness of his father.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen amala, bifa fi hojii warra isaanii hordofanii dhalatu; dhalootatu wal fakkaata.
Meaning_EN: A son mirrors his father in temperament, character, and conduct; like father, like son.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ilmi amala abbaa isaa agarsiisu dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a child's actions, habits, or virtues clearly mirror those of the parent
Keywords_AO: ilma, abbaa, fakkaachuu
Keywords_EN: son, father, reflection

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen dhabnee hin beektu.
Translation_Literal_EN: Children do not comprehend/know the concept of 'we lack it'.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen daangaa fi dhabamuu qabeenyaa hin beektu; waan barbaaddu yerooma sana fedha.
Meaning_EN: Young children cannot understand scarcity or economic hardship; they demand what they want immediately.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen rakkoo maatii osoo hin beekin nyaata gaafattu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when parents struggle with scarcity while innocent children persistently demand food or toys
Keywords_AO: joollee, dhabuu, beekuu
Keywords_EN: children, lack, innocence

Mammaaksa_AO: Booda dhalateeti, gaafni gurra dabra.
Translation_Literal_EN: Though born later, the horn grows past the ear.
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo booda dhufe ykn dargaggoon dandeettii fi guddinaan warra duriirra darba.
Meaning_EN: Though emerging later in time, horns grow longer than the ears; juniors often surpass their seniors.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni booda dhufe dandeettiin beekamaa ta'ee darbu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a younger person or latecomer excels and surpasses their predecessors in achievement
Keywords_AO: gaafa, gurra, dhalachuu
Keywords_EN: horn, ear, surpass

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen daaraa dha, dhawan ni facaati.
Translation_Literal_EN: Children are like dry ashes; if you strike them, they scatter everywhere.
Meaning_AO: Ijoollee gara-jabinaan reebuu dhiisanii obsaan qajeelchu; rukuttaan ijoollee faffacaasa.
Meaning_EN: Children are as fragile and volatile as loose ashes; harsh beatings only scatter and alienate them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoollee reebicha jabaan miidhuu dhowwan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise parents and guardians to guide children with patience rather than harsh beatings
Keywords_AO: joollee, daaraa, dhaanuu
Keywords_EN: children, ash, strike

Mammaaksa_AO: Ji'a halkan ifu, joolleen adu seeti.
Translation_Literal_EN: The moon shining at night, children mistake for the sun.
Meaning_AO: Hubannoo dhabuudhaan wantoota gurguddoo fi wal fakkaatan adda baasuu dadhabu.
Meaning_EN: In their naive innocence, children mistake the soft glow of the night moon for the radiant sun.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hanqina beekumsaatiin waan tokko bakka buusu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to gently describe naive individuals or children who confuse superficial similarities with reality
Keywords_AO: ji'a, aduu, joollee
Keywords_EN: moon, sun, children

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen baasa hin beektuu, moofoo abbaati quba keessi.
Translation_Literal_EN: Children know nothing of destitution; they poke their fingers through their father's ragged clothes.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen hiyyummaa fi qaanfannaa hin beektu; hanqina maatii ifatti baasti.
Meaning_EN: Innocent of financial embarrassment, a child naively pokes fingers through the holes in a father's rags.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen osoo hin yaadin hanqina maatii ormatti agarsiiftu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when innocent children unwittingly expose their family's private poverty to the public
Keywords_AO: joollee, moofoo, quba
Keywords_EN: children, rags, finger

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen ganama waaqa ilaaltu, galgala lafa ilaalti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Children gaze excitedly at the sky in the morning, but stare dejectedly at the ground by evening.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen ganama abdii fi gammachuun kaati, garuu beelaa fi dadhabbiin galgala isaan kuffisa.
Meaning_EN: Children wake full of exuberance gazing at the sky, but weary hunger has them staring at the dirt by sunset.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen beelaa fi dadhabbiin dhiphattu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how quickly childish morning joy wilts into evening weariness when basic needs fail
Keywords_AO: joollee, ganama, galgala
Keywords_EN: children, morning, evening

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen gaafa du'aa kolfiteeti, gaafa taskaaraa boochi.
Translation_Literal_EN: Children laugh on the day of death/mourning, and weep on the day of the memorial feast.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen yeroo gaddaa fi gammachuu sirriitti hin beektu; qalbii bilchaataa hin qabdu.
Meaning_EN: Children lack social awareness, giggling during solemn funerals and crying during festive memorial feasts.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen bakka hin malleetti miira faallaa agarsiiftu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain inappropriate childish reactions arising from total innocence of social gravity
Keywords_AO: joollee, du'a, kolfuu, booyicha
Keywords_EN: children, death, laugh, weep

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen ormaa, nyaatteeti balbala ilaalti.
Translation_Literal_EN: Another person's child eats your food and immediately eyes the doorway.
Meaning_AO: Nama fira hin taane yoo nyaachisan illee gara maatii isaatti deebi'uuf yaada malee hin amanamu.
Meaning_EN: A neighbor's child happily consumes your meal and promptly looks toward the door to run back home.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ormaa nyaata fudhatee gara ofiitti fiigu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that outsiders, no matter how warmly fed, always prioritize their own households
Keywords_AO: joollee, orma, balbala, nyaata
Keywords_EN: children, stranger, door, eat

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen haati irraa duutee fi kan laga biraa dhaqxe wal qixa boochi.
Translation_Literal_EN: The child whose mother died and the child whose mother went across the river weep equally loud.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleef haadha dhabuun yeroofis ta'u du'aanis dhiphina wal fakkaataa fida.
Meaning_EN: To a small child, a mother absent across the river feels just as devastating as a mother lost to death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoolleen haadha dhabuun boossu dubbatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight a young child's absolute, agonizing dependence on the physical presence of its mother
Keywords_AO: joollee, haadha, du'a, booyicha
Keywords_EN: children, mother, death, weep

Mammaaksa_AO: Mucaan gonnoo isaa haadha argisiisee "kookkoo" jennaan "Osoon kana sodaadhee siihuu hin dhalu" jetteeni.
Translation_Literal_EN: When the boy exposed his modesty to his mother saying "A monster!", she replied, "Had I feared that, I would never have birthed you."
Meaning_AO: Wanta namni biraa akka balaa guddaatti ilaalu nama muuxannoo fi beekumsa qabu hin sodaachisu.
Meaning_EN: What an innocent youth thinks is an alarming terror is ordinary reality to an experienced elder.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni muuxannoo qabu waan warri kaan sodaatan tuffatu
Usage_Situation_EN: Used playfully to show that seasoned elders are thoroughly unintimidated by what shocks the inexperienced
Keywords_AO: mucaa, haadha, kookkoo, dhaluu
Keywords_EN: boy, mother, monster, birth

Meaning_EN: Brothers sharing the same father settle their public, territorial, and inheritance affairs in the open commons.

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to refer to open, formal discussions among paternal brothers over lineage and property matters

Translation_Literal_EN: Brothers/children of the same mother hold their council around the warm hearth fire.
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen garaa tokkoo dhimma iccitii fi jaalalaa manuma keessatti dhoksaatti mari'atu.
Meaning_EN: Maternal siblings discuss intimate, emotional, and confidential matters privately by the domestic hearth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo obboolaan haadha tokkoo iccitii waliin qooddatan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the deep, private, and affectionate solidarity shared by uterine siblings
Keywords_AO: ilmaan, haadha, ibidda, marii
Keywords_EN: children, mother, hearth fire, council

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmaan adeeraa, mariin araddaa keessa.
Translation_Literal_EN: Paternal cousins hold their consultations within the broader clan settlement.
Meaning_AO: Firoonni dhihoo fi ilmaan adeeraa dhimma gosaa fi hawaasummaa waliin qooddatu.
Meaning_EN: Cousins of the extended paternal clan meet in the village square to coordinate community solidarity.

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe consultative gatherings among extended cousins to maintain clan unity
Keywords_AO: ilmaan adeeraa, araddaa, marii

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan kufan, ilmaan ka'ani.
Translation_Literal_EN: When the father falls, the sons rise.
Meaning_AO: Dhaloonni duraa yoo darban ilmaan bakka bu'anii seenaa fi maatii itti fufsiisu.
Meaning_EN: When the fathers age or pass away, the sons rise to take their place and carry forward the legacy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ilmaan bakka abbaa bu'anii maatii cimsan
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate natural generational succession where sons step up to replace fallen elders
Keywords_AO: abbaa, kufuu, ilmaan, ka'uu
Keywords_EN: father, fall, sons, rise

Mammaaksa_AO: Dal'uun, gurmuu irra teeyseeti gabbatti
Translation_Literal_EN: The hump gets fat sitting on the shoulder.
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko deeggarsa fi gargaarsa warra kaaniitiin kabajama ykn badhaadha.
Meaning_EN: One prospers or gains prominence by leaning on the strength and support of others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gargaarsa maatii ykn hiriyootaatiin milkaa'e ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that someone's success or status comes from standing on others' shoulders.

Mammaaksa_AO: "Bakki na dhukkubu bakka biraatii, ammoo bakkuma goftaan koo je'e na koobaa" jette, gabrittiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "The place where it hurts is elsewhere, but cup me where my master says," said the slave woman.
Meaning_AO: Dirqisiifamuun waan sirrii hin taane ajaja nama aangoo qabuuf jedhanii raawwachuu.
Meaning_EN: Yielding to the orders of an authority figure against one's own truth or better judgment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko osoo dhugaa beeku ajaja hoogganaatiif waan dogoggoraa raawwatu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone complies with an absurd command from superiors despite knowing the real problem.
Keywords_AO: dhukkubuu, gooftaa, koobuu, gabrittii
Keywords_EN: pain, master, cupping, slave

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni niitiin bulu, ollaa hin bulu
Translation_Literal_EN: A man who is ruled by his wife does not govern the neighborhood.
Meaning_AO: Namni mana ofii irratti murtoo bilisaa hin qabne hawaasa keessattis kabajaa dhabuu.
Meaning_EN: Someone who cannot govern their own household lacks standing or authority in the broader community.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama mana ofii keessatti dhiibbaa jala jiruufi hawaasatti dubbii hin qabne qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize a person whose lack of personal autonomy at home weakens their social influence outside.
Keywords_AO: niitii, buluu, ollaa

Mammaaksa_AO: Mukni mukarra taa'u hundee hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: A tree that perches on another tree has no roots.
Meaning_AO: Wanti of danda'ee hin dhaabbannee fi nama biraa irratti hirkatu bu'uura cimaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: That which relies entirely on another without standing on its own lacks a solid foundation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ykn waan madda ofii dhabee nama biraarratti qofa hirkatetti akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against relying entirely on others without cultivating one's own independent base.
Keywords_AO: muka, hundee, hirkachuu
Keywords_EN: tree, root, parasitic, foundation

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilma gadhee dhalchuu mannaa, dubra gaarii dhalchanii, soddaa arkachuu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to bear a good daughter and gain an in-law than to bear a bad son.
Meaning_AO: Ilma maqaa balleessu qabaachuu irra intala amala gaarii qabduun fira kabajamaa argachuu wayya.
Meaning_EN: A virtuous daughter who brings respected in-laws is far better than an unruly son who brings disgrace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gatii amala gaarii fi walitti dhufeenya firummaa gaarii ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that virtue and good alliances matter far more than mere gender preference in children.
Keywords_AO: ilma, dubra, soddaa, gaarii
Keywords_EN: son, daughter, son-in-law, virtue

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaa fi joolleen, galgala beelaaf duuti
Translation_Literal_EN: A guest and children die of hunger towards the evening.
Meaning_AO: Keessummaa fi daa'imman yeroodhaan nyaachisuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Guests and young children have low tolerance for prolonged hunger and need prompt hospitality.
Usage_Situation_AO: Keessummaa fi ijoolleedhaaf yeroodhaan dhimma nyaataa qopheessuu yoo yaadachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind hosts and parents to feed children and guests without delaying until nightfall.
Keywords_AO: keessummaa, joollee, galgala, beela
Keywords_EN: guest, children, evening, hunger

Mammaaksa_AO: "Maaltu ajaawa" jennaan, "soddaa soddaarra ta'u jiraa ajaawaan" Ja'an
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked "What smells worst?", they replied, "Is there anything worse than an in-law burdening another in-law?"
Meaning_AO: Soddaan soddaa irratti qubachuun ykn hirkachuun safeeffannaa fi kabajaa kan dhabsiisu ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Overstaying or imposing oneself upon one's in-laws destroys mutual respect and causes severe discomfort.
Usage_Situation_AO: Soddaan yeroo hirkattummaa heddummeessuu fi kabajaa walii dagatu gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humorously criticize an in-law who overstays their welcome or overburdens relations.
Keywords_AO: ajaawuu, soddaa, safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: smell, bad odor, in-law, boundary

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan itti kufan lafa, kan qabatanii ka'aniis lafa
Translation_Literal_EN: The ground is what one falls onto, and the ground is what one holds onto to stand up.
Meaning_AO: Madduma rakkoo ykn kufaatii keessaa furmaanni fi jajjabinni akka argamu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: The very place where one stumbles or suffers defeat is where one must find the leverage to rise again.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kufe ykn miidhame tokko akka deebi'ee of ijaaru jajjabeessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage someone to bounce back from adversity using their circumstances as a stepping stone.
Keywords_AO: kufuu, lafa, qabachuu, ka'uu
Keywords_EN: fall, ground, rise, resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen mana hin qabduu mana looniiti galti, nadhoon mana hin qabduu mana dhiiraati galti
Translation_Literal_EN: A donkey has no home and enters the cattle shed; a woman has no home and enters the man's home.
Meaning_AO: Aadaa durii keessatti bakka bu'iinsa fi jireenya dubartootaa heerumaan ibsuuf kan dubbatamu.
Meaning_EN: A traditional reflection on a woman building her life and home through marriage.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haala jireenya heerumaa fi bakka dubartii aadaa keessatti qabdu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used traditionally to describe the custom of a bride leaving her parental home to settle in her husband's homestead.
Keywords_AO: harree, mana, loon, nadhoo, dhiira
Keywords_EN: donkey, home, cattle, woman, man

Mammaaksa_AO: Hora malee hin horan, horii malee hin tolan
Translation_Literal_EN: Without mineral water livestock do not thrive, without wealth life does not prosper.
Meaning_AO: Bu'uura qabeenyaa fi wantoota jireenya fooyyessan malee badhaadhinni akka hin argamne.
Meaning_EN: Just as livestock need mineral spring water to flourish, human well-being requires resources and wealth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Faayidaa qabeenya horachuu fi wantoota bu'uuraa jireenyaaf barbaachisan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain the essential role of resources, wealth, and foundation in securing prosperity.
Keywords_AO: hora, horuu, horii, toluu
Keywords_EN: mineral spring, livestock, thrive, wealth

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa fi sareen bakka itti quufanii hin galani
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool and a dog do not leave the place where they are fed.
Meaning_AO: Namni hubannaa hin qabne bakka faayidaa yeroo argatetti dafee rarra'ee hafa.
Meaning_EN: A foolish person and a dog linger excessively wherever they find momentary food or satisfaction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama faayidaa xiqqoof jedhee bakka hin malleetti tursiisu qeequuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize people who lack self-restraint and cling to wherever they get temporary handouts.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, saree, quufuu, galuu
Keywords_EN: fool, dog, satisfied, lingering

Mammaaksa_AO: Soddaa fi surree wajjin kufan
Translation_Literal_EN: One falls together with one's in-laws and trousers.
Meaning_AO: Soddaa waliin wal dhabuun ykn qaanofsiisuun akka saalfannaa surreen kufuutti ilaalamuu.
Meaning_EN: One must uphold shame and honor with in-laws as intimately as guarding one's clothes from falling.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenya soddaa keessatti of eeggannoo fi kabajaa eeguun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the strict respect, modesty, and careful boundaries required around in-laws.
Keywords_AO: soddaa, surree, kufuu, qaanii
Keywords_EN: in-law, trousers, falling, modesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Barcuma irra taa'anii, muka hin hamatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Sitting on a stool, one does not slander wood.
Meaning_AO: Waan ofii itti fayyadamaa jiran ykn irraa fayyadaman tuffachuu fi arrabsuun sirrii miti.
Meaning_EN: One should not insult or undermine the very source of one's own comfort and benefit.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta fayyadamuufi bu'aa irraa argatu arrabsu ykn tuffatutti akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand ungrateful persons who criticize or bite the hand that supports them.
Keywords_AO: barcuma, muka, hamachuu
Keywords_EN: stool, wood, slander, ingratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan taguuga, akka abbaan godhe taati
Translation_Literal_EN: A guest is pliable; they conform to what the host does.
Meaning_AO: Keessummaan simannaa fi heera abbaan manaa qopheesseen qajeelfamti.
Meaning_EN: A guest follows the lead, hospitality, and arrangements provided by the host.
Usage_Situation_AO: Abbaan manaa qophii fi simannaa gaarii keessummaa isaatiif gochuu akka qabu yeroo yaadachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind hosts that the comfort and conduct of a guest depend entirely on the host's reception.
Keywords_AO: keessummaa, taguuga, abbaa, simannaa
Keywords_EN: guest, flexible, host, accommodation

Mammaaksa_AO: Duuti koo dinnichaarratti jette dhaddeen
Translation_Literal_EN: "My death will be on the potato patch," said the porcupine.
Meaning_AO: Fedhiin garmalee fi jaalalli waan tokkoo nama galaafachuu ykn balaatti geessuu akka danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Excessive greed or passion for a particular indulgence will eventually bring about one's doom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan jaalatan tokkoof jedhanii balaa beekamaa keessa yoo of galchan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a warning against letting an irresistible addiction or craving lead directly to one's destruction.
Keywords_AO: du'a, dinnicha, dhaddee, hawwii
Keywords_EN: death, potato, porcupine, fatal weakness

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalala qabaatan, namni lama ganda
Translation_Literal_EN: If there is love, two people make a village.
Meaning_AO: Yoo jaalalli fi walii galli jiraate, baayyinni osoo hin taane tokkummaan gahaadha.
Meaning_EN: Where true love and unity exist, even two people constitute a complete and thriving community.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka jaalalli jiru namoonni muraasni waan guddaa akka ijaaran yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express that unity and genuine affection are far more important than mere numbers.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, lama, ganda, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: love, two, village, unity

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti fala gooytaati
Translation_Literal_EN: Love is the master's remedy.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli rakkoolee fi mudannoowwan hedduudhaaf furmaata hunda caalu ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Love is the ultimate remedy that overcomes the greatest difficulties and disputes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoo jidduu namootaa jaalalaan furuun akka danda'amu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel that affection and kindness resolve disputes better than harshness.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, fala, gooftaa, furmaata
Keywords_EN: love, remedy, master, solution

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijji jaalalaa hamtuu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: The eye of love is fierce.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan jaalatu irratti hinaaffaa fi quuqama guddaa akka qabu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Love is fiercely protective and easily provoked to intense jealousy or concern.
Usage_Situation_AO: Quuqama, hinaaffaa fi yaaddoo jaalala keessa jiru ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain the intense vigilance and jealousy that naturally accompany deep love.
Keywords_AO: ija, jaalala, hamtuu, hinaaffaa
Keywords_EN: eye, love, fierce, jealousy

Mammaaksa_AO: Aalaa jaalatani, hundee qoqorani
Translation_Literal_EN: Loving the branches, they dig up and prune the roots.
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko jaalachaa garmalee keessa lixanii qorachuun balleessuu danda'uu.
Meaning_EN: Loving something so excessively that over-scrutinizing or meddling ruins its very foundation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalaan garmalee nama ykn waan tokko keessa qotuun miidhaa akka geessu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that excessive prying or micro-managing can destroy what one actually loves.
Keywords_AO: aalaa, hundee, qoqoruu, jaalachuu
Keywords_EN: branches, roots, dig up, scrutinize

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati ilmoo hin obsitu
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother cannot remain indifferent to her child.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli fi dhiifamni haati ilmoo isiitiif qabdu kan hin dhumnee fi obsa hin dhabne ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: A mother's boundless love and instinct cannot endure seeing her offspring suffer or stay estranged.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalala guddaa fi araara haati daa'ima isiitiif qabdu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight the unconditional devotion, forbearance, and compassion of a mother for her child.
Keywords_AO: haadha, ilmoo, obsuu, mararfannaa
Keywords_EN: mother, child, patience, maternal love

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaa jaalatani, ilma isaa dhungatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Out of love for the father, one kisses his son.
Meaning_AO: Nama tokko jaalachuu irraa kan ka'e firaa fi maatii isaas kabajuu fi jaalachuu.
Meaning_EN: One honors, cherishes, and cares for someone's offspring out of respect and love for the parent.
Usage_Situation_AO: Kabajaa nama tokkoof qaban irraa kan ka'e warra isaaniitti dhiyoo ta'an jaalachuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when showing kindness or honor to someone's relatives on account of affection for them.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, ilma, dhungachuu, jaalachuu
Keywords_EN: father, son, kiss, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama jaalatani, harka itti maratani
Translation_Literal_EN: One wraps one's arms around the person one loves.
Meaning_AO: Nama jaalatan haala hundaan gargaaruu, qooda fudhachuu fi cinaa dhaabbachuu.
Meaning_EN: True love expresses itself through protective embrace, steadfast support, and closeness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalala qabatamaa deeggarsa fi walitti dhiyeenyaan mul'atu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express how genuine affection naturally leads to open warmth and active support.
Keywords_AO: nama, jaalachuu, harka marachuu
Keywords_EN: love, arms, embrace, support

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama jaalatan bakka raffisan hin dhabani, hidhii fi funyaan jidduun ni fuuti
Translation_Literal_EN: One never lacks a sleeping place for someone they love; even the space between lip and nose suffices.
Meaning_AO: Namni jaalalli dhugaa qabu nama jaalatu simachuu fi qubsiisuuf sababa hin dhabu.
Meaning_EN: When there is true affection, space and resources are always found to welcome and shelter the beloved.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka jaalalli jirutti dhiphinni iddoo fi dhabinsi wantootaa gufuu akka hin taane ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that where there is love in the heart, there is always room to accommodate others.
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu, raftee, hidhii, funyaan
Keywords_EN: love, sleep, lip, nose, hospitality

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan jaalalti si muddu, jibbansi si hin mudu
Translation_Literal_EN: What love subjects you to, hatred never does.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli fedhii, dhiphinaa fi qormaata jibbansi nama hin mudsiifne keessa nama galcha.
Meaning_EN: The vulnerability, heartache, and tribulations born of love are far more overwhelming than those of hatred.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhiphina fi miidhaa jaalalli fidu jibbansa caalaa ulfaataa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on how intense emotional pain and distress often arise from loving deeply rather than hating.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, muddamuu, jibbansa
Keywords_EN: love, tribulation, hatred, torment

Mammaaksa_AO: Shumburaa goggoyduun nama huuti, jaalalti goggoyduun qalbi nama fuuti
Translation_Literal_EN: Dry chickpeas choke a person; dry love robs one of their senses.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli deebii hin qabnee fi qallaan nama dhiphisee yaada namaa fudhata.
Meaning_EN: Just as dry chickpeas cause choking, dry or unrequited love consumes and unsettles one's peace of mind.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa fi dhiphina jaalalli gama tokkoo qalbii namaarratti fidu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the severe emotional distress and distraction caused by hollow or unreciprocated love.
Keywords_AO: shumburaa, huutuu, jaalala, qalbi
Keywords_EN: chickpeas, choke, love, mind, unrequited

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan jaalatan jaala
Translation_Literal_EN: Whom one loves is held close underneath.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan jaalatu eeggata, cinaatti dhiheeffata, akkasumas wanti jaalatamu hunda caala.
Meaning_EN: That which one cherishes is held closest to the heart and protected above all else.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti namaan jaalatamu addatti kabajamaa fi qaalii ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to state that one always holds dearest and prioritizes whatever or whoever one truly loves.
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu, jaala, kunuunsa
Keywords_EN: love, beneath, cherish, protect

Mammaaksa_AO: Baayyisanii wal jaalachuu irra, xinnessanii wajji jiraachuu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to live together with modest affection than to love passionately and not endure.
Meaning_AO: Jaalala humnaa olii kan dafee badu irra, jaalala tasgabbaa'aa wajjin wal danda'anii itti fufan wayya.
Meaning_EN: Enduring, modest mutual tolerance is far better than an overwhelming passion that burns out quickly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenya keessatti tasgabbiin wajjin turuu dafanii diigamuu akka caalu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise moderation and steady coexistence in marriage or friendship over volatile passion.
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu, xinnessuu, wajji jiraachuu
Keywords_EN: love, moderate, live together, endurance

Mammaaksa_AO: Warra wal jaalatu, dhihanni hin hanqatu
Translation_Literal_EN: For those who love each other, the evening meal is never lacking.
Meaning_AO: Bakka jaalallii fi walhubannaan jirutti hanqinni nyaataas ta'e wantootaa hin dhiphisu.
Meaning_EN: Where people love and share with one another, sustenance and contentment are never in short supply.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalli wantoota qaban xiqqollee yoo ta'e gahaa fi gammachiisaa akka godhu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight how mutual affection transforms even modest provisions into complete satisfaction.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, dhihanna, hanqachuu, hiruu
Keywords_EN: love, evening meal, provision, sufficiency

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti goggoyduun, lafe nama dhukkubsiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Dry love makes one's bones ache.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli kabajaa fi deebii hin qabne qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidha.
Meaning_EN: Empty, unresponsive love inflicts deep, agonizing torment that permeates right to the bones.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa fi dhiphina ulfaataa jaalalli wal-harkaa fuudhiinsa hin qabne namarraan gahu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the deep, visceral pain caused by loving someone who is cold or unfeeling.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, goggoyduu, lafee, dhukkubuu
Keywords_EN: dry love, bones, ache, heartbreak

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa jiruu, kan si jibbu hin jiru
Translation_Literal_EN: O life, there is no one who hates you.
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiyyuu lubbuun jiraachuu fi lubbuu ofii jaalachuu irratti wal hin dhabu.
Meaning_EN: Everyone cherishes living; no one truly despises existence when faced with its preservation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni hundi lubbuu isaatiif iddoo guddaa akka qabu fi jireenya akka jaalatu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to state the universal human truth that all beings instinctively cling to and value life.
Keywords_AO: jiruu, jibbuu, lubbuu, jireenya
Keywords_EN: life, hate, existence, love of life

Mammaaksa_AO: Saani bahuu gahe wal arraaba, namni du'uu gahe wal jaalata
Translation_Literal_EN: Cattle about to leave lick each other; people about to die show love to one another.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo addaan bahuun ykn duuti dhiyaatu namoonni araaramaa fi jaalala walii mul'isu.
Meaning_EN: When departure or death draws near, people reconcile and express tender love and reconciliation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo booddee fi dhumarratti dhiifama gochuu fi jaalala walii dabaluun uumama ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on how nearing departure or finality brings out mutual tenderness and forgiveness.
Keywords_AO: sa'a, arraabuu, du'a, jaalala
Keywords_EN: cattle, lick, death, love, parting

Mammaaksa_AO: "Yaa kan dur na fuudhe", jette, namittiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "O you who married me first," said the woman.
Meaning_AO: Jaalallii fi kabajni namni yeroo jalqabaaf waliin tureef qabu yoomiyyuu akka hin banne agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: The memory and deep affection for one's first love or initial spouse remain indelible.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalli fi qoodni nama duraanii yeroo hundaa qalbiitti deebi'ee mul'atu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when nostalgic fondness for one's first companion or spouse resurfaces in comparison to subsequent ones.
Keywords_AO: fuudhuu, dur, namittii, yaadannoo
Keywords_EN: marry, first, woman, nostalgia

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka jaalalti geeyse, jibbansi hin geenye
Translation_Literal_EN: Where love has reached, hatred has not reached.
Meaning_AO: Dhiibbaa fi humni jaalalli uumu kan jibbansi gonkumaa dhaqqabuu hin dandeenyedha.
Meaning_EN: The depth and transformative power achieved by love far surpass anything hatred can accomplish.
Usage_Situation_AO: Humni jaalalaa jibbansa caalaa waan hundumaa injifachuu danda'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the triumph and superior reach of love over hatred and resentment.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, jibbansa, gahumsa
Keywords_EN: love, hatred, reach, triumph

Mammaaksa_AO: Qulfiin waa hundaan banatan jaalala, sanduuqni keeysa kaayatan obsa
Translation_Literal_EN: The key that opens everything is love; the box to store it in is patience.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli hundaa kan furu yoo ta'u, jaalalli sun akka itti fufu garuu obsi barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Love is the master key to open every heart, while patience is the vessel that preserves it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalallii fi obsi walfaana deemanii jireenya milkeessuu akka qaban yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that opening hearts requires love, while enduring relationships require steadfast patience.
Keywords_AO: qulfii, jaalala, sanduuqa, obsa
Keywords_EN: key, love, chest, patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti ammaan tanaa, durri gaggabaa boodi arraba
Translation_Literal_EN: The love of these days starts with fainting passion and ends in sharp tongues.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli yeroo ammaa bu'uura dhugaa hin qabne dafee dhooyee gara wal-arrabsuutti deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: Superficial modern infatuation begins with dramatic swooning but quickly degenerates into bitter insults.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalala bu'uura hin qabne kan dafee gara wal-mormiitti jijjiiramu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize superficial or shallow romances that flare up intensely and collapse into bitter quarreling.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, ammaan tanaa, gaggabuu, arraba
Keywords_EN: modern love, swooning, tongue, insults

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti fiiginsaa, jibba fiiginsaati fiddi
Translation_Literal_EN: Rushed love brings rushed hatred.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli tasgabbii malee ariitiin jalqabame, dafee gara jibbansa cimaatti garagala.
Meaning_EN: A hasty infatuation that rushes without foundation brings equally rapid and bitter resentment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Osoo wal hin beekin dafanii walitti bu'uun balaa akka qabu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against rushing headlong into relationships without patience and mutual understanding.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, fiiginsa, jibba, ariitii
Keywords_EN: love, rushing, hatred, volatility

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti mormaa olii hin turtu
Translation_Literal_EN: Love from the neck up does not last.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli afaanii fi qalbii irraa hin maddine yeroo muraasa booda bada.
Meaning_EN: Superficial love that comes only from the lips rather than from the heart is fleeting.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalala afaaniin qofa odeeffamu kan garaa keessaa hin jirre balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against insincere, lip-service affection that lacks deep and genuine commitment.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, morma, turuu, soba
Keywords_EN: love, neck, endure, lip-service

Mammaaksa_AO: Lameen wal jaalate, biddeena tokkootu quubsa
Translation_Literal_EN: Two who love each other, a single flatbread satisfies them.
Meaning_AO: Bakka jaalallii fi waliigalteen jiru qabeenyi xiqqoonis namaaf gaha.
Meaning_EN: Where two people truly love each other, even a single piece of bread is more than enough to satisfy them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalli waan xiqqoo gammachuu fi quubsa akka godhu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express that true love brings complete contentment with very little material wealth.
Keywords_AO: lameen, jaalala, biddeena, quufuu
Keywords_EN: two, love, bread, satisfaction

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti guddoon jibbansa gudda fiddi
Translation_Literal_EN: Great love brings great hatred.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli humnaa olii yoo cabe gara jibbansa cimaa fi hammeenyaatti jijjiirama.
Meaning_EN: Intense passion, when broken or betrayed, turns into an equally fierce and profound hatred.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalli garmalee dhooyu yoo mufannaan uumame akka malee gara jibbaatti deebi'uu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that relationships characterized by extreme emotional highs can collapse into intense enmity.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, guddoo, jibbansa, fiduu
Keywords_EN: great love, great hatred, betrayal, extremes

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti soddaa takka, jaalala goggoyduu
Translation_Literal_EN: Love between in-laws is singular, dry love.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli soddaan walii qaban daangaa fi safeeffannaa qabaachuu akka qabu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Affection between in-laws is cautious, formal, and strictly governed by boundaries of modesty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenyi soddaa safeeffannaa fi daangaa eeggachuun akka deemu gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind individuals that relations with in-laws require dignified restraint rather than casual familiarity.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, soddaa, goggoyduu, safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: love, in-law, dry, formal, boundary

Mammaaksa_AO: Ana jaalattu, furrii tiyyaa wajji
Translation_Literal_EN: If you love me, accept me along with my mucus.
Meaning_AO: Nama tokko yoo jaalatan hanqinaa fi amala isaatis dabalanii fudhachuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: True love embraces the beloved unconditionally, flaws, imperfections, and all.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni tokko jaalala guutuu akka barbaadu fi hir'ina isaa wajjin fudhatamuu akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that loving someone requires embracing their flaws and imperfections unconditionally.
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu, furrii, fudhachuu, hanqina
Keywords_EN: love, mucus, acceptance, flaws

Mammaaksa_AO: Joollee jaalatanii, gorora hin jibbani
Translation_Literal_EN: If you love children, you do not despise their drool.
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko yoo jaalatan dhibaa fi rakkoolee isa wajjin dhufan obsaan simachuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: When one genuinely loves children or undertakes a passion, one tolerates the inevitable mess and hardships.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan jaalatan keessatti wantoota nama nuffisiisan obsuun dirqama ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that loving a person or endeavor involves patiently accepting its messy and unappealing sides.
Keywords_AO: joollee, jaalachuu, gorora, jibbuu
Keywords_EN: children, love, drool, tolerance

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaa fardeessanii, haadha hin shalleeysani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not elevate the father while dragging the mother down.
Meaning_AO: Maatii keessatti abbaa fi haadha qixxee kabajuu fi wal caalchisuu dhabuu.
Meaning_EN: One should not glorify the father while disrespecting or neglecting the mother; both deserve equal honor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Warra ofii gidduutti wal caalchisa uumuu fi tokko tuffachuun akka hin taane gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish those who favor one parent while dishonoring or neglecting the other.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, fardeessuu, haadha, shalleessuu
Keywords_EN: father, exalt, mother, belittle, equality

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni jaalala warra ifii hin qabne, jaalala biyyaa hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who has no love for their own kin has no love for their homeland.
Meaning_AO: Jaalallii fi kabajni hawaasaa fi biyyaa maatii ofii jaalachuu irraa eegala.
Meaning_EN: Patriotism and genuine care for one's community begin with affection and loyalty toward one's own family.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni maatii isaatiif hin oo'anne biyyaafis garaa akka hin qabne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that true public loyalty or patriotism stems fundamentally from private familial love.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, warra, biyya, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: love, family, country, patriotism

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalti bara ammaa, kan isniina (dafinoo) haarawaa, salaasaa (lammaffoo) moofoyteeti, arbaa (roobii) gasaroomti
Translation_Literal_EN: The love of these days: fresh on Monday, stale by Tuesday, and worn out by Wednesday.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli yeroo ammaa bu'uura dhugaa dhabee dafee dhumuu fi jijjiiramuu isaa ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Modern shallow infatuation flares up quickly, fades overnight, and decays within days.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenya yeroo ammaa kan dafee badu fi gadi fageenya hin qabne qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock fickle, short-lived romantic trends that lack genuine commitment and patience.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, bara ammaa, isniina, moofoftuu, gasaroomuu
Keywords_EN: modern love, Monday, stale, worn out, fickle

Mammaaksa_AO: jibbansi gaange, jaalalti gaala
Translation_Literal_EN: Hatred is like a mule; love is like a camel.
Meaning_AO: Jibbansi akka gaangee dafee nama dhiita, jaalalli garuu akka gaalaa obsa qabaatee fagootti nama geggeessa.
Meaning_EN: Hatred is stubborn and treacherous like a mule, while love is patient, resilient, and far-reaching like a camel.
Usage_Situation_AO: Faayidaa fi obsa jaalalli qabu hammeenya jibbansaa waliin dorgomsiisanii ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that hatred brings rash malice while love possesses enduring patience and fortitude.
Keywords_AO: jibbansa, gaangee, jaalala, gaala
Keywords_EN: hatred, mule, love, camel, endurance

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaalalaan maletti nageenyi, duumeysaan maletti roobni hin jiru
Translation_Literal_EN: Without love there is no peace, just as without clouds there is no rain.
Meaning_AO: Nageenyi hawaasaa fi namootaa jaalala irratti kan bu'uureffame ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Peace cannot exist without love, just as rain cannot fall from cloudless skies.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nageenya amansiisaa uumuuf dura jaalalli jiraachuu akka qabu barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that true, lasting peace in society is impossible without mutual love and compassion.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, nageenya, duumeysa, rooba
Keywords_EN: love, peace, clouds, rain

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitii jechuun, tan abbaa manaa jaalattu
Translation_Literal_EN: A true wife is one who loves her husband.
Meaning_AO: Gaa'ela keessatti jaalallii fi amanamummaan haadha manaa bu'uura maatiiti.
Meaning_EN: The essence of a true wife and harmonious marriage is genuine devotion and love for her partner.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gaa'ela milkii keessatti jaalallii fi amanamummaan iddoo guddaa qabaachuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that mutual affection and marital devotion form the cornerstone of womanhood in marriage.
Keywords_AO: niitii, abbaa manaa, jaalachuu, gaa'ela
Keywords_EN: wife, husband, love, marriage

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni duumeysa kiyya hin jaalanne, rooba kiyyaas hin jaalatu
Translation_Literal_EN: One who does not love my clouds will not love my rain.
Meaning_AO: Namni haala qormaataa fi rakkina koo keessatti na cinaa hin dhaabbanne, milkaa'ina kootis hin qooddatu.
Meaning_EN: Whoever rejects me through my gloomy struggles does not deserve to share in the blessings of my success.
Usage_Situation_AO: Firoottan yeroo qananii qofa dhufan ceepha'uu fi namoota yeroo rakkoo nama bira jiran adda baafachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss fair-weather friends who abandon one during tough times but seek the rewards of victory.
Keywords_AO: duumeysa, rooba, jaalachuu, hiriyummaa
Keywords_EN: clouds, rain, love, fair-weather, loyalty

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo wal jaalatan, mixiin cidha galcha
Translation_Literal_EN: If they love each other, even ants can host a wedding feast.
Meaning_AO: Jaalallii fi tokkummaan yoo jiraate, wanti danda'amuu hin fakkaanne illee ni milkaa'a.
Meaning_EN: When there is mutual love and unity of purpose, even the smallest and weakest can accomplish wonders.
Usage_Situation_AO: Humni jaalalaa fi gamtummaa waan hundumaa dandeessisuu akka danda'u jajjabeessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire people that small means combined with genuine love and cooperation yield great achievements.
Keywords_AO: jaalala, mixii, cidha, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: love, ants, wedding, cooperation, unity

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo jaalatan jaldeeysaaf illee ni booyani
Translation_Literal_EN: If they love it, they will even weep for a baboon.
Meaning_AO: Jaalalli dhugaa madaallii miidhaginaa fi uumamaa dhabamsiisee maraammartoo guddaa nama keessatti uuma.
Meaning_EN: Love knows no prejudice; when the heart is deeply attached, it mourns even the most uncomely creature.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalli uumamaan nama qabatu daangaa fi bifaan akka hin daangeffamne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate how deep emotional attachment transcends external appearance or conventional standards.
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu, jaldeessa, booyuu, garaa laafuu
Keywords_EN: love, baboon, weep, affection, attachment

Mammaaksa_AO: Guddisaan ganama
Translation_Literal_EN: Upbringing is in the morning.
Meaning_AO: Daa'ima yoo xiqqaa ta'ee eegalee naamusa fi aadaa barsiisan malee yoo guddate sirreessuun rakkisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Proper upbringing and character formation must begin in early childhood; early training shapes the future.
Usage_Situation_AO: Daa'imman umurii daa'imummaa isaaniitti qajeelchuun barbaachisaa ta'uu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise parents that disciplining and educating a child must begin in early years.
Keywords_AO: guddisa, ganama, ijoollee, naamusa
Keywords_EN: upbringing, morning, child, discipline

Mammaaksa_AO: Manni bareedaan asaasara
Translation_Literal_EN: A beautiful house has a good foundation.
Meaning_AO: Wanti kamuu miidhagaa fi cimaa kan ta'u yoo bu'uura gaarii fi xiyyeeffannoo jalqabaa qabaatedha.
Meaning_EN: A beautiful and lasting house relies on proper laying of foundation and continuous tidying.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti tokko bifa gaarii akka qabaatuuf qophii fi bu'uura cimaa barbaachisuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that great results depend fundamentally on proper groundwork and thorough care.
Keywords_AO: mana, bareedaa, asaasara, bu'uura
Keywords_EN: house, beautiful, foundation, care

Mammaaksa_AO: Gundoo jalqaba tolteetu, goolabbii tola
Translation_Literal_EN: A woven basket made well at the start finishes well.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin kamiyyuu jalqabni isaa yoo sirraa'ee fi tole xumurri isaas gaarii taha.
Meaning_EN: A task that begins with sound preparation and precision will conclude successfully.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jalqaba hojii irratti xiyyeeffannoo fi of eeggannoo gochuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that putting care into the initial stages of any endeavor guarantees a good outcome.
Keywords_AO: gundoo, jalqaba, goolabbii, toluu
Keywords_EN: basket, beginning, completion, success

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan barana soqolatte, bara hegeree wayaa darbiti.
Translation_Literal_EN: One who tucked up her skirt this year will discard her clothes next year.
Meaning_AO: Badiin ykn gochi qaanlessaan har'a xiqqaatee jalqabame bor garmalee bal'atee ifatti baha.
Meaning_EN: Modest misconduct or improper behavior initiated today will escalate into shameless abandon tomorrow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Badii xiqqoo har'a jalqabamte dhiisuun fuulduratti qaanii guddaatti akka nama geessu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that small, unchecked compromises in modesty lead to total disgrace over time.
Keywords_AO: soqolachuu, bara hegeree, wayaa, qaanii
Keywords_EN: tuck up skirt, next year, clothes, disgrace

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafa dhudhuufaa karra baateen, akka harree boojitee galtu si beeke
Translation_Literal_EN: The day you farted your way through the gate, I knew you would return having looted only a donkey.
Meaning_AO: Jalqabuma sochiitiin hubannoo fi amala namaa irraa ka'uun bu'aan isaa maal akka ta'u beekuun ni danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: An undisciplined and boastful beginning reveals in advance how mediocre or disgraceful the outcome will be.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama of jajuu fi qophii sirrii hin qabne kan milkaa'ina guddaa fiduu hin dandeenye qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone whose undisciplined, frivolous conduct at the outset made their eventual failure predictable.
Keywords_AO: dhuufuu, karra, harree, boojiuu
Keywords_EN: fart, gate, donkey, plunder, poor result

Mammaaksa_AO: Dura liqimsaniif dura hin quufani
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because one swallows first does not mean one gets satisfied first.
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko ariitiin jalqabuun ykn liqimsuun guutuu ta'uu fi milkaa'ina isa duraatiif wabii miti.
Meaning_EN: Swallowing early does not guarantee early fullness; rushing does not ensure lasting fulfillment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota ariitiin dursanii fiiganii bu'aa dhugaa hin arganne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution that acting hastily or seizing something first does not mean one will reap true satisfaction.
Keywords_AO: dura, liqimsuu, quufuu, ariitii
Keywords_EN: first, swallow, satisfy, haste

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafni Hoolaa, qaama keessatti jallatee baha
Translation_Literal_EN: A sheep's horn grows out already curved within the body.
Meaning_AO: Amalli badaaniis ta'e gaariin nama keessatti uumamaan ykn ijoollummaadhaan hidda qabatee mul'ata.
Meaning_EN: An inherent flaw or crooked disposition is formed inside long before it manifests openly on the outside.
Usage_Situation_AO: Amalli jal'aan nama tokkoo uumama isaatii kaasee kan jiru ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remark that someone's crooked nature or deceitful character was ingrained in them from the start.
Keywords_AO: gaafa, hoolaa, jallachuu, qaama
Keywords_EN: horn, sheep, curved, innate nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkaan mutaan seene, muddaan seene
Translation_Literal_EN: A tooth that was poked with an awl has entered a tight crisis.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo ykn madaa xiqqoo keessa quba naquun gara miidhaa cimaa fi muddamaatti geessuu.
Meaning_EN: Tampering rashly with a delicate vulnerability turns a small irritation into an excruciating ordeal.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan of eeggannoo barbaadu tokko seeraan ala tuquun rakkoo cimaa fiduu isaa ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe someone who foolishly worsens a tender situation by poking at it aggressively.
Keywords_AO: ilkaan, mutaa, muddoo, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: tooth, awl, crisis, tamper

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaa mana biraa fuudhani, dubbii afaan irra fuudhani
Translation_Literal_EN: One takes a route past the house, and picks up words directly from the mouth.
Meaning_AO: Dhugaa fi odeeffannoo sirrii argachuuf madda isaattii fi afaan abbaa irraa dhagahuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Just as one takes a clear path starting from the homestead, reliable information must be gathered from the source.
