Usage_Situation_AO: Oduu nama biraa irraa dhagahamuu dhiisanii afaan abbaatii dhugaa qorachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise verifying news directly from the mouth of the person involved rather than trusting rumors.
Keywords_AO: karaa, mana, dubbii, afaan
Keywords_EN: road, house, word, mouth, source

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka sareen banteeni, waraabessi seena
Translation_Literal_EN: Where the dog leaves an opening, the hyena enters.
Meaning_AO: Bakka eeggannoon fi ittisni maatii ykn biyyaa laafeetti diinni fi miidhaan dafee seena.
Meaning_EN: Where the internal guard slacks or leaves a breach, danger and enemies swiftly break in.
Usage_Situation_AO: Of dagannaan ykn hanqinni eegumsaa diinaaf karaan akka banamu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that internal laxity or breach in defense invites external predators to exploit the gap.
Keywords_AO: saree, banuu, waraabessa, seenuu
Keywords_EN: dog, opening, hyena, enter, security

Mammaaksa_AO: Anaa bakka hamtutti godaane, intalti tiyya heeruma hamaa mudatte
Translation_Literal_EN: While I migrated to a harsh land, my daughter encountered a wretched marriage.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina irratti rakkinni dabalamuun ykn maatii guutuu irratti carraan badaa walitti dhufuun.
Meaning_EN: Misfortunes compounded upon misfortune; while the parent faces hardship, the child falls into misery.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon bakka adda addaatiin maatii tokko irratti wal harkaa fuudhee dhufu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when multiple severe hardships strike a household at the same time from different fronts.
Keywords_AO: godaanuu, intala, heeruma hamaa, gadda
Keywords_EN: migrate, barren, daughter, bad marriage, misfortune

Mammaaksa_AO: Harfiin aliifitti jallatte, aliif laamitti hin diriirtu
Translation_Literal_EN: A letter that bent crookedly at 'Alif' will not straighten out at 'Alif-Lam'.
Meaning_AO: Wanti jalqaba irraa bu'uura dhabee fi jallatee eegale boodarra sirraa'uu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: What is warped at the very first step will not straighten out in subsequent advanced stages.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dogoggora jalqabaa kan booda sirreessuun hin danda'amne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution that foundational flaws must be corrected immediately, as later stages inherit the defect.
Keywords_AO: harfii, aliif, jallachuu, diriiruu
Keywords_EN: letter, Alif, crooked, straighten, foundation

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan maddarraa qalqullaawa
Translation_Literal_EN: Water is clear from the source.
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan, qulqullinni fi amalli gaariin hundee fi madda ofii irraa eegalee qulqulluu ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Water is purest at its spring; purity and authenticity originate directly from the source.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta tokko qulqullinaan beekuuf madda isaa ilaaluun akka barbaachisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that true character, uncorrupted truth, and good quality stem from an untainted source.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, madda, qulqullaa'uu
Keywords_EN: water, spring, pure, clear

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii abbaa biraa dhaban, ilma biraa hin argani
Translation_Literal_EN: Words not found with the father will not be found with the son.
Meaning_AO: Ogeessummaa fi dhugaa abbaan dhabe ilmi biraa argachuun fagoo ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: If wisdom or integrity is missing in the father, one will seldom find it in the son who was raised by him.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ilmi amalaa fi dubbii abbaa isaa akka dhaalu fi abbaarraa baratu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to indicate that a son reflects the wisdom or lack thereof inherited and learned from his father.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, abbaa, dhabuu, ilma
Keywords_EN: word, father, lack, son

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan lagaa dhabame, manaa hin argamu
Translation_Literal_EN: Water lacking in the river will not be found in the house.
Meaning_AO: Wanti madda guddaa irratti dhabame bakka xiqqoo fi gadi aanaatti argamuun hin yaadamu.
Meaning_EN: If a commodity is missing from its primary, vast source, it certainly cannot be found in smaller confines.
Usage_Situation_AO: Madda guddaa irratti wanta hin jirre bakka xiqqaa irraa eeguun falfala akka ta'e ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone that if a resource is depleted at its primary fountainhead, it cannot be expected at home.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, laga, dhabamuu, mana
Keywords_EN: water, river, lack, house

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjaraan, xaafii hin galchu
Translation_Literal_EN: A hasty person does not harvest teff.
Meaning_AO: Xaafii sassaabuun obsa fi of eeggannoo waan barbaaduuf namni jarjaru kasaaraa keessa gala.
Meaning_EN: Harvesting delicate teff requires patience; a hasty person will spill the grain and harvest nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojiin xiyyeeffannoo fi suuta jedhanii hojjechuu barbaadu irratti jarjaruun balaa akka ta'e gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that delicate or meticulous tasks fail when approached with impatience.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, xaafii, galchuu, obsa
Keywords_EN: haste, teff, harvest, patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjarri, hujii sheeyxaanaati
Translation_Literal_EN: Haste is the work of the devil.
Meaning_AO: Ariifannaan dantaa fi karoora malee raawwatamu badii fi dogoggora qofa hordofsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Rash haste is destructive and impulsive, leading only to error and regret.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ariitiidhaan murtoo dogoggoraa dabarsuu deemu gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone against making reckless, impatient decisions.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, hujii, sheeyxaana, dogoggora
Keywords_EN: haste, work, devil, error

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysi jarjaraan, gaafa ciniina
Translation_Literal_EN: A hasty hyena bites the horn.
Meaning_AO: Jarjarri wanta fayyadaa hin qabne akka fudhatan ykn miidhaa akka ofirraan gahan nama godha.
Meaning_EN: In reckless haste, one bites into useless bone or horn instead of meat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni ariifatee waan bu'aa hin qabne irratti carraaqee of miidhe yeroo ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone whose blind impatience led them to seize something worthless or harmful.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, jarjara, gaafa, ciniinuu
Keywords_EN: hyena, haste, horn, bite

Mammaaksa_AO: Marxoon fiigaa hidhatan, osoo fiigan namarraa hiikkatti
Translation_Literal_EN: A loincloth tied while running comes undone while running.
Meaning_AO: Qophii fi hojiin ariitiidhaan fi tasgabbii malee tolfame yeroma sana diigama.
Meaning_EN: What is prepared carelessly in a rush will easily fall apart in the middle of action.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojiin kamiyyuu tasgabbiidhaan bu'uureffamuu akka qabu yeroo yaadachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that hurried, sloppy preparation inevitably unravels under pressure.
Keywords_AO: marroo, fiiguu, hidhachuu, hiikkachuu
Keywords_EN: loincloth, run, fasten, untie

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjaraan re'ee hin horu, lama taatu ni qala, sadi taatu ni gurgura
Translation_Literal_EN: An impatient person does not breed goats; if two he slaughters, if three he sells.
Meaning_AO: Namni obsa hin qabne qabeenya guddisuu hin danda'u, dafee balleessa.
Meaning_EN: An impatient person cannot build wealth; they squander every small accumulation before it grows.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama obsa dhabuun qabeenya ofii dafee fixee hiyyoome qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize someone who lacks the discipline to let their assets multiply over time.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, re'ee, horuu, qaluu, gurguruu
Keywords_EN: haste, goat, breed, slaughter, sell

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjaraan, dhihana ifiiti gadi naqa
Translation_Literal_EN: A hasty person spills their own evening meal.
Meaning_AO: Ariifannaan waan ofii qabanillee akka dhabanii fi akka qisaasessan nama godha.
Meaning_EN: Impatience causes one to ruin or spill the very nourishment prepared for oneself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ariitiidhaan qabeenya ykn carraa ofii balleesse gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone's rashness causes them to spoil their own immediate fortunes or meal.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, dhihana, naquu, badii
Keywords_EN: haste, dinner, spill, ruin

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama dura dubbatu, namaatu jibba
Translation_Literal_EN: The person who speaks first provokes dislike.
Meaning_AO: Osoo hin tasgabbiin dursanii arraba dheereffachuun mufannaa fi jibbansa namootaa kakaasa.
Meaning_EN: Speaking out impulsively before thinking or hearing others generates resentment and ill will.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dubbii keessatti ariifannaa dhiisanii obsaan dhaggeeffachuu akka qaban gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise restraint in conversation, warning against speaking out hastily before others.
Keywords_AO: dubbachuu, dura, jibbuu, arraba
Keywords_EN: speak, first, dislike, speech

Mammaaksa_AO: Midhaan dura bilchaatu, shinbirrootu nyaata
Translation_Literal_EN: The crop that ripens first is eaten by birds.
Meaning_AO: Wanti yeroo isaatii dura ifatti bahe ykn dhufe balaa fi miidhaaf saaxilama.
Meaning_EN: The crop that matures ahead of its time falls prey to birds; precocity attracts early vulnerability.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan tokko yeroo isaatiin dura akka hin gaggabne fi of hin saaxille gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind that being prematurely exposed before the general season invites predation or trouble.
Keywords_AO: midhaan, bilchaachuu, shinbirroo, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: grain, ripen, birds, eat

Mammaaksa_AO: Ar'a dhaale, ar'a dhaane
Translation_Literal_EN: Inherited today, abused today.
Meaning_AO: Wanta carraan ykn dhaalaan argatan yeroma sana kabaja dhabsiisanii miidhuu.
Meaning_EN: Acquiring something through sudden inheritance and immediately abusing or mismanaging it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta osoo itti hin dadhabin argate yeroma sana mancaase ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn someone who immediately mistreats or squanders what they inherited without effort.
Keywords_AO: ar'a, dhaaluu, dhaanuu, tuffii
Keywords_EN: today, inherit, beat, abuse

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo loon hin galin, hattuun mooraa guutte
Translation_Literal_EN: Before the cattle return, thieves have already filled the enclosure.
Meaning_AO: Wanti barbaadamu osoo hin argamin ykn hin gayin wantoonni badaa dursanii qophaa'uu.
Meaning_EN: Premature anticipation; thieves crowding the pen before the livestock have even returned.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan tokko osoo hin argamin dura namoota itti daddafanii qoodachuuf fiigan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock opportunists who scheme over gains before the actual prize has even arrived.
Keywords_AO: loon, galuu, hattuu, mooraa
Keywords_EN: cattle, return, thief, barn, premature

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan dammi lafa jiru, jarjaraan haphee guura
Translation_Literal_EN: While honey is on the ground, the hasty one gathers sticky sap.
Meaning_AO: Obsa dhabuun wanta qaalii fi mi'aawaa dhiisanii waan gatii hin qabne akka qabatan nama godha.
Meaning_EN: Through impatient rushing, one settles for sticky tree sap while real honey lies nearby.
Theme_EN: Settling for Inferior due to Haste
Usage_Situation_AO: Ariifannaan carraa gaarii akka dhabanii fi waan gatii dhabeessa akka fudhatan taasisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when haste blinds someone from seeing true value, making them grab a cheap substitute.
Keywords_AO: damma, lafa, jarjara, haphee
Keywords_EN: honey, ground, haste, sap

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjaraan, ilmoo hin dhalchu
Translation_Literal_EN: A hasty person does not father a child.
Meaning_AO: Dhimmoota bu'uuraa fi gurguddoo ta'an keessatti obsaa fi yeroon murteessaa ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Great and natural processes require their due time and patience; haste produces nothing viable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti bu'a qabeessi kamuu yeroo fi obsa akka barbaadu yeroo barsiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind that meaningful growth and lasting results cannot be rushed ahead of nature.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, ilmoo, dhalchuu, obsa
Keywords_EN: haste, child, give birth, patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyya aannaniitti galla jennaan, jaartiin aannan dhangalaafte
Translation_Literal_EN: Hearing "We enter the land of milk," the old woman spilled her milk.
Meaning_AO: Abdii fi waadaa fuulduraatiin dogoggoranii wanta harkaa qaban gatuu ykn mancaasuu.
Meaning_EN: On hearing rumors of future abundance, the foolish person discarded the actual provisions at hand.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta hin mirkanoofne abdatee wanta qabu kan balleesse yeroo ceepha'an.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who squanders their current security based on unverified promises of future plenty.
Keywords_AO: aannan, dhangalaasuu, biyya, jaartii
Keywords_EN: milk, spill, promised land, old woman

Mammaaksa_AO: "Boru ijji siif banamti" jennaan, "edanu akkamittin bula" je'e, ballaan
Translation_Literal_EN: When told "Tomorrow your eyes will open," the blind man asked, "How will I spend tonight?"
Meaning_AO: Namni rakkina hamaa keessa jiru abdii boruu caalaa fala har'aa fi ammaa barbaada.
Meaning_EN: A person in acute desperation cares about surviving tonight rather than vague promises of tomorrow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota rakkoo cimaa keessa jiraniif abdii fagoo kennuu mannaa gargaarsa ammaa gochuun akka wayyu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that immediate misery needs immediate relief, not distant comforting promises.
Keywords_AO: boru, ija, banamuu, ballaa, buluu
Keywords_EN: tomorrow, eye, blind man, immediate need

Mammaaksa_AO: "Gaafa roobaa dhadhaa si dibna" jennaan, gaafa qacace dhufte
Translation_Literal_EN: When promised "We will butter you when it rains," she arrived on a drizzly day.
Meaning_AO: Haala hin guutamneen waadaa qabachuuf ariifachuu fi wanta xiqqoo argatetti fiiguu.
Meaning_EN: Impatiently rushing to claim a promise at the slightest sign, even when conditions are not yet met.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta abdachiifameef dafee ariifatee haala hin mijanne keessatti dhufe qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone whose eagerness makes them jump at the first faint hint to claim an entitlement.
Keywords_AO: rooba, dhadhaa, dibuu, qacace
Keywords_EN: rain, butter, anoint, drizzle, premature

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjaraan namaa, qaanawu malee hin du'u
Translation_Literal_EN: A hasty person does not die, but they live in constant shame.
Meaning_AO: Ariifannaan lubbuu baasuu baatus yeroo hundumaa qaanii fi salphina keessa nama buusa.
Meaning_EN: Reckless haste may not kill you, but it guarantees an endless cycle of public shame and regret.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ariifannaan kabajaa namaa akka hir'isu fi qaanii akka uumu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that chronic impatience repeatedly subjects a person to embarrassing blunders.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, qaana'uu, du'uu, salphina
Keywords_EN: haste, shame, die, embarrassment

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjarree "aabboo" jenneeti, "aboo" jechuun nu dhibde
Translation_Literal_EN: In haste we called him "revered father," and later we couldn't even manage to say "hey you."
Meaning_AO: Osoo eenyummaa namaa hin beekin kabaja guddaa kennaniifii booda garuu salphina arguun gaabbuu.
Meaning_EN: Elevating someone prematurely with excessive respect leaves one awkwardly unable to redress it later.
Usage_Situation_AO: Osoo amala namaa hin hubatin dafanii kabaja olaanaa kennanii booda gaabbuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when having rashly honored an unworthy person and subsequently regretting the excessive deference.
Keywords_AO: aabboo, aboo, jarjara, gaabbii
Keywords_EN: father, hey you, haste, regret, reverence

Mammaaksa_AO: Ariifataan hori gata
Translation_Literal_EN: The hasty person loses their livestock.
Meaning_AO: Namni ariifatee murtoo dabarsu qabeenya isaa dhabuu fi kasaaruuf saaxilama.
Meaning_EN: Impulsive and hurried decisions cause a person to squander and forfeit their possessions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya bulchuu keessatti obsi fi karooraan deemuu akka barbaachisu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against hasty financial transactions or reckless management of property.
Keywords_AO: ariifannaa, horii, gatuu, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: haste, wealth, discard, loss

Mammaaksa_AO: kan ganna bahuu isii hin beekne, wayaan ganna na hin baasu jetti
Translation_Literal_EN: Uncertain if she will survive winter, she complains her clothes won't last winter.
Meaning_AO: Lubbuu fi jireenya ofii irratti amantee osoo hin qabaatin wantoota xixiqqoo irratti dhiphachuu.
Meaning_EN: Uncertain of whether she will survive the winter, she worries about whether her dress will survive it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dhimma lubbuu fi ijoo ta'e dhiisee waan salphaa irratti dhiphatu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize individuals who fret over trivial luxuries while facing fundamental existential threats.
Keywords_AO: ganna, bahuu, wayaa, dhiphachuu
Keywords_EN: rainy season, survive, clothes, misplaced priority

Mammaaksa_AO: Hatattamaan quufani, jarjaraan deegani
Translation_Literal_EN: A frantic rush satisfies briefly; chronic haste leads to poverty.
Meaning_AO: Waan tokko dafanii fixachuun yeroof qofa tola, ariifannaan dheeraa keessatti hiyyummaatti nama geessa.
Meaning_EN: Rushing through provisions offers only momentary satisfaction, but habitual haste leads straight to poverty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ariifannaadhaan jireenya geggeessuun gara deegumsaatti akka nama geessu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel against living impulsively, warning that chronic impatience drains long-term wealth.
Keywords_AO: hatattama, quufuu, jarjara, deeguu
Keywords_EN: haste, satisfied, rush, poverty

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waan hin beeyne hin beeynu ja'anii, harka maa hudduu irraa na fuutaa" je'e, gurbaan jaartii soddaatiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "If you claim not to know, why are you removing your hands from my buttocks?" said the boy to his mother-in-law.
Meaning_AO: Namni gocha safuu cabse hojjechaa osoo jiruu 'waan hin beekneefan godhe' jechuun soba ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Feigning innocence or ignorance while deliberately engaging in taboo or shameful transgression is transparent deceit.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota balleessaa ifa ta'e raawwachaa 'osoon hin beekin' jedhanii of qusan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to call out brazen hypocrisy when someone feigns ignorance to excuse an obvious, taboo violation.
Keywords_AO: beekuu, harka, hudduu, soddaa, safuu
Keywords_EN: know, hand, buttocks, in-law, taboo

Mammaaksa_AO: Hantuutni dhaltee dhalteeti, eegeen hafnaan oote
Translation_Literal_EN: The mouse gave birth to the whole body, but cried in anguish when only the tail remained.
Meaning_AO: Hojii ykn rakkoo guddaa danda'anii erga xumuranii dhumarratti waan xiqqoodhaan dhibamuu ykn nuffuu.
Meaning_EN: Having endured through the overwhelming bulk of a trial, crying out in defeat over the final little detail.
Theme_EN: Giving Up at the Finish Line
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta guddaa danda'ee dhuma irratti hanqina xiqqoodhaaf gufatu gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone perseveres through massive hardships only to despair or give up at the very final step.
Keywords_AO: hantuuta, dhaluu, eegee, ootuu
Keywords_EN: mouse, give birth, tail, despair, endurance

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan fardaatuu hin beeknuu, kooraan nuun ceceete
Translation_Literal_EN: We know nothing of horses, yet the saddle gallops with us.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma bu'uuraa hin hubanne keessa seenanii waan dabalataa irratti wal dhiphisuu fi muddamuu.
Meaning_EN: Knowing nothing about the primary subject, yet getting completely entangled and agitated by secondary matters.
Usage_Situation_AO: Osoo bu'uura hin beekin waan hin dhimmitetti seenanii dhiphachuu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock an absurd situation where inexperienced people obsess over trivial details of things they don't grasp.
Keywords_AO: farda, kooraa, beekuu, cecechuu
Keywords_EN: horse, saddle, gallop, ignorance

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan waa jibbe diinaa, gaarii jaalateehuu jibbe
Translation_Literal_EN: A heart that has despised something is an enemy; having once loved good, it now spurns it.
Meaning_AO: Garaan yoo nama ykn waan tokko jibbe, wanti gaariin inni hojjetullee akka hamtuutti mul'ata.
Meaning_EN: Once the heart turns bitter against something, it becomes prejudiced and rejects even the good in it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni garaadhaan jibba qabu waan gaarii nama sanaas akka hin argine yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how deep resentment blinds a person to any virtue or goodwill from the hated party.
Keywords_AO: garaa, jibbuu, diina, gaarii
Keywords_EN: heart, hate, enemy, good, prejudice

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni nama jibbu, nama hin faarsu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who hates someone will never praise them.
Meaning_AO: Diinni ykn namni jibbansa qabu gonkumaa milkaa'inaa fi gaarummaa kee hin himu.
Meaning_EN: One who harbors resentment will never speak well of you or acknowledge your achievements.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama jibbansa qabu irraa faaruu fi galata eeguun bu'aa akka hin qabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that it is futile to expect praise or validation from someone who despises you.
Keywords_AO: nama, jibbuu, faarsuu, diina
Keywords_EN: person, hate, praise, enemy

Mammaaksa_AO: Jibbansi soddaa takka, jibbansa goggooyduu
Translation_Literal_EN: Hatred between in-laws is singular, dry hatred.
Meaning_AO: Soddaan yoo wal jibbe wal-saalfannaa fi daangaa dhabee dhimmi isaanii garmalee qallata.
Meaning_EN: Enmity between in-laws is rigid, bitter, and stripped of all traditional modesty and warmth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenyi soddaa yoo faallaa ta'e safeeffannaan hafee gara jibba addaatti jijjiiramuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the severe, awkward, and unyielding nature of disputes between in-laws.
Keywords_AO: jibbansa, soddaa, goggoyduu, safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: hatred, in-law, dry, coldness

Mammaaksa_AO: Haada cite hidhan malee, garaa cite hin hidhani
Translation_Literal_EN: One can tie a severed rope, but one cannot tie a severed heart.
Meaning_AO: Wanta meeshaatiin miidhame suphuun ni danda'ama, garuu jaalala fi amantaa cabe deebisuun baay'ee rakkisaadha.
Meaning_EN: A snapped rope can easily be knotted together, but a deeply broken heart and trust can never be seamlessly mended.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa fi cabeensa jaalalaa deebisanii suphuun ulfaataa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that while material damage is easily repaired, wounded feelings and broken trust linger forever.
Keywords_AO: haada, cituu, hidhuu, garaa
Keywords_EN: rope, snap, tie, heart, heartbreak

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni wal jaalatu, wal jibbuu hin oolu
Translation_Literal_EN: People who love each other will not escape hating each other at times.
Meaning_AO: Walitti dhufeenya jaalalaa keessatti wal mufachiisuun fi wal dhabuun uumama waan ta'eef hin oolu.
Meaning_EN: Where there is deep affection, occasional friction, misunderstanding, or resentment is inevitable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalleewwan ykn maatiin yoo wal dhaban uumama jireenyaa ta'uu yaadachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind companions that disagreements and moments of anger are natural even in the closest bonds.
Keywords_AO: jaalachuu, jibbuu, ooluu, dhiifama
Keywords_EN: love, hate, friction, inevitable

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmaan masaanuu, abbu torbatti masaanuu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Children of co-wives remain rivals even through seven generations.
Meaning_AO: Dorgommiin fi hinaaffaan haadholii gidduu jiru dhaloota irraa dhalootatti ilmaan gidduutti darba.
Meaning_EN: Rivalry born between co-wives persists as deep-seated competition across generations of their descendants.
Usage_Situation_AO: Diinummaa fi dorgommii maatii keessatti hidda dhabee ture ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain long-standing familial animosity rooted in traditional polygamous households.
Keywords_AO: ilmaan, masaanuu, torba, dorgommii
Keywords_EN: children, co-wives, seven generations, rivalry

Mammaaksa_AO: Saree masgiida seente nu hin godhin
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not make us like a dog that has entered a mosque.
Meaning_AO: Bakka hundi itti nama ari'uu fi jibbutti akka hin qaanofne kadhachuu ykn himachuu.
Meaning_EN: A plea not to be placed in an utterly despised, unwanted, and relentlessly chased-out position.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka jibbaa fi salphinni itti baay'atu irraa akka of eeggatan ykn akka rabbiin eegu kadhachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a colorful prayer or expression pleading to avoid being universally unwelcome and chased away.
Keywords_AO: saree, masgiida, seenuu, salphina
Keywords_EN: dog, mosque, ostracized, humiliation

Mammaaksa_AO: Funyoo udaan seente nu hin godhin
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not make us like a rope that has entered feces.
Meaning_AO: Wanta namni hundi itti dhihaachuu sodaatu, balfuufi gatu akka hin taane dubbatan.
Meaning_EN: A plea not to become so contaminated and despised that nobody wants to touch or associate with one.
Usage_Situation_AO: Salphinaa fi xuraawaa hawaasni irraa fagaatu ta'uu irraa rabbiin akka nama baraaru kadhachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used colloquially to pray against falling into such public disgrace and disgust that everyone shuns you.
Keywords_AO: funyoo, udaan, balfuu, salphina
Keywords_EN: rope, feces, repulsive, shunned

Mammaaksa_AO: Eegaan Aamina jibbeen, aammiinii wadaajaa jibbe
Translation_Literal_EN: Since I came to despise Amina, I have despised saying "Amen" at communal prayers.
Meaning_AO: Nama tokko jibbuu irraa kan ka'e waan isa fakkaatu ykn isa wajjin wal qabatu hunda jibbuu.
Meaning_EN: Because of despising one particular person, one develops an aversion to everything associated with them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jibbansi nama tokkoo waan biraa hin qulqullaa'in hunda irratti dhiibbaa yoo fidu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humorously highlight how deep personal dislike spills over into irrational aversion toward related things.
Keywords_AO: Aamina, jibbuu, aammiin, wadaajaa
Keywords_EN: Amina, hate, amen, prayer gathering

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan jibbaniin kakatu
Translation_Literal_EN: One swears an oath by what one despises.
Meaning_AO: Wanta jibban ykn sodaatan akka waadaa fi kakuutti dhiyeessanii of qulqulleessu.
Meaning_EN: People often swear oaths by the very abominations they dread, to prove their innocence or resolve.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni waan sodaataniin fi balaaleffataniin kakachuun dhugaa isaanii akka mirkaneessan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain the cultural custom where serious oaths invoke dreaded calamities or despised taboos.
Keywords_AO: jibbuu, kakachuu, dhugaa, kakuu
Keywords_EN: despise, swear oath, truth, conviction

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama balfan, irrumaa balaaleeffatan
Translation_Literal_EN: One who is already disliked is condemned even further.
Meaning_AO: Namni duraanuu hawaasa keessatti maqaa qabu yoo waan xiqqoo balleesse akka malee itti jabaatama.
Meaning_EN: When someone is already despised, even their harmless actions or minor errors invite exaggerated condemnation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota jibbaman irratti murtii loogii fi harka ciminnaan kennamu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out unfair bias where an already unpopular person receives disproportionate blame.
Keywords_AO: balfuu, balaaleeffachuu, loogii
Keywords_EN: despise, condemn, prejudice, bias

Mammaaksa_AO: Intala jibban, soddaa hin gabbarani
Translation_Literal_EN: If one despises the daughter, one does not pay bride-wealth to the in-laws.
Meaning_AO: Wanta jaalala hin qabneef qabeenyaa fi yeroo ofii dabarsee kennuun hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: If you have no genuine affection for the bride, you do not invest dowry or honor in her family.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta hin barbaadamne irratti baasii fi carraaqqii gochuun faayidaa akka hin qabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to argue that one should not invest time, money, or effort into alliances or endeavors one does not desire.
Keywords_AO: intala, jibbuu, soddaa, gabbara
Keywords_EN: daughter, dislike, in-law, dowry

Mammaaksa_AO: Barbareen mana bulteeti, garaan agabuu bule
Translation_Literal_EN: The chili pepper spent the night in the house, yet the stomach spent the night starving.
Meaning_AO: Wanti jiru nyaatamuuf hin ta'u ykn nama gargaaruu hin danda'u taanaan qabeenyi sun faayidaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: The pepper was present in the house, but one still went to sleep hungry; useless presence yields no sustenance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya qabaatanii garuu rakkoo furuu dadhabuu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when something exists only nominally without being able to solve the immediate hunger or crisis.
Keywords_AO: barbaree, mana, buluu, garaa, agabuu
Keywords_EN: pepper, house, stomach, hungry, uselessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Diina bishaan fuudhe jannaan, kan quluu itti gadi naqe
Translation_Literal_EN: Hearing that the enemy was swept away by water, he poured a gourd of water on him.
Meaning_AO: Diinni yoo miidhame ykn kufe dabalataan miidhaa irraan gahuuf ariifachuu.
Meaning_EN: Hearing that one's enemy was drowning, one poured an extra gourd of water to ensure his demise.
Usage_Situation_AO: Diinummaa cimaa namoonni qaban fi kufaatii diinaa irratti gammaduu isaanii ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate spiteful cruelty where someone actively aggravates the downfall of a ruined adversary.
Keywords_AO: diina, bishaan, fuudhuu, quluu, naquu
Keywords_EN: enemy, water, sweep, gourd, malice

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadha ilmoo didde wal'aanuun nama hin dhibu, ilmoo haadha didde wal'aanuun nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: Treating a mother who rejected her child is manageable; treating a child who rejected the mother is difficult.
Meaning_AO: Daa'imni uumama isaatii kaasee haadha jibbee fi didde garaa jabeessa waan ta'eef sirreessuun rakkisaadha.
Meaning_EN: It is manageable to counsel an estranged mother, but reforming an ungrateful child who spurns their mother is hard.
Usage_Situation_AO: Badii fi hammeenya ilmi haadha ofiitti mul'isu akkaan ulfaataa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the shocking gravity and intractable stubbornness of a child who disowns their mother.
Keywords_AO: haadha, ilmoo, didduu, wal'aanuu
Keywords_EN: mother, child, reject, cure, ingratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Du'a ga'ii nama hamaa, gammachuuf dhaqu
Translation_Literal_EN: To the mourning of a wicked person, people go for celebration.
Meaning_AO: Namni hammeenya baay'ise yeroo du'u hawaasni boochuu mannaa boqonnaa fi gammachuu argata.
Meaning_EN: When a notorious oppressor or wicked person dies, people attend the funeral not in sorrow, but in collective relief.
Theme_EN: Demise of the Wicked & Public Relief
Usage_Situation_AO: Hammeenyi booda salphinaa fi jibbansa du'aan boodaa akka fidu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn wicked people that their tyranny will only earn them celebratory relief upon their death.
Keywords_AO: du'a ga'ii, hamaa, gammachuu, du'a
Keywords_EN: funeral, wicked, celebration, relief

Mammaaksa_AO: Biddeena warra jibbanii nyaatan, galaniiti haqisan
Translation_Literal_EN: Bread eaten from the house of those one despises is vomited upon returning home.
Meaning_AO: Wanta nama jibban biraa qaanfachuun ykn dirqamaan fudhatan booda miidhaa fi nuffii qofa uuma.
Meaning_EN: Food accepted reluctantly from those one hates brings no peace and causes nothing but nausea upon return.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama jibban biraa waan tokko nyaachuu ykn fudhachuun booda gaabbii akka fidu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that taking hospitality from resentful or hated hosts brings digestive and emotional revulsion.
Keywords_AO: biddeena, jibbuu, nyaachuu, haqqisuu
Keywords_EN: bread, hate, eat, vomit, revulsion

Mammaaksa_AO: "Haatee duute" jennaan, "rabbi abaarsa jalaa na baase" je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: When told "Your mother has died," he said, "God has delivered me from her curses."
Meaning_AO: Walitti dhufeenyi maatii garmalee manca'ee gara jibbansa fi boqonnaa barbaaduutti darbuu.
Meaning_EN: Expressing relief at a parent's demise due to the cessation of relentless bitterness and curses.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenyi maatii hangam akka daraan manca'ee fi jibba hamaa keessa seene ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate an extreme degree of familial breakdown where death brings tragic relief rather than sorrow.
Keywords_AO: haadha, du'uu, abaarsa, ba'uu
Keywords_EN: mother, death, curse, relief, toxicity

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waan na godhe anaatu beekaa, karaa awwaala abbaa keetii hin bahin" jette, haati intalaan
Translation_Literal_EN: "I know what he did to me, so do not take the path past your father's grave," said the mother to her daughter.
Meaning_AO: Haaloo fi mufannaan gaa'ela keessatti dhalate hanga du'aa boodaattis ilmaan irratti dhiibbaa uumuu.
Meaning_EN: A mother transmitting her deep-seated marital trauma and grudge against her late husband to her daughter.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jibbansi duraanii hangam hidda dhabee du'aan boodas akka itti fufu yeroo agarsiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate how marital resentment can persist beyond the grave and infect filial relations.
Keywords_AO: awwaala, abbaa, intala, haaloo
Keywords_EN: grave, father, daughter, grudge, spite

Mammaaksa_AO: Marqaa tana daakittiis itti hafte, affeellittis itti hafte,
Translation_Literal_EN: As for this porridge, it remained raw flour and remained undercooked.
Meaning_AO: Wanti kamuu seeraan osoo hin xumuramin karaatti dhumee faayidaa dhabe.
Meaning_EN: This porridge was neither properly ground into flour nor boiled to readiness; a complete botched compromise.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma karaa lamaaninuu hin milkoofne fi bifa dhabe ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize a botch job or poorly executed plan that ends up stranded between two failed states.
Keywords_AO: marqaa, daakittii, affeellittii, hafina
Keywords_EN: porridge, flour, unboiled, botched, incomplete

Mammaaksa_AO: "Hinaafaan kale du'ee, allaattiin cinaacha isaa haa nyaattu" jette, dubri
Translation_Literal_EN: "The jealous one died yesterday, may the bird of prey feast on his ribs," said the young woman.
Meaning_AO: Nama dorgomaa fi hinaaffaadhaan nama dhiphisaa ture irratti gammachuu fi abaarsa ibsuu.
Meaning_EN: Voicing harsh schadenfreude upon the death of an envious persecutor, rejoicing in their complete downfall.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota hinaaffaan jireenya namaa dhiphisan yeroo kutan gaddii dhabamuu agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express vindictive triumph at the fall or death of an envious, toxic tormentor.
Keywords_AO: hinaafaa, du'uu, allaattii, cinaacha
Keywords_EN: jealous, die, bird of prey, ribs, vindication

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka gaara gamaa, gamana namni hin jiru
Translation_Literal_EN: Like the mountain across the river, on this side there is nobody.
Meaning_AO: Namni of tuulu ykn orma faarsu tokko namoota cinaa isaatti argaman akka homaatti lakkaa'uu dhiisuu.
Meaning_EN: Fixating admiringly on distant peaks while ignoring or belittling the people right beside oneself.
Theme_EN: Contempt for the Proximate & Remote Idealization
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama warra dhiyoo tuffatee kan fagootti qofa ilaalcha gaarii kennu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand someone who disdains neighbors and family while idolizing faraway strangers.
Keywords_AO: gaara, gama, gamana, tuffii
Keywords_EN: mountain, beyond, this side, disdain

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni, jireenya isaati fakkaata
Translation_Literal_EN: A person resembles their lifestyle.
Meaning_AO: Haalli jireenyaa, hojiin fi naannoon namni keessa jiraatu bifa, amala fi ilaalcha isaa irratti calaqqisa.
Meaning_EN: A person's appearance, demeanor, and character reflect the living conditions and livelihood they experience.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haalli jireenya nama tokkoo amala fi bifarratti dhiibbaa akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that one's daily life, struggles, and surroundings inevitably shape who they are.
Keywords_AO: nama, jireenya, fakkaachuu, amala
Keywords_EN: person, life, resemble, reflection

Mammaaksa_AO: Akkuma itti jiraniitu jiruu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Life is however one lives it.
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi akkaataa namni itti fudhate, madaqee fi carraaqetti hiika kan argatu ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Life is defined by how one navigates it; adapting to one's reality constitutes living.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haala jiru keessatti madaqanii jireenya ofii itti fufuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel acceptance and realistic adaptation to whatever life circumstances one faces.
Keywords_AO: jiruu, jireenya, madaquu, qabatama
Keywords_EN: life, living, adaptation, reality

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama jiruutu, waa arga
Translation_Literal_EN: Only the living person gets to see things.
Meaning_AO: Hanga lubbuun jiranitti wanta haaraa, jijjiiramaa fi carraawwan arguun kan danda'amu ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: So long as one is alive, one witnesses wonders, endures trials, and experiences opportunities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni abdii akka hin kunneefii hanga jirutti carraan akka jiru jajjabeessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage someone to stay hopeful, reminding them that remaining alive means possibilities remain open.
Keywords_AO: nama, jiruu, arguu, abdii
Keywords_EN: person, alive, see, witness, hope

Mammaaksa_AO: Jiruu hin tuffatani, du'an sanuu dhabani
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not despise life; in death even that is gone.
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi rakkisaa ta'ullee lubbuun jiraachuun wanta hunda caalaa qaalii ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Never disdain even the humblest life or struggle, for in death one loses even that.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni jireenya isaanii tuffatanii abdii kutan akka qananii lubbuu qaban galateeffatan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand despair, urging gratitude for life despite all accompanying hardships.
Keywords_AO: jiruu, tuffachuu, du'a, lubbuu
Keywords_EN: life, disdain, death, value of living

Mammaaksa_AO: Ulfi xiqqaa hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Pregnancy has no small degree.
Meaning_AO: Dhimmi lubbuu, ulfinnii fi guddinnii kamuu xiqqoo jedhamee kan tuffatamu hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Life, honor, and gestation know no minor scale; every beginning carries total weight and dignity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta uumamaa fi kabajamaa ta'e kamuu akka xiqqootti ilaaluun dogoggora ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that matters of pregnancy, life, or basic honor must never be trivialized.
Keywords_AO: ulfa, xiqqaa, kabajaa, lubbuu
Keywords_EN: pregnancy, weight, small, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Bokkaan jireenya, jireenya hin tuffatan
Translation_Literal_EN: Rain is life; one does not despise life.
Meaning_AO: Roobni madda jireenyaa waan ta'eef eebba uumaa fi jireenya ofii galataan simachuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Rain brings sustenance and life; one should never despise life or the blessed showers that maintain it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Eebba uumamaa fi qananii jireenyaa tuffachuu dhiisanii galateeffachuun akka barbaachisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people to embrace the blessing of sustenance and cherish life without complaining.
Keywords_AO: bokkaa, jireenya, tuffachuu, eebba
Keywords_EN: rain, life, despise, blessing

Mammaaksa_AO: Caphuu mannaa, deega galuu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to enter into poverty than to end up broken.
Meaning_AO: Fayyaa fi guutummaa qaamaa dhabuu irra qabeenya dhabanii hiyyooma ta'anii jiraachuu wayya.
Meaning_EN: It is far better to endure material poverty in one piece than to be physically maimed or destroyed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenyi yoo dhabameluu fayyaan qaamaa fi lubbuun caalaa ta'uu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort or advise that preserving physical bodily health and life outweighs any loss of possessions.
Keywords_AO: caphuu, deega, fayyaa, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: broken, poverty, health, whole

Mammaaksa_AO: Hanga jiran mandheerani, du'an ni suntuurani
Translation_Literal_EN: As long as one is alive one roams; once dead one shrivels in the grave.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo lubbuun jiranitti carraawwan jiranitti fayyadamanii socho'uu fi jiraachuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: While alive, one moves and explores the open world; once dead, one is confined and still in the earth.
Theme_EN: Freedom of Life vs. Confinement of Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni yeroo lubbuun jiranitti akka hojjetanii fi jireenya isaanii gammachuun dabarsan kakaasuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire action and vitality, reminding that the mobility of life is brief before the stillness of death.
Keywords_AO: jiraachuu, mandheeruu, du'a, suntuuruu
Keywords_EN: live, roam, die, shrivel, mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan du'e biyye, kan jiru abbaa biyyaati
Translation_Literal_EN: The dead becomes dust; the living is the master of the land.
Meaning_AO: Namni du'e dacheetti makama, kan dachee fi jireenya bulchu garuu nama lubbuun jiru qofaadha.
Meaning_EN: The deceased turns to earth, while the living remains the inheritor and master of the land.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gadda booda gara jireenyaatti deebi'uun dirqama ta'uu fi lafti kan warra jiruutii ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge the living to move forward after bereavement, as the affairs of this world belong to the living.
Keywords_AO: du'uu, biyyee, jiraachuu, abbaa biyyaa
Keywords_EN: dead, dust, earth, living, master of land

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan du'e hin deebi'u, kan hafeetu waan jireenyaa hojjata
Translation_Literal_EN: The dead does not return; it is the one who remains who works for life.
Meaning_AO: Nama darbeef garmalee boo'anii jireenya ofii laamshessuu dhiisanii kan jiruuf carraaquu wayya.
Meaning_EN: The deceased cannot return; those who remain must carry on the responsibilities of living.
Usage_Situation_AO: Warra gadda keessa jiran jajjabeessuu fi gara dalagaa jireenyaatti akka deebi'an gochuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to console the bereaved and prompt them to resume active responsibility for those still living.
Keywords_AO: du'uu, deebi'uu, hafuu, hojjachuu
Keywords_EN: dead, return, remain, work, life

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaatu jiruu tuffata malee, jiruun abbaa hin tuffattu
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the person who despises life; life never despises the person.
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi carraa fi madda hojii hundumaaf banaa dha; namatu nuffee ykn dadhabee tuffata malee.
Meaning_EN: It is the person who spurns livelihoods and opportunities; living itself is always willing to sustain anyone.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii tuffachuu fi jireenyatti mufachuu dhiisanii carraaqqii gochuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke those who complain about life or look down on honest work instead of seizing available chances.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, jiruu, tuffachuu, carraa
Keywords_EN: person, life, disdain, opportunity

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyya hoggaa ja'an, kan du'e hin kaafatanii, kan jiru gaafatani
Translation_Literal_EN: When inquiring about a land, one does not ask of the dead, one asks of the living.
Meaning_AO: Haala hawaasaa fi biyya tokkoo hubachuuf namoota har'a jiran fi qabatama ammaa ilaaluun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: When seeking news of a land, one inquires about the living, not the buried; current reality takes precedence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Seenaa darbe qofa dhiisanii haala amma jiru irratti xiyyeeffachuu akka qaban yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to redirect focus onto the immediate living generation and existing realities rather than past relics.
Keywords_AO: biyya, du'aa, jiraachuu, gaafachuu
Keywords_EN: country, dead, living, inquire

Mammaaksa_AO: Du'a dansaa irra, jireenya hamaa wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: A miserable life is better than a fine death.
Meaning_AO: Duuti bareedaan tokkoyyuu hin jiru; rakkoo wajjinillee taatu lubbuun jiraachuun du'a caala.
Meaning_EN: Even a harsh, impoverished life is preferable to death; life always holds inherent worth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina kamuu keessatti lubbuun jiraachuun qooda du'aa akka caalu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to underscore the absolute value of survival and living, no matter how severe the present hardship.
Keywords_AO: du'a, dansaa, jireenya, hamaa, lubbuu
Keywords_EN: death, fine, life, harsh, survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Kabajaan sire, arrabni qore
Translation_Literal_EN: Respect is a bed; a sharp tongue is a thorn.
Meaning_AO: Namoota kabajuun boqonnaa fi nagaa fida, arrabni hamaa garuu madaa fi dhibee uuma.
Meaning_EN: Respect provides resting comfort like a bed, while a sharp, insolent tongue pricks like a thorn.
Usage_Situation_AO: Afaan ofii to'achuun kabajaan nama waliin jiraachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that polite, respectful speech brings comfort while insults cause painful friction.
Keywords_AO: kabajaa, siree, arraba, qore
Keywords_EN: respect, bed, tongue, thorn

Mammaaksa_AO: "Abbaa" ja'anii, "aboo"  hin ja'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: Having called someone "father," one does not say "hey you."
Meaning_AO: Namaaf kabaja erga kennanii booda kabaja sana dhabsiisanii salphisuun sirrii miti.
Meaning_EN: Once you have bestowed high respect upon someone, you must not demote them to disrespectful familiarity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Kabaja maanguddootaa fi namootaaf kenname akka hin hir'isne gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise maintaining consistent reverence toward an elder rather than dropping into insolence.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, aboo, kabajaa, safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: father, hey you, respect, consistency

Mammaaksa_AO: Furdatan illee, nama hin tuffatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if you grow wealthy, you do not despise people.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya, aangoo fi humna qabaatanillee namoota hiyyeeyyii fi dadhaboo tuffachuun sirrii miti.
Meaning_EN: Even if you grow wealthy and influential, you should never look down upon or disdain others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni badhaadhe ykn aangoo argate akka of tuullee nama hin tuffanne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel prosperous individuals to remain humble and respectful toward the less fortunate.
Keywords_AO: furdachuu, nama, tuffachuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: fatten, wealth, despise, humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Waamicha ulfinaa, ooluun salphina
Translation_Literal_EN: Missing an invitation of honor is a disgrace.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo kabajaan nama waaman kabajicha fudhatanii argamuun aadaa fi naamusa gaariidha.
Meaning_EN: Failing to honor a dignified invitation brings shame upon oneself and insults the host.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni kabajaan yoo affeerame sababa quubsaa malee hafuun salphina ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to honor respectful community or family invitations diligently.
Keywords_AO: waamicha, ulfina, ooluu, salphina
Keywords_EN: invitation, honor, absent, disgrace

Mammaaksa_AO: Jiruu fi jaartii soddaa, hin tuffatani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not despise livelihood nor one's mother-in-law.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin jireenyaa fi safeeffannaan soddaa yoomiyyuu kabajamaa ta'uu qaba.
Meaning_EN: One should never despise honest work, nor should one ever show disrespect to one's mother-in-law.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii argatan kamuu kabajuu fi maatii soddaatiif safeeffannaa guddaa qabaachuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach deep reverence for honest labor and absolute traditional modesty toward in-laws.
Keywords_AO: jiruu, jaartii soddaa, tuffachuu, safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: livelihood, mother-in-law, despise, reverence

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabaabbattullee, jaartii soddaa hin tuffatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if she is short, one does not despise a mother-in-law.
Meaning_AO: Dhaabni qaamaa ykn haalli uumamaa akkamillee yoo ta'e ulfinni soddaa hin hir'atu.
Meaning_EN: Regardless of physical diminutive stature, a mother-in-law's traditional authority and honor remain absolute.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bifa ykn dhaabna qaamaa ilaaluun kabajaa maatii soddaa hir'isuun akka hin danda'amne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that external appearances never diminish the solemn respect owed to in-laws.
Keywords_AO: gabaabbachuu, jaartii soddaa, tuffachuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: short, mother-in-law, despise, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma fedhe guddatan, gosa ifii hin dabrani
Translation_Literal_EN: However great one becomes, one does not surpass one's own clan.
Meaning_AO: Namni sadarkaa akkamii irra yoo gahellee eenyummaa, gosaa fi fira ofii irra deemuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: No matter how wealthy or powerful one becomes, one can never outgrow or disregard one's clan roots.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota aangoon ykn qabeenyaan dhiitamanii firaa fi gosa ofii dagataniif gorsa kennuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humble those whose rise in fortune makes them look down upon their clan and origins.
Keywords_AO: guddisa, gosa, dabruu, eenyummaa
Keywords_EN: grow, clan, surpass, identity

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni sii taa'u si hin argine, olkaatuus si hin argu
Translation_Literal_EN: One who ignores you while seated will not notice you when standing.
Meaning_AO: Namni si tuffatee kabaja siif hin qabne haala kamiinuu ulfina siif kennuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Someone predisposed to ignore or belittle you will never acknowledge your worth, whatever you do.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama si tuffate tokko gammachiisuuf ykn biratti mul'achuuf dhama'uun bu'aa akka hin qabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show the futility of seeking recognition or respect from someone who inherently despises you.
Keywords_AO: taa'uu, arguu, olka'uu, tuffii
Keywords_EN: sit, see, stand, disregard

Mammaaksa_AO: Namuu wal sodaateeti bula
Translation_Literal_EN: Everyone lives by respecting and fearing one another.
Meaning_AO: Nageenyi fi walii galiin hawaasa keessaa kan argamu yoo hundi wal kabajee fi wal safeeffatedha.
Meaning_EN: Society survives and prospers because people hold healthy mutual fear, respect, and restraint.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni seeraa fi safuu hawaasaa eeganii wal kabajanii jiraachuu akka qaban yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to state that social coexistence depends on mutual deterrence, respect, and mutual restraint.
Keywords_AO: buluu, sodaachuu, wal-kabajaa, hawaasa
Keywords_EN: live, fear, respect, coexistence

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama guddisuun if guddisuu dha, nama xiqqeessuun if xiqqeessuu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Elevating others elevates oneself; belittling others belittles oneself.
Meaning_AO: Namootaaf ulfina kennuun kabajaa ofii kan dabalu yoo ta'u, orma salphisuun of salphisuudha.
Meaning_EN: Honoring others magnifies your own dignity, while denigrating others only diminishes your own standing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota kaaniif kabaja kennuun mallattoo namummaa fi kabaja ofii ta'uu barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that treating others with high respect reflects and elevates one's own character.
Keywords_AO: guddisuu, xiqqeessuu, kabajaa, ifi
Keywords_EN: elevate, diminish, respect, self

Mammaaksa_AO: Qallatullee, abbuma warraatu dinqa rafa
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if slender, it is the head of the house who sleeps in the inner room.
Meaning_AO: Namni haala kamiin yoo dadhabeyyuu aangoo fi mirga abbummaa mana ofii keessaa hin dhabu.
Meaning_EN: Even if physically frail or impoverished, the master of the house retains the rightful inner chamber and authority.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka fi kabajaa abbaan manaa maatii isaa keessatti qabu eegamuufii akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to uphold the traditional primacy and domestic authority of the head of the household.
Keywords_AO: qallachuu, abbaa warraa, dinqa, rafuu
Keywords_EN: frail, householder, inner room, authority

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan laafullee, hagicha hin taa'u
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if a father is feeble, he does not sit in the ashes.
Meaning_AO: Abbaan ykn maanguddoon hiyyooma ta'us kabajaa fi teessuma isaaf malu hin dhabu.
Meaning_EN: Even if an elder or father has grown frail, he is never relegated to a disgraceful or unworthy seat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Maanguddootaa fi abbootii haala qabatamaa kamiinuu kabaja isaanii eeguufii akka qaban ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to enforce that parents and elders must never be demeaned or denied their seat of honor.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, laafuu, hagicha, taa'uu
Keywords_EN: father, frail, ashes, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Waaqni , abbaa gadaa dura hin deemu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even God does not walk ahead of the Abbaa Gadaa.
Meaning_AO: Seeraa fi heera uumaan qajeelche keessatti hayyuu fi hoogganaan ummataa iddoo olaanaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Under the sacred order, the divinely sanctioned leader commands supreme social legitimacy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aadaa Oromoo keessatti kabajaa fi aangoo sirni Gadaa qabu agarsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used proverbially to convey the profound, sacred authority vested in the elected Gadaa leadership.
Keywords_AO: Waaqa, Abbaa Gadaa, seera, dura deemuu
Keywords_EN: God, Abbaa Gadaa, law, leadership, authority

Mammaaksa_AO: Maqaa ilaaltu hambisi, garaa ilaaltu fixi
Translation_Literal_EN: If mindful of your name, leave some; if mindful only of your belly, finish it.
Meaning_AO: Namni maqaa fi safuu ofii eeggatu qusannaa qabaata, kan dantaa garaa qofa hordofu garuu salphata.
Meaning_EN: If you care about your reputation and dignity, practice restraint; if you care only for your belly, devour it all.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nyaata fi dantaa irratti of qusachuun kabajaa namaa akka eegu gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge table manners, dignity, and moderation over greedy self-indulgence that harms honor.
Keywords_AO: maqaa, hambisuu, garaa, fixuu
Keywords_EN: reputation, leave, stomach, consume, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin dhiirsa ishii malee kan biraa goota hin seetu
Translation_Literal_EN: A wife thinks no one is a hero except her husband.
Meaning_AO: Jaalallii fi kabajni haadha manaa abbaa manaa isiitiif qabdu nama biraa caalchisee akka ilaaltu taasisa.
Meaning_EN: Out of devotion and respect, a loyal wife perceives her own husband as the greatest of heroes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haati manaa abbaa manaa isheef ilaalcha olaanaa fi kabaja addaa qabaachuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the singular admiration and loyalty a faithful wife holds toward her husband.
Keywords_AO: niitii, dhiirsa, goota, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: wife, husband, hero, devotion

Mammaaksa_AO: Waamichi tolu, owwaannaan tola
Translation_Literal_EN: When the call is pleasant, the answer is pleasant.
Meaning_AO: Haalli namatti dubbatan fi waaman yoo tole, deebiin argamus kabajaa fi mi'aawaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: When an approach or invitation is polite and respectful, the response received is equally gracious.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namootatti gaarummaan dhihaachuun deebii gaarii akka argamsiisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that gentle, courteous speech naturally invites a warm, cooperative response.
Keywords_AO: waamicha, toluu, owwaachuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: call, pleasant, answer, courtesy

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma isiitti, injireen gaafa qabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: Within its own measure, even a louse has horns.
Meaning_AO: Uumamni xiqqoonis ta'ee namni hiyyeessi hanga humna isaatti kabajaa fi of ittisa mataa isaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Even within its minute scale, a louse has its own horns; every being possesses intrinsic dignity and defense.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta ykn nama xiqqaa ta'e tokko akka laayyootti tuffachuun dogoggora ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against underestimating the pride, defense, or dignity of even the smallest person.
Keywords_AO: hamma, injiree, gaafa, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: size, louse, horn, pride, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhagaan gaayyaa, xinnaa hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: The pipe-stone knows no small size.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan ykn namni bakka murteessaa irratti tajaajilu xinnaachus gatii guddaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: The pipe-stone knows no insignificant size; essential elements are priceless regardless of smallness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti xiqqoon bakka hojii guddaa qabdutti tuffatamuu akka hin qabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that vital components cannot be discounted or deemed small when functioning indispensably.
Keywords_AO: dhagaa, gaayyaa, xinnaa, faayidaa
Keywords_EN: stone, pipe, small, essential value

Mammaaksa_AO: Bilisa maddi dhawan malee isa hin dhawan
Translation_Literal_EN: One can strike near a free man, but one does not strike him directly.
Meaning_AO: Nama bilisaa fi kabajamaa ta'e salphisuun fi qaamaan tuquun safuu cabsuudha.
Meaning_EN: A free man's bodily dignity is inviolable; one may gesture near him, but striking him directly breaches honor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mirga fi kabajaa namni bilisummaa qabu qabu eeguu fi salphina irraa of eeggachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to invoke customary protection for the inviolable bodily honor of free men in traditional society.
