Keywords_EN: free man, strike, flank, inviolability

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni warra qabu, gosa qaba
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who has family has a clan.
Meaning_AO: Maatii cimaa qabaachuun bu'uura walitti dhufeenya gosaa fi hawaasummaa bal'aati.
Meaning_EN: One who is grounded in a strong, respected family naturally commands the backing of the wider clan.
Theme_EN: Family Support as Basis of Clan Power
Usage_Situation_AO: Maatiin madda kabajaa fi gargaarsa hawaasummaa ta'uu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that clan solidarity and social influence start directly from solid household roots.
Keywords_AO: nama, warra, gosa, qabaachuu
Keywords_EN: person, family, clan, solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Arrii, azaabnilleen ni sodaata
Translation_Literal_EN: Even the abyss of torment fears gray hair.
Meaning_AO: Maanguddummaa fi arriin bakka hundatti kabajaa fi safeeffannaa olaanaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Even the abyss respects gray hair; venerable age commands fear and reverence in every realm.
Usage_Situation_AO: Maanguddoota arrii qabaniif kabaja guddaa kennuu akka qaban yeroo yaadachiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demand utter deference and respect toward elderly persons endowed with gray hair.
Keywords_AO: arrii, azaaba, sodaachuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: gray hair, hell, fear, elder reverence

Mammaaksa_AO: Hammaattullee, dubbii jaarsaa hin tuffatan
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if harsh, one does not despise the word of an elder.
Meaning_AO: Gorsi maanguddootaa yoo hadhaayellee dhugaa fi bu'aa guddaa waan qabuuf tuffatamuu hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Even if an elder's counsel stings or seems severe, one must never disregard their seasoned wisdom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gorsa abbootii fi jaarsolii kabajaan fudhachuun akka barbaachisu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct younger generations to heed harsh elder advice, knowing it is intended for their guidance.
Keywords_AO: hammaachuu, dubbii, jaarsa, tuffachuu
Keywords_EN: harsh, counsel, elder, disregard

Mammaaksa_AO: Walillee jibban, wal hin tuffatan
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if they hate each other, they do not despise each other.
Meaning_AO: Diinummaan jiraatus namoota jidduutti kabajaa fi safeeffannaan namummaa eegamuu qaba.
Meaning_EN: Even where animosity exists, basic mutual respect and recognition of human dignity must be maintained.
Usage_Situation_AO: Lolli ykn jibbansi yoo uumameluu namummaa walii tuffachuu irraa akka of qusatan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to maintain customary codes of conduct ensuring that conflict never descends into contemptuous degradation.
Keywords_AO: jibbuu, tuffachuu, kabajaa, safuu
Keywords_EN: hate, despise, mutual respect, boundary

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen qe'ee ifiitti nama hin nyaattu
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog does not bite a person in its own homestead.
Meaning_AO: Bakka ofiitti keessummaa fi nama dhufe miidhuu dhiisanii safeeffannaa fi aadaa keessummeessuu eeguu.
Meaning_EN: Even a dog exercises restraint and does not bite visitors within its own home; hospitality obligates forbearance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mana ofiitti keessummaa ykn nama kamuu salphisuun safuu ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind individuals that host etiquette forbids aggression or insult against anyone entering their gates.
Keywords_AO: saree, qe'ee, nyaachuu, keessummaa
Keywords_EN: dog, homestead, bite, hospitality

Mammaaksa_AO: Soddaan sodaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: An in-law is reverence.
Meaning_AO: Walitti dhufeenyi maatii soddaa guutummaatti kabajaa, safeeffannaa fi of eeggannoo irratti kan bu'uureffame ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: In-laws embody solemn reverence and modesty; distance and deep respect are sacred duties.
Usage_Situation_AO: Soddaa waliin yeroo hundumaa kabajaan jiraachuu akka qaban gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a fundamental rule to underscore that relations with in-laws are defined by sacred respect and modesty.
Keywords_AO: soddaa, sodaa, kabajaa, safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: in-law, fear, reverence, etiquette

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsi du'aaf deemu si hin abaarin
Translation_Literal_EN: Let not an elder on the verge of dying curse you.
Meaning_AO: Abaarsi maanguddoo gara dhuma jireenyaa jiru balaa guddaa waan qabuuf isaan mufachiisuu irraa of eeggachuu.
Meaning_EN: Avoid at all costs provoking the curse of an elder on their deathbed, for their parting words carry immense weight.
Usage_Situation_AO: Maanguddoota du'aaf dhiyaatan tajaajiluu fi gammachiisanii eebba fudhachuu akka qaban gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instill solemn fear of crossing frail elders whose dying grievances bring devastating misfortune.
Keywords_AO: jaarsa, du'aa deemuu, abaaruu, eebba
Keywords_EN: elder, dying, curse, blessing

Mammaaksa_AO: Kabajaa balbalaa, andaaqqoon gadi jetti
Translation_Literal_EN: Out of respect for the doorway, the chicken ducks its head.
Meaning_AO: Manaa fi hawaasa kamuu keessatti safuu fi kabajaa jiruuf jedhanii gad of deebisuun uumama gaariidha.
Meaning_EN: Out of instinctive deference to the portal, even the hen bows its head; showing humility before boundaries is virtue.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka kabajamaa seenuu fi nama kabajamaa biratti gad of qabuu barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that lowering oneself respectfully when entering sacred or honorable spaces is refined conduct.
Keywords_AO: kabajaa, balbala, andaaqqoo, gadi jechuu
Keywords_EN: respect, doorway, chicken, bow, humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka itti dhalattetti, buqqeen dhaga cabsiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Where it sprouted, a gourd can break a stone.
Meaning_AO: Bakka dhalootaa fi gosa ofii keessatti namni hiyyeessa ykn dadhabaa ta'us humnaa fi kabajaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: In its native soil where it sprouted, even a fragile gourd can crack a stone; home turf grants innate strength.
Usage_Situation_AO: Biyya ofii fi qe'ee ofiitti dhiibbaa fi kabajaa qabaachuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire pride and confidence that being rooted in one's native ground confers unique power.
Keywords_AO: dhalachuu, buqqee, dhagaa, cabsuu
Keywords_EN: sprout, gourd, stone, break, home power

Mammaaksa_AO: Saree nama jala deemtu, abbaaf dhaban
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog walking behind a person is spared for its master.
Meaning_AO: Nama dhiibbaa qabu ykn kabajamaa ta'eef jedhanii nama isa duukaa bu'uufis obsa fi kabaja agarsiisuu.
Meaning_EN: One refrains from striking a companion dog solely out of respect for the dignity of its master.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama tokko kabajuuf jedhanii nama isa bira jiruufis nagaa fi obsa kennuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when extending forbearance to an annoying subordinate or dependent purely out of high esteem for their patron.
Keywords_AO: saree, deemuu, abbaa, dhabuu
Keywords_EN: dog, follow, owner, spare, respect

Mammaaksa_AO: Wayyaatu soddaa qaba, nama qaanfatuutu kabajaa qaba
Translation_Literal_EN: It is clothing that honors in-laws; it is the modest person who commands dignity.
Meaning_AO: Uffannaan safeeffannaa maatii soddaa eega, namni safuu fi qaanii qabus kabajamaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Proper dress maintains sacred modesty before in-laws, and one who preserves moral shame earns enduring respect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qaanii fi safeeffannaa qabaachuun madda kabajaa fi ulfinaa ta'uu barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that cultivating a sense of shame, modesty, and proper attire is the true foundation of dignity.
Keywords_AO: wayyaa, soddaa, qaanfachuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: clothes, in-law, shame, modesty, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana balbala malee hin seenani, utubaa bakka malee hin dhaabani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not enter a house without a door, nor erect a pillar out of place.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hundi seera, tartiiba fi iddoo mataa isaa qaba; seeraan ala socho'uun badii fida.
Meaning_EN: Everything has its proper procedure, order, and position; acting disorderly brings failure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii fi jireenya keessatti heeraa fi tartiiba eeganii deemuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that all actions must adhere strictly to established procedure and proper boundaries.
Keywords_AO: mana, balbala, utubaa, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: house, door, pillar, order, protocol

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana balbalaan seenani
Translation_Literal_EN: One enters a house through the door.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma kamuu karaa sirrii, ifa ta'ee fi seera qabeessaan qabachuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: One approaches matters through the proper, direct, and legitimate channel.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma tokko karaa dhokataa fi jal'aadhaan dhiyeessuu dhiisanii karaa ifaa hordofuu akka qaban ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone to address an issue openly through legitimate and proper channels.
Keywords_AO: mana, balbala, seenuu, seera
Keywords_EN: house, door, enter, proper channel

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo akkaan ol fuudhan, gaarallee ol fuudhani
Translation_Literal_EN: If lifted with concerted might, even a mountain can be lifted.
Meaning_AO: Humni, tokkummaan fi carraaqqiin guddaan yoo dabalame wanta ulfaataa ta'ellee raawwachuun ni danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: With overwhelming collective effort, determination, and unity, even a mountain can be moved.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojiin ulfaataan yoo namni waliigalee fi jabaatee ka'e akka danda'amu jajjabeessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to motivate people that united willpower and extraordinary effort can overcome immense obstacles.
Keywords_AO: ol fuudhuu, gaara, humna, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: lift up, mountain, power, unity

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo akka malee ol fuudhan, Mixiinuu duuyda nama kutti
Translation_Literal_EN: If lifted improperly, even an ant will snap one's back.
Meaning_AO: Wanta xiqqaa ta'ellee yoo seeraan ala ulfeessan ykn qabatanii garmalee ol kaasan miidhaa fida.
Meaning_EN: If handled improperly or exaggerated beyond measure, even the smallest burden will break your back.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan tokko hamma isaatii olitti ulfeessuu ykn qabiinsa sirrii dhabuun akka nama miidhu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that magnifying a minor issue or handling it inappropriately turns it into a crippling burden.
Keywords_AO: akka malee, ol fuudhuu, mixii, duyda
Keywords_EN: excessively, lift, ant, back, strain

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan jiru biraa, mallaa hin dhungatani
Translation_Literal_EN: While the mouth is right there, one does not kiss the cheek.
Meaning_AO: Wanta dura dhiyaatee fi ijoo ta'e dhiisanii wanta cinaa fi gadi aanaatti goruun sirrii miti.
Meaning_EN: When the direct and essential option is right in front of you, you do not divert to secondary substitutes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma kallattiidhaan ilaalamuu qabu dhiisanii moggaatti naanna'uu balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise addressing primary matters directly rather than circumventing through secondary alternatives.
Keywords_AO: afaan, mallaa, dhungachuu, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: mouth, cheek, kiss, directness, priority

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan jiru biraa, afaa hin haadhani
Translation_Literal_EN: While the mouth is present, one does not sweep the mat.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma afaaniin mari'atanii furuun osoo danda'amu waan alaa fi dallaa irratti qorqoruun gatii hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: While the principal party is available to speak, one does not busy oneself with peripheral trivialities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Abbaa dubbii wajjin ifatti dubbachuu dhiisanii waan biraa keessa naanna'uu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demand speaking directly with the person in charge rather than wasting time on side issues.
Keywords_AO: afaan, afaa, haadhuu, marii
Keywords_EN: mouth, mat, sweep, direct talk

Mammaaksa_AO: Jinnii akkuma heera isiitti sagadaniif
Translation_Literal_EN: One bows to a jinn according to its own custom.
Meaning_AO: Nama ykn haala kamuu amala, aadaa fi heera isaatiin dhihaatanii waliin jiraachuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: One deals with different powers or temperaments strictly according to their specific customs and rules.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota amala rakkisaa qaban heera fi bifa isaaniitiin qabatanii deemsisuuf gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise practical diplomacy, treating each unpredictable person or authority by their own playbook.
Keywords_AO: jinnii, heera, sagaduu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: jinn, custom, bow, diplomacy, tact

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama gad godhatee nyaatu, ciisaniiti kajeelan
Translation_Literal_EN: One craves lying down what a person eats bent low.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan qabu dhoksee fi qusatee nyaatu, warra of saaxilanii kajeelaniif hawwii ta'a.
Meaning_EN: One envies in longing the quiet sustenance that another consumes discreetly and without ostentation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta ofii dhoksanii fi seeraan itti fayyadaman namoota biratti akka hawwamu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe how modest, private enjoyment avoids waste while attracting the covert envy of onlookers.
Keywords_AO: gad godhachuu, nyaachuu, ciisuu, kajeeluu
Keywords_EN: bend low, eat, lie down, covet, discretion

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan olii gad yaa'a
Translation_Literal_EN: Water flows from uphill to downhill.
Meaning_AO: Seerri uumamaa fi tartiibni jireenyaa yoomiyyuu qajeeltoo uumamaa hordofee deema.
Meaning_EN: Water naturally flows downhill; natural hierarchy and the universal order of things cannot be inverted.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta uumamaan ta'uu qabu fi tartiiba hin jijjiiramne ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert the immutable flow of natural hierarchy, cause-and-effect, and traditional social order.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, ol, gad, yaa'uu, seera
Keywords_EN: water, uphill, downhill, flow, natural law

Mammaaksa_AO: Muka jalaa ol koran malee, gubbaa gad hin koran
Translation_Literal_EN: One climbs a tree from bottom to top, not from top to bottom.
Meaning_AO: Guddinni, beekumsi fi hojiin kamuu bu'uura irraa suuta suutaan gara gubbaatti kan ijaaramuudha.
Meaning_EN: One ascends a tree from the roots upward, not downward; progress and mastery require sequential steps.
Usage_Situation_AO: Sadarkaa guddinaa fi hojii keessatti utaalcha malee tartiiba eeguun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct that achieving success or understanding requires following progressive, bottom-up stages.
Keywords_AO: muka, jala, ol koruu, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: tree, bottom, climb, upward, sequential

Mammaaksa_AO: Qilbaa dhiisanii, waa kiibbati hin salaatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Turning away from the Qibla, one does not pray toward the south.
Meaning_AO: Kallattii fi qajeeltoo sirrii dhiisanii karaa faallaa fi sobaa hordofuun fudhatama hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Abandoning the true direction, one does not pray toward an arbitrary orientation; deviation brings invalidity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota karaa sirrii fi dhugaa dhiisanii faallaa deemsaatiin murteessan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn turning away from the known, correct standard to adopt a false or misguided direction.
Keywords_AO: qilbaa, dhiisuu, kiibba, salaatuu
Keywords_EN: Qibla, abandon, south, pray, orientation

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'a ganni ajjeese, waraabeessi maqaa itti fuudhe
Translation_Literal_EN: The cow killed by winter, the hyena got blamed for.
Meaning_AO: Badii ykn balaa uumamaatiin dhufe tokko namuma duraanuu maqaan isaa badetti laachuun himachuu.
Meaning_EN: The cow that died from harsh weather is blamed on the hyena; an already notorious party takes the fall.
Usage_Situation_AO: Badii namni biraan uume nama duraanuu shakkiin irratti jiruutti yoo kuffisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an already unpopular person or scapegoat is blamed for damages they did not cause.
Keywords_AO: sa'a, ganna, waraabessa, maqaa
Keywords_EN: cow, winter, hyena, blame, scapegoat

Mammaaksa_AO: Ofii daddabanii, Rabbi hin sakkabani
Translation_Literal_EN: Failing through one's own weakness, one does not blame God.
Meaning_AO: Hanqinaa fi dadhabina ofiitiin kufee sababa uumuu fi waaqa komachuun sirrii miti.
Meaning_EN: Failing through one's own laziness or incompetence, one should not blame God or fate.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota dogoggora ofiitiin miidhamanii Rabbiin ykn carraa komatan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand those who attribute the consequences of their own laziness to divine destiny.
Keywords_AO: dadhabuu, Rabbi, komachuu, itti-gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: fail, God, blame, responsibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Ofii hammaatanii, nama hin hammeeysani
Translation_Literal_EN: Being wicked oneself, one does not slander others.
Meaning_AO: Ofii amala badaa qabaatanii namoota qulqulluu fi gaarii ta'an xureessuun ykn komachuun dhorkaa ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Having moral defects oneself, one has no right to slander, corrupt, or blame others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota ofii isaaniiyyuu hanqina qabanii nama biraa komachuuf ariifatan akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise hypocrites to examine their own moral failings before pointing fingers at others.
Keywords_AO: hammaachuu, nama, hammeessuu, naamusa
Keywords_EN: wicked, slander, corrupt, hypocrisy

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan Miha(meeshaa) nyaate hantuutaa, raachi garaa guddinaaf duuti
Translation_Literal_EN: The mouse ate the leather, but the frog dies for its big belly.
Meaning_AO: Badii nama biraatiif namni qulqulluun bifa ykn haala uumama isaatiin shakkamee miidhamuu.
Meaning_EN: The mouse ate the leather, yet the frog gets killed just for having a swollen belly; circumstantial blame.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni qulqulluun osoo hin balleessin bifa ykn teessuma isaatiin badii ormaatiif yoo adabamu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an innocent person is wrongfully punished for another's crime simply because of appearance.
Keywords_AO: hantuuta, raacha, garaa, du'uu, loogii
Keywords_EN: mouse, frog, belly, death, scapegoat

Mammaaksa_AO: "UUF" je'e kan harree dhaanee dhuufe
Translation_Literal_EN: "Ugh!" exclaimed the one who beat his donkey and farted.
Meaning_AO: Badii ofiitiin qaana'uu dhiisanii akka waan namni biraa balleesseetti of mul'isuuf yaaluu.
Meaning_EN: Making a disgusted sound to deflect attention from a disgraceful blunder that one committed oneself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ofii balleessaa uumee akka waan nama biraatiin dhufeetti sobaan mufatu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize someone who loudly feigns disgust to cover up their own embarrassing misbehavior.
Keywords_AO: harree, dhaanuu, dhuufuu, uuf jechuu
Keywords_EN: donkey, beat, fart, feign disgust

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysi nyaatu tokkumaa, hunda maqaan bade
Translation_Literal_EN: It is one hyena that eats, but the reputation of all is ruined.
Meaning_AO: Balleessaa namni tokko raawwateen maatiin, gosti ykn gareen guutuun maqaa xuraa'uu.
Meaning_EN: One hyena scavenges, but the entire pack gets a bad name; collective stigma from individual fault.
Usage_Situation_AO: Badii nama tokkootti ka'anii garee ykn gosa guutuu balaaleffachuu yeroo morman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament how the misconduct of a single individual tarnishes the collective name of a group.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, nyaachuu, maqaa, baduu
Keywords_EN: hyena, eat, reputation, collective blame

Mammaaksa_AO: "Ana maqaa balleeysuuf, Harree alatti dhiisani" je'e, waraabeesi
Translation_Literal_EN: "Just to ruin my reputation, they left the donkey outside," said the hyena.
Meaning_AO: Hattuun ykn namni hammeenya hojjetu sababa uumuun miidhaa ofii fi fedhii ofiif qooda qulqulluu fakkaachuu.
Meaning_EN: "They left the donkey out just to frame me," said the hyena; the predator rationalizing its crime as victimhood.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota badii ifa ta'e hojjetanii akka waan ormi itti yaadee isaan qoreetti of qulqulleessan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock wrongdoers who brazenly play the victim when confronted with the temptations they devoured.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, harree, maqaa balleessuu, sababa
Keywords_EN: hyena, donkey, reputation, playing victim

Mammaaksa_AO: "Aannan banaa dhiisaniiti, hattuu namaan ja'anii" jette, adurreen
Translation_Literal_EN: "They leave the milk uncovered and call one a thief," said the cat.
Meaning_AO: Wanta ofii eeggachuu dadhabanii banaa dhiisaniif orma qoruu fi hannaaf saaxilanii komachuu.
Meaning_EN: "Leaving milk uncovered and then labeling people thieves," said the cat; careless owners invite theft.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya ofii osoo hin eeggatin dhiisanii nama dogoggore irratti qofa komii baay'isuu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize careless individuals whose complete lack of precautions invites theft and wrongdoing.
Keywords_AO: aannan, banaa, hattuu, adurree
Keywords_EN: milk, uncovered, thief, cat, temptation

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka sareen jirtutti, nama dhuufe hin gaafatan
Translation_Literal_EN: Where a dog is present, one does not ask who farted.
Meaning_AO: Bakka wanti salphaatti itti sababeessan jirutti namni badii ofii dhokfatee gara biraatti qajeelchuuf qophaa'a.
Meaning_EN: In the presence of a dog, no one asks who passed gas; a convenient scapegoat is always blamed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balleessaa ofii nama ykn uumama biraa kan of ittisuu hin dandeenyetti dabarfatanii of baasan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humorously describe how people immediately pin embarrassing slip-ups onto helpless scapegoats.
Keywords_AO: saree, dhuufuu, gaafachuu, sababa
Keywords_EN: dog, fart, ask, convenient scapegoat

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirsi dhuufee, "barana tanuma biyyatti buuse" jennaan "tana sumatti buusee, biyyaaf nagaya buuse," jetteen, niitiin
Translation_Literal_EN: When the husband farted and said, "This year I brought this calamity upon the land," the wife replied, "He brought it upon himself, and brought peace to the land."
Meaning_AO: Badii fi qaanii ofii akka waan dhimma guddaa biyyaatti uumuu fakkeessanii of jajaniif deebii sirrii kennanii salphisuu.
Meaning_EN: Rebuking a boastful spouse who turns a petty, vulgar personal fault into grand, pretentious rhetoric.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama badii fi salphina ofii guddisee akka waan waan guddaa hojjetetti of ibsu afaan qabsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to deflate arrogant or pretentious rationalizations of shameful personal conduct with sharp wit.
Keywords_AO: dhiirsa, niitii, dhuufuu, biyya, nagaya
Keywords_EN: husband, wife, fart, pretension, sharp retort

Mammaaksa_AO: Walii qaceelaniiti, Rabbi kajeelani
Translation_Literal_EN: One acts uprightly toward fellows, then looks in hope to God.
Meaning_AO: Eebbaa fi araara Waaqayyoo argachuuf dura namoota waliin qajeelummaa fi jaalalaan jiraachuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: One must first deal justly and uprightly with fellow human beings before hoping for God's blessings and favor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota miidhaa irraan gahanii Rabbiin kadhachuun gatii akka hin qabne barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that prayer and divine favor are meaningless without genuine justice and kindness toward others.
Keywords_AO: qajeeluu, Rabbi, kajeeluu, dhugaa
Keywords_EN: upright, God, hope, justice, divine favor

Mammaaksa_AO: Kijibaan, nama gobeensa akaafu
Translation_Literal_EN: A liar is like someone roasting porcupine quills.
Meaning_AO: Kijibaan wanta bu'aa hin qabnee fi hin nyaatamne odeessuun yeroo ofii fi kan namaa gubaa.
Meaning_EN: A liar produces nothing of genuine substance, just like roasting inedible, prickly quills.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduu sobaa kan faayidaa hin qabne afarsuun nama qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to disparage a liar whose elaborate fabrications produce nothing of value.
Keywords_AO: kijibaa, gobeensa, akaafuu, soba
Keywords_EN: liar, roasting, quills, futility

Mammaaksa_AO: Kijibni nama oolcha malee, nama hin bulchu
Translation_Literal_EN: A lie gets one through the day, but does not sustain overnight.
Meaning_AO: Sobni yeroo gabaabaaf nama baasu danda'us dheerina keessatti salphina fi balaa fida.
Meaning_EN: A lie may provide brief, temporary escape, but it cannot offer enduring security.
Theme_EN: Transience of Lies vs. Enduring Truth
Usage_Situation_AO: Sobaan yeroo gabaabaaf milkaa'uun dhumarratti qaanitti akka geessu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that deceit offers only fleeting relief and inevitably unravels over time.
Keywords_AO: kijiba, oolchuu, bulchuu, soba
Keywords_EN: lie, day, night, transience

Mammaaksa_AO: Kijibni karaa nama dabarsa malee, galti qoronfilaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: A lie crosses the path, but homecoming brings thorns.
Meaning_AO: Sobdani wanta tokko yoo darbanillee bu'aan dhumaa salphinaa fi miidhaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: A lie may get you past a checkpoint, but your return home will be met with thorns and shame.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota sobaan dhimma isaanii geggeeffatan booddeeni isaanii akka hamaa ta'u gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution that using lies to navigate difficulties leaves a trail of bitter reckoning.
Keywords_AO: kijiba, karaa, dabarsuu, galta, qoronfilaa
Keywords_EN: lie, road, return, thorns, reckoning

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaa sobaan dabran, gala debiin nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: The road traversed with lies makes the return journey hard.
Meaning_AO: Nama sobdanii bira darban gaafa deebitanii arguuf deemtan qaaniin nama dhoowwa.
Meaning_EN: Deceiving people along the road makes it impossible to face them on your journey back.
Usage_Situation_AO: Sobaan firaa fi karaa ofii cufuu akka hin qabne namatti himuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against burning one's bridges through dishonesty, making future contact unbearable.
Keywords_AO: karaa, soba, dabruu, deebii, qaanii
Keywords_EN: road, lie, cross, return, shame

Mammaaksa_AO: Goda kijibaa, takka malee lama hin bulan
Translation_Literal_EN: In the valley of lies, one spends only a single night.
Meaning_AO: Sobni takkaaf nama gowwomsuu danda'a malee lammata hin hojjetu.
Meaning_EN: You can deceive someone once with a lie, but you will never succeed in tricking them a second time.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni sobaan nama gowwomsu lammata akka amanamummaa hin arganne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to state that a liar burns their credibility and cannot dupe the same person twice.
Keywords_AO: goda, kijiba, takka, lama, buluu
Keywords_EN: valley, lie, once, twice, credibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Sobni hin coomu
Translation_Literal_EN: A lie never fattens into substance.
Meaning_AO: Sobni bu'aa qabatamaa, guddina dhugaa fi qabeenya itti fufiinsa qabu hin argamsiisu.
Meaning_EN: Lies never fatten into true substance; dishonesty yields no lasting prosperity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Sobaan sooromuun ykn milkaa'uun akka hin danda'amne yeroo mirkaneessan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express that ill-gotten gains through deceit have no real permanence or nourishment.
Keywords_AO: soba, coomuu, dhugaa, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: lie, fatten, nourish, substance

Mammaaksa_AO: Kunoo arba gama jennaan, jala ilmaan jette
Translation_Literal_EN: When told "An elephant across," she added "And a calf underneath!"
Meaning_AO: Oduu sobaa fi garmalee guddisame irratti soba dabalataa itti dabalanii odeessuu.
Meaning_EN: Hearing an already exaggerated tall tale, a bigger liar chimes in with an even more absurd embellishment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota oduu sobaa fi afaanumaan guddifamu irratti wanta hin jirre dabalan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize compulsive exaggerators who escalate each other's ridiculous lies.
Keywords_AO: arba, gama, ilmoo, soba, guddisuu
Keywords_EN: elephant, across, calf, exaggeration, tall tale

Mammaaksa_AO: " Gama xaafii tuman" jennaan "kunoo habaqni isaa ija na bu'e" jette
Translation_Literal_EN: Told "They thrash teff across," she said "Its chaff just hit my eye!"
Meaning_AO: Oduu sobaa nama biraa fiiganii qabatanii soba biraatiin mirkaneessuuf dhama'uu.
Meaning_EN: Hearing a rumor of distant threshing, she claimed the flying chaff hit her eye; absurd collusion in lies.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota soba ifa ta'e deggeruuf soba dabalataa uuman qaanlessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock individuals who concoct ridiculous personal anecdotes to support blatant lies.
Keywords_AO: gama, xaafii, habaqa, ija, soba
Keywords_EN: across, teff, chaff, eye, ridiculous lie

Mammaaksa_AO: Kijibaa arbi hin nyaatu, ulateeti bira dabra
Translation_Literal_EN: An elephant does not eat a liar; it sniffs him and walks on.
Meaning_AO: Namni sobdun uumama hundaan tuffatamaa fi balfamaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Even an elephant finds a liar too repulsive to touch, merely sniffing and moving past in disgust.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni kijibaa akka malee kan tuffatamu fi jibbamu ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express total contempt for chronic liars, remarking that even wild beasts shun them.
Keywords_AO: kijibaa, arba, nyaachuu, uufachuu, ulatuu
Keywords_EN: liar, elephant, sniff, contempt

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni hiriyaan biraa dhumte, sobuu hin saalfatu
Translation_Literal_EN: One whose peers have all died feels no shame in lying.
Meaning_AO: Namni ragaan duraanii jalaa dhabame seenaa fi dubbii jijjiiree of jajuuf sobuu hin sodaatu.
Meaning_EN: Someone whose generational peers have died lies boldly without shame, knowing no witnesses remain.
Theme_EN: Brazen Lies in Absence of Witnesses
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota yeroo nama ragaa bahu dhaban seenaa sobaatiin of jajan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to call out isolated persons fabricating grandiose personal history when no peers remain to challenge them.
Keywords_AO: hiriyaa, dhumuu, sobuu, saalfachuu
Keywords_EN: peer, demise, lie, shamelessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin sobaa, dhaga huba
Translation_Literal_EN: Words of falsehood can harm even a stone.
Meaning_AO: Sobni fi oduun sobaa dhiibbaa fi balaa hamaa waan hunda mancaasu fiduu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Malicious falsehood is so corrosive and damaging that it can wear away even solid rock.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduun sobaa fi arrabni sobdootaa balaa hangam guddaa qabaachuu danda'u ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against the deadly, corrosive consequences of lies and slander.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, sobaa, dhagaa, hubuu
Keywords_EN: words, lie, stone, harm, destructive

Mammaaksa_AO: Horiin kijibaa, nama qaanessa
Translation_Literal_EN: Wealth acquired through deceit brings public shame.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi sobaan, hatuun ykn gowwomsaan argame dhumarratti salphina qofa fida.
Meaning_EN: Property gained through dishonesty and fraud ultimately exposes the possessor to disgrace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota sobaan qabeenya argachuu barbaadan gorfachuu fi akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that ill-gotten gains derived from lies inevitably end in public humiliation.
Keywords_AO: horii, kijiba, qaaneysuu, salphina
Keywords_EN: wealth, lie, shame, dishonor

Mammaaksa_AO: Reebuun dharaa ni beeksisa
Translation_Literal_EN: Excessive whipping exposes the false accusation.
Meaning_AO: Wanta sobaa mirkaneessuuf humnaan reebuu fi dhiibuun dhugaan akka ifatti baatu taasisa.
Meaning_EN: Excessive torture or blustering interrogation reveals that the underlying accusation is baseless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balleessaa sobaa humnaan namatti fe'uuf tattaaffachuun ofumaan dhara ta'uu isaa akka saaxilu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that when accusers resort to brutal over-coercion, it betrays the falsity of their case.
Keywords_AO: reebuu, dhara, beeksisuu, haqa
Keywords_EN: whip, falsehood, expose, coercion

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin dhugaa gaggabaabaa dha, dubbiin soba dhedheeraa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Words of truth are short; words of falsehood are long.
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan ifaafi salphaa yoo taatu, soba uumuuf garuu odeeffannoo fi sababa dheereffachuu barbaada.
Meaning_EN: Truth is concise and direct, whereas falsehood requires endless explanations and winding words.
Theme_EN: Conciseness of Truth vs. Tangled Lies
Usage_Situation_AO: Osoo hin xaxin dhugaa ifatti dubbachuun akka wayyu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to differentiate honest testimony from the elaborate, convoluted excuses of liars.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, dhugaa, gabaabaa, soba, dheeraa
Keywords_EN: words, truth, short, lie, long

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabessi  "mukarraa bu'i si hin tuquu"  jennaan "si hin tuquu kana maaltu fide" jette ,jeedalloon
Translation_Literal_EN: When the hyena said "Come down, I won't touch you," the fox asked "What brought up 'I won't touch you'?"
Meaning_AO: Waadaa diinaa shakkisiisaa ta'e daddafanii amanuu dhiisuun of eeggannoo gochuu.
Meaning_EN: Unprompted reassurances of safety from a predator only confirm its underlying malicious intent.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waadaa sobaa diinni namaaf seenu amanuu dhabuu fi dammaqinaan deebii kennuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an adversary's sudden sweet promises arouse justifiable suspicion instead of trust.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, jeedalloo, mukarraa bu'uu, waadaa
Keywords_EN: hyena, fox, tree, promise, suspicion

Mammaaksa_AO: Sobduu fi galaanni lakkuma bulaniin sablatan
Translation_Literal_EN: A liar and a river recede as the days pass.
Meaning_AO: Sobni fi bishaan dhangala'e yeroo booda hir'atee dhugaan qullatti baha.
Meaning_EN: Just as floodwaters recede with time, a liar's pretensions wither and get completely exposed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Sobduun yeroon booda salphatee dhabamuu isaa ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure that no matter how grandiose a liar's schemes appear, time inevitably deflates them.
Keywords_AO: sobduu, galaana, buluu, sablachuu
Keywords_EN: liar, river, recede, expose, time

Mammaaksa_AO: Kijibaan torba dafqa
Translation_Literal_EN: A liar sweats seven times over.
Meaning_AO: Namni sobu soba isaa dhoksuufi mirkaneessuuf dhiphinaa fi naasuu guddaa keessa gala.
Meaning_EN: A liar breaks into a cold sweat repeatedly, tortured by the constant terror of exposure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni sobe hangam qorqalbii dhabee dhiphachaa akka jiru ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the visible nervous agitation and fear of discovery that plague a liar.
Keywords_AO: kijibaa, torba, dafquu, dhiphina
Keywords_EN: liar, seven, sweat, anxiety

Mammaaksa_AO: Kjiibaan sagal kakata
Translation_Literal_EN: A liar swears an oath nine times.
Meaning_AO: Namni sobdun wanta sobaa amansiisuuf kakuu baay'isa malee dhugaan kakuu hedduu hin barbaadu.
Meaning_EN: A liar multiplies desperate oaths; an honest person needs no excessive swearing to be believed.
Theme_EN: Excessive Swearing as Sign of Lying
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni yeroo kakuu daddabalutti shakkiin akka irratti heddummaatu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to identify dishonesty, noting that people who swear incessantly are almost certainly lying.
Keywords_AO: kijibaa, sagal, kakachuu, soba
Keywords_EN: liar, nine, swear oath, dishonesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni soba baayyisaa, kakachuu keessa amala isaa beeksisa
Translation_Literal_EN: One who lies often reveals their character through swearing.
Meaning_AO: Kakuu baay'isuun soba dhoksuuf osoo hin taane eenyummaa sobdummaa ofii calaqqisiisa.
Meaning_EN: Chronic lying and frantic oath-taking only serve to expose one's untrustworthy character.
Usage_Situation_AO: Kakuun baay'atu amanamummaa dhabuu akka agarsiisu yeroo barsiisan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that relying heavily on oaths is a telltale sign of an inherently dishonest person.
Keywords_AO: soba, kakachuu, amala, beeksisuu
Keywords_EN: lie, swear, character, reveal

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirsa kijibu haati manaa garaa isii keeysatti taajjabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: A lying husband, his wife observes him in her heart.
Meaning_AO: Dhiirsi soba baay'isu haadha manaa isaa duratti kabajaa dhabee garaadhaan tuffatama.
Meaning_EN: A deceitful husband loses all genuine moral standing; his wife silently measures and pities his dishonesty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Sobni mana keessatti kabajaa abbaa manaa hangam akka balleessu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that domestic deceit erodes a spouse's respect, replacing love with quiet disillusionment.
Keywords_AO: dhiirsa, kijibuu, haadha manaa, taajjabuu
Keywords_EN: husband, lie, wife, observe, silent contempt

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirsa kijibu, niitiin lafa laalti
Translation_Literal_EN: For a lying husband, the wife looks down at the ground.
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa soba dhiirsa isheetiif qaanfattee fuula buustee lafa ilaalti.
Meaning_EN: When a husband lies, his wife hangs her head in secondhand embarrassment and shame.
Usage_Situation_AO: Sobni abbaa manaa haadha manaa duratti salphinaa fi qaanii uumuu isaa agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show the deep, painful humiliation a wife feels when her partner tells transparent lies.
Keywords_AO: dhiirsa, kijibuu, niitii, lafa laaluu
Keywords_EN: husband, lie, wife, look at ground, shame

Mammaaksa_AO: Foon naa kenneeti, ablee na dhoorkate
Translation_Literal_EN: He gave me meat, but withheld the knife from me.
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko kennuuf fedhii akka qaban fakkeessanii garuu itti fayyadama isaa dhorkachuun gowwomsuu.
Meaning_EN: Offering someone meat while deliberately withholding the knife; giving a useless, obstructed favor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan kennu fakkaatee dhoorkatu ykn bu'aa akka hin arganne godhu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize individuals who make showy offers of assistance while sabotaging the means to use them.
Keywords_AO: foon, kennuu, ablee, dhoorkachuu
Keywords_EN: meat, give, knife, withhold, hollow gift

Mammaaksa_AO: Ulfi kuni bokoka
Translation_Literal_EN: This pregnancy is merely abdominal bloating.
Meaning_AO: Wanti akka guddaatti odeeffamee fi eegamu dhugaa hin qabne, qilleensa qofa ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: What was heralded as a grand creation or genuine pregnancy turns out to be hollow swelling.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma guddifamee dubbatamee garuu bu'aa dhabeessa ta'e balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to deflate exaggerated claims or projects that puff themselves up without delivering substance.
Keywords_AO: ulfa, bokoka, soba, qilleensa
Keywords_EN: pregnancy, bloating, hollow, false alarm

Mammaaksa_AO: Sobni abbaa warraa nama hin godhu
Translation_Literal_EN: Lying does not make one head of a household.
Meaning_AO: Sobanii fi afaanumaan of jajuun kabaja fi itti-gaafatamummaa dhugaa namaaf hin kennu.
Meaning_EN: Pretending and spinning falsehoods will never endow a person with genuine maturity and leadership.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota sobaan of guddisee kabaja barbaaduuf deebii kennuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who uses bravado and lies to project unearned authority or status.
Keywords_AO: soba, abbaa warraa, ta'uu, dhugaa
Keywords_EN: lie, household head, maturity, authentic

Mammaaksa_AO: Biya itti hin deebinetti, dhaabbatanii hagan
Translation_Literal_EN: In a land one will never return to, one defecates standing.
Meaning_AO: Bakka ormaa kan deebi'anii hin yaanne yoo ta'e namoonni safuu malee badii raawwatu.
Meaning_EN: People act without shame or restraint in a land to which they believe they will never return.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota bakka biraatti nagaa fi aadaa ormaa tuffatanii badii hojjetan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn unprincipled people who discard all decency because they face no local reckoning.
Keywords_AO: biyya, deebi'uu, dhaabbachuu, haguu
Keywords_EN: land, return, defecate, shamelessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Sunnaan dhiiraa kijiba
Translation_Literal_EN: The traditional custom of men is lying.
Meaning_AO: Dhiironni fedhii isaanii galmaan gahachuuf soba akka tooftaatti fayyadamuun aadaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Meaning_EN: A satirical observation that men frequently resort to fabrications and flattery to achieve their ends.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhiironni yeroo baay'ee haasawa mi'eessanii soba itti dabalan dubartoonni yoo taajjaban.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously or cynically to describe male flattery, courtship lies, and expedient exaggeration.
Keywords_AO: sunnaa, dhiira, kijiba, qishnaa
Keywords_EN: tradition, men, lie, flattery, satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Bara lolaa, kijibaatu wal lola
Translation_Literal_EN: In times of war, lies battle with lies.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo waldhabdee fi lolaa odeeffannoon sobaa fi propagaandaan hundarra heddummaata.
Meaning_EN: In times of conflict, rumors clash against rumors, and propaganda battles propaganda.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo lolaa odeeffannoo dhugaarra sobaatu baay'ata jedhanii dammaqsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that in times of strife, truth is eclipsed by warring falsehoods and propaganda.
Keywords_AO: bara, lola, kijiba, wal lolchuu
Keywords_EN: era, war, lie, clash, propaganda

Mammaaksa_AO: Cubbuun  dura nama furdifti, booda nama qallifti
Translation_Literal_EN: Sin fattens a person at first, but emaciates them later.
Meaning_AO: Badii fi dhugaa dabsuun yeroof bu'aa guddaa qabaatus boodarra kasaaraa fi badii fida.
Meaning_EN: Injustice and sin enrich a person initially, but ultimately bring devastating ruination and decay.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bu'aa yeroo gabaabaa cubbuu irraa argamuun akka hin gowwoomne gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that temporary prosperity gained through sinful deeds inevitably ends in ruin.
Keywords_AO: cubbuu, furdisuu, qallisuu, badii
Keywords_EN: sin, fatten, emaciate, retribution

Mammaaksa_AO: Maraatan malee, mara hin bahani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one goes mad, one does not escape the siege.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo cimaa fi xaxamaa keessaa bahuuf yeroo tokko tokko kutannoo addaa fi tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuun dirqama.
Meaning_EN: Desperate crises require bold, seemingly irrational resolve; one cannot break a tight bind without daring measures.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon hamaa ta'utti tarkaanfii cimaa fi sodaatamuu hin qabne fudhachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge decisive, audacious action when trapped in an otherwise inescapable dilemma.
Keywords_AO: maraachuu, mara, bahuu, kutannoo
Keywords_EN: mad, encirclement, escape, resolve

Mammaaksa_AO: Adurreen garaa muratte, leencaan qixa nama sodaachifti
Translation_Literal_EN: A determined cat frightens a person as much as a lion.
Meaning_AO: Namni ykn uumamni dadhabaan yoo garaa kutee fi du'aaf qophaa'e nama kamiinuu sodaachisuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: A desperate, cornered cat fights with such fierce abandon that it terrifies as much as a lion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota dadhaboo tuffataman yoo kutatan dhiibbaa guddaa akka fidan akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against pushing the weak to the wall, as sheer desperation breeds formidable courage.
Keywords_AO: adurree, garaa murachuu, leenca, sodaachisuu
Keywords_EN: cat, resolve, lion, frighten, desperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessa garaa murate, bishaan raafuutu gabbisa
Translation_Literal_EN: A poor man who is determined, cabbage-broth fattens him.
Meaning_AO: Namni kutannoo fi quuftummaa qabu wanta xiqqoo argatetti gammadee jireenya isaa milkeessa.
Meaning_EN: A determined pauper thrives and gains strength even on simple cabbage broth; resolve nourishes the spirit.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hamilee fi kutannoon jireenya keessatti wantoota qaban caalaa murteessaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that strong willpower and contentment allow a person to thrive on meager resources.
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, garaa murachuu, bishaan raafuu, gabbisuu
Keywords_EN: poor, resolve, cabbage water, fatten

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan murtii hin qabne, diina abbaati
Translation_Literal_EN: An indecisive heart is its owner's enemy.
Meaning_AO: Namni murtoo dabarsuu dadhabee fi shakkiin dhiphatu ofumaan of miidha, kasaaraattis gala.
Meaning_EN: An indecisive, wavering heart is its possessor's worst enemy, leading to paralysis and ruin.
Usage_Situation_AO: Murtoo hatattamaa fi cinaa dhaabbachuu barbaachisu irratti laafuu balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against chronic hesitation and ambiguity, urging swift, resolute choice.
Keywords_AO: garaa, murtii, diina, abbaa
Keywords_EN: heart, decision, enemy, indecision

Mammaaksa_AO: "Namni namumaa, ija nyaadhu" jette allaattiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "Human is still human; peck at the eye," said the bird of prey.
Meaning_AO: Diinni ykn nama miidhaa barbaadu tokko carraa argannaan bakka laafaa fi murteessaa irratti miidhaa geessa.
Meaning_EN: "A human is formidable, but go straight for the eyes," said the vulture; strike ruthlessly at the vulnerable spot.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qormaata ykn diina fuulduratti bakka dhiibbaa guddaa uumuu danda'u irratti xiyyeeffachuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe a shrewd, predatory strategy that targets an opponent's most critical vulnerability.
Keywords_AO: nama, allaattii, ija, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: human, vulture, eye, peck, vulnerability

Mammaaksa_AO: Kulkatan malee, kulkaa hin bahani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one endures the stinging pain, one does not get cured.
Meaning_AO: Bu'aa gaarii argachuu fi rakkoo keessaa bahuuf dhiphinaa fi miidhaa yeroo sanaa obsuun dirqama.
Meaning_EN: Unless you endure the sharp sting of treatment, you will never be cleansed of the throbbing infection.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina yeroo gabaabaa obsuun milkaa'inaa fi fayyina dheeraa akka fidu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that overcoming deep problems requires confronting uncomfortable, painful remedies.
Keywords_AO: kulkachuu, kulka, bahuu, obsa
Keywords_EN: inflame, pain, heal, endure

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiiraan qabsoo qabanii, lafa hin laalani
Translation_Literal_EN: Wrestling a real man, one does not stare at the ground.
Meaning_AO: Dorgommii ykn qormaata cimaa keessa erga seenanii booda sodaatanii ija gadi qabuun hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Having locked horns in wrestling with a formidable opponent, one cannot afford to look down in fear.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabsoo ykn lola keessatti ija jabinaa fi fuulleetti qophaa'uu akka qaban yeroo kakaasan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge unblinking courage and full engagement when squaring off against a powerful rival.
Keywords_AO: dhiira, qabsoo, lafa laaluu, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: man, wrestling, ground, gaze, fearlessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiiraan qabanii ija lafaan hin qaban
Translation_Literal_EN: Grappling with a valiant man, one does not fix eyes on the ground.
Meaning_AO: Qormaata jabaa wajjin wal qunnamanii of dagachuu fi hamilee dhabuun kufaatiitti geessa.
Meaning_EN: When grappling with serious stakes, dropping your vigilance or courage guarantees defeat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma cimaa keessatti xiyyeeffannoo fi onnee guutuudhaan hirmaachuu akka qaban ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise staying sharp, fearless, and proactive during intense competition or struggle.
Keywords_AO: dhiira, qabachuu, ija, lafa
Keywords_EN: man, grapple, eye, focus, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Gara jabeeysa, heexoon hin albaafne
Translation_Literal_EN: A ruthless person is not purged even by hagenia.
Meaning_AO: Namni garaa jabaate fi murate dhiibbaa fi qoricha akkamitiyyuu akka laayyootti hin jijjiiramu.
Meaning_EN: A truly hardened, unyielding person cannot be shaken or purged even by the strongest bitter medicine.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama yaada isaatti cichu fi laaffachuu hin barbaanne ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe someone whose unshakeable resolve or cold ruthlessness resists every form of pressure.
Keywords_AO: gara jabeessa, heexoo, albaasuu, ciminna
Keywords_EN: ruthless, hagenia, purge, toughness

Mammaaksa_AO: Deemuun nama hin dhibu, itti deemuutu nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: Walking is not hard; following through is what challenges.
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko jalqabuun salphaadha, garuu hanga dhumaatti cichanii milkeessuun dhimma ulfaataadha.
Meaning_EN: Commencing a journey is easy; persevering and seeing it through to the end is the real test.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii jalqabame tokko bakkaan gahuun carraaqqii addaa akka barbaadu yaadachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stress that completing commitments and reaching targets is much harder than casually starting them.
Keywords_AO: deemuu, itti deemuu, dhibuu, galma
Keywords_EN: walk, follow through, difficult, destination

Mammaaksa_AO: Toltu garbu, baddu darbu
Translation_Literal_EN: If it prospers it is barley; if it spoils it passes.
Meaning_AO: Wanta murteessan tokko bu'aa isaas ta'ee miidhaa isaa fudhachuuf garaa murachuu.
Meaning_EN: Whether it turns out favorably or collapses, one accepts the outcome with resolute stoicism.
Usage_Situation_AO: Tarkaanfii fudhatame kamuu bu'aa dhufe amansiisaadhaan simachuuf yeroo qophaa'an.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express ready acceptance of whatever consequences an uncertain decision brings.
Keywords_AO: toluu, garbuu, baduu, darbuu
Keywords_EN: succeed, barley, fail, pass, stoicism

Mammaaksa_AO: Qabbanooytu harkaa, oowwitu fal'aana
Translation_Literal_EN: If it is cool use the hand; if it is hot use the spoon.
Meaning_AO: Haala qabatamaa jiru irratti hundaa'uun tooftaa mijataa fi barbaachisaa ta'etti fayyadamuu.
Meaning_EN: If the food is cool, eat with your hands; if it is piping hot, use a spoon; adapt tools to conditions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoo ykn dhimma jiru akkaataa qabatama isaatiin furmaata kennuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advocate adjusting one's methods flexibly depending on whether a situation is volatile or calm.
Keywords_AO: qabbanaa'uu, harka, oowwuu, fal'aana
Keywords_EN: cool, hand, hot, spoon, adaptability

Mammaaksa_AO: Dheerattu jalaan, gabaabbattu gubbaan
Translation_Literal_EN: If it is tall pass under; if it is short leap over.
Meaning_AO: Gufuu fi haala mudate hundaa akkaataa qabatama isaatiin furuun deemuu.
Meaning_EN: If an obstacle hangs high, duck beneath it; if it sits low, step over it; adapt smoothly to difficulties.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoolee adda addaatiif tooftaa adda addaa gargaaramuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage finding the most effortless, appropriate workaround for any given obstacle.
Keywords_AO: dheerachuu, jala, gabaabbachuu, gubbaa
Keywords_EN: tall, under, short, over, workaround

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaa caphxeen haa yaaftuu
Translation_Literal_EN: Let it flow along the path it has broken through.
Meaning_AO: Wanta uumamaa ykn murtoo darbe tokko hordofanii dhiisuu, wanta ta'e dhiisanii itti fufuu.
Meaning_EN: Let the breach flow where it has broken; let events run their irreversible course without futile resistance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti bade tokko erga ta'ee booda yaaduu dhiisanii isa hafe irratti xiyyeeffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an irreversible turn of events has occurred and the only option is to let it play out.
Keywords_AO: karaa, cabuu, yaa'uu, dhiisuu
Keywords_EN: way, break, flow, accept, irreversible

Mammaaksa_AO: Qeeyransa eegee hin qabanii, qaban gad hin dhiisan
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not hold a leopard's tail, but once held, never let go.
Meaning_AO: Hojii ykn qabsoo balaa qabu osoo hin beekin seenuu hin qaban, erga seenanii garuu cichuu malee karaan hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Never rashly seize a leopard by its tail, but once you do, letting go is fatal; you must see it through.
