Keywords_EN: adversity, seize, children, leaves, compounded

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaan dulloome, qaama ifiitiin haasawa
Translation_Literal_EN: A wise elder grown very old mutters with his own limbs.
Meaning_AO: Dullooma hamaa keessatti beekumsi fi dandeettiin hir'atee gara ofii qofatti dubbachuutti akka jijjiiramu.
Meaning_EN: A once-great sage who reaches extreme senility ends up muttering and conversing with his own limbs.
Theme_EN: The Inevitable Decline of Aging Sages
Usage_Situation_AO: Dulloomni dandeettii sammuu namaa illee akka hir'isu mararfannaadhaan yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remark sadly on the inevitable human toll of extreme old age, which chips away at even great minds.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, dulloomuu, qaama, haasa'uu
Keywords_EN: wise, age, body, converse, senility

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenca rakkoon goda osolee neyxe, osoleen wallaalaaf matarratti fincaanti
Translation_Literal_EN: The lion driven to the hare's burrow, the hare urinates on its head.
Meaning_AO: Gootni yeroo rakkoon dadhabee gad of qabu, dadhaboonni hubannaa dhabuudhaan isa salphisuuf yaalu.
Meaning_EN: A lion driven by dire straits to a hare's burrow; the foolish hare, failing to recognize majesty, urinates on his head.
Theme_EN: Insolence of the Weak toward Fallen Giants
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota jajjaboo rakkina keessa jiran warri dadhaboon yeroo tuffatanii fi salphisuuf yaalan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn insolent fools who disrespect a mighty leader merely because temporary adversity brought him low.
Keywords_AO: leenca, osolee, matarratti fincaanuu, tuffii
Keywords_EN: lion, hare, urinate, head, insolence

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenca dulloome, weessoo ittiin raasan
Translation_Literal_EN: With an aged lion, they churn the milk gourd.
Meaning_AO: Goota duraan sodaatamaa ture yeroo inni dulloomu akka meeshaa laayyootti itti fayyadamuun salphisuu.
Meaning_EN: An aged, toothless lion is treated like an idle churning stick; the fallen mighty made into domestic objects.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aangoo fi kabajni duraanii dhabamee salphinni bakka bu'uu isaa agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament the pathetic state of once-terrifying rulers subjected to domestic indignities in old age.
Keywords_AO: leenca, dulloomuu, weessoo, raasuu
Keywords_EN: lion, aged, gourd, churn, humiliation

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenca dulloome, ijoolleen iyya seeti
Translation_Literal_EN: For an aged lion, children mistake its roar for crying.
Meaning_AO: Humnaa fi kabajaa dhabuun goota duraanii dhaloota haaraa biratti akka nama dadhabaatti ilaalamuu fida.
Meaning_EN: When an aged lion roars, ignorant children mistake the thunder for mere crying; lost authority.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dandeettii fi dhiibbaan duraanii yeroo dhabamu ijoolleenillee akka tuffattu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when the remnants of a formidable person's authority are dismissed or mocked by the uninitiated youth.
Keywords_AO: leenca, dulloomuu, ijoollee, iyya
Keywords_EN: lion, aged, children, cry, dismissed

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenca dulloome, adurreetu ija arraaba
Translation_Literal_EN: An aged lion, a common cat licks its eyes.
Meaning_AO: Goota duraan sodaatamaa ture namni dadhabaan duraan sodaatu ija dura dhaabbatee salphisa.
Meaning_EN: An aged lion suffers having its very eyes licked by a common cat; the ultimate reduction in stature.
Theme_EN: Petty Creatures Insolent to Fallen Giants
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota duraan mootii turan irratti warri xixinnoon daangaa malee yeroo taphatan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the utter vulnerability of a fallen giant whose former inferiors now treat him with brazen familiarity.
Keywords_AO: leenca, dulloomuu, adurree, ija arraabuu
Keywords_EN: lion, aged, cat, lick eyes, degradation

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenca dulloome, titichaa itti taphata
Translation_Literal_EN: On an aged lion, even flies swarm and play.
Meaning_AO: Namni duraan ulfinaa fi humna qabu erga dadhabee booda wanti xiqqoon hunduu isa tuffatti.
Meaning_EN: Upon an aged, helpless lion, even flies swarm and play; total loss of protective deterrence.
Theme_EN: Swarming of Inconsequential Pests on the Fallen
Usage_Situation_AO: Aangoon yeroo darbu namoonni gatii hin qabnellee akka itti baacaniif sababa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how the loss of vigor or political office leaves a former power open to harassment by petty actors.
Keywords_AO: leenca, dulloomuu, tiiticha, taphachuu
Keywords_EN: lion, aged, flies, swarm, play

Mammaaksa_AO: Ija darratte, tiitichaa itti gama
Translation_Literal_EN: Toward an inflamed eye, flies flock.
Meaning_AO: Bakka laafaa, madaa ykn qormaata namatti dhufe irratti rakkoowwan dabalataa fi wantoonni badaa walitti qabamu.
Meaning_EN: Toward an already afflicted, suppurating eye, flies naturally swarm; troubles compound on the vulnerable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni duraanuu rakkoo keessa jiru dabalataan yeroo miidhamu ykn namoonni irratti wal-dabalatan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when opportunists or misfortunes pile onto a person who is already visibly hurting and weakened.
Keywords_AO: ija, darrachuu, tiiticha, gamuu
Keywords_EN: eye, inflamed, flies, flock, vulnerability

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni aanaa muyoo, haluu hin baafatu
Translation_Literal_EN: One whose kin is a coward extracts no vengeance.
Meaning_AO: Firoottan ykn deeggartoota dadhaboo qabaachuun haqa ofii kabachiisuu fi diina ofirraa ittisuu dhabsiisa.
Meaning_EN: One whose primary kin is a spineless coward cannot hope to extract vengeance or defend family honor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gargaarsa fi cimina firaa dhabuun haqa ofii akka dhabsiisu yeroo himan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express the bitter frustration of having ineffective, cowardly kin who cannot uphold justice or defense.
Keywords_AO: nama, aanaa, muyoo, haluu baafachuu
Keywords_EN: kin, coward, vengeance, helpless, defense

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka durii seetee garaa jala na hin dhawin jette intalti
Translation_Literal_EN: "Do not strike me beneath the belly thinking I am as before," said the girl.
Meaning_AO: Haalli jijjiiramuu isaa hubachuu dhabanii akka yeroo duraaniitti nama salphisuuf yaaluu dhoorkuu.
Meaning_EN: "Do not strike me beneath the belly assuming I am still as vulnerable as before," said the girl; times have changed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni duraan dadhabaa ture yeroo of ijaaree fi of baraaree tuffii duraanii didu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reject old patterns of condescension or bullying, asserting that the victim is now capable and vigilant.
Keywords_AO: akka durii, garaa jala, dhaawuu, intala
Keywords_EN: as before, belly, strike, maiden, assert

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiyyeessa mastiin miite, gaalaatu gobeelle seenaan
Translation_Literal_EN: For the pauper struck by distress, a camel entered his grass hut.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina hamaa keessa osoo jiranii balaan hin eegamne kan biraa itti dabalamee mana jilbeenfachiisuu.
Meaning_EN: While the pauper suffered the agony of intoxication and debt, a rogue camel barged into his fragile grass hut.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni duraanuu dadhabaa ta'e balaa humnaa oliitiin yeroo walitti dhufee caccabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe an absurd, overwhelming heap of bad luck where a massive disaster crashes onto fragile poverty.
Keywords_AO: hiyyeessa, mastii, gaala, gobeelle
Keywords_EN: pauper, distress, camel, hut, disaster

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaa ooyruu, jaldeessi keessaa baafate
Translation_Literal_EN: The baboon drove the field owner out of his own farmland.
Meaning_AO: Ormi ykn diinni dhufee abbaa qabeenyaa fi abbaa biyyaa irratti aangoomee qe'ee isaarraa ari'uu.
Meaning_EN: The baboon drove the farmer out of his own field; the brazen intruder usurping the rightful master.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni qabeenya qabu ykn abbaan biyyaa osoo jiruu ormi humnaan yoo abbaa ta'u balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn an intolerable situation where an impudent interloper expels the rightful proprietor from his own estate.
Keywords_AO: abbaa ooyruu, jaldeessa, baasuu, aangoo
Keywords_EN: field owner, baboon, evict, usurpation

Mammaaksa_AO: Mari'ataan gowwaa hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Those who consult have no fool among them.
Meaning_AO: Mariidhaan wanta hundumaa kan qajeelchan yoo ta'e gowwummaan fi dogoggorri bakka hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Those who seek counsel and consult together harbor no fools; collective wisdom protects everyone.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta kamuu raawwachuuf mariin barbaachisaa ta'uu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that seeking advice and deliberating collectively shields a community from foolish blunders.
Keywords_AO: mari'achuu, gowwaa, ogummaa, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: consult, fool, wisdom, deliberation

Mammaaksa_AO: Ni oriinaa dura garam oriinaatu dura
Translation_Literal_EN: Before rushing to run, "Where are we running?" comes first.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi sochii ariifannaa dura galmaa fi kallattii sirriitti mari'atanii beekuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Before sprinting off, one must first decide where to run; purpose and strategy precede haste.
Usage_Situation_AO: Osoo hin mari'atin fi kallattii hin qabatin fiiguun bu'aa akka hin qabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against rushing impulsively into action without first conferring on the objective.
Keywords_AO: oriina, dura, garam, karoora
Keywords_EN: running, first, destination, direction, plan

Mammaaksa_AO: Maraatanii biyya hin bulchani, mari'atanii malee
Translation_Literal_EN: One governs not by madness, but by consultation.
Meaning_AO: Biyya fi hawaasa geggeessuuf aariin fi garmalee oofuun osoo hin taane marii fi heeraan ta'uu qaba.
Meaning_EN: A nation is never governed by reckless rage or madness, but through patient, democratic consultation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hooggansi ummataa marii fi heera irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu qaba jedhanii gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind leaders that enduring governance requires broad consultation, not authoritarian whims.
Keywords_AO: maraachuu, biyya, bulchuu, marii
Keywords_EN: madness, country, govern, consultation

Mammaaksa_AO: Warri marii qabu Arba hidheeti, warri marii hin qabne tafkii qabuu daadhabe
Translation_Literal_EN: A family with counsel tied an elephant; without counsel failed to catch a flea.
Meaning_AO: Marii fi waliigalteedhaan wanta guddaa fi ulfaataa danda'u, marii dhabuun garuu waan salphaattillee gufachiisa.
Meaning_EN: A united family acting with counsel tethered an elephant, while a discordant family failed to catch a flea.
Theme_EN: Power of Consensus vs. Fragmented Ineptitude
Usage_Situation_AO: Humni marii wanta hundumaa akka dandeessisu fi marii dhabuun akka nama laaffisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contrast the miraculous achievements of consensus against the pathetic failures of disunity.
Keywords_AO: marii, arba, hidhuu, tafkii, qabuu
Keywords_EN: counsel, elephant, tether, flea, catch

Mammaaksa_AO: Warri marii qabu dibicha (sangaa) gurgureeti, warrii marii hin qabne raada gurgure
Translation_Literal_EN: A family with counsel sold an ox; without counsel sold a heifer.
Meaning_AO: Warri mari'atu qabeenya bu'aa fidu qusatee kan biraa gurgura, kan marii hin qabne madda dhalaati balleessa.
Meaning_EN: A family that consults sells an ox for cash, while an uncoordinated family sells the reproductive heifer.
Usage_Situation_AO: Murtii qabeenyaa keessatti mariin boruu fi egeree maatii eeguuf akka barbaachisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show how collective deliberation preserves foundational reproductive assets rather than squandering them.
Keywords_AO: marii, dibicha, gurguruu, raada, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: counsel, ox, sell, heifer, wealth management

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni akkam taana je'ee wal gaafate, akka tahu  hin dhabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Those who ask each other "What shall we do?" never lack a way.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni waliin mari'atanii yaada wal jijjiiran furmaata dhabanii hin rakkatan.
Meaning_EN: Those who gather to ask "How shall we proceed?" will never lack an effective path or solution.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina kamuu keessatti mariin karaan akka banamu namoota jajjabeessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage people in trouble, assuring them that pooling thoughts will always generate a solution.
Keywords_AO: akkam taana, gaafachuu, marii, furmaata
Keywords_EN: what to do, ask, counsel, solution

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhuufuun marii qabdu hin ajooytu
Translation_Literal_EN: A fart preceded by consultation does not stink.
Meaning_AO: Gochi ykn murtoon duraan irratti mari'atamee fi beekame yoo rakkoo qabaatelluu mufannaa hin uumu.
Meaning_EN: Even an unpleasant blunder does not cause offense if it was agreed upon or disclosed beforehand.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta nama mufachiisuu danda'u irratti duraan mari'achuun nagaa akka eegu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously to show that mutual prior agreement removes the sting or offense from awkward situations.
Keywords_AO: dhuufuu, marii, ajaa'uu, dhiifama
Keywords_EN: fart, consultation, smell, consensus

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan "cirachaan nyaadha"  jennaan, ilkeen "eenyuun marihatte" jetteen
Translation_Literal_EN: When the belly said "I will eat gravel," the teeth asked "Whom did you consult?"
Meaning_AO: Qaamni ykn namni tokko fedhii ofiitiif qofa ka'ee yoo murteesse, inni itti fayyadamu mormuun seera.
Meaning_EN: When the belly declared "I will feast on gravel," the teeth demanded "Whom did you consult to chew it?"
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni tokko osoo warra hojjetan hin mari'asisin murtoo rakkisaa dabarsuu yoo yaale mormuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke someone who unilaterally commits to a hard task without consulting the ones who must execute it.
Keywords_AO: garaa, ciracha, nyaachuu, ilkee, mari'achuu
Keywords_EN: stomach, gravel, eat, teeth, consult

Mammaaksa_AO: Kadhatanii niitii fuudhanii, kadhattee warra isii dheeyxi
Translation_Literal_EN: Having begged to marry her, she asks permission to visit kin.
Meaning_AO: Gaa'elli fi aadaan heera, safeeffannaa fi wal-dhaggeeffachuu irratti kan ijaaramedha.
Meaning_EN: Begged for in marriage through humble petition, the wife in turn petitions for leave to visit her kin.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aadaa fuudhaa fi heerumaa keessatti kabajaa fi heera eegamuun jiru ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the traditional cycle of formal requests, protocols, and mutual respect in marriage.
Keywords_AO: kadhachuu, niitii, fuudhuu, warra, dhaquu
Keywords_EN: beg, wife, marry, parents, visit, protocol

Mammaaksa_AO: Waliif galan malee, alaa hin galan
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless they agree with each other, they cannot return home.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni waliin jiran yoo marii fi waliigaltee qabaatan qofa nagaan manatti deebi'uu danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Unless travelers agree in harmony among themselves, they can never make a successful return home.
Usage_Situation_AO: Imala, hojii fi jireenya keessatti wal hubachuun bu'uura milkaa'inaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that any venture away from home requires internal unity and consensus to succeed and return safe.
Keywords_AO: waliif galuu, alaa galuu, nagaa, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: agree, return home, peace, unity, consensus

Mammaaksa_AO: Maqaan baduu mannaa, mataan badu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Better for the head to perish than one's name.
Meaning_AO: Kabajaa fi maqaa gaarii ofii dhabanii salphachuu irra lubbuun darbuu wayya.
Meaning_EN: Better that the physical head perish in honor than that one's name and dignity be ruined in disgrace.
Theme_EN: Sanctity of Reputation over Physical Life
Usage_Situation_AO: Maqaa fi kabajaa ofii dursa kennanii eeggachuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that moral honor and a clean reputation are far more valuable than mere physical survival.
Keywords_AO: maqaa, mataa, baduu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: name, head, perish, honor, reputation

Mammaaksa_AO: Maqaa ni bitan malee, hin gurgurani
Translation_Literal_EN: One earns a name, one does not sell it.
Meaning_AO: Maqaan gaariin hojii gaarii fi arjummaan kan ijaaramu malee qarshiidhaan kan gurguramu miti.
Meaning_EN: A noble name is painstakingly earned and cherished; it is never auctioned away for petty material gain.
Theme_EN: Invaluable Worth of a Good Name
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenyaaf jedhanii maqaa fi kabajaa ofii akka hin dabarsine akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against compromising one's integrity or trading one's good reputation for monetary gain.
Keywords_AO: maqaa, bituu, gurguruu, gatii
Keywords_EN: name, buy, sell, integrity, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Mataa tikfatani, maqaa hin dagatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Guarding the head, one does not forget the name.
Meaning_AO: Lubbuu ofii eeggachaa maqaa fi naamusas cinaatti dagachuun hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Even while taking measures to protect one's physical life, one must never lose sight of honor and reputation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina keessatti lubbuun hafuuf jedhanii gocha qaanii raawwachuu irraa of qusachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise that striving to survive hardships should never involve committing shameful acts.
Keywords_AO: mataa, tikfachuu, maqaa, dagachuu
Keywords_EN: head, guard, name, forget, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Barri hamaan ni dabra, maqaa hamaan hin dabru
Translation_Literal_EN: A bad year passes away, but a bad name never passes.
Meaning_AO: Rakkinnii fi beelli yeroof dhufanii darbu, badii fi salphinni maqaa irratti hafe garuu hin dhabamu.
Meaning_EN: A harsh season or drought eventually passes, but an infamous, tarnished name endures forever.
Theme_EN: Enduring Stigma of a Bad Name
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina yeroo darbu keessatti gocha safuu cabsu raawwatanii maqaa ofii akka hin xureessine gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against committing shameful deeds during temporary hardships, as dishonor outlives crisis.
Keywords_AO: bara hamaa, dabruu, maqaa hamaa, eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: bad season, pass, bad name, stigma, permanence

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurri nama du'uu mannaa lubbuun du'uu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Better that life expire than one's reputation die.
Meaning_AO: Salphinaa fi maqaa badiin jiraachuu irra kabajaan du'uutu caala.
Meaning_EN: Better that physical breath expire than that one's good name and public standing suffer mortal death.
Theme_EN: Primacy of Honor over Mere Survival
Usage_Situation_AO: Maqaa badaa fi salphina jalaa ba'uuf kabajaan dhaabbachuu akka qaban yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to declare that living in utter disgrace is far worse than dying with an unblemished reputation.
Keywords_AO: gurra, du'uu, lubbuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: reputation, die, soul, honor, martyrdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Itti qalaniiti duutee fi osoo itti hin qalin duuteen walirraa jala
Translation_Literal_EN: Dying slaughtered properly and dying as carrion are worlds apart.
Meaning_AO: Haalli wanta tokko raawwatan, seera hordofanii xumuruun fi seera malee kufuun garaagarummaa guddaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Dying having been properly consecrated and slaughtered differs vast worlds from dying as unhallowed carrion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Kufaatii fi du'a keessattillee kabajaa fi seera eeggachuun gatii akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that even in loss or death, doing things honorably and by custom makes a profound difference.
Keywords_AO: qaluu, du'uu, seera, garaagarummaa
Keywords_EN: slaughter, die, consecrated, protocol, difference

Mammaaksa_AO: Maqaa hamaa, abbaatu ifirraa eega
Translation_Literal_EN: Against a bad reputation, the owner himself must guard.
Meaning_AO: Maqaa fi kabajaa ofii eeggachuun dhimma nama biraa osoo hin taane itti-gaafatamummaa nama mataa isaati.
Meaning_EN: A person's reputation is their own solemn responsibility; only you can protect your own name from stain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni kamiyyuu amala fi sochiisaatiin maqaa ofii qulqulleeffachuuf akka carraaqu barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind individuals that shielding their name from scandal begins with their own personal conduct.
Keywords_AO: maqaa hamaa, abbaa, eeguu, itti-gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: bad name, owner, guard, personal responsibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Baale hin baduu, gurra hin badin
Translation_Literal_EN: Let not the feather perish, let not reputation perish.
Meaning_AO: Faayaa fi kabajaa ofii eeggachuun, keessattuu maqaa gaarii qabaachuun wanta hundarra dursuu qaba.
Meaning_EN: Guard your plume of honor; above all, never let your good name and renown be tarnished.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni kabajaa fi maqaa abbootiin isaanii ijaaran akka hin balleessine yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to enjoin young warriors or leaders to maintain the plume of valor and never disgrace their lineage.
Keywords_AO: baalee, baduu, gurra, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: feather, plume, ruin, reputation, renown

Mammaaksa_AO: Abaar ni bahaa, maqaa hamaan hin bahu
Translation_Literal_EN: Drought passes, but an evil name never washes out.
Meaning_AO: Beellii fi dheebun yeroon darbee nyaata argataniyyuu maqaan baduu garuu seenaa keessatti hafa.
Meaning_EN: A season of famine eventually ends, but an evil reputation remains indelibly stamped upon history.
Theme_EN: Transience of Famine vs. Indelible Stain
Usage_Situation_AO: Beela yeroof jettu gocha hamaa raawwachuun maqaa bara baraan nama xureessu akka fidu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against dishonorable compromises during hard times, as physical hunger ends but shame stays.
Keywords_AO: abaar, bahuu, maqaa hamaa, seenaa
Keywords_EN: famine, drought, pass, bad name, indelible

Mammaaksa_AO: Barri hin darbaa gurri hin darbuu, hin hatinii hin sobinii nyaattuus garbuu
Translation_Literal_EN: The year will pass, renown endures; do not steal or lie, though eating barley.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyummaa fi rakkina keessatti sobaa fi hanna irraa of qusatanii wantuma jiruun qulqullummaan jiraachuu wayya.
Meaning_EN: The hard year will pass, but your name endures; do not steal or lie, even if you subsist on raw barley.
Theme_EN: Preserving Honor in Hardship through Frugality
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina kamuu keessatti maqaa ofii eeganii qulqullinaan jiraachuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a classic moral compass urging contentment with plain sustenance rather than dishonor.
Keywords_AO: bara, gurra, hatuu, sobuu, garbuu
Keywords_EN: season, reputation, steal, lie, barley, integrity

Mammaaksa_AO: Waywaanni kan du'a nama hin oolchine, abaabuu nama yakka
Translation_Literal_EN: Wailing that spares none from death only damages youth's bloom.
Meaning_AO: Wanta hin oolleef garmalee iyyanii fi dhiphatanii of miidhuun furmaata osoo hin taane miidhaa dabalataati.
Meaning_EN: Frantic lamentation that cannot prevent destined death only exhausts and disfigures one's vital beauty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gadda keessatti miidhaa humnaa olii ofirraan gahuu dhiisanii obsaan fudhachuu akka qaban ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise the bereaved against destructive, excessive grieving over irreversible losses.
Keywords_AO: waywaannaa, du'a, oolchuu, abaabuu, yakkuu
Keywords_EN: wailing, death, prevent, bloom, damage, composure

Mammaaksa_AO: Ganama rafuun, tokkicha deegaati nama dhoorka
Translation_Literal_EN: Sleeping in the morning spares one only poverty.
Meaning_AO: Ganama bariidhaan ka'anii hojjechuu dhiisanii rafuun gara hiyyummaa fi deegumsa daangaa hin qabneetti nama geessa.
Meaning_EN: Sleeping late into the morning yields nothing but a direct ticket to extreme poverty and ruin.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota ganama lafaa ka'anii hojjechuu nuffanii rafan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn lazy sleepers that wasting prime morning work hours guarantees destitution.
Keywords_AO: ganama, rafuu, deega, dhibaa'ummaa
Keywords_EN: morning, sleep, poverty, laziness

Mammaaksa_AO: Hirriibni, duumessa hiyyummaati
Translation_Literal_EN: Sleep is the cloud of poverty.
Meaning_AO: Hirriibni garmalee baay'atu akkuma duumessi rooba fidu hiyyummaa fi dhabinsa nama irratti fida.
Meaning_EN: Excessive sleep is the dark cloud that heralds poverty; sloth precedes economic destitution.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hirriiba heddummeessuun hojii fi guddina namaa akka daangessu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that oversleeping is the ominous precursor to falling into deep poverty.
Keywords_AO: hirriiba, duumessa, hiyyummaa, hojii
Keywords_EN: sleep, cloud, poverty, sloth

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka dhabduun, afaan malee afaa hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: The shiftless woman has a mouth, but no sleeping mat.
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii hin hojjenne afaaniin nama loluu fi dhaadachuu qofa beeka malee mana isaatti wanti jiru hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: The shiftless, impoverished person possesses plenty of mouth, but lacks even a sleeping mat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota afaaniin qofa dandeettii agarsiisanii garuu jireenyaan qullaa ta'an qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock loud, quarrelsome individuals whose domestic reality is complete squalor.
Keywords_AO: akka dhabduu, afaan, afaa, qeeqa
Keywords_EN: destitute, mouth, mat, empty boast

Mammaaksa_AO: "Bishaan lagaa dhume" jennaan, boosattiin "ilil"  jette
Translation_Literal_EN: Told "The river dried," the lazy woman rejoiced.
Meaning_AO: Namni dhibaa'aan hojii mana keessaa fi bishaan waraabuu jibbu sababa hojii dhiisuu ittiin argateef gammada.
Meaning_EN: Hearing that the river dried up, the lazy woman rejoiced; the sluggard celebrates excuses to avoid work.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii jibbuun kan ka'e rakkoo uumameyyuu akka gammachuutti kan lakkaa'an yeroo qeeqan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize a thoroughly lazy person who cheers when common facilities fail because it spares labor.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, laga, boosattii, ilil jechuu
Keywords_EN: water, river, lazy woman, rejoice, sloth

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana boosoo, utubaan waddeetsa
Translation_Literal_EN: In a lazy person's house, the pillar is cordia.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan ykn manni wanta gaarii qabaatus qulqullinaa fi kunuunsa dhabuudhaan faayidaa fi bifa dhabuu.
Meaning_EN: Even if a lazy person's house has fine wooden pillars, complete neglect leaves it unsightly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti qulqullinaa fi qabiinsa dhabe bifa bareedaa qabaatus akka hin miidhagne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remark that quality materials or talent cannot compensate for chronic filth and poor upkeep.
Keywords_AO: mana, boosoo, utubaa, waddeessa
Keywords_EN: house, lazy, pillar, cordia, neglect

Mammaaksa_AO: Deeraan naa taateeti, dhandhaarraan narra guddate jette booso
Translation_Literal_EN: "The crawl-space suited me, the soot defeated me," said the lazy woman.
Meaning_AO: Dhibaa'aan wanta hundaaf sababa dhiheessa; rakkoo ofii danda'ee qulqulleessuu mannaa komii uuma.
Meaning_EN: "The crawl-space suited me, but the soot defeated me," said the sluggard; making endless excuses for filth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota sababa hin taaneef mana fi jireenya ofii mancaasanii komii ormaatti qajeelchan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule lazy individuals who invent absurd excuses to explain away domestic filth.
Keywords_AO: deeraa, dhandhaarraa, boosoo, sababa
Keywords_EN: low ceiling, soot, lazy woman, excuses

Mammaaksa_AO: Ala boon dhihanni shuumoo dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Boasting outside, while dinner at home is boiled grain.
Meaning_AO: Alatti of tuuluun fi akka waan sooromaatti of mul'isuun mana keessatti garuu rakkina beelaa dhandhamuu.
Meaning_EN: Putting on arrogant airs in public while subsisting on mere boiled grain at home; hollow pride.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota alatti of dhaadhessanii mana keessatti hiyyummaa hamaa keessa jiran qaanlessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to puncture the pretensions of those who act wealthy outside while living in destitution at home.
Keywords_AO: ala boonu, dhihana, shuumoo, fakeentee
Keywords_EN: boast outside, evening meal, boiled grain, pretense

Mammaaksa_AO: If dadhabduun, udaan dhuufutti fixxi
Translation_Literal_EN: The incompetent woman exhausts her feces in farts.
Meaning_AO: Namni dandeettii fi kutannoo hin qabne hojii qabatamaa dhiisee sochiilee bu'aa dhabeeyyiin yeroo guba.
Meaning_EN: The utterly incompetent person wastes energy on noisy, fruitless efforts instead of achieving results.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii bu'aa qabu hojjechuu dadhabee bu'aa dhabeessa irratti dhama'u ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize noisy, erratic people who exert themselves frantically on useless actions.
Keywords_AO: if dadhabuu, dhuufuu, udaan, faayidaa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: incompetent, fart, feces, futile, noisy

Mammaaksa_AO: Hemelaal ganda teeysii, qooshaan dhagarra teeysi
Translation_Literal_EN: Roaming the village, while her cooking pot sits on the hearth.
Meaning_AO: Hojii mana ofii dagatanii ganda keessa nanna'uun oduu funaanuu fi mana ofii boosoomsuu.
Meaning_EN: Gossiping idly through the village while her empty cooking pot gathers dust upon the cold hearth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haadholii mana ofii dhiisanii ganda keessa odeessuun yeroo guban akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shame someone who neglects domestic chores and cooking to wander around gossiping.
Keywords_AO: hemelaal, ganda, qooshaa, dhagaa, boosummaa
Keywords_EN: roam, village, pot, hearthstones, neglect

Mammaaksa_AO: Gandaan martuu, sareen qoosharra teeysi
Translation_Literal_EN: While she roams the village, the dog sits on her pan.
Meaning_AO: Bakka manaa dhiisanii ganda irratti garagaluun qabeenyi ofii xuraawuu fi manca'uu isaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: While the homemaker gossips through the village, stray dogs climb and sit upon her bread pans.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mana ofii dhiisanii deemuu fi qulqullina dhabuun salphina akkamii akka fidu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to depict the scandalous domestic neglect of a woman whose wandering allows dogs to defile cooking gear.
Keywords_AO: gandaan maaruu, saree, qooshaa, xuraawaa
Keywords_EN: roam village, dog, baking pan, defilement

Mammaaksa_AO: Boosattiin kajeellaaf mana namaatti tiratti
Translation_Literal_EN: The lazy woman crawls to others' homes out of craving.
Meaning_AO: Hojjatanii nyaachuu dhiisanii mana ormaatti kajeeluu fi hirkattummaadhaan jiraachuuf yaaluu.
Meaning_EN: The shiftless woman drags herself to neighbors' homes, coveting a handout rather than cooking.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota hojjechuu nuffanii wanta namni biraa bilcheesse kajeelanii dhaqan balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn unenterprising people who shamelessly hover around neighbors' mealtimes seeking food.
Keywords_AO: boosattii, kajeellaa, mana namaa, tirachuu
Keywords_EN: lazy woman, coveting, neighbor's house, crawl

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati masluufaa ,qanqalloo bobaa  kaayyateeti, uuda teeysee callaa kadhatti
Translation_Literal_EN: The spendthrift's mother tucks a sack, begging at the threshing floor.
Meaning_AO: Dhibaa'ummaan fi qisaasamni maatii dhumarratti maatii guutuu gara kadhaattii fi salphinatti geessa.
Meaning_EN: The shiftless wastrel's mother tucks a sack under her arm to sit at others' threshing floors begging.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qisaasamni fi hojjechuu dhabuun maatii akkamitti akka salphisu agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to depict the humiliation of families whose laziness reduces them to begging at harvest time.
Keywords_AO: masluufa, qanqalloo, uuda, callaa, kadhachuu
Keywords_EN: spendthrift, sack, threshing floor, grain, begging

Mammaaksa_AO: Muudee warra gaaraa, osoo hin miiccine daara
Translation_Literal_EN: The dress of mountain folk is worn without ever washing.
Meaning_AO: Qulqullina eeggachuu dhiisanii wantuma qaban xuraawaa taasisanii uffachuu fi itti dhibaa'uu.
Meaning_EN: The finery of backward folks is worn day in and day out without ever being washed; unwashed squalor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota uffata fi qaama ofii dhiqachuu jibban qulqullina akka eeggatan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize individuals who wear dirty garments continuously without bothering to wash them.
Keywords_AO: muudee, warra gaaraa, miiccuu, daara, qulqullina
Keywords_EN: ornament, mountain folk, wash, wear out, dirty

Mammaaksa_AO: Qoree dur dirteef, hiyyeessi hokkola
Translation_Literal_EN: For a thorn that pricked long ago, the pauper still limps.
Meaning_AO: Hiyyeessi ykn dadhabaan madaa fi dhibee durii yaalii dhabuun yeroo dheeraa ittiin dhiphachaa jiraata.
Meaning_EN: For a thorn that pricked him long ago, the poor man still limps; poverty leaves minor injuries untreated.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hiyyummaan wanta xiqqoo furmaata dhabsiisee rakkoo bara baraa akka godhu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight how lack of resources turns a simple, treatable mishap into a permanent affliction.
Keywords_AO: qoree, diruu, hiyyeessa, hokkoluu
Keywords_EN: thorn, pierce, poor, limp, untreated

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaalii kan bishaanii du'eeti, kan qoraanii gala
Translation_Literal_EN: The camel sent for water dies, the one for firewood returns.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi iddoo balaan irraa hin eegamnetti namni dhabamuu danda'a, carraan namaa kan hin beekamne ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: The camel sent to the water-source dies, while the one sent for firewood returns; unpredictable fate.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka nageenyaa irraa balaan dhufuu fi bakka sodaatamu irraa nagaan bahuu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on the paradoxical nature of fate where safe ventures bring death while dangerous ones spare life.
Keywords_AO: gaala, bishaan, du'uu, qoraan, galuu
Keywords_EN: camel, water, die, firewood, return, fate

Mammaaksa_AO: Hadaamiin ollaa hagamsaa immimmaan hin qoorfattu
Translation_Literal_EN: The euphorbia near the thorny shrub never dries its tears.
Meaning_AO: Nama hamaa fi qoreessaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuun yeroo hundumaa madaa fi boo'icha fida.
Meaning_EN: The euphorbia neighboring the thorny carissa shrub never dries its weeping sap; living beside toxicity brings sorrow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ollaa ykn hiriyaa hamaa nama miidhu waliin jiraachuun gadda itti fufaa akka fidu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe someone trapped in perpetual distress due to proximity to aggressive, thorny neighbors.
Keywords_AO: hadaamii, hagamsa, imimmaan, qoorfachuu
Keywords_EN: euphorbia, thorny shrub, tears, dry, toxic neighbor

Mammaaksa_AO: Aayyadaan(haati biddeenaa) aduu ganamaati
Translation_Literal_EN: A stepmother is like the morning sun.
Meaning_AO: Aduun ganamaa yeroof kan ho'istu fakkaattus boodarra gara qorrisiisaatti akka jijjiiramu, haati biddeenaas garaa dhugaa hin qabdu.
Meaning_EN: A stepmother is like the early morning sun; seemingly gentle and warm at first, but harsh and deceptive beneath.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haati biddeenaa jaalala sobaa agarsiistus garaan ishee qulqulluu akka hin taane ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used traditionally to observe the deceptive, superficial warmth displayed by stepmothers toward stepchildren.
Keywords_AO: aayyadaa, haadha biddeenaa, aduu ganamaa, miira
Keywords_EN: stepmother, morning sun, deceptive, warmth

Mammaaksa_AO: Aduu ganamaatii fi aayyadaan osoo hin bekne nama miiti
Translation_Literal_EN: The morning sun and a stepmother harm one unawares.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan isaanii suuta suutaan kan dhufu waan ta'eef osoo of hin barin nama hubu.
Meaning_EN: Both the morning sun and a stepmother inflict harm insidiously, damaging you before you even notice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta ykn nama suuta nama miidhu irraa akka of eeggatan gorfachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against subtle, creeping forms of hostility or overexposure that poison comfort imperceptibly.
Keywords_AO: aduu ganamaa, aayyadaa, beekuu, miidhuu
Keywords_EN: morning sun, stepmother, unnoticed, harm

Mammaaksa_AO: Tiifuu fi aayyadaan, malaan nama miiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Drizzle and a stepmother harm a person by stealth.
Meaning_AO: Tiifuun suuta jiistee akka nama qorrisiiftu, haati biddeenaas tooftaa dhokataan daa'ima miiti.
Meaning_EN: Drizzle and a stepmother erode one by stealth; gentle drops soak through just as covert spite wounds deep.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa dhokataa fi suuta suutaan nama barbadeessu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out insidious, gradual abuse that operates beneath polite domestic pretense like soaking drizzle.
Keywords_AO: tiifuu, aayyadaa, mala, miidhuu
Keywords_EN: drizzle, stepmother, stealth, harm

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleef taphaa, billaachaaf lubbu
Translation_Literal_EN: For children it is play, for the butterfly it is life.
Meaning_AO: Wanti namoota humna qabaniif taphaa fi bashannana ta'e namoota dadhaboof balaa lubbuuti.
Meaning_EN: What is careless play for the children is a matter of life and death for the butterfly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa fi dhiphina ormaa akka taphaatti ilaaluu dhoorkuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish thoughtless cruelty where powerful individuals treat another's existential crisis as a joke.
Keywords_AO: joollee, tapha, billaacha, lubbuu
Keywords_EN: children, game, butterfly, life, disparity

Mammaaksa_AO: Adurree taphaa, hantuutaa lubbu
Translation_Literal_EN: For the cat it is play, for the mouse it is life.
Meaning_AO: Dhiibbaa fi gidiraan abbaa humnaatiin akka taphaatti raawwatamu miidhamaadhaaf dhimma du'aa fi jireenyaati.
Meaning_EN: What is a game of cat-and-mouse to the predator is a fight for sheer survival to the prey.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aangoo-qabeeyyiin dhiphina namoota gadi aanoo irratti yeroo baacan mormuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight the stark inequality in conflict where the tormentor sports casually while the victim suffers.
Keywords_AO: adurree, tapha, hantuuta, lubbuu
Keywords_EN: cat, play, mouse, life, predator

Mammaaksa_AO: Sangaa ofiinuu alba'u eegee qabdee raaftaa?
Translation_Literal_EN: Will you shake the tail of an ox with diarrhea?
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo duraanuu dhangala'ee fi manca'aa jiru keessa harka naqanii qisaasama itti dabaluu.
Meaning_EN: Would you grab the tail and shake an ox that already has diarrhea? Rashly aggravating a messy disaster.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma duraanuu badaa fi manca'aa jiru seeraan ala tuquun of xureessuu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against meddling foolishly in an already volatile, foul, and uncontainable situation.
Keywords_AO: sangaa, alba'uu, eegee, raasuu, balaa
Keywords_EN: ox, diarrhea, tail, shake, foolish meddling

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakakkaan titiifuu keessa hammaata
Translation_Literal_EN: Lightning strikes fiercest amidst gentle drizzle.
Meaning_AO: Wanta salphaa fi nagaa fakkaatu keessaa balaan guddaan fi hin eegamne dhohuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Lightning strikes most destructively from within deceptive, gentle drizzle; quiet waters conceal fierce peril.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haala nagaa fi tasgabbaa'aa fakkaatu keessatti dammaqina akka hin dhabne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise vigilance in seemingly mild situations, warning that catastrophic strikes often emerge from quiet skies.
Keywords_AO: bakakkaa, tiitiffuu, hammaachuu, balaa
Keywords_EN: lightning, drizzle, fierce, sudden disaster

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaa dhiiraa cittooyte jennaan bubu'e je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: Told "Hero, you have scabies," he said "I peeled."
Meaning_AO: Badii fi dhibee qaamaa ofii kabajaan ibsuu yaaluun salphina dhoksuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: When told "Sir hero, you have scabies," he replied, "I have merely exfoliated"; dressing a flaw in grand words.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hanqinaa fi salphina ifa ta'e jechoota bareedoo fi dhaadannoodhaan dhoksuuf kan yaalan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock individuals who use heroic or euphemistic language to disguise embarrassing ailments or blunders.
Keywords_AO: abbaa dhiiraa, cittoo, bubu'uu, fakeentee
Keywords_EN: hero, scabies, peel, euphemism, vanity

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbi balbala foonii tan adurreen keessaan nyaattu, tan waraabeysi alaan nyaatu nu hin godhin
Translation_Literal_EN: God forbid us being a meat door eaten by cats within and hyenas without.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaa karaa lamaanuu namatti dhufu irraa, diina keessaa fi diina alaa jidduutti saamamuurraa Rabbiin akka nama baraaru kadhachuu.
Meaning_EN: May God not make us a door of meat devoured by the domestic cat from within and the savage hyena from without.
Theme_EN: Double Peril: Internal Betrayal & External Attack
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoo fi saaminsa karaa keessaas karaa alaas nama qoru irraa akka baraaraman kadhachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as an earnest prayer against being squeezed and plundered simultaneously by internal traitors and external foes.
Keywords_AO: Rabbi, foon, balbala, adurree, waraabessa
Keywords_EN: God, meat, door, cat, hyena, double jeopardy

Mammaaksa_AO: Willee fi dhakaa wal daaku, kan jidduu jiruutu miidhama
Translation_Literal_EN: When millstones grind together, what lies between is crushed.
Meaning_AO: Humnoonni gurguddoon lama yoo wal lolu ykn wal morkatan, namni hiyyeessi fi dadhabaan jidduu jiru miidhama.
Meaning_EN: When two heavy millstones grind against each other, whatever lies caught between them gets crushed to powder.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waldhabdee qaamolee gurguddoo jidduutti ummanni nagaan akka hin miidhamne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament how powerless innocents get caught and obliterated in the ferocious clashes of rival powers.
Keywords_AO: willee, dhagaa, daakuu, miidhamuu
Keywords_EN: upper millstone, stone, grind, crushed, collateral damage

Mammaaksa_AO: Qaaceelchaan Rabbuma
Translation_Literal_EN: The true guide is God alone.
Meaning_AO: Namni karaa qajeelaa qabsiisuu fi jireenya namaa sirreessu Waaqayyo qofa ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: True guidance, righteousness, and direction come from God alone; human effort without divine favor fails.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta hundumaa keessatti qajeelcha fi eebba Waaqayyoo abdatanii jiraachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to acknowledge that moral direction, justice, and success are solely determined by divine guidance.
Keywords_AO: qaaceelchaa, Rabbi, qajeelaa, amantii
Keywords_EN: guide, God, righteous, faith

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin Rabbii suuta
Translation_Literal_EN: The decree of God works patiently.
Meaning_AO: Murtii fi adabbiin Waaqayyoo yeroo isaatti suuta dhufa malee hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: God's justice and providence unfold patiently and deliberately; divine timing never rushes nor fails.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haqa ykn deebii Waaqayyoo eeggachuuf obsi akka barbaachisu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel patience, reassuring that divine retribution and blessings operate on their own time.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, Rabbi, suuta, obsa
Keywords_EN: matter, God, slowly, patience, divine timing

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni kadhachuu hin dhiisu Rabbi waan murate hin dhiisu
Translation_Literal_EN: Man ceases not praying, God wavers not from His decree.
Meaning_AO: Namni abdii fi kadhannaa godha, garuu dhumarratti fedhii fi murtiin Waaqayyoo qofti raawwatama.
Meaning_EN: Man never ceases praying, while God never wavers from His decree; human prayer meets sovereign will.
Usage_Situation_AO: Kadhachuun dirqama namaa yoo ta'u, murtii dhumaa garuu fedha Waaqaatiif dhiisuu akka qaban ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that while prayer is a human duty, ultimate submission belongs to God's decree.
Keywords_AO: kadhachuu, Rabbi, murachuu, dhiisuu
Keywords_EN: pray, God, decree, surrender

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbi duubaa lafti hin baaftu
Translation_Literal_EN: Without God's will, the earth yields nothing.
Meaning_AO: Eebbaa fi hayyama Waaqayyoo malee carraaqqiin lafaa fi qonnaan bu'aa hin argamsiisu.
Meaning_EN: Without the will and blessing of God, the earth will yield no harvest; all bounty stems from grace.
Theme_EN: Dependence of Nature on Divine Blessing
Usage_Situation_AO: Oomishaa fi bu'aa jireenyaa argachuuf eebba Waaqaatu dursa jedhanii amanuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express humble dependence on God, noting that soil fertility and harvest require divine blessing.
Keywords_AO: Rabbi, lafa, baasuu, eebba
Keywords_EN: God, earth, produce, blessing

Mammaaksa_AO: Amrii Rabbi duubaa baalli mukaa hin buune
Translation_Literal_EN: Without God's decree, not a leaf falls from a tree.
Meaning_AO: Uumama guutuu keessatti fedha fi beekumsa Waaqayyoo malee wanti xiqqoon tokkollee hin raawwatamu.
Meaning_EN: Not a single leaf falls from a tree without God's command; absolute divine omniscience and control.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti kamuu kan ta'u hayyama Waaqaatiin qofa ta'uu mirkaneessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm the absolute, detailed sovereignty of God over every minor event in creation.
Keywords_AO: amrii, Rabbi, baala, bu'uu
Keywords_EN: decree, God, leaf, fall, omniscience

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama Rabbiin itti jiru, dhagaatu oloo jala borora
Translation_Literal_EN: For one God favors, even a stone slides under comfortably.
Meaning_AO: Namni eebba fi eegumsa Waaqayyoo qabu balaa fi rakkina keessaa haala nama dhibuun nagaan baha.
Meaning_EN: For the one whom God favors, even a sharp stone slides smoothly under them; divine favor eases all friction.
Theme_EN: Miraculous Ease Brought by Divine Favor
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni Waaqayyo isa wajjin jiru gufuun kamiyyuu akka isa hin miine yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate the effortless protection and comfort enjoyed by a person under divine grace.
Keywords_AO: nama, Rabbi, dhagaa, bororuu
Keywords_EN: person, God, stone, slide, divine favor

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama Rabbiin itti jiru, hantuutaa qara qottoo duraa nyaata
Translation_Literal_EN: For one God favors, a mouse eats before the axe blade.
Meaning_AO: Eebbi Waaqayyoo namaaf yoo ta'e, wanti balaa guddaa qabu illee bu'aa fi nagaa namaaf ta'a.
Meaning_EN: For the one blessed by God, even a mouse feeds safely right at the edge of the axe; peril turns harmless.
Theme_EN: Safety in Peril through Divine Grace
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni carraan eebbifame balaa keessatti illee milkaa'ina akka argatu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show how divinely favored individuals find sustenance and safety in the sharpest situations.
Keywords_AO: Rabbi, hantuuta, qottoo, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: God, mouse, axe, eat, divine protection

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni Rabbiin itti jiru, tan garaa qabdu fuudha
Translation_Literal_EN: The man favored by God marries an expectant woman.
Meaning_AO: Namni eebbi Waaqaa isa qaqqabe carraa fi bu'aa saffisaa ta'e kan hin eegamne argata.
Meaning_EN: The man favored by God marries a woman already expecting; gaining an instant family through luck.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni tokko carraa addaa fi bu'aa daddafaa yoo argate qishnaadhaan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously to describe someone who unexpectedly inherits an immediate, ready-made advantage.
Keywords_AO: nama, Rabbi, garaa qabdu, fuudhuu
Keywords_EN: person, God, pregnant, marry, windfall

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan Rabbiin baasa itti fide, abjuudhaan dibaa guura
Translation_Literal_EN: One upon whom God brought calamity gathers butter in dreams.
Meaning_AO: Namni carraan isaa badee fi adabbiin itti dhufe abjuu sobaatiin of gowwoomsaa kasaaratti deema.
Meaning_EN: One marked for misfortune by fate gathers imaginary wealth in dreams while hurtling toward ruin.

Mammaaksa_AO: Adurree, saree fi dubartii adabaan guddisan
Translation_Literal_EN: Cats, dogs, and women are raised with discipline.
Meaning_AO: Dhaabbilee fi miseensota maatii naamusaa fi sirna aadaatiin qajeelchuun barbaachisaa ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: Domestic companions and family members require steady discipline, manners, and customary guidance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aadaa durii keessatti naamusaa fi adaba maatii barsiisuu yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in traditional contexts to emphasize the necessity of firm discipline in domestic life.
Keywords_AO: adurree, saree, dubartii, adaba
Keywords_EN: cat, dog, woman, discipline, upbringing

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubraa fi jiboota, garaa goggoga leenjisan
Translation_Literal_EN: Maidens and young bulls are trained with a dry belly.
Meaning_AO: Ijoollee fi beelladoota umurii ijoollummaa fi qananii malee leenjisuun bu'a qabeessa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Maidens and young bulls are trained when young and austere; discipline is instilled before comfort spoils.
Usage_Situation_AO: Daa'imman osoo hin qanin eegalanii barsiisuun boruuf akka isaan ijaaru yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that youth should be disciplined and hardened before excessive pampering makes them stubborn.
Keywords_AO: dubra, jibbicha, garaa goggoga, leenjisuu
Keywords_EN: maiden, bull, dry belly, train, austerity

Mammaaksa_AO: Mucaan hin dhaanne, yoo itti dheekkaman booya
Translation_Literal_EN: A child not disciplined with a cane weeps at a scolding.
Meaning_AO: Daa'imni ijoollummaatti adaba fi qajeelcha hin argatin waan xiqqoodhaan naha, hamilee dhabeessa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: A pampered child who was never corrected with discipline breaks into tears at the mildest rebuke.
Usage_Situation_AO: Daa'imman garmalee qanansiisanii jireenyaaf qophii dhabsiisuu balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize over-indulgent parenting that leaves children emotionally fragile and unable to handle criticism.
Keywords_AO: mucaa, dhaanuu, dheekkamuu, booyuu
Keywords_EN: child, cane, scold, weep, pampering

Mammaaksa_AO: Uleen, okkotee qofa cabsa
Translation_Literal_EN: A stick breaks only the clay pot.
Meaning_AO: Humni fi adabbiin qaama laafaa fi dadhabaa irratti qofa hojjeta malee jabaa hin jijjiiru.
Meaning_EN: The rod breaks only the fragile clay pot; physical violence shatters the brittle without curing the deep flaw.
Theme_EN: Limits of Physical Force on Brittle Objects
Usage_Situation_AO: Adabbii garmalee gargaaramuun wanta qulqulluu balleessuu malee furmaata akka hin fidne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution that blind, physical punishment only shatters delicate spirits without resolving root problems.
Keywords_AO: ulee, okkotee, cabsuu, humna
Keywords_EN: stick, clay pot, break, force, limit

Mammaaksa_AO: Uleen, buqqee qofaaf hin tolle
Translation_Literal_EN: The stick was not made solely for the gourd.
Meaning_AO: Adabbiin fi qajeelchi nama tokko qofaaf osoo hin taane hundaafuu barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: The rod is not crafted for the gourd alone; discipline and accountability apply universally.
Usage_Situation_AO: Seerrii fi adabbiin nama kamuu irratti qixxee hojjechuu akka qabu yeroo himan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that corrections and accountability apply across the board, not just to a chosen few.
Keywords_AO: ulee, buqqee, toluu, seera
Keywords_EN: stick, gourd, proper, universal discipline

Mammaaksa_AO: Mootii karaa deemaa, adabaa namaan deema
Translation_Literal_EN: Even a traveling king journeys with courtesy toward people.
Meaning_AO: Mootiiniis ta'ee abbaan aangoo kabajaa fi adaba hawaasaa eegee yoo deeme qofa nagaan jiraata.
Meaning_EN: Even a king traveling abroad must journey with courtesy and respect toward ordinary people.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni aangoo qaban yeroo hawaasa keessa deeman of tuuluu dhiisanii kabajaan akka deddeebi'an gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct that power holders must observe etiquette, humility, and manners when moving among the public.
Keywords_AO: mootii, karaa deemuu, adaba, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: king, travel, manners, courtesy, humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Naamusni birille, eeggatan malee ni capha
Translation_Literal_EN: Discipline is like a glass bottle; unguarded, it breaks.
Meaning_AO: Naamusni fi amalli gaariin akkuma meeshaa birilleetti salphaatti kan badu waan ta'eef of eeggannoo guddaa barbaada.
Meaning_EN: Character and integrity are like fine crystal; fragile and easily shattered unless carefully guarded.
Usage_Situation_AO: Naamusaa fi kabajaa ofii yeroodhaa yerootti eeggachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind individuals that personal honor and moral standing are delicate treasures that require vigilance.
Keywords_AO: naamusa, birillee, eeggachuu, cabuu
Keywords_EN: character, glass bottle, protect, break, fragile

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaa fi ijoolleen hin dhagoomamani
Translation_Literal_EN: The stomach and children cannot be reasoned with by excuses.
Meaning_AO: Beelli fi daa'imman wanta nyaatamu yeroodhaan yoo hin arganne obsa hin qaban, mariin hin deebisan.
Meaning_EN: Neither the belly nor young children can be put off with persuasive excuses; hunger demands real food.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma beelaa fi fedhii daa'immaniitiif qophii hatattamaa gochuun dirqama ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to state that physical hunger and distressed children cannot be pacified with empty talk.
Keywords_AO: garaa, ijoollee, dhagowamuu, beela
Keywords_EN: stomach, children, reasoned with, hunger

Mammaaksa_AO: Adaba dhaba, sareen magaalaa dhayxi
Translation_Literal_EN: For lack of discipline, the dog roams into the market.
Meaning_AO: Namni naamusaa fi daangaa ofii hin beekne bakka isaaf hin malle deemee salphinaaf saaxilama.
Meaning_EN: Lacking domestic discipline, the stray dog roams into the crowded marketplace and gets beaten.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota naamusaa fi daangaa ofii eeggachuu dhabanii bakka hin taanetti salphatan ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke indiscreet people whose lack of personal boundaries leads them to wander into public trouble.
Keywords_AO: adaba dhaba, saree, magaalaa, dhaquu
Keywords_EN: lack discipline, dog, market, stray, disgrace

Mammaaksa_AO: Oduun, soora gurraati
Translation_Literal_EN: News is nourishment for the ear.
Meaning_AO: Gurri oduu fi odeeffannoo dhagahuu akka uumamaatti kan jaalatu fi ittiin sooramu ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: News and stories are food for the ears; human nature is innately hungry for information and tales.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni oduu haaraa dhaggeeffachuuf fedhii guddaa qabaachuu isaanii ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain why people instinctively crave news, conversation, and storytelling.
Keywords_AO: oduu, soora, gurra, quunnamtii
Keywords_EN: news, food, ear, curiosity, storytelling

Mammaaksa_AO: Asii baatee, biyyaa hunda deemti
Translation_Literal_EN: Departing from here, it roams across every land.
Meaning_AO: Oduun ykn afaan namni tokko buuse saffisaan fagaatee bakka hundatti faca'a.
Meaning_EN: Originating right here, a rumor travels to every distant land; news travels with lightning speed.
Theme_EN: Rapid Spread of Rumors and News
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduun afaan tokko irraa bahe battalatti biyya guutuu qaqqabuu isaa yoo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution that a single spoken word quickly spreads uncontrollably throughout the community.
Keywords_AO: bahuu, biyya, deemuu, oduu, saffisa
Keywords_EN: depart, land, travel, rumor, spread

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurraa fi garaan walii diina
Translation_Literal_EN: The ear and the stomach are enemies to each other.
Meaning_AO: Gurri oduu fi haasawa dhagahuu jaalata, garaan garuu nyaata qofa barbaada; oduun beela hin baasu.
Meaning_EN: The ear and the stomach are mutually hostile; listening to tales feeds the ears but starves the belly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduu dhaggeeffachuu irratti yeroo gubanii hojii fi nyaata dagachuun akka hin taane gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind gossips that idle chatter does nothing to fill the empty stomach.
Keywords_AO: gurra, garaa, diina, oduu, nyaata
Keywords_EN: ear, stomach, enemy, news, food

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabaan (magaalaan) hin argin farso qabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: The unseen market has the best beer.
Meaning_AO: Bakka hin geenye fi hin beekne garmalee faarsuun fi akka waan wanti hundi guutuu ta'etti hawwuun amala namaati.
Meaning_EN: The distant, unseen market is always imagined to sell the finest beer; distant grass seems greener.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta hin agarre oduudhaan qofa garmalee mi'eessanii faarsuu qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to deflate exaggerated praise of distant places, noting that imagination always glorifies the unseen.
Keywords_AO: gabaa, magaalaa, farsoo, arguu, hawwii
Keywords_EN: market, town, beer, unseen, greener grass

Mammaaksa_AO: Maqaan guyyaa magaalaa bade, guyyaa magaalaati deebi'a
Translation_Literal_EN: A name ruined on market day is restored on market day.
Meaning_AO: Salphinni fi odeeffannoon sobaa bakka heddumminaatti faca'e bakka sanattiyyuu ifatti qulqullaa'uu qaba.
Meaning_EN: A reputation tarnished on market day must be cleared on market day; public slander demands public redress.
Usage_Situation_AO: Komii fi maqaa balleessii uummata duratti dhufe ummatuma duratti deebisanii sirreessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demand that public defamation be answered and corrected publicly in the same forum.
Keywords_AO: maqaa, guyyaa magaalaa, baduu, deebi'uu
Keywords_EN: reputation, market day, ruin, restore, public vindication

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan odeessanii fi waan bobeessan hin dhabani
Translation_Literal_EN: One never lacks what to talk about, nor what to kindle.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni haasawaaf yoo ta'e oduu fi qoraan bobeessan yoomiyyuu sababa hin dhaban.
Meaning_EN: One never lacks fuel to kindle a hearth, nor gossip to fuel an idle tongue; talk is ever-abundant.
Theme_EN: Endless Supply of Gossip and Words
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduun fi hasaasi yoomiyyuu kan hin dhumne ta'uu fi namoonni waan odeessan hin dhabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that there is never an end to human gossip, just as dry twigs are always found for kindling.
Keywords_AO: odeessuu, bobeessuu, dhabuu, haasawa
Keywords_EN: talk, kindle, lack, gossip, inexhaustible

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbu dheeraa'rra, miila dheeraa dubbii gaafadhaa
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than the long-lived, ask the long-legged for news.
Meaning_AO: Nama umuriin dheerate caalaa namni biyya arge fi imale oduu fi haala qabatamaa beeka.
Meaning_EN: Rather than consulting the long-lived, inquire of the long-traveled; mobility teaches current realities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Odeeffannoo haaraa fi qabatamaa beekuuf nama biyya deemee arge gaafachuu akka wayyu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise seeking fresh news from someone who has physically traveled rather than someone sedentary.
Keywords_AO: lubbuu dheeraa, miila dheeraa, dubbii, gaafachuu
Keywords_EN: long life, long legs, news, inquire, traveler

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirti gurraan rimayooyteeti, afaaniin dhalti
Translation_Literal_EN: Men conceive with their ears and give birth with their mouths.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni oduu gurraan dhagahanii qabatanii battaluma sana afaaniin nama hundatti odeessanii facaasu.
Meaning_EN: Men impregnate their minds with what they hear and give birth to it through their mouths; rumors spread fast.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota oduu dhagahan hunda osoo hin qulqulleeffatin afaaniin facaasan qeequuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize people who cannot keep anything to themselves, blabbing every rumor immediately.
Keywords_AO: dhiira, gurra, rimayoo'uu, afaan, dhaluu
Keywords_EN: men, ear, conceive, mouth, give birth, blabber

Mammaaksa_AO: Bira hin jirreen, gaafa bira jiraniif hin tolle
Translation_Literal_EN: Gossiping of the absent spoils the day they are present.
Meaning_AO: Nama bakka hin jirretti hamachuun gaafa inni dhufe wal qunnamtii fi nagaa balleessa.
Meaning_EN: Slandering someone in their absence ruins the relationship and poisons the air when they are present.
Theme_EN: Perils of Backbiting When Faces Meet
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bakka hin jirre hamachuun gaafa inni dhufe qaanii fi lolatti akka nama geessu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against talking behind people's backs, as the embarrassment when meeting in person is severe.
Keywords_AO: bira hin jirre, hamachuu, gaafa, toluu dhabuu
Keywords_EN: absent, slander, present, awkwardness, backbiting

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurri, bishaan isa seenu qofa jibba
Translation_Literal_EN: The ear hates only water entering; it welcomes all gossip.
Meaning_AO: Gurri oduu kamuu—gaariis ta'ee hamaa—dhaggeeffachuuf banaa dha; wanta isa miidhu qofa dhoowwa.
Meaning_EN: The ear rejects only water pouring into it; otherwise it eagerly absorbs all manner of gossip and tales.
Theme_EN: The Ear's Indiscriminate Appetite for News
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni oduu dhagahuuf gurra isaanii qopheessuun uumama isaanii ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe humorously how ready human ears are to drink in all gossip, drawing the line only at water.
Keywords_AO: gurra, bishaan, seenuu, jibbuu, oduu
Keywords_EN: ear, water, enter, hate, gossip appetite

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'idoon faltii nyaateen, labsuma Rabbiiti
Translation_Literal_EN: The report that Sa'ido ate dung is like a decree of God.
Meaning_AO: Oduun salphinaa fi maqa-balleessii nama irratti faca'e balaa cimaa uumaan fide fakkaata.
Meaning_EN: The shocking rumor that Sa'ido ate dung strikes like a cruel divine decree; scandalous news destroys.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduun badaa fi salphisaan nama tokko irratti bahee akka hin danda'amnetti maqaa yoo balleessu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express how an outrageous scandal ruins a person's standing with the finality of a divine stroke.
Keywords_AO: Sa'idoo, faltii, nyaachuu, labsa, Rabbi
Keywords_EN: Sa'ido, dung, eat, decree, scandal

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaartiin Baalee, harkaan buna akoofti,afaaniin waan baraa qaaqxi
Translation_Literal_EN: The old woman of Bale roasts coffee, babbling of the times.
Meaning_AO: Hojii ofii hojjechaa oduu fi dhimma biyyaa odeessuun amala namoota hedduu ta'uu.
Meaning_EN: The old woman of Bale roasts coffee with her hands while ceaselessly babbling about current affairs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni hojii idilee hojjechaa dhimma addunyaa odeessuun yeroo dabarsan ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe people who combine daily chores with non-stop commentary on politics and neighborhood news.
Keywords_AO: jaartii, Baalee, buna, akoofuu, qaaquu
Keywords_EN: old woman, Bale, coffee, roast, chatter

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waan argani dhagayan" jette, harreen
Translation_Literal_EN: "One listens to what one sees with one's eyes," said the donkey.
Meaning_AO: Oduu nama biraa amanuu mannaa wanta ijaan argan irratti xiyyeeffachuun mirkanaa'aadha.
Meaning_EN: "One heeds only what one witnesses firsthand," said the donkey; prioritize direct sight over hearsay.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduu afaanii dhiisanii dhugaa ijaan mul'atu qofa amanuu akka qaban yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel relying on verifiable firsthand visual evidence rather than secondhand gossip.
Keywords_AO: arguu, dhagahuu, harree, ragaa
Keywords_EN: see, hear, donkey, evidence, eyewitness

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilma duuti ankoobarrii, haati gaafa dhageesse boochi
Translation_Literal_EN: For a son who died in Ankober, his mother weeps when she hears.
Meaning_AO: Gaddi fi dhiphinni kan namatti dhufu yeroo oduun nama qaqqabeedha malee gaafa ta'ee miti.
Meaning_EN: For the son who perished in distant Ankober, his mother mourns on the day the news reaches her; grief awaits word.
Theme_EN: Impact of Distant News on Emotion
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduun hanga nama hin qaqqabnetti namni nagaa ta'uu, garuu gaafa dhageeffatan gaddi eegaluu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect on how emotional reality is triggered by the arrival of news rather than the moment of occurrence.
Keywords_AO: ilma, du'a, Ankoobar, haadha, booyuu
Keywords_EN: son, death, Ankober, mother, weep, news

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan biyya biyyaa, bilbillii iyya
Translation_Literal_EN: Concerning the news of each land, the bell sounds.
Meaning_AO: Dhimmi fi oduun biyya hundaa karaa adda addaatiin mul'atee ifatti baha.
Meaning_EN: Concerning the affairs of every land, the alarm bell tolls; every region's news eventually sounds aloud.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduun hawaasaa fi biyyaa dhokachuu akka hin dandeenye yeroo ibsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that events in every realm eventually resonate and broadcast themselves far and wide.
Keywords_AO: biyya, bilbila, iyyuu, oduu
Keywords_EN: land, bell, toll, news, broadcast

Mammaaksa_AO: Qaban qabaa hin guuttu, gadi dhiisan lafa guutti
Translation_Literal_EN: Held secret it fills not a palm; released it covers the earth.
Meaning_AO: Dubbii ykn oduun afaan keessatti xiqqoodha, garuu yoo baaftee dubbatte biyya guutuu qaqqabdi.
Meaning_EN: Cupped in secret it does not fill a palm; once released into speech it floods the entire land; words' reach.
Theme_EN: Small Secret vs. Vast Public Proliferation
Usage_Situation_AO: Afaan ofii to'achuun barbaachisaa ta'uu fi dubbiin baanaan hin qabamne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach discretion, emphasizing how a tiny whispered secret explodes across the world once spoken aloud.
Keywords_AO: qabuu, gadi dhiisuu, lafa, guutuu, dubbii
Keywords_EN: hold, release, earth, fill, words, secrecy

Mammaaksa_AO: Bira hin jirreen, nama yarsiti
Translation_Literal_EN: The condition of being absent diminishes a person.
Meaning_AO: Bakka dhimmi ofii irratti mari'atamu ykn falmatamutti argamuu dhabuun haqa ofii akka dhaban godha.
Meaning_EN: Being absent causes one to be belittled and cheated; absence forfeits representation and voice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma ofii irratti dhihaatanii of falmachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise people to show up and represent themselves, warning that absence leads to being marginalized.
Keywords_AO: bira hin jirre, nama, yarsuu, haqa
Keywords_EN: absent, diminish, belittle, presence

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhagaan darban dhihoo bu'eeti, gurri darban fagoo bu'e
Translation_Literal_EN: A stone thrown landed near; a word cast landed far away.
Meaning_AO: Dhagaan fagootti darbatamuu baatus, dubbiin fi maqaan garuu dachee guutuu qaqqaba.
Meaning_EN: A stone hurled falls close by, but a word or rumor cast travels vast distances.
Theme_EN: Vast Reach of Spoken Words vs. Physical Objects
Usage_Situation_AO: Dubbiin fi oduun afaanii saffisaa fi fageenya guddaa akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the infinite, uncontrollable reach of spoken words compared to physical force.
Keywords_AO: dhagaa, darbuu, dhihoo, gurra, fagoo
Keywords_EN: stone, throw, near, ear, word, far

Mammaaksa_AO: Duulli hamma oduu hin gahu
Translation_Literal_EN: The actual battle never matches the rumors.
Meaning_AO: Oduun lolaa fi waraanaa yeroo baay'ee garmalee guddisama malee qabatamni isaa sanaan wal hin gahu.
Meaning_EN: The actual battle never matches the terrifying scale of the rumors; reports are always exaggerated.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduu sodaachisaa dhagahame hunda amanuu dhiisanii qabatama ilaaluuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to calm panic, reminding that rumors of impending war are invariably exaggerated compared to reality.
Keywords_AO: duula, hamma, oduu, gahuu
Keywords_EN: campaign, battle, rumor, scale, exaggeration

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka abbaa qabuun, buutii qabachuu hin sodaatani
Translation_Literal_EN: With a hand that has an owner, one fears not grasping a viper.
Meaning_AO: Qaama ykn qabeenya nama biraatiin balaa keessa seenuuf namoonni hin qussatan; miidhaan kan nama biraati.
Meaning_EN: One does not hesitate to grab a viper using someone else's hand; people recklessly risk others' lives.
Theme_EN: Risking Others' Hands for One's Safety
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota ofii isaanii dhokatanii namoota biraa balaatti oofan balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn selfish manipulators who expose others to danger to protect themselves.
Keywords_AO: harka, abbaa qabu, buutii, qabachuu, ofittoo
Keywords_EN: hand, owner, viper, catch, selfish

Mammaaksa_AO: Hudduun abbaa tokkoo, muka itti dhiiban hin laalattu
Translation_Literal_EN: Another's rump does not mind which stick presses against it.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan nama biraa irra gahu nama ofittotti akka homaattuu hin mul'atu; quuqama dhabuu.
Meaning_EN: The hindquarters belonging to someone else don't bother the callous spectator; total lack of empathy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota miidhaa fi dhiphina namoota biraatiif dhimma hin qabne ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize individuals who display crude, total indifference to the suffering of others.
Keywords_AO: hudduu, abbaa tokkoo, muka, dhiibuu, quuqama
Keywords_EN: rump, someone else, stick, press, indifference

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka nama biraatiin, ibidda qabachuu hin sodaatani
Translation_Literal_EN: With another's hand, one fears not grasping fire.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan nama biraa irratti kan qaqqabu yoo ta'e namoonni balaa fi qormaata jabaa raawwachiisuuf hin sodaatan.
Meaning_EN: Using another person's hand, one does not fear grasping fire; using others as disposable pawns.
Theme_EN: Using Others as Pawns in Danger
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni ofii eeggachaa warra kaan ibidda keessa galchuuf tattaafatan akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose the callous hypocrisy of those who put others into harm's way while staying safe.
Keywords_AO: harka, nama biraa, ibidda, qabachuu
Keywords_EN: hand, someone else, fire, hold, exploitation

Mammaaksa_AO: Madaa nama biroo, mukaan diruun nama hin dhibu
Translation_Literal_EN: Poking another's wound with a stick causes one no pain.
Meaning_AO: Dhukkubbiin fi gaddi nama biraa abbaa irra gahe qofaaf ulfaata malee warri kaan akka laayyootti laalu.
Meaning_EN: Poking another's wound with a stick causes you no pain; it is easy to be callous about unfelt pain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota miidhaa fi madaa nama biraatti baacanii fi akka laayyootti ilaalan ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke those who casually belittle, probe, or aggravate another person's deep wounds.
Keywords_AO: madaa, nama biroo, muka, diruu
Keywords_EN: wound, someone else, stick, poke, callousness

Mammaaksa_AO: Ani mataa kootiin ba'eeraa, kan ilmaa fi intalaa hin beeku jedhe abbaan warraa
Translation_Literal_EN: "I saved my own head; I know not of son or daughter," said the master.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo balaan cimaan dhufu ofittummaan garmalee dhufee maatii ofiillee dagachiisuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: "I have escaped with my own skin; I care not for son or daughter," said the householder; raw survival.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkinaa dantaa ofii qofaaf fiiganii warra ofii ganan balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn cowardly, unprincipled abandonment of family and dependents when danger threatens.
Keywords_AO: mataa, bahuu, ilma, intala, abbaa warraa
Keywords_EN: head, save, son, daughter, household head, selfishness

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki waa namaa hiru dhedheeraa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: The hand that shares with others is long.
Meaning_AO: Arjummaan fi qoodiinsi gaariin kabajaa fi jaalala bal'aa namoota biratti namaaf kenna.
Meaning_EN: The hand that shares and dispenses with others reaches far; generosity extends one's reach and renown.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota arjaa harka bal'isanii namaaf kennan galateeffachuuf fi jajjabeessuuf.

Meaning_AO: Dhimma, itti-gaafatamummaa fi ba'aa dhuunfaa ofii nama biraatiin ba'achuun hin danda'amu; hojii ofii abbaatu hojjetata
Meaning_EN: One cannot defecate using someone else's body; you cannot delegate your fundamental personal bodily needs, moral duties, or debts to someone else
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko itti-gaafatamummaa dhuunfaa isaatii ormatti fe'uuf yaalu ceepha'anii qajeelchuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used bluntly to dismiss someone trying to shirk their fundamental duties onto another, reminding that some tasks can only be performed by oneself
Keywords_AO: hudduu; ambaa; haguu; itti-gaafatamummaa; dhuunfaa; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: buttocks; outsider; defecating; personal duty; accountability; blunt

Mammaaksa_AO: Hudduu ifii, huqqattuuni taa'ani

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya ofii isa xiqqoo tuffachuu dhiisee of danda'ee jiraachuu qabu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage self-reliance, advising someone to be content with their own meager assets rather than seeking humiliating comfort from strangers
Keywords_AO: hudduu; ifii; huqqachuu; taa'uu; of-danda'uu; quufa
Keywords_EN: buttocks; self; emaciated; sitting; independence; contentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Qalbiin ergisaa fi midhaan bitii hin barakatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Borrowed wits and bought grain have no lasting abundance
Meaning_AO: Yaada ormaatiin jiraachuunii fi wanta bitamu qofatti hirkachuun yeroo dheeraaf nama hin gahu; beekumsa fi qabeenya ofii qabaachuun barbaachisaadha

Keywords_EN: intellect; borrowed; bought grain; blessing; self-reliance; independence

Mammaaksa_AO: Hangam safii guutu, biddeenni namaa kanuma namaati
Translation_Literal_EN: However much it heaps the tray, another person's bread is still another's
Meaning_AO: Nyaanni yookaan qabeenyi ormaa hangamiyyuu baay'ee yoo ta'e, kan ofii hin ta'u; wanta ormaatti amanamuu dhiisanii kan ofii horachuu qabu

Meaning_AO: Jireenya, maatii fi bultii ofiitiif kan dursa yaaduu fi itti gaafatamummaa baachuu qabu abbuma sanaadha malee ormi dhimma kee hin bulchu

Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi nama tokkoo qofti nama lamaaf hin gahu; hiyyummaa keessaa bahuuf hundi isaaniiyyuu hojjetanii of danda'uu qabu

Meaning_AO: Namni jireenya, amala fi qe'ee ofii sirreessuu dadhabe nama biraatiifis bu'aa tokkollee hin fidu; of tolchuutu orma tolchuu dursaa

Meaning_AO: Qabeenya laafaa fi dafee dhumatu irratti hirkachuudhaan karoora guddaa jireenyaa karoorfachuun balaa akka qabu; wabii cimaa barbaaduu ibsa

Meaning_EN: One limps according to how one was broken; adapt your pace, actions, and expectations realistically to your actual wounds, resources, and limitations
