Mammaaksa_AO: Kan aalaa baalaan hin beekne, dubbii haalaan hin beeku
Translation_Literal_EN: He who knows not wild greens by their leaf knows not speech by its manner
Meaning_AO: Namni mallattoolee xixiqqoo uumamaa hubachuu dadhabe akkaataa haasaa fi ilaalcha namootaa qoratee baruu hin danda'u; dammaqina dhabuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: One who cannot identify wild plants by their leaves cannot read human intention through speech and mannerisms; lacking basic observation blinds one
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko akkaataa haasaa fi mallattoo ormaa hubachuu dadhabee gowwoomu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize someone oblivious to subtext, noting that anyone who cannot read simple environmental signs is hopeless at reading human motives
Keywords_AO: aalaa; baala; beekuu; dubbii; haala; dammaqina
Keywords_EN: wild greens; leaf; speech; context; observation; social nuance

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadha namatti dabdu, abbaatu beeka
Translation_Literal_EN: The mother who is unfair to others, her husband knows best
Meaning_AO: Namni alaan akka gaariitti mul'atus, amala isaa isa dhokataa fi jal'ina isaa kan sirriitti beeku nama dhihoo isaati; dhugaa keessoo beekuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The mother who is deceitful to outsiders, her husband knows her true nature best; intimate household partners see the unvarnished character hidden from the public
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko orma duratti akka qulqulluutti of dhiheessee garuu maatiin amala isaa isa dhugaa beeku ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when exposing someone with a polished public reputation, pointing out that their spouse knows the petty, deceitful traits hidden behind closed doors
Keywords_AO: haadha; dabuu; abbaa; beekuu; amala dhokataa; bultii
Keywords_EN: mother; crooked; husband; knowing; domestic reality; true nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaa garaa hatu, garaan haa too'atu
Translation_Literal_EN: The heart that steals from another heart, let conscience police it
Meaning_AO: Namni shiraa fi yaada dhokataadhaan nama miidhuu fedhu, qalbii fi qulqullummaa keessa isaatiin of qorachuutu irra jiraata; of-to'annoo qalbii barsiisa
Meaning_EN: The heart that secretly steals from another heart, let its own conscience restrain it; moral self-scrutiny must curb secret malice and deceit
Theme_EN: Conscience as the True Arbiter of Secret Motives
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhoksaatti nama miidhuuf yaalu qalbii fi safuu ofiitiin akka of to'atu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to appeal to internal conscience during secret disputes, reminding that when human laws cannot see hidden deceit, one's own heart must act as judge
Keywords_AO: garaa; hatuu; to'achuu; qalbii; shira; qulqullina
Keywords_EN: heart; stealing; policing; conscience; secret deceit; self-restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Namatti himan malee, namatti hin hidhani
Translation_Literal_EN: One counsels a person, but one cannot tether it onto them
Meaning_AO: Namni nama gorsuu fi dhugaa itti himuu danda'a malee, dirqamaan yaada ofii nama irratti fe'uu hin danda'u; filannoon kan abbaati
Meaning_EN: You can give advice to a person, but you cannot bind it onto their limbs; you can offer wisdom, but acceptance remains an individual's sovereign choice
Theme_EN: Offering Counsel vs. Respecting Free Agency
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsa kennameef fudhachuu dide itti dhiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an advisor has spoken their peace, accepting that while you can lead a horse to water, you cannot force another human being to accept counsel
Keywords_AO: himuu; hidhuu dhabuu; gorsa; bilisummaa; filannoo; nama
Keywords_EN: telling; binding; advice; free agency; choice; limits of counsel

Mammaaksa_AO: Re'ee dhiirti hin elmitu, hamma cophxu hin wallaaltu
Translation_Literal_EN: Men do not milk a goat, yet know how much milk she drips
Meaning_AO: Namni dhimma tokko kallattiin yoo hojjechuu baateyyuu, bu'aa fi adeemsa isaa beekuu irraa hin hafu; beekumsi daangaa hojii hin qabu
Meaning_EN: A man does not milk a goat, yet he knows full well how many drops she yields; one does not have to perform a manual chore personally to understand its output
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hoggansi yookaan abbaan qabeenyaa hojii harkaatiin hin hirmaannellee firii isaa sirriitti beeku ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used by managers and overseers to show that while they may not perform the manual task, their sharp eyes accurately track every drop of productivity
Keywords_AO: re'ee; dhiira; elmuu; cophuu; wallaaluu dhabuu; beekumsa
Keywords_EN: goat; men; milking; dripping; knowing; oversight; expertise

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan gowwaan gorsani, beekaan fudhata
Translation_Literal_EN: What they advise the fool, the wise person absorbs
Meaning_AO: Namni qaxaleen gorsa nama gowwaadhaaf kenname dhaga'ee ergaa isaanii ofiif fayyadama; beekaan dogoggora ormaarraayyuu ni barata
Meaning_EN: What is advised to the fool, the wise person absorbs; an intelligent person listens to warnings directed at fools and applies the lessons to himself
Theme_EN: The Wise Learning from Reprimands Given to Fools
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hubataan tokko adabbii nama biraarraa barumsa fudhatu faarsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise a perceptive learner who observes the public correction of a fool and quietly amends his own conduct to avoid the same mistake
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; gorsuu; beekaa; fudhachuu; barachuu; ogummaa
Keywords_EN: fool; advising; wise person; absorbing; learning from others; wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa sadi keessaa, gammi tokko hin dhabamu
Translation_Literal_EN: Among three fools, a spark of sharpness is never lacking
Meaning_AO: Namoota gowwaa ta'an keessattiyyuu yeroo tokko tokko yaanni sirriin yookaan qabxiin gaariin ni argama; homaa tuffatamuu hin qabu
Meaning_EN: Among three fools, a flash of cleverness is never missing; even among simpletons, an occasional stroke of brilliance or accidental truth emerges
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota laafaa keessaa yaanni furmaataa hin yaadamne tokko ba'u dinqisiifachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an unexpectedly clever suggestion emerges from an unlikely group, reminding that wisdom can spark from the humblest assemble of simpletons
Keywords_AO: gowwaa; sadii; gammi; dhabamuu dhabuu; yaada; beekumsa
Keywords_EN: fools; three; clever spark; presence; unexpected insight; humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni aaggata dhawina hin seene, dhawaniis hin dubbatu
Translation_Literal_EN: He who took not a raised fist as a blow will not speak when struck
Meaning_AO: Namni akeekkachiisa duraa tuffatee hin dammaqne gaafa miidhaan qabatamaan irra gahu fala dhabee cal'isa; dursee akeekkachiisa baruu dhabuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: He who did not take a raised fist as a blow will not utter a word when struck down; one who ignores obvious warnings is paralyzed when disaster arrives
Category_EN: Heeding Threats and Paralysis of Neglect
Theme_EN: Ignoring Threats Leading to Stunned Defeat
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni akeekkachiisa duraa tuffatee dhuma irratti salphina guddaa keessa galu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against ignoring cocked fists and early threats, noting that those who dismiss clear danger freeze in speechless despair when the blow lands
Keywords_AO: aaggata; dha'uu; sehuu; dubbachuu dhabuu; akeekkachiisa
Keywords_EN: raised fist; blow; believing; struck; silence; ignoring threats

Mammaaksa_AO: "Utuu haasofnuu, suni Nagarii Gundee mitii" jette maraattuun
Translation_Literal_EN: 'While we are talking, isn't that Nagarii Gundee over there?' said the madwoman
Meaning_AO: Osoo dhimma murteessaa irratti haasa'anii yaada fageessanii wanta dhimma sanaan wal hin qabne kaasanii marii jallisuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
Meaning_EN: 'While we are talking, isn't that Nagarii Gundee over there?' said the madwoman; satirizes abruptly derailing a serious conversation with random trivia
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko marii cimaa keessatti dhimma laafaa fi faayidaa hin qabne kaasee yaada namaa jeequtti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who interrupts an urgent, serious deliberation to point out an utterly irrelevant passing curiosity, breaking everyone's focus
Keywords_AO: haasa'uu; nagarii gundee; maraattuu; yaada facaasuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: conversing; random person; madwoman; distraction; derailing topic; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Hoggaa lafaa fuudhuun, bakka na waraanu beeke
Translation_Literal_EN: The moment I picked it up, I knew where it would stab me
Meaning_AO: Wanta yookaan nama tokko wajjin hariiroo yeroo jalqaban balaa fi miidhaan inni boodarra fidu dursee beekama; balaa beekamaatti seenuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The moment I picked it up from the ground, I knew where it would stab me; taking on an inherently dangerous asset with foreknowledge of its inevitable bite
Theme_EN: Knowing the Exact Wound an Enterprise Will Inflict
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma duraanuu balaa akka qabu beeku keessa seenee gaafa miidhamu gaabbu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an ill-advised venture or toxic relationship turns sour exactly as anticipated, admitting that one saw the barb coming from the very first step
Keywords_AO: lafaa fuudhuu; waraanuu; beekuu; balaa; madaallii
Keywords_EN: picking up; stabbing; knowing; foreseen danger; complicity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin ijaani nama seenti
Translation_Literal_EN: Speech enters a person through the eyes
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta dubbatamu caalaa wanta ijaan arge amana, gochi haasaa caalaa dhiibbaa uuma; fakkeenyi ijaan mul'atu qalbii seena
Meaning_EN: Truth and speech enter a person through the eyes; people are persuaded far more by what they visibly observe than by mere words; actions speak louder
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo afaaniin dubbachuu caalaa gochaan agarsiisuun nama amansiisuu akka danda'u barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advocate leading by visual example and tangible deeds, reminding that people only absorb and believe words when verified by what they see
Keywords_AO: dubbii; ija; seenuu; gocha; ragaa; amantee
Keywords_EN: speech; eye; entering; visual proof; observation; credibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni waan gale hin beekne, ta boruu hin beeku
Translation_Literal_EN: He who understands not what has transpired understands not tomorrow
Meaning_AO: Seenaa fi wanta darbe kan hin beekne gara fuulduraa tilmaamuu fi karoorfachuu hin danda'u; seenaan barumsa boruuti
Meaning_EN: He who does not understand what has transpired cannot understand what tomorrow will bring; one ignorant of history cannot anticipate the future
Theme_EN: Understanding Past Precedents to Anticipate Tomorrow
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo seenaa fi muuxannoo darberraa barachuun gara fuulduraatiif murteessaa ta'uu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge the study of history and precedent, warning that individuals or nations blind to their yesterday are utterly blind to the traps of tomorrow
Keywords_AO: galuu; beekuu; boru; seenaa; dur-argii; karoora
Keywords_EN: transpired; knowing; tomorrow; history; precedent; future foresight

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama hashara afuufu hin tahin
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not be a person who blows upon coffee chaff
Meaning_AO: Wanta salphaa, bu'aa hin qabnee fi nama miidhu keessa lixanii of hin rakkisinaa; dhimma gatii hin qabne dhiisuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: Do not be one who blows upon light coffee chaff; do not meddle with frivolous trivialities that will only blow back and blind your eyes with dust
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhimma xixiqqoo fi faayidaa hin qabne keessa seenee ija ofii jaamsuuf ka'u dhoorkuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against meddling in petty, gossipy, or volatile squabbles, reminding that blowing on light husks only gets painful chaff in your own eyes
Keywords_AO: hashara; afuufuu; ija; dhimma laafaa; of-eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: coffee husks; blowing; chaff; petty matters; backfiring; prudence

Mammaaksa_AO: Soddaan hogguu gu'a himate, dabarsa himate
Translation_Literal_EN: When the son-in-law reports the cow is dry, he is asking for a replacement
Meaning_AO: Namni haala rakkisaa tokko yeroo himatu gargaarsa yookaan bakka bu'iinsa akka barbaadu beekanii hubachuun ogummaa ta'uu ibsa; haasaa keessa ergaa baruu
Meaning_EN: When the son-in-law announces that the cow is dry, he is asking for a replacement; understand the underlying request beneath a polite report of depletion
Theme_EN: Understanding the Implicit Request Beneath a Report
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni haasaa dhiheesse keessatti fedhii dhokataa qabu qalbifachuun barbaachisu itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate social perception, recognizing that when an in-law reports an empty barn or dry cow, etiquette requires offering a fresh replacement
Keywords_AO: soddaa; gu'a; himachuu; dabarsa; aadaa; hubannoo
Keywords_EN: in-law; dry cow; reporting; replacement; indirect request; subtext

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo akkaan gadi ilaalan mixiin ija qabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: If one looks down very closely, even the tiny ant has eyes
Meaning_AO: Wanti yookaan namni kamuu yoo xiyyeeffannaan qoratame dandeettii fi gatii mataa isaa qaba; homaa tuffatamuu hin qabu
Meaning_EN: If you look closely enough, even the tiny ant possesses eyes; no creature, person, or detail is entirely without perception, value, or capability
Theme_EN: Inherent Perception and Worth in Small Things
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni wanta xiqqoo yookaan nama laafaa akka waan gatii hin qabneetti tuffatan qajeelchuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn superficial dismissal of small things, reminding that close, respectful inspection reveals that even the humblest being possesses sight and wit
Keywords_AO: gadi ilaaluu; mixii; ija; qabaachuu; xiyyeeffannaa; gatii
Keywords_EN: looking closely; ant; eyes; observation; inherent value; detail

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka mirgaa kutuun, harka bitaa darbannaa barsiisuu
Translation_Literal_EN: Severing the right arm is merely teaching the left arm how to hurl weapons
Meaning_AO: Goota yookaan fira jabaa miidhuun nama dhihoo jiru kan biraa akka inni jabaatee qabsootti ka'u taasisa; hacuuccaan qabsoo dhalcha
Meaning_EN: Chopping off the right arm only forces the left arm to master hurling spears; persecuting champions only steels their brothers to rise up in resistance
Theme_EN: Persecution Fueling Alternative Strength and Resistance
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo diinni goota tokko ajjeesee garuu qabsoo sabaa caalaatti dammaqsu ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to declare uncompromising political defiance, warning tyrants that slaying one hero only trains the next generation to fight twice as fiercely
Keywords_AO: harka mirgaa; kutuu; harka bitaa; darbachuu; qabsoo; gootummaa
Keywords_EN: right arm; severing; left arm; weapon hurling; defiance; resistance

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaalli muddamu malee, hin albahu
Translation_Literal_EN: A camel does not have diarrhea unless it is hard-pressed.
Meaning_AO: Namni yookiin wanti tokko hamma dhiphinni ykn rakkoon guddaan isa mudatutti waan hin eegamne hin raawwatu.
Meaning_EN: One only resorts to unusual or extreme behavior when pushed to severe crisis or extreme pressure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dhiibbaa fi dhiphina ulfaataadhaan waan hin malle dalagu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain extreme reactions or desperate acts brought about by severe pressure.
Keywords_AO: gaala, muddama, albahu, rakkoo
Keywords_EN: camel, pressure, diarrhea, desperate, crisis

Mammaaksa_AO: Roorroon jabaattu malee, abbaan ilma hin gurguru
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless oppression becomes extreme, a father does not sell his son.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamma rakkinni fi roorroon daangaa dhabdutti waan jaallatu fi kabaju hin laadhu.
Meaning_EN: A person never sacrifices their most precious possession unless driven by intolerable hardship or tyranny.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiphinni fi dhiibbaan ulfaataan nama waan hin taane akka raawwatu godhu himama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when describing someone forced to make painful sacrifices due to extreme adversity.
Keywords_AO: roorroo, abbaa, ilma, gurguru, dhiphina
Keywords_EN: oppression, father, son, sell, extreme hardship

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkataan, farda billawaan dhawa
Translation_Literal_EN: A desperate person strikes a horse with a knife.
Meaning_AO: Namni dhiphate ykn rakkoon itti jabaate tooftaa fi meeshaa sirrii hin taaneen tarkaanfii fudhata.
Meaning_EN: A desperate person takes irrational or damaging actions when under immense stress.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni rakkate tokko dogoggoraan waan qabu miidhu ykn tarkaanfii sirrii hin taane fudhatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when describing how panic and desperation lead people to self-destructive or erroneous acts.
Keywords_AO: rakkataa, farda, billawa, dhaawwaa, jarjara
Keywords_EN: desperate, horse, knife, strike, irrational

Mammaaksa_AO: Beerri irraa dhumtu malee, qirima hin nyaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless women are completely gone, one does not eat leftover scraps.
Meaning_AO: Hamma wanti sirriin dhabamutti wanta qulqullina hin qabne ykn gadi aanaatti hin dhimmaaman.
Meaning_EN: One only accepts poor substitutes when proper alternatives are utterly exhausted.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dirqamee waan gadi aanaa fudhatu agarsiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone has to settle for inferior options only because no better choice exists.
Keywords_AO: beera, qirima, dhabuu, filannoo
Keywords_EN: women, scraps, leftovers, last resort

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysi waan ollaa hin kajeelu, yoo dhabe ammoo biraa agabuu hin bulu
Translation_Literal_EN: A hyena does not covet a neighbor's property, but if it starves, it will not sleep empty-bellied near it.
Meaning_AO: Namni yoo haalli rakkisaa tahe seeraa fi hariiroo ollummaa cabsuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Even those who claim restraint will break boundaries when hunger or necessity strikes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ollaan ykn firri yoo dhiphate amanamummaa dhabuu danda'uu isaa agarsiisuuf himama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a warning that desperation makes even acquaintances unreliable or opportunistic.
Keywords_AO: waraabeysa, ollaa, kajeellaa, agabuu, beela
Keywords_EN: hyena, neighbor, covet, hungry, desperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhibeen niitii gabra nama godha
Translation_Literal_EN: The illness of a wife makes a man a slave.
Meaning_AO: Haati manaa yoo dhukkubsatte hojiin manaa fi rakkon maatii abbaa irratti kufee isa rakkisa.
Meaning_EN: When the matriarch of the house falls ill, household duties overwhelm the family head.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gahee guddaa dubartiin maatii keessatti qabduu fi dhabamuun ishee nama rakkisu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the indispensable role of a wife in household management and order.
Keywords_AO: dhibee, niitii, gabra, maatii, tajaajila
Keywords_EN: illness, wife, burden, slave, domestic responsibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Dheefni gaara gaye, nama afaan debi'a
Translation_Literal_EN: When flight reaches the mountain peak, one turns back to face the pursuer.
Meaning_AO: Baqaafi dhiibbaan yeroo daangaa dhabu namni sodaa dhiisee diina dura dhaabbata.
Meaning_EN: When pushed to the absolute edge, even the timid will turn and fight back.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiibbaan itti hammaate falmii fi deebii jabaa kennuuf deebi'u dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when cornered individuals finally take a stand and confront their oppressor.
Keywords_AO: dheefa, gaara, deebi'a, falmii, mormii
Keywords_EN: retreat, mountain, turn back, resistance, cornered

Mammaaksa_AO: Jabaattu malee, jabaa hin yaamani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless the matter becomes severe, one does not call for the mighty.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoon cimaan yoo uumame malee furmaata fi gargaarsa jabaa hin barbaadatan.
Meaning_EN: Strong measures and formidable allies are only called upon during severe crises.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon dhimma jabaa barbaadu uumamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when justifying calling in heavy reinforcements or taking extreme steps.
Keywords_AO: jabaa, yaamu, rakkoo, furmaata, dhimma
Keywords_EN: mighty, summon, crisis, severity, strength

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoon kofluun gubadhe, jette akaawwiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'While laughing I got burned,' said the roasted grain.
Meaning_AO: Gammachuu fi qoosatti osoo jiranii tasa miidhaan fi balaan nama mudachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Disaster struck in the midst of amusement and carefree laughter.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo taphaa fi kolfi gara miidhaa fi gaddeetti jijjiiramu himama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a playful situation suddenly turns harmful or tragic.
Keywords_AO: kofla, gubachuu, akaawwii, balaa, tasa
Keywords_EN: laughing, roasted grain, burned, ironic, sudden mishap

Mammaaksa_AO: Dheefa goda tuqate, gara galli hammaate
Translation_Literal_EN: Having fled deep into the low valley, the journey back became arduous.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoorraa baqachuun yeroo tokko tokko gara kufaatii fi rakkina caaluutti nama geessa.
Meaning_EN: Running away recklessly leads to places from which return is extraordinarily difficult.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo baqachiisuun ykn murtoon jarjaraa gara rakkina dabalataatti nama geessu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against hasty retreats or reckless escape strategies.
Keywords_AO: dheefa, goda, galla, hammaachuu, murtoo
Keywords_EN: flight, valley, return, arduous, entrapment

Mammaaksa_AO: Maraataa fi rakkataan, daggalatti nama baqata
Translation_Literal_EN: The madman and the destitute flee to the wilderness.
Meaning_AO: Namni rakkinni itti cime fi kan sammuun jeeqame namootarraa fagaatee qofaatti dheessa.
Meaning_EN: Both the mentally afflicted and the deeply impoverished often isolate themselves from society.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiphinni hammaate namarraa adda ba'ee daggalatti baqatu ibsamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how overwhelming shame or destitution drives individuals into seclusion.
Keywords_AO: maraataa, rakkataa, daggala, baqachuu, qofummaa
Keywords_EN: madman, destitute, wilderness, isolation, fleeing

Mammaaksa_AO: Mudattu malee, raada hin qalani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless in an emergency, one does not slaughter a heifer.
Meaning_AO: Horii fi qabeenya boru horuuf ta'u hamma rakkinni hamaan dhufullee hin qisaasan.
Meaning_EN: One does not consume reproductive capital or future assets except in direst need.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya egeree isaaf barbaachisaa ta'e dirqamee baasu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when forced by extreme necessity to expend assets meant for the future.
Keywords_AO: muddama, raada, qaluu, qusannaa, egeree
Keywords_EN: emergency, heifer, slaughter, foresight, capital

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyya ambaa dhaquun nama hin dhibu, galuutu nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: Going to a foreign land is not difficult, but returning home is.
Meaning_AO: Biyya ormaa deemuu danda'u garuu nagaan fi qabeenyaan deebi'uun daran rakkisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Leaving home for foreign soil is easy, but achieving a successful return is hard.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni biyya ambaatti godaanuuf ka'u akka itti yaadu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise prospective migrants about the hardships of returning after departure.
Keywords_AO: biyya ambaa, dhaquu, galuu, godaansa, rakkina
Keywords_EN: foreign land, travel, return, migration, homecoming

Mammaaksa_AO: Namuu beekaa hin mucucaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Nobody slips deliberately.
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiyyuu dogoggora fi kufaatii fedhii isaatiin hin uumu; tasa uumama.
Meaning_EN: No one errs or stumbles with deliberate intent; mistakes happen involuntarily.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko dogoggore dhiifama barbaadu ykn akka hubatamuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to plead for understanding or pardon when someone makes an unintended error.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, mucucaachuu, dogoggora, dhiifama
Keywords_EN: deliberate, slip, mistake, human error, forgiveness

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni biyya hin qabne, bakka itti koflu dhiisi, bakka itti booyuuf ni rakkata
Translation_Literal_EN: A person without a homeland lacks not just a place to laugh, but even a place to weep.
Meaning_AO: Namni biyya fi dachee mataa isaa hin qabne kabajaa fi nagaa guutuu dhabee rakkata.
Meaning_EN: A stateless person is denied dignity both in joy and in sorrow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gatii guddaa biyyi mataa ofii qabaachuun qabuu fi salphina baqattummaa ibsuuf himama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the paramount value of having a homeland and the tragedy of exile.
Keywords_AO: biyya, kofluu, booyuu, baqattummaa, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: homeland, stateless, laughter, weeping, belonging

Mammaaksa_AO: Abjuu jibbanii, qaaxiiraa bulani
Translation_Literal_EN: Despising bad dreams, one spends the night awake in worry.
Meaning_AO: Wanta sodaatan tokko jibbanii wanta caalaatti nama miidhu keessa seenuu.
Meaning_EN: Fear of bad outcomes leads people into sleepless anxiety, worsening their plight.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni sodaa xiqqoof jedhee dhiphina guddaa keessa of galchu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when excessive worry over potential troubles causes real present suffering.
Keywords_AO: abjuu, qaaxiiraa, yaaddoo, sodaa, hirriba
Keywords_EN: nightmare, insomnia, anxiety, sleepless, worry

Mammaaksa_AO: Dugda aduun gube, garaa beelli gube
Translation_Literal_EN: The sun burned the back, while hunger burned the stomach.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina bifa hedduun kallattii maraanuu nama irratti wal geeddarame agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Beset by hardship from every direction; external toil matched by inner hunger.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiphinni keessaa fi alaa walitti dabalamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe compounded suffering where physical labor meets deprivation.
Keywords_AO: dugda, aduu, garaa, beela, gubaa
Keywords_EN: sunburn, hunger, toil, compounded misery, affliction

Mammaaksa_AO: Iyyuu hin beekuun hamma rakkoon hin dhufinitti
Translation_Literal_EN: One claims not to know how to scream only until crisis arrives.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamma dhiphinni fi roorroon itti dhufutti waan dandeettiisaa hin beeku; yoo rakkate ni lallaba.
Meaning_EN: Everyone learns to cry out when genuine agony or peril strikes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni 'ani kana hin danda'u' jedhu dhiibbaan akka isa barsiisu himamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when pointing out that hardship compels people to find their voice and react.
Keywords_AO: iyyuu, rakkoo, dhiphina, barachuu
Keywords_EN: scream, crisis, pain, instinct, expression

Mammaaksa_AO: Anuu badee tan intala tahee, badii lammataa kan intala da'ee jette niitiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I was already ruined by being born female; my second ruin was giving birth to a daughter,' said the woman.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina duraan jiru irratti dabalanni dhiphina biraa yoo dhufu kan himamuudha.
Meaning_EN: A lament over double misfortune and compounding social vulnerability.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkinni tokko osoo hin furamin kan biraan itti dabalamee nama cinqu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an existing vulnerability is multiplied by an identical secondary misfortune.
Keywords_AO: badii, intala, dhaluu, dhiphina, dachaa
Keywords_EN: ruin, female, daughter, double burden, adversity

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkinni hundee manaatii, achi hiiqii hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Hardship is like a house post; there is no shifting away from it.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoon jireenyaa waan hundee qabuuf salphaatti dhiisanii baqachuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Poverty and hardship are deeply rooted and cannot be easily shrugged off.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhiphinni fi rakkinni maatii tokkorraa dafee deemuu dide dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe intractable poverty or systemic hardship that cannot be escaped.
Keywords_AO: rakkina, hundee, mana, hiiquu, jireenya
Keywords_EN: hardship, pillar, house, immovable, persistent

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafa haftuun heerumtu, galaanni guuta
Translation_Literal_EN: On the very day the long-waiting bachelorette marries, the river floods.
Meaning_AO: Nama carraan isaa guyyaa dheeraaf kuteef, yeroo carraan argamtullee danqaan biraa dhufti.
Meaning_EN: When an unlucky person finally gets a break, unforeseen obstacles still arise.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama carraan itti cufamee dhimmi isaa milkaa'uu didu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate terribly bad timing or persistent ill fortune.
Keywords_AO: haftuu, heeruma, galaana, guutuu, carraa
Keywords_EN: spinster, wedding, river flood, bad luck, irony

Mammaaksa_AO: Anaa abbaa kiyya dadhabee, abbaan abbaa kiyyaa abbaa isaa qabatee natti dhufe
Translation_Literal_EN: While I was already overwhelmed by my father, my grandfather came along bringing his own father.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina xiqqaa ba'achuu dadhabee osoo jiruu dhiphina isa caalaa ulfaataatu itti dabalame.
Meaning_EN: Unable to cope with one burden, a whole lineage of heavier burdens arrived.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon tokko osoo hin furamin kan duraa caalu itti fufee nama rakkisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express exasperation when overwhelmed by an exponential escalation of problems.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, dadhabuu, akaakayyuu, ba'aa, dhiphina
Keywords_EN: father, overwhelmed, grandfather, escalation, multiple burdens

Mammaaksa_AO: Duuti haadhaa fi bakki ciisan bubbuleeti nama quuqa
Translation_Literal_EN: A mother's death and a poor sleeping spot cause pain long afterwards.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan haadha dhabuu fi iddoon jireenyaa mijaawaa hin taane miidhaa isaanii yeroo booda mul'ata.
Meaning_EN: The loss of a mother and chronic discomfort leave deep, lasting aches that time reveals.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gatii haadhaa fi miidhaan dhabama ishee yeroon booda akkam akka miidhu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how certain losses are felt more acutely with the passage of time.
Keywords_AO: du'a, haadha, bakka ciisichaa, quuqa, gadda
Keywords_EN: death, mother, bed, delayed pain, lasting grief

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkinni koo rakkinaa, haati koo ammaas ulfa
Translation_Literal_EN: My misery is already enough, yet my mother is pregnant again.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina duraan qaban ba'achuu dadhabanii osoo jiran dhibee fi ba'aan dabalataa dhufuu.
Meaning_EN: When already struggling with scarcity, more dependants or responsibilities are added.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyummaa keessa jiranii wanti baasii fi dhiphina dabalu uumamu himama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament worsening economic stress caused by additional unavoidable obligations.
Keywords_AO: rakkina, haadha, ulfa, ba'aa, hiyyummaa
Keywords_EN: misery, mother, pregnancy, burden, scarcity

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo nyaadhu naan jedhee maaliif ijoollee koo sagal godhaa jedhe namichi
Translation_Literal_EN: 'If He intended for me to eat, why did He give me nine children?' said the man.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi jiru xiqqoo ta'ee maatiin immoo baay'atee yeroo hiyyummaan nama cinqu kan dubbatamuudha.
Meaning_EN: When resources are scarce, having many mouths to feed feels like an impossible burden.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hiyyeessi maatii ballaa qabaatee nyaata dhabuuf komatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express the strain of sustaining a large household under severe economic hardship.
Keywords_AO: nyaachu, ijoollee, sagal, hiyyummaa, komii
Keywords_EN: food, children, nine mouths, poverty, family strain

Mammaaksa_AO: Harkaan hidhanii, ilkaaniin hiikuu dhaqani
Translation_Literal_EN: They tie with hands, then attempt to untie with teeth.
Meaning_AO: Wanta ofii salphaatti dogoggoraan ykn of eeggannoo dhabuudhaan xaxan rakkina guddaan furuuf dhama'u.
Meaning_EN: What is tied easily by hand requires painful effort with teeth to undo.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ofumaa dhimma salphaa xaxee booda furuu dadhabee cinqu dubbatama.

Keywords_AO: harka, hidhuu, ilkaan, hiikuu, rakkoo
Keywords_EN: hands, tie, teeth, untie, preventable knots

Mammaaksa_AO: Mucaas na dhoowwattee, fayyaas na hin dhoowwatin yaa maaramii jette dhabduun facaafattee
Translation_Literal_EN: 'You denied me a child, do not also deny me my health, O deity,' said the barren woman offering prayers.
Meaning_AO: Wanta guddaa tokko dhabnullee fayyaa fi lubbuun jiraachuun wanta hunda caala.
Meaning_EN: Even when denied one great blessing, preserving life and health remains paramount.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimmi tokko jalaa hafeellee fayyaa isaaf galateeffatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express contentment with basic health even after suffering painful life losses.
Keywords_AO: mucaa, fayyaa, maarama, kadhaa, dhabduu
Keywords_EN: child, barren, health, supplication, contentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Natti hin dhufin, anuu sitti niin dhufaa, jette buseen
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Do not come after me, for I am already coming toward you,' said the plague/pox.
Meaning_AO: Balaan ykn wanti hamaan ofumaanuu osoo hin waamin nama barbaadee dhufa.
Meaning_EN: Trouble needs no invitation; it arrives on its own momentum.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkinni ykn dhibeen osoo hin eegin dhufee nama mudatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to convey that impending disaster or hardship often arrives unprompted.
Keywords_AO: busee, dhufuu, balaa, dhukkuba, soda
Keywords_EN: pox, plague, approach, inevitable danger, disaster

Mammaaksa_AO: Duruu hin jirtuu, sanuu mana hin jirtu
Translation_Literal_EN: She barely exists as it is, and even so she is not at home.
Meaning_AO: Namni dandeettii fi humna xiqqaa qabu ammas itti gaafatamummaa isaa dagatee baduu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Someone of little utility who fails even to fulfill the simplest minimal obligation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni bu'aa hin qabne tokko bakka barbaadamuttis dhabamu tuffachuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used mockingly when an already ineffective individual is missing when needed.

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana abbaan waggaa keessa ture, keessummaan halkan tokkoo dadhaba
Translation_Literal_EN: In a house where the master stayed for a year, a guest finds it unbearable for a single night.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina abbaan danda'ee keessa jiraatu namni alaa dhufe yeroo gabaabaafiyyuu danda'ee hin obsu.
Meaning_EN: What a homeowner endures indefinitely, an outsider cannot tolerate for even one night.
Usage_Situation_AO: Garaagarummaa danda'uu abbaa manaa fi keessummaa agarsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight how local occupants endure conditions that shock visitors.
Keywords_AO: mana, abbaa, waggaa, keessummaa, dadhabuu
Keywords_EN: homeowner, guest, one night, endurance, hardship

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka fardaaf tolutti, gafarsi hin kaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A buffalo does not run merely to suit the convenience of a horse.
Meaning_AO: Diinni yookiin wanti tokko fedhii fi faayidaa keetiif jedhee akka siif mijatutti hin socho'u.
Meaning_EN: Your quarry or rival will never play according to rules convenient for you.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni haalli hundi akka fedhii isaatti ta'a jedhee eegu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone that opponents will not accommodate their convenience.
Keywords_AO: farda, gafarsa, kaachuu, fedhii, morkii
Keywords_EN: horse, buffalo, chase, opponent, convenience

Mammaaksa_AO: Horiin lafa jabaan qixxe
Translation_Literal_EN: Wealth is on equal terms with solid land.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi qabaachuun akkuma lafa jabaa qabaachuutti nama tasgabbeessa, kabajaas namaaf kenna.
Meaning_EN: Possessing wealth provides as much firm footing and security as solid ground.
Usage_Situation_AO: Faayidaa fi humna qabeenyi namaaf kennu ibsuuf himama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to validate the crucial stability and dignity provided by material wealth.
Keywords_AO: horii, lafa jabaa, qabeenya, kabaja, tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: wealth, firm land, cattle, security, stability

Mammaaksa_AO: Ayyaanaa ayyaanaa, kan koo gagaa hin qabu jedhe, namtichi damma gagaa wajji liqimse

Meaning_AO: Nama of jajuuf jedhee miidhaa ykn hir'ina qabu akka waan qulqulluutti sobee himu.
Meaning_EN: Claiming spotless perfection while blatantly tolerating or swallowing flaws.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hir'ina ofii dhoksuuf jedhee of faarsu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used mockingly against someone attempting to conceal obvious imperfections with boastful claims.
Keywords_AO: ayyaana, gagaa, damma, liqimsuu, of-jajuu
Keywords_EN: grace, wax, honey, swallow, self-deception

Mammaaksa_AO: Mall jedhu jedhee, jaarsi dubbii fuudhe
Translation_Literal_EN: 'What will they say?' thought the elder as he began speaking.
Meaning_AO: Jaarsi yeroo dubbatu yaada namaa fi miira namootaa tilmaama keessa galchuun of eeggannoodhaan dubbata.
Meaning_EN: A wise elder speaks with great deliberation, considering societal reactions beforehand.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo araaraa fi jaarsummaa keessatti dubbiin of eeggannoon dubbatamuu qabu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how responsible speakers weigh the reception of their words in assembly.
Keywords_AO: jaarsa, dubbii, marii, of-eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: elder, discourse, deliberation, discretion, council

Mammaaksa_AO: Muka jigetti, qottootu baayyata
Translation_Literal_EN: Once a tree falls, axes multiply around it.
Meaning_AO: Nama kufetti yookiin humna dhabetti namoonni hedduun itti roorrisuuf yaalu.
Meaning_EN: When a mighty figure falls, opportunistic attackers readily multiply.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni humna dhabe tokko hunda biraa miidhamuu fi salphifamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when people opportunistically exploit or pile on someone who has lost power.
Keywords_AO: muka, jiguu, qottoo, baayyachuu, roorroo
Keywords_EN: fallen tree, axes, opportunistic, vulnerability, exploitation

Mammaaksa_AO: Korommii wal nyaatte lachuu gurguruu dha, nadheen wal arrabsite lachuu misirroo dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Two bulls that fight each other should both be sold; two women who quarrel are both brides.
Meaning_AO: Horii lolaa qisaasa hambisuuf gurguru, dubartoota wal lolanis akka maatii haaraatti kabajanii araarsu.
Meaning_EN: Belligerent bulls are best liquidated, while quarreling women must both be reconciled as prized household members.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo mormii fi lola gidduu maatiitti uumame fala sirrii itti barbaadan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to prescribe appropriate, measured approaches to domestic and livestock disputes.
Keywords_AO: korommii, lachuu, nadheen, arrabsoo, misirroo
Keywords_EN: bulls, quarreling, women, brides, conflict resolution

Mammaaksa_AO: Intalti garaa laaftu, garaa qullaa hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A soft-hearted girl does not remain with an empty womb.
Meaning_AO: Nama laafaa fi tolaa tahe namoonni faayidaa irra oolchuun miidhuu ykn dharraasisuu danda'u.
Meaning_EN: An overly yielding or naïve person easily becomes vulnerable to exploitation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Garaa laafummaan daangaa hin qabne akka nama hin miine akeekkachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against excessive gullibility or soft-heartedness that invites taking advantage.
Keywords_AO: intala, garaa laaftuu, ulfa, miidhaa, amala
Keywords_EN: soft-hearted, girl, pregnant, exploited, caution

Mammaaksa_AO: Ija laaftuun, obbolessaaf ulfooyti
Translation_Literal_EN: A shy, submissive woman becomes pregnant by her own brother.
Meaning_AO: Qaanii fi ija-laafummaan daangaa darbe wanta farrummaa fi safuu cabsu keessatti nama kuffisa.
Meaning_EN: Excessive timidity and inability to say no can lead to catastrophic boundary violations.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ija-laafina irraa kan ka'e namni 'lakki' jechuu dadhabee miidhaa guddaa uumu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as an extreme warning against failing to establish and assert firm personal boundaries.
Keywords_AO: ija laaftuu, obboleessa, ulfaa'uu, safuu, akeekkachiisa
Keywords_EN: bashful, brother, taboo pregnancy, assertiveness, boundaries

Mammaaksa_AO: Intalti "haayaa" guddattu, obbolessarraa fafaan galti
Translation_Literal_EN: The girl raised saying 'yes' to everything returns pregnant by her brother.
Meaning_AO: Ijoollee murtii ofii akka hin qabaannee fi diduu akka hin dandeenyetti guddifamte salphaatti miidhamti.
Meaning_EN: A child trained only to comply without questioning becomes an easy victim of abuse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ijoolleef diduu fi of eeggachuu barsiisuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to argue for raising children with agency and discernment rather than blind obedience.
Keywords_AO: haayaa, guddina, obboleessa, safuu, of-ittisa
Keywords_EN: compliance, upbringing, sibling taboo, agency, boundary

Mammaaksa_AO: Keessummaan qaanfattuun (zigaal guddattu) abbaa warratiin nyaadhu jetti
Translation_Literal_EN: The overly shy guest (raised with false modesty) tells the host to eat.
Meaning_AO: Qaaniin daangaa dabarte iddoo fi gahee namaa dogoggorsiisuun nama saalfachiisa.
Meaning_EN: Excessive diffidence causes an awkward reversal of proper social roles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo keessummaan of eeggannoo daangaa dabarseen wanta hin malle godhu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to poke fun at crippling social awkwardness and exaggerated courtesy.
Keywords_AO: keessummaa, qaanfachuu, abbaa warraa, nyaata, saalfii
Keywords_EN: guest, bashful, host, eat, social awkwardness

Mammaaksa_AO: Zigaal guddateetu, lukkuu maxxanaan kuffisa
Translation_Literal_EN: Excessive bashfulness causes one to trip a chicken with a stick.
Meaning_AO: Of eeggannoo fi qaanii humnaa oliin wanta salphaa fi adda hin taane xaxanii miidhuu.
Meaning_EN: Exaggerated hesitation or timidity turns trivial actions into clumsy mishaps.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qaanii isaatiin wanta salphaa balleessu kolfuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule clumsy blunders caused by unwarranted shyness or overthinking.
Keywords_AO: zigaala, lukkuu, kuffisuu, qaanfannaa, dogoggora
Keywords_EN: timidity, chicken, clumsy, mishap, false modesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen, waa agartu malee hin duttu
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog does not bark unless it sees something.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko sababa malee hin ta'u; dubbiin ykn iyyi uumame wanta ka'umsa tahe qaba.
Meaning_EN: There is no smoke without fire; an outcry or alarm always has a root cause.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimmi tokko sababa qabaachuu isaa hubachiisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that rumors or warnings always stem from an underlying reality.
Keywords_AO: saree, dutuu, arguu, sababa, oduu
Keywords_EN: dog, bark, see, cause, root reason

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo roobni roobe, bakakkaan bu'a
Translation_Literal_EN: When rain pours, lightning strikes.
Meaning_AO: Wanta guddaan yeroo uumamu balaan ykn miidhaan isaa wajjin wal qabatee dhufuun isaa hin oolu.
Meaning_EN: Major events naturally carry unavoidable and sometimes dangerous repercussions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti guddaan tokko miidhaa fi balaa of keessaa qabu hubachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when pointing out that momentous happenings bring along associated perils.
Keywords_AO: rooba, bakakkaa, bu'uu, balaa, uumama
Keywords_EN: rain, lightning, storm, consequences, risk

Mammaaksa_AO: Qoreen dirraan, dhiigni dhufe
Translation_Literal_EN: When pierced by a thorn, blood follows.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaa ykn dogoggorri raawwatame battalumatti bu'aa hamaa fi madaa fida.
Meaning_EN: Harmful actions or injuries instantly produce pain and visible consequences.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo miidhaan uumame battalatti bu'aa isaa mul'isu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that a painful incident leads directly to suffering or grievance.
Keywords_AO: qoree, dhiiga, diruu, madaa, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: thorn, blood, pierce, wound, direct result

Mammaaksa_AO: Qoraan yoo dhoowwatan malee, ibiddi hin dhaamu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless firewood is withheld, the fire will not go out.
Meaning_AO: Lolaa fi waldhabdee dhaamsuuf wanta isa kakaasu dhabamsiisuun dirqama.
Meaning_EN: To extinguish a conflict, one must cut off the fuel and incitement feeding it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo waldhabdee dhaamsuuf sababa lolaa dhabamsiisuun barbaachisu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when advising adversaries to stop fueling arguments and remove points of contention.
Keywords_AO: qoraan, ibidda, dhaamuu, lola, furmaata
Keywords_EN: firewood, flame, extinguish, conflict, de-escalation

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan dhugan malee, hin fincaanani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one drinks water, one does not urinate.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko osoo hin jalqabamin ykn sababni hin jiraatin bu'aan isaa hin mul'atu.
Meaning_EN: Without prior intake or action, there can be no subsequent output or outcome.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti tokko sababa dhabuun hin raawwatamne agarsiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize the indispensable role of a primary cause behind any event.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, dhuguu, fincaanuu, sababa, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: water, drink, urinate, prerequisite, logic

Mammaaksa_AO: Midhaan nyaatan malee, hin udaanani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one eats food, one does not defecate.
Meaning_AO: Wanta hojjetan ykn gumaachan irratti hundaa'ee bu'aan argama malee duwwaarraa homaa hin dhalatu.
Meaning_EN: Outcomes depend entirely on what has been invested or done; nothing comes from nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bu'aan wanta raawwatame irraa argamu mirkaneessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to convey that results are inextricably linked to prior sustenance or effort.
Keywords_AO: midhaan, nyaachuu, udaanuu, bu'aa, uumama
Keywords_EN: grain, eating, bodily waste, result, necessity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhagaa keessa jiruutu, bishaan dubbisa
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the stone submerged beneath that understands the water.
Meaning_AO: Rakkinaa fi haala dhimma tokkoo kan beeku nama dhimma sana keessa jiru qofaadha.
Meaning_EN: Only those immersed in a difficult situation truly fathom its depth and pressure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni alaa dhimma tokkorratti yaada kennu garuu kan keessa jiru caalaatti beeku himamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind outsiders that direct experience yields the truest understanding.
Keywords_AO: dhagaa, bishaan, keessa, dubbisuu, beekumsa
Keywords_EN: stone, submerged, water, deep insight, lived experience

Mammaaksa_AO: Muka jigu bira, muka dhiibuutu jira
Translation_Literal_EN: Beside a falling tree, there is a tree pushing it.
Meaning_AO: Nama kufu ykn miidhamu duuba humna ykn nama isa suuquu fi kuffisuutu jira.
Meaning_EN: Behind every sudden downfall, there is often an unseen instigator or pushing force.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo balaa ykn kufaatii nama tokkoo duuba harki diinaa akka jiru hubachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reveal that someone's ruin was actively engineered by covert adversaries.
Keywords_AO: muka, jiguu, dhiibuu, kufaatii, diina
Keywords_EN: tree, fall, push, instigator, conspiracy

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbataa jiru, callisaan hin jiru
Translation_Literal_EN: Where someone is speaking, there is no silent bystander.
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin yoo ka'e namni hundi yaada kennuuf kaka'a malee namuu callisee hin dhiisu.
Meaning_EN: Active discussion compels engagement; silence disappears once a matter is voiced.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimmi tokko marii fi yaada namoota hundaa dammaqsu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an outspoken issue draws everyone into debate and dissolves passive silence.

Keywords_AO: gaara, gaarii, fiiguu, tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: mountain, goodness, running, patience, balance

Mammaaksa_AO: Da'uuf durri ulfa
Translation_Literal_EN: Before giving birth, pregnancy comes first
Meaning_AO: Waan tokko bu'aa isaa arguuf dura rakkoo fi dhiphina isaa baachuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: Before the joy of birth, one must endure the nine months of pregnancy; every harvest requires preceding toil.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni bu'aa qofa dharra'u dhiphina dura bu'aa sanii akka baachuu qabu hubachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone that every desired achievement requires enduring the necessary preparatory hardships.
Keywords_AO: da'uu, ulfa, dhiphina, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: birth, pregnancy, gestation, hardship, harvest

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka argatani, lukatti hiixatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Having obtained the hand, they stretch for the leg
Meaning_AO: Nama arjummaadhaan waan xiqqoo kenneef daangaa dhabanii waan guddaa irraa fudhachuuf kajeeluun sirrii miti.
Meaning_EN: Given the hand, they reach greedily for the foot; taking unfair advantage of someone's generosity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gargaarsa argatee quufuu dide daangaa akka beeku akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand an ungrateful person who exploits someone's kindness by continuously demanding more.
Keywords_AO: harka, luka, hiixachuu, kajeellaa
Keywords_EN: hand, leg, overreaching, greed, ungratefulness

Mammaaksa_AO: Miila lama qabna je'anii yeroo tokkotti muka lama hin korani
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying 'we have two legs', one cannot climb two trees at once
Meaning_AO: Humni namaa daangaa waan qabuuf hojiiwwan gurguddoo lama altokkotti raawwachuuf yaaluun kasaaraa fida.
Meaning_EN: Having two legs does not allow one to climb two trees simultaneously; do not scatter your energy on split goals.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii adda addaa walirra buusee raawwachuuf yaalee hunda balleessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against dividing one's attention across conflicting goals, advocating focused dedication to one task at a time.

Keywords_EN: legs, trees, climbing, focus, multitasking limits

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaara tokko yaaban, gaara tokkootu mul'ata
Translation_Literal_EN: When one ascends one mountain, another mountain appears
Meaning_AO: Jireenya keessatti qorumsa tokko yoo dabarzan kan biraatu dhufa; ilaalchi namaas bal'achaa deema.
Meaning_EN: When you climb one summit, another peak comes into view; overcoming one hurdle reveals the next horizon.
Usage_Situation_AO: Milkaa'ina tokko booda qophiin itti aanu akka jiru hubachiisuu fi muuxannoo jireenyaa ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that life is an ongoing succession of challenges and discoveries; achieving one milestone reveals the next.
Keywords_AO: gaara, yaabuu, mul'ata, jireenya
Keywords_EN: mountain, climbing, horizon, perspective, challenges

Mammaaksa_AO: Halkan bahaniif, bara hin bahani
Translation_Literal_EN: Escaping through the night does not mean surviving the era
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo guyyaa tokkoo yookiin yeroo gabaabaa bira darbuun qorumsa jireenyaa guutuu dhiifame jechuu miti.
Meaning_EN: Surviving through the night does not mean you have outlived the epoch; momentary relief is not permanent safety.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkoo yeroo gabaabaa jalaa bahee dantaa dhabeef jireenyi itti fufaa ta'uu isaa akeekkachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people not to relax their vigilance just because a momentary danger has passed.

Keywords_EN: night, era, survival, vigilance, permanence

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaa dheeraa hin ceehani, dubbii dheertuu itti hin jarjarani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not leap over a long road, nor rush through a complex matter
Meaning_AO: Imala dheeraa akkuma suuta tarkaanfatanii dhumarratti gahan, dhimma ulfaataas obsaan xiinxalu.
Meaning_EN: A long road cannot be crossed in a single leap, nor can profound, complex disputes be resolved in haste.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaarsummaa fi marii keessatti dhimmi xaxamaa yeroo fi obsa akka barbaadu namoota dammaqsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in councils and reconciliation processes to ensure matters are thoroughly examined without rushing.

Mammaaksa_AO: Ar'uma horraan hin tahu
Translation_Literal_EN: It does not become prosperous all on the same day
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi yookiin beekumsi guyyaa tokkotti hin argamu; tattaaffii dheeraa eeggata.
Meaning_EN: Wealth and prosperity do not happen in a single day; it takes continuous accumulation over time.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dafee duroomuu barbaaduuf qabeenyi suutaan akka kuufamu hubachiisuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to calm get-rich-quick desires by emphasizing that sustainable prosperity takes prolonged diligence.

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan haaddatee fi kan jiifate waluma faana
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who shaves clean and the one who trims low are side by side
Meaning_AO: Namoonni karaa garaagaraatiin qophaa'an yookiin hojjetan dhumarratti sadarkaa fi bu'aa walfakkaatu qabaachuu danda'u.
Meaning_EN: The one who shaved completely and the one who trimmed down close end up looking virtually identical.
Usage_Situation_AO: Manni fi uffanni garaagara ta'us bu'aan dhumaa tokko ta'uu yeroo ibsamu dubbatama.

Mammaaksa_AO: Arriin mukattuu ni baati
Translation_Literal_EN: Even trees develop grey hair (lichen)
Meaning_AO: Dullumni yookiin jijjiiramni yeroo fi umrii uumama hunda irra kan gahuudha malee nama qofaa miti.
Meaning_EN: Ageing and the passage of time affect every living creation, even trees; it is a universal law of nature.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni dulluma yookiin milkaa'ina umrii ofii yeroo sodatu yookiin jibbu akka uumamaatti hubachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to console or remind someone that growing old is a natural and inevitable law of nature.

Mammaaksa_AO: Gubbaa tuulee, keessa duule
Translation_Literal_EN: He piled up from above, but raided from within
Meaning_AO: Nama alaan tolaa fi jaalalloo fakkaatee keessaan ammoo miidhaa fi badii dalagu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Refers to a hypocrite who acts beneficent on the surface while secretly plotting harm or destruction within.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala sobaa qabu, kan alaan namaaf yaada fakkaatee keessaan nama balleessu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize hypocritical behavior where someone pretends friendship while undermining from within.

Mammaaksa_AO: Hiddiin ol hin guddattu
Translation_Literal_EN: The Sodom apple bush does not grow upwards into a tall tree
Meaning_AO: Wanti uumamaan daangaa qabu hamma fedhe tattaafatu daangaa uumamaa isaa dabruu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A low bush like Sodom apple cannot grow into a towering tree; everything has inherent limitations.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dandeettii yookiin bakka uumamaan qabu bira darbee waan hin taane dharra'u gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution someone overestimating their natural abilities or seeking what is beyond their nature.

Mammaaksa_AO: Foon harree, sireerra kaayan illee daaraa hin hanqatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if donkey meat is placed upon a bed, it will not miss the dust
Meaning_AO: Wanti yookiin namni gatii fi kabajaa hin qabne bakka ol aanaas yoo kaa'an gara salphina isaatti deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: No matter how elevated an ignoble person or thing is made, their vulgar nature will inevitably show.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amalli isaa gadi bu'aa ta'e carraa gaarii yoo argetiyyuu akka amala isaatti deebi'u mul'isuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize someone of low character who fails to live up to high positions or noble treatment.

Keywords_EN: donkey meat, raised bed, ash, dust, low character

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen yoo sireerra kaayan, daaraa keessa gangalatti
Translation_Literal_EN: If a donkey is placed upon a bed, it still rolls in the dust
Meaning_AO: Namni kabajaa fi bakka guddaa hin malleef kennameef kabajicha eeggachuu dadhabee salphinatti deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: Place a donkey upon an elevated bed, and it still leaps into dust; uncultured people ruin exalted honors.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ulfina fi kabaja kennameef hin beekne, kan gocha salphaatti deebi'u akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an undeserving person squanders elevated status by reverting to vulgar habits.
Keywords_AO: harree, siree, daaraa, gangalachuu
Keywords_EN: donkey, bed, rolling, ash, decorum, ingratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen faaya hin beektuu, kan ofii ofirratti nyaatti
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog knows nothing of adornment; it chews its own ornaments
Meaning_AO: Namni qaroomaa fi kabajaa hin beekne waan miidhaginaa fi faayidaa qabu balleessa malee itti hin gammadu.
Meaning_EN: A dog lacks appreciation for fine adornment and chews off its collar; unrefined individuals destroy elegance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wantoota kabajamaa fi qaalii ta'an tuffatu yookiin gatii isaanii hin beekne ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to characterize someone unable to appreciate noble gifts, culture, or fine treatment.

Keywords_EN: dog, ornament, adornment, chewing, uncultured

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo beektee haga hin buutuu, kan namuu sii gaggabuutu
Translation_Literal_EN: If you truly knew, you wouldn't defecate; everyone is falling over themselves for you
Meaning_AO: Namni kabajaa fi jaalala namoonni isaaf qaban osoo beekee amala gadhee fi gocha nama jibbisiisu hin raawwatu ture.
Meaning_EN: If one recognized the immense honor and goodwill shown to them, they would not act so disgraced and crude.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kabajaa fi jaalala guddaa namootaa argachaa osoo jiruu amala fokkisaadhaan of salphisuuf gorfama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish someone who ruins the immense respect and affection they enjoy by acting crudely.

Keywords_EN: awareness, dignity, esteem, crude behavior, reproach

Mammaaksa_AO: Haa fifiigduu malee, harreen daaraa dhaa hin baatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Let it gallop all it wants, the donkey never leaves the dust
Meaning_AO: Namni bu'uura amala isaa hin jijjiirre hamma fedhe yoo ifaaje sadarkaa fi amala gadhee isaa jalaa hin bahu.
Meaning_EN: No matter how fast a donkey runs, it belongs to the dust; superficial motion changes neither nature nor fate.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala isaa jijjiiruu osoo hin danda'in qaroomaa fakkaachuuf fiigu agarsiisuuf jedhama.

Keywords_EN: running, donkey, ash, dust, core nature

Translation_Literal_EN: Before the one riding is tired, the one being ridden is exhausted
Meaning_AO: Namni tajaajilamaa jiru osoo hin quufin, namni isa gargaaru yookiin tajaajilu humna dhabee rakkata.
Meaning_EN: Before the rider tires of travelling, the beast being ridden collapses; beneficiaries overworking their providers.

Meaning_AO: Maddi inni guddaan osoo hin raafamin namni isa irratti hirkatee jiru dura dadhaba.
Meaning_EN: The mighty Odaa fig tree endures effortlessly, whereas the climbing parasite vine supporting itself on it withers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qaama jabaa fi bu'uureffamaa qabu morkachuuf yaalu yookiin namoota hirkattuu ta'an dammaqsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that enduring institutions and strong figures outlast weak, parasitic challengers.
Keywords_AO: odaa, qalamee, dadhabuu, humna
Keywords_EN: Odaa tree, climbing vine, endurance, dependence

Mammaaksa_AO: Dachiin "ani tan isin ba'atte isin hin dadhabnee isin maaliif wal dadhabdani" jette
Translation_Literal_EN: The Earth said: 'I who carry all of you have not grown tired of you, so why do you grow weary of one another?'
Meaning_AO: Uumamni bal'aan hunda keenya baachaa osoo jiruu ilmaan namaa waldanda'uu fi nagaan waliin jiraachuu dadhabuun isaanii kan nama gaddisiisuudha.
Meaning_EN: Earth tolerates bearing everyone without complaint, yet human beings fail to tolerate living peacefully beside one another.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota nagaa fi waldanda'iinsa dhabanii wal loluuf obsa fi waliin jireenya barsiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to appeal for mutual tolerance and peaceful coexistence among people caught in needless strife.
Keywords_AO: dachii, ba'achuu, dadhabuu, waldanda'uu
Keywords_EN: earth, bearing, coexistence, tolerance, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabeysi soogiddaan hin nyaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A hyena does not eat using salt
Meaning_AO: Bineensi yookiin namni dharraan qabame wanta fedhu qofa qulqullinaa fi sirna malee fedhii isaa raawwachuuf ariifata.
Meaning_EN: A hyena devours without seasoning or etiquette; raw greed and savagery have no decorum or refinement.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan tokko argachuuf sirna, safuu fi qajeelfama dantaa dhabee ariifatu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn crude, uncivilized, and shameless greed that ignores all standards of decency.

Keywords_EN: hyena, salt, unrefined, greed, savagery

Mammaaksa_AO: Tiitichaa fi gadi galoon tokkicha
Translation_Literal_EN: The fly and the low-life vagabond are of the same kind
Meaning_AO: Namni bakka hin malle hunda dhaquu fi xuraawaa jaallatu akka tiitichaatti salphaa fi nama jibbisiisaadha.
Meaning_EN: A fly and an aimless, shameless hanger-on share the same nature; both pester people and hover over filth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qulqullina fi ulfina ofii hin eegganne, kan bakka hundaatti nama jeequtti fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used derisively against shameless vagabonds who loiter everywhere looking for hand-outs like pesky flies.

Keywords_EN: fly, parasite, vagabond, shamelessness, decorum

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsa dardarummaa hin fixatin mana ambaatti hin ergatani
Translation_Literal_EN: An elder who never outgrew the impulses of his youth is not sent to another's home on an errand
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo dhimma guddaaf ergamu tasgabbii fi bilchina hin qabne salphina fida malee hojii hin hojjetu.
Meaning_EN: One should not send an elder who never shed youthful impulsiveness to negotiate, for he will bring disgrace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma jaarsummaa fi ergaa ulfaataaf nama bilchaataa fi of eeggannoo qabu qofa filachuuf gorfama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise selecting only mature, composed individuals for delicate embassies and council representations.
Keywords_AO: jaarsa, dardarummaa, ergaa, mana ambaa
Keywords_EN: elder, youthful impulse, emissary, maturity, trust

Mammaaksa_AO: Handaaqqootti lootii keenyaan, ofitti harkiftee kutte
Translation_Literal_EN: When an earring was placed on a hen, she pulled it herself until it broke
Meaning_AO: Namni gatii fi ulfina wanta tokkoo hin beekne kabajaa fi carraa kennameef ofumaan balleessa.
Meaning_EN: Adorn a hen with a golden jewel, and it will peck and snap it off; uncouth people ruin high honors bestowed on them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama carraa gaarii yookiin kabaja guddaa kennameefii ofumaan gocha gowwummaatiin of jalaa balleesseef jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a clueless or vulgar person self-destructively spoils a noble honor or golden opportunity.

Keywords_EN: hen, earring, jewelry, breaking, unrefined, self-sabotage

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhadhaan garaa saree hin bulu
Translation_Literal_EN: Butter does not spend the night in a dog's belly
Meaning_AO: Namni iccitii baachuu hin dandeenye waan argee fi dhaga'e hunda hatattamaan baasee dubbata.
Meaning_EN: Clarified butter cannot be retained in a dog's stomach; a loose-tongued person cannot keep a secret.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama iccitii eeggachuu hin dandeenyetti waan tokko akka hin himne akeekkachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against entrusting confidential matters to indiscreet people who immediately blab.

Mammaaksa_AO: Gandi gaara jalaa, barumaan bara jala
Translation_Literal_EN: A village under the mountain remains under it year after year
Meaning_AO: Haalli yookiin bakki jireenyaa tokko jijjiirama hin qabne yeroo hunda akkuma jirutti tura.
Meaning_EN: A village situated beneath a towering mountain remains sheltered beneath it year after year; immutable constants in life.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti tokko yeroo dheeraaf jijjiirama malee jiraachuu isaa fi haalli tokko dhaabbataa ta'uu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comment on unchanging realities, deeply rooted circumstances, or lifelong static environments.

Keywords_EN: village, mountain, years, permanence, constant

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni kabajaa hin beekne, maqaa yaamaniin owwaata
Translation_Literal_EN: The person who does not understand honor responds to any name called
Meaning_AO: Namni of hin kabajne fi gatii ofii hin beekne salphinaaf saaxilamaa ta'ee maqaa salphaattiyyuu tole jedha.
Meaning_EN: Someone devoid of self-respect responds blindly to any degrading label; they lack dignity and boundaries.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama of tuffatu yookiin daangaa kabajaa ofii eeggachuu hin dandeenye qeequuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish someone lacking personal dignity who accepts disrespectful treatment without objection.
Keywords_AO: kabajaa, maqaa, yaamuu, owwaachuu
Keywords_EN: honor, name, answering, self-respect, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni kabajaa hin beekne, maqaan yaamtu hin owwaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: The person who knows no honor does not respond when called with honor
Meaning_AO: Nama ulfinaa fi safuu hin beekne akkamittiiyyuu yoo kabajan kabaja sanaaf iddoo hin kennu.
Meaning_EN: An uncultured person ignorant of decorum fails to appreciate or respond to respectful addressing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama safuu fi ulfina namaa dhabee kabajaa namoonni isaaf kennaniif deebii sirrii hin kennine qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize an ill-mannered person who ignores courtesy and does not recognize when honor is accorded to them.
Keywords_AO: kabajaa, maqaa, owwaachuu, safuu
Keywords_EN: respect, name, answering, decorum, ignorance

Mammaaksa_AO: "Haadha dhiiraa" jennaan diddeet, "haadha qoraanii" jennaan owwaatte
Translation_Literal_EN: When called 'mother of heroes', she refused; but when called 'mother of firewood', she answered
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwaan yookiin salphate kabajaa fi maqaa gaarii dhiisee gara waan salphaa fi gadi aanaatti kajeela.
Meaning_EN: Offered the noble title 'mother of brave men', she declined; addressed as 'carrier of firewood', she eagerly answered.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kabajaa fi iddoo guddaa isaaf malu dhiisee waan salphaa fi xiqqootti gammaduuf kan itti fayyadamanidha.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically about someone who shuns dignity and noble aspirations, preferring lowly, degrading positions.
Keywords_AO: haadha dhiiraa, haadha qoraanii, owwaachuu, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: mother of heroes, firewood, honor, ignominy, satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Sodaataa uleen kudhani
Translation_Literal_EN: To a coward, one stick seems like ten
Meaning_AO: Namni sodaataan waan xiqqoo akka waan guddaatti argee naasaa fi shororkaa keessa gala.
Meaning_EN: A fearful person exaggerates minor risks into massive threats; fear multiplies danger tenfold in the mind.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko waan salphaa sodaatee baqatu yookiin dhiphatu amala isaa qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique someone whose timidity causes them to magnify harmless or minor obstacles.

Keywords_EN: coward, stick, ten, fear, exaggeration

Mammaaksa_AO: Haftuun goota hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: An unmarried spinster sees no man as a hero
Meaning_AO: Namni abdii kutatee fi carraan jalaa dabre nama hundumaa tuffata, wanti gaariin jiras jedhee hin amanu.
Meaning_EN: A bitter, disillusioned person sees no merit or heroism in anyone around them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan hunda tuffatuu fi gaarummaa yookiin jagnummaa namootaa hin arganne ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe a cynical critic who dismisses everyone else's worth due to personal frustration.
Keywords_AO: haftuu, goota, tuffii, abdii dhabuu
Keywords_EN: spinster, hero, cynicism, contempt, disillusionment

Mammaaksa_AO: Luyni kan haadhaati
Translation_Literal_EN: The coward belongs to his mother
Meaning_AO: Jagni biyyaa fi lammiif duulaa oolee seenaa yoo hojjetu, luyni garuu mana haadhaa taa'ee of dhoksa.
Meaning_EN: While heroes serve their country and make history, cowards hide at home under their mothers' apron.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gootummaa dhabee bakka hojii fi dirree murteessaa irraa dheessu arrabsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used derisively against a timid man who avoids public duty and danger by hiding at home.
Keywords_AO: luyna, haadha, sodaa, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: coward, mother, timidity, avoidance, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Jiileeti bahee, udaan huddutti hin deebi'u
Translation_Literal_EN: Once discharged in panic, feces does not return to the anus
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko sodaadhaan yookiin gowwummaadhaan erga badee booda deebisanii sirreessuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: An irreversible blunder or action committed in panic cannot be undone once it has happened.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni erga waan tokko balleesse yookiin baqatee booda gaabbee gatii akka hin qabne hubachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that hasty panic leads to irreversible losses that remorse cannot undo.
Keywords_AO: jiiluu, bahuu, udaan, deebii dhabuu
Keywords_EN: panic, discharge, irreversible, consequence, regret

Mammaaksa_AO: Sodaataan, niitii irraa ilma hin dhalchu
Translation_Literal_EN: A coward does not father a son with his wife
Meaning_AO: Namni sodaa qabu jireenya keessatti ija jabina dhabee waan kabajamaa fi dhaabbataa hin milkeeffatu.
Meaning_EN: A timid, indecisive person lacks the boldness required to achieve lasting honor and legacy in life.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni waan guddaa galmaan gahuuf sodaa ofirraa dhiisee murteessaa akka ta'u jajjabeessuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to spur someone to bold action, emphasizing that timidity achieves neither respect nor legacy.
Keywords_AO: sodaataa, niitii, ilma, dhiirummaa
Keywords_EN: coward, wife, son, boldness, legacy, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni guyyaa bofa arge, halkan teepha dheessa
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who saw a snake by day flees from a leather strap at night
Meaning_AO: Namni duraan balaa yookiin miidhaan irra gahe wanta balaa sana fakkaatu hunda naasuudhaan sodaata.
Meaning_EN: Someone traumatized by a real danger becomes hyper-vigilant and fears anything that vaguely resembles it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama sababa miidhaa duraatiin waan hundumaa shakkuu fi sodaatu hubachuuf yookiin ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when explaining why a previously burned person reacts with intense suspicion and avoidance.
Keywords_AO: bofa, teepha, dheessuu, naasuu
Keywords_EN: snake, leather strap, trauma, fear, suspicion

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan roobaa, jooba keessa hin dubbatani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not discuss the rain while caught under a leaking shelter
Meaning_AO: Rakkina guddaa keessa osoo jiranii dhimma rakkichaa lafa bal'aatti kaasanii morkuun yeroo isaa miti; dura jalaa bahuutu dursa.
Meaning_EN: One should not engage in leisurely analysis of an ordeal while still actively drowning in it; escape first.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balaa yookiin qorumsa keessatti osoo jiranii falmii bu'aa hin qabne dhiisanii furmaata irratti akka xiyyeeffatan gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against endless theoretical discussions while an emergency is ongoing; act first.
Keywords_AO: rooba, jooba, dubbachuu, furmaata
Keywords_EN: rain, shelter, discussion, crisis, action

Mammaaksa_AO: "Osoo wacaafaan jiraachuu baatee, ashiitaan numa qoyxuu dha" jette, shinbirroon
Translation_Literal_EN: "If it weren't for the sling-guard, the fresh grain would be ours to pick," said the bird
Meaning_AO: Hattuu fi diinni yoo eeggannoo fi waardiyyaan jabaan jiraachuu baate qabeenya namaa saamuuf qophiidha.
Meaning_EN: Thieves and adversaries would effortlessly plunder resources if not for constant vigilance and deterrence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenyaa fi daangaa ofii tikfachuu dhiisuun diinaaf carraa kennuu ta'uu isaa hubachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate that peace and property remain secure only through diligent vigilance and deterrence.
Keywords_AO: wacaafaa, ashiita, shinbirroo, eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: sling, crop, bird, vigilance, security, deterrence

Mammaaksa_AO: Harree dadhaban, gorboota dhawani
Translation_Literal_EN: Failing to discipline the donkey, they beat the leather pack-saddle
Meaning_AO: Nama balleessaa qabu yookiin jabaa ta'e adabuu dadhabanii nama dadhabaa fi balleessaa hin qabne miidhuu.
Meaning_EN: Failing to confront the powerful wrongdoer, one vents frustration upon the innocent or helpless scapegoat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama abbaa qajeeltoo adabuu dhiisee harka dadhabaa irratti jabaatu qeequuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn the cowardly habit of punishing a defenseless scapegoat instead of confronting the real culprit.
Keywords_AO: harree, gorboo, dhaanuu, dadhabina
Keywords_EN: donkey, pack-saddle, beating, scapegoat, displaced anger

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakakkaan qara sodaate, jinfutti bu'a
Translation_Literal_EN: Lightning, fearing the sharp edge, strikes the blunt butt-end
Meaning_AO: Diinni yookiin namni hamaan nama jabaa fi qophaa'aa morkachuu sodaatee kan dadhabaa irratti miidhaa geessisa.
Meaning_EN: An aggressor terrified of confronting strength targets the soft, blunt, and defenseless flank.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gootarraa dheessee dadhabaa irratti goota ta'u qeequu fi saaxiluuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shame a coward who avoids tough contenders and instead bullies the vulnerable.
Keywords_AO: bakakkaa, qara, jinfu, sodaa
Keywords_EN: lightning, sharp edge, blunt end, targeting, cowardice

Mammaaksa_AO: Loon leenca argee hin fincaanne, garaa keessaa humaa hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Cattle that see a lion and do not urinate have nothing left in their bellies
Meaning_AO: Balaa guddaa fi sodaachisaa duratti sodachuu dhabuun hin danda'amu; sodaan uumama keessa jira.
Meaning_EN: Facing terrifying peril, extreme dread is completely natural unless one has lost all sensation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balaa lubbuu nama dhabsiisu dura dhaabbatanii naasuun waan uumamaa ta'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to acknowledge that fear in the face of genuine, overwhelming danger is natural human nature.
Keywords_AO: loon, leenca, fincaanuu, sodaa
Keywords_EN: cattle, lion, fear, terror, natural instinct

Mammaaksa_AO: Mataa leencaa, loon hin arraabani
Translation_Literal_EN: Cattle do not lick the head of a lion
Meaning_AO: Dadhabaan diina isa duguugee balleessu duratti taphachuu yookiin jaalala barbaaduun balaa fida.
Meaning_EN: The vulnerable do not seek playful affection from a mortal predator; beware of fatal folly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama diina hamaa wajjin qoosaa godhu yookiin balaatti of dhiheessu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a grave warning against displaying naive familiarity around dangerous, predatory forces.
Keywords_AO: mataa, leenca, loon, arraabuu
Keywords_EN: head, lion, cattle, licking, fatal folly, warning

Mammaaksa_AO: Joolleen hiriyaa sodaannaan, karaa golaa (alawaadaa) na baasaa jetti
Translation_Literal_EN: When a child fears his peers, he asks to be let out through the back pantry
Meaning_AO: Namni walmorkii fi dhugaa fuullee ba'uu sodaatu karaan dhoksaa fi daddaaqaan baqachuuf yaala.
Meaning_EN: When someone dreads facing peers or accountability, they seek secretive backdoors to sneak away.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dirree qorumsaarraa dheessee karaa dhoksaatiin of oolchuuf socho'u qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule someone who dodges direct public accountability by slinking away through covert exits.
Keywords_AO: joollee, hiriyaa, gola, alawaadaa, sodaa
Keywords_EN: child, peers, pantry, backdoor, evasion, fear

Mammaaksa_AO: Haadha dhiiraa dhaananii, mudhii hiikkatanii hin rafani
Translation_Literal_EN: After striking the mother of a brave man, one does not unfasten one's belt and sleep easily
Meaning_AO: Nama fira jabaa fi haloo baafatu qabu yoo miidhan tasgabbaa'anii taa'uun balaa fida; haloon ni dhufa.
Meaning_EN: Having provoked or harmed the kin of a formidable warrior, one cannot relax; retribution will follow.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humna jabaa tuffatee miidhaa geessiseef deebiin ulfaataan akka dhufu dammaqsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against complacency after attacking someone who possesses strong, retaliatory backing.
Keywords_AO: haadha dhiiraa, dhaanuu, mudhii, rafuu
Keywords_EN: mother of warrior, striking, vigilance, retribution

Mammaaksa_AO: Duulli dheessu halkan gala
Translation_Literal_EN: The army that flees retreats under cover of night
Meaning_AO: Salphinaa fi injifatamuu ofii dhoksuuf jecha namni gocha gadhee hojjete halkan dukkana fayyadama.
Meaning_EN: Cowardly retreat and shameful defeat seek the dark of night to hide from public humiliation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qaanifatee dhugaa fuulleetti baasuu dhabee dhoksaan hojjetu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique shameful failures who skulk in shadows rather than face up to their defeat.
Keywords_AO: duula, dheessuu, halkan, qaanii
Keywords_EN: war, retreat, night, shame, evasion, darkness

Mammaaksa_AO: Luyni niitii irraa dheeysa
Translation_Literal_EN: A coward runs away from his own wife
Meaning_AO: Namni gootummaa fi jabina hin qabne dhimma mana isaa iyyuu itti gaafatamummaa fudhachuu dadhabee baqata.
Meaning_EN: A thoroughly spineless person lacks courage even to face domestic disputes and flees from his wife.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama itti gaafatamummaa maatii baqatee jireenya keessatti laafaa ta'e tuffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock a thoroughly weak-willed individual who shirks basic family obligations out of timidity.
Keywords_AO: luyna, niitii, dheessuu, itti gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: coward, wife, fleeing, domestic weakness, timidity

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaala xaan lafa taa'uufiitu, raroof gadooda
Translation_Literal_EN: The camel destined to collapse to the ground groans at the pack-saddle
Meaning_AO: Namni hojiif yookiin deemsaaf fedhii dhabee dadhabe sababa salphaa lakkaa'ee komii baay'isa.
Meaning_EN: A person already looking for an excuse to quit blames small burdens for their inevitable failure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dadhabaa sababa adda addaa dhiheessuun hojii dhiisuu barbaadu qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose someone making trivial excuses to mask their own laziness or surrender.
Keywords_AO: gaala, lafa taa'uu, raroo, gadooduu
Keywords_EN: camel, collapsing, pack-saddle, whining, excuses

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni bofa baqate, bofni nama baqate, karaan jiddutti hafe
Translation_Literal_EN: The man fled the snake, the snake fled the man, and the road was left empty between them
Meaning_AO: Gareewwan lamaanuu wal sodaatanii walirraa yoo baqatan nagaan bu'ee lola malee walirraa fagaatu.
Meaning_EN: When both adversaries fear each other and mutually withdraw, open conflict is averted peacefully.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wal dhabiinsi morkattoota lamaan gidduutti wal sodaachuun osoo lola hin kaasin yeroo furamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a standoff resolves itself peacefully because neither side wishes to risk direct confrontation.
Keywords_AO: nama, bofa, baqachuu, karaa, nagaa
Keywords_EN: man, snake, mutual retreat, empty road, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Shahaadaa guddisuun, du'a sodaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Excessive repetition of the creed comes from fear of death
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo baayyee dhiphuu fi duuti itti dhihaatu qofa kadhannaa fi qalbii jijjiirrata.
Meaning_EN: People often intensify religious fervor only when cornered by mortal danger or the fear of death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama yeroo nagaa amantii dantaa dhabee yeroo balaan dhufu qofa iyyatu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically about someone who only turns pious and devout when faced with mortal peril.
Keywords_AO: shahaadaa, du'a, sodaa, kadhaa
Keywords_EN: shahada, creed, death, fear, crisis piety

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabessi, kan boodaa irra guddaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Among hyenas, the one trailing behind is the largest
Meaning_AO: Balaan yookiin rakkoon tokko darbe jennaan inni boodarra dhufu daran jabaatee dhufeera ta'a.
Meaning_EN: One cannot breathe easy after one calamity passes, for what follows is often even more daunting.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkoo duraa mo'adhe jedhee eeggannoo dhiiseef balaan guddaan itti aanuu danda'a jechuuf jedhama.
