Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge continued alertness, cautioning that subsequent challenges are often larger than initial ones.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, booda, guddaa, rakkoo
Keywords_EN: hyena, trailing, bigger, escalating trouble, vigilance

Mammaaksa_AO: Qara dabre, jinfuun nama hin waraanu
Translation_Literal_EN: Once the sharp point has passed, the blunt end cannot pierce you
Meaning_AO: Balaan inni guddinni erga dabarsee booda, wanti hafe miidhaa guddaa nama irraan hin gahu.
Meaning_EN: Once the sharpest edge of danger has safely passed, the remaining blunt end cannot pierce or harm you.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota balaa guddaa jalaa erga oolanii booda waan xiqqoo hafte sodaatan jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure someone that the worst of a crisis has passed and the remaining traces are harmless.
Keywords_AO: qara, jinfu, waraanuu, balaa
Keywords_EN: sharp edge, blunt end, piercing, danger passed, reassurance

Mammaaksa_AO: Ibiddi dhaamu, daaraan nama hin gubu
Translation_Literal_EN: Once the fire is extinguished, the ash does not burn
Meaning_AO: Aariin yookiin balaan inni ulfaataan erga qabbanaa'ee booda wanti hafe sodaachisaa miti.
Meaning_EN: Once the flames of conflict or danger have died down, the cold ashes left behind pose no threat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Lola yookiin aarii guddaa booda nagaan bu'uu fi shakkii qabaachuun akka hin barbaachisne ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how fury or danger loses its capacity to harm once passions have completely cooled.
Keywords_AO: ibidda, daaraa, gubuu, tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: fire, ash, burning, cooling off, safety

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenca dabre, eegeen dabarte
Translation_Literal_EN: Once the lion has passed, its tail has passed as well
Meaning_AO: Balaan inni guddaan nama dabarraan wanti isa hordofu kamiyyuu dhiibbaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: When the apex danger itself has moved past, its trailing tail will not harm you; the peril is fully over.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama balaa guddaa jalaa bahee ammas naasuu keessa jiru tasgabbeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to calm someone who remains anxious after escaping a formidable threat.
Keywords_AO: leenca, eegee, darbuu, tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: lion, tail, danger passed, complete relief

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa'a qallate, Kopheen bahani
Translation_Literal_EN: Across a shallow stream, one crosses with shoes on
Meaning_AO: Rakkina salphaa fi dhiphaa ta'e osoo dhiphina hin uumin salphaatti tarkaanfatanii bira darbu.
Meaning_EN: A shallow, narrow stream is crossed easily with one's shoes on; minor hurdles require no fuss.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimmi tokko salphaa fi kan nama hin dhibne ta'uu isaa agarsiisuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to indicate that a problem is easily manageable and requires no extraordinary effort.
Keywords_AO: yaa'a, qallachuu, kophee, bahuu
Keywords_EN: stream, shallow, shoes, crossing, ease

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa'a qallateef, kophee hin baafatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because a trickle of water flows, one does not remove shoes
Meaning_AO: Waanuma salphaa fi xiqqoof jecha qophii guddaa fi dhiphina hin malle keessa hin galani.
Meaning_EN: One does not go to the trouble of removing shoes for a mere trickle; avoid overreacting to petty hurdles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan xiqqoof jecha dhimma guddaa godhee socho'u gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone not to make a mountain out of a molehill or over-complicate minor matters.
Keywords_AO: yaa'a, kophee baafachuu, gorsaa
Keywords_EN: stream, trickle, removing shoes, overreaction, moderation

Mammaaksa_AO: Galaanni dabru, cirrachi nama hin fuudhu
Translation_Literal_EN: Once the river flood has passed, the gravel cannot wash you away
Meaning_AO: Qorumsa jabaa fi balaa guddaa erga dandamatanii booda, wanti xiqqoon nama hin kuffisu.
Meaning_EN: Having withstood the ferocious raging flood, the remaining pebbles cannot sweep you away.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qorumsa ulfaataa dabarseef abdii kennuu fi rakkoolee xixiqqoof akka hin raafamne jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage someone who conquered immense trials that small lingering difficulties will not break them.
Keywords_AO: galaana, cirracha, fuudhuu, jabina
Keywords_EN: flood, river, gravel, pebbles, resilience, victory

Mammaaksa_AO: "Nu ofii rimayaa, mooji tumaalessa" jette, re'eettiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "We ourselves are pregnant, who knows about the castrated buck?" said the goat
Meaning_AO: Namni ofii isaatiifiyyuu ba'aa fi rakkina guddaa keessa jiru waa'ee dhimma nama biraatiif yaaddoo hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: We are occupied with our own heavy burdens; we have no energy to fret over the affairs of others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhiphuu ofii qabu dhimma nama biraa akka baatu gaafatamu deebii kennuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone overwhelmed with their own critical responsibilities excuses themselves from others' matters.
Keywords_AO: rimaya, tumaalessa, re'ee, ba'aa
Keywords_EN: pregnant, goat, buck, heavy burden, personal focus

Mammaaksa_AO: Boru heerumtaan, waan haftuun sossobani
Translation_Literal_EN: "You will marry tomorrow" is the coaxing phrase used to pacify a spinster
Meaning_AO: Namatti abdii sobaa fi waadaa yeroo dheeraa kennanii garaa ciibsuuf yookiin sossobuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Meaning_EN: Giving someone false hope and empty promises merely to pacify them temporarily.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota dhiphatanitti abdii sobaa lafaa hin jirre kennanii deemsisan ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique the habit of stringing along desperate people with unrealistic, empty promises.
Keywords_AO: heeruma, haftuu, sossobaa, abdii sobaa
Keywords_EN: marriage, spinster, coaxing, false hope, deception

Mammaaksa_AO: Bareedinaa fi horiin, nama gowwoomsiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Beauty and wealth deceive a person
Meaning_AO: Miidhagina alaa fi qabeenya qofaan qalbii dhabanii gara murtee dogongoraa fi gowwummaatti galu.
Meaning_EN: Superficial beauty and riches can easily bewitch a person, blinding their judgment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bifa yookiin qabeenyaan boojiyamee amala fi dhugaa dhokataa irraanfatu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against being blinded by physical glamour and affluence at the expense of sound judgment.
Keywords_AO: bareedina, horii, gowwoomsuu, qalbii
Keywords_EN: beauty, wealth, deception, superficial allure, vanity

Mammaaksa_AO: "Kookkoo ala jiraan", waan joolleen sossobani
Translation_Literal_EN: "The monster is outside" is the scare tactic used to pacify children
Meaning_AO: Waan hin jirre uumanii fi sodaachisanii nama hubannoo xiqqaa qabu to'achuuf fayyadamu.
Meaning_EN: Fabricating imaginary monsters or fears to keep the naive and vulnerable compliant.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoota sodaachisanii dantaa ofiitiif akka ajajaman taasisan saaxiluuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose manipulative tactics where imaginary terrors are manufactured to coerce obedience.
Keywords_AO: kookkoo, joollee, sossobaa, sodaa
Keywords_EN: bogeyman, children, coaxing, phantom fear, manipulation

Mammaaksa_AO: Haftuu mana haadhaatti hin beekanii, dhadhaa dibanii, ambaan dhibani
Translation_Literal_EN: Failing to marry her off at home, they anointed her with butter and confused outsiders
Meaning_AO: Wanta yookiin nama amalli isaa beekamu faayanii fi miidheysanii nama biraa gowwoomsuuf yaalu.
Meaning_EN: Cosmetically adorning someone whose serious flaws are known at home in order to deceive strangers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan qulqullina hin qabne alaan bareechanii gabaatti dhiheessuu fi gowwoomsuu qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock attempts to palm off flawed goods or individuals by embellishing their outward appearance.
Keywords_AO: haftuu, dhadhaa, amba, dhibuu, soba
Keywords_EN: spinster, butter, cosmetic disguise, deceiving strangers

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama waan namaatti ija dhiibu, laaffisoo agarsiisaniiti faltii guurshani
Translation_Literal_EN: To the one eyeing others' food, they show a pancake and feed him cow dung
Meaning_AO: Nama bololaan qabeenya namaa saamuuf ija godhatu kiyyoo keessa galchanii salphisu.
Meaning_EN: An envious, greedy opportunist eyeing others' property is lured with a treat and fed humiliation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kajeellaadhaan qabeenya nama biraatti ija godhatu adabuu fi akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show how covetous schemers who constantly eye others' plates end up bitterly humiliated.
Keywords_AO: ija dhiibuu, laaffisoo, faltii, bolola
Keywords_EN: covetousness, pancake, dung, retribution, greed

Mammaaksa_AO: Daa'imni ol daddarban, kan ifii isaatii ol utaalu itti fakkaata
Translation_Literal_EN: A child tossed repeatedly in the air imagines he is jumping up by himself
Meaning_AO: Namni gargaarsa fi tumsa namootaatiin bakka guddaa gahe humna ofiitiin akka waan ka'eetti of tuula.
Meaning_EN: Someone lifted to prominence on the shoulders of others foolishly imagines they soared on their own power.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama deggersa namootaan guddannoo argatee garuu gargaartota isaa tuffatuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to deflate the arrogant ego of someone who attributes collective help entirely to personal brilliance.
Keywords_AO: daa'ima, darbuu, utaaluu, of tuulummaa
Keywords_EN: child, tossing, jumping, delusion, arrogance

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni kan humaa hin kennineef, hiyyessa mataa qaqqabata
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who gives nothing strokes the head of the destitute
Meaning_AO: Gargaarsa qabatamaa kennuu dhiisanii jaalalaa fi garaa laafina sobaa afaaniin agarsiisu.
Meaning_EN: Offering empty affectionate gestures and words to the needy without providing tangible help.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama harka qalleeyyiidhaaf jecha qofa kennu garuu gargaarsa dhowwatu saaxiluuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand individuals who offer meaningless patronizing gestures instead of genuine material help.
Keywords_AO: hiyyessa, mataa qaqqabachuu, fakkeessaa, arjummaa
Keywords_EN: destitute, stroking head, empty gestures, token sympathy

Mammaaksa_AO: Shumburaa goggoyduun, nama huuti
Translation_Literal_EN: Dry chickpeas choke a person
Meaning_AO: Wanti tolaa fi laafina hin qabne, yookiin jaalala dhugaa hin qabne nama miidha malee bu'aa hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Dry, dry things without water choke; similarly, harsh treatment and dry appeasement harm rather than nourish.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hariiroo keessatti laafinaa fi marrummaan yoo dhabame walitti dhufeenyi akka dhabamu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that devoid of genuine warmth and moisture, harsh interactions inevitably suffocate.
Keywords_AO: shumburaa, goggoyduu, huutuu, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: dry chickpeas, choking, harshness, unfeeling behavior

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabra biddeena furdaan maxaysani
Translation_Literal_EN: A servant is kept quiet with thick, coarse bread
Meaning_AO: Nama hirkataa ta'e waanuma xiqqoo fi salphaa kennaniifii akka inni mirga isaa hin gaafanne callisiisu.
Meaning_EN: Throwing a subordinate coarse sustenance just to keep them quiet and prevent them from demanding their rights.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mootummaa yookiin abbootiin taayitaa uummata waan xiqqoon sossobanii mirga isaanii ukkaamsuu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique political or social systems that buy off complaints with meager, temporary crumbs.
Keywords_AO: gabra, biddeena, maxaysuu, hacuuccaa
Keywords_EN: servant, thick bread, silencing, pacification, control

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabra, huddu dhoysani, garaa guutani
Translation_Literal_EN: For a servant, they cover the behind and fill the belly
Meaning_AO: Hojjetaa yookiin nama gadi aanaa waan lubbuun turuuf isa dandeessisu qofa kennaniifii itti fayyadamu.
Meaning_EN: Subjugating a laborer by providing only bare clothing and food merely to maintain their working capacity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojjettootaaf bu'aa isaanii hunda dhowwatanii qooda xiqqoo qofa kennuu qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn maintaining workers in bare subsistence while extracting the maximum value from them.
Keywords_AO: gabra, hudduu, garaa guutuu, hacuuccaa
Keywords_EN: servant, subsistence, belly, clothing, exploitation

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo jajuu, jajihe
Translation_Literal_EN: While they praised him, he went entirely astray
Meaning_AO: Faaruu fi jajuun daangaa darbe nama afaan faajjessitee akka inni of tuulee hojii balleessu taasifti.
Meaning_EN: Unrestrained flattery and inflated praise went straight to his head, leading to total ruin.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama faaruudhaan booji'amee of tuuluummaadhaan badii keessa galeef jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a caution that unwarranted, hyperbolic praise often spoils and corrupts promising individuals.
Keywords_AO: jajuu, jajihuu, faaruu, badii
Keywords_EN: praise, faltering, flattery, ruin, corruption

Mammaaksa_AO: Quufni dubbaa, galaa male, imaltuu nama oofa
Translation_Literal_EN: Fullness from pumpkin drives a traveler on his journey without provisions
Meaning_AO: Wanti yeroo gabaabaaf qofa quubsu nama gowwoomsee eeggannoo fi qophii barbaachisaa akka dhiisan godha.
Meaning_EN: The short-lived, watery satiety of pumpkin deludes a traveler into hitting the road without real provisions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Carraa yeroo gabaabaa irratti hirkachuun gara dhiphina fagoo fi beelaatti akka nama hin geessine gorfama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against mistaking temporary relief for lasting stability and neglecting vital preparation.
Keywords_AO: quufa, dubbaa, galaa, imaltuu
Keywords_EN: pumpkin, satiety, provisions, traveler, false security

Mammaaksa_AO: Haa corattu jennaan, dal'uu qaqqabe
Translation_Literal_EN: When told 'help yourself to a slice', he grabbed for the fatty hump
Meaning_AO: Eeyyamaa fi arjummaa namni sitti agarsiisetti fayyadamtee daangaa dabartee waan hunda saamuuf yaaluu.
Meaning_EN: Granted permission to take a modest piece, he immediately overreached and laid hands on the prized hump.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama arjummaa fi qooda kennameef tuffatee waan qaalii fi guddaa saamuuf kajeelu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand a presumptuous opportunist who grossly abuses hospitality and generosity.
Keywords_AO: corachuu, dal'uu, bolola, arjummaa
Keywords_EN: meat slicing, hump, greed, overreaching, presumption

Mammaaksa_AO: Garii anaatu galchaa, garii dhihaatu galchaa jette tumtuun
Translation_Literal_EN: "Part I finish myself, and part sunset finishes," said the blacksmith
Meaning_AO: Hojii qulqullina hin qabne xumuruuf sababa dukkanaa fi yeroo gabaabaa fayyadamuun nama gowwoomsu.
Meaning_EN: Shoddy craftsmen rush their poor work and count on the falling dusk to hide imperfections from customers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii isaa qulqullinaan hojjechuu dhiisee dhoksaatti namaaf dhiheessu qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically about artisans or workers who do sub-standard work and conceal it under cover of darkness.
Keywords_AO: tumtuu, galchuu, dhiha, qulqullina dhabuu
Keywords_EN: blacksmith, sunset, twilight, shoddy work, deception

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan quufu rafa malee, sossobaan hin rafu
Translation_Literal_EN: A belly sleeps when genuinely full, not upon mere soothing words
Meaning_AO: Dhimmi yookiin beelli qabatamaa furmaata qabatamaa barbaada malee jecha sobaatiin hin callisu.
Meaning_EN: A starving stomach rests only with real nourishment, not with empty soothing and smooth talk.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina jiruuf furmaata qabatamaa dhiheessuu mannaa dubbii laafaa dubbatan irratti deebii kennuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to insist on tangible material relief instead of platitudes and empty reassurances.
Keywords_AO: garaa, quufuu, rafuu, sossobaa
Keywords_EN: belly, fullness, sleep, soothing words, substance

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni ifii nyaateeti, gowwaa afaan diba
Translation_Literal_EN: The clever one eats the meal himself, then smears grease on the fool's lips
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyaa fi bu'aa dhugaa ofii fudhatanii gowwaa immoo akka waan inni argateetti itti fakkeessanii gowwoomsu.
Meaning_EN: The cunning takes the whole feast for himself, and merely smears greasy residue on the fool to trick him.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gowwaa gowwoomsee bu'aa isaa dhuunfatu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn the exploitation where a manipulator consumes the gains and gives a naive partner pure illusion.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, gowwaa, afaan dibuu, saamicha
Keywords_EN: eating, fool, smearing lips, exploitation, trickery

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaa nyaataa yaami, ergaa si hin didu
Translation_Literal_EN: Invite a fool to eat, and he will never refuse your errand
Meaning_AO: Nama hubannoo hin qabne waanuma xiqqoo kennaniifii hojii ulfaataa fi ergaa barbaadan hunda itti fe'uun danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: Feed a simpleton a single meal, and he will eagerly run all your exhausting errands without question.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota hubannoo dhaban faayidaa xiqqoon gowwoomsanii hojii ulfaataaf itti fayyadamuu agarsiisa.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used cynically to show how easily gullible people are put to heavy labor with trifling incentives.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, nyaata, ergaa, to'annoo
Keywords_EN: fool, food, errand, manipulation, naivety

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo namni ilkee sitti mul'ise, if hin dagatin
Translation_Literal_EN: When someone bares their teeth in a smile, do not forget yourself
Meaning_AO: Kolfi alaa fi ilkaan adii hundi jaalala miti; diinni kolfaa nama nyaatu waan jiruuf of eeggannoon barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: A friendly display of gleaming teeth does not guarantee goodwill; never lower your guard before a charming smile.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kolfi namaa gowwoomsee of dagateef akka dammaqu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a strong warning against letting down one's guard simply because an adversary is smiling broadly.
Keywords_AO: ilkee, mul'isuu, of dagachuu, eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: teeth, smiling, vigilance, self-protection, warning

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafaan nama diraniiti, eegeen nama hooysani
Translation_Literal_EN: They gore you with the horns, then caress you with the tail
Meaning_AO: Miidhaa fi balaa guddaa erga nama irraan gahanii booda jaalala fi marrummaa fakkeessuun nama gowwoomsu.
Meaning_EN: Inflicting devastating injury with the horns, and then soothing the victim with gentle strokes of the tail.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hammeenya guddaa hojjetee booda araara fi marrummaa sobaa fakkeessu saaxiluuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose malicious actors who wound others deeply and then offer insulting, hypocritical solace.
Keywords_AO: gaafa, diruu, eegee, hooysuu, fakkeessaa
Keywords_EN: horns, goring, tail, caressing, hypocrisy, treachery

Mammaaksa_AO: Allaattiin fira fakkaattee, moora ijaa nyaatti
Translation_Literal_EN: The bird poses as an intimate friend, yet pecks out the eye's fat
Meaning_AO: Diinni fira fakkaatee dhihaatu iddoo hunda caalaa nama miidhu irratti balaa fida.
Meaning_EN: An enemy masquerading as a loyal friend strikes treacherously at your most vulnerable and precious spot.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dhiheenya qabaatee garuu keessaan nama balleessu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against treacherous intimates who use their trusted proximity to cause grievous harm.
Keywords_AO: allaattii, fira, moora ijaa, nyaachuu
Keywords_EN: bird, false friend, eye fat, betrayal, vulnerability

Mammaaksa_AO: Jeedalloon, gogaa hoolaa uffatteef, hoolaa hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if a jackal wears a sheepskin, it never becomes a sheep
Meaning_AO: Namni hamaan uffata qulqullummaa fi amala gaarii yoo uffateyyuu amala bineensummaa isaa dhoksuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A predator wrapped in a fleece remains a predator; superficial disguise cannot alter wicked inner nature.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala gadhee qabu garuu gaarii fakkaachuuf carraaqu saaxiluuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reveal that outward piety or polite pretenses cannot disguise an intrinsically malicious nature.
Keywords_AO: jeedalloo, gogaa hoolaa, uffachuu, amala
Keywords_EN: jackal, sheepskin, disguise, predator, false piety

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaangee sibiila cancalaa afaanitti darbaniiti, isii lubbuuf fiiyduun waa deemtii ja'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: They shove an iron chain bit into the mule's mouth; as she bolts for dear life, they say 'she travels well'
Meaning_AO: Nama dhiphinaa fi miidhaa guddaadhaan rakkatu argaa akka waan inni fedhiidhaan tattaafatuutti faarsuun madaallii dhabuudha.
Meaning_EN: Inflicting excruciating agony on someone and then cynically complimenting how remarkably fast they flee.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hacuuccaa fi dhiphina nama irra gahaa jiru osoo arganii dhimma itti hin qabne qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn callous onlookers who romanticize or praise the desperate struggles of an oppressed victim.
Keywords_AO: gaangee, sibiila, afaan, fiiguu, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: mule, iron bit, agony, fleeing, cynical praise

Mammaaksa_AO: Alagaa ilkeen adii, alangaan sa'aa sadihi
Translation_Literal_EN: A stranger with white gleaming teeth, but his whip measures three spans
Meaning_AO: Namni ormaa kolfee sitti dhihaatullee keessaan gara jabeenya fi miidhaa qabaachuu waan danda'uuf amanuun balaadha.
Meaning_EN: A stranger may greet you with charming, dazzling smiles, yet conceals a vicious whip of harsh treachery.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama nama ormaatiin gowwoomee amantee guutuu kenneef akka of eeggatu hubachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against placing naive trust in charismatic, smiling strangers who harbor harsh cruelty.
Keywords_AO: alagaa, ilkee adii, alangaa, sa'aa sadii
Keywords_EN: stranger, white teeth, whip, smiling menace, warning

Mammaaksa_AO: "Buutii lafa buute, dhagaa lafa guute, malli abbaarra" jette, jeedalloon
Translation_Literal_EN: "The viper has dropped to earth, stones cover the ground, the solution is up to each individual," said the jackal
Meaning_AO: Yeroo balaan bifa adda addaatiin nama marsu, namuu of oolchuuf tooftaa fi dandeettii mataa isaatti dhimma bahuu qaba.
Meaning_EN: When peril abounds on every side, every individual must rely on their own wits and vigilance to survive.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon hunda galeessi ta'e dhufee namni hundi mala ofiitiin bahuu qabu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a pervasive crisis strikes and each person must depend on their own survival ingenuity.
Keywords_AO: buutii, dhagaa, malli abbaarra, jeedalloo
Keywords_EN: viper, stones, ingenuity, survival, crisis

Mammaaksa_AO: Sussuuqachuu fi harka marachuun, nama hin jagnoomsitu
Translation_Literal_EN: Hesitating timidly and crossing one's arms does not make anyone brave
Meaning_AO: Taa'anii ilaaluu fi sodaadhaan lafa qabachuun bu'aa homaatuu hin fidu; gootummaan socho'uu barbaada.
Meaning_EN: Hesitating and passively folding one's arms will never conquer adversity; courage requires proactive deeds.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkina fuulduratti callisee harka maratee taa'u sochoosuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people out of passive inertia into bold, decisive action.
Keywords_AO: sussuuqachuu, harka marachuu, jagnummaa
Keywords_EN: hesitation, folded arms, bravery, initiative, action

Mammaaksa_AO: "Iyyan malee, korbeessa hin dhalchanii ?" je'e Hoolaan korbeessa re'eetiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "Unless one screams at the top of one's lungs, can one not father a buck?" said the ram to the he-goat
Meaning_AO: Waanuma uumamaan raawwatamu hundaaf iyyaa fi waca baay'isuun gatii akka hin qabne qeequuf dubbatama.
Meaning_EN: Mocking someone who creates needless noise, drama, and fanfare over ordinary, natural duties.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii salphaa hojjete hunda daddaaqee wacuuf akka inni tasgabbaa'u itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically against show-offs who boast noisily about completing basic, mundane duties.
Keywords_AO: iyyuu, korbeessa, hoolaa, re'ee, waca
Keywords_EN: screaming, ram, he-goat, fanfare, composure

Mammaaksa_AO: "Wanti barbaaddu gara duubaa jirtii, maaliif gurra irrati iyyitaa "jette re'eettiin korbeessaan
Translation_Literal_EN: "What you seek is behind, so why scream directly into my ears?" said the she-goat to the billy-goat
Meaning_AO: Dhimma furmaata barbaadu dhiisanii kallattii dogongoraatti wacuun yookiin nama hin taane dhiphisuun bu'aa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Clamoring loudly at the wrong person or place instead of directing effort toward the true objective.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma qabu dhiisee nama biraa irratti aarii fi waca isaa buusu itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used humorously to rebuke someone directing misplaced complaints or demands at the wrong party.
Keywords_AO: barbaaduu, gurra, iyyuu, re'ee, korbeessa
Keywords_EN: ear, screaming, she-goat, buck, misdirected focus

Mammaaksa_AO: Qalan malee, cooma hin argani
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one slaughters, one does not see the fatty meat
Meaning_AO: Aarsaa barbaachisu kaffalanii fi hojii qabatamaa keessa seenan malee bu'aa guddaa argachuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: One cannot enjoy rich fat without the willingness to slaughter; greatness requires sacrifice and effort.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama osoo aarsaa hin kaffalin bu'aa guddaa qofa hawwuuf gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people that achieving high rewards demands upfront toil and meaningful sacrifice.
Keywords_AO: qaluu, cooma, aarsaa, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: slaughtering, fatty meat, sacrifice, reward, effort

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan qalu hin qaanfannee, kan gogaa irraa baasu maaliif qaanfata?
Translation_Literal_EN: If the one who slaughters feels no shame, why should the one skinning the hide feel ashamed?
Meaning_AO: Abbaan dhimmaa inni guddaan balleessaa isaatti osoo hin qaanfatin, namni isa gargaare qaana'uun hin malu.
Meaning_EN: If the primary perpetrator feels no embarrassment for his bold act, the subordinate helper has no reason to feel shame.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gargaaraa ta'e dhiphatu, gochicha kan jalqabe kan hin qaanfanne ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to free secondary accomplices from undue embarrassment when the ringleader feels entirely unbothered.
Keywords_AO: qaluu, qaanfachuu, gogaa baasuu
Keywords_EN: slaughter, shame, skinning hide, principal actor

Mammaaksa_AO: Uf ufiin, madaa hin fayyifne
Translation_Literal_EN: Merely blowing "uf-uf" on a wound does not heal it
Meaning_AO: Jecha afaanii yookiin sossobaa qofaan dhibee fi rakkina jabaa furuun hin danda'amu; furmaata qabatamaa barbaada.
Meaning_EN: Blowing cool air over a gaping wound cures nothing; real problems require substantial remedies, not mere sympathy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkoo jabaa ta'eef furmaata salphaa fi bu'aa hin qabne dhiheessu akeekkachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to insist on concrete, professional solutions rather than superficial, ineffectual palliatives.
Keywords_AO: uf-uf, madaa, fayyisuu, furmaata
Keywords_EN: blowing breath, wound, healing, concrete solution

Mammaaksa_AO: Jibbansi, mujjaa hin balleessu
Translation_Literal_EN: Hatred does not eliminate noxious weeds
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko jibbuun qofti wanticha hin dhabamsiisu; socho'anii hojjechuun buqqisuutu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Simply resenting troublesome weeds does not clear the field; elimination requires bending down to uproot them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkoo tokko jibbaa taa'uuf hojiin tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka qabu hubachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to stop dwelling in passive bitterness and instead take concrete measures to remove problems.
Keywords_AO: jibbansa, mujjaa, balleessuu, hojii
Keywords_EN: hatred, weeds, eradication, decisive action

Mammaaksa_AO: Haa na nyaatuun, beela hin baasu
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying "let it devour me" does not satisfy hunger
Meaning_AO: Abdii kutannaa fi of ajeessuudhaan rakkina jalaa hin bahan; tattaaffii godhanii nyaata barbaaddachuutu mala.
Meaning_EN: Despairing cries of "let hunger consume me" fill no stomach; survival demands rising up to look for food.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dhiphuu keessatti abdii kutatee harka buusu jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke defeatist fatalism and encourage struggling actively through hardship.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, beela, abdii kutannaa, tattaaffii
Keywords_EN: devouring, hunger, fatalism, resilience, effort

Mammaaksa_AO: Erga teenye, urji lakkoofna jedhe namichi
Translation_Literal_EN: "Since we are already sitting idle, let us count the stars," said the man
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii dhabee fi yeroo gubu waan bu'aa hin qabne fi dhumti isaa hin jirre keessa gala.
Meaning_EN: "Since we have nothing to do, let's count the stars"; idle people occupy themselves with endless, futile tasks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota hojii bu'a qabeessa dhiisanii waan gatii hin qabne hojjetan qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically about bored, idle people who invent absurd, unproductive ways to kill time.
Keywords_AO: taa'uu, urjii lakkaa'uu, hojii dhabuu
Keywords_EN: sitting, counting stars, idleness, futile pastime

Mammaaksa_AO: nama dhaabbateetu, nama taa'urra jira
Translation_Literal_EN: The one on his feet is better positioned than the one sitting down
Meaning_AO: Namni socho'aa fi qophaa'ee jiru isa dantaa dhabee callisee taa'u caalaa carraa fi guddina qaba.
Meaning_EN: The person standing alert and active is in a far better state than the indolent person sitting inert.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii fi jireenya keessatti dammaqanii socho'uun taa'uu irra bu'aa akka qabu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to motivate someone to get up and be actively engaged rather than languishing in passive idleness.
Keywords_AO: dhaabbachuu, taa'uu, qophii, carraa
Keywords_EN: standing, sitting, alertness, readiness, enterprise

Mammaaksa_AO: Jibbi, waraabessa'lee hin hobbaafne
Translation_Literal_EN: Mere hatred never eradicated even the hyena
Meaning_AO: Waan tokko jibbuun qofti humna isa dhabamsiisu hin qabu; tarkaanfii qabatamaatu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Universal hatred never drove the hyena to extinction; emotional despise without action accomplishes nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jibba qofa qabatanii taa'uun jijjiirama akka hin finne hubachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight that passive disdain toward a nuisance will never remove it without decisive deeds.
Keywords_AO: jibba, waraabessa, hobbaasuu, tarkaanfii
Keywords_EN: hatred, hyena, eradication, action vs resentment

Mammaaksa_AO: lafa citanitti, citaa guurratan
Translation_Literal_EN: Where thatch grass is cut, that is where it is gathered
Meaning_AO: Bakka carraan jiru fi yeroo carraan argametti fayyadamanii bu'aa ofii sassaabbatu.
Meaning_EN: One gathers thatch right where it is cut; seize opportunities on the spot wherever and whenever they arise.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni carraa dhihootti argame osoo hin dantaa dhabin hatattamaan akka itti fayyadamu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise seizing immediate local advantages and harvesting opportunities right where they occur.
Keywords_AO: lafa, cituu, citaa, guurrachuu, carraa
Keywords_EN: grass cutting, thatch, gathering, opportunity, timing

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dalagaa hin qabne, xaafii gadi naqee guura
Translation_Literal_EN: A person with no work pours out teff grain and gathers it back up
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii qajeelaa dhabe dhiphinaa fi hojii bu'aa hin qabne of irratti uuma.
Meaning_EN: A person without meaningful work creates pointless chores, spilling grain only to collect it again.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii gatii hin qabne hojjetanii akka nama hojiin qabameetti of tuuluu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock people who invent useless, laborious distractions simply because they lack real productive goals.
Keywords_AO: dalagaa dhabuu, xaafii, guuruu, yeroo gubuu
Keywords_EN: joblessness, teff, spilling grain, wasted effort

Mammaaksa_AO: Sagal dhuufuu mannaa, takka haguu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than farting nine times, it is better to defecate once
Meaning_AO: Waan bu'aa hin qabne deddeebisanii dubbachuu yookiin hojjechuu mannaa murtee tokko murteessanii xumuruutu wayya.
Meaning_EN: Rather than repeated annoying half-measures, it is far better to take one decisive, thorough action.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota dhimma tokko irratti marii dheeressanii yeroo gubaniif murtee qabatamaa akka fidan gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demand a definitive resolution rather than endless noisy, indecisive half-steps.
Keywords_AO: sagal, takka, murtii, furmaata
Keywords_EN: nine times, once, decisiveness, thoroughness, action

Mammaaksa_AO: Malli abbaa, karaan labba
Translation_Literal_EN: The scheme belongs to the thinker, but the road belongs to the open expanse
Meaning_AO: Namni karoora ofii yoo baaseyyuu haalli qabatamaa karaa irratti mul'atu akka fedha isaatti ta'uu dhiisuu mala.
Meaning_EN: A person may formulate their clever plan, but the unpredictable realities of the road chart their own course.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti karoorsan hunduu akkuma yaadametti akka hin deemne hubachuun qophii barbaachisaa gochuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind planners that theoretical schemes must remain flexible to accommodate unpredictable terrain.
Keywords_AO: malli, abbaa, karaan, labba, karoora
Keywords_EN: strategy, road, open expanse, planning, reality

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan lafa taa'u, hoo shuumoo
Translation_Literal_EN: To a mouth that sits idle, "Here, take some boiled grain"
Meaning_AO: Nama dalagaa malee afaaniin qofa wacu wanta salphaa itti kennanii callisiisu.
Meaning_EN: A loud mouth that contributes no real labor is readily shut up by stuffing it with modest boiled grain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota faayidaa malee odeessan waanuma xiqqoon callisiisuu agarsiisuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss noisy grumblers whose complaints are easily silenced with minor handouts.
Keywords_AO: afaan, lafa taa'uu, shuumoo, callisuu
Keywords_EN: mouth, idle, boiled grain, silencing, appeasement

Mammaaksa_AO: Ka'an fiigu, taa'an rafu jedhe hilleeysi
Translation_Literal_EN: "If up, run full speed; if down, sleep soundly," said the hare
Meaning_AO: Yeroo hojjetan dandeettii guutuun hojjechuu, yeroo boqotan immoo tasgabbiin boqochuutu mala; laafina hin qabaatin.
Meaning_EN: "When awake, sprint with all your might; when resting, sleep deeply"; commit whole-heartedly to whatever you do.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii keessatti laafummaa dhiisanii xiyyeeffannoo guutuun akka hojjetaniif itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise total commitment: give your utmost energy to tasks, and rest without anxiety when done.
Keywords_AO: ka'uu, fiiguu, taa'uu, rafuu, hilleensa
Keywords_EN: rising, running, sitting, sleeping, hare, commitment

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo anatti dalagattan, akkaan ani qaamaa ol ooletti namaa ol ooltan jedhe mataan namaan
Translation_Literal_EN: "If you work using me, just as I sit above the body, you will stand above all other people," said the head to man
Meaning_AO: Sammuu, beekumsaa fi hubannaadhaan yoo hojjetan jireenya keessatti kabajaa fi sadarkaa ol aanaa argatu.
Meaning_EN: Using your intellect and wisdom elevates your station in life above others, just as the head sits atop the body.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humna qofa irratti hirkatu sammuu fi qorannoodhaan akka fayyadamu gorsuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to prioritize intellect, wisdom, and strategic thinking over brute force.
Keywords_AO: mataa, sammuu, beekumsa, guddina
Keywords_EN: head, intellect, wisdom, elevation, strategy

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni utaalee mogolee caphe, kan ciisee cinaacha caphe ni caala
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who leaped and broke a hamstring is better than the one who lay down and broke a rib
Meaning_AO: Tattaafachaa fi yaalii gochaa miidhamuun callisanii taa'aa yookiin ciisaa salphina keessa galuu caala.
Meaning_EN: Failing while daring bold endeavors is far nobler than suffering misfortune through lazy, cowardly stagnation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii keessatti kufaatii mudateef abdii kennuu fi yaalii gochuu isaa faarsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to console someone who took a brave risk and stumbled, praising their active courage over idle passivity.
Keywords_AO: utaaluu, mogolee, ciisuu, cinaacha, yaalii
Keywords_EN: leaping, hamstring, lying down, ribs, enterprise, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan qaban darbannaan, sodaataa hin tahani
Translation_Literal_EN: Once you have thrown whatever weapon you hold, you are no longer a coward
Meaning_AO: Humnaa fi carraa qaban hunda dhimma tokkoof oolchuun gootummaa fi murannoo guutuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Giving all the strength and weapons at your disposal into the struggle completely clears you of cowardice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama carraaqqii isa danda'ame hunda godheef qoodni isaa gootummaa ta'uu mirkaneessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure a fighter or worker who gave everything they had that their effort was truly valiant.
Keywords_AO: darbachuu, qabaachuu, sodaataa, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: throwing, weapon, coward, courage, full commitment

Mammaaksa_AO: Miila deemuutu gala
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the foot that walks that returns home with gains
Meaning_AO: Namni bahee socho'ee fi tattaafatu muuxannoo fi qabeenya argatee gara manaa milkaa'inaan deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: Only the foot that ventures forth travels, learns, and returns home enriched with success and experience.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama mana taa'ee guddina eeggatu socho'ee hojii akka barbaaddatu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people out of manufacturing excuses into pursuing livelihood, noting that enterprise brings home returns.
Keywords_AO: miila, deemuu, galuu, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: foot, walking, returning, enterprise, gains

Mammaaksa_AO: Deddeebi'ii keessa, haadni dhagaa mure
Translation_Literal_EN: Through repeated rubbing, the soft rope cuts through stone
Meaning_AO: Tattaaffiin walirraa hin cinne wantoota ulfaatoo fi jabaa fakkaatan hunda injifachuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Through constant, unrelenting friction, a soft rope eventually carves into solid rock; persistence conquers all.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii ulfaataa keessatti obsaan itti fufanii yoo hojjetan milkaa'inni akka dhufu jajjabeessuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire patience during prolonged uphill struggles, reminding that steady effort wears down mountains.
Keywords_AO: deddeebi'uu, haada, dhagaa, muruu, obsa
Keywords_EN: repetition, rope, stone, cutting, perseverance

Mammaaksa_AO: Jala shidan malee hin bilchaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless you stoke the fire underneath, it does not cook
Meaning_AO: Hojiin bu'aa gaarii akka kennuuf aarsaa fi tattaaffii dabalataa itti gochuun dirqama.
Meaning_EN: Nothing cooks or ripens without fueling the steady fire of hard work underneath it; passion drives results.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bu'aa barbaadu garuu hojichaaf gumaacha gochuu dhiise dammaqsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind someone that achievements require steady, energetic investment of effort beneath them.
Keywords_AO: shiduu, bilchaachuu, ibidda, aarsaa
Keywords_EN: stoking, fire, cooking, effort, investment

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan booda sii tolaa, garaa hidhadhuu itti jabaadhu
Translation_Literal_EN: It will be wonderful for you later, so gird your loins and endure with strength
Meaning_AO: Rakkina yeroo ammaa obsaan dandeessanii gara fuulduraatti jireenya gammachiisaa argachuuf cichuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: Brace yourself and endure present trials with resolute courage, for the eventual outcome will be sweet.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama yeroo ammaa qorumsi itti hammaate jajjabeessuu fi abdii itti horuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to strengthen the spirit of someone undergoing intense temporary hardships with the promise of future joy.
Keywords_AO: booda, toluu, garaa hidhachuu, jabaachuu
Keywords_EN: future reward, girding loins, endurance, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Fagoon laga gama
Translation_Literal_EN: "Far away" is merely just across the river
Meaning_AO: Wanti fagoo fakkaatu yoo deemsa itti jalqaban salphaatti bira gahuun danda'ama; qorumsa sodaachuu hin qaban.
Meaning_EN: What appears unimaginably distant is simply across the river; once you take the first steps, distance shrinks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama karoora yookiin galma guddaa sodaatee duubatti harkifatu jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage someone intimidated by a long project that embarking on the journey brings goals into reach.
Keywords_AO: fagoo, laga gama, deemsa, dhihoo
Keywords_EN: far away, across river, journey, perspective, courage

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaa dhibuu mannaa, miila dhibuu wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Better to lack feet than to lack courage and spirit in the heart
Meaning_AO: Miidhaa qaamaa caalaa murannoo, kaka'umsaa fi abdii garaa keessaa dhabuutu nama kuffisa.
Meaning_EN: Physical impairment of the feet is manageable, but lacking heart, spirit, and resolve is total defeat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Murannoon keessaa humna qaamaa hundarra akka caalu hubachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that unwavering inner willpower and courage matter far more than physical strength.
Keywords_AO: garaa, miila, dhibuu, murannoo
Keywords_EN: heart, courage, feet, spirit, inner resolve

Mammaaksa_AO: Teenyee maa gubannaa, deemnee hubanna
Translation_Literal_EN: Why should we sit and burn with anxiety, when we can walk and understand for ourselves?
Meaning_AO: Taa'anii yaaddoodhaan dhiphachuu mannaa socho'anii dhugaa jiru baruu fi furmaata barbaaduutu caala.
Meaning_EN: Rather than agonizing in passive paralysis, step out into the field to investigate and understand reality directly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama yaaddoon qabamee mana taa'u ka'ee tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gochuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people out of anxious speculation and rumor into direct, empirical discovery.
Keywords_AO: taa'uu, gubachuu, deemuu, hubachuu
Keywords_EN: sitting, burning, walking, discovering, action

Mammaaksa_AO: Hormaanni, hiree hin tahu
Translation_Literal_EN: Mere material increase does not constitute true blessed destiny
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi baay'achuun qofti nagaa fi gammachuu hin fidu; eebbaa fi hiree gaarii qabaachuutu caala.
Meaning_EN: Mere multiplying of worldly herds does not guarantee happiness; true well-being requires peace and blessed fate.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qabeenya qofaan boonee jireenya dhugaa dagate gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against equating raw accumulation of assets with genuine contentment and divine blessing.
Keywords_AO: hormaata, hiree, qabeenya, eebba
Keywords_EN: wealth, herds, destiny, blessing, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Tuffataan hiree hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: The disdainful person has no share in good fortune
Meaning_AO: Namni carraa fi waan xiqqoo argate tuffatu dhumarratti qoodaa fi milkaa'ina guddaa dhabee qullaa hafa.
Meaning_EN: He who scorns modest opportunities or gifts ends up missing out on real fortunes and blessings.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama carraa argame tuffatee waan guddaa hawwu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that arrogance and contempt toward modest gifts inevitably leaves one empty-handed.
Keywords_AO: tuffachuu, hiree, carraa, galata
Keywords_EN: disdain, contempt, fortune, opportunity, gratitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Itti buufan malee, sibiilli hin finiinu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless the bellows are pumped upon it, iron does not glow red-hot
Meaning_AO: Dandeettii fi humna jiru ifatti baasuuf tattaaffii jabaa fi kaka'umsa itti dabalanii hojjechuun dirqama.
Meaning_EN: Latent potential and raw steel remain cold and inert until the relentless bellows of labor ignite them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dandeettii osoo qabuu hojiitti hin hiikin jajjabeessuu fi dammaqsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that latent talent requires aggressive training, pressure, and effort to shine brilliantly.
Keywords_AO: buufuu, sibiila, finiinuu, kaka'umsa
Keywords_EN: bellows, iron, glowing, effort, igniting talent

Mammaaksa_AO: Sossohuun, bakkaa nama hin siysu
Translation_Literal_EN: Merely fidgeting does not move one forward from one's place
Meaning_AO: Sochii galma fi qajeelfama hin qabneen yeroo gubuun gara guddinaatti nama hin geessu.
Meaning_EN: Aimless fidgeting and chaotic movement without true directional purpose yield no meaningful progress.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii bu'aa hin qabneen asii fi achi fiigu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to critique hectic busyness that lacks strategy, reminding that motion is not necessarily progress.
Keywords_AO: sossohuu, bakka, siqsuu, galma
Keywords_EN: fidgeting, moving, progress, aimless busyness, direction

Mammaaksa_AO: Kennaan guyyaa tokkoo, hiyyeessa hin guddisu
Translation_Literal_EN: A single day's gift does not make a poor man prosperous
Meaning_AO: Gargaarsi al tokkoo rakkoo hiyyummaa bu'uuraan hin furu; hojjetanii of dandeessisuutu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: A one-off charitable handout cannot solve long-term poverty; sustainable livelihood demands work and self-reliance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Harka qalleeyyiidhaaf furmaata waaraa uumuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advocate for empowering people with skills and sustained enterprise rather than fleeting handouts.
Keywords_AO: kennaa, guyyaa tokko, hiyyeessa, guddina
Keywords_EN: gift, one day, poor, empowerment, sustainable work

Mammaaksa_AO: Akkumaan xullub xullub ja'u kanaaniin gaara xuulloo bahuu taa'aa je'e raachi
Translation_Literal_EN: "With these modest hops of mine, I am going to scale Mount Xuulloo," said the frog
Meaning_AO: Dandeettiin ofii xiqqoo yoo ta'eyyuu obsaa fi cichoominaan galma guddaa bira gahuun akka danda'amu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: "Hop by humble hop, I will scale Mount Xuulloo"; small but steadfast strides conquer the highest peaks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bu'uura xiqqoorraa ka'ee galma guddaa abdatu jajjabeessuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage someone starting from humble beginnings that consistent modest strides will reach great heights.
Keywords_AO: xullub, raacha, gaara xuulloo, cichoomina
Keywords_EN: hopping, frog, mountain, persistence, ambition

Mammaaksa_AO: Rakkattu malee hin bal'attu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless you undergo severe constriction, you will not experience broad expanse
Meaning_AO: Dhiphinaa fi qorumsa jireenyaa osoo hin baatin gara badhaadhinaa fi nagaa bal'aatti bahuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: One must pass through narrow straits of hardship before reaching the wide, glorious plains of prosperity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qorumsa keessa jiruuf rakkoo booda bal'inni akka jiru abdachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort someone enduring harsh difficulties, promising that prosperity emerges on the other side.
Keywords_AO: rakkina, bal'achuu, qorumsa, badhaadhina
Keywords_EN: hardship, expanse, narrow straits, prosperity, growth

Mammaaksa_AO: Hanga raatu diroon dhadhaa baati
Translation_Literal_EN: Through prolonged churning, the milk gourd yields rich butter
Meaning_AO: Hojii tokko irratti yoo yeroo fi aarsaa gahaa kennan, bu'aa mi'aawaa fi gatii qabu argatu.
Meaning_EN: By patiently churning milk in the gourd, rich butter eventually separates; endurance produces sweet rewards.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojiin isaa dafee bu'aa hin kenniniif obsaan akka itti fufu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel perseverance in ongoing projects, assuring that diligent churning will yield rich butter.
Keywords_AO: raasuu, diroo, dhadhaa, obsa
Keywords_EN: churning, milk gourd, butter, patience, sweet harvest

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhalti guddoon wahitti nama baafti
Translation_Literal_EN: Great progeny and productive stock elevate a person to honor
Meaning_AO: Ijoollee gaarii guddifachuu fi qabeenya bu'a qabeessa horachuun dhumarratti nama milkeessa.
Meaning_EN: Rearing virtuous progeny and nurturing productive stock eventually raises a household to high standing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Faayidaa maatii cimaa fi sanyii gaarii horachuu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate the long-term fruits of investing lovingly in strong, upright offspring and productive wealth.
Keywords_AO: dhala, guddaa, maatii, kabajaa
Keywords_EN: progeny, offspring, elevation, family legacy, honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama irraa baratanii, nama irra baratani
Translation_Literal_EN: One learns from others, and through learning, one surpasses others
Meaning_AO: Jalqaba beekumsa namootarraa fudhatanii booda dandeettii ofii guddifachuun namoota caaluu danda'u.
Meaning_EN: One begins by humbly learning from mentors, and by mastering that craft, one eventually excels and surpasses them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Barataan ciminaan hojjete barsiisaa isaa caalee akka mul'achuu danda'u ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire students and apprentices that humble study today paves the path to supreme excellence tomorrow.
Keywords_AO: barachuu, nama irraa, caaluu, beekumsa
Keywords_EN: learning, mentor, surpassing, excellence, study

Mammaaksa_AO: Mixiin of hin tuffattuu, dhaga ba'attee deemti
Translation_Literal_EN: The tiny ant does not despise itself; it hoists a stone and marches on
Meaning_AO: Qaamaan xiqqaa ta'aniyyuu of tuffachuu dhiisanii murannoo fi cichoominaan ba'aa guddaa baachuun ni danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: The little ant never looks down upon its small size; it hoists heavy stones and moves purposefully forward.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humni koo xiqqoodha jedhee abdii kutatuuf akka inni of amanu jajjabeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire self-confidence in individuals facing gigantic tasks despite their modest circumstances.
Keywords_AO: mixii, dhagaa, ba'achuu, of amanuu
Keywords_EN: ant, stone, carrying, self-confidence, tenacity

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka aalaa itti nyaatan hin taa'ani, taa'an alotti deebi'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not linger at the feast of harvest; lingering sends one back into destitution
Meaning_AO: Milkaa'ina yeroo tokkootti gammadaa taa'uun qabeenya balleessa; hojii haaraaf socho'uutu mala.
Meaning_EN: Do not linger passively celebrating past bounty; complacently resting on laurels returns you straight to poverty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bu'aa argatetti quufe hojii dhaabeef itti fufinsaan akka hojjetu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against resting on past laurels, reminding that sustainable wealth demands ongoing industry.
Keywords_AO: aalaa, nyaachuu, taa'uu, hiyyummaa, dammaqina
Keywords_EN: harvest, feasting, lingering, complacency, ongoing work

Mammaaksa_AO: Boolla arbaaf qotan, ifiif dura itti badani
Translation_Literal_EN: A pit dug for an elephant, the digger falls into it first
Meaning_AO: Namni nama biraatiif kiyyoo fi hammeenya guddaa qopheessu ofuma isaatii dura itti kuffee miidhama.
Meaning_EN: He who digs a massive pitfall for an elephant falls into it himself first; wicked plots backfire on the plotter.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama diina isaa kuffisuuf kiyyoo qopheessee ofumaan itti kufe akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that malicious traps set for others often ensnare the very schemer who created them.
Keywords_AO: boolla, arba, qotuu, kiyyoo, badii
Keywords_EN: pit, elephant, digging, trap, backfiring, retribution

Mammaaksa_AO: Boolla namaaf hin qotin, qottuus qad hin fageessin ifiif itti galtu hin beektuu
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not dig a pit for another, and if you do, do not make it deep; you never know if you will fall into it yourself
Meaning_AO: Nama miidhuuf kiyyoo qopheessuu dhiisuu wayya; yoo qopheessanis kiyyichi deebi'ee of kuffisuu mala.
Meaning_EN: Do not dig a trap for your fellow man, and if you do, keep it shallow; you may be the one who ends up tumbling in.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hammeenya nama irratti karoorsuuf akka inni of eeggatu gorsuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people against orchestrating ruin for others, reminding that malice often recoils.
Keywords_AO: boolla, fageessuu, kiyyoo, qajeelummaa
Keywords_EN: pit, shallow, trap, restraint, ethics, recoil

Mammaaksa_AO: Haachuu abbaan qaree, abbaa qale
Translation_Literal_EN: The sickle the owner sharpened slit the owner's own throat
Meaning_AO: Wanti yookiin namni ofii jabeessanii fi qopheessan deebi'ee of irratti gara galee miidhaa geessisa.
Meaning_EN: The very blade sharpened carefully by its owner ended up slitting his own throat; one's creation causing ruin.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama nama gargaaree guddisetti yookiin meeshaa qopheessetti miidhame ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a person is harmed by the very protégé or tool they personally nurtured and empowered.
Keywords_AO: haachuu, qaruu, qaluu, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: sickle, sharpening, slitting throat, self-sabotage

Mammaaksa_AO: Barbareen, abbuma dhaabe gubdi
Translation_Literal_EN: Hot pepper burns the mouth of the one who planted it
Meaning_AO: Hammeenyi fi bu'aan badaa namni qopheesse duraan dursee abbuma qopheesse sana guba.
Meaning_EN: Fiery pepper burns the very hands and mouth of the farmer who planted it; cultivating bitterness harms the cultivator.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni gocha badaa facaase dhumarratti miidhaa isaa dhandhamuu akka qabu hubachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that sowing malice, discord, or toxicity inevitably scorches the person who nurtured it.
Keywords_AO: barbaree, dhaabuu, gubuu, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: pepper, planting, burning, consequences, karma

Mammaaksa_AO: Amiiroo keeyruma dalagi, sharriin abbuma eeggattii
Translation_Literal_EN: O my friend, do only good deeds; evil always lies in wait for its author
Meaning_AO: Yeroo hunda gaarummaa fi tola qofa hojjedhu; hammeenyi fi daboon gara abbaa isaatti deebi'uun hin oolu.
Meaning_EN: Strive always to practice goodness and charity; wickedness inevitably lies in ambush for its own author.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hammeenya irratti akka hin hirmaanne fi tola qofa akka dalagu jajjabeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to stick firmly to good deeds, knowing that malevolent actions destroy their perpetrator.
Keywords_AO: keeyrii, sharrii, tola, dalaguu
Keywords_EN: goodness, evil, charity, virtue, retribution

Mammaaksa_AO: Ifii ja'aniit, namaaf dhabani
Translation_Literal_EN: They thought only of themselves, and thus deprived others and themselves
Meaning_AO: Ofittummaan waan hunda dhuunfachuuf yaaluun dhumarratti firummaa fi gargaarsa namaa dhabsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Greedily hoarding everything for self-interest eventually alienates the community and leaves one helpless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ofittoo qabeenya dhuunfatee nama biraa dantaa dhabe gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn selfish greed that destroys communal harmony and leaves the hoarder friendless.
Keywords_AO: ifii, ofittummaa, dhabuu, namaaf
Keywords_EN: self, selfishness, deprivation, greed, isolation

Mammaaksa_AO: Akkuma intalti tiruu goote, tiruun intala goote
Translation_Literal_EN: Just as the girl treated the liver, the liver treated the girl
Meaning_AO: Gochaan namni tokko namatti raawwate akkuma jirutti deebi'ee bu'aa walfakkaataa fida; wanti kennan ni deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: Just as the girl treated the liver, the liver reciprocated; every action triggers an exact corresponding consequence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni waan gaarii yookiin badaa hojjete deebii walfakkaataa yeroo argatu itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone reaps precisely what they sowed, proving the unerring law of reciprocity.
Keywords_AO: intala, tiruu, gocha, haqa
Keywords_EN: girl, liver, deed, reciprocity, consequence

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaan ganama hijaan dabran, gala nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: The road traveled with spite in the morning makes the evening return treacherous
Meaning_AO: Yeroo carraan jiru nama miidhanii darbuun yeroo rakkinaa deebi'anii nama biratti fudhatama dhabsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Traveling a road with malice in the morning makes returning along it in the evening impossible; do not burn bridges.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama yeroo har'aa aangootti fayyadamee namoota miidhuuf fuuldura akka yaadu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn arrogant individuals against mistreating people today, since they may need their grace tomorrow.
Keywords_AO: karaa, ganama, gala, hijaa, hammeenya
Keywords_EN: road, morning, return, spite, burning bridges

Mammaaksa_AO: Malaani bishaan waadan;
Translation_Literal_EN: With strategy and cunning, they can even roast water
Meaning_AO: Beekumsa, malaa fi tooftaa qajeelaadhaan wanta hin danda'amne fakkaatu hunda raawwachuun ni danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: With sharp intelligence and ingenuity, one can even roast water; clever strategy accomplishes the impossible.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkoon itti baay'atee abdii kutateef mala fi ogummaadhaan akka furu jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise the power of creative ingenuity, noting that brilliant tactics overcome insurmountable odds.
Keywords_AO: mala, bishaan, waaduu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: strategy, water, roasting, ingenuity, possibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijji taa'aa hin agartuu, malaani udaan irraa haqan,
Translation_Literal_EN: The eye cannot see the sitting posture, yet tact and technique wipe it clean
Meaning_AO: Wanta ijaan kallattiin hin argineyyuu hubannoo, ogummaa fi tooftaa barataniin to'atanii qulqulleessu.
Meaning_EN: Though the eyes cannot see the sitting rear, practiced technique wipes it clean; intellect manages unseen matters.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii keessatti ija qofa osoo hin taane ogummaa fi muuxannoodhaan dhimma furuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that ingrained skill, sensory experience, and technique solve challenges that eyes cannot see.
Keywords_AO: ija, taa'aa, mala, haquu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: eye, sitting, technique, wiping, practical skill

Mammaaksa_AO: Dukkana Keessaa ifaa si baasaa, rakkoo keessaa malaa si baasa
Translation_Literal_EN: Light leads you out of darkness, and strategy leads you out of trouble
Meaning_AO: Akkuma ifaan dukkana dhabamsiisee qajeelcha kennu, beekumsaa fi falli qajeelaan rakkina keessaa nama baasa.
Meaning_EN: Just as bright light delivers one from deep darkness, sound ingenuity and wisdom guide one out of severe crisis.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qorumsa keessatti dhiphachuu dhiisanii malaa fi fala beekumsaa barbaaddachuuf gorfama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire people in distress to rely on strategic intelligence, which illuminates a way out of trials.
Keywords_AO: dukkana, ifaa, rakkoo, mala
Keywords_EN: darkness, light, trouble, strategy, deliverance

Mammaaksa_AO: Adunyaan aylumaa, aakiraan amaluma
Translation_Literal_EN: The temporal world demands intellect, and the hereafter demands righteous character
Meaning_AO: Jireenya addunyaa keessatti qaroomaa fi malaan jiraatan, aakiraa keessatti garuu amala qajeelaa fi hojii gaariitu faayidaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: Surviving this earthly world requires sharp wits and intelligence; attaining eternal salvation demands moral virtue.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jireenya addunyaa fi kan amantaa walitti madaalanii akka qajeelchan barsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach a balanced life: use sharp intellect to navigate this world, but keep noble character for eternity.
Keywords_AO: adunyaa, ayli, aakiraa, amala
Keywords_EN: temporal world, wits, hereafter, moral character

Mammaaksa_AO: Marqa afuufuun, sossobanii liqimsuufi
Translation_Literal_EN: Blowing on hot porridge is meant to soothe and swallow it
Meaning_AO: Wanta jabaa fi ulfaataa ta'e obsaan tasgabbeessanii fi laaffisanii dhimma ofii galmaan gahatu.
Meaning_EN: Blowing gently upon steaming porridge is merely a patient tactic to cool it down and swallow it smoothly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma xaxamaa aariidhaan osoo hin taane obsaa fi tooftaadhaan laaffisanii xumuruuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe gentle diplomacy and patient moderation applied to defuse and resolve volatile situations.
Keywords_AO: marqa, afuufuu, sossobaa, liqimsuu
Keywords_EN: porridge, blowing, soothing, swallowing, tact

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa marqa wanniniin si afuufuuf si liqimsuufi malee, si dhiisuufii miti
Translation_Literal_EN: "O porridge, the reason I blow on you is to swallow you, not to spare you"
Meaning_AO: Tasgabbiin yookiin laafina yeroof agarsiisan dhimma sana dhiisuuf osoo hin taane tooftaadhaan milkeessuufi.
Meaning_EN: Patience and gentle delay should never be mistaken for surrender or abandonment; the objective will be seized.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama laafina keenya akka sodaatti lakkaa'eef galmi keenya akka hin jijjiiramne hubachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inform an adversary that tactical patience and courteous handling do not mean giving up the goal.
Keywords_AO: marqa, afuufuu, liqimsuu, dhiisuu
Keywords_EN: porridge, blowing, swallowing, tactical patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Muccaa abbaa lafaa utuu irratti kufuu beekanuu jalatti kufu
Translation_Literal_EN: Knowing the landlord's child is falling, one falls beneath him to break his fall
Meaning_AO: Abbaa taayitaa yookiin nama aangoo qabu kabajuu fi balaa irraa eeguuf jecha miidhaa ofitti fudhatu.
Meaning_EN: Knowing the powerful landlord's heir is falling, subordinates dive beneath him to cushion the impact and absorb injury.
Theme_EN: Absorbing the Fall for the Powerful
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota abbootii aangootiif jecha of miidhan yookiin itti gaafatamummaa nama biraa baatan qeequuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize servile sycophancy where underlings voluntarily injure themselves to protect elite masters.
Keywords_AO: mucaa, abbaa lafaa, kufuu, aangoo
Keywords_EN: child, landlord, falling, cushioning, sycophancy

Mammaaksa_AO: Hantuutni boolla lamaa hin du'u
Translation_Literal_EN: A mouse with two exit holes does not easily die
Meaning_AO: Namni karoorawwan filannoo fi mala dabalataa qabu balaa fi rakkoo tasa mudatu keessaa salphaatti baha.
Meaning_EN: A mouse that prepares two exit holes rarely gets trapped; having contingency alternatives ensures survival.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii fi jireenya keessatti yeroo hunda karoora lammaffaa qabaachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise always maintaining backup options and alternative plans to survive unpredictable setbacks.
Keywords_AO: hantuuta, boolla lama, du'a ooluu, mala
Keywords_EN: mouse, two burrows, backup plan, contingency, survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Allaatti nyaachuu kajeelan, sololiyaa jedhanin
Translation_Literal_EN: When they crave to eat a forbidden bird, they call it a francolin
Meaning_AO: Wanta dhowwamaa yookiin seeraan ala ta'e raawwachuuf fedhaniif maqaa gaarii fi fudhatama qabu kennaniifii gocha sana dhiheessu.
Meaning_EN: When craving to eat a taboo scavenger bird, they re-label it a delicious partridge; justifying vices by rebranding them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gocha seeraan alaa fi gadhee ta'eef maqaa qulqulluu moggaasee ittiin daldalu saaxiluuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose hypocrites who rename immoral deeds with pious or acceptable labels to legitimize their lusts.
Keywords_AO: allaattii, sololiyaa, kajeellaa, maqaa jijjiiruu
Keywords_EN: scavenger bird, francolin, rationalization, hypocrisy

Mammaaksa_AO: Saalaa haada sa'aatiin qabani
Translation_Literal_EN: The wild oryx is roped using the tether of a domesticated cow
Meaning_AO: Meeshaa fi tooftaa salphaa harkaa qabaniin wanta guddaa, sodaachisaa fi rakkisaa ta'e to'achuun ni danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: A fierce, wild oryx can be secured with a simple domestic cow-rope; accessible tools tame mighty wild challenges.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan harkaa qabanitti fayyadamanii rakkoo guddaa furuu akka danda'an namoota barsiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that ordinary, everyday instruments can resolve extraordinary crises when combined with skill.
Keywords_AO: saala, haada, sa'aa, qabachuu, mala
Keywords_EN: oryx, rope, cow tether, capturing, resourcefulness

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilma abaan kiyyaatu tahaan ergachuu dadhabe, ormi keetiitu tahaan ergate
Translation_Literal_EN: The haughty son whose own father could not command, strangers humbled and made to run their errands
Meaning_AO: Namni maatii isaatiif ajajamuuf of tuulee dide ormi isa cabsanii salphinatti isa bitu.
Meaning_EN: The defiant son who refused his father's gentle guidance was completely broken and subordinated by cruel strangers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dargaggoota maatii tuffatanii ormaaf meeshaa ta'an gorsuu fi akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn rebellious youths that scorning parental counsel will only lead to humiliating subjugation by strangers.
Keywords_AO: ilma, abbaa, orma, ergachuu, of tuulummaa
Keywords_EN: son, father, strangers, obedience, humility, fall

Mammaaksa_AO: "Buufaa bari, kijiba bari, jaldhaaba bari" je'e, tumtichi ilmaan
Translation_Literal_EN: "Learn the bellows, learn persuasive embellishment, learn the tongs," said the blacksmith to his son
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi daldala keessatti dandeettii harkaa qofa osoo hin taane tooftaa haasaa fi dhiheessaa beekuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: In craft and commerce, technical skill alone is insufficient; one must master persuasive negotiation and diplomacy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ogummaa hojii baratuuf dandeettii daldalaa fi haasaa akka cimsatu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach apprentices that master craftsmanship requires technical finesse combined with savvy salesmanship.
Keywords_AO: buufaa, kijiba, jaldhaaba, tumtuu
Keywords_EN: bellows, exaggeration, tongs, blacksmith, salesmanship

Mammaaksa_AO: "Maaliif gurra re'eettii irratti iyyita" je'ee korbeesi hoolaa gaafannaan "akka anaaf laaftu godhuu kiyya" je'e korbeessi re'ee
Translation_Literal_EN: When the ram asked "Why scream into the she-goat's ear?", the billy-goat replied "To make it easier for myself"
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko fedhii isaa salphaatti raawwachiifachuuf tooftaa naasuu fi wacaatti dhimma baha.
Meaning_EN: Creating sensory overload and noisy panic is often used as a deliberate tactic to disorient and secure compliance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wacaa fi naasuudhaan dhimma ofii milkeessuuf yaalu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used satirically to expose individuals who manufacture loud drama and commotion to railroad others into submission.
Keywords_AO: gurra, iyyuu, re'ee, hoolaa, korbeessa
Keywords_EN: ear, screaming, she-goat, ram, disorienting drama

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka dhagaa jala seene, suuta suutaan baafatani
Translation_Literal_EN: A hand trapped under a heavy stone is eased out slowly and carefully
Meaning_AO: Yeroo rakkina ulfaataa fi kiyyoo jabaa keessa galan tasgabbiidhaan, obsaan of bilisa baasu malee hin jarjaran.
Meaning_EN: A hand caught beneath a crushing boulder must be extricated millimeter by millimeter; volatile crises demand patient delicacy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru aariidhaan osoo hin taane obsaan akka keessaa bahu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel cool-headed, deliberate patience when trapped in precarious and dangerous entanglements.
Keywords_AO: harka, dhagaa, suuta, baafachuu
Keywords_EN: hand, heavy stone, extrication, patience, crisis management

Mammaaksa_AO: Faranjiin, malaani bishaan gaara baafti
Translation_Literal_EN: Through ingenuity and science, foreigners pump water up a mountain
Meaning_AO: Beekumsa, malaa fi saayinsiidhaan wantoota uumamaan hin danda'amne fakkaatan hunda milkeessuun ni danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: Through technical ingenuity and applied engineering, foreigners pump water uphill; intelligence conquers physical barriers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Humna beekumsaa fi teeknooloojii agarsiisuun namoota akka baratan jajjabeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise the triumph of scientific innovation, proving that smart techniques conquer seemingly impossible hurdles.
Keywords_AO: faranjii, mala, bishaan, gaara
Keywords_EN: foreigner, ingenuity, water, mountain, engineering

Mammaaksa_AO: Kuni tooftaan meeshaa ittiin gurguratanii jette hantuutni
Translation_Literal_EN: "This is merely a sales technique to market their goods," said the mouse of the baited trap
Meaning_AO: Balaa fi kiyyoo lubbuu dhabsiisu salphistanii ilaaluun gowwummaa guddaadha.
Meaning_EN: The mouse rationalized the lethal baited trap as mere advertising; foolishly trivializing a fatal danger.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama balaa ifa ta'e dura dhaabbatee akka waan salphaatti ilaalu saaxiluuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock people who fool themselves into thinking obvious traps and hazards are harmless conveniences.
Keywords_AO: tooftaa, meeshaa, gurguruu, hantuuta
Keywords_EN: technique, merchandise, trap, mouse, fatal rationalization

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni bishaan daakkii beeku, dakkii keessattii nama dhiita
Translation_Literal_EN: The person who knows how to swim kicks others under water
Meaning_AO: Namni ogummaa fi beekumsa addaa qabu dandeettii isaatti fayyadamee dhoksaan nama miidhuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: An expert swimmer uses his underwater prowess to secretly kick and sabotage others; expertise abused for covert harm.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dandeettii qabu garuu dandeettii sanaan dhoksaatti nama miidhu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against skilled insiders who leverage their unseen technical advantage to sabotage rivals.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, daakuu, dhiituu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: water, swimming, kicking, covert sabotage, expertise

Mammaaksa_AO: Booyyeen nama nyaattiin waan gabraan sodaachisani
Translation_Literal_EN: "Wild boars devour humans" is the manufactured myth used to terrify servants
Meaning_AO: Oduu sobaa fi wanta hin jirre uumuudhaan namoota dadhaboo sodaachisanii to'annaa jala oolchu.
Meaning_EN: Fabricating absurd fairy-tale horrors to keep servants terrified, docile, and completely subservient.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mootummaan yookiin abboonni aangoo uummata sobaan sodaachisanii to'achuu saaxiluuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose ruling authorities or bullies who invent baseless bogeys to paralyze subjects into obedience.
Keywords_AO: booyyee, nama nyaachuu, gabra, sodaachisuu
Keywords_EN: wild boar, man-eater, servant, manufactured fear, control

Mammaaksa_AO: Luka falmii, harki haa lafa bu'u
Translation_Literal_EN: In a desperate battle over your leg, let the hand touch the ground
Meaning_AO: Yeroo dhimma guddaa fi lubbuu irratti qabsa'an wanta xiqqoo aarsaa gochuun ooluutu wayya.
Meaning_EN: In a life-and-death struggle over saving one's limbs, brace with the hand or make minor concessions to preserve the whole.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta guddaa oolchuuf wanta xiqqoo aarsaa gochuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel strategic concession: surrender a small claim or asset to protect life and core interests.
Keywords_AO: luka, falmii, harka, aarsaa
Keywords_EN: leg, dispute, hand, concession, strategic survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii sii hin tahin, haayaan si hin dhibin, bakkaa si hin argin
Translation_Literal_EN: In a matter that does not belong to you, let not "yes" burden you, and let no one find you at the scene
Meaning_AO: Dhimma ofii hin taane keessa seenuu dhiisuu, waadaa hin galle seenuu dhiisuu fi of eeggannoo gochuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Do not meddle in matters not your own; do not bind yourself with careless assent, and steer clear of the scene.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota dubbii ormaa keessa seenanii rakkina keessa galaniif akka fagaatan gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to avoid meddling in outside disputes, warning that neither verbal assent nor physical presence belongs there.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, haayaa, bakka, of eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: speech, assent, distance, discretion, meddling

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin karraan baatu, ati qoqqobaan bahi
Translation_Literal_EN: If your wife storms out through the main gate, you step out through the side hedge
Meaning_AO: Yeroo aariin ka'u walitti bu'iinsa kallattiirraa fagaatanii karaa tasgabbii fi nagaa filachuun maatii baraarsa.
Meaning_EN: When anger flares and your partner charges through the main gate, take the side hedge; avoid destructive frontal clashes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jeequmsa maatii keessatti aarii aariin deebisuu dhiisanii tasgabbaa'uuf gorfama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise husbands and partners to defuse volatile domestic confrontations through non-confrontational evasion.
Keywords_AO: niitii, karra, qoqqobaa, nagaa
Keywords_EN: wife, main gate, side hedge, de-escalation, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Toosiiboon luynooma hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: Dire necessity and destiny know no cowardice
Meaning_AO: Yeroo dhiphinaa fi qorumsi lubbuu dhufu namni sodaataan iyyuu ija jabinaan falmachuuf dirqama.
Meaning_EN: Dire emergency and existential necessity erase cowardice; when survival is at stake, even the meekest find ferocious bravery.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni sodaataa fakkaatullee yeroo rakkoo jabaa akka gootaatti socho'uu danda'uu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to note that when cornered by absolute necessity, even historically timid people display astonishing valor.
Keywords_AO: toosiiboo, luynummaa, dirqama, jireenya
Keywords_EN: necessity, cowardice, courage, survival, emergency

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhaamonnaan harkifnee, nuun lollaan lakkifne
Translation_Literal_EN: When chilled we pulled the blanket, but when they fought us over it we let it go
Meaning_AO: Waan qananii yookiin salphaadhaaf jecha lola fi jeequmsa keessa galuu mannaa dhiisanii nagaan jiraachuutu caala.
Meaning_EN: We drew the cover for warmth, but when contested with hostility we yielded; never buy trivial comfort with bloodshed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan gatii hin qabneef jecha lola kaasuu dhiisanii nagaa dursuu agarsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise graceful concession over petty luxuries, choosing serenity over endless, venomous conflict.
Keywords_AO: dhaamochuu, harkisuu, loluu, lakkisuu
Keywords_EN: cold, pulling blanket, fighting, yielding, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: lola leencaa harka tokkotti eeboo, harka tokkotti marga baatu
Translation_Literal_EN: When confronting a lion, carry a spear in one hand and fresh green grass in the other
Meaning_AO: Balaa guddaa dura dhaabbachuuf qophii lolaa fi mala araaraa lamaanuu qabatanii deemuun ogummaa dhugaati.
Meaning_EN: Facing the lion, hold a weapon of defense in one hand and fresh grass of peace in the other; prepare for all outcomes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma ulfaataa keessatti nagaa barbaaduu wajjin of eeggannoo jabaa gochuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach diplomatic readiness: pursue peace sincerely, but maintain formidable defensive strength simultaneously.
Keywords_AO: leenca, eeboo, marga, qophii
Keywords_EN: lion, spear, green grass, dual readiness, deterrence

Mammaaksa_AO: Joollee maleeykaa dubbisaa, diddu didi malee muca
Translation_Literal_EN: Children speak with angels; if you must refuse, simply refuse plainly, my child
Meaning_AO: Ijoolleen amanamummaa fi qulqullummaan wanta garaa isaanii dubbatu; haqa isaaniis iftoominan simachuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: Children communicate with angelic purity; if they decline something, their simple, unfeigned refusal should be honored.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qulqullummaa fi dubbii daa'immanii kabajuu fi soba malee simachuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind adults to respect the innocent, transparent honesty of children without forcing hypocritical pretenses.
Keywords_AO: joollee, maleeykaa, diduu, qulqullummaa
Keywords_EN: children, angels, candor, innocence, plain refusal

Mammaaksa_AO: Kiyyaan na duraa hin lolino, jette niitiin dhiirsaan
Translation_Literal_EN: "Do not fight my own kin in the name of defending me," said the wife to her husband
Meaning_AO: Maqaa jaalala ofiitiin firaa fi aanaa namaa wajjin walitti bu'iinsa uumuun balaa guddaa akka qabu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: "Do not quarrel with my kin in the name of fighting for me"; never fracture your partner's family out of misguided zeal.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhiirsi yookiin michuun maqaa namaatiin maatii sana wajjin akka hin lolu akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution spouses against creating irreparable rifts with their in-laws under the pretext of defending their mate.
Keywords_AO: niitii, dhiirsa, fira, lola
Keywords_EN: wife, husband, kin, fighting, preserving family

Mammaaksa_AO: Dukkanaaf ifa, hiraariif ayliitu barbbaachisa
Translation_Literal_EN: For darkness, light is needed; for deep sorrow and distress, intellect and wisdom are required
Meaning_AO: Akkuma dukkanni ifaan dhabamu, dhiphinaa fi gadadoo jireenyaa keessaa bahuufis sammuu fi fala beekumsaatu furmaata.
Meaning_EN: Just as physical darkness is pierced by light, emotional anguish and deep distress require intellect and wisdom to overcome.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gaddaa fi dhiphina keessa jiruuf sammuudhaan tasgabbaa'ee akka fala argu jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that overcoming deep trauma and despair requires rational guidance, wisdom, and mental fortitude.
Keywords_AO: dukkana, ifa, hiraara, ayli
Keywords_EN: darkness, light, sorrow, intellect, wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Tokkichi waaqa hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: A solitary person stands without divine protection and communal backing
Meaning_AO: Namni kophaa hafe firaa fi deggersa waan dhabuuf salphaatti kufaatii fi miidhaaf saaxilama.
Meaning_EN: An isolated individual lacks both divine and communal shield; human beings need solidarity to survive.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qophaa ta'uun gahaadha jedhee oftuuluuf hawaasaa wajjin akka hiriiru gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against proud self-isolation, reminding that solitary individuals are extremely vulnerable.
Keywords_AO: tokkicha, waaqa, qobummaa, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: solitary, community, isolation, vulnerability, solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Qubni tokko, fuula hin dhiqu
Translation_Literal_EN: A single finger cannot wash a face
Meaning_AO: Hojii guddaa fi hawaasummaa namni tokko qofaan galmaan gahuu hin danda'u; harka walitti qabachuutu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: A single finger cannot wash a face; communal, cooperative effort is required to accomplish significant tasks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni hojii gamtaa keessatti hundi isaanii qooda akka fudhataniif itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct groups that monumental undertakings demand the active, combined labor of all members.
Keywords_AO: quba, tokko, fuula, dhiquu, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: finger, face, washing, cooperation, teamwork

Mammaaksa_AO: Qubni tokko, tiiticha hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: A single finger cannot catch a fly
Meaning_AO: Qophaa socho'uun wanta salphaa iyyuu to'achuuf rakkisaadha; tokkummaan humna uuma.
Meaning_EN: A single finger cannot trap an agile fly; even capturing small opportunities requires coordinated teamwork.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qofaa isaa waan hunda gochuuf yaalee dadhabuuf tokkummaa akka barbaadu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise individuals who struggle alone on tasks that require coordinated multi-handed teamwork.
Keywords_AO: quba, tiiticha, qabachuu, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: finger, fly, catching, teamwork, coordination

Mammaaksa_AO: Arrabni kophaa, irree hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: An isolated tongue has no power or muscle
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin yookiin himannaan deggersa ummataa fi tokkummaa hin qabne humnaa fi fudhatama dhabee hafa.
Meaning_EN: Words spoken in isolation possess no real force; speech acquires authority only through collective backing.
