Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qofaa isaa dubbatee bu'aa dhabeef tokkummaan uummataa barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that advocacy or political demands must be rooted in united community backing to have impact.
Keywords_AO: arraba, kophaa, irree, sagalee
Keywords_EN: tongue, solitary, force, collective voice, solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki tokko, of hin dhiqu
Translation_Literal_EN: One hand cannot wash itself
Meaning_AO: Namni kamuu gargaarsa nama biraa malee qulqulluu fi guutuu ta'uu hin danda'u; wal deeggaruutu mala.
Meaning_EN: One hand cannot wash itself; mutual assistance and reciprocity are essential for human cleanliness and survival.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni wal dhiisuu dhiisanii akka wal gargaaraniif jaarsummaadhaan gorsuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in community reconciliation to remind people that interdependence is natural and indispensable.
Keywords_AO: harka, dhiquu, wal gargaarsa, jireenya
Keywords_EN: hand, washing, interdependence, mutual aid, reciprocity

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaa tokko irraa, gowwaa lamaatu caala
Translation_Literal_EN: Two fools consulting together are better than a single lone genius
Meaning_AO: Yaada walitti fiduu fi waliin mari'achuun beekumsa nama dhuunfaa qofaa caalaa bu'aa fida.
Meaning_EN: Two fools in mutual consultation accomplish more than a solitary sage; collective dialogue beats isolated wisdom.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama beekumsa ofiitti boonee marii namaa dhowwatu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge solitary know-it-alls to consult others, reminding that two minds are better than one.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, gowwaa, marii, caalmaa
Keywords_EN: wise man, fools, consultation, collective wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Kophaa nyaattuun, kopha duuti
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who feasts alone dies alone in abandonment
Meaning_AO: Namni ofittummaadhaan namaa wajjin hin qooddanne yeroo rakkinaa fi du'aa firaa fi gargaaraa dhabee bada.
Meaning_EN: The hoarder who eats in solitary selfishness dies in lonely abandonment, deprived of kin and mourners.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qabeenya ofii qofaa dhuunfate dantaa dhabeef akka inni namaa wajjin qooddatu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a stern warning against antisocial hoarding, showing that a solitary feast brings a solitary grave.
Keywords_AO: kophaa, nyaachuu, du'uu, ofittummaa
Keywords_EN: eating alone, dying alone, hoarding, selfishness, isolation

Mammaaksa_AO: Tokko ni aara malee, hin bobbahu
Translation_Literal_EN: A single firebrand merely smokes, but does not burst into a blaze
Meaning_AO: Namni kophaa isaa tattaafatu aaree dadhaba malee jijjiirama guddaa fi ifa mul'atu fiduu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A solitary piece of firewood only smolders with irritating smoke; glowing flames require burning logs together.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii keessatti kaka'umsa guddaa uumuuf tokkummaan dhaabbachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that generating inspiring energy and success requires collective community solidarity.
Keywords_AO: tokko, aaruu, bobbahuu, ibidda
Keywords_EN: single wood, smoke, blazing, fire, collective energy

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki tokko kophaa hin shubbisu
Translation_Literal_EN: One hand alone cannot clap to the dance
Meaning_AO: Waliigalteen, gammadaniis ta'ee hojiin milkaa'u nama lamaa fi isaa ol barbaada.
Meaning_EN: One hand alone cannot clap to dance; harmony, agreement, and joy require the meeting of two sides.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma jaalalaa fi hojii keessatti fedhii gam-lamee qabaachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that successful collaboration, romance, and peace require willing efforts from both sides.
Keywords_AO: harka, shubbisuu, kophummaa, gamtaa
Keywords_EN: hand, dancing, clapping, harmony, cooperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni mana tokko jaaru citaa wal hin saamu
Translation_Literal_EN: People building the same house do not snatch thatch grass from one another
Meaning_AO: Warri galma tokko qaban wal gargaaru malee wal dura dhaabbachuun bu'aa isaanii hin mancaasan.
Meaning_EN: Those constructing the same roof do not snatch thatch from each other; united teams cooperate to build.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miseensonni maatii yookiin dhaabbata tokkoo wal loluu dhiisanii waliin akka hojjetan gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish members of the same household or organization against destructive internal rivalry.
Keywords_AO: mana, jaaruu, citaa, saamuun, galma
Keywords_EN: house, building, thatch, snatching, common purpose

Mammaaksa_AO: jabaateef tokko gogaa hin dhifu
Translation_Literal_EN: No matter how strong, one person cannot peg out a hide alone
Meaning_AO: Humni dhuunfaa hamma fedhe jabaatus hojii tokkummaa barbaadu qofaan hojjetanii xumuruun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: However physically powerful an individual may be, stretching and pegging a hide requires multiple hands.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humna ofiitti amanee hiriyaa dhabeef hojiin tokko tokko nama baay'ee akka barbaadu barsiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humble self-reliant strongmen, reminding that certain tasks are physically impossible without partners.
Keywords_AO: jabaachuu, gogaa, dhifuu, wal gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: strength, hide, pegging out, collective labor

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkeen hidhiin bira hin jirre hin toltu
Translation_Literal_EN: Teeth without lips to cover them look unsightly and vulnerable
Meaning_AO: Qaamoleen yookiin namoonni walitti hidhata qaban addaan baanaan miidhaginaa fi eegumsa dhabu.
Meaning_EN: Teeth exposed without the sheltering grace of lips are both vulnerable and hideous; partners shield one another.
Usage_Situation_AO: Firoonni yookiin ollaan wal eeguu fi wal kabajuun faayidaa guddaa akka qabu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that individuals in a community provide mutual cover, dignity, and beauty to one another.
Keywords_AO: ilkee, hidhii, tola, eegumsa
Keywords_EN: teeth, lips, shielding, vulnerability, symbiotic dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Guddinni bineensaa buukii wajji, guddinni bishingaa biyyee wajji
Translation_Literal_EN: The growth of game depends on the forest thicket, and the growth of sorghum depends on rich soil
Meaning_AO: Namnis ta'ee uumamni kamuu naannoo fi hawaasa isa deggaru wajjin taanaan qofa milkaa'ina fi guddina argata.
Meaning_EN: Wildlife flourishes within the shielding thicket, and sorghum thrives in rich soil; flourishing demands community roots.
Usage_Situation_AO: Guddinni namaa hawaasa fi aadaa ofii wajjin kan wal qabate ta'uu hubachiisuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that human thriving is inextricably tied to belonging to a healthy, supportive society.
Keywords_AO: bineensa, buukii, bishingaa, biyyee, guddina
Keywords_EN: wildlife, thicket, sorghum, soil, flourishing community

Mammaaksa_AO: Bofni biyyee wajjiin, namni biyyaa wajjiin
Translation_Literal_EN: The serpent belongs with the soil, and a human being belongs with his homeland and people
Meaning_AO: Namni lammii fi biyya isaa wajjin qofa kabajamaa fi jabaa ta'ee jiraachuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: A snake thrives in intimate communion with the dust, and a human attains true honor rooted in their homeland.
Usage_Situation_AO: Biyya fi saba ofiitti dhihaatanii jiraachuun ulfina guddaa akka ta'e faarsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instill love for one's people and native homeland, emphasizing that true dignity blooms at home.
Keywords_AO: bofa, biyyee, nama, biyya
Keywords_EN: serpent, soil, human, homeland, patriotism

Mammaaksa_AO: Kophaa dhiqaan, xurii hin baasu
Translation_Literal_EN: Bathing completely alone does not remove all the grime from one's back
Meaning_AO: Rakkinaa fi hanqina ofii hunda qofaan sirreessuun hin danda'amu; gorsa fi tumsa namaa barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Scrubbing oneself in isolation leaves the back unwashed; self-improvement and blind spots require trusted helpers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama yaada namaa hin fudhanneef gorsi firaa barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf itti dhimma bamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind stubborn individuals that no one sees their own back; constructive criticism from kin is vital.
Keywords_AO: kophaa, dhiquu, xurii, gargaarsa
Keywords_EN: bathing alone, grime, back, mutual scrubbing, blind spots

Mammaaksa_AO: Tokkummaan nama jabeessa
Translation_Literal_EN: Unity makes people strong and formidable
Meaning_AO: Wal ta'iinsaa fi tokkummaan humni namootaa akka dachaan cimu taasisa.
Meaning_EN: Solidarity and collective harmony multiply individual power, transforming communities into unyielding strongholds.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hawaasni akka wal ta'uu fi wal deeggaru kakaasuuf yeroo hunda kan itti fayyadamanidha.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a timeless rallying cry urging community members to stand shoulder to shoulder in common defense.
Keywords_AO: tokkummaa, nama, jabeessuu, humna
Keywords_EN: unity, strength, solidarity, resilience, empowerment

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen wal nyaattu, waraabeeysa of irraa hin aatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Dogs busy biting each other cannot chase the hyena away
Meaning_AO: Yeroo namoonni keessaan wal lolan diina alaa dhufee isaan miidhu ofirraa ittisuu hin danda'an.
Meaning_EN: Pack dogs tearing into one another cannot bark away the encroaching hyena; internal strife invites predation.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gareewwan keessoo wal dura dhaabbatan diinni akka isaan hin balleessine akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge feuding kinsmen to halt fratricidal bickering before common enemies consume them all.
Keywords_AO: saree, wal nyaachuu, waraabessa, aatuu
Keywords_EN: dogs biting, hyena, internal strife, defense, vulnerability

Mammaaksa_AO: Bofni walitti marameeti Arba hidha
Translation_Literal_EN: Slender serpents intertwined together bind the mighty elephant
Meaning_AO: Namoonni dadhaboon yoo tokkummaa jabaa qabaatan humna diina guddaa fi jabaa kamuu cabsuu danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Thin serpents coiling tightly together form a cable that ties up an elephant; collective unity fells titans.
Usage_Situation_AO: Uummanni harka qalleeyyiin tokkummaadhaan dhiibbaa mootii yookiin diina jabaa mo'achuu danda'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire oppressed or modest populations that unbreakable grassroots unity overcomes the mightiest tyrants.
Keywords_AO: bofa, walitti maramuu, arba, hidhuu
Keywords_EN: snakes, coiling, elephant, binding, collective power

Mammaaksa_AO: Qunceen wal gargaarteeti muka hiiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Bark fibers helping one another bind up the timber log
Meaning_AO: Wanti xiqqaani fi dadhabaan yoo wal gargaare humna cimaa uumuun wanta guddaa to'achuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Fragile strips of inner bark joining forces form a stout rope that binds heavy logs; cooperation yields great power.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni humna xiqqaa qaban wal deeggaranii hojii ulfaataa akka hojjetan jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to demonstrate that small, everyday contributions interwoven together create an unbreakable bond.
Keywords_AO: quncee, wal gargaaruu, muka, hiituu
Keywords_EN: bark fiber, cooperation, tree log, binding, synergy

Mammaaksa_AO: Walii galan, daboon (guuzni) nama hin dhibu
Translation_Literal_EN: When there is harmony, communal work parties (daboo) pose no hardship
Meaning_AO: Waliigaltee fi jaalalli yoo jiraate hojiin ulfaataan hawaasaa salphaatti fi gammachuudhaan raawwatama.
Meaning_EN: Where mutual love and agreement flourish, massive communal cooperative labor feels effortless and joyful.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aadaa daboo fi wal gargaarsaa Oromoo keessatti waliigalteen bu'uura ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in traditional Oromo communal work groups (daboo) to celebrate smooth teamwork built on consensus.
Keywords_AO: waliigaltee, daboo, guuza, dhibuu
Keywords_EN: consensus, communal labor, daboo, guuza, harmony

Mammaaksa_AO: heera walii galli fannise, alaanalli hin buufne
Translation_Literal_EN: A customary covenant hoisted by universal consensus cannot be pulled down by rogue outlaws
Meaning_AO: Seeraa fi murtee uummanni waliigaleen murteesse eenyuyyuu salphaatti diiguu yookiin cabsuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A customary covenant consecrated by the general assembly cannot be overturned by isolated rogue outlaws.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aadaa Gadaa fi jaarsummaa keessatti murtee waloo kabajuun dirqama ta'uu mirkaneessuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in Gadaa governance and councils to uphold the binding inviolability of collectively legislated laws.
Keywords_AO: heera, waliigalli, fannisuu, alaanalli
Keywords_EN: customary law, consensus, supremacy, assembly, covenant

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkee bakka takka jirtuutu, waa ciniina
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the teeth set side by side in unison that bite through things
Meaning_AO: Qindoominaa fi tokkummaadhaan yoo socho'an qorumsa jabaa hundumaa salphaatti injifatu.
Meaning_EN: Only teeth aligned tightly in unison can bite through tough sustenance; united ranks cut through all resistance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojiin garee bu'a qabeessa ta'uuf miseensonni hundinuu qindaa'anii socho'uu akka qaban gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that effective teamwork requires members to stay tightly aligned and strike in unison.
Keywords_AO: ilkee, bakka takka, ciniinuu, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: teeth, aligned, biting, coordinated action, unity

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki tokko ni dhiqa malee, xurii hin baasu
Translation_Literal_EN: A single hand can wet itself, but cannot scrub away the stubborn dirt
Meaning_AO: Tattaaffiin nama tokkoo qofti bu'aa guutuu hin fidu; wal gargaarsa harka lamaatiin qulqullinni fida.
Meaning_EN: A solitary hand may splash water, but cannot scour out deeply ground dirt; spotless results require two hands.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii tokko qulqullinaan xumuruuf tumsi namoota biraa barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to show that while solo efforts initiate a process, full, immaculate success requires collective washing.
Keywords_AO: harka, dhiquu, xurii baasuu, qulqullina
Keywords_EN: hand, washing, stubborn dirt, thoroughness, mutual aid

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka lamaatu wal dhiqa
Translation_Literal_EN: Two hands wash each other
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiyyuu gargaarsa nama biraa barbaada; wal deeggaruun jireenya guutuu taasisa.
Meaning_EN: Two hands wash each other; mutual assistance and symbiotic friendship make life complete and clean.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalalaa fi wal gargaarsa namoota gidduu jiru faarsuuf yeroo hunda dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate reciprocal fraternity, reminding friends and neighbors that mutual support sustains society.
Keywords_AO: harka lama, wal dhiquu, wal deeggaruu
Keywords_EN: two hands, washing each other, reciprocity, solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Hancufti ida'aa galaanaati
Translation_Literal_EN: Individual drops of saliva added together form a mighty river
Meaning_AO: Gumaachi xiqqoon namuu godhu walitti qabamee qabeenyaa fi humna guddaa uuma.
Meaning_EN: Modest drops of saliva gathered collectively form a swelling torrent; micro-contributions create massive reserves.
Usage_Situation_AO: Uummanni waan qabu xiqqoo yoo walitti buuse bu'aa guddaa akka galmeessu jajjabeessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in fundraising and communal drives to show that even the smallest contributions accumulate into oceans.
Keywords_AO: hancufa, ida'uu, galaana, gumaacha
Keywords_EN: saliva, addition, river, micro-contributions, collective wealth

Mammaaksa_AO: Caphaan lama, walitti fayyaa tokko
Translation_Literal_EN: Two broken pieces joined together make one sound, whole body
Meaning_AO: Namoonni hanqina qaban yoo walitti dhufanii wal deeggaran humna guutuu fi bu'a qabeessa ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Two fractured entities uniting together become one complete, sound organism; mutual support heals shared weakness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni dadhabina qaban walitti dhufanii hojii guddaa yeroo hojjetan jajjabeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used compassionately when two vulnerable or imperfect people join forces to forge a whole, resilient unit.
Keywords_AO: caphaa, lama, fayyaa, tokko, wal guutuu
Keywords_EN: broken pieces, two, sound health, wholeness, complementary strength

Mammaaksa_AO: Warra wal tahe, biddeena tokkootu quubsa
Translation_Literal_EN: For a family living in harmonious concord, a single loaf of bread is plenty
Meaning_AO: Maatii jaalalaa fi tokkummaa qabuuf qabeenyi xiqqoonis nagaa fi quufa guutuu kenna.
Meaning_EN: For a united household living in true concord, a single flatbread satisfies all; harmony multiplies scarce bread.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nagaan mana keessatti qabeenya caalaa quufa akka fidu maatii barsiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise domestic peace, teaching that love and solidarity bring greater contentment than stockpiled riches.
Keywords_AO: warra, wal tahu, biddeena, quufuu
Keywords_EN: family, accord, flatbread, satisfaction, contentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Wal taha araddaatu, heera fugug mooha
Translation_Literal_EN: The solidarity of the village council prevails over the distant authoritarian decree
Meaning_AO: Tokkummaan naannoo fi hawaasa bu'uuraa dhiibbaa fi murtii alaa kamuu mo'atee haqa mirkaneessa.
Meaning_EN: The close consensus of the local village green defeats distant authoritarian edicts; grassroots unity prevails.
Usage_Situation_AO: Aangoon uummata tokkoomee dhiibbaa alaa kamuu akka mo'atu ibsuuf fayyada.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert local communal autonomy and self-determination against arbitrary external edicts.
Keywords_AO: araddaa, wal tahu, heera, fugug, mo'uu
Keywords_EN: village green, consensus, distant edict, grassroots sovereignty

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan tuutaa wajji hin nyaanne, hantuutaa wajji nyaata
Translation_Literal_EN: The one who refuses to feast with the crowd will dine with the mice
Meaning_AO: Namni hawaasatti makamee qooddachuu dide dhumarratti qobummaa fi hiyyummaa keessa bu'a.
Meaning_EN: He who refuses to fellowship and share meals with his community will eventually dine in isolated squalor with mice.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ofittoo fi hawaasarraa of fageessuuf akka inni ummatatti makamu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn misanthropic recluses that rejecting the community table leads straight to degraded solitude.
Keywords_AO: tuuta, nyaachuu, hantuuta, hawaasummaa
Keywords_EN: crowd, eating, mice, fellowship, reclusiveness

Mammaaksa_AO: Xuuxxoon shantam nama tokkoof ba'aa dha, nama shantamiif boona
Translation_Literal_EN: Fifty bundles of thatch reeds are a crushing burden for one man, but for fifty men, they are an easy, proud march
Meaning_AO: Hojiin ulfaataan yoo qoodamee waloon hojjetame salphaa, gammachuu fi boonsaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Fifty bundles of reed thatch break the spine of one lone carrier, but divided among fifty, they are light work and proud fanfare.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii ijaarsa hawaasaa keessatti hundi qooda fudhatee akka wal gargaaru jajjabeessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to motivate communal solidarity, demonstrating that collective distribution turns crushing burdens into effortless pride.
Keywords_AO: xuuxxoo, shantam, ba'aa, boona, daboo
Keywords_EN: thatch bundles, fifty, burden, pride, shared labor

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaan, biyya ofiitti hin kabajamu
Translation_Literal_EN: A wise person is not honored in their own homeland
Meaning_AO: Namni beekumsa qabu yeroo baay'ee namoota naannoo isaatti argamaniin tuffatama yookiin gatii dhabsiifama.
Meaning_EN: Familiarity often breeds contempt; people rarely appreciate or acknowledge the wisdom of someone from their own community.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni beekaan yookiin ogeessi tokko biyya isaatti osoo hin kabajamin orma biratti bakka guddaa argatu jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a talented or wise person is undervalued by their own people but praised elsewhere.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, biyya, kabaja, tuffii
Keywords_EN: wise, homeland, honor, respect, prophet

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni nama dhaabe, muka nama seeha
Translation_Literal_EN: One who makes someone stand thinks they are a tree
Meaning_AO: Namni nama biraa rakkise yookiin hojii dadhabsiisaa irratti dhiise, dhibee fi dadhabbii nama sanaa hin tilmaamu.
Meaning_EN: Someone who burdens or makes others wait fails to realize human fatigue and treats them as unfeeling objects.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko nama biraa dhaabee tursiisee yookiin dadhabsee rakkisaa jiru dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone inconsiderately makes another person stand or wait excessively without care for their fatigue.
Keywords_AO: dhaabuu, muka, dadhabbii, nama
Keywords_EN: stand, tree, fatigue, thoughtless, wait

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama kuffisaniif, lukku (handaaqqoo) kuffisani
Translation_Literal_EN: For someone they push down, they also slaughter a chicken
Meaning_AO: Nama tuffatan yookiin gadi xiqqeessan irratti wanta xinnoo fi salphaa ta'e godhanii ittiin qoosu.
Meaning_EN: When people look down on someone, they offer minimal respect or insult them further under guise of an offering.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama tuffatame tokkoof wanti gatii hin qabne kennamee ittiin qoosamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a disregarded individual is offered something trivial as a mock sign of courtesy or disrespect.
Keywords_AO: kuffisuu, lukkuu, tuffii, handaaqqoo
Keywords_EN: fall, chicken, insult, contempt

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama tuffatan, sare jalatti dhaanan
Translation_Literal_EN: The person they despise, they beat the dog right under them
Meaning_AO: Nama tuffatan yookiin jibbaniif kallattiin dubbachuu dhiisanii ergaa tuffii karaa biraatiin dabarsuufi.
Meaning_EN: Disdain for someone is indirectly shown by mistreating things around them or directing veiled hostility in their presence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko tuffatamee akka inni hin barbaadamne gocha biraatiin itti agarsiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said when passive aggression or contempt is demonstrated to an unwanted guest or person.
Keywords_AO: tuffii, saree, dhaanuu, jibba
Keywords_EN: despise, dog, beat, contempt, passive aggressive

Mammaaksa_AO: Warra yarsan, mooti duraa ajjeesan
Translation_Literal_EN: A family or clan they humiliate, they kill their leader right before them
Meaning_AO: Gosa yookiin nama tuffatamee fi humna dhabe tokko wanta guddaa inni kabaju duraa balleessuun caalaatti salphisu.
Meaning_EN: To crush and humiliate a vulnerable group or person, one destroys their greatest pride or protector.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni humn-dhabeeyyii ta'e garmalee miidhamee fi salphifame dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe extreme humiliation and oppression inflicted on the powerless.
Keywords_AO: yarsuu, mootii, ajjeesuu, salphina
Keywords_EN: humiliate, king, leader, kill, defeat

Mammaaksa_AO: Ani hamma namaa hin ga'u, namni garaa na hin ga'u
Translation_Literal_EN: I am not of average human size, but nobody fills my stomach
Meaning_AO: Ofii xinnoo ta'anii wanta guddaa hawwuu, yookiin of tuffachaa warra kaanillee tuffachuu.
Meaning_EN: Being physically small or humble in status, yet having insatiable desires or finding no one good enough.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ofii isaatii hanqina qabu tokko kanneen biroo hin quufne yookiin tuffatu jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Applied to someone deficient themselves yet perpetually unsatisfied or demanding too much.
Keywords_AO: hamma, nama, garaa, quufa
Keywords_EN: size, stomach, greed, dissatisfaction

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni namarra jiru, ciiseeti nama dhiita
Translation_Literal_EN: The person who is on top of someone kicks them while lying down
Meaning_AO: Namni humna qabu yookiin aangoorra jiru nama isa jala jiru salphumatti miidha.
Meaning_EN: Those in superior power or authority easily abuse and suppress those under their control without much effort.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni aangoorra jiru tokko namoota gadi aanoo miidhuu fi roorrisuu agarsiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when an authority figure or stronger party casually exploits and suppresses subordinates.
Keywords_AO: namarra, ciisuu, dhiituu, aangoo
Keywords_EN: on top, kick, lie down, power, abuse

Mammaaksa_AO: Hadaamiin, wal qixxaattu malee hin kuftu
Translation_Literal_EN: The euphorbia cactus does not fall unless its branches grow evenly balanced
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko yoo garmalee baay'atee fi madaallii dhabe kufiinsi isaa saffisaa ta'a; badiin wal-faana dhufa.
Meaning_EN: A top-heavy structure or arrogant collective falls all at once when overdeveloped beyond measure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti tokko garmalee baballatee kufaatiif qophaa'u akeekkachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that unmeasured growth, pride, or excess precedes sudden and total collapse.
Keywords_AO: hadaamii, wal qixxaachuu, kufu, madaallii
Keywords_EN: cactus, balance, fall, collapse, excess

Mammaaksa_AO: Miilli mata ja'a, mataan miila ja'a
Translation_Literal_EN: The foot says 'head', the head says 'foot'
Meaning_AO: Wal-dhabdee, wal-tuffachuu fi iddoo walii beekuu dhabuu irraan kan ka'e walii galteen dhabamuu.
Meaning_EN: A state of total confusion, disrespect, and disorder where roles are reversed and no one agrees.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni lama walitti dhufeenya dhabanii tokko isa kaan tuffatee waldhabbiin uumamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when there is complete discord, lack of order, or mutual disrespect between leaders and followers.
Keywords_AO: miila, mataa, wal dhabiinsa, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: foot, head, discord, confusion, disorder

Mammaaksa_AO: Jiraa sablisuun, jalaa callisuu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: To silence an unbearable person is to keep quiet beneath them
Meaning_AO: Nama dharrooftuu, lolu yookiin falmu mo'achuuf cal'isuutu falli gaariidha.
Meaning_EN: The most effective way to disarm an aggressive or foolish troublemaker is maintaining dignified silence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni lola barbaadu nama aarsuuf yaalutti cal'isuun furmaata ta'uu agarsiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Advised when dealing with a belligerent person where reacting would only escalate matters.
Keywords_AO: jiraa, sablisuu, callisuu, gorsa
Keywords_EN: silence, ignore, calm, dispute, wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Iddoo cabsituun jirtuutti, hin guddatani
Translation_Literal_EN: In a place where a breaker resides, no one grows
Meaning_AO: Bakka namni nama kuffisu, hamilee nama cabsu yookiin hiraarsu jirutti guddinni hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: No progress or development is possible in an environment dominated by toxic and destructive people.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo naannoon tokko guddina namaaf hin mijoofne yookiin namoonni hamoon guddina dhowwan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said when destructive personalities prevent community members or youth from thriving.
Keywords_AO: cabsituu, guddina, bakka, gufuu
Keywords_EN: breaker, growth, stagnation, toxic, hindrance

Mammaaksa_AO: Cabsituun, fardaan ushee jetti
Translation_Literal_EN: A destructive person says 'shoo' to a horse
Meaning_AO: Namni amala badaa qabu wanta kabajamaa fi jabaa ta'ellee salphisee tuffata.
Meaning_EN: A reckless or ignorant person treats valuable and noble things with foolish disrespect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dandeettii hin qabne wanta ulfaataa tokko salphisutti dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an unqualified or disrespectful person degrades something majestic or significant.
Keywords_AO: cabsituu, farda, ushee, tuffii
Keywords_EN: destructive, horse, shoo, disrespect, ignorance

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan harree hin qabne, gaangee namaatiin "har" ja'a
Translation_Literal_EN: One who does not own a donkey says 'har' (shoo) to another's mule
Meaning_AO: Namni ofii isaatii homaa hin qabne qabeenya nama biraatiin of jajuu yookiin ajajuu barbaada.
Meaning_EN: One who possesses nothing attempts to boss around or show off using someone else's superior property.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya hin qabne tokko kan namaatiin faayadamuuf fiiguu fi ajaju dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Applied when an empty-handed person tries to command or meddle with other people's valuable belongings.
Keywords_AO: harree, gaangee, ajajuu, qabeenya ormaa
Keywords_EN: donkey, mule, command, borrowed pride, pretense

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraabessi osoo bushaa bushaa ja'uuti harree nyaatee fixe
Translation_Literal_EN: While the hyena kept saying 'tasteless, tasteless', it ate up the donkey completely
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko tuffachaa fi ceepha'aa garuu hunda isaa fayyadamuu yookiin duguuguu.
Meaning_EN: Hypocritically disparaging something while consuming or taking full advantage of it to the very end.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko wanta tokko arrabsaa fi tuffachaa garuu harka duubaatiin hunda isaa dhuunfatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone complains about the quality of something while greedily exhausting all of it.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, bushaa, harree, fakkeessummaa
Keywords_EN: hyena, tasteless, donkey, devour, hypocrisy

Mammaaksa_AO: Hin qaanfattuu, dhiirsaan aboo jetti
Translation_Literal_EN: Shameless as she is, she addresses her husband as 'pal'
Meaning_AO: Namni kabajaa fi safuu hin beekne nama ulfina qabuuf ulfina malu hin kennu.
Meaning_EN: A shameless or ill-mannered person lacks boundaries and addresses their superiors or partners insolently.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni adaba hin qabne nama isa dura jirutti kabajaa dhabsiisu jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said when someone displays utter insolence and inappropriate familiarity where reverence is due.
Keywords_AO: qaanfannaa, dhiirsa, aboo, safuu
Keywords_EN: shameless, husband, bro, dude, insolence, respect

Mammaaksa_AO: "Deegii aabboon mana namaa na kaayullee, baaduun waa aannanii miti" jette, haftuun
Translation_Literal_EN: "Though poverty led my father to place me in another's house, whey is not milk," said the spinster
Meaning_AO: Rakkinni nama qunnamullee, wanta gaarii fi badaa, sobaa fi dhugaa adda baasanii beekuun hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: Hard times do not blind a person of dignity from distinguishing genuine quality from cheap substitutes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni hiyyeessa ta'e tokko tuffatamee wanta xiqqaadhaan gowwoomfamuu didu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Expressed when an underprivileged person insists on truth and refuses to accept poor substitutes as genuine.
Keywords_AO: deega, aabboo, baaduu, aannan, haftuu
Keywords_EN: poverty, father, whey, milk, discernment, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: "Doofaa kana heerumuu mannaa, dubrummaa dhaan hafuu naa wayyaa" jette intalti
Translation_Literal_EN: "Rather than marrying this fool, it is better for me to remain unmarried," said the girl
Meaning_AO: Nama wallaalaa fi bu'aa hin qabne waliin walitti hidhamuu irra kophaa of danda'anii jiraachuutu filatama.
Meaning_EN: Remaining single and preserving peace of mind is better than yoking oneself to an ignorant and reckless partner.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gorsa yookiin hiriyaa gaarii hin taane didee of danda'uu filatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when choosing solitude and dignity over an unfruitful and troublesome partnership.
Keywords_AO: doofaa, heeruma, dubrummaa, filannoo
Keywords_EN: fool, marriage, maidenhood, better, decision

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsa heerumtee mannaa, eda duutee wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than marrying an old man, it is better to have died yesterday
Meaning_AO: Jireenya gaa'ilaa kan gammachuu fi abdii hin qabne keessa seenuu caalaa du'a filachuu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Suffering an ill-matched, miserable union is portrayed as far worse than an untimely death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo walitti dhufeenyi umurii fi fedhiin wal hin gitne garmalee balaaleffatamu jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in cultural discourse to emphasize the abhorrence of deeply mismatched or forced traditional arrangements.
Keywords_AO: jaarsa, heeruma, du'a, wayya
Keywords_EN: old man, marriage, death, misery, mismatched

Mammaaksa_AO: Adurree ciifte, hantuunni mataarra deema
Translation_Literal_EN: Over a sleeping cat, a mouse walks on its head
Meaning_AO: Hoggantoonni yookiin qaamni seera eegsisu yoo laafe, kanneen sodaatan duraanii ija jabina argatanii roorrisu.
Meaning_EN: When authority or vigilance sleeps, those formerly timid grow emboldened and overstep boundaries.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hoggansi laafee badiin fi ija-jabinni bakka hin malleetti babal'atu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when the absence of active authority emboldens subordinates or wrongdoers to act recklessly.
Keywords_AO: adurree, hantuuta, mataarra, ciisuu
Keywords_EN: cat, mouse, sleeping, bold, defiance, authority

Mammaaksa_AO: "Dhiirsi humaa naa hin goone, dhuufuun na ajjeese" jette, niitiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "My husband provided nothing for me, yet killed me with flatulence," said the wife
Meaning_AO: Nama faayidaa homaayyuu hin qabne garuu dhibee fi nuffii qofa nama irratti baay'isu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Describing someone who contributes nothing beneficial yet causes nuisance and annoyance continuously.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko gargaarsa homaa osoo hin kennin nama jibbisiisaa ta'u dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe an obnoxious dependent or partner who delivers no value but constantly annoys.
Keywords_AO: dhiirsa, bu'aa dhabeessa, dhuufuu, niitii
Keywords_EN: husband, useless, flatulence, nuisance, complaint

Mammaaksa_AO: Tiitichi nama ajjeesuu baatu, nama haqqisiisuu hin oolu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if a fly does not kill a person, it surely makes them vomit
Meaning_AO: Wanti xinnoon yookiin namni dandeettii xiqqaa qabu nama balleessuu baatus, jireenya jeequu fi nuffisiisuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Even if an insignificant adversary or minor nuisance cannot destroy you, it can still cause great disgust, discomfort, and disruption.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta xiqqoo tuffatame garuu nuffisiisaa fi rakkisaa ta'e agarsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when warning not to dismiss minor irritants or weak opponents who can still cause distress.
Keywords_AO: tiiticha, ajjeesuu, haqqisiisuu, nuffii
Keywords_EN: fly, kill, vomit, nuisance, disgust

Mammaaksa_AO: Ableen, tan harsama hin murreetu, nama mure
Translation_Literal_EN: The knife that could not cut sheep fat ended up cutting a person
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan yookiin namni wanta laafaa tokko hojjechuu dadhabe tasa nama irratti balaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Someone or something deemed incapable of handling simple tasks unexpectedly causes serious injury or harm.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni yookiin wanti laafaa fakkaatu tokko miidhaa guddaa geessisutti dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when a seemingly weak tool or person causes unexpected harm.
Keywords_AO: ablee, harsama, muruu, balaa
Keywords_EN: knife, fat, cut, harm, danger

Mammaaksa_AO: Xiqqaatulee bofa irra hin ajjatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if it is small, one does not step on a snake
Meaning_AO: Wanta balaa qabu yookiin diina xinnoo ta'ellee tuffatanii of dagachuun hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Dangerous adversaries or threats should never be underestimated simply because they are small.
Usage_Situation_AO: Diina yookiin balaa xiqqaa tuffatanii akka of hin daganne nama gorsuuf itti fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against complacency when facing a potent, though physically small, danger.
Keywords_AO: xiqqaa, bofa, ajjachu, of eeggannoo
Keywords_EN: small, snake, step on, caution, venom

Mammaaksa_AO: Injireen bulleeti, injijiin buluu dadhabne
Translation_Literal_EN: We spent the night with lice, but we could not bear the night with nits
Meaning_AO: Rakkina guddaa obsaan dandeessanii osoo jirtanii rakkoo xinnoo fi nuffisiistuudhaan dadhabuu.
Meaning_EN: Enduring a major hardship only to be worn down and defeated by petty, persistent annoyances.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhibee gurguddaa dandamatee wantoota xixinnoo fi tuffatamoodhaan dhiphatu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said when someone survived a serious crisis only to find minor persistent nagging intolerable.
Keywords_AO: injiree, injijii, buluu, obsa
Keywords_EN: lice, nits, endure, exasperation, annoyance

Mammaaksa_AO: Mixii illee taatu, maquma duulaatiin sodaa dha jedhe arbi
Translation_Literal_EN: "Even if they are ants, the very name of a marching army is fearful," said the elephant
Meaning_AO: Humni tokko yoo wal ta'ee fi gurmaa'ee dhufe, hammamiyyuu xiqqaatu sodaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Numbers and unity create a formidable threat that even the mighty cannot afford to disregard.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo humni xiqqaan gamtaadhaan dhufee isa guddaas akka sodaachisu ibsamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when highlighting how collective unity makes even the smallest creatures formidable.
Keywords_AO: mixii, duula, arba, sodaachisa
Keywords_EN: ant, army, elephant, fear, collective strength

Mammaaksa_AO: Arbaa fi mixiin wal lolaniiti baallama qabatani, arbi walitti qabamee "xiqqeenyaaf diina hin tuffatanii nurraa laalaa" je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: The elephant and the ants had a feud and set an appointment; the elephant gathered his kind and said: 'One does not despise an enemy for being small, learn from us'
Meaning_AO: Diina xiqqaa ta'e tuffatanii of dagachuun kufaatii guddaaf nama saaxila; of-eeggannoon yeroo hunda barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Never underestimate an adversary based on physical size or stature; small foes can topple the giants.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni humna xiqqaa tuffachuuf yaalanitti akka of eeggatan gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Told as a moral lesson to discourage arrogance and complacency against seemingly weaker rivals.
Keywords_AO: arba, mixii, diina, tuffii, lola
Keywords_EN: elephant, ant, enemy, disdain, warning

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni galgala, ni gaaroma
Translation_Literal_EN: A person becomes kind in the evening
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo dhumarratti yookiin erga dullomee/rakkate booda amala gaarii fi araara barbaadu ta'a.
Meaning_EN: People soften, mellow, and seek reconciliation as they grow older or as their day draws to an end.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni umuriin deeme yookiin jireenyi itti lixe amala arjummaa fi qabbanaa mul'isu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing that age or quiet twilight hours soften human stubbornness and harshness.
Keywords_AO: galgala, gaaroma, nama, dulloomuu
Keywords_EN: evening, mellow, kindness, age, reflection

Mammaaksa_AO: Sangaan bara qotu heedata (lakkaawata)
Translation_Literal_EN: An ox counts the years it plows
Meaning_AO: Namni yookiin uumamni dadhabbiin itti baay'ate waggaa fi dhiphina dabarse ni yaadata.
Meaning_EN: Those who labor long and hard bear the memory and physical toll of every year of hard toil.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojjataan yookiin namni dhibame tokko dadhabbii fi umurii hojii keessatti dabarse yaadu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said of a loyal, hard-working laborer reflecting upon long years of exhaustive toil.
Keywords_AO: sangaa, qotuu, heedata, lakkaawata
Keywords_EN: ox, plow, count years, toil, labor

Mammaaksa_AO: Huccuun miicca lakkaawatti
Translation_Literal_EN: Clothes count each washing
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko deddeebi'amee yoo itti fayyadaman yookiin rukutame suuta suuta miidhamaa fi dhumachaa deema.
Meaning_EN: Repeated friction, handling, or wear steadily degrades even the most resilient material.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti tokko deddeebi'amee fayyadama irra ooluun dullomu yookiin moofawu ibsamu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain how continuous use, trials, or friction gradually wear down things or people.
Keywords_AO: huccuu, miicca, lakkaawuu, moofomuu
Keywords_EN: clothes, wash, wear, tear, degradation

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsi ture, baay'ee beeka
Translation_Literal_EN: An elder who has lived long knows much
Meaning_AO: Muuxannoon jireenyaa fi turtii dheeraan beekumsaa fi hubannaa guddaa namaaf kenna.
Meaning_EN: Longevity and life experience bestow profound wisdom, knowledge, and understanding.
Usage_Situation_AO: Gorsa fi marii jaarsolii kabajuu fi barbaachisummaa muuxannoo agarsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken to acknowledge and respect the deep, accumulated wisdom of older generations.
Keywords_AO: jaarsa, turuu, beekumsa, muuxannoo
Keywords_EN: elder, live long, wisdom, knowledge, experience

Mammaaksa_AO: Ballaa fi ajjuuzaan, keeyrii hin qabani
Translation_Literal_EN: The blind and the decrepit old possess no good deeds/charity
Meaning_AO: Namni dandeettii of danda'uu hin qabne yookiin haalli itti jabaate namaafis ta'e ofiif bu'aa buusuun itti ulfaata.
Meaning_EN: Those utterly destitute of physical ability and resources find it difficult to render benevolence to others.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni humnaa fi dandeettii dhabe tokko waan gaarii namaaf gochuu dadhabutti dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said colloquially to highlight the extreme limitations of those immobilized by infirmity or helplessness.
Keywords_AO: ballaa, ajjuuzaa, keeyrii, dadhabina
Keywords_EN: blind, decrepit, charity, incapacity, limitation

Mammaaksa_AO: Midhagaa guddatani, fokkisaa dulloomani
Translation_Literal_EN: One grows up beautiful, but grows old ugly
Meaning_AO: Bareedinni fi dargaggummaan kan darbuudha; dullumni uumama namaa kan jijjiiruu fi dadhabsiisudha.
Meaning_EN: Youth and physical beauty are ephemeral; aging inevitably brings physical decay and frailty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bareedina yeroon baduun of jajuun akka hin malle fi uumama namaa hubachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people that youth and physical vanity are temporary and fade with time.
Keywords_AO: midhagaa, guddate, fokkisaa, dulloome
Keywords_EN: beauty, youth, aging, physical decay, transience

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaartiin jaarsaaf daa'ima
Translation_Literal_EN: To an old man, his old wife is like a child
Meaning_AO: Jaarroleen yeroo dullooman walii isaaniif kunuunsa, marartoo fi jaalala akka daa'imaatti walii kennu.
Meaning_EN: Aging partners view and protect each other with deep tenderness, vulnerability, and gentle affection.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalala fi wal-kunuunsuu abbaa manaa fi haadha manaa dulloomanii ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Expressed when highlighting the sweet, enduring devotion and care between elderly spouses.
Keywords_AO: jaartii, jaarsa, daa'ima, kunuunsa
Keywords_EN: old woman, old man, child, tender care, companionship

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni moluu qabu, bakka itti tolu hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: A bald person has no comfortable spot
Meaning_AO: Namni hanqina yookiin amala jibbisiisaa qabu bakka hundatti nagaa dhabuu fi komatamuu.
Meaning_EN: Someone who carries obvious flaws or persistent insecurities finds restlessness wherever they go.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko bakka dhaqe hundatti guungumu yookiin tasgabbii dhabu jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Applied to an irritable or flawed individual who can never find peace or contentment anywhere.
Keywords_AO: moluu, bakka, nagaa dhabuu, komii
Keywords_EN: bald, place, restlessness, dissatisfaction, flaw

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsaa fi gaayyaa ganama naqu
Translation_Literal_EN: One serves an old man and a smoking pipe in the morning
Meaning_AO: Jaarsolii fi wantoota barbaachisoo ta'an ganamaan kunuunsuun aadaa fi safuu Oromootti kabajamaadha.
Meaning_EN: Providing care, nourishment, and attention to elders early in the day is essential duty and respect.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaarsolii fi maanguddoota ganamaan tajaajiluu fi kunuunsuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reinforce the cultural requirement of giving prompt morning attention and care to the elderly.
Keywords_AO: jaarsa, gaayyaa, ganama, kunuunsa
Keywords_EN: elder, pipe, morning, respect, care

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilmi ni ceeha malee, abbaa hin dabru
Translation_Literal_EN: A son may leap, but he cannot surpass his father
Meaning_AO: Dhaloonni ammayyaa dandeettii fi saffisa qabaatus, seenaa, maqaa fi kabaja abbaa dhalche dhabamsiisuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A son may achieve great agility or success, but the foundational role and legacy of the father remain paramount.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dargaggeessi yookiin ilmi tokko abbaa isaarratti of jajuu akka hin qabne barsiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Said to instill humility in youth, reminding them to always honor paternal roots regardless of achievements.
Keywords_AO: ilma, ceehuu, abbaa, kabaja
Keywords_EN: son, leap, father, filial respect, lineage

Mammaaksa_AO: Dulluma hin muudanii, arrii hin funaanani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not anoint old age, nor does one pluck gray hair
Meaning_AO: Dullumni uumama Waaqaa waan ta'eef jijjiiruun yookiin dhowwuun hin danda'amu; fudhachuutu barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Old age is an inevitable natural process ordained by Providence; it cannot be halted or hidden.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dullumni fi arriin seera uumamaa waan ta'eef akka salphaatti fudhatamuu qabu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express that growing old is natural and futile to resist or feel ashamed of.
Keywords_AO: dulluma, muuduu, arrii, uumama
Keywords_EN: old age, anoint, gray hair, inevitable, nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Dullattiin qoraan hin dhaqattu, ibiddaaf gaabbii hin qabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: An old woman does not fetch firewood, yet she has no regrets regarding the hearth's fire
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii isaaf hin malle yookiin humna hin qabne irraa of qusatus, wanta argamuun quufee nagaadhaan jiraata.
Meaning_EN: Those freed by age or limitation from strenuous labor enjoy whatever warmth is provided without grievance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni humna dhabe tokko hojii dadhabsiisaa keessaa bahee wanta jiruun gammadu dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken when someone unable to perform hard tasks peacefully relies on communal provision without complaint.
Keywords_AO: dullattii, qoraan, ibidda, gaabbii
Keywords_EN: old woman, firewood, fire, regret, contentment

Mammaaksa_AO: Raachi bishaan galaa, jaarsi yeroon gala
Translation_Literal_EN: A frog retires into water, a wise elder retires on time
Meaning_AO: Namni beekaan yookiin maanguddoon iddoo fi yeroo isaaf malu beekee of eeggannoodhaan socho'a.
Meaning_EN: A wise person knows their proper place, sets healthy boundaries, and acts with impeccable timing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko sirnaan yeroo eeggatee galuu yookiin socho'uu qabu akeekkachiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that a dignified elder or responsible person always respects proper timing and boundaries.
Keywords_AO: raacha, bishaan, jaarsa, yeroon
Keywords_EN: frog, water, elder, on time, propriety

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii gaarii manguddoo irraa fudhatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Good counsel is received from elders
Meaning_AO: Gorsi gaariin, murtiin dhugaa fi araarri maanguddoota muuxannoo qaban irraa argama.
Meaning_EN: Sound counsel, reconciliation, and righteous judgment are gathered from the wisdom of elders.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo rakkoon uumamee jaarsolii fi maanguddootatti murtiin kennamuu qabu agarsiisan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Spoken during dispute resolution or community meetings to highlight the indispensable value of elder guidance.
Keywords_AO: dubbii gaarii, manguddoo, gorsa, muuxannoo
Keywords_EN: good words, elder, counsel, guidance, truth

Mammaaksa_AO: Gorsi ergisaa dha, ayliin handhura
Translation_Literal_EN: Advice is a loan, but intellect is the navel.
Meaning_AO: Gorsi namaa gargaaruu danda'a garuu hubannaan ofii kan dhalootaan nama keessa jiruudha.
Meaning_EN: External advice can assist someone, but innate wisdom and sound judgment must come from within.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni gorsa namarraa qofa eeggatu yookiin hubannoo ofii dhabu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise someone that external counsel cannot substitute for one's own critical thinking and good sense.
Keywords_AO: gorsa, ailii, handhura, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: advice, intellect, innate, wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: Roobuus, caamuus, ijji misiraa lama
Translation_Literal_EN: Whether it rains or shines, the lentil seed has two eyes.
Meaning_AO: Haalli yoo jijjiiramellee uumamni ykn amalli wanta tokkoo hin jijjiiramu.
Meaning_EN: No matter how external conditions change, intrinsic nature and fundamental facts remain unchanged.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta haalli alaa hin jijjiirre ykn nama amala isaa hin dhiifne ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that core character or essential truth does not shift according to changing circumstances.
Keywords_AO: rooba, caama, ija misiraa, uumama
Keywords_EN: rain, sun, lentil, nature, constancy

Mammaaksa_AO: Boortaan, ilma hin dhalchiiftu
Translation_Literal_EN: Boasting does not give birth to a son.
Meaning_AO: Of gurguddisuu fi afaaniin dhaadachuun bu'aa qabatamaa hin argamsiisu.
Meaning_EN: Empty boasting and false pride do not yield practical achievements or real progeny.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii malee afaaniin of tuulu ykn waan bu'aa hin qabneen dhaadatu gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone that mere boasting or coyness achieves nothing without concrete results.
Keywords_AO: boortaa, ilma, bu'aa, of-tuulummaa
Keywords_EN: boasting, son, achievement, pretense

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan, jaalatee hin fokkatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person does not willingly become ugly.
Meaning_AO: Namni kamiyyuu fedhii isaatiin waan badaan ykn salphinni akka isa irra ga'u hin barbaadu.
Meaning_EN: No one deliberately chooses ugliness, flaws, or misfortune; shortcomings are often beyond personal control.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta namni itti hanqate ykn rakkoo uumamaa qabu akka itti hin qoofne yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish people not to ridicule another person's inherent physical or circumstantial defects.
Keywords_AO: abbaa, jaalala, fokkisa, rakkoo
Keywords_EN: choice, ugliness, flaw, empathy

Mammaaksa_AO: Shanyii malee, hantuutni adii hin daltu
Translation_Literal_EN: Without lineage, a rat does not give birth to a white one.
Meaning_AO: Amallii fi wanti hundi sanyii fi hidda dhalootaa irraa dhufa malee tasa hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Characteristics and values stem from origin and heredity; nothing appears without its corresponding root.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo amalli nama tokkoo kan maatii ykn sanyii isaa fakkaatu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain that an individual's behavior or attributes are natural reflections of their ancestry.
Keywords_AO: shanyii, hantuuta, adii, dhaloota
Keywords_EN: seed, rat, white, heredity, lineage

Mammaaksa_AO: Lukkuun hedduun iyyiteef, hin barihu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if many roosters crow, dawn does not break early.
Meaning_AO: Wantoonni yeroo fi sirna isaanii eeggatu malee jarjaraan hin ta'an.
Meaning_EN: Events unfold according to their designated schedule; commotion and impatience cannot rush time.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni ariifachuun waan tokko yeroon dura fiduu barbaadan gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution impatient people that things must take their natural course and cannot be hurried.
Keywords_AO: lukkuu, iyyuu, bariisa, yeroo
Keywords_EN: rooster, crow, dawn, timing, patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Jarjaraniif, abbaa fi haadha dura hin dhalatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if one rushes, one cannot be born before one's parents.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hundi tartiiba fi daangaa qaba; ariifachuun seera uumaa hin jijjiiru.
Meaning_EN: Impatience cannot overturn the natural sequence of events or fundamental hierarchies.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humni fi yeroon dura deemsa fiduuf yaaluuf gorsa kennuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to check overly eager people trying to skip necessary stages or surpass natural bounds prematurely.
Keywords_AO: jarjara, abbaa, haadha, dhaloota
Keywords_EN: rush, father, mother, birth, order

Mammaaksa_AO: Bokkaan lafa nyaphaatiis ni rooba
Translation_Literal_EN: Rain falls even on the enemy's land.
Meaning_AO: Toli fi arjummaan uumaa nama hundaaf wal qixa; hammeenyi fi jibbi tola Rabbii hin daangessu.
Meaning_EN: Natural blessings and divine generosity fall impartially on all, even upon adversaries.
Usage_Situation_AO: Toli fi eebbi Waaqayyoo nama hundatti akka dhaqqabu yeroo ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that providence and natural benevolence are universally and impartially distributed.
Keywords_AO: bokkaa, lafa nyaphaa, rooba, tola
Keywords_EN: rain, enemy land, grace, impartiality

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaa huurkaan bahuun, baga dhiigni hin argini
Translation_Literal_EN: Fortunately, blood did not find the way through which sweat escapes.
Meaning_AO: Baga balaan guddaan hin dhufin; waan xiqqaatti hafuun galateeffamuu qaba.
Meaning_EN: It is a relief when great tragedy is avoided and distress remains confined to mere sweat and labor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo balaan cimaan hafee rakkina salphaan darban galata dhiheessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to voice gratitude and relief when a potentially catastrophic threat resolves with minor strain.
Keywords_AO: karaa, huurka, dhiiga, oolmaa
Keywords_EN: sweat, blood, escape, relief

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan hin qoraasani, afaan dubbii mi'eessu ganama dhalata
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not perfume the mouth; the mouth that sweetens speech is born that way.
Meaning_AO: Dandeettiin haasaa fi dubbii bareechuu kennaa uumamaati malee wanta boodarra bitamu miti.
Meaning_EN: True eloquence and articulate speech are innate gifts rather than artificial affectations.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama afaan mi'aawaa fi dubbii dandeessu dinqisiifachuuf ykn ogummaa uumamaa ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to commend a naturally eloquent and persuasive speaker whose skill comes effortlessly from within.
Keywords_AO: afaan, qoraasa, mi'aawa, dubbii
Keywords_EN: mouth, incense, eloquence, gift

Mammaaksa_AO: Aduun rakkoo namaa hin beektuu, osoo laalanuu dhiiti
Translation_Literal_EN: The sun does not know human distress; it sets while you are watching it.
Meaning_AO: Yeroon namaaf hin dhaabbatu; rakkinni namaa yeroo fi uumama hin dhowwu.
Meaning_EN: Time marches onward indifferently without halting for anyone's troubles or uncompleted tasks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni yeroo dhabee rakkatu ykn waan qabu xumuruuf muddamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reflecting on the relentless pace of time, especially during emergencies or desperate situations.
Keywords_AO: aduu, rakkoo, dhiha, yeroo
Keywords_EN: sun, distress, sunset, time

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaalli eegeen saawaa, mataan nama
Translation_Literal_EN: The camel has the tail of a cow and the head of a person.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko amala fi bifa adda addaa of keessatti qabaata; wanti hundi wal-makoodha.
Meaning_EN: A creature or situation can possess contrasting features; reality is full of unexpected paradoxes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta ykn nama bifa tokkoon salphaa fakkaatee gama biraatiin ulfaataa ta'e ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to characterize complex individuals or phenomena that blend disparate and unexpected qualities.
Keywords_AO: gaala, eegee saawaa, mataa namaa
Keywords_EN: camel, cow tail, human head, paradox

Mammaaksa_AO: "Fuula waaqaatu miidhagsaa, deeminsa abbaatu tolfata" je'e, jaldeessi
Translation_Literal_EN: "God beautifies the face, but one regulates one's own walk," said the baboon.
Meaning_AO: Bifa fi uumamni kennaa Waaqayyoo yoo ta'eeyyuu, amala fi deemsa ofii namaatu tolfata.
Meaning_EN: Physical endowment is determined by God, but posture, conduct, and manners are one's personal duty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni waan uumamaan qabu qofa osoo hin taane amala isaa sirreeffachuu akka qabu yeroo gorsan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stress that while you cannot choose your natural looks, you are entirely responsible for your conduct.
Keywords_AO: fuula, waaqa, deeminsa, jaldeessa
Keywords_EN: face, God, gait, baboon, conduct

Mammaaksa_AO: Uumaa Rabbiitu tolchaa, sansaankaa abbaatu tolfata
Translation_Literal_EN: God creates the form, but the individual shapes their own conduct.
Meaning_AO: Dhalootaa fi bifa Waaqatu kenna, garuu amala gaarii fi adeemsa qajeelaa ofiitu horata.
Meaning_EN: God grants physical creation, but cultivating upright character and moral habits is up to the individual.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni amala badaa uumaa irra osoo hin kaayin of sirreessuu akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that one cannot blame fate for moral failures; good character must be actively developed.
Keywords_AO: uumaa, rabbi, sansaankaa, amala
Keywords_EN: creation, God, character, morals

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhama'aan dhama raasa
Translation_Literal_EN: The exhausted person churns skimmed milk.
Meaning_AO: Hojii bu'aa hin qabne irratti ifaajuu ykn dadhabuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Wasting time and energy on an endeavor that yields no profit or substance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan homaa hin baafne irratti ifaajee of dadhabsu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against pouring labor and resources into fruitless activities.
Keywords_AO: dhama'aa, dhama, raasuu, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: exhaustion, churning, buttermilk, futility

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan, bishaan bahar waraabee fixuuf tattaafata
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool strives to finish drawing all the ocean's water.
Meaning_AO: Waan danda'amuu hin dandeenye fi daangaa hin qabne gochuuf tattaafachuu gowwummaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Undertaking an impossible and boundless task through pure lack of sense.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni humnaa ol ta'ee fi wanta matumaa hin danda'amne gochuuf ifaaju.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone pursues an absurdly impossible goal beyond human capability.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, bishaan, bahara, tattaaffii
Keywords_EN: fool, water, ocean, impossibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen gowwaan, dumessatti dutti
Translation_Literal_EN: A foolish dog barks at the clouds.
Meaning_AO: Wanta miidhaa nama irra hin geessisne ykn qaqqabamuu hin dandeenye irratti wacuu.
Meaning_EN: Making useless noise against harmless things that are completely out of reach.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta isa hin ilaallanne ykn isa hin miine irratti iyyuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who gets agitated and complains about things far beyond their sphere.
Keywords_AO: saree, gowwaa, duumessa, dutuu
Keywords_EN: dog, fool, cloud, barking

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii kalessa turte, ar'a hin gaafatani
Translation_Literal_EN: A matter that stayed yesterday is not interrogated today.
Meaning_AO: Wanta darbe fi xumurame deebisanii kaasanii jeequmsa uumuun hin barbaachisu.
Meaning_EN: Past, settled issues should not be exhumed to stir up fresh controversy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma duraan dhiifame deebisee kaasu dhowwuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against bringing up past grievances that have already been resolved.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, kaleessa, har'a, gaaffii
Keywords_EN: speech, yesterday, today, past grievance

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan, gobeensa akkafeeti firii irraa eeggata
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool roasts acacia thorns and expects grain from it.
Meaning_AO: Waan gatii hin qabne irraa bu'aa gaarii fi qooda eeguun gowwummaa ta'uu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Harboring unrealistic hopes of gaining valuable sustenance from worthless material.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bu'aa homaayyuu hin jirre irraa abdii sobaa horatu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone expects fruitful outcomes from inherently barren or unviable schemes.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, gobeensa, akaawwii, firii
Keywords_EN: fool, thorns, roasting, empty hope

Mammaaksa_AO: Dukkanatti, ija hin baasani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not strain their eyes open wide in the dark.
Meaning_AO: Haala wanti tokko hin danda'amne keessatti of dhiphisuun bu'aa akka hin qabne agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Straining oneself in circumstances where achievement is inherently impossible is useless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haala dhiibbaa qabu fi furmaata hin qabne keessatti humna ofii qisaasessuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people not to exhaust themselves attempting what environment or reality forbids.
Keywords_AO: dukkana, ija baasuu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: darkness, staring, futility, realism

Mammaaksa_AO: Kunuu hin jirtuu, kunuu hin cittu, foon dullachaa
Translation_Literal_EN: Neither yields nor tears—meat of an aged beast.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko furmaata dhabee, tolus diddee baduus diddee yeroo nama rakkisu.
Meaning_EN: Refers to an obstinate, indecisive problem or situation that neither resolves nor goes away.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma ykn nama furmaata hin arganne fi jireenya harkifachiisu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe a stubborn issue or uncooperative person causing prolonged, unresolved frustration.
Keywords_AO: foon dullachaa, cituu, rakkina
Keywords_EN: tough meat, stubborn, deadlock

Mammaaksa_AO: Arbaan caccabsaaf moorreen (xirinyiin) udaan bakka takkatti guurti
Translation_Literal_EN: To crush the elephant, the civet piles its dung in one spot.
Meaning_AO: Humna ofii osoo hin beekin waan guddaa injifachuuf yaaluu fi of tuuluu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: An insignificant party foolishly plotting to bring down a giant through trivial means.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humna hin qabne garuu waan guddaa irratti of tuulee ka'u qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize powerless individuals who concoct ridiculous schemes against vastly superior forces.
Keywords_AO: arba, moorree, udaan, humna
Keywords_EN: elephant, civet, dung, false power

Mammaaksa_AO: "Waaniin ani lama butee dadhabe" je'e, waraabessi
Translation_Literal_EN: "Because I tried to snatch two, I failed," said the hyena.
Meaning_AO: Wanta lama al tokkotti qabachuuf bololuun lamaanuu dhabsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Greedily attempting to seize two prizes at once results in losing both completely.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bololaan wantoota hedduu al tokkotti qabachuu barbaadee harka duwwaa hafu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against dividing one's attention or grasping greedily after multiple gains simultaneously.
Keywords_AO: waraabessa, lama butuu, dadhaba, bolola
Keywords_EN: hyena, snatching two, greed, loss

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan, bakka loon hin oolinii faltii barbaada
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool searches for cow dung where cattle never spent the day.
Meaning_AO: Bakka wanti tokko hin jirretti ykn hin eegamnetti qisaasa'anii barbaaduu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Futilely looking for results or resources in a place where they could never exist.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan tokko bakka hin taanetti barbaadee ifaajuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who looks for solutions, help, or wealth where none could possibly be found.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, loon, faltii, barbaacha
Keywords_EN: fool, cattle, dung, vain search

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'a eegee nyaatu, eeganii hin dandayani
Translation_Literal_EN: One cannot continuously guard a cow that eats its own tail.
Meaning_AO: Nama amala balleessaa ofii qabu fi gorsa hin fudhanne eeguun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: It is impossible to rescue or monitor someone persistently determined on self-destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gorsa kuffisee of balleessu dhiisuuf ykn abdii irraa kutuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when giving up on someone whose self-sabotaging behavior defeats any external help.
Keywords_AO: sa'a, eegee, nyaachuu, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: cow, tail, self-harm, incorrigible

Mammaaksa_AO: Ibidda dhaame, daaraa hin afuufani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not blow the ashes of a fire that has gone out.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma xumuramee fi dhabame duubatti deebi'anii ifaajuun faayidaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: It is pointless to invest breath and hope into reviving something entirely defunct and cold.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma du'ee fi kanaan dura xumurame deebisanii dammaqsuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to stop dwelling on or trying to resurrect dead relationships or lost causes.
Keywords_AO: ibidda, dhaamuu, daaraa, afuufuu
Keywords_EN: fire, ashes, extinguished, dead past

Mammaaksa_AO: Arba argaa, faanta hin barbaadani
Translation_Literal_EN: While seeing the elephant, one does not look for its footprints.
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan ifatti utuu jiruu ragaa biraa barbaaduun yeroo gubuu dha.
Meaning_EN: When the primary evidence is plainly visible, searching for indirect clues is superfluous.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta ifa ta'ee mul'achaa jiru irratti marii fi ragaa dheeressuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when concrete, direct proof is before everyone, making further investigation redundant.
Keywords_AO: arba, faana, barbaaduu, dhugaa
Keywords_EN: elephant, tracks, obvious truth

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijaarannee manaa, keessa jirtii nama
Translation_Literal_EN: We build the house, but its true existence is the people inside.
Meaning_AO: Manni ijaarame qofti faayidaa hin qabu; jiraachuu fi nagaan nama keessaati murteessaa.
Meaning_EN: A physical building has no real meaning; its value comes entirely from human life and harmony.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya manaa caalaa nagaa fi jaalala maatii keessaa dursuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that the warmth, health, and accord of human occupants surpass structural grandeur.
Keywords_AO: ijaarsa, mana, nama, jireenya
Keywords_EN: house, building, human life, family

Mammaaksa_AO: Qaalluu rabbi salphise, nama du'utti waamani
Translation_Literal_EN: A spiritual leader whom God disgraced is called over a corpse.
Meaning_AO: Nama ulfina dhabe ykn salphate dhimma bu'aa hin qabne fi gad-aanaa irratti ramadu.
Meaning_EN: A once-revered figure who has lost standing is reduced to hopeless and unrewarding duties.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kabajaa isaa dhabee fi tuffatamee waan gad-aanaatti dhiibame ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how disgraced individuals are assigned only thankless or miserable tasks.
Keywords_AO: qaalluu, rabbi, salphina, du'aa
Keywords_EN: priest, disgrace, corpse, fallen status

Mammaaksa_AO: Ooyruu nooleen qotte, waatu itti hafe jettee itti hin debi'in
Translation_Literal_EN: To a field plowed by the Noole, do not return thinking something was left unplowed.
Meaning_AO: Wanta ogeessi ykn qotee-bulaan sirriitti hojjete hin shakkin; guutuu ta'uu amani.
Meaning_EN: Do not question or attempt to redo craftsmanship executed by proven, meticulous experts.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii namni beekaan fi amanamu raawwate irratti shakkii fi qunnamtii dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire confidence in expert labor, warning against unnecessary second-guessing.
Keywords_AO: ooyruu, noolee, qotisa, hojii
Keywords_EN: plowed field, Noole clan, thoroughness

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitii ala hiiyte, niiti naa taati jette hin abdatin
Translation_Literal_EN: A woman who wanders abroad, do not hope she will become a true wife.
Meaning_AO: Nama amala tasgabbii hin qabne fi ala qofa jaalatu irraa jireenya dhaabbataa eeguun hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Do not expect domestic loyalty and devotion from someone whose heart belongs to aimless roaming.
Usage_Situation_AO: Fira ykn hiriyaa jireenyaa filachuu keessatti amala tasgabbaawaa eeggachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a warning against committing to someone who shows no inclination toward home and stability.
Keywords_AO: niitii, ala, bultii, amala
Keywords_EN: wandering wife, marriage, commitment

Mammaaksa_AO: Galataa fi haaloon, humaa sii hin ba'u
Translation_Literal_EN: Holding grudges and failing to give thanks brings you nothing.
Meaning_AO: Haaloo qabachuun fi galata dhabuun ofuma nama miidha malee homaa bu'aa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Harboring bitterness and ingratitude provides zero benefit and only consumes the bearer.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama haaloo qabatu ykn galata wallaaluuf gorsa kennanii gara qalbitti deebisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise individuals to abandon resentment and ingratitude in favor of emotional peace.
Keywords_AO: galata, haaloo, bu'aa, amala
Keywords_EN: gratitude, grudge, futility, peace

Mammaaksa_AO: Nuugiin tumanii nyaatan, humna ba'atterra hin jirtu
Translation_Literal_EN: The noug seed pounded to be eaten is not worth the energy expended.
Meaning_AO: Wanti bu'aan isaa baasii ykn dadhabbii isaa hin geenye hojjechuun faayidaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: A yield that does not compensate for the exhausting labor required to extract it is worthless.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii dadhabbii guddaa qabaatee bu'aa xiqqoo qabu dhiisuuf ykn addaan kutuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when deciding to drop a project whose operational burden far outweighs its meager returns.
Keywords_AO: nuugii, tumuu, humna, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: noug seed, pounding, energy, deficit

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhuufuu kutteef, hudduu hin butani
Translation_Literal_EN: Because it passed wind, one does not sever the buttocks.
Meaning_AO: Balleessaa salphaa ykn uumamaa ta'eef tarkaanfii badiisaa fi garmalee ta'e hin fudhatani.
Meaning_EN: One must never react with destructive overreach or mutilation over trivial, natural lapses.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dogoggora xiqqoo fi salphaa ta'eef murtii cimaa fi miidhaa guddaa fidu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against draconian penalties or extreme overreactions to minor, inadvertent mistakes.
Keywords_AO: dhuufuu, hudduu, tarkaanfii, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: flatulence, severing, overreaction, balance

Mammaaksa_AO: Waraana darbanii, jinfuu hin qabatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Having hurled the spear, one does not hold onto its tail.
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko erga murteessanii fi raawwatanii booda, duubatti deebi'anii yaadda'uun bu'aa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Once a decisive action is launched or committed, you cannot retract it or cling to second thoughts.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni erga tarkaanfii fudhatee booda shakkii fi gaabbiin duubatti deebi'uuf yaalu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct someone to stand by their decisive choices rather than hesitate in futile regret.
Keywords_AO: waraana, darbuu, jinfuu, murtoo
Keywords_EN: spear, throwing, commitment, decisive

Mammaaksa_AO: Laga kaan keessa dhaabbatanii, kaanitti hin toohani
Translation_Literal_EN: Standing inside one river, one does not spit into another.
Meaning_AO: Bakka jiran dhiisanii ykn dhimma ofii osoo hin xumurin waan fagaatu irratti dhiibbaa gochuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: One cannot meddle in or influence distant matters while still immersed in one's immediate affairs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dhimma ofii dhiisee dhimma namoota fagootti qajeelchuuf ifaaju gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn people against interfering in external problems when their own doorstep is unresolved.
Keywords_AO: laga, dhaabbachuu, toohuu, daangaa
Keywords_EN: river, standing, spitting, boundaries

Mammaaksa_AO: Galanni sirbaa, dafqa
Translation_Literal_EN: The final outcome of dancing is sweat.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko gammachuu fi bashannana qabaatus, xumurri isaa dadhabbii fi dhiibbaa qabaata.
Meaning_EN: Even joyous and voluntary activities ultimately demand physical exertion and unavoidable fatigue.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni waan jaalate hojjeteeyyuu bu'aa fi dadhabbii isaa danda'uu akka qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when reminding people that enjoyable pursuits carry natural physical tolls and costs.
Keywords_AO: sirba, galata, dafqa, dadhabbii
Keywords_EN: dancing, reward, sweat, fatigue

Mammaaksa_AO: Harki, nama rukuta malee, humaa hin haleelu
Translation_Literal_EN: The hand can strike a person, but it cannot deliver final destruction.
Meaning_AO: Humni namaa daangaa qaba; namni nama miidhuu danda'a garuu murtee dhumaa kan kennu uumaadha.
Meaning_EN: Human aggression has natural boundaries; a human strike can injure but cannot decide ultimate destiny.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama diinaan doorsifame ykn miidhameef jajjabina kennuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort victims of injustice by pointing out that human malice cannot rewrite destiny.
Keywords_AO: harka, rukutuu, haleela, humna
Keywords_EN: hand, striking, limits, destiny

Mammaaksa_AO: Haati duunaan, rimayni due
Translation_Literal_EN: When the mother dies, the pregnancy dies with her.
Meaning_AO: Hundeen ykn maddii wanta tokkoo yoo bade, wanti isarratti hirkatee jirus ni bada.
Meaning_EN: When the primary pillar or creator falls, all dependent entities inevitably collapse with it.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo bu'uurri dhimma tokkoo diigamee wanti hundi harka duwwaa hafu ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in tragic moments when the loss of a key benefactor destroys all hopes attached to them.
Keywords_AO: haadha, du'a, rimaya, hundee
Keywords_EN: mother, death, fetus, collapse

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan madda hin qabne, hin yaa'u, yaa'uus ni cita
Translation_Literal_EN: Water without a spring does not flow, and if it flows, it soon dries up.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hundee fi bu'uura dhugaa hin qabne yeroo dheeraa hin turu, dafee dhumata.
Meaning_EN: Anything lacking a genuine root or renewable source is fundamentally unsustainable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta sobaan ykn bu'uura malee jalqabamee dafee dhumatu agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe superficial or artificially maintained ventures that quickly fail without substance.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, madda, yaa'a, cituu
Keywords_EN: water, spring, sustainability, roots

Mammaaksa_AO: Soogidda hin waadanii, waan dabre hin yaadani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not roast salt, nor does one dwell upon the past.
Meaning_AO: Wanta bu'aa hin qabne irratti hin dhiphatani; waan darbe yaaduun akkuma soogidda waaduu qisaasa'ina.
Meaning_EN: Obsessing over irreversible past events is as absurd and pointless as roasting salt.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gaabbii fi dhimma darbeen of miidhu gara fuulduraatti deebisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel someone to stop grieving over unalterable past events and focus on what lies ahead.
Keywords_AO: soogidda, waaduu, waan dabre, yaada
Keywords_EN: salt, roasting, past, moving forward

Mammaaksa_AO: Galata bade, gatii hin fudhatani
Translation_Literal_EN: For forfeited gratitude, one cannot collect compensation.
Meaning_AO: Gaarummaa namni hubachuu didee fi dhabameef gatii deebisanii argachuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: You cannot extort appreciation or recover dividends from someone resolutely ungrateful.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo tola oolanii galata dhabanii fi gatii deebisanii hin arganne ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when resigning oneself to the fact that kindness done for ungrateful folks yields nothing.
Keywords_AO: galata, baduu, gatii, tola
Keywords_EN: gratitude, loss, payment, ungrateful

Mammaaksa_AO: Hudduun, udaan dhiqanillee hin baatu
Translation_Literal_EN: The buttocks never completely part with dirt even after washing.
Meaning_AO: Amalli badaa ykn xuriin uumamaa yeroof dhiqamullee guutummaatti hin dhabamu.
Meaning_EN: Inherent baseness or deep-rooted character blemishes cannot be wiped away by cosmetic cleaning.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala isaa isa badaa dhiisuu dadhabe ykn deebisee agarsiise qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used bluntly when someone's superficial reform drops to reveal their original vulgar habits.
Keywords_AO: hudduu, udaan, dhiqannaa, amala
Keywords_EN: buttocks, dirt, persistent flaw, nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhadhaa ibidda bu'e, waatu irraa naa hafa jette hin eeggatin
Translation_Literal_EN: Butter that fell into the fire, do not expect anything to remain of it.
Meaning_AO: Wanti gara badiisa guutuutti seene deebi'ee akka bu'aa buusu hin abdatani.
Meaning_EN: Do not count on salvaging resources that have slipped into irreversible disaster.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya ykn carraa guutummaatti manca'e irraa abdii kutuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a stark warning to write off total losses rather than pine over what cannot be saved.
Keywords_AO: dhadhaa, ibidda, hafuu, kasaaraa
Keywords_EN: butter, fire, total loss, destruction

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan hin dhalatin, dhalatuus hin guddatin
Translation_Literal_EN: May a fool never be born, and if born, may he never grow up.
Meaning_AO: Gowwummaan ofii fi maatii mara waan salphisuu fi mancaasuuf akka badiisaatti ilaalama.
Meaning_EN: Folly brings so much grief, shame, and ruin that it is viewed as an unmitigated calamity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balleessaa gowwaan fidu irraa kan ka'e aariin dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Exclaimed in exasperation over the enormous damage and shame inflicted by senseless individuals.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, dhalachuu, guddina, abaarsa
Keywords_EN: fool, birth, curse, destructive folly

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan niitii irraa waraabessa hin dhoorku
Translation_Literal_EN: A foolish husband cannot protect his wife from a hyena.
Meaning_AO: Namni hubannoo fi gootummaa hin qabne qabeenyaa fi maatii isaa balaa irraa eeguu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A cowardly, dim-witted guardian is powerless to defend his family against obvious predators.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama itti-gaafatamummaa maatii ba'achuu dadhabee fi sodaataa ta'e ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize an incompetent leader or partner who fails to provide basic safety and custody.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, niitii, waraabessa, dhoorkuu
Keywords_EN: fool, wife, hyena, defenseless

Mammaaksa_AO: Wadalli harree, niitii irraa waraabeysa hin dhoorku
Translation_Literal_EN: A male donkey cannot protect its mate from a hyena.
Meaning_AO: Wanti uumamaan sodaataa fi dadhabaa ta'e dhimma jabinna barbaadu irratti abdii hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Weak and cowardly entities by their nature cannot offer protection against true aggression.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humni fi gootummaan isaa gahaa hin taane irratti hirkachuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to highlight that depending on weak-willed individuals for protection is an exercise in futility.
Keywords_AO: wadala, harree, waraabessa, sodaattummaa
Keywords_EN: donkey, mate, hyena, cowardice

Mammaaksa_AO: Manni, lafee Harreetiin jaarame, foonii fi dhiiga harreetiin maragamee, rifeensa harreetiin ajjeerame, yeroo waraabeysi yuuse diigama
Translation_Literal_EN: A house built with donkey bones, plastered with its flesh and blood, and thatched with its hair, collapses when the hyena howls.
Meaning_AO: Wanti bu'uura dadhabaa fi wantoota hin amansiisne irraa tolfame soda fi balaa dura hin dhaabbatu.
Meaning_EN: Any enterprise built upon fundamentally frail and compromised materials collapses at the first threat.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta bu'uura qajeelaa hin qabne fi doorsisa xiqqoon kufutti fayyadamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate that ill-conceived schemes and flimsy alliances cannot withstand real pressure.
Keywords_AO: mana, harree, waraabessa, diigamuu
Keywords_EN: house, donkey parts, hyena, collapse

Mammaaksa_AO: Kormaan lukkuu ifii hin nyaatu, namaa hin laatu, foon mataa irratti ba'atee deema
Translation_Literal_EN: The rooster does not eat it, nor give it away; he carries meat on top of his head.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya qabanitti ofii fayyadamuu dhabuu fi nama rakkateefis kennuu diduu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Holding resources greedily without putting them to use or letting others benefit from them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama doqna waan qabuun ofis hin gonne namas hin gargaarre qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize hoarders and misers who live in squalor despite possessing ample assets.
Keywords_AO: kormaa lukkuu, foon, mataa, doqnummaa
Keywords_EN: rooster, comb, meat, miserliness

Mammaaksa_AO: Jiini hammam ibsu'lle waan halkanii hin dhabu
Translation_Literal_EN: However brightly the moon shines, it never lacks traces of night.
Meaning_AO: Wanti kamiyyuu hammam gaarii fi guutuu yoo fakkaate hanqinaa fi mudaa of keessaa hin dhabu.
Meaning_EN: No matter how radiant or noble something appears, it inevitably contains subtle flaws.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ykn wanta guutuu dha jedhamee yaadamu irratti hanqina mul'atu obsaan ilaaluuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind idealists that perfection does not exist in earthly individuals or situations.
Keywords_AO: ji'a, ibsaa, halkan, hanqina
Keywords_EN: moon, brightness, night, imperfection

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan awwaaletti, du'a hin himani
