Translation_Literal_EN: To the one who performed the burial, one does not break news of death.
Meaning_AO: Wanta namni ofuma isaatiin argee fi raawwate deebisanii itti himuun hin barbaachisu.
Meaning_EN: It is redundant and foolish to lecture someone about facts they handled personally.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan tokko beeku fi keessa bahe irratti afaan banuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to silence someone trying to explain a matter to the very person who experienced or solved it.
Keywords_AO: awwaala, du'a, beekumsa, gorsa
Keywords_EN: burial, death, redundancy, experience

Mammaaksa_AO: Niitiin, eega hiikan alagaa dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Once divorced, a wife becomes a stranger.
Meaning_AO: Hariiroon gaa'elaa erga citee booda daangaan fi kabajaan alagummaa jiraachuu qaba.
Meaning_EN: Once a matrimonial contract is formally dissolved, mutual domestic ties turn into those of strangers.
Usage_Situation_AO: Walitti dhufeenyi duraanii erga citee booda seeraa fi alagummaa eeggachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to enforce clear emotional and social boundaries following a divorce or broken pact.
Keywords_AO: niitii, hiikuu, alagaa, hariiroo
Keywords_EN: wife, divorce, stranger, boundaries

Mammaaksa_AO: Uumee hin fixatuu, ajjeesee hin dhifatu
Translation_Literal_EN: He never tires of creating, nor does He refrain from slaying.
Meaning_AO: Aangoo fi seera Waaqayyoo kan jireenyaa fi du'aa daangaa akka hin qabne agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Expresses awe at divine sovereignty; the cycle of creation and mortality remains perpetually in God's hands.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jireenyaa fi duuti harka Rabbii qofa akka jiru hubachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when contemplating life, death, and human vulnerability under ultimate divine authority.
Keywords_AO: uumuu, ajjeesuu, rabbi, aangoo
Keywords_EN: creation, death, God, sovereignty

Mammaaksa_AO: ulee bofaan ajjeesan, wajjuma darbani
Translation_Literal_EN: The stick used to kill a snake is cast away with it.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaa wanta summaa'aa fi bala-qabeessa irratti fayyadaman eeggannaaf jedhanii ofirraa gatu.
Meaning_EN: An instrument contaminated by venomous danger is discarded along with the threat itself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ykn wanta badii keessatti qooda qabaatee xuraa'e ofirraa fageessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when discarding accomplices, instruments, or relics associated with a dangerous ordeal.
Keywords_AO: ulee, bofa, ajjeesuu, darbuu
Keywords_EN: stick, snake, disposal, contamination

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamartiin namaa hin taane, quba nama nyaatti
Translation_Literal_EN: A ring that is not one's size pinches and cuts the finger.
Meaning_AO: Wanti amala, qooda, ykn sadarkaa keetiin wal hin simne yoo fudhatte miidhaa sitti fida.
Meaning_EN: Adopting a partner, job, or responsibility incompatible with your nature brings persistent friction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan isaaf hin malle ykn hiriyaa isa hin madaalle filate gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against entering mismatched relationships or taking roles ill-fitted to one's temperament.
Keywords_AO: hamartii, quba, miidhaa, mijaawina
Keywords_EN: ring, finger, pinching, mismatch

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan alaa ol ceehu mana seenaa, kan manaa gad dheyse eeysa seena?
Translation_Literal_EN: He who flees dangers outside enters the home; but where does he who flees from within the house go?
Meaning_AO: Rakkoon alaa mana dhufamee dandamatama; rakkoon manuma keessaa garuu baqaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Outside turmoil finds sanctuary inside the home; but when the home itself turns hostile, no shelter remains.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waldhabdee maatii keessatti uumamee bakka itti baqatan dhabamsiise ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament intimate familial betrayal or domestic conflict where no safety remains.
Keywords_AO: alaa, mana, dheessuu, baqaa
Keywords_EN: outside, home, fleeing, sanctuary

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan shan hin horreef, shantamni hin horuufi
Translation_Literal_EN: For him who cannot multiply five, fifty will never multiply.
Meaning_AO: Wanta xiqqoo bulchuu fi kunuunsuu dadhaban, waan guddaas qabaatanii bulchuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: One who cannot steward modest means can never successfully oversee abundant resources.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta xiqqoo qabutti qisaasee waan guddaa hawwu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach that discipline with modest possessions is an indispensable prerequisite for larger wealth.
Keywords_AO: shan, shantama, horuu, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: five, fifty, multiplication, management

Mammaaksa_AO: Qalbiin xiqqoon, dhiirsa nagaya gaafatti
Translation_Literal_EN: A shallow mind badgers the husband with senseless interrogations.
Meaning_AO: Hubannoo dhabuun fi dhiphinni sammuu wantoota gaggaarii jireenyaa fi nagaa maatii booressa.
Meaning_EN: Petty-mindedness and lack of emotional depth disrupt domestic calm over trivialities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan bu'aa hin qabneen nagaa manaa jeequ akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize trivial nagging and narrow-minded behavior that ruins domestic peace.
Keywords_AO: qalbii xiqqoo, dhiirsa, nagaa, jeequmsa
Keywords_EN: shallow mind, husband, peace, nagging

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen qalbii hin qabne, awwaala (qabrii) irra teysi
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog lacking sense sits atop a grave.
Meaning_AO: Namni safuu fi naamusa hin beekne bakka sodaatamaa fi ulfina qabu hin kabaju.
Meaning_EN: A crude and clueless character violates sacred solemnities through total ignorance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama iddoo fi yeroo kabajamaatti amala badaa agarsiise ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reproach uncouth individuals who display tasteless indifference in dignified settings.
Keywords_AO: saree, qalbii dhabuu, awwaala, safuu
Keywords_EN: dog, senselessness, grave, irreverence

Mammaaksa_AO: Miicaa oolan ille, waaroon hin addaattu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if washed all day long, coarse black wool cloth will not turn white.
Meaning_AO: Amalli badaa fi uumama keessaa jiru wanta alaan gochuu yaalaniin hin jijjiiramu.
Meaning_EN: Inherent, deeply ingrained character traits cannot be altered or bleached by superficial efforts.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala badaa uumamaa qabu jijjiiruuf yaaluun bu'aa akka hin qabne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to indicate that fundamental, ingrained flaws cannot be reformed by superficial remedies.
Keywords_AO: waarroo, miicuu, addaachuu, amala
Keywords_EN: black wool, washing, bleaching, inalterable

Mammaaksa_AO: Taguugni, kuma dhiqaa ooltullee hin qulqullaawu
Translation_Literal_EN: The scouring rag, even if washed a thousand times, never becomes clean.
Meaning_AO: Wanti bu'uurri isaa xuraawaa fi gad-aanaa ta'e hammam qulqulleessanillee xurii hin dhabu.
Meaning_EN: Something inherently dirty or base can never achieve purity no matter how persistently cleansed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta bu'uuraan xuraa'ee fi qulqullina hin qabne jijjiiruu dadhabuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss corrupt or vile characters who cannot be made respectable through outward polishing.
Keywords_AO: taguuga, kuma dhiquu, qulqullina, amala
Keywords_EN: scouring rag, washing, permanent dirt, vile

Mammaaksa_AO: hammam dhiqaa oolan ille, taguugni siibaa hin tahu
Translation_Literal_EN: However much one washes it all day, a scouring sponge never becomes fine linen.
Meaning_AO: Wanti gatii salphaa qabu ykn amalli gad-aanaan hammam faayameyyuu sadarkaa kabajamaa hin qabatu.
Meaning_EN: A crude, low-grade entity can never be transformed into refined elegance through mere washing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta gad-aanaa tokko wanta guddaa fi kabajamaa fakkeessuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stress that artificial promotion cannot elevate fundamentally cheap items into true nobility.
Keywords_AO: taguuga, siibaa, dhiquu, gatii
Keywords_EN: sponge, fine linen, washing, intrinsic value

Mammaaksa_AO: Koobaa dhiqan, xuriin hin baatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if you wash the cupping horn, the residue of dirt will not leave it.
Meaning_AO: Wanta xurii fi miidhaa tajaajilaa ture irraa mallattoon isaa guutummaatti hin badu.
Meaning_EN: An instrument steeped in dirt and blood can never entirely erase the residual stain of its past.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amalli duraanii xuraawaa ta'e mallattoo isaa guutummaatti dhiisuu dadhabe ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when past corruption leaves indelible marks on an individual despite apparent cleansing.
Keywords_AO: koobaa, dhiquu, xurii, haftee
Keywords_EN: cupping horn, washing, dirt, permanent stain

Mammaaksa_AO: Funyaan saree, hin qulqullaawu
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog's nose never becomes clean.
Meaning_AO: Namni amalli isaa yeroo mara waan xuraawaatti qabame kabajaa fi qulqullina hin qabaatu.
Meaning_EN: A creature constantly probing into filth can never be considered pure, clean, or dignified.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala gad-aanaa fi wantoota xuraawaa keessa oolu qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand individuals whose degraded habits keep them chronically mired in disrepute.
Keywords_AO: funyaan saree, qulqullina, amala, safuu
Keywords_EN: dog's nose, cleanliness, foulness, disrepute

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni gaala hate, gad godhatee hin deemu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who has stolen a camel cannot walk stooped over to hide it.
Meaning_AO: Balleessaa fi hojii guddaa dhoksuun hin danda'amu; waan ifatti ba'u dhoksuun gowwummaa dha.
Meaning_EN: One cannot conceal a massive crime or elephantine scandal through petty, laughable secrecy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balleessaa guddaa dhoksuuf yaalii bu'aa hin qabne namni gochu jiru akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn wrongdoers that gigantic transgressions are impossible to camouflage.
Keywords_AO: gaala, hatuu, gad-jedhuu, dhoksaa
Keywords_EN: camel, stealing, ducking, obvious crime

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan suuqan tullaawaa, dhoysaan humaa hin goone
Translation_Literal_EN: What is tucked away heaps up; secrecy achieves nothing.
Meaning_AO: Wanti dhoksaan walitti kuufame yeroo booda ifatti mul'ata malee dhoysaan hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: Things stashed away in secret accumulate until they burst into plain view; concealment is futile.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta dhoksaan hojjetamee booda ifatti ba'ee nama qaanessu agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution that covered misdeeds will inevitably pile up and expose their perpetrator.
Keywords_AO: suuqaa, tullaa, dhoksaa, ifatti
Keywords_EN: tucking away, pile, secrecy, exposure

Mammaaksa_AO: Madaan nyaattuun jala jirtu, hin fayyitu
Translation_Literal_EN: A wound harboring a parasite beneath will not heal.
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo bu'uuraa fi summii keessaa osoo hin furin wanti alaan tolfame hin fayyu.
Meaning_EN: A sore plagued by underlying rot can never close; superficial treatment fails without excising the root.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waldhabdee ykn rakkina bu'uura isaa osoo hin sirreessin alaan dhoksuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that patching up an issue while ignoring its festering root causes ensures ongoing disaster.
Keywords_AO: madaa nyaattuu, fayyuu, hundee, rakkina
Keywords_EN: eating ulcer, healing, root cause, festering

Mammaaksa_AO: Cooma dal'uu irraa dhaban, bakki irraa argatan hin jiru
Translation_Literal_EN: If you cannot find fat on the camel's hump, there is nowhere else you will find it.
Meaning_AO: Bakka wanti tokko caalmaatti irraa eegamu irraa yoo dhabame, iddoo biraatti argachuun hin yaadamu.
Meaning_EN: If the most abundant primary source yields nothing, looking in subsidiary quarters is entirely futile.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka waan tokko argachuun abdatamu irraa dhabamuu isaa hubachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when the richest possible source proves bare, demonstrating that lesser places have no chance.
Keywords_AO: cooma, dal'uu, gaala, dhabuu
Keywords_EN: fat, camel hump, prime source, scarcity

Mammaaksa_AO: Silaahiin deega dubbiiti
Translation_Literal_EN: "If only" is the destitution of speech.
Meaning_AO: Wanta ta'ee darbe irratti "silaa akkana ta'ee" jechuun dadhabina fi bu'aa dhabdummaa mul'isa.
Meaning_EN: Relying on wishful "if onlys" reflects total intellectual helplessness and lack of practical initiative.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii dhiisee gaabbii fi yaada bu'aa hin qabneen yeroo gubu qajeelchuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuff people who waste breath on hindsight regrets rather than taking active steps.
Keywords_AO: silaa, deega, dubbii, gaabbii
Keywords_EN: if only, poverty, hindsight, inaction

Mammaaksa_AO: Garbuun jiiydee fi beerri caphe hin kaatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Wet barley and an old woman with broken hips do not rise again.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hubamee fi humni isaa guutummaatti dhume deebi'ee bakka duraatti hin deebi'u.
Meaning_EN: Severely ruined commodities and frail elderhood broken by tragedy cannot be restored.
Usage_Situation_AO: Kasaaraa ykn hubama dandamatamuu hin dandeenye ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to express the finality of unrecoverable physical ruin or permanent misfortune.
Keywords_AO: garbuu jidhe, beera caphe, ka'uu, badiisa
Keywords_EN: wet barley, broken old woman, irreversible

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijji allaattiin nyaatte, humaa hin argitu, gurri allaattiin nyaatte, humaa hin dhagayu
Translation_Literal_EN: The eye pecked out by a vulture sees nothing; the ear devoured by a vulture hears nothing.
Meaning_AO: Namni hubannoo fi qalbii isaa guutummaatti dhabe waan gaariis ta'ee waan badaa hin hubatu.
Meaning_EN: When one's critical senses and moral faculties are destroyed, no wisdom or warning can penetrate.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gorsa fi dhugaa hubachuu dadhabee qalbii dhabe ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to characterize individuals whose discernment has been completely stripped away by folly.
Keywords_AO: ija, gurra, allaattii, dhagahuu
Keywords_EN: eye, ear, vulture, complete blindness

Mammaaksa_AO: Hancufa tufan, deebianii hin arraabani
Translation_Literal_EN: Spittle that has been spat out is not licked back up.
Meaning_AO: Wanta murteessanii dhiisan ykn gatan deebisanii fudhachuun safuu fi salphina.
Meaning_EN: One must maintain self-respect and never crawl back to retrieve what was deliberately cast aside.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta tuffatee dhiise deebisee fudhachuuf yaalu qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to preserve dignity and abide steadfastly by their rejections and separations.
Keywords_AO: hancufa, tufuu, arraabuu, safuu
Keywords_EN: spittle, spitting, licking back, dignity

Mammaaksa_AO: Kaleen ar'a hin tahu
Translation_Literal_EN: Yesterday cannot become today.
Meaning_AO: Yeroon darbe deebi'ee hin dhufu; waan har'aa irratti xiyyeeffachuun dirqama.
Meaning_EN: Past moments never return; one must confront present reality rather than cling to bygone days.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan darbe keessa jiraatu gara waan ammaatti deebisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ground daydreamers and remind them that past privileges or mistakes cannot recreate today.
Keywords_AO: kaleessa, har'a, yeroo, jireenya
Keywords_EN: yesterday, today, passing time, reality

Mammaaksa_AO: Godaannaaf marqa hin fudhatani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not pack porridge as provisions for migration.
Meaning_AO: Imala ykn hojii dheeraaf qophii sirrii fi itti fufiinsa qabu gochuu malee waan dafee badu hin qabatan.
Meaning_EN: One should not select fragile or perishable supplies when undertaking long, demanding journeys.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii ulfaataaf qophii laafaa fi bu'aa hin qabne qopheeffachuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise thorough, durable logistics rather than fragile temporary measures for serious tasks.
Keywords_AO: godaansa, marqa, qophii, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: migration, porridge, preparation, durability

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama beekaa balleessu, gorsi hin qajeelchu
Translation_Literal_EN: A person who does wrong knowingly cannot be reformed by advice.
Meaning_AO: Namni ta'e jedhee osoo beeku cubbuu fi badii hojjetu gorsa namaatiin hin deebi'u.
Meaning_EN: Counsel is completely lost on an individual whose misconduct is calculated, conscious, and willful.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama osoo beeku balleessu gorsanii of dadhabsuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise withholding counsel from those deliberately perpetrating wrong with full awareness.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, balleessuu, gorsa, qajeelfama
Keywords_EN: knowing, wrongdoing, advice, futile counsel

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan mixii irraa, maraka barbaada
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool expects broth from an ant.
Meaning_AO: Wanta homaa hin qabne irraa waan guddaa fi faayidaa eeguun gowwummaa dha.
Meaning_EN: It is utter folly to anticipate substantial sustenance or assistance from an impoverished source.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama bakka qabeenyi hin jirree gargaarsa barbaacha dhaqu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock those who seek massive favors or wealth from people who possess virtually nothing.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, mixii, marqa, abdii
Keywords_EN: fool, ant, broth, impossible gain

Mammaaksa_AO: Iyyaniif, duudaa gurri hin dhagayu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if you shout loudly, a deaf ear cannot hear.
Meaning_AO: Nama hubachuu hin dandeenye ykn dhagahuu hin feene dirqisiisanii amansiisuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: No volume of shouting can compel understanding from one who is either naturally or willfully deaf.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dhagahuu dideef dubbatanii of dadhabsuu dhiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when recognizing that further argumentation is futile because the listener refuses to comprehend.
Keywords_AO: iyyuu, duudaa, gurra, dhagayuu
Keywords_EN: shouting, deaf, hearing, closed mind

Mammaaksa_AO: Biddeenni abjuu, garaa nama hin guutu
Translation_Literal_EN: Bread seen in a dream does not fill one's belly.
Meaning_AO: Hawwii fi abjuun qofti bu'aa qabatamaa hin fidu; hojii fi qabatamummaan barbaachisaa dha.
Meaning_EN: Fanciful dreams and abstract hopes cannot satisfy real, aching hunger or solve practical needs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama abjuu fi hawwii qofaan jiraatu gara hojii qabatamaatti deebisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stir dreamers into practical action by reminding them that theoretical desires feed nobody.
Keywords_AO: biddeena, abjuu, garaa quufuu, hojii
Keywords_EN: bread, dream, full stomach, action

Mammaaksa_AO: Jiruu deegaa jiruu seetaa, nama du'e kan ka'u seetaa
Translation_Literal_EN: Do you consider a pauper's existence true living, or do you expect the dead to arise?
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi rakkinaa fi dararaa du'a irraa adda hin ta'u; abdii hin taane qabaachuun bu'aa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Miserable destitution is barely distinguishable from death; unrealistic optimism changes nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina cimaa jireenya hiyyummaa keessa jiru ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to paint the bleak, unbearable reality of severe pauperism where hope of resurrection is lost.
Keywords_AO: jiruu, deegaa, du'a, ka'uu
Keywords_EN: living, pauper, death, bleak survival

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana waraabeysaatii, foon liqii hin barbaaddani
Translation_Literal_EN: In the hyena's den, one does not ask for meat on loan.
Meaning_AO: Bakka doqnummaan fi hammeenyi jirutti arjummaa fi gargaarsa barbaaduun gowwummaa dha.
Meaning_EN: One does not expect loans, kindness, or concessions from rapacious, insatiable predators.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama diina ykn doqna irraa arjummaa eeggatu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against petitioning greedy hoarders and natural foes for charity or fair dealing.
Keywords_AO: mana waraabessaa, foon, liqii, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: hyena's den, meat, loan, predatory nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Gowwaan waraabeysatti foon fi'ata
Translation_Literal_EN: A fool loads meat onto a hyena for transport.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya ofii diina isaatti kennanii amananii dhabamsiisuu ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Trusting one's treasured assets to the safekeeping of the very predator eager to swallow them.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta gati-jabeessa diina amansiisee kenne qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock the supreme foolishness of handing vulnerable valuables over to known plunderers.
Keywords_AO: gowwaa, waraabessa, foon, fe'uu
Keywords_EN: fool, hyena, meat, misplaced trust

Mammaaksa_AO: Achi buutee, faana re'ee Ogaadeen
Translation_Literal_EN: Vanished without a trace, like the tracks of a goat in the Ogaden sands.
Meaning_AO: Wanta guutummaatti badee fi bakki buutee isaa hin beekamne ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Denotes complete, absolute disappearance where not a single trace, track, or clue survives.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta ykn nama tasa dhabamee argamuu dide ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe people, objects, or leads that have completely dissolved into thin air.
Keywords_AO: achi buutee, faana re'ee, ogaadeen, baduu
Keywords_EN: disappearance, goat track, desert, vanished

Mammaaksa_AO: Bariitu lafa hin arguu, ballaan maa barii gaafata, deemeetuu tabba hin bahuu, naafni maa tattaafata
Translation_Literal_EN: Even when day breaks he cannot see the ground, why does the blind man ask for dawn; he cannot climb hills, why does the cripple strain himself?
Meaning_AO: Wanta dandeettii ofiin ol ta'e fi faayidaa namaaf hin qabne irratti dhiphachuu dhiisuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: It is futile to expend anguish or ambition on privileges one lacks the capability to utilize.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan humnaa olii fi isaaf hin danda'amne irratti dhiphatu tasgabbeessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind people not to exhaust their spirits agonizing over conditions they cannot leverage.
Keywords_AO: barii, ballaa, naafa, tabba, daangaa
Keywords_EN: dawn, blind man, lame man, hill, limitation

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni waa gurguruu bare, haadha magaalaa geeysee dhaadheeysa
Translation_Literal_EN: One accustomed to selling things takes his own mother to the market and hawks her for sale.
Meaning_AO: Amalli gurgurtaa fi bu'aa barbaaduu nama keessa galee daangaa yoo dhabe, wanta safuu qabullee daldaluu irraa nama hin deebisu.
Meaning_EN: When the obsession with commerce and profit knows no bounds, a person loses all shame and commodifies even their own mother.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama faayidaa fi bu'aaf jedhee wanta safuu ta'e hunda sarbu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn ruthless individuals whose relentless greed and commercial habits trample honor and family decency.
Keywords_AO: gurguruu, haadha, magaalaa, dhaadheessuu
Keywords_EN: selling, mother, market, hawking, shamelessness

Mammaaksa_AO: Kabiirri hin wallisu, kan bare hin cal'isu
Translation_Literal_EN: A religious elder does not sing secular songs, and one accustomed to a habit never stays silent.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan tokko bare dhiisuu hin danda'u; amalli baratame yeroo hundumaa ofumaan mul'ata.
Meaning_EN: A pious teacher does not indulge in worldly chanting, and someone habituated to an action cannot stay restrained.
Usage_Situation_AO: Amalli namni tokko itti bare yeroo mul'atu fi dhiifamuu dadhabu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an ingrained habit naturally resurfaces, demonstrating that people cannot long conceal what they are used to.
Keywords_AO: kabiira, wallisuu, cal'isuu, amala
Keywords_EN: elder, singing, habit, silence, nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Harka hanna bare, dooluutu sossooha
Translation_Literal_EN: To a hand accustomed to thievery, even the amputated stump twitches.
Meaning_AO: Namni hanna bare osoo harki isaa madaa'ee ykn citellee amala isaa dhiisuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Even when mutilated or scarred, a hand habitual to theft still reflexes; ingrained vices defy physical deterrence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amalli hannaatiin sammuun isaa summaa'e fi dhiisuu hin dandeenye akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that chronic thieves remain driven by criminal impulses regardless of harsh punishment or physical ruin.
Keywords_AO: harka, hanna, dooluu, sossoohuu
Keywords_EN: hand, theft, stump, twitching, chronic habit

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni nama hamachuudhaaf oduu jettee jettee odeessu, gaafa waan hamatu dhabe amammoochaati bula
Translation_Literal_EN: A slanderer who spreads gossip spends the night chewing his own gums when he finds no one to malign.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamii bare dhimma namaa dhiisee nagaan buluu hin danda'u; hamachuun akkuma araadaatti nama qabata.
Meaning_EN: A compulsive gossip deprived of fresh targets to defame will squirm and gnaw in agony from the sheer craving to slander.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hamii fi oduu namaatiin jiraatu fi nagaa dhabe balaaleffachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose the miserable, agitated state of chronic gossips who cannot rest without tearing down others.
Keywords_AO: nama hamachuu, oduu, amammoochuu, arraba
Keywords_EN: slander, gossip, chewing lips, compulsion

Mammaaksa_AO: Buutiin yoo ajjeesan malee, mudhii ciqqaawaniis, boolla seenuu fi nama ciniinuuf fifiiguu hin dhiiftu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless killed, even if you snap its waist, a puff adder does not stop seeking holes or trying to strike.
Meaning_AO: Diinni ykn wanti summaa'aan humni isaa yoo laafellee, hammeenya isaa guutummaatti hin dhiisu; eeggannoon barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Unless entirely destroyed, a venomous enemy will persist in trying to strike and cause harm even when severely crippled.
Usage_Situation_AO: Diinni ykn namni hamaan hammam dadhabullee akka salphaatti hin ilaalamne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against letting down one's guard against wounded or weakened adversaries who retain their toxic malice.
Keywords_AO: buutii, ajjeesuu, mudhii, ciniinuu
Keywords_EN: puff adder, killing, waist, biting, malice

Mammaaksa_AO: Jawween yoo waan liqimsitu dhabde, eegee isiiti liqimsiti
Translation_Literal_EN: When a python finds nothing to swallow, it swallows its own tail.
Meaning_AO: Wanti bololaa fi humna qabu yoo waan biraa dhabe gara ofii isaatti garagalee ofuma balleessa.
Meaning_EN: When predatory power or ravenous greed runs out of external prey, it turns inward and devours itself.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni bololaan guutaman yeroo wanti alaa dhumatu wal nyaachuu fi of balleessuu yeroo jalqaban.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe how rapacious, destructive forces end up consuming their own members when outside victims are exhausted.
Keywords_AO: jawwee, liqimsuu, eegee, badiisa
Keywords_EN: python, swallowing, tail, self-consumption

Mammaaksa_AO: Diiggalli dulloomee ilkee fixatullee, irgoon hantuuta ciniinuu hin dhiisu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even when the wildcat grows old and loses its teeth, it does not stop gnawing rats with its gums.
Meaning_AO: Namni ykn bineensi waan tokko bare dandeettii dhabullee fedhii fi yaalii isaa hin dhiisu.
Meaning_EN: Even when age strips away physical capacity, natural predatory instincts and lifelong habits stubbornly persist.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni dulloomee ykn humni itti xiqqaatullee amala isa duraanii agarsiisuu hin dhiifne ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that aging individuals or former authorities still cling tenaciously to their lifelong practices.
Keywords_AO: diiggala, dullooma, ilkee, hantuuta
Keywords_EN: wildcat, old age, teeth, rat, instinct

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan haadhatti bare soddatti
Translation_Literal_EN: What one learned at the mother's house, one practices before the in-laws.
Meaning_AO: Amalli fi naamusni manatti baratame bakka kamittiyyuu, bakka kabajaattillee ba'ee nama salphisa.
Meaning_EN: Indisciplined habits tolerated at home will inevitably spill out and cause deep embarrassment in polite society.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ijoollee ykn namoota mana ofiitti adaba dhabanii ala nama qaanessan gorsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to admonish that lack of domestic manners and basic propriety will inevitably humiliate a person among respected company.
Keywords_AO: haadha, baruu, soddaa, adaba
Keywords_EN: mother, learning, in-laws, domestic manners

Mammaaksa_AO: Nyaanne quufnee, akka warra keenyaa sanitti haa faffacaafnuu jette Lukkuun
Translation_Literal_EN: "We have eaten our fill; now let us scatter the food around like our ancestors," said the hen.
Meaning_AO: Amalli uumamaa fi baratame erga fedhiin guuttamee booda deebi'ee mul'ata; quufni qisaasama fida.
Meaning_EN: Once basic hunger is satisfied, inherent disorderly habits emerge, leading to wasteful and destructive behavior.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota yeroo quufan waan qaban qisaasessanii fi amala badaatti deebi'an qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize those who, upon reaching prosperity, quickly revert to wasteful, unruly, and ungrateful tendencies.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, quufuu, faffacaasuu, lukkuu
Keywords_EN: eating, satisfaction, scattering, wastefulness

Mammaaksa_AO: "Mana eegi" jennaan "mana eeguu niin eegaa, waan amala kiyyaa niin godha" jette, lukkuun
Translation_Literal_EN: When told "guard the house," the hen replied, "I will guard the house, but I will still follow my nature."
Meaning_AO: Namni itti-gaafatamummaan kennameef amala isaa isa badaa dhiisuu akka hin dandeenye agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Entrusting a duty to someone cannot erase their nature; they will still scratch around and cause their trademark mess.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama itti-gaafatamummaa fudhatee garuu amala isaa isa duraaniin badii fidu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution against assigning delicate tasks to individuals whose chronic habits run completely counter to the assignment.
Keywords_AO: mana eeguu, lukkuu, amala, itti-gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: house guarding, hen, nature, unreliable

Mammaaksa_AO: Mi'eeffatte Na arraabi je'e soogiddi
Translation_Literal_EN: "Taste my sweetness, then lick me," said the salt.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko jalqaba irratti nama hawwatee boodarra araada fi dhiibbaa cimaa ta'uu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: An initial enticing taste draws a person into an irresistible, repetitive indulgence that is difficult to break.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo wanti xiqqoon hawwatamtu nama harkiftee gara araadaatti geessu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how seemingly harmless, enticing pleasures hook people into chronic, demanding dependencies.
Keywords_AO: mi'eeffachuu, arraabuu, soogidda, araada
Keywords_EN: tasting sweetness, licking, salt, temptation

Mammaaksa_AO: Injireen nyyaata barte, mooluurratti duuti
Translation_Literal_EN: A louse accustomed to feeding dies on a bald head.
Meaning_AO: Namni faayidaa fi quufa bare bakka wanti dhumetti illee hafee lubbuu isaa dhabuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: A parasite spoiled by easy grazing stubbornly lingers over barren, exhausted pickings until it starves.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama faayidaa duraanii dhabee bakka homaa hin jirretti of balleessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock opportunists who perish because they cannot adapt or move on after their benefactor runs completely dry.
Keywords_AO: injiree, nyaata, mooluu, du'a
Keywords_EN: louse, feeding, bald head, fatal parasite

Mammaaksa_AO: Mi'eeffatan Liqeeffatan
Translation_Literal_EN: Once they taste the pleasure, they take out loans for it.
Meaning_AO: Namni waan tokko yoo mi'eeffatee fi jaalate, liqiidhaanis ta'ee argachuuf dhiibbaa ofirra kaaya.
Meaning_EN: Once a craving takes hold of someone's taste, they will plunge into reckless debt just to sustain the indulgence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni fedhii isaaniitiif jedhanii baasii fi liqii keessa of galchan yeroo gorsaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke people who take on ruinous financial debts simply because they lack the discipline to deny their appetites.
Keywords_AO: mi'eeffachuu, liqeeffachuu, fedhii, gatii
Keywords_EN: tasting pleasure, borrowing, craving, debt

Mammaaksa_AO: "Eega nyaadhu naan jettan, akka aadaa kiyyaattiin nyaadha" jette, lukkuun Keeysymmaa dhayxee
Translation_Literal_EN: "Since you told me to eat, I shall eat according to my custom," said the hen visiting as a guest.
Meaning_AO: Namni amalli isaa gad-aanaa ta'e bakka kabajamaa deemullee safeeffachuu dhiisee amala isaa mul'isa.
Meaning_EN: Even when honored with formal hospitality, an uncouth individual will shamelessly revert to their coarse, messy ways.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama keessummaa ta'ee erga affeeramee booda amala badaa agarsiisee qaanessu ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize unmannered guests who disrespect host hospitality by displaying unruly or uncivilized habits.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, aadaa, lukkuu, keessummaa
Keywords_EN: eating, custom, hen, guest, coarse manners

Mammaaksa_AO: Sabiyyiin dhooksaa barte, guyyaadhaan dinqatti fiigdi
Translation_Literal_EN: A child habituated to secret deeds runs into the inner bedroom even in broad daylight.
Meaning_AO: Namni hojii dhoksaa fi amala shakkisiisaa bare ifattiillee amala shakkisiisaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Someone conditioned to stealth and deceit instinctively acts shifty and scurries into hiding even under clear sunlight.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan hundumaa dhoksuuf qophaa'ee fi amala amanamummaa dhabe ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe secretive, dishonest characters whose compulsive evasion gives them away even when unprovoked.
Keywords_AO: sabiyyee, dhoksaa, dinqa, fiiguu
Keywords_EN: child, secrecy, inner room, shifty habit

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen bishaan foonii mi'eeffatte, ni deddeebiti
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog that has savored meat-broth keeps returning over and over.
Meaning_AO: Namni ykn bineensi wanta mi'aawaa fi faayidaa qabu yeroo tokko argate deebisee barbaacha dhufa.
Meaning_EN: Once a scavenger or opportunist gets a taste of easy delicacies, they become a permanent, recurring fixture.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan duraan argateen arraadamee yeroo mara deebi'ee faayidaa barbaadu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain why freeloaders persistently circle back to places where they once received easy benefits.
Keywords_AO: saree, bishaan foonii, mi'eeffachuu, deddeebiyuu
Keywords_EN: dog, meat broth, tasting, habitual return

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo kan Nabii dhufe, kan asaabaa ni hafa
Translation_Literal_EN: When the Prophet's matter arrives, that of the companions is set aside.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hunda caalaa guddaa fi ulfaataan yeroo dhufu, kanneen xixiqqoon dursa hin argatan.
Meaning_EN: When paramount authorities or supreme priorities emerge, secondary matters and subordinates yield precedence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma hunda caalaa murteessaa ta'eef dursa kennuun dirqama ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that supreme priorities unconditionally override lesser concerns.
Keywords_AO: nabii, asaabaa, dursa, sadarkaa
Keywords_EN: prophet, companions, precedence, supreme priority

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan dura du'e, dura awwaalani
Translation_Literal_EN: He who dies first is buried first.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hundi tartiiba isaatiin raawwatamuu qaba; dursa kan dhufetu dursa furmaata argata.
Meaning_EN: Matters must be handled in chronological and orderly succession; first come, first served.
Usage_Situation_AO: Tartiiba dhimmootaa eeguu fi qajeelfama dursa dhufetti fayyadamuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to enforce fairness by processing grievances or tasks strictly according to when they arose.
Keywords_AO: du'a, awwaala, dura, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: death, burial, order, chronological sequence

Mammaaksa_AO: "Dura kan taa'aarraa" jette jaldettiin
Translation_Literal_EN: "First from the one sitting before me," said the female baboon.
Meaning_AO: Hojii ykn gargaarsa ofitti dhihoo jiru irraa jalqabuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: It is most practical and effective to begin duties with whoever or whatever is immediately nearest.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii ykn dhimma of dura jiru dhiisanii kan fagootti utaaluu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct people to resolve immediate, closest problems before wandering to distant affairs.
Keywords_AO: dura, taa'aa, jaldettii, dhiheenya
Keywords_EN: first, sitting, female baboon, proximity

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurraattii dhiifteeti, gurra barbaaddi
Translation_Literal_EN: Leaving the black goat behind, she searches for ear trinkets.
Meaning_AO: Wanta guddaa fi qabatamaa harkaa qaban dhiisanii waan xiqqoo fi bu'aa hin qabne barbaacha ifaajuu.
Meaning_EN: Neglecting substantial, living wealth already in one's possession to chase after petty, cosmetic trifles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qabeenya ykn carraa guddaa dhiisee waan salphaa duukaa fiigu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand someone who abandons vital assets while squandering energy on insignificant vanities.
Keywords_AO: gurraattii, gurra, qabeenya, madaallii
Keywords_EN: black goat, ear, misplaced values, vanity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dura ni siysani moo, dura hidhi muuxeysani?
Translation_Literal_EN: Does one first urge the mount onward, or does one first pout the lips?
Meaning_AO: Wanti hundi tartiiba qaba; dalagaan dura ta'uu qabu dursa argachuu qaba malee wanta boodaa hin dursani.
Meaning_EN: Foundational actions must precede dramatic expressions; do not substitute theatrical gesturing for real effort.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii isa ijoo dhiisee wanta bu'aa hin qabne ykn booda dhufu dursu qajeelchuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to correct those who place superficial posturing ahead of essential preparatory work.
Keywords_AO: siysuu, hidhii muuxessuu, tartiiba, dalagaa
Keywords_EN: urging mount, pouting lips, logical sequence

Mammaaksa_AO: Nyaataafuu dhabnee, miila dhadhaa dibattaa?
Translation_Literal_EN: We lack food to eat, and yet you anoint your feet with butter?
Meaning_AO: Wanta murteessaa fi jireenyaaf barbaachisu dhabanii wanta faayaa fi qisaasamaaf kaachuu dhowwa.
Meaning_EN: When essential sustenance is lacking, squandering scarce supplies on cosmetic indulgence is unconscionable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haala rakkisaa keessatti nama faayaa fi of tuulummaaf qabeenya qisaasessu ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn squandering vital resources on superficial pampering while basic needs are neglected.
Keywords_AO: nyaata, dhadhaa, miila dibachuu, qisaasama
Keywords_EN: food, butter, feet anointing, misplaced luxury

Mammaaksa_AO: Iftu duraa, soddaan amba
Translation_Literal_EN: One's self comes first; in-laws are external people.
Meaning_AO: Namni dura of eeggachuu fi of jiraachisuu qaba; sana booda nama biraaf yaaduun danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: Self-preservation and personal well-being are paramount before one can extend support to external relations.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama of miidhee nama biraa gammachiisuuf ifaaju ofitti deebisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise individuals to protect their own core security before overextending for in-laws and acquaintances.
Keywords_AO: ifii, soddaa, amba, of dursuu
Keywords_EN: self, in-laws, strangers, self-preservation

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuu ar'a bulteetu, tan boruu yaada
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the soul that survives today that contemplates tomorrow.
Meaning_AO: Dura wanta har'aa furanii nagaan buluun dirqama; sana booda waa'ee boruu yaaduun dhufa.
Meaning_EN: Securing today's survival is the prerequisite for having any future about which to plan.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoo amma jiru dhiisanii yaaddoo fagoo kan boruu keessa seenuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ground people in resolving present crises rather than being paralyzed by distant future anxieties.
Keywords_AO: lubbuu, har'a, boru, jireenya
Keywords_EN: soul, today, tomorrow, survival first

Mammaaksa_AO: Guddinaa loontu caalaa, mi'aa foon hoolaatu caala
Translation_Literal_EN: In stature cattle are greater, but in flavor mutton is superior.
Meaning_AO: Guddinni qofti gatii wanta tokkoo hin murteessu; qulqullinaa fi mi'aan isaatu caala.
Meaning_EN: Bulk and massive size do not denote supreme value; finer quality and sweetness often belong to the modest.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta guddaa garuu qulqullina hin qabne irra waan xiqqoo fi qulqulluu filachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm that intrinsic excellence, refinement, and sweetness outweigh mere bulk and sheer volume.
Keywords_AO: loon, hoolaa, foon, mi'aa, qulqullina
Keywords_EN: cattle, sheep, mutton, flavor, quality

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii tan nama bira jirtu haasawan malee, tan nama bira hin jirre hin haasawani
Translation_Literal_EN: One discusses matters concerning the person present, not rumors of the absent.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma jiru nama bakka sana jiru wajjin mari'atanii furu malee nama hin jirre hamachuun hin barbaachisu.
Meaning_EN: Address and resolve issues directly with the people present instead of indulging in gossip about the absent.
Usage_Situation_AO: Marii iftoomina qabu geggeessuu fi hamii nama hin jirree dhiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to insist on candid, direct dialogue with those attending and to discourage unhelpful backbiting.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, nama bira jiru, haasawa, safuu
Keywords_EN: speech, presence, dialogue, backbiting

Mammaaksa_AO: Ifii banaa bulanii, balbala hin ergisani
Translation_Literal_EN: Exposing oneself to the night, one does not lend out one's door.
Meaning_AO: Osoo ofii qullaa fi rakkoo keessa jiranii nama biraaf waan bu'uuraa kennanii of miidhuun gowwummaa dha.
Meaning_EN: Leaving your own house vulnerable to predators while lending your defensive gate to others is folly.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan jireenya isaatiif murteessaa ta'e arjummaadhaan kenne of miidhu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn generous people not to give away their indispensable protections and leave themselves ruined.
Keywords_AO: banaa, buluu, balbala, ergisuu
Keywords_EN: exposed, overnight, door, foolish lending

Mammaaksa_AO: Hunqaa mana gahe ala facaasani
Translation_Literal_EN: Is grain safely brought into the granary to be scattered outside?
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya qulqullinaan galfate deebisanii bakkee irratti qisaasessuun safuu dha.
Meaning_EN: Hard-won provisions secured inside the home must never be recklessly squandered in the open.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya rakkinaan walitti qabame salphaatti akka hin qisaasofne akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to halt the careless dissipation of wealth and supplies that required tremendous toil to secure.
Keywords_AO: hunqaa, mana, ala facaasuu, qusannaa
Keywords_EN: grain harvest, house, scattering outside, thrift

Mammaaksa_AO: Bubbeen dhuftu, dura ija ifiiti qabatani
Translation_Literal_EN: When the gale strikes, one first shields one's own eyes.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo balaan tasa dhufu, dura of baraarsuun dursa argata.
Meaning_EN: When sudden tempests or peril arrive, protecting one's vision and survival is the urgent first instinct.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo balaa cimaatti dura of eeggachuun sirrii ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to validate self-protective reflexes and maintaining clear sight during overwhelming sudden crises.
Keywords_AO: bubbee, ija qabachuu, balaa, nageenya
Keywords_EN: gale, shielding eyes, danger, self-protection

Mammaaksa_AO: Namaan gorsaa dura, ifiin gorsaatu caala
Translation_Literal_EN: Before counseling others, counseling oneself is far superior.
Meaning_AO: Nama biraa gorsuun dura amala fi hojii ofii sirreeffachuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Self-reflection and correcting one's own deficiencies must precede any attempt to instruct neighbors.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ofii balleessaa qabaatee nama gorsuuf fiigu qajeelchuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to silence hypocritical busybodies who preach virtues to others while ignoring their own failings.
Keywords_AO: nama gorsuu, of gorsuu, safuu, qajeelummaa
Keywords_EN: advising others, self-counsel, integrity

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama qa'ee ifii tolfateetu, qa'ee abbaa qabdu dhaqa
Translation_Literal_EN: It is the one who has ordered his own compound that visits the homestead of another.
Meaning_AO: Hojii fi nagaa manaa ofii erga qajeelchanii booda dhimma nama biraa keessa galuun tola.
Meaning_EN: Only one whose own domestic affairs are in pristine order has the credibility to inspect another's domain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mana ofii osoo hin tolfatin namatti qeeqaa fi gorsaa ta'uu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind critics to tidy up their own private disarray before commenting on other households.
Keywords_AO: qa'ee, tolfachuu, dhaquu, adaba
Keywords_EN: compound, setting in order, credibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama mana keessaa haxaawwateetu, mooraa haxaawwata
Translation_Literal_EN: He who has swept inside the living quarters sweeps the cattle enclosure.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin keessaa fi inni ijoon yoo raawwatame qofa kan alaa irratti hojjetama.
Meaning_EN: Securing and cleaning the interior living space takes precedence before attending to outer perimeters.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma keessoo dhiisanii kan alaa irratti yeroo qisaasessan tartiiba qabsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to enforce systematic priority: handling intimate, internal necessities before outward appearances.
Keywords_AO: mana keessa, haxaawwachuu, mooraa, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: inside house, sweeping, enclosure, priorities

Mammaaksa_AO: Dandeytiitu baana (diqaalaa) ba'ataa, ormi kan abbaa qabuuhuu dadhabe
Translation_Literal_EN: Sheer wealth shoulders the burden of a bastard, while poor folks struggle with legitimate offspring.
Meaning_AO: Humni fi qabeenyi wanta ulfaataa ta'ellee salphaatti ba'achuu nama dandeessisa; dhabuun waan salphaattuu nama dhiba.
Meaning_EN: Abundant means can absorb extraordinary anomalies, whereas extreme poverty struggles with basic duties.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenyi fi humni dhimma ulfaataa salphisuu fi dhabuun waan salphaa ulfeessuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe how financial strength effortlessly sustains heavy burdens that would crush the poor.
Keywords_AO: dandeettii, baana, abbaa qabu, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: wealth, illegitimate child, legitimate, burden

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyya jechuun, biyyee mitii nama
Translation_Literal_EN: A country is not mere soil; it is the people.
Meaning_AO: Biyyi lafa qofaan osoo hin taane hawaasa fi tokkummaa namaatiin ijaaramti.
Meaning_EN: A nation is defined not by lifeless dirt and terrain, but by its living people, community, and human bond.
Usage_Situation_AO: Lafa qofa osoo hin taane nageenyaa fi kabaja lammiilee dursuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in communal dialogues to prioritize the dignity, life, and concord of human beings above empty land.
Keywords_AO: biyya, biyyee, nama, hawaasa
Keywords_EN: homeland, soil, human beings, community

Mammaaksa_AO: Sa'a mana jiruu, rifeensa hin haadani
Translation_Literal_EN: While the cow is alive in the stable, one does not scrape its hide.
Meaning_AO: Wanta jiru fi bu'aa kennaa jiru yeroo malee dhabamsiisuuf hin ariifatan.
Meaning_EN: One does not prematurely skin or strip an asset that is currently alive, thriving, and productive.
Usage_Situation_AO: Waan faayidaa qabu yeroon dura garmalee saamuuf ariifachuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to restrain reckless people from butchering or over-exploiting working assets before their due season.
Keywords_AO: sa'a, mana jiru, rifeensa haaduu, obsa
Keywords_EN: cow, alive in barn, shaving hide, patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo hin kurfaawin, nyaataaf harka hin dhiqatani
Translation_Literal_EN: Before the meal is ready, one does not wash hands to eat.
Meaning_AO: Wanta qophiin isaa hin xumuramneef duraan dursee qophaa'uun yeroo gubuu dha.
Meaning_EN: Do not sit down and wash hands to feast before the dishes have even been prepared and served.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta hin geenyeef ariifatanii yeroo malee qophaa'uu dhowwuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to check premature excitement and actions that jump the gun before conditions are ripe.
Keywords_AO: kurfaawuu, nyaata, harka dhiqachuu, yeroo
Keywords_EN: getting ready, feast, washing hands, timing

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama lafatti wal taheetu, muka wajjiin kora
Translation_Literal_EN: Only people in harmony on the ground climb the tree together.
Meaning_AO: Tokkummaa fi waliigaltee bu'uuraa yoo qabaatan qofa hojii ulfaataa waliin hojjechuun danda'ama.
Meaning_EN: Only companions who possess solid mutual trust on flat land can safely venture into perilous heights together.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii guddaa jalqabuuf dura bu'uura tokkummaa fi jaalalaa uumuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that shared high-stakes ventures require deep-rooted accord and mutual confidence first.
Keywords_AO: lafa, wal-tahuu, muka koruu, tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: ground, harmony, climbing tree, cooperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhaaba kanniisaa, kan duraati muran
Translation_Literal_EN: Of a beehive's combs, one cuts the outermost one first.
Meaning_AO: Hojii ykn dhimma keessatti wanta dursa dhufe fi dhihoo jiru dura raawwatu.
Meaning_EN: When harvesting honeycombs, one severs the foremost comb first; progress systematically from the entrance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii tartiiba qabu jalqaba irraa suuta eegaluuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise following methodical, step-by-step procedures rather than tackling an enterprise haphazardly.
Keywords_AO: dhaaba kanniisaa, dura muruu, tartiiba
Keywords_EN: beehive comb, cutting foremost, orderly steps

Mammaaksa_AO: Hookkoon waan dura aanaa fuudhi jette
Translation_Literal_EN: The crooked hook said, "Draw in what is immediately ahead."
Meaning_AO: Wanta of dura jiru fi harka qaqqabu dursa fudhatanii fayyadamuun ogummaadha.
Meaning_EN: Wisdom dictates pulling in the fruit and opportunities immediately within reach before overextending.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta dhihoo fi salphaatti danda'amu dhiisanii kan fagootti kaachuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel taking advantage of immediate, tangible gains rather than overreaching for distant ones.
Keywords_AO: hookkoo, dura aanaa, fuudhuu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: crooked hook, foremost, grasping, practical

Mammaaksa_AO: Amalli hamaan ni qaramaa, barri hamaan hin qaramu
Translation_Literal_EN: Bad character can be honed and reformed, but a bad era cannot be sharpened.
Meaning_AO: Amala namaa gorsanii fi barsiisanii sirreessuun ni danda'ama, garuu barri ykn qilleensi hamaan harka namaa hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Human misconduct can be disciplined and refined, but adverse times and natural disasters defy human control.
Usage_Situation_AO: Amala namaa jijjiiruun danda'amuu garuu barri yoo dide obsaan dabarsuu akka qaban ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that human morals can be molded, whereas adverse fortunes must be endured patiently.
Keywords_AO: amala hamaa, qaruu, bara hamaa, obsa
Keywords_EN: bad character, sharpening, hard times, endurance

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama qonnaan si bira kute ni dhaqqabda, nama hormaataan si bira kute hin dhaqqabdu
Translation_Literal_EN: You can catch up to him who outpaces you in farming, but not him who outpaces you in breeding livestock.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi loonii fi hormaataa dhalootaan kan baay'atu waan ta'eef, dorgomee qaqqabuun baay'ee ulfaataadha.
Meaning_EN: Agricultural yields grow seasonally, but livestock multiplies exponentially, making compounding herds impossible to overtake.
Usage_Situation_AO: Garaagarummaa gosa qabeenyaa fi saffisa horachuu ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the compounding leverage of livestock husbandry over ordinary seasonal cultivation.
Keywords_AO: qonnaa, dhaqqabuu, hormaata, loon
Keywords_EN: farming, catching up, livestock, compounding

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyya itti dhalatan malee, biyya itti du'an hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One knows the land of one's birth, but never the land of one's death.
Meaning_AO: Jalqaba jireenyaa beekanillee, xumuraa fi dhuma jireenyaa kan beeku Waaqayyo qofa.
Meaning_EN: While one's origin and birthplace are certain, where and when death will strike remains an absolute mystery.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni bakka dhuma isaatii akka hin beekne hubachiisuun of eeggannoo fi gad-of-qabuu barsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to inspire humility and caution by reminding mortals of their complete ignorance regarding their final end.
Keywords_AO: biyya dhalootaa, du'a, beekumsa, rabbi
Keywords_EN: birthplace, death, unknown destiny, mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka itti oolan malee, akka itti bulan hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One knows how one spends the day, but not how one will pass the night.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo ammaa jiran beekanillee wanti booda dhufu fi jijjiirama tasaa tilmaamuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: The daylight hours are known and experienced, but sudden evening calamities can disrupt any certainty.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jireenyi yeroma hunda jijjiiramuu akka dandeessu beekanii of eeggachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution people against taking peaceful hours for granted, as circumstances can change in a flash.
Keywords_AO: oolmaa, bulmaata, yeroo, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: daytime, passing night, uncertainty, preparedness

Mammaaksa_AO: hamma maqanii fi hamma taa'an hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One knows neither the span of their wandering nor the length of their stay.
Meaning_AO: Dheerina jireenyaa, umurii, fi daangaa turtiif deemisaa wanti namni beeku hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: Humans know neither the duration of their earthly sojourn nor the exact boundary of their lifespan.
Usage_Situation_AO: Umuriin fi jireenyi namaa daangaa hin beekamne qabaachuu isaa hubachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect upon the transient, unpredictable nature of human lifespans and migrations.
Keywords_AO: maqaa, taa'umsa, umurii, daangaa
Keywords_EN: wandering, staying, lifespan, transience

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafa ka'anii fi gaafa molaawan hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One knows neither the day one rises to prominence nor the day one is stripped bare.
Meaning_AO: Carraan jireenyaa, badhaadhinni fi kufaatiin yeroo itti dhufu hin beekamu; jireenyi furguggeedha.
Meaning_EN: No one can predict the precise day their fortune ascends or the sudden day disaster strips them destitute.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni yeroo badhaadhe akka hin boonnee fi yeroo rakkate akka abdii hin kunne gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach temperance in prosperity and patience in adversity, since human fortune turns unpredictably.
Keywords_AO: ka'uu, molaawuu, carraa, jireenya
Keywords_EN: rising, going bald, fortune, vicissitude

Mammaaksa_AO: Qara, waa hin doomsani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not deliberately dull a sharp blade.
Meaning_AO: Wanta qara qabu, beekaa, ykn nama dandeettii qabu akka inni bu'aa dhabu hin godhani.
Meaning_EN: One should never deliberately blunt a razor edge, sabotage acute intelligence, or ruin effective assets.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dandeettii fi meeshaa qara qabu mancaasuu irraa of qusachuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against crippling competent workers, undermining talents, or dulling critical tools.
Keywords_AO: qara, doomsuu, ogummaa, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: sharp blade, blunting, preserving talent, skill

Mammaaksa_AO: Gamna gowwoomsuun, jibba barbaaduu dha
Translation_Literal_EN: Tricking a clever person is actively inviting enduring hatred.
Meaning_AO: Nama dammaqaa fi beekaa sobuuf yaaluun jibbaa fi hammeenya guddaa ofitti fida.
Meaning_EN: Attempting to swindle an astute, perceptive mind only incites their permanent, focused enmity.
Theme_EN: The Danger of Tricking the Wise
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gamna fi beekaa ta'e sobuuf yaalu akeekkachiisanii dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn schemers that attempting to outfox brilliant minds creates dangerous and unrelenting adversaries.
Keywords_AO: gamna, gowwoomsuu, jibba, sodaa
Keywords_EN: cunning person, tricking, hatred, peril

Mammaaksa_AO: Beekaa gowwoomsuun, hija guddisa
Translation_Literal_EN: Outsmarting a wise person only compounds one's ultimate liability.
Meaning_AO: Nama beekaa gowwoomsuuf yaaluun kasaaraa fi badiisa guddaa ofirraan gaha.
Meaning_EN: Attempting to deceive a truly knowledgeable person backfires, severely multiplying damages and public disgrace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama beekaa fi hayyuu sobee bu'aa argachuu yaalu qajeelchuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution petty tricksters against attempting to dupe wise leaders whose retribution will be manifold.
Keywords_AO: beekaa, gowwoomsuu, hija, kasaaraa
Keywords_EN: wise man, deceiving, debt, compounded ruin

Mammaaksa_AO: Diina namaa, dutti hin fixne jibbansi hin fageysine
Translation_Literal_EN: Barking does not destroy an enemy, nor does mere hatred drive them away.
Meaning_AO: Afaaniin wacuu fi aariin diina hin dhabamsiisu; gocha qabatamaa fi furmaata barbaachisa.
Meaning_EN: Noisy shouting does not neutralize foes, and silent bitterness never drives adversaries from one's doorstep.
Usage_Situation_AO: Diina irratti iyyuu dhiisanii qophii qabatamaa fi furmaata fiduu akka qaban hubachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise people to stop indulging in toothless complaining and instead execute effective, decisive action.
Keywords_AO: diina, dutuu, jibbansa, gocha
Keywords_EN: enemy, barking, hatred, practical action

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan dhaabbatanii fannisan, taa'anii fuudhuun nama dhiba
Translation_Literal_EN: What is hung up casually while standing becomes an ordeal to retrieve while seated.
Meaning_AO: Wanta salphaatti liqeessan ykn balleeysan yeroo deebisanii argachuuf yaalan rakkisaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Resources extended casually or lent without formal terms become an agonizing, humiliating trial to reclaim.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya ofii namaaf liqeessuu fi kenne deebifachuu keessatti eeggannoo akka godhan gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution lenders that parting with wealth is easy, but reclaiming it from debtors is painful toil.
Keywords_AO: dhaabbachuu, fannisuu, taa'uu, liqii
Keywords_EN: standing, hanging, sitting, debt recovery

Mammaaksa_AO: Gurra muran dhagayaatu hafa
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if the outer ear is severed, hearing remains within.
Meaning_AO: Miidhaan alaa yoo ga'ellee, dandeettii fi hubannoon keessaa hin badu.
Meaning_EN: Mutilating the external ear leaves the internal sense of hearing untouched; persecution cannot crush truth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa qaamaa fi doorsisa alaa dandamatanii dhugaa fi hubannoo eeggachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to assert that external oppression or superficial assault can never extinguish inner truth and perception.
Keywords_AO: gurra muruu, dhagaya, hubannoo, jabinna
Keywords_EN: cutting ear, hearing, inner resilience, truth

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijji yoo bayxe, boolli ijaa hin baddu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if the eyeball is torn out, the empty eye socket endures.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko yoo badellee, mallattoon fi bakki isaa yeroo mara ni yaadatama.
Meaning_EN: Even when a precious entity is plucked out and lost, the indelible scar and hollow cavity forever remain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa fi kasaaraa guddaa darbe deebisanii hin arganne garuu faanni isaa hafe ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to convey that monumental losses leave permanent historical scars that can never be smoothed over.
Keywords_AO: ija bahuu, boolla ijaa, yaadannoo, madaa
Keywords_EN: plucked eye, socket, permanent scar, loss

Mammaaksa_AO: Dheebuu ebeloo fi jibbansa haadhaa hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One cannot fathom another's burning thirst, nor can one detect a mother's hidden aversion.
Meaning_AO: Miira keessoo namaa fi yaada garaa namni biraa guutummaatti beekuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: Another individual's agonizing inner craving is invisible, just as subtle maternal disfavor stays deeply concealed.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miira nama biraa akka salphaatti hubachuun rakkisaa ta'uu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to acknowledge that private suffering and intimate emotional currents cannot be fully plumbed by outsiders.
Keywords_AO: dheebuu, jibbansa haadhaa, qalbii, dhoksaa
Keywords_EN: thirst, mother's aversion, hidden feeling

Mammaaksa_AO: Miila lama qabaataniif, farda lama hin korani
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because one has two legs, one does not mount two horses simultaneously.
Meaning_AO: Humna qaban mara iddoo adda addaatti facaasuun hin ta'u; daangaa ofii beekuun tola.
Meaning_EN: Having two legs does not empower one to ride two mounts at once; avoid absurdly overextended pursuits.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii humnaa olii fi bakka baay'eetti faca'ee of rakkisu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge people to concentrate their faculties on a single realistic goal rather than dividing efforts absurdly.
Keywords_AO: miila lama, farda, koruu, daangaa
Keywords_EN: two legs, horses, riding, focus, limits

Mammaaksa_AO: Kofla saree, hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One cannot decipher the grinning grimace of a dog.
Meaning_AO: Kofla sobaa fi amala nama sobdootaa amanuun nama miidha; qalbii keessaa beekuun rakkisaadha.
Meaning_EN: A dog baring its teeth could be playfully smiling or preparing to bite; never trust treacherous, deceitful smiles.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama afaan mi'aawaa fi kofla sobaatiin nama gowwoomsu irraa of eeggachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against hypocrites who conceal venomous, biting intentions behind warm, deceitful grins.
Keywords_AO: kofla saree, soba, shakkii, amala
Keywords_EN: dog's grin, false laughter, deception, warning

Mammaaksa_AO: surreen, sagal dhuufuu hin dhoowwu
Translation_Literal_EN: Trousers do not prevent passing wind nine times.
Meaning_AO: Wanti uumamaan dhufu uffannaa fi qofaan hin daangeffamu; wanta dhoksuun hin danda'amne dhoowwuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Garments cannot contain or stifle involuntary internal gases; outward facades cannot conceal natural eruptions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Amala uumamaa isa badaa uffannaa fi bifa alaan dhoksuu yaalu qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize futile attempts at using polite clothes or social facades to mask vulgar, uncontrollable flaws.
Keywords_AO: surree, dhuufuu, dhoksaa, uumama
Keywords_EN: trousers, flatulence, facade, exposed nature

Mammaaksa_AO: Manni hamadaya malee, hama hin dayu
Translation_Literal_EN: A house shelters against bitter frost, but it cannot shelter against malevolent evil.
Meaning_AO: Manni qabbana alaa ittisuu danda'a garuu nama hamaa fi qalbii badaan dhufe ittisuu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: A dwelling provides physical protection from icy gales, but no walls can insulate against domestic treachery.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nageenyi manaa qabeenya fi dallaa qofaan osoo hin taane qulqullina qalbii namaatiin akka dhufu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reflect that structural fortifications mean nothing if moral evil and betrayal fester within the household.
Keywords_AO: mana, hamadaya, hamaa, nageenya
Keywords_EN: house, frost, evil, domestic vulnerability

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo darbatanuu tulluu hin fullaatu, ijji waan namaa hin fuutu
Translation_Literal_EN: Even when flung, a stone cannot pierce a mountain; a covetous eye cannot take another's property.
Meaning_AO: Hawwii fi ijaan ilaaluun qabeenya namaa ofii hin godhu; wanta hin danda'amneef of hin dhiphisani.
Meaning_EN: A thrown pebble cannot penetrate a mountain, and hungry eyes cannot confiscate another's rightful possessions.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qabeenya namaatti ija dhiyee bololuuf gorsa kennuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind envious gazers that staring covetously at another's wealth brings zero benefit and changes nothing.
Keywords_AO: darbachuu, tulluu, ija, qabeenya namaa
Keywords_EN: throwing, mountain, covetous eye, impotence

Mammaaksa_AO: Arriin baate, debitee, hin gurraachomtu
Translation_Literal_EN: Gray hair that has sprouted never turns black again.
Meaning_AO: Dulloomni fi yeroon darbe deebi'ee hin dhufu; uumama duraatti deebi'uun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Sprouted silver hair never returns to natural black; lost youth and irreversible aging cannot be unwound.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dulloomaa fi jijjiirama uumamaa obsaan fudhachuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge graceful acceptance of physical aging and life transitions, rejecting vain attempts to fake youth.
Keywords_AO: arrii, gurraachomuu, dullooma, yeroo
Keywords_EN: gray hair, turning black, aging, irreversible

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaan ganna bahee fi maqaan ganna bahe hin fayyu
Translation_Literal_EN: A ditch gouged by seasonal floods and a reputation destroyed in seasonal crisis never heal.
Meaning_AO: Badiin yeroo rakkisaa keessatti maqaa irratti dhufe fi daandiin dhangala'aan mancaase hin deebi'u.
Meaning_EN: A ravine cut by violent monsoon torrents and a name ruined in a moment of crisis leave permanent destruction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Maqaa ofii balleessaa irraa eeggachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that a ruined reputation incurred during an emergency remains a permanent stigma forever.
Keywords_AO: karaa gannaa, maqaa bahe, madaa, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: rainy track, damaged name, indelible scar

Mammaaksa_AO: Goblaa qabaattu malee hin barartu
Translation_Literal_EN: Unless one possesses wings, one cannot take flight.
Meaning_AO: Dandeettii, humna, fi meeshaa barbaachisu osoo hin qabaatin waan guddaa bira ga'uun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: Without wings, flight is impossible; without foundational ability and resources, grandiose aspirations fail.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta dandeettii fi humna hin qabneen hojjechuuf ka'uu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ground over-ambitious people, reminding them to build necessary skills before attempting high flights.
Keywords_AO: goblaa, bararuu, humna, dandeettii
Keywords_EN: wings, flying, capability, realism

Mammaaksa_AO: Roobaan, dhukke hin kaasani
Translation_Literal_EN: In the midst of downpours, one does not kick up dust.
Meaning_AO: Haala hin taane keessatti wanta hin danda'amne gochuuf yaaluun gowwummaa dha.
Meaning_EN: One cannot kick up clouds of dust while torrential rain is falling; avoid attempting contradictory absurdities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta haalli yeroo hin hayyamne raawwachuuf dadhabuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out the folly of demanding or attempting conditions entirely ruled out by current reality.
Keywords_AO: rooba, dhukkee, yeroo, haala
Keywords_EN: rain, dust, contradiction, impracticality

Mammaaksa_AO: Afaan abbaa qabu, qabanii hin cuqqaalani
Translation_Literal_EN: A mouth that has a master cannot be forcibly stuffed shut.
Meaning_AO: Namni dubbachuuf mirga qabu fi beeku dubbii isaa irraa dhowwamuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: A voice backed by rightful ownership, conviction, and courage cannot be permanently silenced or muffled.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mirga dubbachuu fi dhugaa baasuu namaa kabachiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm the right to free expression and to declare that righteous truth will speak out regardless of threats.
Keywords_AO: afaan, abbaa, cuqqaaluu, bilisummaa
Keywords_EN: mouth, owner, gagging, free speech

Mammaaksa_AO: Maraataan, ni wayyaawa malee hin fayyu
Translation_Literal_EN: A lunatic may show improvement, but he never completely cures.
Meaning_AO: Amalli badaa fi qoricha hin qabne yeroof tasgabbaa'ullee deebi'ee ka'uu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Deep-seated lunacy or chronic vice may enjoy periods of quiet remission, but the core affliction never vanishes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amala badaa duraaniitti deebi'uuf eeggannoo gochuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge persistent vigilance against individuals prone to relapse into chronic, erratic vices.
Keywords_AO: maraataa, wayyaawuu, fayyuu, amala
Keywords_EN: lunatic, improving, curing, chronic vice

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen, eegeen hin fuutu
Translation_Literal_EN: A dog does not lift or pick up objects with its tail.
Meaning_AO: Wanta uumamaan meeshaa fi dandeettii isaaf hin taaneen hojjechuun hin danda'amu.
Meaning_EN: A dog cannot carry cargo with its tail; do not deploy fundamentally unsuitable tools for serious jobs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii guddaaf nama dandeettii hin qabne ykn meeshaa dogoggoraatti fayyadamuu ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize assigning critical duties to individuals or instruments completely lacking the needed capacity.
Keywords_AO: saree, eegee, fuudhuu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: dog, tail, picking up, unfit tool

Mammaaksa_AO: Hangam itti roobuus, dhagaan hin biqilu
Translation_Literal_EN: However heavily rain pours upon it, a boulder will never sprout.
Meaning_AO: Nama qalbii gogaa fi gorsi hin seenne hammam barsiisanillee hin jijjiiramu.
Meaning_EN: No deluge of rainfall can coax green shoots from solid rock; no amount of wise counsel can soften a stony heart.
Theme_EN: The Futility of Sowing on Stone
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gorsa fi barnoota hin fudhanne jijjiiruuf yaalanii dadhabuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when resigning from futile attempts to reform stubborn, unteachable, and callous individuals.
Keywords_AO: rooba, dhagaa, biqiluu, gorsa
Keywords_EN: rain, stone, sprouting, stony heart

Mammaaksa_AO: Horaan baasatti, jawwee baase
Translation_Literal_EN: Hoping to draw wealth, he pulled out a python.
Meaning_AO: Wanta gaarii fi bu'aa eeggachaa osoo jiranii tasa balaa fi waan sodaatamaa argachuu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Anticipating rich gains and prosperity, one inadvertently triggers a deadly, horrifying hazard.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta gaarii hawwaa jiru tasa balaa cimaa keessatti kufe ibsamu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an innocent search for easy fortune unexpectedly unearths dangerous and monstrous trouble.
Keywords_AO: horaa, baasuu, jawwee, balaa
Keywords_EN: wealth, drawing, python, hazardous surprise

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaaf gaaf, dhuufuun albaatii namatti taati
Translation_Literal_EN: Sometimes, passing flatulence turns into diarrhea.
Meaning_AO: Dogoggorri ykn wanti salphaan tokko yeroo tokko tokko gara balaa fi rakkina guddaatti jijjiirama.
Meaning_EN: Occasionally, a minor, casual slip escalates unpredictably into an uncontrollable, messy scandal.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dogoggora salphaa tuffatanii dhiisuun akka balaa guddaa hin fidne of eeggachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that small indiscretions and minor oversights can rapidly spiral into utter disaster.
Keywords_AO: dhuufuu, albaatii, balaa, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: flatulence, diarrhea, escalation, caution

Mammaaksa_AO: Lubbuu sibiilaaf kaaye, qoraan ajjeesa
Translation_Literal_EN: The life preserved from iron weapons is killed by a simple thorn.
Meaning_AO: Namni balaa fi waraana guddaa irraa oole wanta salphaa fi hin eegamneen miidhamuu ykn du'uu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: A soul that survived ferocious battles and cold steel can fall victim to a trivial thorn prick.
Usage_Situation_AO: Akeekkachiisa jireenyaa fi ajalli waan hin eegamneen nama qaqqabuu danda'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to contemplate human mortality and the irony of dodging monumental perils only to die from a trifle.
Keywords_AO: lubbuu, sibiila, qoraa, ajjeesuu
Keywords_EN: life, steel blade, thorn, mortal irony

Mammaaksa_AO: Bakka hin dhaqu jedhan, maraatanii dhaqani
Translation_Literal_EN: To the place one swore never to go, one ends up going while mad.
Meaning_AO: Wanta duraan "matumaa hin godhu" jedhan carraan dirqisiisee akka namni raawwatu godha.
Meaning_EN: Circumstance, desperation, and misfortune can drive a person to the very doorstep they proudly shunned.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni waan tokko "ani hin godhu" jedhee akka hin boonnee fi of hin tuulle akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against proud, absolute vows, since life's desperate turns can compel anyone to swallow their pride.
Keywords_AO: dhaquu, maraachuu, of-tuulummaa, jireenya
Keywords_EN: going, madness, sworn refusal, humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan tuffataniitu nama caala, kan jibbaniitu nama dhaala
Translation_Literal_EN: The one you despise surpasses you, and the one you detest inherits your wealth.
Meaning_AO: Namni salphaatti tuffatame yeroo baay'ee milkaa'ee kan tuffate caala; carraan nama jibbaniifis ta'uu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: The person dismissed with contempt often rises to dominance, and the despised relative ends up as heir.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama kamiyyuu tuffachuu fi jibbuu irraa akka of qusatan gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke arrogant prejudice and warn that the despised underdog frequently triumphs or inherits.
Keywords_AO: tuffachuu, nama caaluu, jibbuu, dhaaluu
Keywords_EN: scorn, surpassing, hatred, inheritance

Mammaaksa_AO: Haaduun ani lafeen muruuf filadheetu tiruu muruu irratti caphe
Translation_Literal_EN: The knife I chose to sever bone broke while cutting soft liver.
Meaning_AO: Wanti ykn namni jabaa fi abdachiisaa dha jedhamee amaname wanta salphaa irratti dadhabee fashale.
Meaning_EN: A blade trusted to split solid bone shattered while cutting tender liver; high hopes dashed on an easy task.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ykn meeshaa jabaa seetanii wanta salphaa irratti fashalee nama qaanessu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when a person with an intimidating reputation fails miserably when confronted by the simplest duty.
Keywords_AO: haaduu, lafee, tiruu, caphuu
Keywords_EN: knife, bone, soft liver, shattered expectations

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama lafaatu, nama fardaa reebe
Translation_Literal_EN: The pedestrian on foot beat the mounted horseman.
Meaning_AO: Namni humni fi carraan isaa gad-aanaa ta'e isa meeshaa fi gurguddoo qabu injifachuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: The unmounted, vulnerable underdog physically outmatched and defeated the proud mounted warrior.
Usage_Situation_AO: Humni ykn meeshaan qofti murteessaa akka hin taane fi dadhabaanis injifachuu danda'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate improbable upsets where humble participants conquer opponents possessing every advantage.
Keywords_AO: nama lafaa, nama fardaa, reebicha, injifannoo
Keywords_EN: pedestrian, horseman, beating, underdog victory

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama laafaatu, nama jabaa reebe
Translation_Literal_EN: The frail person beat the mighty person.
Meaning_AO: Jabinni qaamaa qofti ga'aa miti; gamnummaa fi carraan nama laafaa isa jabaa akka moo'atu godha.
Meaning_EN: Physical brawn alone is never invincible; courage, strategy, and agility enable the frail to fell giants.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama humnaan cimaa ta'e akka hin sodaannee fi laafaanis goota ta'uu danda'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage the physically or socially disadvantaged not to fear arrogant powerhouses.
Keywords_AO: nama laafaa, nama jabaa, reebicha, humna
Keywords_EN: frail man, strong man, defeat, wit over brawn

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama mancaatu, nama qawwee ajjeese
Translation_Literal_EN: The man with a machete killed the man armed with a rifle.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan qofti gootummaa hin kennu; murannoo fi dandeettii namaatu murteessaadha.
Meaning_EN: Advanced weaponry guarantees nothing; unyielding resolution and raw courage trump technical superiority.
Usage_Situation_AO: Meeshaa gurguddaan dhaadachuu dhiisanii murannoo fi gootummaa qabaachuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that the bravery of the warrior matters far more than the sophistication of their arsenal.
Keywords_AO: mancaa, qawwee, ajjeesuu, gootummaa
Keywords_EN: machete, rifle, killing, courage over weapons

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaaf gaaf harreen loon dura galti
Translation_Literal_EN: Sometimes the donkey enters the homestead ahead of the cattle.
Meaning_AO: Yeroo tokko tokko wanti salphaan fi gad-aanaan wanta kabajamaa fi guddaa dursa argachuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: On occasion, the humble donkey leads the way into the homestead while the prized cattle trail behind.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni ykn wanti hin eegamne dursaa fi carraa argate dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing curious reversals where lower-status individuals unexpectedly seize priority.
Keywords_AO: harree, loon, dura galuu, carraa
Keywords_EN: donkey, cattle, precedence, flipped order

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoo dullachi jiruuti, jabbiin duuti
Translation_Literal_EN: While the aged cow survives, the young calf dies.
Meaning_AO: Duuti fi balaan tartiiba umuriitiin hin dhufu; dargaggoon osoo manguddoon jiru darbuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: Death and destiny pay no homage to biological seniority; the tender young may fall while the old endure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dargaggoon ykn ijoolleen tasa lubbuun darban gaddaan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used during heartbreaking bereavements when promising youths pass away before their frail elders.
Keywords_AO: dullacha, jabbii, du'a, umurii
Keywords_EN: aged cow, young calf, untimely death, mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Osoon dhala eeguun, ulfa dhabe
Translation_Literal_EN: While anticipating a birth, I lost the pregnancy entirely.
Meaning_AO: Bu'aa guddaa eegaa osoo jiranii qabeenya fi bu'uura qabaniyyuu dhabanii kasaaruu.
Meaning_EN: Eagerly anticipating a triumphant birth, one loses the fetus; forfeiting both prospective fruits and core capital.
Theme_EN: Tragic Loss of Asset and Hope
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta guddaa eeggachaa osoo jiranii waan harkaa qabanis dhabanii yeroo miidhaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to lament double disasters where chasing anticipated windfalls destroys existing principal wealth.
Keywords_AO: dhala, ulfa dhabuu, abdii, kasaaraa
Keywords_EN: offspring, miscarriage, ruined hope, double loss

Mammaaksa_AO: Dinqii dinqii, biddeenaatu eelee cabse
Translation_Literal_EN: Wonder of wonders! The soft bread broke the clay griddle!
Meaning_AO: Wanti laafaa fi dadhabaa jedhamee yaadamu wanta jabaa fi cimaa sana balleessuu isaa dinqisiifachuu.
Meaning_EN: Astonishment of astonishments! The yielding, soft dough managed to shatter the hardened clay griddle.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta uumamaa fi yaada namaatiin ol ta'ee tasa raawwatame dinqisiifachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in utter disbelief and awe when something notoriously delicate destroys a hardened, rigid institution.
Keywords_AO: dinqii, biddeena, eelee cabsuu, jijjiirama
Keywords_EN: wonder, bread, breaking griddle, paradox

Mammaaksa_AO: Galti mukaa, harka ibiddaati
Translation_Literal_EN: The final destination of wood is in the hands of fire.
Meaning_AO: Wanti kamiyyuu xumura fi dhuma hin oolle qaba; mukni yeroo dhumu ibiddaan gubata.
Meaning_EN: The ultimate destination and destiny of wood is the fire; everything marches toward its inevitable conclusion.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhumni dhimma tokkoo akka hin hafne fi kanuma uumamaa ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to emphasize that every earthly entity has an unavoidable final end dictated by its nature.
Keywords_AO: gala, muka, ibidda, xumura
Keywords_EN: return, wood, fire, inevitable end

Mammaaksa_AO: Kuyyuubisni, bakka irraa mayretti jiga
Translation_Literal_EN: The termite mound collapses toward whichever side it leaned.
Meaning_AO: Namni ykn wanti amala tokkotti gore xumurri isaas garauma sanatti kofa'ee kufa.
Meaning_EN: An unstable mound falls precisely in the direction it habitually inclined; ingrained leanings dictate one's collapse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni amala badaatti goru xumurri isaa kasaaraa ta'uu agarsiisuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that lifelong bad habits and persistent moral tilts inevitably determine where one falls.
Keywords_AO: kuyyuubisa, mayra, jiguu, amala
Keywords_EN: termite mound, leaning, collapse, habit

Mammaaksa_AO: Samii barartuus, allaattii, duuti lafuma
Translation_Literal_EN: Even if it soars into the high heavens, the bird's death is upon the earth.
Meaning_AO: Namni hammam ol ka'ee yoo boonellee, xumurri isaa lafa fi du'a; uumamni hundi gara biyyetti deebi'a.
Meaning_EN: However majestically a bird soars in the high sky, its mortality ends on the ground; no one outsoars death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ol aantummaan of tuulu gara gad-of-qabuu fi dhugaa jireenyaatti deebisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to puncture arrogance and remind the mighty that all human glory eventually meets the cold soil.
Keywords_AO: samii, allaattii, du'a, lafa
Keywords_EN: sky, bird, death, earth, mortality

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilkeen sossoote, buqqa'uu hin ooltu
Translation_Literal_EN: A tooth that has grown loose will never escape falling out.
Meaning_AO: Wanti bu'uurri isaa laafe fi shakkisiisaa ta'e yeroo booda diigamuun isaa hin hafu.
