Meaning_EN: A loosened tooth is irrevocably destined to fall out; fragile compromises and crumbling ties cannot endure.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hariiroo ykn dhimma bu'uura dhabee diigamuuf ga'e ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to declare that shaky partnerships and rotting arrangements are past saving and will soon dissolve.
Keywords_AO: ilkee, sossohuu, buqqa'uu, kufaatii
Keywords_EN: tooth, loose, extraction, inevitable collapse

Mammaaksa_AO: Turtu turti malee, jalloon gala hin ooltu
Translation_Literal_EN: Though she lingers long abroad, the wayward wanderer will eventually return home.
Meaning_AO: Wanti jallate ykn namni fagaate yeroo fudhatus gara hundee fi dhugaatti deebi'uun hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: Though the errant wanderer tarries indefinitely, truth, origins, and natural order will eventually draw her home.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta yeroof bitaa gale deebi'ee qajeeluuf abdachiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to comfort those waiting for deviated affairs or wayward individuals to finally return to their roots.
Keywords_AO: turti, jalloo, galma, deebii
Keywords_EN: delay, wayward one, return home, roots

Mammaaksa_AO: Baddi galtii baddi galtii, booddeen harree garaa waraabeysaati
Translation_Literal_EN: Straying and returning repeatedly, the donkey's final end is inside the hyena's stomach.
Meaning_AO: Namni yeroo mara of eeggannoo dhabee balaa keessa deddeebi'u dhumni isaa badiisa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: Recklessly straying into danger time and again, the heedless donkey inevitably ends up inside the predator.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama deddeebi'ee balaatti of saaxilu fi gorsa didu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn habitual thrill-seekers that repeated flirtation with peril will soon end in terminal disaster.
Keywords_AO: baduu, galtii, harree, waraabessa
Keywords_EN: straying, returning, donkey, hyena's belly

Mammaaksa_AO: Yar yarii, booddi du'a
Translation_Literal_EN: However much you reduce desires or endure, the ultimate conclusion is death.
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi hammam dheeratullee ykn dararri hammam yoo danda'amellee xumurri nama maraa du'a.
Meaning_EN: No matter how modestly one curtails ambition or endures suffering, the terminal equalizer for all is death.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhiphina jireenyaa keessatti xumura jireenyaa yaadatanii tasgabbaa'uuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a stoic reminder of mortality, helping people find perspective amid daily hardships and fears.
Keywords_AO: yaryarii, booda, du'a, jireenya
Keywords_EN: diminishing, ultimate end, death, stoicism

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka boonanitti, waa hin hafani
Translation_Literal_EN: Things never remain as proudly as people posture.
Meaning_AO: Booranii fi of tuulanii jiraachuun wanta hundee hin qabneedha; jijjiiramni fi xumuri nama eeggata.
Meaning_EN: Earthly prestige and arrogant postures are fleeting; human circumstances never stay permanently exalted.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qabeenyaa fi taayitaadhaan boonuuf gorsa kennanii of tuulummaa dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel proud and powerful figures that their elevated status is temporary and subject to sudden fall.
Keywords_AO: boona, hafuu, jijjiirama, safuu
Keywords_EN: pride, permanence, decline, vanity

Mammaaksa_AO: Biyyaa fi biyye itti debi'u hin oolani
Translation_Literal_EN: To one's homeland and to the soil of the grave, one inevitably returns.
Meaning_AO: Namni biyya dhalootaa isaatti deebi'uun, akkasumas lafa uumamaatti (qabrii) deebi'uun seera hin oolledha.
Meaning_EN: Returning to one's native home and returning to the dust of mortality are two inescapable appointments.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jaalala biyya dhalootaa fi xumura jireenya namaa ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate deep bonds to one's homeland while acknowledging the ultimate universal return to dust.
Keywords_AO: biyya, biyyee, deebi'uu, dhaaba
Keywords_EN: homeland, soil, returning, inevitable destiny

Mammaaksa_AO: Tiruun lafa buute, huuba fuute
Translation_Literal_EN: The tender liver dropped to the ground and gathered dirt.
Meaning_AO: Wanti qulqulluu fi kabajamaa ture yoo bakka gad-aanaatti kufe xuraa'ee gatii dhabuun hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: Once prime, pristine liver falls into the dirt, it collects grime; noble reputations dropped low become tarnished.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama sadarkaa kabajamaa irraa kufee salphate fi qulqullina dhabe ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mourn the disgrace of honorable people whose sudden lapse drops them into contaminating indignity.
Keywords_AO: tiruu, lafa bu'uu, huuba, salphina
Keywords_EN: liver, dropping, grime, sullied honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Guutuun jigu, guutuu hin debi'u
Translation_Literal_EN: When the noble crest collapses, it never returns to complete wholeness.
Meaning_AO: Wanti guutuu fi kabajamaa ture yeroo diigame deebi'ee akka duraatti guutuu ta'uu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: When a towering crown or complete enterprise shatters, no amount of repair can restore its original perfection.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta miidhamee deebi'ee akka duraatti hin tolle fi mudaa qabaatu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an irreparable breach occurs, noting that things may be patched but will never be flawless again.
Keywords_AO: guutuu, jiguu, deebi'uu, badiisa
Keywords_EN: complete crest, collapsing, restoration, flaw

Mammaaksa_AO: Dal'uun lafa buute, huuba hin hanqanne
Translation_Literal_EN: The camel's hump fell to the earth; it could not avoid collecting debris.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi ykn namni kabajamaan yoo kufe xurii fi salphinni isatti maxxanuun hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: When the treasured hump of a camel hits the dust, debris clings to it; fallen majesty cannot escape insult.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ulfinni erga cabe booda salphinni hordofuu agarsiisuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how high-ranking individuals are immediately tainted with ridicule once they stumble.
Keywords_AO: dal'uu, lafa bu'uu, huuba, kufaatii
Keywords_EN: camel hump, falling to ground, dirt, fallen glory

Mammaaksa_AO: Bishaan keessa dhaabadhee, hin jiineen soba
Translation_Literal_EN: Claiming "I stood inside the water, yet did not get wet" is an outright lie.
Meaning_AO: Bakka wanti tokko jiru oolanii fi hojjetanii dhiibbaa ykn qooda isaa irraa qulqulluu of fakkeessuun soba.
Meaning_EN: Saying one stood submerged in the river without getting soaked is a falsehood; you cannot touch corruption clean.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan badaa keessa oolee of qulqulleessuuf yaalu saaxiluuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to unmask hypocrites who operate within corrupt circles while self-righteously claiming total innocence.
Keywords_AO: bishaan, dhaabbachuu, jiidhuu, soba
Keywords_EN: water, standing inside, soaking, inescapable taint

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan hamatanii fi waan nyaatan hin dhabani
Translation_Literal_EN: One never lacks something to slander, nor something to eat.
Meaning_AO: Namni hamachuuf yoo fedhe sababa yeroo hunda argata; akkasumas carraan jireenyaa hin dhumatu.
Meaning_EN: Critics will perpetually invent faults to malign, just as hungry mouths constantly find scraps to chew.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hamii fi oduu namaatiin dhiphachuu dhiisuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss malicious backbiting, reminding the target that gossips will always invent rumors regardless.
Keywords_AO: hamachuu, nyaachuu, dhabuu, arraba
Keywords_EN: slander, eating, endless gossip, cynicism

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan odeysanii fi waan bobeeysan hin dhabani
Translation_Literal_EN: One never lacks rumors to spread, nor dry twigs to burn.
Meaning_AO: Oduun fi dubbiin addunyaa kana irraa matumaa hin dhumu; yeroo mara waatu jiraata.
Meaning_EN: Sensational tales to chatter about will never run dry, just as the wilderness never runs out of wood to burn.
Usage_Situation_AO: Oduu fi afaan namootaatiif iddoo kennuu dhiisuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge indifference toward community chatter, acknowledging that idle minds will forever invent talk.
Keywords_AO: odeessuu, bobeessuu, oduu, dubbii
Keywords_EN: gossiping, burning fuel, endless talk, rumor

Mammaaksa_AO: Wajji dhalataniif, wajji hin hafani
Translation_Literal_EN: Just because siblings were born together, they do not remain together forever.
Meaning_AO: Obbolummaan dhalatanillee, jireenyaa fi xumura irratti namni hundi qophaa isaati.
Meaning_EN: Though brothers share the same womb, each possesses a distinct lifespan, private destiny, and separate grave.
Usage_Situation_AO: Addaan ba'uu fi carraa dhuunfaa jireenyaa obsaan fudhachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to accept the eventual parting of brothers and relatives as they disperse to fulfill their own fates.
Keywords_AO: dhalachuu, wajjiin, hafuu, dhaaba
Keywords_EN: born together, staying together, individuality

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni dayma laaqu, quba numa arraaba
Translation_Literal_EN: A person stirring honey invariably licks his fingers.
Meaning_AO: Namni qabeenya ykn faayidaa guddaa keessa hojjetu qooda ofii fudhachuun isaa hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: Whoever handles rich honey inevitably licks his fingers; those managing lucrative funds will taste the perks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni dhimma qabeenyaa qabu faayidaa akka argatu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to observe that administrators or custodians of wealth almost inevitably take a cut of the proceeds.
Keywords_AO: damma laaquu, quba arraabuu, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: stirring honey, licking fingers, perks, opportunity

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan du'e numa faarsani, kan jiru numa arrabsani
Translation_Literal_EN: The dead are endlessly eulogized, while the living are constantly reviled.
Meaning_AO: Namoonni erga du'anii booda gaarummaa isaanii faarsu, garuu yeroo jiranitti ceepha'uun hin hafu.
Meaning_EN: Humanity hypocritically showers the deceased with saintly praise, while treating living souls with scorn.
Usage_Situation_AO: Haala hawaasni namoota jiraniif gatii dhowwatee erga du'anii jajatu balaaleffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke society's shameful habit of withholding honor while people live, only to flatter them in graves.
Keywords_AO: du'aa faarsuu, jireenya arrabsuu, safuu
Keywords_EN: praising the dead, reviling the living, hypocrisy

Mammaaksa_AO: "Aayyoo baga nagayaan si hiike" jennaan "osoo abbaan kee jiruu maaltu naa hiiqa" jette haati intalaan
Translation_Literal_EN: When told, "Mother, congratulations on safe delivery," the mother replied, "As long as your father is alive, what relief will I ever know?"
Meaning_AO: Sababni rakkoo fi dadhabbii hundee isaa osoo jiruu boqonnaan yeroo qofaa furmaata guutuu hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: Temporary relief from labor is an illusion as long as the primary agent of perpetual toil remains right beside you.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoon bu'uuraa osoo jiruu boqonnaa xiqqoof gammaduu dhowwuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used wryly when people celebrate an ephemeral respite while the fundamental cause of exhaustion endures.
Keywords_AO: aayyoo, hiikuu, abbaa, boqonnaa
Keywords_EN: mother, childbirth relief, father, unending toil

Mammaaksa_AO: Kophee dhiphatteef, miila hin qorani
Translation_Literal_EN: Because the shoe is tight, one does not whittle down one's own foot.
Meaning_AO: Wanta alaa fi salphaa ta'e sirreessuu malee wanta bu'uuraa fi qaama ofii hin miidhani.
Meaning_EN: One does not mutilate one's own flesh to accommodate an ill-fitting shoe; adjust outer tools, not core essentials.
Theme_EN: Protecting the Core vs Adjusting Tools
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma ykn meeshaa alaa sirreessuu dhiisanii of miidhuuf yaalan akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against distorting or damaging core principles and human health merely to satisfy rigid external standards.
Keywords_AO: kophee, dhiphachuu, miila qoruu, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: shoe, tight fit, carving foot, proportion

Mammaaksa_AO: Bayxu bayxi malee, saree ija hin kuulani
Translation_Literal_EN: Bulge though they may, one never applies kohl to a dog's eyes.
Meaning_AO: Wanta uumamaan qajeelaa hin taane faayanii fi bareechuuf yaaluun bu'aa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: However wide and protruding they appear, one never adorns a dog's eyes with kohl; never waste elegance on base nature.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta bu'uuraan gad-aanaa ta'e miidhagsuu fi kabajuuf ifaajamu qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss attempts to bestow refined honors, cosmetics, or dignified status onto crude, unrefined individuals.
Keywords_AO: saree, ija kuuluu, bayxuu, uumama
Keywords_EN: dog, kohl, protruding eyes, futile adornment

Mammaaksa_AO: Okkotetti, gurra hin godhani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not attach ears to a clay cooking pot.
Meaning_AO: Wanta uumamaan hin qabne fi faayidaa hin qabne irratti dabalanii of hin rakkisani.
Meaning_EN: One does not fashion ears onto a spherical clay stew-pot; avoid adding absurd, useless appendages to functional designs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta bu'aa hin qabne fi hin barbaachifne hojiitti dabalanii qisaasessuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against adding unnecessary, ornamental complications to things that function perfectly well in simple form.
Keywords_AO: okkotee, gurra, hojii, ogummaa
Keywords_EN: clay pot, ears, unnecessary additions, design

Mammaaksa_AO: Ifiin jiroon, uuda hin dhayxu
Translation_Literal_EN: Wild pasture weeds never create a bountiful threshing floor.
Meaning_AO: Wanti gatii fi qulqullina hin qabne bu'aa guddaa fi oomisha qabatamaa hin kennu.
Meaning_EN: Spurious wild weeds never yield a rich threshing floor; low-quality stock produces no substantial or edible harvest.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta bu'aa hin qabne irratti hirkachuun kasaaraa ta'uu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to indicate that superficial, inferior materials can never produce real, valuable wealth or reliable nourishment.
Keywords_AO: ifiin-jiroo, uuda, oomisha, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: wild weeds, threshing floor, poor yield, value

Mammaaksa_AO: Ifiin jirootu, bishingaa naa taha jettee hin eeggatin
Translation_Literal_EN: Do not expect wild pasture weeds to turn into sorghum for you.
Meaning_AO: Wanta faayidaa hin qabne irraa waan gaarii fi bu'uuraa eeguun gowwummaa dha.
Meaning_EN: Never foster illusions that useless field weeds will morph into nutritious sorghum; inferior roots cannot yield staple grain.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan gatii hin qabne irraa bu'aa guddaa abdatu gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to caution dreamers against expecting noble outcomes and substantial rewards from fundamentally defective foundations.
Keywords_AO: ifiin-jiroo, bishingaa, abdii, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: wild weeds, sorghum, false hopes, reality

Mammaaksa_AO: Mixaaxis akka nyaata tolutti, udaan hammaata
Translation_Literal_EN: Just as sweet potatoes are delicious to eat, their digestive waste is foul.
Meaning_AO: Wanti jalqaba irratti mi'aawaa fi salphaa fakkaatu boodarra miidhaa fi rakkina fida.
Meaning_EN: As sweet and pleasant as sweet potatoes taste upon consumption, their aftermath brings foul and offensive flatulence.
Usage_Situation_AO: Fedhii yeroof mi'aawaa garuu boodarra rakkina guddaa fidu akeekkachiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn that short-term, sweet indulgences often carry embarrassing, uncomfortable, and troublesome consequences.
Keywords_AO: mixaaxisa, nyaata, udaan, miidhaa
Keywords_EN: sweet potato, eating, digestive foulness, aftermath

Mammaaksa_AO: Goda awwaaldiigeysaa, waraabeysi hin seenu
Translation_Literal_EN: Into the deep lair of an aardvark, the hyena dares not enter.
Meaning_AO: Bakka bineensi jabaan fi bala-qabeessi jiru waraabeessi illee sodaatee hin seenu.
Meaning_EN: Even a hungry, brazen hyena avoids descending into the burrow of the digging badger; prudent predators respect lethal lairs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka balaa qabu fi nama humna qabu dura dhaabbachuu irraa of qusachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn aggressive individuals not to invade the fortified domain of opponents capable of fierce, lethal defense.
Keywords_AO: awwaaldiigeysa, waraabessa, goda, sodaa
Keywords_EN: aardvark, hyena, burrow, lethal territory

Mammaaksa_AO: Harreen duute ja'anii, karaa hin oolani
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying "the pack-donkey has died," one does not abandon the journey.
Meaning_AO: Kasaaraan ykn miidhaan yoo ga'ellee jireenyaa fi imala ofii itti fufuu malee hin dhaaban.
Meaning_EN: One does not cancel an essential journey simply because a pack-beast perished; mission and destiny must press forward.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkinaa fi kasaaraa karaatti mudate dandamatanii karoora ofii itti fufuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to steel resolve, reminding people that setbacks and individual losses must not halt the collective journey.
Keywords_AO: harree duute, karaa, deemuu, murannoo
Keywords_EN: dead donkey, journey, perseverance, resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Adurree godaanna itti hin himanii, meeshaarratti fi'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not announce the migration to a cat; one simply loads it onto the baggage.
Meaning_AO: Nama dhimma murteessuu hin dandeenye marii keessa galchuu dhiisanii akkuma haalatti itti fayyadamu.
Meaning_EN: One does not hold formal consultations with the domestic cat about moving; one merely packs it with the baggage.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama qooda murtoo hin qabne marii dhimma guddaatti dabalanii yeroo gubuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to point out that passive dependents and minor subordinates need only be directed, not exhaustively debated with.
Keywords_AO: adurree, godaansa, meeshaa, murtoo
Keywords_EN: cat, migration, baggage, subordinate role

Mammaaksa_AO: Erbeen re'ee, na duraa ka'ii malee, narraa achi siqii hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A tiny goatskin mat allows "get off me," but offers no room to "slide over."
Meaning_AO: Wanta gabaabaa fi daangaa qabu keessatti bal'ina fi filannoo hedduun hin jiru.
Meaning_EN: A diminutive goatskin rug permits one to stand up and vacate, but has no spare room to scooch over; tight limits offer zero leeway.
Usage_Situation_AO: Iddoo ykn qabeenya dhiphaa keessatti dhimma dabalaa dhiheessuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when resources or space are so strictly limited that compromise is impossible; one must either accept or leave entirely.
Keywords_AO: erbee re'ee, ka'uu, achi siquu, dhiphina
Keywords_EN: goatskin mat, standing up, shifting, strict limits

Mammaaksa_AO: Kal'oon dhaddee, raroo fardaa hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A spiny porcupine skin can never serve as a saddlecloth for a horse.
Meaning_AO: Wanti qoraa fi miidhaa qabu bakka laafaa fi kunuunsa barbaadutti hin fayyadu.
Meaning_EN: Prickly porcupine hide can never cushion a horse's back; dangerous, hurtful agents cannot serve in gentle capacities.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amalli isaa nama waraanu fi miidhu dhimma nagaa fi tasgabbii irratti ramaduu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn against placing harsh, abrasive, or hostile individuals in delicate, supportive, or caring roles.
Keywords_AO: kal'oo dhaddee, raroo fardaa, mijaawina
Keywords_EN: porcupine skin, horse saddlecloth, mismatch

Mammaaksa_AO: Garbuu fi gabra, huddu dhoysani
Translation_Literal_EN: Barley and a domestic servant: their vulnerable rears must be kept secured.
Meaning_AO: Wantoota kunuunsa fi eeggannoo addaa barbaadan sirriitti to'achuun barbaachisaadha.
Meaning_EN: Barley stores and house-servants require vigilant custody; expose either to neglect and you court immediate loss.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya fi qooda ofii akka hin banne eeggannoo fi to'annaa gochuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a traditional administrative maxim urging vigilant supervision over essential household assets and labor.
Keywords_AO: garbuu, gabra, dhoysuu, to'annaa
Keywords_EN: barley, servant, securing, vigilant custody

Mammaaksa_AO: "Bookeen gurra arbaa irra teyse" jennaan, "teysuus maal gooti kaatuus maal gooti" jedhe
Translation_Literal_EN: When told "A gnat landed on the elephant's ear," the elephant replied, "What does its sitting or flying matter?"
Meaning_AO: Wanti xiqqoon fi humna hin qabne waan guddaa irratti dhiibbaa homaayyuu hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: When informed that a tiny fly perched on his massive ear, the elephant scoffed that its arrival and departure are utterly irrelevant.
Usage_Situation_AO: Doorsisa ykn yaalii namoota xixiqqoo isaaniin ol jiran jeeqe hin dandeenye tuffachuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used by powerful figures or great institutions to show complete indifference toward petty critics and powerless agitators.
Keywords_AO: bookee, gurra arbaa, teysuma, tuffii
Keywords_EN: gnat, elephant's ear, landing, insignificance

Mammaaksa_AO: Killa keysatti, bubbee hin kaasani
Translation_Literal_EN: Inside a small wooden milk-bowl, one does not stir up a whirlwind.
Meaning_AO: Dhimma xiqqoo fi iddoo dhiphaa keessatti jeequmsa guddaa uumuun safuu dha.
Meaning_EN: One does not whip up a gale inside a small milk bowl; do not create an explosive scandal within a tiny circle.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma salphaa fi maatii keessaa gara lola guddaatti guddisuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to restrain people from escalating minor disagreements into catastrophic, blown-out community crises.
Keywords_AO: killa, bubbee, jeequmsa, tasgabbii
Keywords_EN: milk bowl, whirlwind, tempest in teapot, restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiiga adarii keysa hin gangalatani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not roll around in the contaminated blood of a wild beast.
Meaning_AO: Wanta xuraa'aa, summaa'aa, fi bala-qabeessa keessa of galchanii of hin balleessani.
Meaning_EN: One does not wallow in the spilled blood of a savage predator; do not submerge oneself in toxic, ruinous conflicts.
Usage_Situation_AO: Balleessaa fi lola badiisa qabu keessa seenanii maqaa fi qulqullina ofii dhabuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel people to keep a wide distance from vile disputes, corrupt gains, and poisonous affairs.
Keywords_AO: dhiiga adarii, gangalchuu, balaa, qulqullina
Keywords_EN: wild beast blood, wallowing, contamination

Mammaaksa_AO: Baaqelaan dhume jennaan, dhuufuunuu gabaabbatte je'e
Translation_Literal_EN: When told "the broad beans are finished," he replied, "then flatulence has also been cut short."
Meaning_AO: Maddi rakkinaa yeroo dhumatu, miidhaan ykn bu'aan isaa inni badaanis waliin dhuma.
Meaning_EN: When informed the bean supply ran dry, he noted that digestive trouble ceases too; removing the source ends the affliction.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanti nama nuffisiise tokko yeroo dhumatu miidhaan isaa inni hordofus baduu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used with wry satisfaction when the exhaustion of a bothersome thing simultaneously eliminates its annoying fallout.
Keywords_AO: baaqelaa, dhuufuu, gabaabbachuu, madda
Keywords_EN: beans, flatulence, ending, removing source

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhuufuu harreetii, funyaan hin qabatani
Translation_Literal_EN: At the passing of wind by a donkey, one does not bother pinching one's nose.
Meaning_AO: Wanta amala uumamaa bineensaa ykn nama gad-aanaa ta'eef dhiphachuu fi nuffuun hin barbaachisu.
Meaning_EN: One does not pinch nostrils in outrage over a donkey's flatulence; do not waste noble dignity on base vulgarity.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta namni gad-aanaan dubbatu ykn godhuuf iddoo kennanii of aarsuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise ignoring crude insults or vulgar displays from inferior minds who know no better.
Keywords_AO: dhuufuu harree, funyaan qabachuu, tuffii
Keywords_EN: donkey flatulence, pinching nose, disdain

Mammaaksa_AO: Arbi qummuuxxoo hin hokkolu
Translation_Literal_EN: An elephant does not limp because of a tiny thorn.
Meaning_AO: Namni guddaan fi jabaan rakkoo fi ceepha'a xixiqqoon hin jeeqamu.
Meaning_EN: A magnificent elephant does not limp from a tiny thorn prick; mighty characters are never derailed by petty irritations.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoonni gurguddoon dhibee xixiqqoof osoo hin jeeqamin hojii isaanii itti fufuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage stalwart leaders to march ahead unbothered by trivial criticisms, minor aches, or petty obstacles.
Keywords_AO: arba, qummuuxxoo, hokkoluu, jabinna
Keywords_EN: elephant, thorn, limping, mighty resilience

Mammaaksa_AO: Sonbaaf, ablee hin barbaadani
Translation_Literal_EN: For slicing soft lung tissue, one does not fetch a heavy dagger.
Meaning_AO: Hojii salphaa fi laafaa ta'eef humna guddaa fi qophii ulfaataa hin barbaachisu.
Meaning_EN: Cutting soft lung meat does not require a heavy war dagger; do not summon excessive force for effortless chores.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma salphaatti xumuramuuf humnaa fi baasii guddaa baasuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise proportional effort, cautioning against using heavy-handed or costly measures to handle simple tasks.
Keywords_AO: sonba, ablee, hojii salphaa, madaallii
Keywords_EN: lung meat, dagger, light task, proportional force

Mammaaksa_AO: Citaa tokkoof, manni hin dhimmisu
Translation_Literal_EN: For the lack of a single blade of thatch, the roof does not leak.
Meaning_AO: Wanti xiqqoon fi hanqinni salphaan dhimma guddaa guutummaatti hin mancaasu.
Meaning_EN: A sound roof does not leak because of a single missing straw; minor cosmetic flaws do not compromise a robust whole.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hanqina xiqqoo ta'eef jedhanii wanta guddaa fi gaarii sana akka hin tuffanne gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure perfectionists that a minute deficit or trivial flaw does not spoil an otherwise magnificent endeavor.
Keywords_AO: citaa, manni dhimmiisuu, madaallii
Keywords_EN: single thatch, leaking house, minor flaw

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaagurri, yoo kanniisa itti naqan malee, muka mukarra taa'u
Translation_Literal_EN: A beehive is just a hollow log resting on a tree, unless bees are put into it.
Meaning_AO: Meeshaan ykn qaamni kamiyyuu hojjettoota fi qabiyyee keessaa yoo dhabe gatii hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: A beehive is merely dead wood sitting in tree forks unless energized by bees; structures are worthless without substance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhaabbata ykn maqa qofa osoo hin taane hojii qabatamaa keessa jiruuf gatii kennuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stress that institutions, buildings, and offices are empty shells unless filled with active, productive labor.
Keywords_AO: gaagura, kanniisa, muka, bu'aa
Keywords_EN: beehive, bees, hollow wood, substance

Mammaaksa_AO: Waabeen nama hin idduu yoo kanniisaa malee, beekaan nama hin tuquu gadi galoo malee
Translation_Literal_EN: A hornet does not sting like a bee, and a wise man never harms unless he has degraded himself.
Meaning_AO: Namni qajeelaan fi kabajamaan sababa malee nama hin miidhu; gad-aantuutu namatti ka'a.
Meaning_EN: A drone insect does not deliver a rich bee sting, and a noble wise man never insults or assaults unless fallen from grace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama beekaa fi kabajamaa ta'ee amala gad-aanaatti dhihaate ceepha'uuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind community leaders that dignity demands forbearance, and only degenerates pick pointless fights.
Keywords_AO: waabee, kanniisa, beekaa, gadi-galoo
Keywords_EN: hornet, honeybee, wise man, debasement

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka dhaba ganda kiyyaa, wadaay kiyyaa wakkiila
Translation_Literal_EN: For total lack of leaders in my village, my simple companion is made deputy.
Meaning_AO: Bakka beekaan fi hayyuun dhabametti namni salphaan akka guddaatti tajaajila.
Meaning_EN: For sheer lack of qualified candidates in our village, my ordinary crony is made chief deputy; scarcity elevates mediocres.
Usage_Situation_AO: Bakka beekaan hin jirretti namoonni gahaa hin taane bakka qabachuu agarsiisuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used with self-deprecating humor when an unqualified individual is thrust into leadership simply because no one else is around.
Keywords_AO: dhaba gandaa, wadaay, wakkiila, sadarkaa
Keywords_EN: village scarcity, companion, deputy, default

Mammaaksa_AO: Wanni tokkotti gale dhume
Translation_Literal_EN: Whatever has dwindled down to a solitary one is virtually finished.
Meaning_AO: Wanti hirkannoo tokkicha qofa qabu balaa keessa jira; waan tokkotti hafuun kasaaraa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Whatever relies on a single surviving specimen is teetering on the brink of total extinction; zero redundancy is perilous.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya ykn carraa tokkicha qofatti amanamuu dhiisanii of eeggachuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge diversification and caution, warning that possessing only one remaining asset leaves zero margin for error.
Keywords_AO: tokkotti galuu, dhumuu, qabeenya, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: reduced to one, finishing, vulnerability

Mammaaksa_AO: Mayri citaa, gobeensa hin caalu
Translation_Literal_EN: The fresh sprouting of thatch-grass is no better than dry acacia thorns.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko bifa haarawaan dhufullee faayidaa fi amalli isaa isa duraanii irra hin wayyu.
Meaning_EN: The tender new shoot of common thatch grass is no more nourishing than dry thorns; novel facades bring no real upgrade.
Usage_Situation_AO: Jijjiirama sobaa isa duraanii irra homaa wayyina hin qabne saaxiluuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dismiss superficial reforms or new faces that boast of change but deliver the same barren, useless results.
Keywords_AO: mayri citaa, gobeensa, madaallii, gatii
Keywords_EN: sprouting thatch, acacia thorns, false upgrade

Mammaaksa_AO: Hammam dheeratu, gurri mataa hin dabru
Translation_Literal_EN: However long it grows, the ear never overgrows the head.
Meaning_AO: Namni hammam yoo guddate fi beekame, maatii, seera, fi aadaa ofii caaluu hin danda'u.
Meaning_EN: However long an ear might grow, it never surpasses the crown of the head; juniors can never outrank their origins.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ijoollee ykn barattoota warra isaanii fi barsiisota isaanii tuffachuuf ka'an adabuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct youth, subordinates, and proteges to remain humble and respect their elders and founding mentors.
Keywords_AO: gurra, mataa, dheerachuu, sadarkaa
Keywords_EN: ear, head, growing long, immutable hierarchy

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan hin jirreef, galmeen gandaan dhaqa jettee boochi
Translation_Literal_EN: Over things that do not exist, the parchment weeps saying "I must tour the village."
Meaning_AO: Wanta qabatamaa hin taane fi hin jirreef iyyuu fi dhiphachuun faayidaa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: The register cries about having to be carried through town over empty illusions; creating theatrical fuss over nothing.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma homaayyuu keessa hin jirre irratti wacuu fi dhiphachuu qaanessuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock people who make enormous public commotions and launch solemn inquests into non-existent, imaginary issues.
Keywords_AO: galmee, ganda, boohuu, waan hin jirre
Keywords_EN: register, village tour, weeping, imaginary fuss

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo ni dhunganna ja'an nama ciniinti, yoo ni ciniinna ja'an nama dhungatti
Translation_Literal_EN: If you offer to kiss her, she bites; if you threaten to bite her, she kisses you.
Meaning_AO: Amala nama faallaa fi fudhatama hin qabne, kan waan gaarii fi badaanillee wal hin simne ibsa.
Meaning_EN: Describing a perverse and erratic personality who attacks gentle affection and repays hostility with sudden affection.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama amalli isaa yeroo mara faallaa ta'ee fi tasgabbii hin qabne ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe perverse, contradictory people who instinctively do the opposite of whatever situation warrants.
Keywords_AO: dhungachuu, ciniinuu, amala faallaa, jeequmsa
Keywords_EN: kissing, biting, contrariness, erratic behavior

Mammaaksa_AO: Owwaatan "si haa oosu" ja'a, usan "si haa cufu" ja'a, way dubbii rabbii
Translation_Literal_EN: If you answer, he says "May it scorch you!"; if you remain silent, he says "May it choke you!"—Oh divine wonder!
Meaning_AO: Haala nama kamiyyuu gammachiisuun hin danda'amne, dubbatanis cal'isanis ceepha'amu agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: An impossible double-bind where replying invites a curse and remaining silent invites another; a no-win predicament.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbatanis cal'isanis balleessaa ta'u dhiheessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when dealing with unreasonable personalities where both compliance and silence are condemned alike.
Keywords_AO: owwaachuu, usuu, oosuu, cufuu, dubbii rabbii
Keywords_EN: answering, silence, scorching, choking, impossible bind

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka hin dubbanne lubbu akka hin dhunganne huddu
Translation_Literal_EN: Lest you speak, your life is at stake; lest you kiss it, it is the buttocks.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina filannoo hin qabne; dubbachuunis lubbuu nama gaafata, callisuunis wanta fokkisaa ta'a.
Meaning_EN: An agonizing dilemma where speaking the truth invites death, yet compliance requires kissing vulgar disgrace.
Usage_Situation_AO: Filannoo hamaa lama gidduutti yeroo qabaman ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when caught in a humiliating bind where survival demands shameful submission and defiance brings execution.
Keywords_AO: dubbachuu, lubbuu, dhungachuu, hudduu
Keywords_EN: speaking, life, kissing buttocks, mortal dilemma

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin, garatti garba taateet qomatti qayra taate
Translation_Literal_EN: In the belly, the matter became an ocean; in the chest, it became a piercing spear.
Meaning_AO: Dhimmi tokko ba'achuu fi garaatti qabachuuf guddoo ta'ee, dubbachuuf immoo waraansa cimaa ta'e.
Meaning_EN: A tormenting crisis: swallowed within, it drowns like an ocean; spoken aloud, it pierces the chest like a spear.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma dhoksuun ulfaatee fi baasuunis balaa qabuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when agonizing over a catastrophic secret that tears one apart inside whether kept hidden or exposed.
Keywords_AO: dubbii, garaa, garba, qoma, qayra
Keywords_EN: matter, belly, ocean, chest, piercing spear

Mammaaksa_AO: Roobaa ka dhufee, sa'aa ka kufee, re'e ta baddee, malli maali?
Translation_Literal_EN: The downpour has broken out, the cow has collapsed, and the goat is lost; what on earth is the plan?
Meaning_AO: Yeroo balaan walitti qabamee karaa hunda nama marsee furmaanni dhabamu.
Meaning_EN: Torrential rain falls, the prized cow is down, and the goat has vanished; multiple disasters striking simultaneously without remedy.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoon hedduun al tokkotti nama mudatee furmaata dhabuu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when emergencies multiply at once, overwhelming all resources and leaving everyone in bewildered panic.
Keywords_AO: rooba, sa'a kufu, re'ee baddee, mala dhabuu
Keywords_EN: rain, fallen cow, lost goat, compounded disaster

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka hin nyaachifne, zangaadaa marqite, akka hin dhiife dhadhaa itti goote
Translation_Literal_EN: So you couldn't eat it, she made porridge of coarse millet; so you couldn't leave it, she poured rich butter on it.
Meaning_AO: Wanta qormaata qabu garuu faayidaa of keessaa qabu kan dhiisuun ykn fudhachuun rakkisaa ta'e.
Meaning_EN: She used bitter grain so you would choke on it, yet covered it with rich butter so you could not abandon it; an enticing torment.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta faayidaa qabaateeyyuu rakkoo cimaa of keessaa qabu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe an enticing offer or partnership that offers genuine profit but comes wrapped in unbearable hardship.
Keywords_AO: zangaadaa, marqa, dhadhaa, rakkina
Keywords_EN: coarse millet, porridge, butter, mixed blessing

Mammaaksa_AO: Ol utaaluuf humna hin qabnu, callisuuf haadha teenyaat du'e, jedhe raachi
Translation_Literal_EN: "To leap up we lack the strength; to keep silent, our mother has died," said the frog.
Meaning_AO: Rakkina cimaa keessatti gadda ba'achuu dadhabanii fi furmaata fiduufis humna dhabuu.
Meaning_EN: "We have no strength to leap out, yet we cannot stay quiet when our mother is dead," said the frog; grief compelled to cry out despite helplessness.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina guddaa keessa ta'anii osoo humni hin jirree iyyuu fi gadduuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when victims of overwhelming oppression cry out in protest despite knowing they lack the power to enforce justice.
Keywords_AO: ol utaaluu, callisuu, haadha duute, raacha
Keywords_EN: leaping, silence, dead mother, frog's lament

Mammaaksa_AO: Irraa ka'uf killee tiyya, irra taa'uf lubbuu tiyya, jedhe raachi
Translation_Literal_EN: "If I step off them, they are my eggs; if I sit on them, my life is at stake," said the frog.
Meaning_AO: Filannoo qabeenya ykn ijoollee ofii baraarsuu fi lubbuu ofii oolchuu gidduutti rakkachuu.
Meaning_EN: "If I abandon the spot, my eggs perish; if I stay, my own life ends," said the frog; the ultimate choice between offspring and survival.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya/maatii ofii fi lubbuu ofii baraarsuu gidduutti yeroo mudatan.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to depict the unbearable struggle of having to choose between sacrificing one's creations or forfeiting one's life.
Keywords_AO: irraa ka'uu, killee, lubbuu, raacha
Keywords_EN: leaving, eggs, own life, parental sacrifice

Mammaaksa_AO: Akka hin nyaanne mimmixaa itti naqxe, akka hin dhiifne dhadhaa itti goote
Translation_Literal_EN: So you couldn't eat it, she loaded it with chili; so you couldn't leave it, she poured rich butter on it.
Meaning_AO: Wanta hawwataa ta'ee garuu gubaa fi rakkina guddaa qabu kan dhiisuun nama dhibu.
Meaning_EN: Seasoned with burning pepper to make it painful to swallow, yet drenched in butter so you cannot bear to walk away.
Usage_Situation_AO: Carraa faayidaa qabu garuu rakkina guddaa wajjin dhufu fudhachuu dhabuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an opportunity is exquisitely lucrative yet loaded with grueling personal suffering and indignity.
Keywords_AO: nyaachuu, mimmixa, dhadhaa, qormaata
Keywords_EN: eating, chili, butter, tantalizing torment

Mammaaksa_AO: Yoo liqimsite haadhaatu du'a, yoo tufte abbaatu du'a
Translation_Literal_EN: If you swallow it, the mother dies; if you spit it out, the father dies.
Meaning_AO: Murtoo kamiyyuu yoo fudhatan balaa guddaa fi kasaaraa hin oolletu hordofa.
Meaning_EN: If you swallow, the mother perishes; if you spit it out, the father dies; an absolute, unresolvable tragedy where every path destroys.
Usage_Situation_AO: Filannoo lamaan keessaa kamiyyuu miidhaa guddaa fiduuf yeroo rakkatan dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe impossible choices where every option inflicts equal, intolerable heartbreak upon loved ones.
Keywords_AO: liqimsuu, tufuu, haadha, abbaa, du'a
Keywords_EN: swallowing, spitting, mother, father, tragic choice

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhaqan shantamaatu du'a, hafan kudhaniitu du'a
Translation_Literal_EN: If you march forward, fifty will die; if you stay back, ten will die.
Meaning_AO: Kasaaraa xiqqaa filachuun dirqama yeroo ta'u; wanti hundi miidhaa qabaatus isa salphaa filachuu.
Meaning_EN: If you advance, fifty perish; if you hold back, ten will die; grim circumstances forcing the bitter choice of the lesser evil.
Usage_Situation_AO: Miidhaa guddaa jalaa ba'uuf jecha miidhaa xiqqaa fudhachuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in military or crisis triage where preserving life requires willingly accepting a painful, smaller sacrifice.
Keywords_AO: dhaquu, hafuu, shantama, kudhan, du'a
Keywords_EN: advancing, staying, fifty, ten, lesser evil

Mammaaksa_AO: Aannan gaalaa, liqimsitu ni duuta, dhiiftuus ni duuta
Translation_Literal_EN: Camel's milk in extremity: if you drink it, you die; if you leave it, you starve to death.
Meaning_AO: Haala rakkisaa kan keessatti furmaanni kamuu balaa hordofsiisu.
Meaning_EN: Camel's milk in extreme conditions: drinking it proves fatal, yet forsaking it brings death by starvation; caught between two dooms.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkina furmaata hin qabne fi gama hundaan nama miidhu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when all courses of action and inaction lead straight to unavoidable catastrophe.
Keywords_AO: aannan gaalaa, liqimsuu, dhiisuu, du'a
Keywords_EN: camel milk, swallowing, leaving, fatal bind

Mammaaksa_AO: Horuu hin dinnee, hoosisu didde
Translation_Literal_EN: She did not refuse to bear young, but she refused to nurse them.
Meaning_AO: Hojii tokko jalqabuu jaalatanii xumuruu fi itti-gaafatamummaa ba'achuu diduu.
Meaning_EN: She did not object to giving birth, but flatly refused to nurse; willing to initiate ventures but shunning daily maintenance.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama dhimma jalqabee kunuunsuu fi xumuruu dadhabe ceepha'uuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize parents, leaders, or builders who love starting grand projects but shirk the ongoing labor of rearing them.
Keywords_AO: horuu, diduu, hoosisuu, itti-gaafatamummaa
Keywords_EN: bearing offspring, refusing, nursing, neglect

Mammaaksa_AO: Harree eegee hin qabne, nama nama hin qabne, jinnii heera hin qabne, Rabbi namarraa haa qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: A tailless donkey, a person without kin, and a lawless demon—may God shield us from them!
Meaning_AO: Wanta to'annaa hin qabne, amala badaa fi jeequmsa fidu irraa Waaqayyo akka nama eegu kadhachuu.
Meaning_EN: A tailless donkey (unsteerable), an unmoored person (unaccountable), and a rogue spirit—may God deliver us from such lawless chaos.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota fi wantoota seeraa fi to'annaa hin qabne irraa of eeguuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used as a fervent plea to be spared from erratic individuals who have neither family reputation, shame, nor rules to govern them.
Keywords_AO: harree eegee dhabdu, nama qofa, jinnii, kadhaa
Keywords_EN: tailless donkey, unmoored man, lawless demon

Mammaaksa_AO: Waa garii "AH"!
Translation_Literal_EN: Some things just leave you with a heavy sigh: "AH!"
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko tokko jechaan ibsamuu kan hin dandeenye, gaddisiisaa fi nama aarsaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.
Meaning_EN: Certain situations are so deeply infuriating, shocking, or sorrowful that human vocabulary collapses into a solitary, heavy sigh.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dubbii fi gochi namaa jecha dhabsiisee aariin nama hudhu.
Usage_Situation_EN: Exclaimed when witnessing folly or betrayal so staggering that only an exasperated, sorrowful sigh can convey the feeling.
Keywords_AO: waa garii, aarii, jecha dhabuu, gadda
Keywords_EN: certain things, sigh, speechless, exasperation

Mammaaksa_AO: Itti himnaan didde, dhooynaan mufatte
Translation_Literal_EN: When advised with words, she refused; when struck with discipline, she acted offended.
Meaning_AO: Nama gorsi hin deebisne fi adabbiinis hin sirreessine; amala diddaa fi mufannaa qabu.
Meaning_EN: Counseled with gentle words, she turned stubborn; reprimanded with physical discipline, she sulked in deep offense; completely unmanageable.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama karaa nagaas ta'ee adabaan jijjiiramuu dide ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to characterize chronically defiant and touchy individuals whom neither gentle advice nor firm discipline can correct.
Keywords_AO: itti himuu, diduu, dha'uu, mufachuu
Keywords_EN: advising, refusing, striking, sulking

Mammaaksa_AO: Itti himan ni diddi, rukutan ni gaggabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: When told, she refuses; when struck, she collapses in a faint.
Meaning_AO: Nama gorsa hin fudhanne garuu adabbii fi qormaata salphaa hin dandeenye.
Meaning_EN: When advised, she haughtily defies; when touched with discipline, she melodramatically faints; stubbornly proud yet spinelessly fragile.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama gorsa dide garuu itti-gaafatamummaa ba'achuu hin dandeenye qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to ridicule people who are aggressively rebellious against wise rules but break down into hysterical victimhood upon correction.
Keywords_AO: itti himuu, diduu, rukutuu, gaggabuu
Keywords_EN: advising, defying, hitting, fainting

Mammaaksa_AO: Asiin hudduu, asiin lubbuu harree eeysaan fe'ani
Translation_Literal_EN: Here the flanks are bruised, here breath is fading—where on earth does one load the donkey?
Meaning_AO: Yeroo madaan fi rakkini qaama hunda qabee bakki hojiif mijatu dhabamu.
Meaning_EN: Here raw wounds bleed, there its last breath falters—where can one possibly pack the load? Facing absolute exhaustion without recourse.
Usage_Situation_AO: Rakkoo fi dhiibbaan gama hundaan nama mudatee tarkaanfii fudhachuun rakkisaa yeroo ta'u.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an individual, institution, or project is so utterly battered and exhausted that placing any further burden is impossible.
Keywords_AO: hudduu, lubbuu, harree, fe'uu, dhiphina
Keywords_EN: buttocks, breath, donkey, loading, total exhaustion

Mammaaksa_AO: "Akkaan itti ragaa sii bahe agartee" jennaan, "akkaan itti si ajaa'ibe wahi agartee" je'een
Translation_Literal_EN: When he asked, "Did you see how boldly I testified for you?", the other replied, "Did you see how appalled I was at your shamelessness?"
Meaning_AO: Namni tokko soba ykn gocha safuu dhabe raawwatee akka waan gaariitti yoo of jajatu, inni biraan immoo qaaniidhaan isa taajjaba.
Meaning_EN: When a corrupt accomplice boasts of how shamelessly he lied, the companion stares in stunned disgust at his utter lack of honor.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama sobaan namaaf ragaa ba'ee ykn wanta fokkisaa hojjetee of faarsu qaanessuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to silence brazen flatterers or corrupt witnesses who boast of their shameful deceits expecting gratitude.
Keywords_AO: ragaa ba'uu, ajaa'ibuu, soba, qaanii
Keywords_EN: testifying, astonishment, shameless lie, disgust

Mammaaksa_AO: Gudii guddaa, marqaan bulee afaan guba
Translation_Literal_EN: A great wonder: porridge left overnight still scalds the mouth!
Meaning_AO: Wanta qabbanaa'ee fi darbe seetanii osoo hin eegin deebi'ee balaa fi gubaa fidu.
Meaning_EN: An astonishing anomaly: porridge kept cold overnight still burns the lips; an old, settled feud suddenly flaring with fresh fury.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dhimma darbee qabbanaa'e jedhamee yaadamu deebi'ee yeroo nama miidhu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an old dispute thought to be thoroughly dormant and harmless unexpectedly erupts with scorching hostility.
Keywords_AO: gudii, marqa bule, afaan gubuu, dinqii
Keywords_EN: wonder, cold porridge, burning mouth, dormant fire

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbayyaan gurri guddaa, bira ga'an bishaani
Translation_Literal_EN: The Blue Nile possesses a terrifying legend, but when you reach its banks, it is just water.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko oduu fi odeeffannoodhaan guddatee mul'atus, dhihaatanii yoo ilaalan salphaa fi uumamaamaadha.
Meaning_EN: The mighty Abbay carries an intimidating reputation from afar, but up close it is merely flowing water; reality deflates myth.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta oduun garmalee guddatee garuu qabatamatti salphaa ta'e ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure people that daunting problems and exaggerated reputations are far less terrifying once confronted directly.
Keywords_AO: abbayyaa, gurra guddaa, bishaan, dhugaa
Keywords_EN: Blue Nile, huge rumor, plain water, reality

Mammaaksa_AO: Roobiin abbayyaa keessaa baatee, fiixessa arraabdi
Translation_Literal_EN: The hippopotamus emerges from the vast Abbay river to lick tiny dew drops.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya guddaa fi madda bal'aa qabaatanii waan xiqqoo fi bu'aa hin qabne barbaacha ifaajuu.
Meaning_EN: A massive hippo abandons the immense waters of the Abbay to lick petty drops of morning dew; leaving abundance to beg for crumbs.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama carraa fi qabeenya guddaa qabu dhiisee waan salphaa duukaa bu'ee of xiqqeessu qajeelchuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock wealthy or privileged individuals who demean themselves by squabbling greedily over petty, insignificant scraps.
Keywords_AO: roobii, abbayyaa, fiixessa, bolola
Keywords_EN: hippopotamus, Nile, dew drops, absurd greed

Mammaaksa_AO: Ilma abbaan daakkii beeku, galaanni fuudha
Translation_Literal_EN: The son whose father is a master swimmer is swept away by the river torrent.
Meaning_AO: Dandeettiin ykn beekumsi abbaa dhalootaan ilmoof hin daddarbu; of eeggannoo dhabuun balaa fida.
Meaning_EN: The son of an expert swimmer drowns in the river; relying complacently on ancestral prestige without personal competence is fatal.
Usage_Situation_AO: Dandeettii fi maqaa maatiitti amanamanii of dagachuu irraa akka of eegan gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn offspring that their parents' brilliant credentials cannot rescue them if they fail to master their own craft.
Keywords_AO: ilma, abbaa daakkii, galaana, eeggannaa
Keywords_EN: son, swimmer father, drowning, complacency

Mammaaksa_AO: Yaa afaan jedhe, fuunyaan gadi ilaalee
Translation_Literal_EN: "Oh, what a mouth!" exclaimed the nose, looking down upon it in disgust.
Meaning_AO: Namni ofii isaatii hanqina qabu nama biraa irratti mudaa barbaaduu fi ceepha'uu.
Meaning_EN: "Oh, look at that repulsive mouth!" sneered the nose looking down; hypocritically scorning a companion while sharing the same face.
Theme_EN: The Pot Calling the Kettle Black
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ofii xurii qabaatee nama ceepha'u qaanessuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose hypocrites who look down on their immediate neighbors' faults while oblivious to their own grotesque defects.
Keywords_AO: afaan, funyaan, gadi ilaaluu, ceepha'a
Keywords_EN: mouth, nose, sneering down, hypocrisy

Mammaaksa_AO: Wahiin arge jette, siibuun amaara argitee
Translation_Literal_EN: "I have seen a miraculous sight!" exclaimed the Siibuu tribesman upon meeting an Amhara.
Meaning_AO: Wanta namoota biraatiif baratamee fi salphaa ta'e namni beekumsa hin qabne akka waan guddaatti dinqisiifachuu.
Meaning_EN: "I have witnessed an incredible wonder!" cried the isolated villager upon seeing a stranger; rustic naivety marveling at the mundane.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama waan salphaa fi beekamaa ta'etti doofummaadhaan dinqisiifatu ibsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used with affectionate satire when a sheltered, provincial person reacts with wide-eyed awe to everyday sights.
Keywords_AO: siibuu, amaara, argaa, doofummaa
Keywords_EN: Siibuu clan, stranger, naive wonder, provincialism

Mammaaksa_AO: Leenci kanaa, faanti mee ree?
Translation_Literal_EN: Here stands the lion in plain view; why on earth are you still looking for footprints?
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan ifatti utuu jiruu ragaa biraa barbaaduun ykn shakkisiisuun bu'aa hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Here stands the actual lion in flesh and blood; why are you still bent over looking for tracks? The ultimate proof is right before you.
Usage_Situation_AO: Ragaa qabatamaa harkaa qabaachaa dubbii dheeressuu fi shakkii uumuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to cut through useless debates when the incontrovertible truth and main evidence are standing right in front of everyone.
Keywords_AO: leenca, faana, barbaaduu, dhugaa
Keywords_EN: lion, tracks, direct evidence, obvious truth

Mammaaksa_AO: Kan argani jettee, cirriin sa'arra kufte
Translation_Literal_EN: Chirping "I found what I saw!", the oxpecker bird crashed right onto the cow.
Meaning_AO: Bololaan fi ariitiin wanta hawwan irratti utaaluun akka nama hin miine of eeggachuu.
Meaning_EN: Crying "I see my prize!", the greedy oxpecker bird plunged recklessly onto the cow; diving headlong into desire without checking risks.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama wanta tokko argee bololaan itti dhihaatee of miidhu gorsuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn impulsive opportunists who rush so recklessly toward tempting bait that they smash into hazards.
Keywords_AO: cirrii, sa'a, kufuu, bolola
Keywords_EN: oxpecker bird, cow, reckless plunge, greed

Mammaaksa_AO: Sirban qaama hunda
Translation_Literal_EN: When you dance, you dance with your entire body.
Meaning_AO: Hojii tokko yeroo hojjetan guutummaatti itti seenanii qalbii fi humna hunda kennuu qabu.
Meaning_EN: When dancing, engage your whole body; dedicate undivided passion and complete energy to any chosen pursuit.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii tokkoof fedhii guutuu fi humna hunda akka kennan gorsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge complete, undivided dedication to a task rather than timid or half-hearted participation.
Keywords_AO: sirba, qaama hunda, hojii, murannoo
Keywords_EN: dancing, whole body, total commitment, passion

Mammaaksa_AO: niin sirbaa fi guntutaan dhoyfadhaan walitti hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Saying "I am dancing" while trying to hide one's breasts do not go together.
Meaning_AO: Wanta ifatti ta'uu qabu tokko hojjechaa safeeffachuu fi dhoksuuf yaaluun walitti hin dhufu.
Meaning_EN: Passionate dancing and timidly clutching one's bosom are completely incompatible; boldness permits no coy pretenses.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama hojii guddaatti seenee garuu waan xiqqoof qaanfatee guutuu hojjechuu dide qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock individuals who enter public, high-profile endeavors yet display ridiculous, inhibiting coyness.
Keywords_AO: sirbuu, guntuta dhoksuu, faallaa, qaanii
Keywords_EN: dancing, hiding breasts, contradiction, false modesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Rifeensa mataa, gam tokko haadanii, gamm tokko hin dhiisani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not shave one side of the head and leave the other side unshaven.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin kamiyyuu guutuu ta'ee xumuramuu qaba malee walakkaan dhiifamuu hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: One never shaves half of a head while leaving the other half bushy; never leave duties lopsided and half-finished.
Usage_Situation_AO: Hojii walakkaan dhiisanii deemuu dhowwuu fi qulqullinaan xumuruu gorsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn leaving projects partially done or executing policies in an asymmetrical, uneven fashion.
Keywords_AO: rifeensa, mataa haaduu, walakkaa, hojii
Keywords_EN: head hair, shaving, lopsided, thorough completion

Mammaaksa_AO: Gam tokkoon coomanii, gam tookkoon hin haarani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not grow plump on one flank while remaining emaciated on the other.
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko yoo fooyya'e guutummaatti mul'ata malee gama tokko qofaan hin ta'u.
Meaning_EN: A creature does not become fat and flourishing on one flank while starving on the other; health must be holistic.
Usage_Situation_AO: Misooma ykn guddina gama tokkoo qofa ta'ee kan biraa miidhe ceepha'uuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to criticize uneven, distorted prosperity where one faction thrives while the other languishes in squalor.
Keywords_AO: cooma, haaraa, madaallii, guutummaa
Keywords_EN: fattening, emaciated, balanced growth, wholeness

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhuufuu fi dalagaan, wal keessa hin taatu
Translation_Literal_EN: Passing wind and serious labor do not belong mixed together.
Meaning_AO: Hojiin kabajamaa fi qulqulluun qoosamaa fi safuu dhabdummaa wajjin wal hin fudhatu.
Meaning_EN: Crude vulgarity and serious, productive industry cannot coexist; disciplined tasks demand respectful conduct.
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo hojii kabajamaatti namoota amala salphaa fi qoosatti seenan qajeelchuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand workers who introduce vulgar antics, clownish distractions, or disrespect into solemn duties.
Keywords_AO: dhuufuu, dalagaa, safuu, hojii
Keywords_EN: flatulence, work, discipline, professional conduct

Mammaaksa_AO: Nama gaangee irra jiruun harka dhiqadhu hin jedhani
Translation_Literal_EN: To a traveler mounted on a mule, one does not say "Wash your hands to dine."
Meaning_AO: Nama deemsa fi imala irra jiru dhimma tasgabbii fi boqonnaa barbaadutti hin waamani.
Meaning_EN: One does not invite a rider mounted on a traveling mule to wash hands for dinner; suit invitations to reality.
Usage_Situation_AO: Nama ariifatee deemsaaf ka'etti dhimma harkifachiisaa dhiheessuu dhowwuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach situational tact, warning against extending leisurely, cumbersome invitations to people in urgent transit.
Keywords_AO: gaangee, harka dhiqachuu, imala, haala
Keywords_EN: mule, washing hands, traveler, situational tact

Mammaaksa_AO: Kiyyaa fi keenyaan tokkoo miti
Translation_Literal_EN: "Mine" and "ours" are never the same thing.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi dhuunfaa fi qabeenyi waliinii garaagarummaa guddaa fi to'annaa addaa qaba.
Meaning_EN: "Mine" and "ours" represent entirely different realms; private ownership brings absolute sovereignty, shared ownership brings compromise.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya dhuunfaa fi kan waliinii adda baasanii beekuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to clarify boundaries, reminding people that collective goodwill can never replace clear, private rights.
Keywords_AO: kiyya, keenya, qabeenya, garaagarummaa
Keywords_EN: mine, ours, private property, collective share

Mammaaksa_AO: Kootiin kan ofii, keenyaan kan warraa
Translation_Literal_EN: "Mine" belongs to oneself; "ours" belongs to the household and kin.
Meaning_AO: Wanti dhuunfaa ofiitiin murtaa'a, garuu kan waliinii harka hundaatiin bulfama.
Meaning_EN: "Mine" is subject to solitary personal discretion; "ours" belongs to the collective household with shared claims.
Usage_Situation_AO: Mirga dhuunfaa fi dirqama maatii walitti dhiheessanii ibsuuf itti fayyadaman.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in domestic settlements to distinguish between personal property and collective family patrimony.
Keywords_AO: kootii, keenyaa, maatii, qabeenya
Keywords_EN: mine, ours, kin patrimony, personal rights

Mammaaksa_AO: Tiyyaan manatti gorteeti, teenyaan hulaa dura dabarte
Translation_Literal_EN: "Mine" turned safely into my house, while "ours" marched past the outer gate.
Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi dhuunfaa mana ofiitti galfama, kan waliinii garuu qoodama dhabee karaatti hafuu danda'a.
Meaning_EN: "Mine" was secured inside my own homestead, while "ours" drifted past the entrance; shared assets easily get neglected.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenyi waliinii akka hin qisaasofne eeggannoo gochuuf dubbatama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate how collective property often perishes through shared apathy, while private goods are vigilantly guarded.
Keywords_AO: tiyya, teenya, mana, hulaa, to'annaa
Keywords_EN: mine, ours, entering house, gate, collective neglect

Mammaaksa_AO: Mana ifii, itti quufuu dadhaban itti dhuufani
Translation_Literal_EN: In one's own house, if one cannot be fully sated, at least one can pass wind in liberty.
Meaning_AO: Mana ofii keessatti bilisummaa fi nagaan guutuu qabaachuun wanta qabeenya caaludha.
Meaning_EN: In one's own home, even when food is modest, one enjoys absolute uninhibited liberty, free from foreign eyes.
Usage_Situation_AO: Qabeenya dhabanis mana ofiitti bilisummaan jiraachuun eebba ta'uu ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used with coarse, earthy pride to celebrate the peace, privacy, and absolute liberty of having one's own humble roof.
Keywords_AO: mana ifii, quufuu, dhuufuu, bilisummaa
Keywords_EN: own house, fullness, liberty, domestic sanctuary

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaan soogiddaa, waan ifii keessaa hafuu hin tahu
Translation_Literal_EN: The owner of the salt does not need to abstain from seasoning his own pot.
Meaning_AO: Namni qabeenya qabu waan ofiitti fayyadamuuf nama gaafachuu hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: The rightful owner of salt need never hold back from sprinkling it into his own food; owner's usage needs no apology.
Usage_Situation_AO: Abbaan qabeenyaa wanta qabutti bilisaan fayyadamuu mirga qabaachuu isaa ibsuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to affirm that the legitimate possessor of resources has undisputed right to enjoy them without seeking permission.
Keywords_AO: abbaa soogiddaa, qabeenya, fayyadama, mirga
Keywords_EN: salt owner, personal wealth, rightful enjoyment

Mammaaksa_AO: Karaa fi karratti, kan lixu tokkuma
Translation_Literal_EN: Whether out on the highway or entering the gate, the one who enters is the same person.
Meaning_AO: Namni amalli isaa alaa fi manatti tokkuma; bakki jijjiiramuun nama hin jijjiiru.
Meaning_EN: Whether journeying on the highway or stepping into the domestic kraal, a man remains the identical character throughout.
Usage_Situation_AO: Namni bakka kamuu yoo deeme amalli isaa tokkuma ta'uu ibsuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to stress that location and circumstances do not alter fundamental character; integrity is the same everywhere.
Keywords_AO: karaa, karra, lixuu, amala tokko
Keywords_EN: highway, gate, entering, consistent character

Mammaaksa_AO: Qanqalloo fi boqqolloo, abbaan tokkuma

Keywords_EN: leather sack, maize, single owner, undivided estate

Meaning_AO: Meeshaan ykn dhimmi tokko nama isa to'achuu fi sirriitti itti fayyadamu beeku qofa barbaada.

Meaning_EN: The whip cried out for its legitimate handler; neglected affairs inevitably demand the return of competent authority.

Mammaaksa_AO: Mataan keetii, rifeensi keetii miti jechuun waa hin fakkaatu

Usage_Situation_AO: Namoota wanta walitti qabame sobaan addaan qoqqooduuf yaalan qaanessuuf.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shatter legalistic quibbles that attempt to artificially separate two inherently fused and inseparable entities.

Mammaaksa_AO: Qumaaxaa qubni faayaa, osolee godni qullubbi
Translation_Literal_EN: To a leper, a remaining finger is an ornament; to a mongoose, wild garlic in a burrow is a feast.

Meaning_EN: To the leper, an imperfect finger-stub is a treasured jewel; to a mongoose, wild garlic in a hole is a royal feast; value is relative.
Usage_Situation_AO: Wanta xiqqoo qaban galateeffachuu fi haala nama dhabee hubachuuf jedhama.
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instill profound gratitude for whatever modest blessings one retains, recognizing that the needy cherish small things.

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan ofii irra kufi, waan namaa xurii mormaa

Meaning_AO: Qabeenya fi mirga ofiitiif murannoon loluu qabu; qabeenyi namaa garuu gatii hin qabu.
Meaning_EN: Perish boldly in defense of your own rightful patrimony; another's property is mere worthless grime that washes off the neck.

Meaning_EN: Even the tongue and teeth bite and clash occasionally; friction is natural and unavoidable among intimate companions and relatives sharing close proximity

Meaning_EN: People are reluctant to be generous or concede to one another from afar; face-to-face interaction and presence are required to inspire generosity and understanding

Meaning_EN: A quarrel among kin is like bleeding gums: you swallow some blood to guard family honor, and spit some out to clean the wound; kin disputes demand delicate balance

Translation_Literal_EN: 'If you magnify me I grow to the size of an elephant; if you let me be I shrink to the size of a flea,' said the dispute

Keywords_EN: dispute; magnifying; elephant; flea; escalation; de-escalation; composure

Mammaaksa_AO: Qarri qara hin muru

Meaning_AO: Ollaa ofii wajjin nagaan jiraachuuf jecha jecha mi'aawaa fi safeeffannaa qofa dubbatu malee, dhugaa hadhooftuu himuun diinummaa waan fiduuf namni fagaatee dhugaa baasa
Meaning_EN: One visits neighbors for polite hospitality and coffee, but to speak hard, uncomfortable truths, one must journey far away; local proximity demands polite diplomacy over brutal honesty

Mammaaksa_AO: Joollee fi beeraatu, dhiira waliin gaya

Meaning_EN: It is children and an honorable wife that truly complete a man and fulfill his life's standing; family and progeny establish a man's domestic dignity and social maturity
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dargaggoo fuudhee bultii akka dhaabbatu jajjabeessan yookaan ulfina maatiin dhiiraaf kennu ibsanitti itti fayyadama

Mammaaksa_AO: Sareen wal loltee waa hedduun nama geessi

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn someone against meddling in unruly disputes between vulgar actors, reminding that interfering in dogs' fights only gets one bitten or dragged into filth

Meaning_EN: Traditional folk saying claiming that a woman will wander by her own intuition and arrive eventually, so giving her directions is futile; reflects traditional gender banter

Usage_Situation_EN: Used in traditional folk banter to playfully observe that women follow their own instincts, arriving at their destination through their own roundabout paths

Mammaaksa_AO: Manni bubbe dhoowwa malee, dubbii hin dhoowwu
Translation_Literal_EN: A house keeps out the wind, but it does not keep out disputes
Meaning_AO: Manni ijaarame qilleensa alaa fi qabbana ittisuu danda'us, komii, aarii fi waldhabdee keessoo maatii jalaa namni dhokachuu hin danda'u; nagaan qalbii manarra murteessaadha
Meaning_EN: A house keeps out the blowing wind, but it cannot keep out disputes; external walls can shelter against cold weather, but they cannot shield a family from internal strife and discord

Usage_Situation_EN: Used when observing that an affluent, well-built home offers no comfort if poisoned by domestic strife, reminding that peace of heart matters more than bricks

Mammaaksa_AO: Loon waraanaa, waraanatti nama geessani

Meaning_AO: Qabeenyi humnaan, saamichaan yookaan lolaan ormarraa dhufe nagaa hin fidu; deebi'ee haloo, waraana fi badiisa biraatiif nama saaxila

Mammaaksa_AO: Wallaalli abbatti beekkomsa fakkaata

Meaning_EN: To an ignorant person, their own ignorance appears as profound knowledge; fools are blind to their lack of understanding and mistake their folly for wisdom

Mammaaksa_AO: "Sobni dhume" jette, tumtuun kasala fixxee
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Falsehood has ended,' said the smith having exhausted her charcoal
Meaning_AO: Namni wanta ittiin nama gowwoomsu yookaan meeshaa sobaa dhabe yeroo qullaa hafu akka waan qulqulluu ta'etti fakkeessuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: 'The deceit has ended,' said the smith upon running out of charcoal; mocks someone claiming moral reform only because their means of cheating ran dry
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni daba hojjetu meeshaa fi carraa dhabee qofaaf akka waan dhugaa filatetti of dhiheessu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock hypocrites who proclaim they have renounced trickery, when in reality their resources or tricks have simply run out
Keywords_AO: soba; dhumuu; tumtuu; kasala; qishnaa; fakkeessummaa
Keywords_EN: lie; finished; blacksmith; charcoal; false reform; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaa dubbatan waaqaatu jaalata, harka dhiqatan garaatu jaalata
Translation_Literal_EN: Speaking truth pleases God; washing hands pleases the belly
Meaning_AO: Qulqullinni afaanii (dhugaan) Waaqayyo biratti eebbifamaadha; akkuma qulqullinni qaamaa fayyaa garaaf tolu, dhugaanis jireenya miidhagsa
Meaning_EN: Speaking truth pleases God, just as washing one's hands pleases the stomach; moral cleanliness delights heaven as physical hygiene nurtures health
Theme_EN: Moral Truth Pleasing God and Cleanliness
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ijoollee fi hawaasa dhugaa dubbachuu fi qulqullina qaamaa eeggachuu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to teach moral integrity alongside basic health, showing that honest speech honors God just as clean hands protect nutrition
Keywords_AO: dhugaa; dubbachuu; waaqa; harka dhiquu; garaa; qulqullina
Keywords_EN: truth; speaking; God; washing hands; stomach; moral hygiene

Mammaaksa_AO: Ciisomni dubbii na dhoowwe, dhugaan callisuu na dhoowwe
Translation_Literal_EN: Conciliation forbade me to dispute, but truth forbade me to keep silent
Meaning_AO: Nagaaf jedhanii callisuun madaalawaa ta'us, dhugaan jirtu garuu dantaa dhabuu dhowwitee nama dubbachiisti; falmii qalbii agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The desire for peaceful settlement forbade me to argue, yet truth forbade me to keep silent; captures the moral struggle between diplomatic peace and vocalizing truth
Theme_EN: Conscience Compelling Speech over False Peace
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni nagaa hawaasaa eeguu fedhu garuu haqa miidhame argee callisuu dadhabee dubbii baasu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an individual is torn between keeping quiet for politeness and speaking out against injustice, choosing moral duty over easy silence
Keywords_AO: ciisoma; dubbii; dhoorkuu; dhugaa; callisuu; qalbii
Keywords_EN: conciliation; dispute; truth; silence; moral dilemma; conscience

Mammaaksa_AO: Ijji baddu imimmaan hin badu
Translation_Literal_EN: Though the eye is lost, tears are never lost
Meaning_AO: Qaamni yookaan qabeenyi yoo dhabameluu, gaddi, miiraa fi miidhaan keessoo itti fufa; rakkina walirraa hin cinne ibsa
Meaning_EN: Even if the physical eye is lost to blindness, tears still flow; material deprivation or physical mutilation cannot extinguish human grief and sorrow
Theme_EN: The Enduring Nature of Grief Beyond Loss
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni balaa qaamaa yookaan qabeenyaa boodas dhiphinaa fi imimmaan keessaa bahuu dadhabu gaddaan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mourn lingering sorrow, observing that taking away a person's assets or vision does not prevent them from weeping over the trauma
Keywords_AO: ija; baduu; imimmaan; gadda; dhiphina; madaa
Keywords_EN: eye; blindness; tears; grief; lasting trauma; sorrow

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaan kaasaa (dhukkubu) hin raffisu, dhugaan hin callisiisu
Translation_Literal_EN: An aching belly allows no sleep; righteous truth permits no silence
Meaning_AO: Akkuma dhukkubni garaa hirriiba nama dhowwatu, dhugaa beekuunii fi qalbii qabaachuunis wanta dabaa ilaaluun callisanii taa'uu nama dhowwa
Meaning_EN: A churning, aching stomach permits no sleep; righteous truth allows no silence; a conscience burdened by truth cannot remain passively quiet before injustice
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko miidhaa fi daba argee callisuu dadhabee afaan baasee haqaaf falmu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to explain why an honest person speaks up against injustice, comparing the moral urge to an aching stomach that drives away all rest
Keywords_AO: garaa kaasaa; rafuu dhabuu; dhugaa; callisuu dhabuu; haqa
Keywords_EN: churning stomach; sleeplessness; truth; unyielding voice; conscience

Mammaaksa_AO: Hamma dhugaan dhufutti, sobni barcumaara teessi
Translation_Literal_EN: Until truth arrives, falsehood sits upon the stool of honor
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan ifa baatee murtii hanga argatutti, yeroof sobni aangoo fi iddoo kabajamaa qabattee boonuun ishee hin oolu; garuu kan yerooti
Meaning_EN: While truth is on its way, falsehood sits comfortably upon the throne; a lie can travel round the world and usurp honor while truth is putting on its shoes
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo warri dabaa fi sobdootaa yeroof aangootti ol bahanii kabajaman, dhugaan akka isaan kuffisu eeggachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel patience during corrupt regimes, reminding that while deceit temporarily occupies high seats, truth will topple it
Keywords_AO: dhugaa; dhufuu; sobni; barcuma; aangoo yeroo; haqa
Keywords_EN: truth; arrival; falsehood; throne; temporary power; patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Kijiba baranaa mannaa, dhugaa bar hegeree wayya
Translation_Literal_EN: Rather than this year's lie, next year's truth is far better
Meaning_AO: Bu'aa yeroo gabaabaa sobaan argamurra, haqa fi milkaa'ina qulqulluu yeroodhaan booda dhufu obsaan eeggachuutu kabaja qaba
Meaning_EN: Better to wait for next year's honest truth than to profit from this year's quick lie; delayed integrity brings lasting honor over instant, corrupt gains
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni bu'aa ariifachiisaaf jedhee soba filachuuf ka'u qajeelchuuf, obsee dhugaa akka eeggatu gorsanitti itti fayyadama

Keywords_AO: kijiba baranaa; dhugaa; bar hegeree; wayyuu; obsa; safuu
Keywords_EN: current lie; next year's truth; delayed gratification; integrity; honor

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaa dubbatanii, lafa aduun namatti lixe bulan
Translation_Literal_EN: Speak the truth, and spend the night wherever sunset overtakes you
Meaning_AO: Dhugaa fi haqa dubbachuuf jecha salphinaa fi baqannaa yoo fidellee hin sodaatinaa; dhugaa qabatanii bakka argametti buluutu ulfina
Meaning_EN: Speak the truth fearlessly, and be ready to spend the night wherever the setting sun catches you; endure exile or homelessness rather than betraying truth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhugaa baasuuf sodaa ormaa qabu jajjabeessanii, aarsaa kamiyyuu fudhatee dhugaa akka dubbatu kakaasanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instill uncompromising courage, commanding an individual to state the plain truth regardless of social ostracism or sleeping out in the bush
Keywords_AO: dhugaa dubbachuu; aduu lixuu; buluu; aarsaa; gootummaa
Keywords_EN: speaking truth; sunset; sleeping out; sacrifice; moral defiance; principle

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaan ganama badde, galgala galti
Translation_Literal_EN: Truth, lost in the morning, returns home by evening
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan yeroo gabaabaaf ganama yoo dhokatteyyuu, guyyaan osoo hin dhihin galgala ifatti baatee gara qe'eetti deebi'uun ishee hin hafu
Meaning_EN: Truth that went missing in the morning returns home safely by evening; temporary confusion or concealment cannot prevent truth's inevitable homecoming
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haqni yeroof micciiramee namoonni dhiphatan, dhugaan galgala akka galu abdachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure someone suffering temporary miscarriage of justice that truth has a way of finding its way home before the day ends
Keywords_AO: dhugaa; ganama baduu; galgala galuu; deebii; haqa
Keywords_EN: truth; morning loss; evening return; homecoming; certainty

Mammaaksa_AO: Hidda mukaa lolaatu (bishaan) baasaa, hidda dubbii dhugaatu baasa
Translation_Literal_EN: Floods expose tree roots; truth exposes the root of a dispute
Meaning_AO: Akkuma lolaan bishaanii biyyee dhiqee hundee mukaa mul'isu, dhugaanis shiraa fi soba qulqulleessee hundee dubbichaa ifatti baasa
Meaning_EN: Just as rushing floodwaters wash away topsoil to expose tree roots, uncompromising truth strips away deceit to lay bare the deepest roots of a dispute
Theme_EN: Truth Exposing the Roots of Conflict
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo falmiin walxaxaa ta'e qoramee dhugaan hundee dhimmaa ifatti baasu dinqisiifachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used by mediators to cut through tangled arguments, noting that patient investigation and truth expose the foundational root of the quarrel
Keywords_AO: hidda mukaa; lolaa; bishaan; hidda dubbii; dhugaa; haqa
Keywords_EN: tree roots; flood; dispute roots; truth; revelation; mediation

Mammaaksa_AO: Rabbiin dhugaarraa karra bane
Translation_Literal_EN: God has opened the wide gateway for truth
Meaning_AO: Waaqayyo dhugaa fi haqaaf karaa fi eegumsa banaa godheera; dhugaan gufuu kamuu cabsitee milkii fi injifannoo argatti
Meaning_EN: God has thrown open the grand gateway for truth; divine order guarantees an open pathway for justice that no human barrier can close
Theme_EN: The Divinely Opened Gates of Truth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni haqa qaban diina dura dhaabbatanii deeggarsa Waaqayyootti amanamanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to declare religious faith in the victory of righteousness, affirming that God clears the path for truth against all obstacles
Keywords_AO: rabbi; dhugaa; karra banuu; haqa; eebba; injifannoo
Keywords_EN: God; truth; open gateway; divine justice; blessing; victory

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaan boru bariiti
Translation_Literal_EN: Truth is tomorrow's bright daybreak
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan abdii gara fuulduraati; akkuma boriin ifa fidu dhugaanis dukkana sobaa dhabamsiisee iftoomina bara baraa fida
Meaning_EN: Truth is tomorrow's certain dawn; no matter how pitch-black today's injustice may feel, truth arrives with the inevitable brilliance of sunrise
Theme_EN: Truth as the Dawning Light of Tomorrow
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni roorroo fi dukkana keessa jiraatan abdii boriitiin akka jabaatan jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage people enduring bleak oppression, affirming that truth is as certain to arrive as tomorrow's sunrise

Keywords_EN: truth; tomorrow; daybreak; light; dawn of justice; hope

Mammaaksa_AO: Abbaaf dhugaa dha, waan nyaatu dhabe, aayyoof dhugaa dha waan kennitu dhabde
Translation_Literal_EN: For the father it is truth, he had no food; for the mother it is truth, she had none to give
Meaning_AO: Rakkina diinagdee keessatti gama lamaaniiyyuu sababa qabatamaa fi haqa qabaachuu; wal komachuun furmaata akka hin taane ibsa
Meaning_EN: It is the plain truth for the father, he found no food; and it is truth for the mother, she had nothing to serve; recognizes mutual, tragic helplessness in poverty
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo abbaan manaa fi haati manaa sababa hanqina qabeenyaatiin wal komachuuf ka'an akka wal danda'an gorsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to defuse domestic finger-pointing during harsh poverty, showing that neither spouse is to blame when external scarcity binds both
Keywords_AO: abbaa; aayyoo; dhugaa; nyaata dhabuu; hiyyummaa; maatii
Keywords_EN: father; mother; truth; lacking food; poverty; mutual understanding

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaan diirama huqqattee galgala gabbatti, Dharti diirama gabbatteeti galgala huqqatti
Translation_Literal_EN: Truth is lean in the morning and fattens by evening; falsehood is fat in the morning and emaciated by dusk
Meaning_AO: Dhugaan jalqaba irratti laaftuu fi dadhabduu fakkaatus boodarra jabaatti; sobni ammoo jalqabarratti boonee dhuma irratti kufa
Meaning_EN: Truth is lean and frail in the morning but fattens by evening; falsehood struts plump in the morning but is withered by dusk; the arc of justice
Theme_EN: The Morning Frailty and Evening Triumph of Truth
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo sobni jalqabarratti milkaa'aa fakkaatu dhumarratti akka kufu fi dhugaan akka gabbatu hubachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to illustrate the changing tides of conflict, noting that while lies enjoy an early sprint, truth runs the marathon and finishes triumphant
Keywords_AO: dhugaa; diirama; galgala; gabbachuu; dhara; huqqachuu
Keywords_EN: truth; morning; evening; flourishing; falsehood; withering; arc of justice

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni waan arge dubbata
Translation_Literal_EN: A person speaks of what he has actually seen
Meaning_AO: Ragaan dhugaa wanta ijaan argame qofaadha; namni qajeelaan oduu namaa osoo hin taane waan qabatamaan arge ragaa baha
Meaning_EN: A person speaks of what his own eyes have witnessed; reliable speech and credible testimony are grounded strictly in firsthand eyewitness evidence
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo seera duratti ragaa bahamu odeessa dhiisanii wantuma argan qofa dubbachuun barbaachisaa ta'e ibsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in legal testimony to insist that witnesses stick strictly to what they personally saw rather than repeating hearsay

Keywords_EN: person; seeing; speaking; eyewitness; testimony; evidence

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaa, waaqa hin dhoksani
Translation_Literal_EN: Truth, one does not conceal from God
Meaning_AO: Waaqayyo wanta hundumaa waan beekuuf, cubbuu fi soba dhoksuun hin danda'amu; qulqullummaa fi amanamummaa qabaachuun dirqama
Meaning_EN: From God, truth can never be concealed; divine omniscience sees into all hidden chambers; human attempts at holy deceit are utterly futile
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni badii hojjete dhokachuuf yaalu, Waaqayyo jalaa miliquun akka hin danda'amne akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge confession and repentance, reminding wrongdoers that mortal lies cannot deceive the all-seeing gaze of God
Keywords_AO: dhugaa; waaqa; dhoksuu dhabuu; qulqullina; amantii
