Mammaaksa_AO: Haqni bakka hin wallaalu
Translation_Literal_EN: Justice never loses its way to its destination
Meaning_AO: Haqni akkuma nama qalbii qabuutti daandii isaa sirriitti beeka; yeroo dheerateyyuu bakka sirrii fi nama isaaf malu bira ni gaha
Meaning_EN: Justice never forgets its address or loses its bearings; truth possesses an infallible compass that unfailingly guides it to its righteous mark
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haqni micciiramee bade fakkaatu, dhuma irratti akka galma gahu namatti himanii abdii jabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reassure someone when legal procedures are dragged out, affirming that justice always finds its proper destination
Keywords_AO: haqa; bakka; wallaaluu dhabuu; qajeelummaa; murtii
Keywords_EN: justice; destination; unerring; infallible; moral compass; equity

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhugaan habbuuqan ni hadhaawa, liqimsan ni mi'aawa
Translation_Literal_EN: Truth, swished in the mouth is bitter; swallowed, it is sweet
Meaning_AO: Dhugaa dura fudhachuun ulfaataa fi hadhaawaa ta'us, erga qalbiin amantanii fudhatanii booda nagaa fi boqonnaa mi'aawaa namaaf kenna
Meaning_EN: Truth is bitter while swished in the mouth, but sweet once swallowed; accepting hard facts hurts initially, but produces deep, lasting peace once digested

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to persuade someone to embrace hard facts and painful realities, assuring them that digesting truth brings liberation and tranquility
Keywords_AO: dhugaa; habbuuquu; hadhaawuu; liqimsuu; mi'aawuu; gorsa
Keywords_EN: truth; mouth; bitter; swallowing; sweetness; digestion; acceptance

Mammaaksa_AO: Miciirratan, bifa jijjiirratani
Translation_Literal_EN: If one wrings oneself out, one changes one's appearance
Meaning_AO: Namni jireenya keessatti qorumsa, dafqaa fi tattaaffii cimaa keessa darbu qofa jireenya isaa jijjiiree milkaa'ina fi bifaa haaraa gonfachuu danda'a

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to motivate someone undergoing demanding trials or discipline, reminding them that hardship is the crucible of personal growth

Keywords_EN: wringing; appearance; transformation; effort; discipline; renewal

Mammaaksa_AO: Darbatan gabbatani
Translation_Literal_EN: By casting away generously, they grew prosperous
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya yookaan yaada ofii arjummaadhaan ormaaf yoo gumaachanii fi dabarsanii kennan, deebi'ee barakaa fi badhaadhina guddaa namaaf fida
Meaning_EN: By sharing, investing, and casting away possessions generously, one ultimately prospers and flourishes; selfless generosity multiplies returns
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni arjummaadhaan harka qalleeyyii gargaaruun deebisee nama sooromsa jedhanii barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage charity and open-handed investment, teaching the paradox that giving away wealth leads to true spiritual and material enrichment

Mammaaksa_AO: Takka liqimsaatu, balaa dhidhimsa
Translation_Literal_EN: A single swallow plunges calamity into the deep

Meaning_EN: A single swallow sinks a looming disaster into the depths; swallowing one's anger or pride for a brief moment averts catastrophic conflict and bloodshed

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge someone on the verge of explosive retaliation to bite their tongue and swallow their rage, preventing a major family or communal disaster

Keywords_EN: swallowing; calamity; submerging; anger; forbearance; de-escalation

Mammaaksa_AO: Waan nama gabbisaa hin beekani
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not know what truly sustains a person
Meaning_AO: Nama tokkoof kan milkaa'ina, fayyaa fi boqonnaa fidu wanta inni hawwu qofa osoo hin taane waan hin yaadamne ta'uu danda'a; carraan dhokataadha
Meaning_EN: One never truly knows what will nourish and elevate a person; true life breakthroughs often emerge from unexpected circumstances or modest opportunities
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko hojii yookaan carraa salphaa fakkaaturraa milkaa'ee sooressu dinqisiifachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when someone finds great success or vitality from an unlikely, modest source, noting that destiny chooses unexpected channels to sustain people

Keywords_EN: nourishing; unknown; sustenance; destiny; unexpected fortune; humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Garaa fi harreen ba'a jaalatti
Translation_Literal_EN: The belly and the donkey both love a heavy load
Meaning_AO: Garaan akkuma harree ba'aa hin nuffineetti yeroo hundumaa nyaata dabalataa barbaada; bololli garaa fi fedhiin qaamaa hin quufu
Meaning_EN: The belly and the donkey both love a heavy pack; physical appetite is as insatiable as a donkey that endlessly bears cargo, always demanding more
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko osoo quufuu danda'uu dabalata kajeellee garaa guuttachuuf fiigu qishnaadhaan ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to satirize people who continually overeat or indulge their material cravings, comparing human stomach capacity to an accommodating beast of burden
Keywords_AO: garaa; harree; ba'aa; jaalachuu; bolola; quufa dhabuu
Keywords_EN: belly; donkey; load; appetite; gluttony; insatiability

Mammaaksa_AO: Liqimsaa guddinaa hin quufani
Translation_Literal_EN: One is not sated by the sheer size of a single swallow
Meaning_AO: Wanta tokko yeroo tokkotti humnaan liqimsuun nama hin quubsu; jireenyi fi badhaadhinni suutuma suuta madaallii qabaatee kan dhufuudha
Meaning_EN: One is not satisfied by the mere largeness of a single mouthful; true satiety and lasting success come from steady, patient nourishment rather than frantic gulps

Keywords_EN: swallowing; magnitude; unsatisfied; rushing; moderation; patience

Mammaaksa_AO: Galaanaatu walitti yaa'a malee, garaan walitti hin yaa'u
Translation_Literal_EN: Rivers flow together, but human hearts do not flow together
Meaning_AO: Bishaan laggeenii salphaatti walitti makamee tokko ta'uu danda'a, garuu qalbii fi yaada namootaa walitti fiduun baay'ee ulfaataadha
Meaning_EN: Rivers effortlessly merge into a single stream, but human hearts do not blend so easily; human nature is characterized by deep individuality and conflicting desires
Theme_EN: Inherent Diversity and Obstacles to Mutual Accord
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni waliin jiraatanis yaadaan wal hubachuu dadhabanii wal dhaban ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when lamenting interpersonal misunderstandings and division, observing that uniting independent human wills is vastly harder than joining rushing rivers
Keywords_AO: galaana; yaa'uu; garaa; walitti yaa'uu dhabuu; qalbii
Keywords_EN: river; confluence; heart; divergence; human conflict; individuality

Mammaaksa_AO: Masluufni, hangam masluufa tahu, nyaata hin hifatu
Translation_Literal_EN: A spendthrift, however reckless, never wearies of food
Meaning_AO: Namni qabeenya isaa hunda qisaasee fixu illee fedhii garaa fi nyaata isaatiif dadhabbii hin qabu; fedhiin qoonqoo hin dhumatu
Meaning_EN: However careless a spendthrift may be with resources, he never grows weary of eating; even the most ruined squanderers retain an active appetite

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock wasteful freeloaders who claim fatigue when work is required, but instantly rally whenever dinner is served

Keywords_EN: spendthrift; squanderer; food; appetite; unwearied; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Haraaraan qoonqoo hin dhumtu
Translation_Literal_EN: The craving of the throat is never extinguished
Meaning_AO: Fedhiin foonii fi dharraan nyaataa hanga lubbuun jirtutti yeroo hunda haaroma malee gonkumaa hin dhumatu; of to'achuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: The craving of the throat never expires; physical appetite renews itself endlessly day after day, requiring continuous moral self-control
Theme_EN: Endless Appetite and Need for Discipline
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni fedhii garaa qofa hordofee jireenya isaa miidhu qalbii akka qabaatu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to counsel discipline over bodily desires, reminding that physical hunger is a perpetual fire that must be governed rather than indulged unchecked
Keywords_AO: haraara; qoonqoo; dhumuu dhabuu; fedhii; of-to'annoo
Keywords_EN: craving; throat; unending; appetite; physical desires; restraint

Mammaaksa_AO: Jaarsaa fi qanqalloon, guutu malee hin dhaabbatani
Translation_Literal_EN: An elder and a leather sack do not stand upright unless filled

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii fi murtiin, kan waaqaa caala
Translation_Literal_EN: In speech and righteous verdict, divine decree surpasses all
Meaning_AO: Beekumsi, haasaanii fi murtiin namaa kamiinuu murtii fi dhugaa Waaqayyoo gadi; haqni dhugaan kan uumaa bira qofa jira
Meaning_EN: In legal deliberation and final verdict, God's decree surpasses all human arbitration; divine justice reigns supreme over all mortal courts
Theme_EN: Supremacy of Divine Judgment Over Human Courts
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo murtiin jaarsolii dadhabamee haqa dhugaa Waaqayyo biratti dhiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to humble human judges and disputants, affirming that earthly verdicts are fallible and ultimate justice rests with God
Keywords_AO: dubbii; murtii; waaqa; caaluu; haqa; seera
Keywords_EN: dispute; verdict; God; surpassing; divine justice; supremacy

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbii dubbii fakkaataa, namaa nama fakkaata
Translation_Literal_EN: Words resemble true speech, just as a bystander resembles a real man
Meaning_AO: Dubbiin hundi qulqullina hin qabu akkuma namni hundi goota yookaan jabaa hin taane; bifa qofaan osoo hin taane bu'uuraan madaaluu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Words superficially resemble wise speech, just as any body resembles a true human; distinguish hollow rhetoric from wisdom
Category_EN: Rhetoric vs. Substance and True Character
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo haasaan mi'aawaa fakkaatus qabatamatti gatii dhabu yookaan namni tokko gowwoomsaa ta'u ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge discernment, reminding people not to be deceived by smooth words or handsome figures that lack true character
Keywords_AO: dubbii; fakkaachuu; nama; qulqullina; madaallii
Keywords_EN: speech; resemblance; man; authentic substance; discernment

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin, hanga abbaan gahe geessi
Translation_Literal_EN: A dispute reaches only as far as its master/advocate can carry it
Meaning_AO: Waldhabdeen yookaan falmiin tokko fudhatama kan argatuu fi bakka kan gahu hanguma dandeettii fi murannoo abbaa dhimmaa sanaati
Meaning_EN: A dispute travels only as far as its champion has the strength and resolve to carry it; the success of a grievance depends on the advocate's stamina
Theme_EN: The Reach of a Cause Bound by its Champion
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni haqa qabu tokko falmii isaa jabeessuu akka qabu yookaan dandeettii isaa madaalu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to remind litigants that justice requires active stamina, showing that an abandoned grievance dies if the claimant lacks the grit to push it
Keywords_AO: dubbii; hanga abbaan gahe; gahuu; falmii; murannoo
Keywords_EN: dispute; owner's reach; advocacy; stamina; legal struggle

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin wallaalaaf na bira kutte jetti malee, beekaati na bira kutte hin jettu
Translation_Literal_EN: The dispute complains 'an ignorant fool bypassed me', but never says 'a wise man bypassed me'
Meaning_AO: Nama beekaatu dubbii toftaadhaan qoratee hundee ishee fura; gowwaan garuu osoo hin hubatin bira darbee wanta hunda mancaasa
Meaning_EN: The dispute says, 'an ignorant fool stepped past my core', but never says that of a wise man; the wise untangle disputes while fools bypass the point
Category_EN: Mediation, Wisdom, and Grasping the Point
Theme_EN: The Wise Grasping the Core vs. Fools Missing the Point
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo jaarsi beekaan hundee falmii tokkoo qoratee furmaata sirrii fidu dinqisiifachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise a skilled mediator who goes straight to the heart of a dispute, whereas incompetent judges talk around the edges
Keywords_AO: dubbii; wallaalaa; beekaa; bira darbuu; jaarsummaa; hundee
Keywords_EN: dispute; fool; wise man; missing the point; arbitration

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbiin tan joollee fakkaatuu fi tan manguddoo fakkaatuu jira
Translation_Literal_EN: Discourse has that which resembles child's play and that which carries elder wisdom
Meaning_AO: Haasaan hundi tokko miti; gariin salphaa fi kan qoosaa yoo ta'u, gariin immoo kan bilchinaa fi murtii jabaa of keessaa qabuudha
Meaning_EN: Speech has two forms: that which resembles frivolous child's babble, and that which carries seasoned elder gravity; distinguish the two
Theme_EN: Childish Frivolity vs. Elder Gravity in Discourse
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo marii keessatti yaada laafaa fi yaada bilchaataa adda baasanii fudhachuun barbaachisutti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used in councils to separate silly, childish bickering from the solemn, measured counsel of experienced elders
Keywords_AO: dubbii; joollee; manguddoo; fakkaachuu; bilchina; qalbii
Keywords_EN: speech; children; elders; maturity; frivolous vs wise; counsel

Mammaaksa_AO: Dubbatan dubbii lamaa, dhiisan ergarama
Translation_Literal_EN: Spoken, it turns into double dispute; suppressed, it turns into internal torment
Meaning_AO: Iccitii yookaan mufannaa jiru yoo dubbatan lola fida, yoo garaatti dhiisan immoo qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidha; qormaata cimaadha
Meaning_EN: Spoken aloud, it creates double dispute; left unsaid, it festers into agonizing torment; caught in the dilemma between domestic explosion and silent ulcers
Category_EN: Dilemmas of Speech and Suppressed Pain
Theme_EN: The Agonizing Dilemma Between Confrontation and Suppressed Pain
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma hadhaawaa tokko baasuu sodaatee garuu cal'isuus dadhabee dhiphatu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an individual agonizes over whether to expose a painful scandal that will ignite war, or bottle it up and suffer solitary torment
Keywords_AO: dubbachuu; dubbii lama; dhiisuu; ergarama; dhiphina
Keywords_EN: speaking; double conflict; withholding; internal torment; dilemma

Mammaaksa_AO: Duudaan gaafa gurra qabu waan dhagaye odeessa
Translation_Literal_EN: The deaf person, on the day he regains hearing, blabs everything he heard
Meaning_AO: Namni carraa yookaan beekumsa haaraa argate of to'achuu dadhabee wantuma argee fi dhaga'e hunda bakkeetti facaasa; dammaqina dhabuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: The deaf man, on the rare day he acquires hearing, broadcasts every single sound he heard; novices gaining new information blab without discretion
Theme_EN: Blabbing Everything Upon Gaining New Awareness
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni iccitii haaraa dhagahe tokko afaan qabachuu dadhabee uummata hundaaf labsu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock people who suddenly gain access to insider information and immediately embarrass themselves by blurting out every detail
Keywords_AO: duudaa; gurra qabaachuu; dhagahuu; odeessuu; iccitii dhabuu
Keywords_EN: deaf person; hearing; blabbing; indiscretion; gossip; satire

Mammaaksa_AO: Duuti sheenaa dhabde hin jirtu
Translation_Literal_EN: There is no death that lacked deep remorse and longing
Meaning_AO: Namni kamuu yeroo du'u wanti inni yaade, hawwii fi gaabbiin osoo hin xumuramin hafuun hin oolu; duuti yeroo hunda sheenaa qabdi
Meaning_EN: There is no death that is devoid of regret; every human departure leaves behind unfinished dreams, unsaid words, and aching remorse
Theme_EN: Universal Remorse and Unfinished Desires in Death
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko osoo karoora hedduu qabuu du'ee maatiin gaddaan yaadu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used during bereavement to comfort the mourning, observing that no mortal ever dies having finished every task and leaving no regrets behind
Keywords_AO: du'a; sheenaa; gaabbii; jireenya; aarsaa; darbiinsa
Keywords_EN: death; regret; remorse; mortality; unfinished life; grief

Mammaaksa_AO: Dura deeman malee, duubaan hin deemani, yoo du'anii dabran malee
Translation_Literal_EN: One travels forward, never backward, unless passing into death
Meaning_AO: Jireenyi gara fuulduraatti deema malee duubatti hin deebi'u; wanta darbeef yaadda'uu dhiisanii gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuu qabu
Meaning_EN: One marches forward, never backward, unless passing into death; life is an irreversible progression toward the future; only corpses are dragged back
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni waan darbe yaadee duubatti harkifatu, jireenyi fuulduratti akka deemu jajjabeessuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to shake someone out of nostalgia or regret, reminding that living beings march forward, and backward movement is only for corpses
Keywords_AO: dura deemuu; duubaan; du'uu; darbuu; fuuldura; jireenya
Keywords_EN: moving forward; backward; death; progression; irreversibility

Mammaaksa_AO: durillee erbe jette tan takkaa jibrii hin qotatin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I've always had rawhide rags,' said she who never planted cotton
Meaning_AO: Wanta bu'uuraa hojjechuu dhiisanii wantuma gad-aanaa fi salphaa ta'e akka waan filannoo ofiitti dhiheessuun qaanii ofii dhoksuu ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: 'I've always preferred rawhide rags,' said she who never planted cotton; making sour-grapes excuses for wearing rags when one simply refused to cultivate
Theme_EN: Inventing Excuses for Poverty Caused by Idleness
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhibaa'ummaa isaatiin hiyyoome akka waan uumamaan qananii jibbuutti of dhiheessu saaxiluuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock lazy individuals who rationalize their poverty by pretending they never wanted comfort, when they simply refused to do the work
Keywords_AO: erbe; jibrii qotachuu dhabuu; dhibaa'ummaa; sababa sobaa
Keywords_EN: rags; cotton farming; idleness; sour grapes; rationalization

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhaba'rra jirtii, dhabaneey mana jirti
Translation_Literal_EN: Deprivation is upon the land, yet the shiftless woman idles at home
Meaning_AO: Osoo beellii fi dhabinsi jiru ka'anii hojjechuu dhiisanii manatti taa'uun hiyyummaa dachaa fida; dhibaa'ummaa yeroo rakkinaa ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: Scarcity stalks the land, yet the shiftless sluggard sits idle at home; idling during a famine compounds poverty into absolute starvation
Theme_EN: Idleness at Home During Universal Scarcity
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni rakkina keessa taa'ee hojii hin barbaaddanne ceepha'anii gara hojiitti oofuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to reprimand able-bodied loafers who sit indoors with arms crossed while hard times demand that everyone hustle for sustenance
Keywords_AO: dhabamuu; dhabaneey; mana taa'uu; dhibaa'ummaa; hojii
Keywords_EN: scarcity; lazy person; sitting home; sloth; economic urgency

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhabduun, diddu of fakkeessiti
Translation_Literal_EN: She who lacks options pretends she is the one refusing
Meaning_AO: Wanta argachuuf humna fi carraa hin qabne akka waan fedhii ofiitiin didaniitti fakkeessuun qaanii dhokfachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
Meaning_EN: She who lacks options pretends to be the one refusing; someone denied a prize or rejected pretends they turned it down by personal choice
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhabuu isaatiin waan tokko dhabe akka waan jibbee dhiiseetti boonu saaxiluuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to puncture the pride of someone pretending they turned down an opportunity or suitor, when in reality they were never offered it
Keywords_AO: dhabduu; didduu; fakkeessuu; qaanii dhoksuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: lacking options; refusing; pretense; sour grapes; saving face

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhabaarraa hin liqeeffatani, kan qaburraa qabsiifatan malee
Translation_Literal_EN: One does not borrow from a pauper; from one who has, one lights a spark
Meaning_AO: Nama homaa hin qabne irraa deeggarsa eeguun bu'aa hin qabu; gargaarsi fi mormiin kan argamu nama dandeettii fi qabeenya qabu biraayi
Meaning_EN: One does not borrow from someone who lacks; from one who has fire, one lights a flame; seek resources and aid from those who possess the means
Theme_EN: Seeking Aid from Those Who Truly Possess It
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko nama rakkataarraa gargaarsa eegee harka qullaa hafu qajeelchuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct people on realistic requests, reminding that petitioning an impoverished neighbor for a loan is a waste of effort
Keywords_AO: dhabaa; liqeeffachuu dhabuu; qabsiifachuu; qabeenya; fala
Keywords_EN: pauper; borrowing; lighting fire; seeking aid; realism

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhiirri dhiirsa hin qabu, kan liqeesseef malee
Translation_Literal_EN: A man acknowledges no master, except the one to whom he is indebted
Meaning_AO: Dhiirri kamuu bilisa ta'ee jiraatus, namni inni liqii irraa qabu garuu dhiibbaa fi kabaja isa dhabsiisa; liqiin garbummaa akka ta'e ibsa
Meaning_EN: A free man recognizes no overlord, except the creditor to whom he owes a debt; unpaid debt is the only force that enslaves an independent man
Theme_EN: Debt as the Destroyer of Male Independence
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namoonni liqii baay'isuun bilisummaa fi kabaja ofii akka hin dhabne akeekkachiisanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to warn men against careless borrowing, reminding them that an unpaid creditor becomes the master who dictates to them and strips their pride
Keywords_AO: dhiira; dhiirsa dhabuu; liqii; bilisummaa; kabaja; qabeenya
Keywords_EN: man; master; debt; creditor; independence; financial slavery

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhukkuba lukkuuti gaala hin qalani
Translation_Literal_EN: For the illness of a chicken, one does not slaughter a camel
Meaning_AO: Rakkoo xiqqoo fi salphaa ta'eef aarsaa guddaa fi qabeenya qaalii hin qisaasani; madaallii furmaataa eeguu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: For a chicken's passing illness, one does not sacrifice a camel; never expend massive, catastrophic costs to resolve minor, inconsequential ailments
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dhimma xiqqoof baasii guddaa baasee kasaaruuf jedhu dhaabsisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise against drastic, wildly disproportionate overreactions, teaching that remedies must match the modest scale of the affliction
Keywords_AO: dhukkuba lukkuu; gaala qaluu; madaallii; qisaasama; aarsaa
Keywords_EN: chicken illness; slaughtering camel; proportionality; overkill

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhukkuba karaa deemu, hashare goromsaan bitatte
Translation_Literal_EN: The sickness passing along the road, she purchased with a pregnant heifer
Meaning_AO: Balaa ormaa isa nama hin tuqne ofitti waamanii qabeenya guddaa itti dhabuu ceepha'a; dhimma nama hin ilaallanne keessa galuu dhowwa
Meaning_EN: A passing illness on the highway, she traded a pregnant heifer to contract it; paying an exorbitant price to import unnecessary, toxic trouble into one's life
Theme_EN: Importing Needless Trouble at Great Cost
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni nagaa qabu dhimma ormaa keessa seenee qabeenyaa fi nagaa ofii balleessu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock someone who meddles in an outside scandal, effectively paying with their own wealth and sanity to invite disaster into their home
Keywords_AO: dhukkuba; karaa; goromsa; bitachuu; balaa ofitti fiduu
Keywords_EN: passing illness; heifer; purchasing trouble; meddling; folly

Mammaaksa_AO: Dhungoo goggoyduun, ilmoo namaa hin guddifne
Translation_Literal_EN: Dry kissing never raised a human child
Meaning_AO: Jecha mi'aawaa fi jaalala afaanii qofaan ijoollee guddifachuun hin danda'amu; soorata, uffataa fi qabeenya qabatamaatu barbaachisa
Meaning_EN: Dry, empty kisses never reared a child; sentiment and affectionate words alone cannot feed or clothe a dependent; parenting requires tangible provision
Theme_EN: Tangible Provision vs. Mere Affectionate Words
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni afaaniin qofa jaalala agarsiisee garuu baasii fi nyaata ijoolleef dhowwatu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to rebuke negligent providers who shower dependents with verbal sweetness while withholding the real food and clothing they need
Keywords_AO: dhungoo goggoyduu; ilmoo; guddisuu; soorata; baasii; maatii
Keywords_EN: dry kiss; child; raising; tangible provision; responsibility

Mammaaksa_AO: Eenyurra dhaabbattee, eenyu hamatta jette dachiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Upon whom are you standing as you slander another?', asked the Earth
Meaning_AO: Hunduu dachee Waaqayyoo irra jiraachaa nama biraa tuffachuu fi hamachuun safuu dha; hundumtuu uumama tokko ta'uu yaadachiisa
Meaning_EN: 'Upon whom do you stand while slandering another?', challenged the Earth; human beings all rest upon the same ground; none has the standing to look down on others
Theme_EN: The Hypocrisy of Slander Among Equals
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni of hin ilaalle tokko nama biraa salphisuu fi hamachuutti ka'u afaan qabsiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to silence arrogant backbiters, reminding them that they stand on the exact same dirt as their victim, with no superior moral foundation
Keywords_AO: dachiin; dhaabbachuu; hamachuu; safuu; walqixxummaa
Keywords_EN: Earth; standing; slandering; equality; hypocrisy; humility

Mammaaksa_AO: Ergaa hamtuun lola fiddi
Translation_Literal_EN: A clumsy, malicious message ignites a war
Meaning_AO: Ergamaan dubbii hin dandeenye ergaa jallisee yookaan jecha hadhaawaa itti dabalee lola guddaa dhalcha; ergaa sirriitti dabarsuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: A tactless or malicious messenger sparks war; delivering messages with hostility, distortion, or harsh arrogance transforms a simple inquiry into conflict
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo ergamaan afaan isaa eeggachuu dhabuun namoota walitti buusu akeekkachiisuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to instruct emissaries to speak with utmost tact and fidelity, warning that a reckless tongue carrying news can set whole clans ablaze
Keywords_AO: ergaa hamtuu; lola; fiduu; quunnamtii; safeeffannaa
Keywords_EN: bad message; war; diplomacy; tact; emissary; conflict

Mammaaksa_AO: Ergaan ergaramaa dha barbaaddi
Translation_Literal_EN: An errand demands patient suffering and endurance
Meaning_AO: Namni dhimmaaf ergame dadhabbii, qorra, beelaa fi qormaata karaa obsaan danda'uu qaba; amanamummaa ergaa agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Running an errand requires enduring hardship and toil; serving as a faithful messenger demands perseverance through fatigue, weather, and hunger
Theme_EN: Enduring Hardship in the Line of Duty
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo nama hojii fi ergaaf bobbahuuf qormaata karaa obsuu akka qabu gorsanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to steel the resolve of a worker or messenger, reminding them that fulfilling an assignment requires accepting necessary discomfort
Keywords_AO: ergaa; ergarama; dhiphina; obsa; amanamummaa
Keywords_EN: errand; endurance; hardship; service; loyalty; duty

Mammaaksa_AO: Fageenyaa hin hafani, yoo wal quufan malee
Translation_Literal_EN: People do not stay away because of distance, unless they are weary of each other
Meaning_AO: Fageenyi lafaa jaalalleewwan addaan hin dhowwu; kan walirraa nama hambisu jaalala dhabuu fi wal jibbuu qofaadha
Meaning_EN: People are never kept apart merely by geographic distance, unless they have grown tired of each other; alienation of the heart is the true divide
Theme_EN: Coldness of Heart as the True Cause of Absence
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko fageenya karaatti sababeeffatee fira yookaan michuu dubbisuu dhiisu saaxiluuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to see through excuses about physical distance, observing that when affection dies, miles become mountains, but love crosses any ocean
Keywords_AO: fageenya; hafuu; wal quufuu; jaalala; hariiroo
Keywords_EN: distance; staying away; wearying; affection; alienation

Mammaaksa_AO: Parda bade, farda jiruun barbaadani
Translation_Literal_EN: A lost horse is searched for using a living horse
Meaning_AO: Qabeenya bade yookaan dhimma rakkisaa furuuf wantuma akkasaatti humna qabuun gargaaramu; jabaan jabaa barbaada
Meaning_EN: A lost horse is tracked down using a living horse; to recover lost assets or solve formidable crises, employ equivalent, vigorous resources
Theme_EN: Employing Matching Resources to Recover Losses
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo dhimma ulfaataa furuuf meeshaa fi humna isa madaalu ramaduun barbaachisutti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to advise allocating proper resources to track down losses, noting that pursuing a fast, escaped mount on foot is futile without a horse
Keywords_AO: farda baduu; farda jiru; barbaaduu; toftaa; qabeenya
Keywords_EN: lost horse; living horse; searching; matching resources; recovery

Mammaaksa_AO: Fira jettee wal yaamti, qullaa wal dhokfatti
Translation_Literal_EN: They call each other kin, yet conceal their nakedness from each other
Meaning_AO: Afaaniin firooma odeessanii qalbii fi iccitii dhugaa garuu wal duraa dhoksuu ceepha'a; firooma sobaa fi amantee dhabuu saaxila
Meaning_EN: They call one another kin, yet hide their vulnerabilities and nakedness from each other; critiques hollow, superficial kinship that lacks true trust
Theme_EN: Superficial Kinship Devoid of Intimate Trust
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo firoonni afaaniin wal faarsanii garuu yeroo rakkinaa wal hin amanne ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose hypocritical relatives who profess immense family solidarity in words, but maintain guarded secrecy and distrust in private
Keywords_AO: fira; wal yaamuu; qullaa; dhokfachuu; amantii dhabuu
Keywords_EN: kin; calling family; nakedness; concealing; distrust; pretense

Mammaaksa_AO: Foon ifii hin nyaanne, allaattiif dhiisani
Translation_Literal_EN: Meat one cannot consume oneself, one leaves for the birds
Meaning_AO: Wanta ofii itti fayyadamuu hin dandeenye nama kaaniif dhiisuu yookaan gatuu; dantaa dhabuu fi qisaasama agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: Meat that one cannot eat oneself, one abandons to the scavenging birds; discarding what could nourish others simply because one has lost appetite
Theme_EN: Discarding Assets Rather than Sharing Generously
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko qabeenya ofiif hin fayyadamne ormaaf kennuu dide wantichi akka badu godhu ibsuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used when an uncharitable person allows surplus goods to rot and feed vultures rather than letting poor neighbors partake
Keywords_AO: foon; nyaachuu dhabuu; allaattii; dhiisuu; doqnummaa
Keywords_EN: meat; uneaten; scavengers; abandoning; dog-in-the-manger

Mammaaksa_AO: Fuudhuun qaanii hin qabu
Translation_Literal_EN: Marrying bears no shame
Meaning_AO: Sirnaan fuudhanii bultii ijaarrachuun aadaa fi safuu kabajamaadha malee yeelloo hin qabu; gaa'ila jajjabeessa
Meaning_EN: Taking a spouse in honorable marriage bears no shame; wedlock is a sacred, lawful institution that brings social dignity rather than embarrassment
Theme_EN: Sanctity and Honor of Lawful Wedlock
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni fuudhaaf qaanfatu jajjabeessanii bultii akka ijaarratu kakaasanitti itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to dispel awkward shyness in bachelors, reminding them that marriage is a noble duty celebrated by the community without shame
Keywords_AO: fuudhuu; qaanii dhabuu; bultii; aadaa; gaa'ela
Keywords_EN: marriage; no shame; wedlock; custom; dignity; family

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafa tolu, ni tottola
Translation_Literal_EN: When fortune favors, everything turns thoroughly pleasant
Meaning_AO: Yeroo carraan namaaf dhufe wanti hundi milkaa'ee nagaan namaaf ta'a; yeroo milkii agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: When fortune turns favorable, every single thing flourishes effortlessly; in seasons of blessing, all enterprises succeed in harmony
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni tokko carraan saaqamee hojiin isaa hunduu haala nama dhibuun milkaa'u galateeffachuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to celebrate a golden streak of good fortune, observing that when circumstances align, every endeavor turns out sweet and successful
Keywords_AO: gaafa toluu; tottoluu; carraa; milkii; badhaadhina
Keywords_EN: favorable day; flourishing; fortune; golden streak; success

Mammaaksa_AO: Gaafa na kaaseen, aayyoo gurguraa karra baase
Translation_Literal_EN: The day fortune lifted me, I drove my mother out to the gate to sell her
Meaning_AO: Namni gowwummaa fi bololaan qabame yeroo qabeenya yookaan carraa argatu wanta safuu hunda dagatee maatii ofii iyyuu salphisa
Meaning_EN: The very day fortune elevated me, I took my own mother to the gate to hawk her for sale; biting satire on instant wealth turning a fool into a monster
Theme_EN: Sudden Wealth Turning Fools into Filial Monsters
Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni qabeenya xiqqoo argatetti of dagatee warra isa guddise tuffatu ceepha'uuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn arrogant nouveau-riche ingrates who achieve sudden success and immediately mistreat, disrespect, or discard their humble parents
Keywords_AO: ka'uu; aayyoo gurguruu; karra; of-tuulummaa; safuu
Keywords_EN: rising; selling mother; gate; hubris; ingratitude; filial betrayal

Mammaaksa_AO: Gabiiba roobee? "jennaan," kan dur roobeefuu harka lafaatti rigata" jedhe
Translation_Literal_EN: When asked 'Did the autumn showers fall?', he replied, 'We are still wiping mud from the last rain'

Meaning_EN: The person tumbling from a tree ponders a thousand thoughts before hitting the ground; the shock of downfall compresses a lifetime of desperate realizations into seconds
Category_EN: Downfall, Sudden Crisis, and Rapid Insight

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to describe the lightning-fast flashes of regret and clarity that flood a person's consciousness during the terrifying moments of their downfall
Keywords_AO: muka; kufuu; lafa gahuu; yaaduu; balaa; gaabbii
Keywords_EN: tree; falling; hitting ground; rapid thoughts; sudden downfall; regret

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni waraabessa yaabbate, koottu siin huddeelladhaa je'a
Translation_Literal_EN: He who is mounted upon a hyena says, 'Come, let me carry you piggyback!'
Meaning_AO: Namni ofii isaatiiyyuu balaa lubbuu galaafatu keessa jiru nama biraatiif dahoo fi wabii ta'uu akka danda'u dhaadachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
Meaning_EN: One riding on a hyena says, 'Come, let me give you a piggyback ride!'; mocks helpless individuals in grave danger offering protection to others

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to mock people whose own affairs are in lethal jeopardy, yet who presumptuously offer to carry and protect others
Keywords_AO: waraabessa; yaabbachuu; huddeellachuu; balaa; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: hyena; riding; piggyback; mortal peril; false protection; absurd boast

Mammaaksa_AO: Namni ollaa fi duugdaan ol ejja
Translation_Literal_EN: A person steps upward through neighbors and clan backbone
Meaning_AO: Guddinni, kabajnii fi milkaa'inni nama tokkoo deeggarsa ollaa gaarii fi jabinna firoota isaatiin mirkanaa'a; tokkummaan bu'uura
Meaning_EN: A person steps upward in status through neighbors and a sturdy kin backbone; social advancement rests entirely on communal goodwill and clan support

Keywords_AO: nama; ollaa; dugda; ol ejjechuu; guddina; tokkummaa
Keywords_EN: person; neighbors; backbone; stepping upward; social rise; solidarity

Mammaaksa_AO: Naggada wallaalteeti, magaalaa komatti
Translation_Literal_EN: She failed to understand trade, yet she blames the marketplace
Meaning_AO: Dandeettii fi beekumsa daldalaa dhabuu ofii dagatanii haala gabaatti sababeeffachuu ceepha'a; hanqina ofii ormatti fe'uu dhowwa

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni dandeettii dhabuudhaan kasaaree garuu naannoo fi orma komatu qajeelchuuf itti fayyadama
Usage_Situation_EN: Used to expose poor planners who fail in business or exams and blame external systems instead of their own ignorance and lack of preparation

Keywords_EN: trade; ignorance; blaming market; incompetence; excuses

Mammaaksa_AO: Natti hin hafin sitti haa hafuu jette dhabduun sungoo facaaftee
Translation_Literal_EN: 'Let it not stay with me, let it cling to you!' said the childless woman scattering rue herbs
Meaning_AO: Gaddi fi dhiphinni ofirra jiru ormattis akka darbu hawwuu; namni carraa dhabe nama biraatiifis carraa gaarii dhowwachuu balaaleffata

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn spiteful individuals who, embittered by their own deprivation, perform malicious acts wishing ruin upon innocent neighbors
Keywords_AO: natti hin hafin; dhabduu; sungoo; facaasuu; hinaaffaa; safuu
Keywords_EN: not on me; barren woman; rue herbs; spite; wishing misfortune

Mammaaksa_AO: Niin gaggabaa mucaa narraa qabaa jettte jaartiin
Translation_Literal_EN: 'I am about to faint, take the child from me!' said the old woman
Meaning_AO: Dadhabbii fi humna dhabuu ofii beekanii ba'aa humnaa olii osoo hin kufin namaaf daddabarsuu; daangaa humna ofii beekuu agarsiisa
Meaning_EN: 'I am swooning, take the child from me!' said the old woman; knowing one's physical limits and handing over delicate burdens before collapse

Keywords_EN: fainting; child; taking child; old woman; physical exhaustion; limits

Translation_Literal_EN: A woman habituated to roaming burns in another's house
Meaning_AO: Nama bakka isaaf hin malle naannawuun amaleeffate balaan yoo mudate salphinaa fi miidhaa guddaa keessa gala; qe'ee ofii eeggachuu barsiisa
Meaning_EN: A woman addicted to wandering outside gets burned in a stranger's house; restless rovers who abandon home eventually get caught in outside catastrophes

Meaning_AO: Qabeenya xiqqoo fi bu'uura hin qabne irratti hirkachuudhaan baasii fi liqii daangaa hin qabne keessa lixanii of kuffisuu ceepha'a

Mammaaksa_AO: Nyaataan nyaatee nama nyaachisa
Translation_Literal_EN: By eating heartily, one feeds and enables others to eat
Meaning_AO: Namni dura of jiraachisee fi humna horate qofa nama biraa gargaaruu fi sooruu danda'a; of dandeessisuun nama gargaaruuf bu'uura
Meaning_EN: By nourishing oneself, one earns the vitality to feed others; you must secure your own strength and sustenance before you can nourish dependents

Keywords_EN: eating; feeding others; vitality; sustenance; provider capacity

Mammaaksa_AO: Obboleettiin koo san dhaltee niin kakadha malee, saniif dhaltee hin kakadhu
Translation_Literal_EN: I swear because my sister bore a child, but I do not swear on the child's behalf
Meaning_AO: Jaalallii fi kabajni fira dhiigaatiif qaban kan nama alagaa wajjin wal hin gahu; dhiigni dhiigaaf dursa kenna

Keywords_EN: sister; birthing; swearing oath; blood ties; clan loyalty

Mammaaksa_AO: Obbollessa akkanaa, nama dhiisii waraabessilleen ni qaba
Translation_Literal_EN: Such a useless brother: let alone humans, even the hyena possesses one
Meaning_AO: Obboleessa yookaan fira faayidaa fi deeggarsa hin qabne, kan gargaarsa malee ba'aa qofa ta'e qishnaadhaan ceepha'a

Keywords_AO: obboleessa; waraabessa; qabaachuu; faayidaa dhabuu; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: brother; hyena; possessing; useless sibling; satire; contempt

Mammaaksa_AO: Ofiifuu ni ciisaa, gaala maa danqita
Translation_Literal_EN: He is lying down inert himself; why bother hobbling the camel?
Meaning_AO: Wanti tokko ofuma isaatiiyyuu dadhabaa fi kan socho'uu hin dandeenye ta'ee osoo jiruu, eeggannoo dabalataatiin of rakkisuu ceepha'a

Meaning_AO: Namni bakka balaa fi qorumsaa keessa boonee oolu dhuma irratti wantuma sanumaan kuffifamee dhumata; balaatti taphachuu ceepha'a

Translation_Literal_EN: While those with thirty teeth sat silent, the man with a single tooth begged for a chew-stick

Meaning_AO: Wanta qabatamaan hin mirkanoofneef dursee qophaa'anii of gowwoomsuu; carraa hin dhufeef jarjaruu balaaleffata

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to defend a homeowner's right to protect their wealth against persistent moochers, noting that freeloaders have no claim on your bread

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to praise sharp minds that comprehend complex realities from faint signals, contrasting them with dense fools who need blunt demonstrations

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to urge finishing what was started, telling a host or partner that having invested the initial effort, withholding the final reward is petty

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to condemn contradictory behavior where a victim seeks remedies for their suffering while flattering the very oppressor who poisoned them

Keywords_EN: medicinal herbs; burning; evil eye; praising; contradictory folly

Meaning_EN: Eating greens, he refused to sleep; eating squash, he refused to speak; critiques impossible, contrary individuals who find pretexts to be dissatisfied with everything

Translation_Literal_EN: God does not deliver the giving hand into destitution

Usage_Situation_EN: Used to encourage generous giving, assuring donors that charity to the vulnerable will never deplete wealth, as God continually restores the giver

Meaning_AO: Wanta harkaa qabanii fi qabeenya naannoo jiruun dhimma ofii xumuruu malee wanta hin jirre hawwuun bu'aa hin qabu; qabatamummaa barsiisa

Keywords_EN: timber; native land; building house; local resources; pragmatism

Mammaaksa_AO: Haatee durbaa jennaan, dur kaa jedhe mucaan
Translation_Literal_EN: When told 'Your mother was once an unmarried maiden', the child said, 'Of course, long ago!'

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo namni wanta namuu beeku akka dhimma haaraatti dhiheessu qishnaan bira darbuuf itti fayyadama

Keywords_AO: haadha; durba; mucaa; dur; waan beekamaa; qishnaa
Keywords_EN: mother; maiden; child; long ago; self-evident; sarcasm

Mammaaksa_AO: Galle, jette lafoon farda jala galtee
Translation_Literal_EN: 'We have returned home!', exclaimed the foot-soldier walking beneath the horse's flank
Meaning_AO: Dadhabbii fi saffisa nama cimaatiin fayyadamaa ofii isaatiis akka waan isa qixxee hojjeteetti boonu saaxila

Mammaaksa_AO: Worruma keennaa harreen hin taane, jedhe namichi booyyee ari'ee
Translation_Literal_EN: 'In our household, a donkey is of no use anyway,' said the man after chasing the wild pig in vain

Usage_Situation_AO: Yeroo michooma gaarii faarsanii fi hiriyaa badaarraa of eeggachuu barsiisanitti itti fayyadama

Mammaaksa_AO: Boriif boorri jiraa
Translation_Literal_EN: For tomorrow, there is another dawn and sunrise
